1337 H@Xx0R.description: Your gobbing is renowned across the galaxy's infospheres, making you something of an urban legend. You gain the @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.feats.Item.abcKcLvAGE5AKig4]{Combat Hack} skill feat. Hackers and frequent infosphere users against whom you succeed at a @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.actions.Item.fz1XOiQr3FJYRxJh]{Battle Gobbing} or Combat Hack check recognize your handiwork, granting you a +1 status bonus to Deception checks to @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.actions.Item.ewwCglB7XOPLUz72]{Lie}, [[/act create-a-diversion]], or @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.feats.Item.01qv8QiKM7S6hHt7]{Legendary Troll} those creatures for 1 minute.
1337 H@Xx0R.name: 1337 H@Xx0R

360 No Scope.description:
Requirements You're wielding a gun.

You fire a trick shot as part of a daredevil maneuver. You @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.feats.Item.WBrg7BsHa8ylkigL]{Parkour}. You can @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.actions.Item.sLikawnrJJzHMYeC]{Aim} and then make a ranged Strike with the gun you're wielding during this movement, including when you're falling.
360 No Scope.name: 360 No Scope

A Different Sort of Fey.description: Radiation and electricity are simply natural phenomena, which might explain your fey-like connection to things others see as science. You can cast @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.spells.Item.rBh2PjtbDGAjbcu6]{Discharge}, @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.spells.Item.Cbj7tDkb2ZTp10Cg]{Electrotether}, and @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.spells.Item.MfsxPjshwZJZuNpN]{Irradiate} once per day each as 3rd-rank primal innate spells.
A Different Sort of Fey.name: A Different Sort of Fey

A Hardor in Motion.description: When you get your powerful legs moving, it's very difficult to stop you. Increase your land Speed by 5 feet. If you move at least 20 feet on your turn, you gain a +1 circumstance bonus to attempts to [[/act shove]] or [[/act tumble-through]] an opponent's square until the end of that turn. You can attempt to Shove a creature up to two sizes larger than you, or up to three sizes larger than you if you're legendary in Athletics.
A Hardor in Motion.name: A Hardor in Motion

A Head for Magic.description:
Frequency once per hour

One of your heads manages the magic, while the other is free to go about your business. You Sustain a spell.
A Head for Magic.name: A Head for Magic

A Life For a Life.description:
You've learned to manipulate the forces of vitality and void to cheat death. Choose one of the following cantrips: @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.spells.Item.RA7VKcen3p56rVyZ]{Forbidding Ward} or @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.spells.Item.SnjhtQYexDtNDdEg]{Stabilize}. You can cast this spell as a divine innate spell at will. A cantrip is heightened to a spell rank equal to half your level rounded up.

Special You can select this feat twice. Each time, you must select a different cantrip.
A Life For a Life.name: A Life For a Life

A Little Piece of Home.description:
Your affinity with the plant life of Kasath has made it so that you can summon it from nearly anywhere.

You gain @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.spells.Item.hk2mTLH9DIvNqDuS]{Verdant Code} as a 2nd-rank arcane innate spell you can cast once per hour. You gain a +2 status bonus to your basic Reflex saves to avoid the piercing damage from your verdant code.
A Little Piece of Home.name: A Little Piece of Home

AbadarCorp Rep Dedication.description:
You've internalized your corporation's culture and strategies, and you're knowledgeable about general business practices. You gain the @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.feats.Item.BocFD2KV0qgUC76x]{Additional Lore} general feat for Business or Corporate Lore.

You can use Business or Corporate Lore instead of any other skill when making a Recall Knowledge check about subjects related to your work, such as goods your company buys and sells, individuals or settlements where you do business, or industry laws.

@UUID[Compendium.sf2e.journals.JournalEntry.vx5FGEG34AxI2dow.JournalEntryPage.CLVCOT4R4PsKCOBC]{AbadarCorp Rep}

featPrerequisites.0: trained in Deception, Diplomacy, or Society

AbadarCorp Rep Dedication.name: AbadarCorp Rep Dedication

Aberrant Shape.description: You can take the form of a terrifying aberration. When you Change Shape, you can choose one of the following: gain the effects of a 4th-rank @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.spells.Item.wzctak6BxOW8xvFV]{Enlarge} spell and 6th-rank @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.spells.Item.Y8Y0LS6sh4pkxPsq]{Eldritch Bond} spell; gain the effects of a 2nd-rank enlarge spell and 6th-rank eldritch bond spell granting three abilities; or gain the effects of a 6th-rank eldritch bond spell granting four abilities. This effect lasts for 1 minute or until you shift back, whichever comes first.
Aberrant Shape.name: Aberrant Shape

Aberrant Thoughts.description: Your mind's functions are alien to most creatures, giving you natural psychic defenses. Any effect that specifically attempts to read your mind to glean information must succeed at a counteract check against the higher of your class DC or your spell DC to do so; otherwise, it gains no information. The counteract rank is equal to half your level rounded up.
Aberrant Thoughts.name: Aberrant Thoughts

Able Assistant.description: You're always prepared to help others succeed in their callings. You gain a +4 circumstance bonus on checks to Aid.
Able Assistant.name: Able Assistant

Above and Below.description:
You and your partner outmaneuver your foes by taking advantage of your difference in size. When you and your ally who's a different size than you flank the same enemy, that enemy takes a –2 circumstance penalty to its DCs against [[/act disarm]], [[/act feint]], [[/act reposition]], [[/act shove]], [[/act trip]], and [[/act tumble-through]] attempts.

@UUID[Compendium.sf2e.feat-effects.Item.lx8R8RLgmxIEkT04]{Effect: Above and Below}

featPrerequisites.0: You have a bond with the Sympathetic Bond feat or dragonkin partner bond feature.

Above and Below.name: Above and Below

Absolute Empathy.description: You find the feelings of your foe to better understand them. You attempt to [[/act feint skill=diplomacy]] against a creature. Unlike a normal Feint, use Diplomacy instead of Deception. You attempt your check against the creature's Will DC instead of its Perception DC.
Absolute Empathy.name: Absolute Empathy

Absolute Unit.description: Your size gives the impression that there's no room to escape. You gain the @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.feats.Item.xQMz6eDgX75WX2ce]{Intimidating Glare} skill feat. Additionally, if you're blocking a target's passage down a hallway or door, you gain a +1 circumstance bonus to your Intimidation checks when you [[/act demoralize]] that target.
Absolute Unit.name: Absolute Unit

Absorb Flame.description:
Trigger You would take fire damage.

You incorporate fire that washes over you into your own flame, burning brighter and hotter for a short time. Until the beginning of your next turn, the area of your solar luminance is doubled, and your next Strike deals additional fire damage equal to half your level (rounded up).
Absorb Flame.name: Absorb Flame

Absorb Magic.description:
Frequency once per hour

Trigger You attempt a saving throw against an area effect with the arcane trait.

You attempt to absorb some of the magic of an incoming spell into your blood. Attempt a counteract check against the triggering effect; your counteract rank equals half your level (rounded up), and for the counteract check, use the higher of your spell attack modifier or your class DC minus 10. If you counteract the triggering effect, you end the effect for all other creatures in the area, but you become @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.4D2KBtexWXa6oUMR]{Drained 1} for 10 minutes as your body struggles to contain the transfusion of magic.
Absorb Magic.name: Absorb Magic

Absorb Vibe.description:
Frequency once per 10 minutes

By touching a friend and concentrating, you can draw in harmful effects negatively impacting their emotions. Attempt a @Check[perception|options:counteract]{Counteract} check using your Perception modifier and a counteract rank equal to half your level (rounded up). If you succeed, the target gains temporary Hit Points equal to your level for a number of rounds equal to your Charisma modifier (minimum 1 round).

@UUID[Compendium.sf2e.feat-effects.Item.GsiH3fTqaDRkR52l]{Effect: Absorb Vibe}
Absorb Vibe.name: Absorb Vibe

Absorbent Plating.description:
Some threats go beyond the physical, and your chitin can adapt to protect you from them. You gain resistance to acid, cold, electricity, fire, or sonic damage equal to half your level.

Special You can take this feat multiple times. Each time you do so, select a different damage type.
Absorbent Plating.name: Absorbent Plating

Accelerated Mind.description: Your synthetic brain makes it difficult for your enemies to assault your mind while ensuring that your thought processing is as fast as the currents flowing through your circuits. You gain a +1 circumstance bonus to saving throws against mental effects.
Accelerated Mind.name: Accelerated Mind

Accelerated Step.description: You can absorb the solar and electromagnetic radiation in your surroundings, transforming it into kinetic energy that propels your body faster. Your Speeds increase by 5 feet. In addition, you gain the @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.actions.Item.P95mzZ3VV40cXbx5]{Light Speed} action.
Accelerated Step.name: Accelerated Step

According to My Calculations.description:
You announce business projections to an ally to benefit them. Make a @Check[business-lore|dc:@self.level] or @Check[corporate-lore|dc:@self.level] check against a DC based on your level. Whether or not you're successful, the target becomes temporarily immune to According to My Calculations for 24 hours. The benefit lasts for 1 minute or until activated.

Critical Success The target gains a +2 circumstance bonus on their next skill check or attack roll.

Success The target gains a +1 circumstance bonus on their next skill check or attack roll.

Critical Failure The target takes a –1 penalty to their next skill check or attack roll.
According to My Calculations.name: According to My Calculations

Acidic Spit.description:
Frequency once per day

You have a specialized gland that produces an acidic compound that eats away at hard surfaces. You spit this acidic compound in a @Template[line|distance:30]. Each creature in the line takes @Damage[ternary(gte(@actor.level,16),11,8)d6[acid]|options:area-damage] damage with a @Check[fortitude|against:class-spell|basic|options:area-effect] save against the higher of your class DC or spell DC.

A creature that fails its save gains weakness 5 to piercing damage until the end of your next turn (this has no effect on creatures with resistance or immunity to piercing damage). At 16th level, the damage increases to 11d6.

@UUID[Compendium.sf2e.feat-effects.Item.9AYamzd9VOGXn8KM]{Effect: Acidic Spit}
Acidic Spit.name: Acidic Spit

Acquire Asset.description: You assess a foe while in the thick of battle by observing their reactions to your attack. Make a melee or ranged Strike against a creature that isn't your asset. On a hit, your target becomes your asset as if you'd used @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.feats.Item.iHzfiebxLxN3ogpH]{Size Up}. On a critical hit, you can also immediately attempt a check to @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.actions.Item.1OagaWtBpVXExToo]{Recall Knowledge} about the target.
Acquire Asset.name: Acquire Asset

Activate All Brains!.description:
Frequency once per day

You put all your brains in a hyperactive state to process dangers. You become @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.nlCjDvLMf2EkV2dl]{Quickened} for 1 minute and can use your extra action only to @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.actions.Item.1OagaWtBpVXExToo]{Recall Knowledge}, Stride, or Strike.
Activate All Brains!.name: Activate All Brains!

Activate Sensilla.description:
Requirements You're standing on a solid surface.

You listen for vibrations through your legs' sensitive hairlike fibers. You gain imprecise tremorsense with a range of 20 feet until the start of your next turn.
Activate Sensilla.name: Activate Sensilla

Adapt to Injury.description:
Frequency once per day

Trigger You're struck by a critical hit that deals physical damage.

Your body's polyps respond to an injury by immediately shedding wounded or dead polyps and regrowing new ones. Attempt a @Check[flat|dc:17]. If you're successful, the attack becomes a normal hit.
Adapt to Injury.name: Adapt to Injury

Adaptable Intellect.description:
Requirements You have access to an infosphere, library, or similar reference collection.

What might take other minds a lifetime to master, you can temporarily absorb through a brief, intense study session. During your daily preparations, you can review literature to gain the trained proficiency rank in one skill of your choice. This proficiency lasts until you prepare again. Since this proficiency is temporary, you can't use it as a prerequisite for a skill increase or a permanent character option (like a feat).
Adaptable Intellect.name: Adaptable Intellect

Adaptable Limbs.description: You grow sturdy lower limbs that allow you to walk on land. Increase your Speed to 20 feet. Additionally, you gain the @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.actions.Item.iIESt0oV0vobl41N]{Adaptive Locomotion} action.
Adaptable Limbs.name: Adaptable Limbs

Adaptable Membranes.description: Your body instinctively integrates foreign materials. You gain the @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.feats.Item.sEb6KmjQVdWNTqiu]{Augmented Body} general feat. If the chosen augmentation deals damage, increase that damage by 1 for every two augmentations you have (minimum 1). If the chosen augmentation gives you resistance to damage or has Hardness, increase it by 1 for every two augmentations you have (minimum 1).
Adaptable Membranes.name: Adaptable Membranes

Adapted Augmentations.description: You embrace ultimate adaptation by integrating cutting-edge augmentations into your body. Choose one common augmentation with an item level of 1 or less. You begin with this augmentation already installed in your body (you don't need to pay the credits to purchase this starting augmentation). This augmentation doesn't count toward your implant limit.
Adapted Augmentations.name: Adapted Augmentations

Adapted Cantrip.description:
Through study of multiple magical traditions, you've altered a spell to suit your spellcasting style. Choose one cantrip from a magical tradition other than your own. If you prepare spells, you can choose this spell when you prepare your cantrips, in addition to your other options. If you have a spell repertoire, replace one of your cantrips known with the chosen spell. You can cast this cantrip as a spell of your class's tradition.

If you swap or retrain this cantrip later, you can choose its replacement from the same alternate tradition or a different one.
Adapted Cantrip.name: Adapted Cantrip

Adapted Underwater Brawler.description: You've learned how to wield nearly any weapon effectively while underwater. You don't take the –2 penalty for making melee slashing or bludgeoning Strikes while underwater. Your ranged attacks aren't affected by being underwater. You can use weapons that deal fire damage underwater.
Adapted Underwater Brawler.name: Adapted Underwater Brawler

Adaptive Adept.description: You've continued adapting your magic to blend your class's tradition with your adapted tradition. Choose a cantrip or 1st-rank spell from the same magical tradition as your cantrip from Adapted Cantrip. You gain that spell, adding it to your spell options just like the cantrip from Adapted Cantrip. You can cast this spell as a spell of your class's magical tradition. If you choose a 1st-rank spell, you don't gain access to the heightened versions of that spell, meaning you can't prepare them if you prepare spells and you can't learn them or select the spell as a signature spell if you have a spell repertoire.
Adaptive Adept.name: Adaptive Adept

Adaptive Coagulation.description:
Frequency once per day

You can coagulate your oozy body to respond to different types of ongoing harm. Attempt a @Check[flat|dc:15]; on a success, you recover from any ongoing persistent damage. Additionally, you gain resistance to each type of persistent damage you had when you used Adaptive Coagulation equal to half your level for 1 minute.
Adaptive Coagulation.name: Adaptive Coagulation

Adaptive Defense.description:
You prepare your vitality network to catch some of your excess magic, allowing it to flow back and bolster your bond's defenses. If the next action you use is to Cast a Spell that deals damage, whether or not it successfully deals damage, you and one bonded ally gain resistance to that spell's type of damage equal to the spell's rank (minimum 1) until the end of your next turn. If the spell deals more than one type of damage, choose one and gain resistance to that type.

@UUID[Compendium.sf2e.feat-effects.Item.qbnXMOmVMMKphIgg]{Effect: Adaptive Defense}
Adaptive Defense.name: Adaptive Defense

Adaptive Dermis.description:
Frequency once per hour

Trigger You take acid, cold, electricity, fire, poison, sonic, or void damage.

You've recently developed a new mutation: flesh that rapidly adapts to hazardous environments—for a time. You gain resistance 5 against the triggering damage type for 1 hour.
Adaptive Dermis.name: Adaptive Dermis

Adaptive Echolocation.description: You can emit sound waves and sense your environment as it's reflected by objects around you. When you take the [[/act seek]] action, you can use hearing as a precise sense with a range of 40 feet until the start of your next turn. You can also use this sense while you @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.actions.Item.TiNDYUGlMmxzxBYU]{Search}.
Adaptive Echolocation.name: Adaptive Echolocation

Adaptive Resistance.description:
Frequency once every 10 minutes

Requirements Your last action was a successful tentacle Strike against a living creature.

You absorb fragments of the genetic code and psychic energy of living creatures through your tentacles to temporarily augment your abilities.

Pick one damage type that your target is resistant or immune to. You gain resistance to that damage type equal to half your level for 1 minute. If the creature has a compound resistance or immunity, pick one damage type; for example, if a creature is resistant to all physical damage, you could pick bludgeoning, piercing, or slashing.

If you don't know the target's resistances or immunities, you gain a resistance chosen at random. If the target has no immunities or resistances, you gain no resistance, and this use doesn't count against Adaptive Resistance's frequency.
Adaptive Resistance.name: Adaptive Resistance

Adaptive Talent.description:
You gain the @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.class-features.Item.9nO9EkhE1TiS0Yh6]{Adaptive Talent} class feature, but you do not gain additional skill feats at higher levels.

Special You can select this feat a second time as a 10th level feat and a 16th level feat, increasing the number of skill feats you gain using adaptive talent by 1.
Adaptive Talent.name: Adaptive Talent

Adat Training.description:
You have studied the art of adat—the kasathan mystical technique of preserving a slice of brain from a deceased intelligent creature and establishing a technomagical link to the creature's soul. The kasathan Doyenate use these to preserve the wisdom of their ancestors, and you've adapted their technique for use in the field to draw important information out of a target or send disorienting messages to a target's mind.

You gain @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.spells.Item.eHiWtMiXoI1d48A7]{Holographic Memory} and @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.spells.Item.qkehzRdn7JeGrR6E]{Void Whispers} as 3rd-rank divine innate spells. You can cast each spell once per day, and when you cast holographic memory, you can extract a memory of up to 10 minutes instead of 5 minutes.
Adat Training.name: Adat Training

Additional Lore.description:
Your knowledge has expanded to encompass a new field. Choose a Lore skill subcategory. You become trained in it. At 3rd, 7th, and 15th levels, you gain an additional skill increase you can apply only to the chosen Lore subcategory.

Special You can select this feat more than once. Each time you must select a new subcategory of Lore and you gain the additional skill increases to that subcategory for the listed levels.
Additional Lore.name: Additional Lore

Adhering Acid.description: You mix your sticky, corrosive resin with certain weapons and spells. The next time this turn you Strike with a spell or weapon, one creature that takes non-persistent acid damage from the Strike becomes @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.i3OJZU2nk64Df3xm]{Clumsy 1} until the start of your next turn, then becomes immune to Adhering Acid for 24 hours.
Adhering Acid.name: Adhering Acid

Adhesive Grip.description: Your sticky mucous lets you hang onto foes with a painfully tenacious grip. When you roll a critical failure on a check to [[/act grapple]] a target, you get a failure instead. In addition, when a creature you've @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.kWc1fhmv9LBiTuei]{Grabbed} rolls a failure on its check to Escape, it gets a critical failure instead, and if it rolls a critical success, it gets a success instead.
Adhesive Grip.name: Adhesive Grip

Adjust Gravity.description:
Your connection to the gravitational forces of copi allows you to temporarily alter gravity's effects on your body. You treat gravity as being one step higher or lower (for example, low gravity becomes standard gravity, or standard gravity becomes high gravity), but you can't Adjust Gravity to extreme or zero gravity. This only affects you, your gear, and your movement. This lasts until the end of your next turn if you adjust from extreme or zero gravity; otherwise, it lasts 1 hour, until you Adjust Gravity again, or until you enter an environment with a different gravity, whichever comes first.

At 13th level, you can adjust gravity to zero gravity or extreme gravity. At 17th level, you can lower or raise the gravity level by up to two steps.
Adjust Gravity.name: Adjust Gravity

Admixture Breath.description:
Your internal chemical balance is adaptable, allowing you to control the composition of your normally flaming expulsions. When you use @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.ancestry-features.Item.jjVH7W3IhgaJ5Yct]{Fire Breath}, you can choose to deal acid or cold damage instead of fire damage.

Special If you're a mystic with the @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.class-features.Item.AurhNoZmNNhHktx6]{Elemental} connection, you can also choose bludgeoning, electricity, or poison damage instead of fire damage.
Admixture Breath.name: Admixture Breath

Adopted Ancestry.description: You're fully immersed in another ancestry's culture and traditions, whether born into them, earned through rite of passage, or bonded through a deep friendship or romance. Choose a common ancestry or another ancestry to which you have access. You can select ancestry feats from the ancestry you chose, in addition to your character's own ancestry, as long as the ancestry feats don't require any physiological feature that you lack, as determined by the GM.
Adopted Ancestry.name: Adopted Ancestry

Adopted Overlords.description:
Your ancestors served the Veskarium for countless generations. You've incorporated vesk traditions into your own life, and the Veskarium has freely shared its secrets with you.

You gain the @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.feats.Item.ihN8gkHSdPG9Trte]{Adopted Ancestry} general feat and must choose vesk. You gain a 1st-level @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.ancestries.Item.06FBb4UDg64S5AYI]{Vesk} ancestry feat for which you qualify, and your mantle grows tougher. Increase your resistance to precision damage by 2.
Adopted Overlords.name: Adopted Overlords

Adopted Talents.description:
Requirements You have a bonded partner.

Since becoming bonded with your partner, you've learned a lot about them, and you're beginning to pick up their habits, interests, and knowledge. You gain the @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.feats.Item.ihN8gkHSdPG9Trte]{Adopted Ancestry}, but you must select the ancestry of your bonded partner. You also gain one 1st-level ancestry feat from the ancestry you chose for Adopted Ancestry.

Special You must have a permanent partner bond to select this feat, meaning you can't be a mercurial dragonkin.
Adopted Talents.name: Adopted Talents

Adorable Face.description: Your big-eyed, pleading look melts hard hearts. You gain your choice of the @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.feats.Item.B6HbYsLBWb1RR6Fx]{Charming Liar} or @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.feats.Item.4RjDxgvNXNl5GG9d]{Hobnobber} skill feats, even if you don't meet the feat's prerequisites. Additionally, you gain a +1 circumstance bonus to initiative rolls when you use Deception or Diplomacy for initiative.
Adorable Face.name: Adorable Face

Adrenaline Rush.description:
Frequency once per hour

Trigger You roll initiative.

Danger gives you a rush. For 1 minute, you ignore the encumbered condition and gain a +2 circumstance bonus to your Athletics checks. While you are not encumbered, you gain a +5-foot circumstance bonus to your Speed for the duration.
Adrenaline Rush.name: Adrenaline Rush

Advanced Atmospheric Flight.description: You've become more adept at using your energy wings within an atmosphere. @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.feats.Item.wZyBTTRM2BjC93gg]{Atmospheric Flight} no longer has a frequency and can be used as often as desired. When you use Atmospheric Flight, your wings remain manifested until you spend a single action to purposefully dismiss them.
Advanced Atmospheric Flight.name: Advanced Atmospheric Flight

Advanced Design Specialization.description: You're able to unlock dormant abilities in your design. Choose an android heritage. You gain all of its mechanical effects. You count as having that heritage for the purposes of qualifying for feats.
Advanced Design Specialization.name: Advanced Design Specialization

Advanced Distortion.description:
You gain one witchwarper feat. For the purpose of meeting its prerequisites, your witchwarper level is half your character level.

Special You can select this feat more than once. Each time you do, you gain another witchwarper feat.
Advanced Distortion.name: Advanced Distortion

Advanced Epiphany.description: You gain a deeper understanding of your connection. You gain the advanced epiphany spell for your chosen connection.
Advanced Epiphany.name: Advanced Epiphany

Advanced First Aid.description: You use your medical training to ameliorate sickness or assuage fears. When you use Medicine to @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.actions.Item.MHLuKy4nQO2Z4Am1]{Administer First Aid}, instead of Stabilizing a character or Stopping Bleeding, you can reduce an ally's @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{Frightened} or @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.fesd1n5eVhpCSS18]{Sickened} condition by 2, or remove either of those conditions entirely on a critical success. You can remove only one condition at a time. The DC for the Medicine check is usually the DC of the effect that caused the condition.
Advanced First Aid.name: Advanced First Aid

Advanced General Training.description:
Over the long course of your adventuring life, your adaptability has let you pick up numerous useful abilities. You gain a general feat of 7th level or lower. You must meet the feat's prerequisites.

Special You can select this feat multiple times, choosing a different feat each time.
Advanced General Training.name: Advanced General Training

Advanced Gunner.description:
You gain one operative feat. For the purpose of meeting its prerequisites, your operative level is half your character level.

Special You can select this feat more than once. Each time you do, you gain another operative feat.
Advanced Gunner.name: Advanced Gunner

Advanced Leadership.description:
You gain one envoy feat. For the purpose of meeting its prerequisites, your envoy level is equal to half your character level.

Special You can select this feat more than once. Each time you select it, you gain another envoy feat.
Advanced Leadership.name: Advanced Leadership

Advanced Mysticism.description:
You gain one mystic feat. For the purpose of meeting its prerequisites, your mystic level is half your character level.

Special You can select this feat more than once. Each time you do, you gain another mystic feat.
Advanced Mysticism.name: Advanced Mysticism

Advanced Physiological Mimicry.description: You more closely mimic the physiological traits of your ancestry. You gain a heritage from your ancestry in addition to this versatile heritage. If an ability from this new heritage conflicts with an ability from your versatile heritage, you choose which of the conflicting abilities your character has, as normal. You count as having that heritage for the purposes of qualifying for feats.
Advanced Physiological Mimicry.name: Advanced Physiological Mimicry

Advanced Soldier Training.description:
You gain one soldier feat. For the purpose of meeting its prerequisites, your soldier level is half your character level.

Special You can select this feat more than once. Each time you do, you gain another soldier feat.
Advanced Soldier Training.name: Advanced Soldier Training

Advanced Stellar Attunement.description:
You gain one solarian feat. For the purpose of meeting its prerequisites, your solarian level is half your character level.

Special You can select this feat more than once. Each time you do, you gain another solarian feat.
Advanced Stellar Attunement.name: Advanced Stellar Attunement

Advanced Targeting System.description: Your ocular processors are augmented with advanced targeting systems, which allow you to more easily pinpoint your enemy and read their movements. You can cast @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.spells.Item.Gb7SeieEvd0pL2Eh]{Sure Strike} once per day as a 1st-rank arcane innate spell.
Advanced Targeting System.name: Advanced Targeting System

Advanced Warp.description: Your paradox begins to cement itself across your life. You gain the advanced warp spell for your paradox.
Advanced Warp.name: Advanced Warp

Advantageous Assault.description: When your foe is weak, you press on. When you successfully Strike a creature that has the frightened or persistent bleed condition with a melee or ranged weapon, you gain a circumstance bonus to the damage roll equal to the number of weapon damage dice of the weapon used for the Strike.
Advantageous Assault.name: Advantageous Assault

Aerial Dash.description: Whether by catching a current or pushing yourself beyond your limits, you fly forward incredibly fast. Fly up to three times. If you are a stormrider dragonkin, instead you Fly up to four times.
Aerial Dash.name: Aerial Dash

Aerial Master.description: Your ability to fly through the skies under your own power is unparalleled. Your fly Speed increases by 10 feet.
Aerial Master.name: Aerial Master

Agglomerate Leshy.description:
You gather organic plant or fungal matter to your body, permanently increasing your size. You become Large.

Once per day as a two-action activity with the concentrate trait, you can grow a burst of foliage that further reinforces your body, increasing your reach by 5 feet, granting you a +2 status bonus to melee damage rolls, and making you @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.i3OJZU2nk64Df3xm]{Clumsy 1} for 10 minutes.

@UUID[Compendium.sf2e.feat-effects.Item.rmKcSjjP9gdzirRt]{Effect: Agglomerate Leshy}
Agglomerate Leshy.name: Agglomerate Leshy

Aggressive Antlers.description: Like copaxi warriors of old, you've grown particularly sturdy and threatening copi antlers instead of the elegant ones favored by most modern copaxis. You gain an antlers unarmed attack that deals @Damage[1d4[piercing]] damage. Your antlers are in the brawling group and have the finesse and unarmed traits.
Aggressive Antlers.name: Aggressive Antlers

Aggressively Ostentatious.description: Your photonic magic is flashy and disorienting to behold. When a creature fails or critically fails a save against a spell you cast that has the light trait, they also become @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.TkIyaNPgTZFBCCuh]{Dazzled} for 1 round.
Aggressively Ostentatious.name: Aggressively Ostentatious

Akashic Sync.description:
Frequency once per 10 minutes

You can briefly connect to the Akashic Records. You @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.actions.Item.1OagaWtBpVXExToo]{Recall Knowledge} using [[/act recall-knowledge skill=occultism]]{Occultism} instead of any other skill as though Occultism were applicable to perform Recall Knowledge for that topic.

Critical Success You recall accurately and gain three pieces of information or context.

Success You recall accurately and gain two pieces of information or context and a piece of erroneous information, but you don't have any way to differentiate which is which.

Failure You gain a piece of information or context and two pieces of erroneous information.

Critical Failure You gain three pieces of erroneous information.
Akashic Sync.name: Akashic Sync

Akashic Transcendence.description: Your eye opens to greater truths. You can use @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.feats.Item.xQQgbsRjFWp7dZhU]{Akashic Sync} once per round instead of once every 10 minutes.
Akashic Transcendence.name: Akashic Transcendence

Alarming Scream.description:
You release a loud shriek meant to draw attention or raise alarm. All enemies within 60 feet must attempt a @Check[will|against:class-spell] save against the higher of your class DC or spell DC. The targets are then temporarily immune to your Alarming Scream for 24 hours.

Critical Success The target is unaffected.

Success The target becomes @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{Frightened 1}.

Failure The target becomes @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.9PR9y0bi4JPKnHPR]{Deafened} for 1 round and @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{Frightened 2}.

Critical Failure The target becomes deafened for 1 minute and @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{Frightened 4}.
Alarming Scream.name: Alarming Scream

All Hands on Deck.description:
Frequency once per day

You're able to focus on your coordination for a moment. Until the beginning of your next turn, you count up to one additional pair of hands as your active hands. At the beginning of your next turn, choose which set of active hands remains your active hands.
All Hands on Deck.name: All Hands on Deck

All In.description:
Requirements You haven't used your lucky number yet today.

You can go all in on your luck in the present moment at the expense of your luck in the future. Before you roll a check, you can choose to expend both uses of your lucky number to count the roll as a 20. The effort strains your relationship with the primal forces of luck, so you don't get a lucky number tomorrow.
All In.name: All In

All-Grabber Stance.description:
1 or 3

Frequency once per day

Requirements You have at least one hand free.

You carefully balance with the aid of only a few arms, freeing the rest to snag anything around you. As you do, your limbs elongate and writhe. Until combat ends, you're knocked out, or you Dismiss All-Grabber Stance, you can make lashing limb Strikes. These deal @Damage[3d6[bludgeoning]] damage, are in the brawling group, have the grapple and unarmed traits, and have a reach of 15 feet. You can also use the @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.actions.Item.e7Io0ZnzHuFD6yek]{Hug the World} activity. If you spent 3 actions to use All-Grabber Stance, you can immediately Hug the World.
All-Grabber Stance.name: All-Grabber Stance

Alloyed Attacks.description: You've layered alloys over your fists and tusks to improve their efficiency in dispatching certain foes. This enhancement might be voluntary or part of some unwanted evolution or experimentation. Choose cold iron or silver. Your melee unarmed attacks have the special properties of a weapon made of that metal. If you're at least 13th level, you can choose adamantine instead of just cold iron or silver.
Alloyed Attacks.name: Alloyed Attacks

Allsix.description:
Frequency once per day

Requirements You aren't holding any items except in your active hands.

You put forth your best effort and focus everything you've got on the task at hand, putting allsix of your hands (three of your sets of arms) into it! The next time you roll an attack roll or skill check, roll it three times and use the highest result.
Allsix.name: Allsix

Alluring Pheromones.description: You influence others with pheromones, even when you lack other means of communication. You can use Diplomacy to @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.actions.Item.OX4fy22hQgUHDr0q]{Make an Impression} on creatures with whom you don't share a language and to make simple Requests of them. This could include getting directions or getting the target to pick a specific individual out from a crowd. When you do, Make an Impression and Request lose the linguistic trait and gain the olfactory trait.
Alluring Pheromones.name: Alluring Pheromones

Aloof Mind.description: You're confident in your knowledge and undeterred by those who would have you believe otherwise. Anytime you gain the @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.e1XGnhKNSQIm5IXg]{Stupefied} condition, reduce its value by 1. This doesn't reduce the stupefied condition if the value would be reduced to 0.
Aloof Mind.name: Aloof Mind

Alter Weight.description: Your unnatural relationship with gravitational forces allows you to manipulate its flow to your will. You can cast @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.spells.Item.gLOelTMvex2OgBqV]{Gravity Field} as an 8th-rank occult innate spell once per day.
Alter Weight.name: Alter Weight

Always Prepared.description: You're trained in Mission Lore, a special Lore skill that can be used only to @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.actions.Item.1OagaWtBpVXExToo]{Recall Knowledge}, but on any topic related to an assignment, mission, or quest performed on behalf of another individual or organization. If you fail a check to Recall Knowledge with Mission Lore, you get the effects of the @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.feats.Item.1Bt7uCW2WI4sM84P]{Dubious Knowledge} skill feat unless the question was already answered during a mission briefing. If you have legendary proficiency in Society, you gain expert proficiency in Mission Lore, but you can't increase your proficiency rank in Mission Lore by any other means.
Always Prepared.name: Always Prepared

Always on Alert.description: After countless unexpected encounters you've developed a second sense for danger. You can perform the @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.actions.Item.kV3XM0YJeS2KCSOb]{Scout} exploration activity at the same time as the @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.actions.Item.IE2nThCmoyhQA0Jn]{Avoid Notice}, @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.actions.Item.EwgTZBWsc8qKaViP]{Investigate}, or @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.actions.Item.TiNDYUGlMmxzxBYU]{Search} exploration activity. The bonus to initiative you grant when you Scout is +2 instead of +1.
Always on Alert.name: Always on Alert

Ambidextrous Shifter.description: You have enough practice with your natural form that you can utilize more of your limbs than usual. You have six arms, which allows you to wield and hold up to six hands' worth of weapons and equipment. If you use more than four of these arms, your land Speed becomes 5 feet. At any time, one pair of hands is designated your active hands. You can change this designation from one pair of hands to another by taking the @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.actions.Item.oW81CfM9ebxXnrw3]{Switch Hands} action, which is a single action. You can only perform actions with your active hands. This feat allows you to use up to six arms when you use Change Shape to take a form with multiple arms, such as a kasatha or skittermander.
Ambidextrous Shifter.name: Ambidextrous Shifter

Ammo Hoarder.description:
Requirements You're wielding an automatic weapon.

By using direct and methodical burst fire, you conserve your ammunition without compromising your destructive potential. Your @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.actions.Item.6ctkxUnVwqooSvgg]{Auto-Fire} has an expend equal to the number of targets in the area, rather than the number of targets in the area × 2.
Ammo Hoarder.name: Ammo Hoarder

Amplify Radiance.description: You're an abundant source of electromagnetic radiation, which naturally amplifies the radiance of lights around you. Light sources in your possession (including those carried, cast on you, worn, or otherwise a part of you) are more luminous—double the area illuminated by these light sources. If a light source you possess would deal damage or cause a harmful effect based on its area, the area of those additional effects are not increased by Amplify Radiance. Additionally, you gain a +2 circumstance bonus to counteract checks made to counteract darkness.
Amplify Radiance.name: Amplify Radiance

Ancestral Cantrip.description:
Choose one cantrip from your ancestry's magic entry. You can cast that cantrip at will. A cantrip is heightened to a spell rank equal to half your level rounded up. This spell has the same tradition as listed in the feat entry.

Special If you have multiple cantrips listed for your ancestry, you can select this feat more than once. If you do, you must select a different spell.

Note: For a list of cantrips for your ancestry, see the @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.journals.JournalEntry.Cf6Ej0OgFpqg2VoF]{Ancestries} journal page for your ancestry.
Ancestral Cantrip.name: Ancestral Cantrip

Ancestral Communion.description:
You've forged a strong relationship with your ancestors through years of shared customs and fellowship. You feel so close to them that by simply recalling the story of their life and enacting one of their cherished traditions, you can channel a portion of their wisdom into yourself.

Choose one skill to emulate for 10 minutes. You gain a +2 status bonus to that skill and can attempt any skill check that normally requires you to have master proficiency in that skill, and if you're untrained in that skill, your proficiency bonus to untrained skill checks is equal to your level.
Ancestral Communion.name: Ancestral Communion

Ancestral Growth.description: Focusing latent power from your distant minotaur cousins, you expand quickly in size. You can cast @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.spells.Item.wzctak6BxOW8xvFV]{Enlarge} on yourself as a 2nd-rank occult innate spell once per day. At 13th level, this spell is heightened to 4th rank.
Ancestral Growth.name: Ancestral Growth

Ancestral Knowledge.description:
Choose an ancestry or heritage. You learn a new language available to that ancestry or heritage. You become trained in Society. If you're already trained in Society, you instead become trained in another skill of your choice. You also become trained in the Lore skill related to that specific ancestry or heritage, such as Android Lore or Ysoki Lore.

Special You can select this feat multiple times, choosing a different ancestry or heritage each time.
Ancestral Knowledge.name: Ancestral Knowledge

Ancestral Magic.description:
Your ancestry has a powerful connection to one or more magical traditions.

Choose one 1st-rank spell from your ancestry's magic entry. You can cast that spell as an innate spell once per day as a 1st-rank spell. If this is your 9th level ancestry feat, choose a 3rd-rank or lower ancestry spell as a 3rd-rank innate spell. If this is your 13th level ancestry feat, choose a 5th-rank or lower ancestry spell as a 5th-rank innate spell. If this is your 17th level ancestry feat, choose a 7th-rank or lower ancestry spell as a 7th-rank innate spell. This spell has the same tradition that is listed in the feat entry.

Special If you have multiple spells listed for your ancestry, you can select this feat more than once. If you do, you must select a different spell.
Ancestral Magic.name: Ancestral Magic

Ancestral Memory.description:
Humans have traveled across the galaxy and seen a little bit of everything on every imaginable type of planet. Many of your ancestors' stories have percolated down through storytellers and community records, allowing that knowledge to spread.

You can attempt one additional @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.actions.Item.1OagaWtBpVXExToo]{Recall Knowledge} check to yield more information about a specific creature even if you failed the check once. If you're an expert in the relevant skill, you can use this ability even if you failed the same check twice.
Ancestral Memory.name: Ancestral Memory

Ancestral Paragon.description: Whether through instinct, study, or magic, you feel a deeper connection to your ancestry. You gain a 1st-level ancestry feat.
Ancestral Paragon.name: Ancestral Paragon

Ancestral Pest.description: You assume the form of a tiny animal, gaining the effect of a 1st-rank @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.spells.Item.gfPjmG6Fe6D3MFjl]{Pest Form}, except you can transform only into a creature that matches the listed entry, and you can use your normal base Speed if it's higher than what the battle form grants. If the listed creature is normally larger than Tiny, you transform into a smaller, younger version of the animal. If the listed creature usually has a swim Speed, Ancestral Pest grants you a swim Speed of 20 feet.
Ancestral Pest.name: Ancestral Pest

Ancestral Physiology.description:
Your time spent in another skin has allowed you to shape your own body into a weapon. You gain a feat associated with a chosen ancestry or heritage that grants an unarmed attack. You can select ancestry feats that include that feat as a prerequisite as if you were a member of that ancestry or heritage. You can use the unarmed attack only when you're transformed into a member of that ancestry.

Special You can select this feat multiple times, choosing a different ancestry or feat each time.
Ancestral Physiology.name: Ancestral Physiology

Ancestral Resistance.description:
Your ancestry provides you some level of natural defense against specific types of damage. You gain resistance to the damage type listed by your ancestry's resistance entry equal to half your level.

Special If you have multiple damage types listed, you can take this feat multiple times. Each time you do so, select a different damage type.
Ancestral Resistance.name: Ancestral Resistance

Ancestral Skills.description:
You have a keen interest in the origins of your people. You become trained in the skills listed in your ancestry's skills entry. If you would automatically become trained in one of those skills (from your background or class, for example), you instead become trained in a skill of your choice.

You also gain the @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.feats.Item.BocFD2KV0qgUC76x]{Additional Lore} general feat for the Lore skill associated with your ancestry (for example, androids have Android Lore and ysoki have Ysoki Lore).
Ancestral Skills.name: Ancestral Skills

Ancestral Unarmed Attack.description:
You gain the unarmed attack listed for your ancestry. At your GM's discretion, you can select one of the alternate unarmed attack options listed in the Less Standard Unarmed Attacks sidebar.

At 5th level, whenever you land a critical hit with one of these attacks, you can add its critical specialization effect.

Special If you have multiple attacks listed for your ancestry, you can take this feat up to the number of attacks listed for your ancestry. Each time you do, select a different attack.
Ancestral Unarmed Attack.name: Ancestral Unarmed Attack

Ancestral Weapon Familiarity.description:
You gain access to all uncommon weapons with your ancestry trait. You have familiarity with weapons with your ancestry trait and with ancestral weapons. For the purposes of proficiency, you treat any of these that are martial weapons as simple weapons and any that are advanced weapons as martial weapons.

At 5th level, whenever you land a critical hit with one of these weapons, you can add its critical specialization effect.
Ancestral Weapon Familiarity.name: Ancestral Weapon Familiarity

Ancestral Weapon Familiarity (Astrazoan).description:
You've learned how to use the traditional weapons of another ancestry. You gain the weapon familiarity feat associated with a chosen ancestry or heritage, even if you are not a member of that ancestry or heritage. You can select ancestry feats that include that feat as a prerequisite as if you were a member of that ancestry or heritage. You must meet all feats' prerequisites when chosen other than the ancestry or heritage.

Special You can select this feat multiple times, choosing a different ancestry or feat each time.
Ancestral Weapon Familiarity (Astrazoan).name: Ancestral Weapon Familiarity (Astrazoan)

Anchoring Impacts.description:
Your suppressing attacks pin foes in place, preventing them from moving at more than a crawling pace. When you @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.enA7BxAjBb7ns1iF]{Suppress} a target with one of your attacks, increase the speed penalty to a –20-foot status penalty for the duration of the suppressed condition. If the effect that imparted the suppressed condition was a critical hit, or the target critically fails its save and becomes suppressed, then the target also becomes @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.dfCMdR4wnpbYNTix]{Stunned 1}.

@UUID[Compendium.sf2e.feat-effects.Item.5da0ZOocaoySCSJ2]{Effect: Anchoring Impacts}
Anchoring Impacts.name: Anchoring Impacts

Anchoring Strike.description:
Requirements Your quantum field is active.

Battle can be disorienting, but for you, the intense mental effort of striking your targets lends you additional clarity and focus. Make a Strike. The Strike gains the following success and critical success effects.

Critical Success The Strike gains the anchoring trait. You can reroll the damage dice rolled for this strike, but you must use the second result, even if it's worse.

Success The Strike gains the anchoring trait.
Anchoring Strike.name: Anchoring Strike

Ancient Izalguun Engineering.description: As one of the izalguuns who created the advanced technology of Izalraan, you have a deep understanding of engineering practices. You become trained in Crafting. If you would automatically become trained in Crafting (from your background or class, for example), you instead become trained in another skill of your choice. You gain the @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.feats.Item.VxmkzyDr4ShmJnNZ]{Electrical Engineer} skill feat.
Ancient Izalguun Engineering.name: Ancient Izalguun Engineering

Android Lore.description:
You have a keen interest in the origins of your people. You gain the trained proficiency rank in Crafting and Thievery. If you would automatically become trained in one of those skills (from your background or class, for example), you instead become trained in a skill of your choice.

You also gain the @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.feats.Item.BocFD2KV0qgUC76x]{Additional Lore} general feat for Android Lore.
Android Lore.name: Android Lore

Animal Skins.description: Once per day, when you Change Shape, you can instead gain the effects of @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.spells.Item.wp09USMB3GIW1qbp]{Animal Form}, heightened to half your level rounded up, for 1 minute or until you shift back, whichever comes first.
Animal Skins.name: Animal Skins

Anomalous Provenance.description: You were born Gap-touched, have long since acclimated to your strange affliction, and can wield it more effectively than most of your peers. When you Step, you can flicker in and out of reality, causing your Step to gain the teleportation trait and allowing you to Step into Difficult Terrain.
Anomalous Provenance.name: Anomalous Provenance

Another Day.description:
Frequency once per 10 minutes

Trigger You're damaged by an enemy's attack.

Preserving your time is the most important thing you can do. You summon a primal form of desperation to protect yourself. You gain a number of temporary Hit Points equal to half your level rounded up that last for 1 round. You can immediately Stride up to your Speed but must end your movement further away from the triggering enemy.
Another Day.name: Another Day

Anti-Theist Resistance.description:
Frequency once per day

Trigger You fail or critically fail a saving throw against a divine spell or effect.

Your resistance to the god Kadrical has manifested in the form of great resilience against divine influence. You reroll the triggering saving throw and use the second result.
Anti-Theist Resistance.name: Anti-Theist Resistance

Anticipate Danger.description:
Frequency once per 10 minutes

Trigger A creature attacks you while you're @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.AJh5ex99aV6VTggg]{Off-Guard} to them, you share a language with that creature, and that creature is within range of your limited telepathy.

The very thoughts of your enemies give them away. The triggering attack roll targets your Perception DC instead of your AC. Though this allows you to avoid taking penalties to your AC, it doesn't remove any conditions or other effects causing such penalties. For example, an enemy with sneak attack would still deal extra damage to you for being off-guard.
Anticipate Danger.name: Anticipate Danger

Apocalypse Burst.description: You vent the contents of your stomach while spinning in place, unleashing a cloud of your internal gases in a @Template[type:emanation|distance:30]. This functions as @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.ancestry-features.Item.jjVH7W3IhgaJ5Yct]{Fire Breath}, except that the damage dice are d10s instead of d4s. Creatures that fail their Reflex saves against this effect are also @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.TkIyaNPgTZFBCCuh]{Dazzled} for 1 round. You can't use Fire Breath for 1 minute.
Apocalypse Burst.name: Apocalypse Burst

Apply Atraxid Venom.description:
Frequency once per 10 minutes

While your fangs aren't suitable for biting, you still produce a dangerous venom. You spit your venom onto a melee weapon or into the magazine of a ranged weapon you're holding. Your next Strike or use of Auto-Fire with the chosen weapon until the start of your next turn that deals bludgeoning, piercing, or slashing damage also deals an additional @Damage[1d6[poison]] damage.

@UUID[Compendium.sf2e.feat-effects.Item.c8sAqdlyyYzg2FeT]{Effect: Atraxid Venom}
Apply Atraxid Venom.name: Apply Atraxid Venom

Arboreal Acrobat.description: While vulkarisu are naturally good climbers, you're exceptional, and can ascend and descend vertical surfaces without a second thought. You become trained in Athletics. If you would automatically become trained in Athletics (from your background or class, for example), you instead become trained in another skill of your choice. You gain the @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.feats.Item.09PurtIanNUPfNRq]{Combat Climber} skill feat, and you reduce the number of free hands required to @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.actions.Item.pprgrYQ1QnIDGZiy]{Climb} by one.
Arboreal Acrobat.name: Arboreal Acrobat

Arcane Adept.description: Your intense magical studies have taught you how to watch out for signs of magic even when looking for other things. When you're @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.actions.Item.TiNDYUGlMmxzxBYU]{Searching}, you also gain the benefits of the @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.actions.Item.Yb0C1uLzeHrVLl7a]{Detect Magic} exploration activity unless you choose not to.
Arcane Adept.name: Arcane Adept

Arcane Consumption.description: Your blood consumes arcane magic. Whenever you successfully save against a foe's harmful spell or magical effect, you gain temporary Hit Points equal to the spell's rank or equal to the level if the magical effect isn't a spell (double the number of temporary Hit Points you gain if the spell or trait is arcane). You gain these temporary Hit Points before the effect is resolved, and they last until the end of your next turn.
Arcane Consumption.name: Arcane Consumption

Arcane Recall.description:
Frequency once per day

Your training has enhanced your memory for magic, and spells linger in your mind. You can cast one spell you've already cast today without expending a spell slot.
Arcane Recall.name: Arcane Recall

Arcane Sense.description: You can cast 1st-rank @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.spells.Item.gpzpAAAJ1Lza2JVl]{Detect Magic} at will as an arcane innate spell. If you're a master in Arcana, the spell is heightened to 3rd rank; if you're legendary, it is heightened to 4th rank.
Arcane Sense.name: Arcane Sense

Arctic Bite.description: The freezing power of your bite becomes irresistible. The cold damage dealt by your jaws Strike increases to @Damage[2d6[untyped]] damage and ignores an amount of the target's cold resistance equal to your level. A creature's immunities are unaffected.
Arctic Bite.name: Arctic Bite

Armor Ace.description: You've learned through trial and painful error how to make the most out of your armor, deflecting damage from explosions and similar effects. When donning armor, you can grant it the bulwark trait until you remove it. When you're wearing armor that already has the bulwark trait, increase the modifier to Reflex saves to avoid damaging effects granted by that armor to +4, rather than +3.
Armor Ace.name: Armor Ace

Armor Proficiency.description:
You become trained in light armor. If you already were trained in light armor, you gain training in medium armor. If you were trained in both, you become trained in heavy armor. If you are at least 13th level, you become an expert in this armor type.

Special You can select this feat more than once. Each time, you become trained in the next type of armor, as detailed above.
Armor Proficiency.name: Armor Proficiency

Armored Shell.description: You've grown an armored copi exoskeleton—far sturdier than most copaxi exoskeletons—to protect the rest of your body from harm. Your exoskeleton grants a +3 item bonus to AC, has a Dex cap of +1, a check penalty of –2, and a Strength threshold of +3, and has the comfort and exposed traits. You're trained in your exoskeleton. You can wear a @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.equipment.Item.dnv1OFVU6BpyfAWi]{Flight Suit}, but you can't wear other armor. You can't install armor upgrades or etch armor runes onto your exoskeleton.
Armored Shell.name: Armored Shell

Armpit Pocket.description: You are adept at carrying objects in your armpit pockets. You can store up to four objects of negligible or light Bulk in your pockets. Stored objects are protected from environmental damage, including water. You can stow or remove an object as an Interact action, or drop all stored objects to the ground as a free action. When you become @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.fBnFDH2MTzgFijKf]{Unconscious}, all stored objects are dropped.
Armpit Pocket.name: Armpit Pocket

Art is Dead.description: You've studied music and color theory; you understand the necessary function of art while removing any ambiguous subtext, metaphor, and even the very soul that makes it art. You can use Society in place of Performance when you use the [[/act perform skill=society]] action and @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.actions.Item.QyzlsLrqM0EEwd7j]{Earn Income} downtime activity. You can @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.actions.Item.ftG89SjTSa9DYDOD]{Create Forgery} to replicate digital works of art (such as pictures, movies, and songs).
Art is Dead.name: Art is Dead

Ascended Stability.description:
Trigger You would cycle or become unattuned.

You briefly enter a meditative state in which you re-center yourself and remember the ever-shifting balance between the violent extremes of the cycle. You don't become unattuned or cycle, and you remain in your current attunement state.
Ascended Stability.name: Ascended Stability

Ascending Necrovite.description: You've reached the pinnacle of necrovite training available to living creatures. You've crafted an electroencephalon, a type of high-tech soul cage designed to preserve your existence, and you've begun your mystical preparations for your final transition into undeath. You gain void healing and immunity to death effects, disease, and poison. You gain resistance 5 to cold and physical damage. When you die, your soul immediately transfers to your electroencephalon.
Ascending Necrovite.name: Ascending Necrovite

Aspalasch Faithful.description:
You have continued in your worship of Aspalasch, and the ocean spirit has granted you greater powers. Choose a spell from air bubble, create water, and sanctuary. You can cast that spell as a 1st-rank divine innate spell once per day. You may choose each morning which cantrip you would like to cast from Aspalasch Worshipper.

If you select this feat at 9th level, you can additionally choose from @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.spells.Item.5esP2GVzvxWsMgaX]{Environmental Endurance}, @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.spells.Item.MZGkMsPBztFN0pUO]{Water Breathing}, and @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.spells.Item.Seaah9amXg70RKw2]{Water Walk}. You can cast that spell as a 2nd-rank divine innate spell once per day.

Special You can select this feat more than once. If you do, you must select a different spell.
Aspalasch Faithful.name: Aspalasch Faithful

Aspalasch Worshipper.description:
You worship the ancestral deity of Czelle, the great ocean spirit Aspalasch, seen as the protector both of binnaquids and all other life on the planet. You gain the Additional Lore general feat for Aspalasch Lore.

Additionally, Aspalasch grants you magical gifts. Choose one divine cantrip from @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.spells.Item.RA7VKcen3p56rVyZ]{Forbidding Ward}, @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.spells.Item.izcxFQFwf3woCnFs]{Guidance}, @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.spells.Item.vLzFcIaSXs7YTIqJ]{Message}, and @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.spells.Item.yvs1zN5Pai5U4CJX]{Summon Instrument}. You can cast that cantrip as an innate spell at will. A cantrip is heightened to a spell rank equal to half your level rounded up.
Aspalasch Worshipper.name: Aspalasch Worshipper

Aspiring Necrovite.description: You don't plan to die—instead, you're going to exist forever as a necrovite. You live by the Song of Silence and have spent time investigating undead organizations and studying the processes required to make the final transition into undeath. You gain a +1 circumstance bonus on checks to @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.actions.Item.1OagaWtBpVXExToo]{Recall Knowledge} about undead creatures, the Corpse Fleet, and Eox. You also learn the Necril language.
Aspiring Necrovite.name: Aspiring Necrovite

Assistant Regional Manager.description:
Frequency once per hour

You've been promoted to assist a mysterious supervisor who communicates via suspiciously well-timed text messages, infosphere newsreels, or even conveniently placed graffiti that quickly conveys exactly what you need to know to get the job done. When you @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.actions.Item.1OagaWtBpVXExToo]{Recall Knowledge}, your benefactor sends you a clue that allows you to make your check with Society instead of any other skill, as well as roll twice and use the better result. If you Recall Knowledge using Business Lore, Corporate Lore, or Society, reduce the frequency of Assistant Regional Manager to once per 10 minutes.
Assistant Regional Manager.name: Assistant Regional Manager

Assistive Goo Gush.description:
Frequency once every 10 minutes

Your sticky resin flows into your wounds or the wounds of an adjacent creature currently taking persistent damage, helping to repair cellular damage. For the next minute, reduce the DC of any flat check the target rolls to recover from persistent damage as though it were being assisted. The target immediately rolls a flat check to see if it recovers from each ongoing source of persistent damage.

@UUID[Compendium.sf2e.feat-effects.Item.9ShdNY94n869OXem]{Effect: Assistive Goo Gush}
Assistive Goo Gush.name: Assistive Goo Gush

Assistive Shove.description:
Trigger An adjacent ally who is at least one size smaller than you would be hit by a Strike.

You use your size and leverage to quickly move an ally out of harm's way. Attempt an Athletics check to @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.actions.Item.7blmbDrQFNfdT731]{Shove} the ally targeted by the triggering Strike. If your ally is willing, treat the result as one degree of success higher. On a success, in addition to its normal effects, the Shoved ally also gains a +2 circumstance bonus to their AC against the triggering Strike.

@UUID[Compendium.sf2e.feat-effects.Item.Gt6n0nYxHlPSmWVH]{Effect: Assistive Shove}
Assistive Shove.name: Assistive Shove

Assurance.description:
Even in the worst circumstances, you can perform basic tasks. Choose a skill you're trained in. You can forgo rolling a skill check for that skill to instead receive a result of 10 + your proficiency bonus (do not apply any other bonuses, penalties, or modifiers).

Special You can select this feat multiple times. Each time, choose a different skill and gain the benefits for that skill.

featPrerequisites.0: trained in at least one skill

Assurance.name: Assurance

Astrophysicist.description: You have an innate knowledge of suns, stars, and stellar forces. You become trained in Nature. If you would automatically become trained in Nature (from your background or class, for example), you instead become trained in another skill of your choice. You gain the @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.feats.Item.BocFD2KV0qgUC76x]{Additional Lore} feat for Physical Science Lore and one other space-related lore of your choice, such as Astrophysics Lore, Astronomy Lore, Star Lore, or Sun Lore.
Astrophysicist.name: Astrophysicist

Astrowanderer.description: You've traveled out into the stars and adapted to the void of space, allowing you to survive in lifeless conditions and operate more effectively in zero-gravity environments. You can breathe in a vacuum without environmental protection and ignore the @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.i3OJZU2nk64Df3xm]{Clumsy} condition imposed by being @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.z1ucw4CLwLqHoAp3]{Untethered} in zero-g.
Astrowanderer.name: Astrowanderer

At Home In My Body.description: You eschew physical augmentations beyond what's necessary, avoiding superfluous enhancements on your body. During your daily preparations, choose a skill that you're at least trained in. Until your next daily preparations, you gain the @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.feats.Item.W6Gl9ePmItfDHji0]{Assurance} feat for that skill.

featPrerequisites.0: You have no augmentations that count against your augmentation limit.

At Home In My Body.name: At Home In My Body

Atmospheric Flight.description: You can manifest your energy wings while within an atmosphere for a short time. Your energy wings manifest, granting you a fly Speed equal to your land Speed plus 10 feet for 10 minutes. You can end this duration early as a single action.
Atmospheric Flight.name: Atmospheric Flight

Atraxid Lore.description: You exemplify the favored studies of the atraxids. You become trained in Crafting and Thievery. If you would automatically become trained in one of those skills, you instead become trained in a skill of your choice. You also gain the Additional Lore general feat for Atraxid Lore.
Atraxid Lore.name: Atraxid Lore

Attuned Blow.description: You can use your manifestations immediately upon attuning yourself. When you Attune as a single action, you can make a Strike with your solar flare or solar weapon as a free action.
Attuned Blow.name: Attuned Blow

Attuned Wards.description:
You extend your control of stellar forces to punish your foes. Creatures that hit you with an attack suffer consequences based on your attunement.

Graviton-Attuned The creature is @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.i3OJZU2nk64Df3xm]{Clumsy 1} and @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.AJh5ex99aV6VTggg]{Off-Guard} for 1 round. This increases to @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.i3OJZU2nk64Df3xm]{Clumsy 2} if this is the second time it hit you this turn.

Photon-Attuned The creature takes persistent fire damage equal to half your level.
Attuned Wards.name: Attuned Wards

Augmented Adaptation.description: You've adapted your own body to suit your needs. The total number of augmentations you can install is increased by two.
Augmented Adaptation.name: Augmented Adaptation

Augmented Body.description:
You implant one augmentation with an item level equal to your character level or lower. This augmentation doesn't count against your total implant limit. The first time you take this feat, the augmentation you receive is free as long as its item level is 1 or lower. You can upgrade this augmentation by swapping it out with another augmentation when you gain a level or by spending downtime replacing the augmentation as though changing out a feat. When you swap out the augmentation, you must pay the difference between the original and new augmentation each time you upgrade.

Special You can select this feat multiple times, choosing a different augmentation each time. Retraining this feat requires paying the cost of the original augmentation.
Augmented Body.name: Augmented Body

Augmented Shell.description: Your exoskeleton shell has further merged with your body, granting you more bodily space for enhancements. Increase the number of augmentations you can have implanted by 2.
Augmented Shell.name: Augmented Shell

Aurum Authority.description: Your golden blood grants you access to powerful magic that lets you better lead and threaten those around you. You gain @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.spells.Item.aIHY2DArKFweIrpf]{Command} and @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.spells.Item.4koZzrnMXhhosn0D]{Fear} as 1st-rank arcane innate spells. You can cast each of these arcane innate spells once per day.
Aurum Authority.name: Aurum Authority

Automatic Knowledge.description:
You know basic facts off the top of your head. Choose a skill you're an expert in that has the Recall Knowledge action and for which you have the Assurance feat. You can use the Recall Knowledge action with that skill as a free action once per round. If you do, you must use Assurance on the skill check.

Special You can select this feat multiple times, choosing a different skill each time. You can use Automatic Knowledge with any skills you have chosen, but you can still use Automatic Knowledge only once per round.

featPrerequisites.0: expert in a skill with the recall knowledge action

Automatic Knowledge.name: Automatic Knowledge

Avid Traveler.description:
You spend more time gallivanting across the galaxy than you do at home. You become trained in Society. If you would automatically become trained in Society (from your background or class, for example), you instead become trained in a skill of your choice.

You also gain the @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.feats.Item.P9HCz0uR6xPHuw72]{Multilingual} skill feat.
Avid Traveler.name: Avid Traveler

Aw, Nuts!.description:
Frequency once per day

Trigger You fail a skill check.

Requirements You're not in a combat encounter.

You're always prepared to catch yourself mid-failure before it cascades into a complete disaster, shrugging off a potential mistake as merely bad luck and pushing forward without letting it get you down. Reroll the triggering skill check and use the better result.
Aw, Nuts!.name: Aw, Nuts!

Back to Back Bond.description:
You and your partner are so in tune with each other that you can move past each other with ease on the battlefield. You can end your movement sharing the same space as your bonded partner and they can do the same, even if you're the same size. As long as you're in the same square, you and your bonded partner can't be flanked by creatures of your level or lower.

@UUID[Compendium.sf2e.feat-effects.Item.2xon6Q6ukZK5BXnX]{Effect: Back to Back Bond}

featPrerequisites.0: You have a bond with the Sympathetic Bond feat or dragonkin partner bond feature.

Back to Back Bond.name: Back to Back Bond

Balancing Tail.description: You've developed a healthy appreciation for your prehensile tail. It's hard to imagine life without it—you'd probably fall over all the time. Luckily, yours is there to help keep your balance, even in the trickiest situations. You gain a +1 circumstance bonus to Acrobatics checks to [[/act balance]] and a +1 circumstance bonus to your Reflex DC against attempts to [[/act trip]] you. As long as your tail isn't holding an item, you aren't @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.AJh5ex99aV6VTggg]{Off-Guard} while on a narrow surface or uneven ground.
Balancing Tail.name: Balancing Tail

Baleful Gaze.description:
Frequency once per minute

You have an ominous presence that unnerves the living. You have learned to harness this sinister aura to your own advantage and can scare your foes with a focused glance. Focus your ill intent at one living creature within 30 feet. The target must succeed at a @Check[type:will|dc:resolve(@actor.system.attributes.classOrSpellDC.value)] save against the higher of your class DC or spell DC, or become @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{Frightened 1} (@UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{Frightened 2} on a critical failure) and @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.e1XGnhKNSQIm5IXg]{Stupefied 1} as long as it's frightened. Once you've used Baleful Gaze against a creature, it's temporarily immune for 24 hours.
Baleful Gaze.name: Baleful Gaze

Baleful Presence.description: You've learned to unleash the anger and malice you've built up over the course of your life and restless undeath against multiple foes at once, creating a potent effect around yourself. You can choose to use Baleful Gaze as a 2-action activity, rather than 1. When you do, Baleful Gaze gains the divine trait, loses the visual trait, and affects each living creature in a @Template[type:emanation|distance:30], rather than a single living creature.
Baleful Presence.name: Baleful Presence

Barathu Lore.description:
From your upbringing, you've learned the ways of your people while also seeking to expand your own mind in the fields of creation. You gain the trained proficiency rank in Crafting and Medicine. If you would automatically become trained in one of those skills (from your background or class, for example), you instead become trained in a skill of your choice.

You also gain the @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.feats.Item.BocFD2KV0qgUC76x]{Additional Lore} general feat for Barathu Lore.
Barathu Lore.name: Barathu Lore

Bargain Hunter.description: You can @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.actions.Item.QyzlsLrqM0EEwd7j]{Earn Income} using Diplomacy, spending your days hunting for bargains and reselling at a profit. You can also spend time specifically seeking a great bargain on an item; this works as if you were using Earn Income with Diplomacy, except instead of gaining money, you purchase the item at a discount equal to the money you would have gained, gaining the item for free if your earned income equals or exceeds its cost. Finally, if you select Bargain Hunter during character creation at 1st level, you start play with an additional 20 credits.
Bargain Hunter.name: Bargain Hunter

Barricade.description: You hastily create a barricade using nearby items, junk, or debris. The barricade provides lesser cover for you and one other ally, though you can @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.actions.Item.ust1jJSCZQUhBZIz]{Take Cover} to increase this benefit to standard cover. The barricade is flimsy and falls apart at the end of your next turn.
Barricade.name: Barricade

Basic Distortion.description: Your disruptive powers grow. You gain a 1st- or 2nd-level witchwarper feat.
Basic Distortion.name: Basic Distortion

Basic Epiphany.description: You gain your connection's initial epiphany spell. If you don't already have one, you also gain a focus pool of 1 Focus Point, which you can Refocus by reflecting on your connection.
Basic Epiphany.name: Basic Epiphany

Basic Flight.description:
Frequency once per minute

You Fly. If you don't have a fly Speed, you gain a fly Speed equal to your ancestry's Flight Specialist entry for this action. If you aren't on solid ground at the end of this movement, you fall.
Basic Flight.name: Basic Flight

Basic Insectile Flight.description:
Some shirrens are born with wings, but others grow them later. You evolve a pair of insectile wings that grant you a fly Speed of 20 feet. In addition, when you fall, you take no falling damage.

Special If you're a winged shirren, you either grow a second set of wings or your existing wings morph into a stronger set of wings, increasing your fly Speed to 25 feet.
Basic Insectile Flight.name: Basic Insectile Flight

Basic Leadership.description: You gain a 1st- or 2nd-level envoy feat of your choice.
Basic Leadership.name: Basic Leadership

Basic Mystic Spellcasting.description: You gain the @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.journals.JournalEntry.vx5FGEG34AxI2dow.JournalEntryPage.DOc3Pf8wmVxanTIv#basic-spellcasting-feat]{Basic Spellcasting} benefits. Each time you gain a spell slot of a new rank from the mystic archetype, add a spell of the appropriate spell rank to your repertoire: a common spell of your connection's tradition, or one of your connection's granted spells.
Basic Mystic Spellcasting.name: Basic Mystic Spellcasting

Basic Quantum Field.description: Your quantum field gains the effect of your chosen paradox.
Basic Quantum Field.name: Basic Quantum Field

Basic Warp Spell.description: You gain your paradox's initial warp spell. If you don't already have one, you also gain a focus pool of 1 Focus Point, which you can Refocus by contemplating infinite worlds. (For more on warp spells, see page 165.)
Basic Warp Spell.name: Basic Warp Spell

Basic Witchwarper Spellcasting.description: You gain the @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.journals.JournalEntry.vx5FGEG34AxI2dow.JournalEntryPage.DOc3Pf8wmVxanTIv#basic-spellcasting-feat]{Basic Spellcasting} benefits. Each time you gain a spell slot of a new rank from the witchwarper archetype, add a spell of the appropriate spell rank to your repertoire: a common spell of your paradox's tradition, or one of your paradox's granted spells.
Basic Witchwarper Spellcasting.name: Basic Witchwarper Spellcasting

Battle Analysis.description:
Frequency once per day

Trigger You roll initiative.

You attempt a check to @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.actions.Item.1OagaWtBpVXExToo]{Recall Knowledge} about a single creature you can sense. You gain a +1 circumstance bonus to your Recall Knowledge check if you use the same skill you're using to roll initiative. This bonus increases to +2 if you're a master in that skill.
Battle Analysis.name: Battle Analysis

Battle Cry.description: When you roll initiative, you can yell a mighty battle cry and [[/act demoralize]] an observed foe as a free action. If you're legendary in Intimidation, you can use a reaction to @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.actions.Item.2u915NdUyQan6uKF]{Demoralize} your foe when you critically succeed at an attack roll.
Battle Cry.name: Battle Cry

Battle Focus.description:
Frequency once per day

Trigger You reduce a creature to 0 Hit Points.

You effortlessly enter a state of flow in combat. When you use Battle Focus and each time you reduce a hostile creature to 0 Hit Points in the next minute, you regain @Damage[@actor.level[healing]] Hit Points equal to your level. If you're @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.Yl48xTdMh3aeQYL2]{Wounded}, you can reduce the wounded condition by 1 instead of regaining Hit Points.
Battle Focus.name: Battle Focus

Battle Medicine.description:
Requirements You're holding or wearing a medkit.

You can patch up wounds, even in combat. Attempt a Medicine check with the same DC as for @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.actions.Item.1kGNdIIhuglAjIp9]{Treat Wounds} and restore the corresponding amount of HP; this doesn't remove the wounded condition. As with Treat Wounds, you can attempt checks against higher DCs if you have the minimum proficiency rank. The target is then @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.feat-effects.Item.2XEYQNZTCGpdkyR6]{immune} to your Battle Medicine for 1 day. This does not make them immune to, or otherwise count as, Treat Wounds.
Battle Medicine.name: Battle Medicine

Battle Saint.description: You have ascended to the rank of living battle saint and are on a path to become a true divine servant of Damoritosh when you meet him in the afterlife. You can cast @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.spells.Item.BHWG0rQPTgBF5Ye1]{Rocket Dash} and @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.spells.Item.o6YCGx4lycsYpww4]{Haste} as 7th-rank divine innate spells once per day each.
Battle Saint.name: Battle Saint
