Battleblessed.description: You're an accomplished battledancer and warrior, blessed by seers, honed by ancestral tradition, and capable of feats beyond the natural abilities of your peers. You gain @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.spells.Item.KcLVELhCUcKXxiKE]{Tailwind} as a 1st-rank primal innate spell that you can cast once per day.
Battleblessed.name: Battleblessed

Beastie Blood.description: You have an affinity for riding animals of all shapes and sizes, and you haven't met a mount that you aren't willing to ride. You become trained in Nature. If you would automatically become trained in Nature (from your background or class, for example), you instead become trained in a skill of your choice. You gain the @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.feats.Item.Rq5wkA8DtsmbzoGV]{Ride} general feat and gain a +1 circumstance bonus to @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.actions.Item.q9nbyIF0PEBqMtYe]{Command an Animal} if the target is trained as a mount.
Beastie Blood.name: Beastie Blood

Better Split!.description:
Frequency once per hour

Trigger You are attacked by a foe but haven't rolled yet.

In an emergency, your especially oozy body has adapted to split into multiple pieces to survive danger. A piece of you splits off to ward off a harmful blow. The triggering attacker must attempt a @Check[flat|dc:13]; on a success, the attack targets you normally; if they fail, the attack targets the piece of you that split off, destroying it. You become @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.e1XGnhKNSQIm5IXg]{Stupefied 1} and @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.i3OJZU2nk64Df3xm]{Clumsy 1} for 1 minute, after which time your body regrows the split-off part.
Better Split!.name: Better Split!

Big Bang.description:
Frequency once per hour

Requirements You're photon-attuned.

You manifest a fragment of the cosmic forces from the Universe's first moments, unleashing a blast of scouring cosmic fire that reverts all things to their basic components and overcomes even magical defenses. This deals @Damage[(max((@actor.level - 4),10))d6[fire]|options:area-damage] damage to all creatures in a @Template[type:emanation|distance:30]. You and any number of adjacent allies are unaffected by this Big Bang. Affected creatures can attempt a @Check[reflex|against:solarian|options:area-effect] save against your class DC.

Critical Success The creature is unaffected.

Success The creature takes half damage.

Failure The creature takes full damage and @Damage[2d6[persistent,fire]|options:photon-attuned] damage.

Critical Failure The creature takes double damage and @Damage[4d6[persistent,fire]|options:photon-attuned] damage, and you can attempt to counteract a spell on the creature, using half your level, rounded up, as the counteract rank.

Level (+1) Increase the damage by 1d6.
Big Bang.name: Big Bang

Big Mouth.description: Your cheek pouches are especially large and stretchy. Instead of storing up to four items of light Bulk in your cheek pouches, you can store up to 1 Bulk worth of items. The maximum size of a given item is unchanged.
Big Mouth.name: Big Mouth

Big Stretch.description: You might be Tiny, but your pliable anatomy allows you to stretch and contort to simulate the reach of a larger creature. When you wield a melee weapon that requires two hands and doesn't have reach, you can change between a typical two-handed grip and an extended two-handed stretch using an Interact action. Weapons wielded in your extended stretch gain a reach of 5 feet.
Big Stretch.name: Big Stretch

Binaric Assault.description: You coordinate your attacks with both your solar flare and solar weapon. Make two Strikes at the same target, one with your solar weapon and one with your solar flare, each using your current multiple attack penalty. You can make these Strikes in whichever order you desire. After the first time a Strike hits, resolve the damage and effects, then swap your current attunement. If both attacks fail to hit, you become unattuned. Binaric Assault counts as two attacks when calculating your multiple attack penalty.
Binaric Assault.name: Binaric Assault

Binnaquid Lore.description: You have learned the traditional hunting techniques of your people. You gain the trained proficiency rank in Stealth and Survival. If you would automatically become trained in one of those skills (from your background or class, for example), you instead become trained in a skill of your choice. You also gain the Additional Lore general feat for Binnaquid Lore.
Binnaquid Lore.name: Binnaquid Lore

Bioluminescence.description:
Your eyes glow like bioluminescent lamps, and you have learned how to focus them into a directional beam. Your eyes shed light in a 30 foot line in any direction you're looking.

You can suppress or restore this light as a free action. In addition, while this light is active you can take the Point Out action to indicate a creature within the area of your bioluminescence without making any noise, in which case it loses the auditory and manipulate traits. Finally, after you use an action to Hide or @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.actions.Item.VMozDqMMuK5kpoX4]{Sneak}, you can send predetermined signals with your lights to alert all allies you can see to your location as a free action.
Bioluminescence.name: Bioluminescence

Bioluminescence (Shirren).description:
You can induce a chemical reaction that allows a part of your body to glow. You must designate what part of your body glows when you take this feat.

You begin to glow with bright light in a 20-foot radius and dim light for the next 20 feet. While you're glowing, you can't be @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.VRSef5y1LmL2Hkjf]{Undetected} and you take a –4 penalty to Stealth checks to [[/act hide]] and [[/act sneak]]. You can Dismiss the glow as a free action. At 9th level, you shed bright light in a 40-foot radius and dim light for the next 40 feet.
Bioluminescence (Shirren).name: Bioluminescence (Shirren)

Bioluminescent Flash Bang.description:
Frequency once per day

The chemical reaction in your body has grown more potent with time. You release a blinding burst of bioluminescence. Creatures in a @Template[emanation|distance:10] around you must attempt a @Check[fortitude|against:class-spell|options:area-effect,inflicts:blinded,inflicts:dazzled] save against the higher of your class DC or spell DC. On a failure, the creature becomes @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.TkIyaNPgTZFBCCuh]{Dazzled} for [[/r 1d4 #rounds]]{1d4 rounds}. On a critical failure, the creature is also @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.XgEqL1kFApUbl5Z2]{Blinded} for 1 round.
Bioluminescent Flash Bang.name: Bioluminescent Flash Bang

Bionanite Skin.description: You can tap into your biotech's generative nature to don a new face or persona and better adapt to your surroundings. You physically modify your features to another creature of the same size category as yourself. Using Bionanite Skin counts as creating a disguise for the @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.actions.Item.AJstokjdG6iDjVjE]{Impersonate} use of Deception, and you gain a +2 status bonus to checks to Impersonate to pretend you're this other creature. You remain in this shape indefinitely and can shift into another shape by using this action again.
Bionanite Skin.name: Bionanite Skin

Biowaste Schmiowaste.description: Where others see garbage and slime, you see bandages and disinfectants. Your become an expert in Medicine. If you were already an expert in Medicine or would automatically become expert from another source, you instead become trained in a skill of your choice. You gain the @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.feats.Item.rLwzwcrLh1qaN4pk]{Unusual Treatment} skill feat, and you can apply its benefit to [[/act treat-disease]] and [[/act treat-poison]] actions in addition to @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.actions.Item.1kGNdIIhuglAjIp9]{Treat Wounds}.
Biowaste Schmiowaste.name: Biowaste Schmiowaste

Biting Corpsefolk.description:
A transformation after death twisted your body, elongating your teeth into fangs or sharpening your appendages into claws. When you select this feat, you gain one of the following unarmed attacks of your choice: claw or jaws. Both of these attacks are in the brawling weapon group and have the listed damage die and traits.

Claw 1d6 slashing (agile, finesse, unarmed)

Jaws 1d6 piercing (grapple, unarmed)

At 5th level, whenever you get a critical hit with one of these attacks, you get its critical specialization effect.

Special You can select this feat two times. Each time you do, select a different attack from the options listed above.
Biting Corpsefolk.name: Biting Corpsefolk

Bizarre Magic.description: You can draw upon strange variations in your spellcasting, whether or not you can cast occult spells. The DCs to Recognize Spells you cast and Identify Magic you use increase by 5.
Bizarre Magic.name: Bizarre Magic

Black Hole.description:
Frequency once per 10 minutes

Requirements You're graviton-attuned.

You concentrate on the gravitational forces around you, pulling matter toward you in emulation of a black hole. Select any number of creatures within 30 feet. Each affected creature takes @Damage[(floor(@actor.level / 2)d8)[bludgeoning]|options:area-damage,forced-movement] damage and must attempt a @Check[fortitude|against:solarian] save against your class DC.

Critical Success The creature is unaffected.

Success The creature takes half damage and is pulled 5 feet toward you.

Failure The creature takes full damage, is pulled 15 feet toward you, and is @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.AJh5ex99aV6VTggg]{Off-Guard} against the next melee attack that you attempt against it before the end of your current turn.

Critical Failure The creature takes double damage, is pulled 30 feet toward you, and is knocked @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.j91X7x0XSomq8d60]{Prone}.

Level (+2) Increase the damage by 1d8.
Black Hole.name: Black Hole

Blazing Corona.description: Your ability to manipulate solar radiation has improved. You can manifest your wings to use Coronal Flare without any hands at any time, even if you are not in a vacuum. In addition, your Coronal Flare gains the Thrown 40 feet trait.
Blazing Corona.name: Blazing Corona

Blend In.description: You know how to blend in and become a forgettable face in the crowd. While in a crowd of at least 10 other creatures, you can roll a Society check in place of a Stealth check when using the @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.actions.Item.IE2nThCmoyhQA0Jn]{Avoid Notice} exploration activity to see if enemies notice you. While in a settlement, you can use [[/act impersonate skill=society]]{Society} in place of Deception when Impersonating a non-specific individual.
Blend In.name: Blend In

Blinding Awe.description:
Trigger You're about to [[/act demoralize]] with the visual trait while you're in an area of bright light.

You focus your mantle's reflective properties to overwhelm not just your target's will but also its senses. Attempt your @Check[intimidation|against:reflex] check against the target's Reflex DC instead of its Will DC. If you critically succeed, the target is @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.TkIyaNPgTZFBCCuh]{Dazzled} until it's no longer frightened.
Blinding Awe.name: Blinding Awe

Blood Born.description: Your magical blood resists being spilled. Your DC on flat checks to end persistent bleed damage is reduced from 15 to 10, or from 10 to 5 after receiving especially appropriate assistance.
Blood Born.name: Blood Born

Blood Feast.description:
Frequency once per day

Requirements Your last action was a successful Strike with an unarmed attack or commercial knife you created using your lineage.

By tapping into the latent necromantic energies that surround you, you leech vitality from nearby living creatures, healing your own body in the process. You cast @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.spells.Item.fd31tAHSSGXyOxW6]{Vampiric Exsanguination} as a 7th-rank divine innate spell, but the spell affects only the target of your last Strike.
Blood Feast.name: Blood Feast

Blood Sense.description: You have a keen sense of smell and are capable of detecting bloody wounds at a distance. You gain blood sense as an imprecise sense with a range of 30 feet. This means you can use your sense of smell to determine the exact location of a living creature who isn't at its full Hit Points. Creatures that don't have blood, such as oozes and most constructs, can't be detected with your blood sense.
Blood Sense.name: Blood Sense

Blood-Tinged Attack.description:
You channel a portion of your blood into your weapon to empower your next Strike. The first time you successfully Strike a creature before the end of your turn, your target becomes tinged with your blood for the next minute. Double the range of any of your spells that target any creature tinged with your blood. In addition, you don't need line of sight to target them with spells, though you still need line of effect.

Special Blood-tinged Attack is a free action if you're taking persistent bleed damage.
Blood-Tinged Attack.name: Blood-Tinged Attack

Bloody Wounds.description: You know how to target your mark's vital spots, leaving bloody wounds. When you critically hit your mark, you deal persistent bleed damage to your mark equal to your number of @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.actions.Item.sLikawnrJJzHMYeC]{Aim} damage dice.
Bloody Wounds.name: Bloody Wounds

Bloomguard.description: After years of meritorious military service, you were chosen for the elite Bloomguard, where you underwent rigorous training that honed your defenses against the tricks of First World creatures. You gain a +2 circumstance bonus to Will saving throws and Will DCs against mental effects and effects created by fey, and once per day, you can roll twice and take the better on a save against a mental effect or an effect created by a fey.
Bloomguard.name: Bloomguard

Blossoming Technology.description: You can activate the energy within technology and spur it into new, blossoming life. You can cast @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.spells.Item.hk2mTLH9DIvNqDuS]{Verdant Code} as a 2nd-rank primal innate spell once per hour.
Blossoming Technology.name: Blossoming Technology

Blowhole.description: You can force water out through the protrusion on top of your head and blast an enemy with a stream of water. You gain a blowhole ranged unarmed attack with a range increment of 30 feet and the water trait that deals 1d6 bludgeoning damage. On a critical hit, you knock the target back 5 feet from you. Blowholes do not add critical specialization effects.
Blowhole.name: Blowhole

Blue Mood.description:
Frequency once per day

Trigger You or an ally you can sense within 15 feet rolls an attack roll, saving throw, or skill check.

When things seem about to turn against you or your allies, you invoke your innate connection to the fickle and uncanny whims of luck. The triggering check can be rerolled, and the second result must be used.
Blue Mood.name: Blue Mood

Body Art.description: Your body is your canvas, and you've taken body modification to a whole new level. You gain an augmentation at no cost. The augmentation must be your level or lower. This augmentation doesn't count against the maximum number of augmentations you can implant, and each time you gain a new ancestry feat, you can upgrade this augmentation to a new augmentation of your level or lower at no cost, representing your continued exploration in body modification.
Body Art.name: Body Art

Body Electric.description:
Trigger An adjacent creature hits you with a Strike.

You channel your inner battery into a retaliatory discharge. You deal electricity damage equal to @Damage[(max(1,floor(@actor.level/2)))[electricity]]{half your level} or your electricity resistance, whichever is greater, to the triggering creature.
Body Electric.name: Body Electric

Bolstered By Battle.description:
Frequency once per hour

Trigger You deal the killing blow to an enemy.

You don't just fight because you have to; the threat of battle and the thrill of victory invigorate you. You gain a number of temporary Hit Points equal to your level. These temporary Hit Points last for 1 minute or until the encounter ends, whichever comes first.
Bolstered By Battle.name: Bolstered By Battle

Bond Boost.description:
Trigger A bonded ally within 20 feet is about to roll a saving throw.

You channel a surge of energy through your bond, shielding your ally's body and mind. Your ally gains a +1 status bonus to the triggering saving throw. If they roll a success on the saving throw against a vitality or void effect, they get a critical success instead.

@UUID[Compendium.sf2e.feat-effects.Item.9Sq4P1Pxr1owEv6R]{Effect: Bond Boost}
Bond Boost.name: Bond Boost

Bond Spell.description:
Trigger An ally within 30 feet Casts a Spell.

You pulse energy through your bond as your ally casts a spell, empowering their spell in one of the following ways.

  • If their spell deals damage or heals Hit Points and doesn't have a duration, you grant that spell a status bonus to damage or healing equal to its rank.

    @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.feat-effects.Item.WNCJ8ZgkqU7LhJNk]{Effect: Bond Spell}

  • If their spell doesn't have a spellshape effect applied to it, apply the effects of any one spellshape feat you know to the spell. The spellshape feat must be one that can be applied to the triggering spell, and you must be able to use it (for instance, if the spellshape feat is usable only a limited number of times per day).
Bond Spell.name: Bond Spell

Bondbearer.description: You and your bonded partner have learned the ancient art of dragonriding. Your bonded partner can ride you if they are one size category smaller than you (Medium size, for most dragonkin), rather than needing to be two size categories smaller. When your bonded partner rides you as a mount, your synchronicity enables them to gain three actions at the start of their turn, rather than the two they normally would for riding another PC. You still gain only two actions at the start of your turn, rather than three.
Bondbearer.name: Bondbearer

Bonded Rider.description: Inspired by legends of heroes from a bygone age, you and your bonded partner have learned the ancient art of dragonriding. You can ride your bonded partner as a mount if they're one size category larger than you. When you ride your bonded partner as a mount, your synchronicity enables them to gain three actions at the start of their turn, rather than the two actions they normally would for being ridden by another PC. You still gain only two actions at the start of your turn, rather than three.

featPrerequisites.0: You have a bond with the Sympathetic Bond feat or dragonkin partner bond feature.

Bonded Rider.name: Bonded Rider

Bonded Tandem Feint.description: You and your partner are skilled at working together to bait your enemies and throwing them wholly off-kilter. When you or your partner [[/act feint]] and roll a critical success, the target is also @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.AJh5ex99aV6VTggg]{Off-Guard} to melee and ranged attacks that you or your bonded partner attempt against it until the end of your next turn.

featPrerequisites.0: You have a bond with the Sympathetic Bond feat or dragonkin partner bond feature.

Bonded Tandem Feint.name: Bonded Tandem Feint

Bonded Transposition.description:
Frequency once every 10 minutes.

Trigger Your bonded partner is within 40 feet and would be damaged by an enemy.

Instinctively sensing your bonded partner is in danger, you swoop in to save them from harm. You and your bonded partner immediately swap places with one another, teleporting into one another's locations. The damage that would be dealt to your bonded partner is dealt to you instead.
Bonded Transposition.name: Bonded Transposition

Bone Shards.description:
Frequency once per 10 minutes

You break off a piece of your anatomy and fling sharp bone shards at your enemies. You gain a bone shards unarmed attack that deals 1d8 piercing damage. Your bone shards are in the projectile group and have the area (cone) trait with a range of 15 feet. This effect lasts 1 minute.
Bone Shards.name: Bone Shards

Borai Lore.description:
Since your resurrection, you've learned a lot about yourself, your place in the cycle of souls, and other undead. You gain the trained proficiency rank in Intimidation and Religion. If you would automatically become trained in one of those skills (from your background or class, for example), you instead become trained in a skill of your choice.

You also gain the @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.feats.Item.BocFD2KV0qgUC76x]{Additional Lore} general feat for Borai Lore.
Borai Lore.name: Borai Lore

Born Singing.description: You're well-versed in the artistic history of your people and found a way to make it your own. You might not even be a musician, but an actor, comedian, or other kind of performer—the fact remains that the show is in your blood, and you're good at what you do. You gain the Virtuosic Performer feat with the specialty of your choice. Your background in entertainment has left you shrewd, and you know exactly how to get a reaction out of a crowd. When you roll Performance to @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.actions.Item.QyzlsLrqM0EEwd7j]{Earn Income}, treat your task's level as 1 higher for the purposes of determining income earned, but don't increase the DC.
Born Singing.name: Born Singing

Born to Fly.description: You find flying exhilarating and live to perform impressive aerial maneuvers. You gain a +1 circumstance bonus to Acrobatics checks to @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.actions.Item.Qf1ylAbdVi1rkc8M]{Maneuver in Flight} and on Piloting checks to @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.actions.Item.uS3qDAgOkZ7b8ERL]{Drive} a vehicle or starship. When you roll a critical failure on an Acrobatics check to Maneuver in Flight, you get a failure instead.
Born to Fly.name: Born to Fly

Borrow Spell.description:
Frequency once per day

Trigger You use an action that Sustains your quantum field, and the quantum field is still active.

By reaching across both time and space, you can borrow the use of a spell from a version of yourself inhabiting another reality. During this turn, you can cast one spell without spending a spell slot to do so. The spell must be in your repertoire.
Borrow Spell.name: Borrow Spell

Bottomless Pockets.description: Your travels have taught you to pack smart for any situation. You've got really big pockets, and you've crammed a whole lot of useful stuff into them. You can use Just the Thing… once per hour, rather than once per day.
Bottomless Pockets.name: Bottomless Pockets

Bounce Back.description:
Frequency once per day

Trigger Your turn begins, and you have the @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.Yl48xTdMh3aeQYL2]{Wounded} condition.

Like your hard-luck ancestors, you somehow always recover from near-death experiences with astounding resilience and determination. Reduce your wounded condition by 1.
Bounce Back.name: Bounce Back

Bouncy Ball.description:
By landing your foot orb directly on the ground, you can use your momentum to bounce yourself forward. If you land on the ground at the end of a jump (whether performing a [[/act high-jump]], [[/act long-jump]], or @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.actions.Item.d5I6018Mci2SWokk]{Leap}), you can use High Jump or Long Jump as a single action, but you don't get to Stride as part of the activity.

Special If you have the @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.feats.Item.ZBhvJ9O8MvBFAlhq]{Quick Jump} skill feat, you gain a +2 circumstance bonus to your Athletics check for your second High Jump or Long Jump.
Bouncy Ball.name: Bouncy Ball

Boundless Brachiator.description: You can take a leap of faith and usually land on your feet. You can @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.actions.Item.d5I6018Mci2SWokk]{Leap} up to 30 feet in any direction without touching the ground and without requiring an Athletics check; when doing so, you must land on a surface you can Climb or adjacent to an Edge you can Grab within 30 feet of you, or else you fall after using your next action. You can exceed your normal Speed while Leaping.
Boundless Brachiator.name: Boundless Brachiator

Boundless Energy.description: Your wells of energy are unending, and your exuberance can't be contained. You can use @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.feats.Item.o7xxuslqMeEvsqha]{Zoomies} once every hour, rather than once per day.
Boundless Energy.name: Boundless Energy

Brainsplain.description:
Trigger You succeed at a check to Recall Knowledge to identify a foe within range of your limited telepathy.

Upon carefully analyzing a creature, you helpfully send it a telepathic lecture regarding its physiological and psychological inadequacies. For inexplicable reasons, doing so tends to aggravate the creature rather than educate it. The creature must attempt a @Check[will|against:class] save against your class DC. If you critically succeeded at the triggering check to Recall Knowledge, the target takes a –1 status penalty to its Will save. The creature is then temporarily immune for 24 hours.

Critical Success You accidentally overshare, exposing your own foibles. The creature gains a +1 circumstance bonus to its next attack roll against you, as long as that attack is made within 1 minute.

Success The creature is unaffected.

Failure The creature is @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.e1XGnhKNSQIm5IXg]{Stupefied 1} for [[/gmr 1d4 #rounds]]{1d4 rounds}.

Critical Failure The creature is @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.e1XGnhKNSQIm5IXg]{Stupefied 2} for 1 round, after which it is stupefied 1 for [[/gmr 1d4 #rounds]]{1d4 rounds}.
Brainsplain.name: Brainsplain

Brainwave Scanner.description:
You attune to the brain waves of living creatures and can sense the presence or absence of thought in others.

You gain thoughtsense as a precise sense with a range of 30 feet, allowing you to detect thinking creatures. As thoughtsense only detects thinking creatures, a creature that doesn't think or is otherwise immune to mental effects (such as many oozes and robots) can't be perceived using your thoughtsense, regardless of how precise it is.
Brainwave Scanner.name: Brainwave Scanner

Brave New Reality.description: The universe is nothing like the simulation you once lived in, but you refuse to stay in the past. You gain the @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.feats.Item.9jGaBxLUtevZYcZO]{Untrained Improvisation} general feat. In addition, you can attempt skill actions that normally require you to be trained even if you're untrained.
Brave New Reality.name: Brave New Reality

Brawler LFAN.description: In addition to allowing you to wield weapons made for much larger creatures, your LFAN lets you wrestle way above your weight class. You gain a +1 circumstance bonus on Athletics checks to [[/act disarm]], [[/act grapple]], [[/act reposition]], [[/act shove]], or [[/act trip]] Small and Tiny creatures. You can attempt to Disarm, Grapple, Reposition, Shove, or Trip creatures of up to Huge size. If you're legendary in Athletics, you can also attempt these actions on Gargantuan creatures.
Brawler LFAN.name: Brawler LFAN

Breach.description:
You propel yourself up like a whale breaching the surface of the ocean, then crash back down with thunderous force. @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.actions.Item.d5I6018Mci2SWokk]{Leap}. When you land, all opponents within 10 feet of you must succeed at a @Check[fortitude|against:class-spell] save against your class DC or spell DC, whichever is higher, or be knocked @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.j91X7x0XSomq8d60]{Prone}.

Special If you have the Quick Jump feat, you can @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.actions.Item.2HJ4yuEFY1Cast4h]{High Jump} or @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.actions.Item.JUvAvruz7yRQXfz2]{Long Jump} when using Breach.
Breach.name: Breach

Break Curse.description: You spend 8 hours praying or performing occult rites over the target, weakening a curse's power over them. Attempt to counteract the curse, using @Check[occultism] or @Check[religion] for your counteract check and half your level rounded up for the counteract rank. Break Curse only takes 10 minutes of prayer and rites if you are legendary in Occultism or Religion.
Break Curse.name: Break Curse

Break It.description:
You know that sometimes the right answer to technological problems is to simply break something. Attempt a @Check[crafting|against:fortitude] check against the item's DC or the Fortitude DC of the creature possessing the item if the item is being carried, held, or worn. The target is then temporarily immune to your attempts to Break It for 10 minutes.

Critical Success The item becomes @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.6A2QDy8wRGCVQsSd]{Glitching 1} for 1 minute.

Success The item becomes glitching 1 for 2 rounds.

Critical Failure Your attempt backfires. If the target has the glitching condition, reduce the value of its glitching condition by 1.
Break It.name: Break It

Breath Control.description: You can breathe even in hazardous or sparse air. You can hold your breath for 25 times as long as usual before suffocating. You gain a +1 circumstance bonus to saving throws against inhaled threats, such as inhaled poisons, and if you roll a success on such a saving throw, you get a critical success instead.
Breath Control.name: Breath Control

Brightbomb.description:
Frequency once per day

You Step and create a burst of brilliant, scintillating light in a @Template[type:burst|distance:5] centered on one corner of your previous space. Other creatures in the area must attempt a @Check[fortitude|against:class-spell|options:inflicts:blinded,inflicts:dazzled] save against the higher of your class DC or spell DC. On a failure, a creature is @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.XgEqL1kFApUbl5Z2]{Blinded} and @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.TkIyaNPgTZFBCCuh]{Dazzled} for 1 round. On a critical failure, they're blinded for 2 rounds and dazzled for 1 minute.
Brightbomb.name: Brightbomb

Bring it On!.description:
Requirements You're wielding a two-handed weapon.

Your sheer bravado bolsters your defenses despite your recklessness. Until the start of your next turn, you take a –2 circumstance penalty to AC and gain resistance to all damage equal to half your level. If you have the @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.class-features.Item.T78VQC8oaD1Odz1k]{Armor Storm} fighting style, this resistance is doubled against attacks made by suppressed creatures.
Bring it On!.name: Bring it On!

Broad Shoulders.description: Your wide build allows you to carry crushing weights. Increase your maximum and encumbered Bulk limits by 4. You ignore the penalty to attack rolls using weapons with the kickback trait as if you had +2 Strength, regardless of your actual modifier.
Broad Shoulders.name: Broad Shoulders

Broadside Charge.description:
Requirements You are wielding a gun and a melee weapon with the agile trait or a phase cutlass, each in a different hand.

Advancing with blade and pistol in hand, you make a ranged Strike, move up to your Speed, and make a melee Strike, each using your current multiple attack penalty and both at the same target. This counts as two attacks when calculating your multiple attack penalty.
Broadside Charge.name: Broadside Charge

Broken Hand Technique.description:
You've been trained in a traditional orc combat style called the Broken Hand Technique. The style originates from a tale that claims the orc who invented it was said to have driven off an invasion with two broken hands. This fighting style emphasizes close-quarters combat, grappling, trips, and pins, and uses the knees, elbows, feet, and shoulders to maneuver the enemy into a more advantageous position regardless of their size.

You become trained in Athletics. If you would automatically become trained in Athletics (from your background or class, for example), you instead become trained in another skill of your choice. You gain the @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.feats.Item.KxaYlC50zzHysJj8]{Titan Wrestler} skill feat.
Broken Hand Technique.name: Broken Hand Technique

Brood-Minder.description: You've served as, or are training to become, a brood-minder responsible for rearing and educating dozens of hatchlings. It's a multi-year job requiring extreme endurance. You become trained in Society. If you would automatically become trained in this skill (from your background or class, for example), you instead become trained in a skill of your choice. In addition, you gain a +2 circumstance bonus on saves to resist becoming @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.HL2l2VRSaQHu9lUw]{Fatigued}.
Brood-Minder.name: Brood-Minder

Broodless.description: You grew up without a brood. Whether you were a lone survivor, became lost, or were raised offworld, you've learned to survive alone. You become trained in one of the following skills of your choice: Deception or Thievery. If you would automatically become trained in both of those skills (from your background or class, for example), you instead become trained in a skill of your choice. If you selected Deception, you gain the Charming Liar skill feat. If you selected Thievery, you gain the Subtle Theft skill feat.
Broodless.name: Broodless

Brutal Anatomy.description:
You're a natural predator trained to use part of your body as a weapon. When you select this feat, you gain one of the following unarmed attacks of your choice: claw, jaws, or tail. Each of these attacks is in the brawling weapon group.

A claw unarmed attack deals 1d6 slashing damage and has the agile, finesse, unarmed, and vesk traits.

A jaws unarmed attack deals 1d6 piercing damage and has the grapple, unarmed, and vesk traits.

A tail unarmed attack deals 1d6 bludgeoning damage and has the sweep, trip, unarmed, and vesk traits.

At 5th level, whenever you get a critical hit with one of these attacks, you get its critical specialization effect.

Special You can take this feat three times. Each time you do, select a different attack from the options listed above.
Brutal Anatomy.name: Brutal Anatomy

Brutal Barrage.description:
Requirements You're wielding an area or automatic weapon.

You prepare the perfect shot, able to tear through those closest to the impact point. If your next action is to @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.actions.Item.oc0ZKnk5zD0GXqZi]{Area Fire}, @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.actions.Item.6ctkxUnVwqooSvgg]{Auto-Fire}, or @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.feats.Item.xND8wnEdnGSq84kn]{Whirling Swipe}, add two additional weapon damage dice to targets who are adjacent to the center point of impact or within the first 10 feet of a cone or line.
Brutal Barrage.name: Brutal Barrage

Brutal Blows.description:
Requirements You have at least one active hand free and are holding nothing in your other pair of hands.

You pummel an opponent mercilessly. Make a fist Strike against an adjacent creature. If the Strike hits, you automatically @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.actions.Item.PMbdMWc2QroouFGD]{Grapple} the target in your inactive hands and make a second fist Strike with the following success conditions; the second Strike applies your multiple attack penalty as normal.

Critical Success The target is @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.dfCMdR4wnpbYNTix]{Stunned 1}, and @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.e1XGnhKNSQIm5IXg]{Stupefied 2} for 1 round.

Success The target is @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.e1XGnhKNSQIm5IXg]{Stupefied 1} for 1 round.
Brutal Blows.name: Brutal Blows

Bucking Escape.description:
Trigger You fail, but don't critically fail, an attempt to @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.actions.Item.SkZAQRkLLkmBQNB9]{Escape}.

You writhe wildly to get out of your predicament. You reroll the triggering attempt to Escape and use the second result.
Bucking Escape.name: Bucking Escape

Bug Bite.description: You have large and fearsome mandibles intended for protecting the hive. In addition, your body produces a venom that causes swelling, itching, and pain at the site of your bug bite. Your jaws unarmed attack deals 1d8 piercing damage and loses the finesse trait. Whenever you score a critical hit with your jaws unarmed attack, it deals an additional 1 persistent poison damage per weapon damage die.
Bug Bite.name: Bug Bite

Bulky Armplates.description: Your armplates are larger than most, giving you superior defensive capabilities. While you have your armplates raised, you can use the [[/act take-cover]] action to increase the circumstance bonus to AC to +4. This lasts until the shield is no longer raised, or until any of the normal conditions that end Take Cover, whichever comes first. If you would provide lesser cover against an attack, having your armplates raised provides standard cover against it (and other creatures can Take Cover as normal using the cover from your armplates).
Bulky Armplates.name: Bulky Armplates

Bullet Dance.description:
Requirements You're wielding a gun.

You dance across the battlefield while dispatching enemies with precision and grace. Stride up to twice. You can make up to three ranged Strikes during this movement. Each ranged Strike you make must target a different creature within your first range increment (calculated from the point at which you took your attack at that target). Each attack counts toward your multiple attack penalty but doesn't increase your penalty until you've made all your attacks.
Bullet Dance.name: Bullet Dance

Bullet Fever.description:
Frequency once per hour

Trigger You take damage that would reduce you to 0 Hit Points.

You fly into a frenzy instead of accepting defeat. Instead of being knocked out, you're reduced to 1 Hit Point, gain a number of temporary Hit Points equal to your half you level for 1 minute, increase your wounded value by 1, and enter a frenzy that lasts for 1 minute. You can't voluntarily end your frenzy. While in a frenzy caused by Bullet Fever, you're affected as follows.

  • You automatically apply precision damage to all targets as though you were Aiming.
  • You take a –1 circumstance penalty to AC.
  • You take a –1 circumstance penalty to Will saves.

  • You can't take actions that don't have the attack or move traits except to Reload your weapons.

When Bullet Fever ends, you lose any remaining temporary Hit Points from Bullet Fever.
Bullet Fever.name: Bullet Fever

Bullet Hell.description:
Requirements You're wielding an automatic or area (cone) weapon.

You fire your weapon in sustained bursts to unleash a consistent deluge of firepower that tears apart the terrain to become treacherous. Make an @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.actions.Item.oc0ZKnk5zD0GXqZi]{Area Fire} or @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.actions.Item.6ctkxUnVwqooSvgg]{Auto-Fire} attack with your weapon. Until the start of your next turn, any creature that moves through the area you attacked takes 1d4 damage of the same type as the weapon fired per square traversed, with a @Check[reflex|against:soldier|basic|options:area-effect] save at the end of each move action it takes through the area. On a failure, a creature becomes @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.enA7BxAjBb7ns1iF]{Suppressed} until the start of your next turn.
Bullet Hell.name: Bullet Hell

Bullet Typhoon.description: Your destructive power has become second nature as enemies stand in awe of your overwhelming firepower. You can use the Area Fire or Auto-Fire attacks as a single action. However, you can never make more than two such attacks in the same round.
Bullet Typhoon.name: Bullet Typhoon

Buoy.description:
Trigger An ally within 60 feet fails a Will saving throw.

You shout or sign encouragement to an ally in their time of need, buoying their spirits and hardening their resolve. Your ally rerolls the triggering check but must use the new result, even if it's worse. If you shout, Buoy gains the auditory trait. If you sign, Buoy gains the visual trait.
Buoy.name: Buoy

Burn Up.description:
You vent copious amounts of thermal energy as you fly, burning anyone in your path. Whenever you use Shooting Star, you can choose to vent thermal energy. If you do, you deal @Damage[(ceil(@actor.level/2)-4)d6[fire]] damage to all creatures in the spaces you move through, with a @Check[reflex|against:class-spell|basic] save against the higher of your class DC or spell DC. On a critical failure, a creature additionally catches fire, taking @Damage[ternary(gte(@actor.level,17),2,1)d4[persistent,fire]] damage.

At 15th level and every 2 levels thereafter, the fire damage increases by 1d6, and at 17th level, the persistent fire damage increases by 1d4.
Burn Up.name: Burn Up

Burrowing Specialist.description: Whether by natural appendages or through some personal modification, you can burrow. You gain a burrow Speed equal to your ancestry's Burrowing Specialist entry.
Burrowing Specialist.name: Burrowing Specialist

Burst Fire.description: You squeeze the trigger and release a calculated burst of fire. If you make your second Strike from @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.feats.Item.l5v7SnMbgsVGCsMA]{Double Tap} with the same gun, Double Tap counts as one attack when calculating your multiple attack penalty, and you apply your precision damage bonus from @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.actions.Item.sLikawnrJJzHMYeC]{Aim} to both Strikes.
Burst Fire.name: Burst Fire

Burst of Speed.description: You overexert your internal hydraulics for a burst of speed. You Stride with a +10-foot circumstance bonus to your Speed. When your movement ends, you become @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.enA7BxAjBb7ns1iF]{Suppressed} until the end of your next turn. You can't use this feat while suppressed.
Burst of Speed.name: Burst of Speed

Burst of Strength.description:
Frequency once per hour

Trigger You fail an Athletics check to @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.actions.Item.Dt6B1slsBy8ipJu9]{Disarm}, @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.actions.Item.PMbdMWc2QroouFGD]{Grapple}, @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.actions.Item.lOE4yjUnETTdaf2T]{Reposition}, @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.actions.Item.7blmbDrQFNfdT731]{Shove}, or @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.actions.Item.ge56Lu1xXVFYUnLP]{Trip}.

You draw on your inner reserves and rally yourself to try again. Reroll the triggering check, but you must use the new result, even if it's worse.
Burst of Strength.name: Burst of Strength

Bursting Surge.description:
You don't just hum with dim light, you exude a burst of it. When you use @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.feats.Item.JS24EjgLYcHB9E3T]{Nanite Surge}, you can choose to have your circuitry exude bright light in a @Template[emanation|distance:10] and dim light 10 feet beyond that for 1 round. Creatures that start their turn in the area of your bright light must attempt a @Check[reflex|against:class-spell|options:inflicts:blinded,inflicts:dazzled] save against the higher of your class DC or spell DC. On a failure, a creature is @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.TkIyaNPgTZFBCCuh]{Dazzled} for 1 round (or @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.XgEqL1kFApUbl5Z2]{Blinded} for 1 round and dazzled for 1 minute on a critical failure). A creature can spend a single Interact action to rub its eyes to remove the blinded condition.

@UUID[Compendium.sf2e.feat-effects.Item.MXV9PRH3mK7o6TDP]{Effect: Bursting Surge}
Bursting Surge.name: Bursting Surge

Byzantine Linguistics.description:
You've spent hours poring over dusty tombs and ancient inscriptions, giving you practiced insight into linguistic problems. You gain access to uncommon languages that are restricted due to belonging to ancient civilizations or long-lost cultures. This does not give you access to languages that are restricted for additional reasons, such as not being decoded yet or being a secret language.

You can use Society or Delve Lore to Decipher Writing and you gain a +1 circumstance bonus on checks made to decipher text in a language that you don't know.
Byzantine Linguistics.name: Byzantine Linguistics

Cable Slicer.description: You're a quick study when it comes to breaking things, even with minimal equipment. You gain a +2 circumstance bonus to Computers and Crafting checks to @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.actions.Item.cYdz2grcOcRt4jk6]{Disable a Device} if the device has the tech trait. Additionally, while wielding a weapon from the knife group, you can treat it as an @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.equipment.Item.coJUVZGcuVg3FoYh]{Infiltrator's Toolkit} when attempting to Disable a Device or @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.actions.Item.2EE4aF4SZpYf0R6H]{Pick a Lock}.
Cable Slicer.name: Cable Slicer

Calcifying Enzymes.description: Your resin contains a protective hardening reagent activated by stress. Whenever you're @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.i3OJZU2nk64Df3xm]{Clumsy}, @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.4D2KBtexWXa6oUMR]{Drained}, or @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.MIRkyAjyBeXivMa7]{Enfeebled}, you gain resistance equal to the value of the condition against physical damage. This doesn't apply to conditions caused by beneficial effects, such as the @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.spells.Item.wzctak6BxOW8xvFV]{Enlarge} spell.
Calcifying Enzymes.name: Calcifying Enzymes

Call Forth Gravity.description: Gravitational forces are always accessible to you, even in a vacuum. You can cast @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.spells.Item.0mNmVi9CLXor3McX]{Personal Gravity} as a 3rd-rank occult innate spell once per day. The first time each day that you cast this spell while in a vacuum, that casting doesn't count toward this limit.
Call Forth Gravity.name: Call Forth Gravity

Call the Hive.description:
When you're stumped, you can reach out through your hive mind to access the shared knowledge of your colony. Once per day, when you attempt to @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.actions.Item.1OagaWtBpVXExToo]{Recall Knowledge} with a skill you aren't trained in, you can treat your level as your proficiency bonus. Additionally, you can roll twice on the check and take the better result.

Special If you have the @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.feats.Item.i9mumLmHNlH0iIfx]{Hypertelepathy} feat, you can use the skill modifier of a willing ally within range of your telepathy even if it's a skill you aren't trained in.
Call the Hive.name: Call the Hive

Called to Another World.description: The Call led you far away to another planet. You gain the @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.feats.Item.ihN8gkHSdPG9Trte]{Adopted Ancestry} general feat, and you also gain one 1st-level ancestry feat from the ancestry you chose for the Adopted Ancestry feat or the @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.feats.Item.mcl1efgOfMJK1UU9]{Unconventional Weapon} standardized ancestry feat.
Called to Another World.name: Called to Another World

Called to Artistry.description: When you first heard the Call, you began to truly understand the meaning of beauty. Once per day, when you fail a Crafting check, Performance check, or a Lore check related to art or crafting, you can reroll the check and take the higher result.
Called to Artistry.name: Called to Artistry

Called to Help.description: The Call led you to help others, whether members of your ancestral colony or friends you've made after years of swashbuckling adventures. At the start of your turn, you gain one additional reaction, which you can use only to Aid.
Called to Help.name: Called to Help

Called to War.description: The Call led you to war, whether on Castrovel or another world. When wielding a weapon you aren't proficient with, treat your level as your proficiency bonus. At 11th level, you become trained in all weapons.
Called to War.name: Called to War

Calm Before the Storm.description: You maintain a calm demeanor even when facing mortal peril. When frightened, at the end of your turn, reduce your frightened condition by 2 instead of 1.
Calm Before the Storm.name: Calm Before the Storm

Camera Blur.description:
Frequency once per hour

With focus, you remove yourself from videos and pictures, leaving only pixelated images and static behind. You become @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.DmAIPqOBomZ7H95W]{Concealed} to all technological visual sensors, such as security cameras, ocular cybernetic augmentations, and the visual processors of technological constructs, for 1 minute.
Camera Blur.name: Camera Blur

Camouflage Expert.description: You use your camouflaged skin to your advantage, moving unseen with ease. When you use Shifthide Camouflage and are in your selected terrain, you can [[/act hide]] or [[/act sneak]] without cover or being @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.DmAIPqOBomZ7H95W]{Concealed}.
Camouflage Expert.name: Camouflage Expert

Camouvisage.description: You shift the color and texture of your skin to match your surroundings. You Change Shape, but instead of taking on the form of another creature, you blend in with your environment. As long as an observer is at least 20 feet away from you, you don't need cover from that observer to Hide or @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.actions.Item.VMozDqMMuK5kpoX4]{Sneak}. This lasts as long as you stay in your new form or until you move to an area with substantially different terrain.
Camouvisage.name: Camouvisage

Cannonball.description:
Years of playing skitterspree trained you for a special move. You curl up into a tightly wound ball, and an adjacent ally with a free hand that's at least one size larger than you can use a reaction to attempt a ranged Strike with your body as an unarmed attack that deals 1d10 bludgeoning damage for the duration of the Strike. This unarmed attack is in the brawling weapon group and has the agile, analog, brutal, and thrown (20 feet) traits. This unarmed attack gains the benefits of your worn @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.equipment.Item.b12tnjobe9IrphII]{hardlight handwraps}. You land adjacent to the target, but you land @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.j91X7x0XSomq8d60]{Prone} if the Strike is a critical failure.

@UUID[Compendium.sf2e.feat-effects.Item.hi8MzgUdx532I1Gt]{Effect: Cannonball}
Cannonball.name: Cannonball

Canny Acumen.description: Your avoidance or observation is beyond the ken of most in your profession. Choose Fortitude saves, Reflex saves, Will saves, or Perception. You become an expert in your choice. At 17th level, you become a master in your choice.
Canny Acumen.name: Canny Acumen

Canny Survivor.description: Your survival instincts are honed by a life of danger and scarcity, and you've learned to never let your guard down. You are not @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.AJh5ex99aV6VTggg]{Off-Guard} against @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.iU0fEDdBp3rXpTMC]{Hidden} or @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.VRSef5y1LmL2Hkjf]{Undetected} creatures. In addition, you can use @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.feats.Item.WXyalVd471MVyoN6]{Survivor's Instincts} anytime you would attempt a Reflex save.
Canny Survivor.name: Canny Survivor

Cantrip Expansion.description: Study broadens your range of simple spells. Add two additional cantrips from your spell list to your repertoire.
Cantrip Expansion.name: Cantrip Expansion

Capture Laser.description: Light is nourishment for you, even if it comes in the form of highly concentrated beams. You gain resistance 5 against laser weapons and effects with the light trait. You can also use the @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.actions.Item.OdKGpXP83uA1wdES]{Photon Accelerator} activity.
Capture Laser.name: Capture Laser

Careful Planning.description: Your life has a strict time limit, and it makes every moment more valuable. It's incumbent upon you to go to great lengths to ensure that none of your time is wasted. You gain a +2 circumstance bonus to Perception checks for initiative.
Careful Planning.name: Careful Planning

Careful Strike.description:
You focus on your solar weapon's trajectory so you can adjust it up to the last possible moment and turn a missed attack into a glancing blow. Make a Strike with your solar flare or solar weapon. It gains the following failure effect.

Failure Your attack deals damage equal to your Strength modifier. It doesn't count as a hit and doesn't trigger any other special abilities.
Careful Strike.name: Careful Strike

Carrion Feeder.description: Once per day as an Interact action, you can siphon nutrients from a dead creature. You consume part of a creature that hasn't been dead for more than 24 hours, and you heal 3d8 Hit Points, plus 1d8 for every 2 of your levels beyond 5th (@Damage[(ceil(@actor.level/2)d8)[healing]]).
Carrion Feeder.name: Carrion Feeder

Carry Their Memories.description:
You have spent more of your life away from elven communities than you have within them and have grown accustomed to living surrounded by other species. You've buried more non-elven friends than most elves will make across their entire lifetimes, and you will carry the memories of these friends for centuries.

During your daily preparations, you can reminisce about a lost friend, gaining the @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.feats.Item.W6Gl9ePmItfDHji0]{Assurance} skill feat for one skill you're trained in. This lasts until you prepare again. Since this skill feat is temporary, you can't use it to satisfy a prerequisite for a permanent character option.
Carry Their Memories.name: Carry Their Memories

Cat Fall.description: Your catlike aerial acrobatics allow you to cushion your falls. Treat falls as 10 feet shorter. If you're an expert in Acrobatics, treat falls as 25 feet shorter and 50 feet if you're a master. If you're legendary in Acrobatics, you always land on your feet and don't take damage, regardless of the distance of the fall.
Cat Fall.name: Cat Fall

Caterwaul Concertina.description:
Frequency once per day

By preparing your caterwaul, you can focus on your performance and sing to a wider audience. If your next action is to use @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.feats.Item.JEzClwVFM97EUKMX]{Pahtra Caterwaul}, you can affect up to five targets instead of one. If any allies in range of your caterwaul speak Pahtra, they can spend their reaction to join in on your Pahtra Caterwaul. If at least one ally joins the Pahtra Caterwaul, increase the frightened value of targets that fail their save by 1.
Caterwaul Concertina.name: Caterwaul Concertina

Caterwaul Strut.description: You can sashay while you sing. You Stride. You can use @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.feats.Item.JEzClwVFM97EUKMX]{Pahtra Caterwaul} at any point during the Stride. If you're more than 5 feet above the target of this Pahtra Caterwaul, the range of the Pahtra Caterwaul increases by 30 feet.
Caterwaul Strut.name: Caterwaul Strut

Caustic Biotoxins.description: Your body excretes abrasive chemicals in your slime when you're threatened. When you use @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.ancestry-features.Item.F7aBUHwgBVRdyZJe]{Slime Squirt} or @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.feats.Item.64rwZGS8fKt8P5Ae]{Slime Spray}, creatures in the area take @Damage[floor(@item.level/3)d4[persistent,acid]] damage with a basic @Check[reflex|against:class-spell] saving throw against the higher of your class DC or spell DC. At 12th level and every three levels thereafter, the persistent acid damage increases by 1d4.
Caustic Biotoxins.name: Caustic Biotoxins

Caustic Trail.description:
Frequency once per day

A mixture of resin and corrosive slime oozes from you and trails behind you as you move. You Climb or Stride twice. You leave a trail of slime in each square you leave as part of this movement, and each square adjacent to those squares, except the square where you end your movement. Each square containing slime becomes difficult terrain as well as hazardous terrain, dealing @Damage[2[acid]] damage for each square a creature moves through. The slime dries out, ending these effects, after 1 minute.

At 17th level, the hazardous terrain deals @Damage[6[acid]] damage.
Caustic Trail.name: Caustic Trail

Cautious Curiosity.description: You've met all kinds of people in your long and varied life and have steeled your mind with caution. You gain a +1 circumstance bonus to saves against mental effects and a +2 circumstance bonus to Perception checks to @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.actions.Item.1xRFPTFtWtGJ9ELw]{Sense Motive}.
Cautious Curiosity.name: Cautious Curiosity

Cautious Trespasser.description: You grew up in a dangerous environment that taught you to be wary. You can perform the Investigate exploration activity at the same time as the @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.actions.Item.TiNDYUGlMmxzxBYU]{Search} exploration activity.
Cautious Trespasser.name: Cautious Trespasser

Cave Legs.description: Scrambling through tunnels beneath the rocky surface of Nchak can be difficult when you're a 12-foot-tall arthropod with thick, armored plates covering most of your body, but they say practice makes perfect. You've spent enough time squeezing yourself through tunnels that your exoskeleton has grown accustomed to bending and deforming to fit in tight spaces, and by now, it hardly slows you down at all. You become trained in Acrobatics. If you would automatically become trained in Acrobatics (from your background or class, for example), you instead become trained in another skill of your choice. You gain the @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.feats.Item.3G8xUlgCjRmRJNfP]{Quick Squeeze} feat.
Cave Legs.name: Cave Legs

Cellular Acceleration.description:
Frequency once per day

You speed up your body's metabolism and respiration by changing yourself at a cellular level. You become @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.nlCjDvLMf2EkV2dl]{Quickened} for 1 minute and can use the extra action each round only for Strike and Stride actions.
Cellular Acceleration.name: Cellular Acceleration

Cellular Adaptation.description: The malleable nature of your body dulls the impact of physical ailments. You gain a +1 circumstance bonus to saving throws against diseases, poisons, and radiation. If you roll a success on a saving throw against one of these effects, you get a critical success instead.
Cellular Adaptation.name: Cellular Adaptation

Cellular Regeneration.description:
Frequency once per day

Your body can repair damaged cells and even regrow missing limbs. You gain regeneration equal to half your level for 1 minute. During this time, you can't die from damage and your dying condition can't increase to a value that would kill you, though if your @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.Yl48xTdMh3aeQYL2]{Wounded} value becomes 4 or higher, you stay @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.fBnFDH2MTzgFijKf]{Unconscious} until your wounds are treated. Each time you regain Hit Points from regeneration, you also regrow one damaged or ruined organ (if any), and you can reattach severed body parts by spending an Interact action to hold the body part to the area it was severed from.
Cellular Regeneration.name: Cellular Regeneration

Cellular Static Discharge.description:
Frequency once per hour

Your body stores cellular kinetic energy as a static charge. You discharge this electricity in a @Template[emanation|distance:10] (@Template[emanation|distance:15]{15 feet} if you're in a body of water). All creatures in the area take @Damage[ternary(gte(@actor.level,17),11,ternary(gte(@actor.level,13),8,5))d6[electricity]|options:area-damage] damage (basic @Check[reflex|against:class-spell|basic|options:area-effect] save against the higher of your class DC or spell DC). On a critical failure, a creature becomes @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.eIcWbB5o3pP6OIMe]{Immobilized} for 1 round. At 13th level, the damage increases to 8d6. At 17th level, the damage increases to 11d6.
Cellular Static Discharge.name: Cellular Static Discharge

Center Thoughts.description:
Frequency once per day

Trigger You fail a Will saving throw against a mental effect.

You center your thoughts and focus your mind, shaking off emotional turmoil and harmful mental intrusions. Reroll the triggering saving throw and use the better result.
Center Thoughts.name: Center Thoughts

Center Your Emotions.description:
Frequency once every 10 minutes

You pause and take a quick breath to stabilize your emotions. Choose any emotional state for your soulfeel.

Special You can Center Your Emotions as a free action if you're a @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.heritages.Item.7wp6pQc0ZLbShHgl]{Court of Dance Moyishuu} who chooses joy, a @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.heritages.Item.2zafLaWFZJJ1Lcln]{Court of Fields Moyishuu} who chooses wonder, a @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.heritages.Item.n7PPMZNz1x1UxXNt]{Court of Flames Moyishuu} who chooses fury, or a @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.heritages.Item.5ClxThmv7Plakmee]{Court of Song Moyishuu} who chooses sorrow.
Center Your Emotions.name: Center Your Emotions

Centered Mind.description: You know your own mind and instinctively resist attempts to unbalance your thoughts or control your emotions. You can use @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.feats.Item.sobAVW9cH4VGaRkn]{Center Thoughts} once per hour, rather than once per day.
Centered Mind.name: Centered Mind

Centering Scent.description:
You can recenter yourself with a familiar scent stored on your body, such as a favorite food, the scarf of a loved one, or a sample of dirt from your home world. Roll a @Check[flat|dc:5].

Critical Success Reduce your @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{Frightened} value by 2.

Success Reduce your frightened value by 1.
Centering Scent.name: Centering Scent

Cerebral Circumvention.description:
Trigger A Telepredicted creature uses an effect that requires a Reflex save or attempts to @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.actions.Item.Dt6B1slsBy8ipJu9]{Disarm} or @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.actions.Item.ge56Lu1xXVFYUnLP]{Trip} you.

Requirements You have a bonus against the target using Telepredict.

By reading cues and analyzing probability outcomes, you smoothly predicting your opponent's next move. You gain a +1 circumstance bonus to your Reflex save or Reflex DC against the triggering action. Increase this bonus to +2 if you've dealt mental damage to the target since the last time you used Telepredict.
Cerebral Circumvention.name: Cerebral Circumvention

Change of Plans.description:
Trigger The target of your @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.actions.Item.cmCtfURzpbzkxWsy]{Get 'Em!} is reduced to 0 Hit Points.

Requirements You used Get 'Em! against a creature on your last turn.

When the target you directed your allies to take down falls @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.fBnFDH2MTzgFijKf]{Unconscious} or is destroyed, you quickly direct them at another target. You use Get 'Em! against a new target following all the normal targeting restrictions for Get 'Em! You don't count as leading by example against this new target.
Change of Plans.name: Change of Plans

Channel the World's Core.description:
Frequency once per day

Many talphi philosophers have studied the forces underlying the universe for countless generations, finding ways to link their minds to primordial forces much like solarians. You can steady your body and mind to attune yourself to the ultradense core of your home planet, channeling the pressure and density of its core through your weapon. Add 1d4 bludgeoning damage per weapon damage die to the next attack you make with your weapon before the end of your next turn. On a critical hit, roll these damage die after doubling the weapon's damage.
Channel the World's Core.name: Channel the World's Core

Charged Blood.description:
Frequency once per day

You invoke your arcane blood so that it can revitalize and energize your body. You regain @Damage[6d6[healing]] Hit Points. You also gain the @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.nlCjDvLMf2EkV2dl]{Quickened} condition until the end of your next turn and can use the extra action to only Stride or Strike.
Charged Blood.name: Charged Blood

Charming Liar.description: Your charm allows you to win over those you lie to. When you get a critical success using the @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.actions.Item.ewwCglB7XOPLUz72]{Lie} action, the target's attitude toward you improves by one step, as though you'd succeeded at using Diplomacy to @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.actions.Item.OX4fy22hQgUHDr0q]{Make an Impression}. This works only once per conversation, and if you critically succeed against multiple targets using the same result, you choose one creature's attitude to improve. You must be lying to impart seemingly important information, inflate your status, or ingratiate yourself, which trivial or irrelevant lies can't achieve.
Charming Liar.name: Charming Liar

Chattermander.description: You never let the inability to communicate stop you from chatting with nufriends! You gain @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.spells.Item.BBvV7qoXGdw09q1C]{Speak with Animals} as a 2nd-rank primal innate spell, and @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.spells.Item.qvwIwJ9QBihy8R0t]{Speak with Plants} and @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.spells.Item.vTQvfYu2llKQedmY]{Translate} as 3rd-rank primal innate spells. You can cast each of these primal innate spells once per day.
Chattermander.name: Chattermander

Check it Out!.description: You've poured all your creativity into making your weapon truly eye-catching. Choose one weapon you own to decorate in your own style. While wielding your chosen weapon, add the weapon's tracking value as an item bonus to Deception checks to @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.actions.Item.QNAVeNKtHA0EUw4X]{Feint} and Intimidation checks to @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.actions.Item.2u915NdUyQan6uKF]{Demoralize}. You can only have one such weapon active at a time. You can spend 24 hours customizing a new weapon, at which point your connection with your previous weapon is lost.
Check it Out!.name: Check it Out!

Cheek Holster.description:
You know the best place to keep a firearm is out of sight, and you've adjusted your cheeks for maximum efficiency. It takes 10 minutes to safely prepare a one-handed gun and store it in your cheek pouch, and the gun can be up to 1 Bulk. As a single action, you can Interact to draw and Strike with the gun you stored in your mouth.

Special If you have the @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.feats.Item.cCv9pgyXzZ0TQmZg]{Big Mouth} ysoki feat, you can store a two-handed gun instead of a one-handed gun, and the gun you store can be up to 2 Bulk instead of the normal amount.
Cheek Holster.name: Cheek Holster

Cheek Pouches.description: Your cheeks are stretchy, and you can store up to four items of light Bulk or less in these cheek pouches. None of these items can have a dimension longer than 1 foot. As long as you have at least one item in your cheek pouches, your speech is noticeably difficult to understand. Placing an item in your cheek pouch or retrieving one is an Interact action. You can empty your mouth with a single action, causing everything you had stored in your cheek pouches to fall to the ground in your square.
Cheek Pouches.name: Cheek Pouches

Cheer Up.description: You encourage an adjacent ally to overcome their minor ailments by patting them on the back, providing them useful advice, or offering some form of comfort or inspiration. The target reduces the value of one of the following conditions of their choice by 2: @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.i3OJZU2nk64Df3xm]{Clumsy}, @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.MIRkyAjyBeXivMa7]{Enfeebled}, @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{Frightened}, @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.fesd1n5eVhpCSS18]{Sickened}, @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.e1XGnhKNSQIm5IXg]{Stupefied}. The target then becomes temporarily immune to Cheer Up for 1 day.
Cheer Up.name: Cheer Up

Chemical Connoisseur.description: Your acute taste boosts your immunities. You gain a +2 circumstance bonus to saves against effects with the disease, ingested, olfactory, or poison traits. Any disease you contract with a level lower than your own loses the virulent trait.
Chemical Connoisseur.name: Chemical Connoisseur

Chew Through Wires.description: The quickest way to stop a machine, in your experience, is to bite it over and over. Your melee unarmed Strikes gain the razing trait.
Chew Through Wires.name: Chew Through Wires

Child of the Red Planet.description: Calling upon your birthright as a shobhad, you channel the spirit of your ancestral home world of Akiton to encase you in a forbidding aura that causes your enemies to shy away from you in fear. Clad in the glory of the red planet, none can stand before you! You can cast @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.spells.Item.yrZA4k2VAqEP8xx7]{Repulsion} once per day as a primal innate spell. Creatures from Akiton take a –2 penalty to their Will saves against this effect.
Child of the Red Planet.name: Child of the Red Planet

Chitinous Shield.description: You have a growth of particularly durable chitin on your arm that you can use as a shield. This shield doesn't need to be held in your hand, and it can't be disarmed. Your shield has an AC bonus of +2, Hardness 4, 12 Hit Points, and a Broken Threshold of 6. If your shield becomes broken, it can't be repaired until you are restored to full health and spend 10 minutes readjusting your chitin. You can spend 1 day of downtime and expend raw materials (such as UPBs) to improve the grade of your shield, but only to a grade up to your level (such as advanced if you're level 8 or higher). Use the level, price, Hardness, HP, and BT adjustments in the Shield Improvements table.
Chitinous Shield.name: Chitinous Shield

Chitterspam.description: By chittering out a hodgepodge of complex algorithmic computer code, you can disrupt technology attempting to process your words. You gain the @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.feats.Item.abcKcLvAGE5AKig4]{Combat Hack} skill feat. You can Combat Hack a creature with the tech trait within 30 feet without the use of a @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.equipment.Item.qqjDcCW118ySAlAS]{hacking toolkit} or free hand. If you do, the action loses the manipulate trait and gains the auditory and linguistic traits.
Chitterspam.name: Chitterspam

Chosen Family.description: Traveling across the galaxy, you've formed a tight bond with your found family, absorbing some of their culture now as your own. You gain the @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.feats.Item.ihN8gkHSdPG9Trte]{Adopted Ancestry} general feat, and you also gain one 1st-level ancestry feat from the ancestry you chose for the Adopted Ancestry feat.
Chosen Family.name: Chosen Family

Chosen of Nchak.description: Hylax's favor flows through you, and you can feel her calling out, offering you a gift. You spend 24 hours in prayer deep underground, under intense environmental pressure. The power of Hylax flows into your exoskeleton, thickening the plates, strengthening the flesh beneath them, and providing you with the ultimate protection. You gain resistance to all physical damage (except adamantine) equal to one quarter your level (minimum 1).
Chosen of Nchak.name: Chosen of Nchak

Cite the Deep Lore.description:
You're one of the forlorn, and the centuries you've spent away from Castrovel have helped you understand how other species live and how to move among them without drawing undue attention.

You become trained in Society. If you would automatically become trained in Society (from your background or class, for example), you instead become trained in a skill of your choice. You gain the @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.feats.Item.49lDxXmZZ0eJFI78]{Blend In} skill feat.
Cite the Deep Lore.name: Cite the Deep Lore

Clan Crystal Form.description:
Your clan crystal glows and expands, coating you in the ores found in the crust of the planet you were born nearest to.

You can cast @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.spells.Item.HAaRcHfN4g83eSEC]{Cairn Form} twice per day as a 6th-rank primal innate spell. You resemble the statue found on your clan crystal when you do so. While in cairn form, increase the damage die size of your clan crystal weapon by one step, and double your resistance to laser weapons and effects with the light trait.
Clan Crystal Form.name: Clan Crystal Form

Claws of the Artist.description: Your work emphasizes the skilled manual dexterity and attention to detail required to create beautiful works of artistry. You gain the @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.feats.Item.QLeMH5mQgh28sa5o]{Specialty Crafting} feat of your choice. Additionally, your background in artistry has left you with a keen eye for aesthetics that can often make your work more valuable to collectors. When you roll a critical success on Crafting to @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.actions.Item.QyzlsLrqM0EEwd7j]{Earn Income}, you gain the amount of currency listed for the task level + 2 and your proficiency rank.
Claws of the Artist.name: Claws of the Artist

Cleanse Spirit.description: Through your knowledge of traditional kasathan healing rituals and meditative practices, you've learned to cleanse the body and mind of the ill or troubled. You gain @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.spells.Item.SUKaxVZW2TlM8lu0]{Cleanse Affliction} and @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.spells.Item.Et8RSCLx8w7uOLvo]{Sound Body} as 4th-rank occult innate spells. You can cast each of these occult innate spells once per day.
Cleanse Spirit.name: Cleanse Spirit

Clever Improviser.description: You've learned how to handle situations when you're out of your depth. You gain the @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.feats.Item.9jGaBxLUtevZYcZO]{Untrained Improvisation} general feat. In addition, you can attempt skill actions that normally require you to be trained, even if you are untrained.
Clever Improviser.name: Clever Improviser

Climbing Claws.description: You can extend your claws to aid you in climbing. You gain a climb Speed equal to your land Speed.
Climbing Claws.name: Climbing Claws

Climbing Specialist.description: Whether by natural appendages or by some personal modification, you can climb. You gain a climb Speed equal to your ancestry's Climbing Specialist entry.
Climbing Specialist.name: Climbing Specialist

Clinging Bite.description: You have excellent control over your stomach-mouth. Your jaws unarmed attack gains the grapple trait. When you critically hit with your jaws attack, you can use your next action to attempt to @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.actions.Item.PMbdMWc2QroouFGD]{Grapple} that creature with your jaws or automatically extend the @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.kWc1fhmv9LBiTuei]{Grabbed} condition on a creature you're restraining with your jaws. This attempt neither applies nor counts toward your multiple attack penalty.
Clinging Bite.name: Clinging Bite

Clinging Flare.description: Your flare wraps around your foes on impact, entangling them. Make a solar flare Strike. On a hit, the target is @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.eIcWbB5o3pP6OIMe]{Immobilized} until the end of its next turn or until it Escapes (against your class DC), whichever comes first. On a critical hit, the target is additionally @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.AJh5ex99aV6VTggg]{Off-Guard} for as long as it's immobilized.
Clinging Flare.name: Clinging Flare

Cloaking Field.description:
Frequency once per hour

You bend light and background vibrations around yourself, either through expertise or a bit of technological ingenuity, allowing you to avoid detection. You become @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.zJxUflt9np0q4yML]{Invisible} for 10 minutes. This makes you @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.VRSef5y1LmL2Hkjf]{Undetected} to all creatures, though creatures can attempt to find you, making you @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.iU0fEDdBp3rXpTMC]{Hidden} instead. If you use a hostile action, the effect ends after that hostile action is completed. While your Cloaking Field is active, security cameras, sentries, and other surveillance don't detect you unless they possess special senses that normally see through invisibility.
Cloaking Field.name: Cloaking Field

Close the Gap.description:
1 or 2

Frequency once per hour

You advance into danger, heedless of threats and intent on closing with your targets. Stride once, or Stride twice if you used two actions. You gain a +10-foot status bonus to your Speed for these Strides.
Close the Gap.name: Close the Gap

Cloud Jump.description:
Your unparalleled athletic skill allows you to jump impossible distances. Triple the distance you jump on a successful @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.actions.Item.JUvAvruz7yRQXfz2]{Long Jump} (so you could jump 90 feet with an Athletics result of 30). When you successfully @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.actions.Item.2HJ4yuEFY1Cast4h]{High Jump}, use the distance jumped and distance limit for a Long Jump but don't triple the distance.

You can jump a distance greater than your Speed by spending additional actions when you Long Jump or High Jump. For each additional action spent, add your Speed to the distance limit.
Cloud Jump.name: Cloud Jump

Cloud Storage.description: You can use your vitality network as an extradimensional storage space, sliding items into and out of thin air as if it were a @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.equipment.Item.EAMHdtJLqWUO0ZU0]{Null Space Chamber}. You can Interact with an item that weighs 1 Bulk or less to stow it into your Cloud Storage. A creature in your bond and on the same plane can remove an item from your Cloud Storage as an Interact action, but doing so takes 2 actions instead of 1 action. Your Cloud Storage has a capacity of 12 Bulk. This increases to 25 Bulk at 8th level, 50 Bulk at 12th level, and 75 Bulk at 16th level.
Cloud Storage.name: Cloud Storage

Clustered Shots.description:
Requirements You're wielding a gun with at least 3 expend worth of ammunition.

You shoot a spray of bullets at a target. You @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.actions.Item.sLikawnrJJzHMYeC]{Aim}, make a ranged Strike against your mark, and subtract three times your weapon's expend from its magazine. Roll the attack twice, and use the better result. The attack ignores circumstance penalties to the attack roll and any flat check required due to the target being @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.DmAIPqOBomZ7H95W]{Concealed} or @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.iU0fEDdBp3rXpTMC]{Hidden}.
Clustered Shots.name: Clustered Shots

Coagulation.description: Your blood coagulates into sludge, making your body more resilient against attacks that rip and shred. You gain resistance to bleed and precision damage equal to your level. The DC of your flat checks to recover from persistent bleed damage is 13 rather than 15. This reduces to 8 rather than 10 when receiving appropriate assistance.
Coagulation.name: Coagulation

Coastal Adaptation.description:
You grew up in a colony that builds structures along the coast and in the oceans, and you've adapted to life underwater. You become trained in Athletics. If you would automatically become trained in Athletics (from your background or class, for example), you instead become trained in another skill of your choice. You gain a swim Speed of 5 feet and the amphibious trait, allowing you to breathe underwater as well as in the air.

Special If you take the @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.feats.Item.CkbBMAYyehWlKVBS]{Swimming Specialist} ancestry feat, you gain a swim Speed of 30 feet instead of 20 feet.
Coastal Adaptation.name: Coastal Adaptation

Coat in Bile.description:
Frequency once per day

Requirements You're wielding a weapon that deals physical damage.

You coat your weapon or its ammunition in your toxic stomach fluids, which remain potent until the end of your next turn. The next time you successfully Strike a creature with the required weapon within the duration, if the Strike deals damage, you deal an additional 1d4 poison damage to the target. At 3rd level and every 2 levels thereafter, this damage increases by 1d4.
Coat in Bile.name: Coat in Bile

Code Talker.description: Your understanding of languages extends to the logic-driven way computers and other technology communicates, allowing you to participate in their electronic dialogue. You become trained in Computers. If you would automatically become trained in Computers (from your background or class, for example), you instead become trained in another skill of your choice. You gain the @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.feats.Item.ifQiKhl0Gt2CM7i9]{Phreaker} skill feat. You can use Computers instead of Diplomacy to Make a [[/act request skill=computers]] of creatures with the tech trait.
Code Talker.name: Code Talker

Cognitive Agility.description:
You adjust quickly to changing circumstances in battle, whether from intense training or some intrinsic knowledge. As a result, you're able to shake off effects that are intended to distract or cloud the mind.

You gain a +1 status bonus to saving throws against emotion effects and a +1 to your Perception DC against attempts to @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.actions.Item.GkmbTGfg8KcgynOA]{Create a Diversion} and @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.actions.Item.QNAVeNKtHA0EUw4X]{Feint}.
Cognitive Agility.name: Cognitive Agility
