If the Strike hits, attempt to @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.actions.Item.Dt6B1slsBy8ipJu9]{Disarm} the target using the same ranged attack roll against the target's Reflex DC, instead of attempting an Athletics check. A Disarming Shot counts as two attacks for your multiple attack penalty, but the penalty doesn't increase until after you've used Disarming Shot.
Disarming Shot.name: Disarming Shot

Disciple of the Cycle.description: While it pales in comparison to the powers of a true solarian, you are a devoted disciple of the Cycle and can temporarily manifest control over the powers of the cosmos. You gain @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.spells.Item.kR5A0h2a9hY41wav]{Entropy Strike} and @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.spells.Item.VmtQlZqeraTv0Eer]{Skyfire Wings} as 3rd-rank occult innate spells. You can cast each of these occult innate spells once per day.
Disciple of the Cycle.name: Disciple of the Cycle

Disciplined Follower.description: You adapt to new hierarchies with ease and find reassurance in a reliable command structure. When using the @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.actions.Item.tfa4Sh7wcxCEqL29]{Follow the Expert} activity in exploration mode, you gain a +3 circumstance bonus if the ally you're following is an expert and a +4 circumstance bonus if your ally is a master. In addition, if you roll a success on your saving throw against a mental effect that would make you controlled, you get a critical success instead.
Disciplined Follower.name: Disciplined Follower

Dishonored Contrarian.description: When the going gets tough, the tough fight tooth and nail to build a better life—literally. Your fellow vlakas might carry hope, dreams, and unending optimism in their hearts, but you've always found it harder to look on the bright side, and you've done some dubious things to get by. Whether you've lied, cheated, stolen, or taken some lives, you know that you did what it took to survive and thrive in a cold and callous galaxy. You become trained in one of the following skills of your choice: Deception, Intimidation, or Thievery. If you select Deception, you gain the @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.feats.Item.HEBXaS656MZTiWFu]{Lengthy Diversion} skill feat. If you select Intimidation, you gain the @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.feats.Item.gUqvezs2zzoTXFAI]{Group Coercion} skill feat. If you select Thievery, you gain the @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.feats.Item.hVZbnsDuXihggylt]{Subtle Theft} skill feat.
Dishonored Contrarian.name: Dishonored Contrarian

Disperse!.description:
When you're fully decked out in your Hellknight regalia, just the presence of your fearsome visage drives enemies back. Attempt an @Check[intimidation] check against an enemy within 30 feet who can perceive you.

Critical Success You push your target up to 10 feet away from you. You can Stride after it, but you must move the same distance and in the same direction.

Success You push your target back 5 feet. You can Stride after it, but you must move the same distance and in the same direction.
Disperse!.name: Disperse!

Dissect Recordings.description: You've spent hours going through limdive footage, and now you're an expert at finding hidden details in recordings. You become trained in Computers; if you're already trained, you instead become trained in another skill of your choice. You gain the @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.feats.Item.GBGvxPo6rnlEXFMg]{Hologram Skeptic} skill feat. Additionally, when you critically fail your check to @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.actions.Item.d9gbpiQjChYDYA2L]{Decipher Writing}, @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.actions.Item.1OagaWtBpVXExToo]{Recall Knowledge}, or [[/act seek]] by watching recorded footage, you fail instead.
Dissect Recordings.name: Dissect Recordings

Distant Blur.description: You become a blur when you push yourself to move as fast as you can. When you Stride while @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.nlCjDvLMf2EkV2dl]{Quickened} from @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.feats.Item.ydQ7gfZubVug7xLK]{Need for Speed}, you gain @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.DmAIPqOBomZ7H95W]{Concealment} until the start of your next turn. As usual for concealment involving an obvious visual manifestation, you can't use this concealment to @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.actions.Item.XMcnh4cSI32tljXa]{Hide} or @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.actions.Item.VMozDqMMuK5kpoX4]{Sneak}.
Distant Blur.name: Distant Blur

Distant Feint.description: You're an incredible actor, and you can use your over-the-top bits and dramatic gestures to throw a foe off its game. If you're wielding a ranged weapon, you can @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.actions.Item.QNAVeNKtHA0EUw4X]{Feint} against an opponent at a range of 100 feet, rather than just within melee reach. If you succeed, the opponent is @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.AJh5ex99aV6VTggg]{Off-Guard} against your melee and ranged attacks, rather than only your melee attacks.
Distant Feint.name: Distant Feint

Distant Flare.description: Your concentration lets you fire your solar flare even further. Increase the range increment of your solar flare by 15 feet.
Distant Flare.name: Distant Flare

Distant Telepath.description:
Whether through training or innate talent, you've expanded the range at which you can telepathically communicate. Increase the range of your limited telepathy by 15 feet.

Special You can select this feat more than once.
Distant Telepath.name: Distant Telepath

Distracting Cling.description:
Requirements Your target is larger than you.

You cling to a target with a sticky grasp. Attempt an @Check[athletics|against:fortitude] check against the target's Fortitude DC.

Critical Success The target is @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.XgEqL1kFApUbl5Z2]{Blinded} until the end of your next turn, unless you move or your target Escapes. If the target moves, you move with them.

Success The target is @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.TkIyaNPgTZFBCCuh]{Dazzled} until the end of your next turn, unless you move or your target Escapes. If the target moves, you move with them.

Failure You miss the target.

Critical Failure You miss the target and land @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.j91X7x0XSomq8d60]{Prone}.
Distracting Cling.name: Distracting Cling

Distracting Gesture.description: Kasathan combat training tends to focus on grace instead of economy of movement. Certain forms and gestures are passed down both for their beauty and their capacity to distract an unfocused foe. Once per turn, when you Switch Hands you can [[/act feint]] as a free action.
Distracting Gesture.name: Distracting Gesture

Disturbing Violence.description: You're a vicious fighter. When you succeed at a melee weapon Strike against a @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{Frightened} enemy, that enemy can't reduce their frightened condition below 1 until the beginning of your next turn.
Disturbing Violence.name: Disturbing Violence

Dive Bomb.description: A well-trained maraquoi hunter can launch themself at their prey from any perch, in any direction. You [[/act high-jump]], [[/act long-jump]], or [[/act maneuver-in-flight]] to @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.actions.Item.cS9nfDRGD83bNU1p]{Fly} your fly Speed. If you move at least 10 feet and end in a square adjacent to a target, make a melee Strike or attempt to [[/act shove]] the target. If you rolled a critical success on your Athletics check to High Jump or a success on your Acrobatics check to Maneuver in Flight, your target is @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.AJh5ex99aV6VTggg]{Off-Guard} to this attack.
Dive Bomb.name: Dive Bomb

Dive for Cover.description: When threatened, you can quickly take a dive and find somewhere to hunker down. You @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.actions.Item.d5I6018Mci2SWokk]{Leap}, land @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.j91X7x0XSomq8d60]{Prone}, and immediately @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.actions.Item.ust1jJSCZQUhBZIz]{Take Cover}, which allows you to hunker down and gain greater cover against ranged attacks.
Dive for Cover.name: Dive for Cover

Diverse Schemes.description: You're an efficient multitasker, and you always have more than one goal in mind or scheme on the go. You can maintain twice your Charisma modifier of assets.
Diverse Schemes.name: Diverse Schemes

Divine Bond.description: As a disciple of a god, you wield some of their divine power. You become trained in the listed divine skill associated with the deity and add the listed cleric spells to your spell list and spell repertoire as signature spells. If you were already trained in the listed divine skill, you instead become trained in another skill of your choice. You become bound by that deity's anathema and can receive that deity's divine sanctification.

featPrerequisites.0: connection with divine spellcasting, you worship a deity

Divine Bond.name: Divine Bond

Divine Guidance.description: You're so immersed in divine scripture that you find meaning and guidance for any situation in your texts. Spend 10 minutes @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.actions.Item.d9gbpiQjChYDYA2L]{Deciphering Writing} on religious scriptures of your deity or philosophy while thinking about a particular problem or conundrum you face, and then attempt a @Check[religion] check (DC determined by the GM). If you succeed, you unearth a relevant passage, parable, or aphorism that can help you move forward or change your thinking to help solve your conundrum.
Divine Guidance.name: Divine Guidance

Divine-Etched Shell.description: Your shell is etched with markings that grant you a connection with the underlying truth of the cosmos. Choose one cantrip from the divine spell list. You can cast this cantrip as a divine innate spell at will. You can also cast the @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.spells.Item.ZBeKxBcUOsXrfMRo]{Implant Data} cantrip as a divine innate spell at will, except when you do, the target becomes "your shell," and data implanted on your shell can be accessed by any creature that knows the G'folian language. A cantrip is heightened to a spell rank equal to half your level rounded up.
Divine-Etched Shell.name: Divine-Etched Shell

Do You Believe This Joker?.description: You are adept at reading nonvisual social cues and quickly use this to your advantage when a conversation is going awry. You gain the Just Kidding! skill feat even if you don't meet the prerequisites and can use Deception instead of Performance when you're Just Kidding!
Do You Believe This Joker?.name: Do You Believe This Joker?

Do You Know Who I Work For?.description: Throwing your corporation's name around adds weight to your threats. When you use Intimidation to @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.actions.Item.tHCqgwjtQtzNqVvd]{Coerce} or @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.actions.Item.2u915NdUyQan6uKF]{Demoralize} a target who knows about your corporation, a success becomes a critical success.
Do You Know Who I Work For?.name: Do You Know Who I Work For?

Doctor in Training.description: You believe a healthy mind and body is integral to a life well lived, dedicating yourself to helping others recover swiftly from illness and disease. You become trained in Medicine. If you would automatically become trained in Medicine (from your background or class, for example), you instead become trained in another skill of your choice. In addition, you gain a +1 circumstance bonus on Medicine checks to [[/act administer-first-aid]], [[/act treat-disease]], and [[/act treat-poison]], and if you get a critical failure on one of these checks, you get a failure instead.
Doctor in Training.name: Doctor in Training

Don't Touch That!.description:
Frequency once per day

Trigger An ally you can observe triggers a trap.

You give a sharp, panicked reprimand to an unobservant ally. This feat gains the visual or auditory trait, whichever is appropriate for your warning. Attempt a Delve Lore check against the hazard's stealth DC.

Critical Success Your warning comes just in time. You prevent the trap from being triggered, or you delay the activation until the start or end of your next turn (your choice).

Success Your ally gains a +1 circumstance bonus to AC against the trap's next attack, or to their next saving throw against the trap's effects.

Critical Failure Your sharp warning only startles your ally, leaving them @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.AJh5ex99aV6VTggg]{Off-Guard} against the trap's next attack.
Don't Touch That!.name: Don't Touch That!

Don't You Die on Me.description: You encourage your ally to hang on and keep going, despite life-threatening wounds or other serious injuries that might take them out. Select an adjacent dying ally. Reduce the target's dying value by 1. If this would reduce their dying value to 0, they lose the dying condition, don't increase their wounded condition, and remain @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.fBnFDH2MTzgFijKf]{Unconscious}. The targeted ally then becomes temporarily immune to Don't You Die on Me for 1 hour.
Don't You Die on Me.name: Don't You Die on Me

Doom-Strengthened.description:
Your relationship with death has progressed such that you are empowered when you feel it near. You can use the @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.actions.Item.CPO4LgkZPHIHQEB4]{Doomsayer's Litany} reaction as often as you like.

In addition to its usual trigger, you can use Doomsayer's Litany whenever an ally's @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.yZRUzMqrMmfLu0V1]{Dying} value increases. When you use the reaction, the +2 status bonus applies to any recovery checks or saving throw the ally attempts until the end of their next turn, instead of just the triggering recovery check.

Whenever you use your Doomsayer's Litany reaction, you gain a status bonus equal to your @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.3uh1r86TzbQvosxv]{Doomed} value or the doomed value of the triggering ally to attack rolls and saving throws until the end of your next turn.
Doom-Strengthened.name: Doom-Strengthened

Dorjo Darkvision.description: You've spent a great deal of time in Dorjo's deserts at night, or in otherwise dark environments. You gain darkvision.
Dorjo Darkvision.name: Dorjo Darkvision

Double Dip.description: It's easier to protect yourself on the move with two sets of eyes, so you can do it twice as well as most. You Step twice.
Double Dip.name: Double Dip

Double Draw.description: Using your multiple sets of hands, you can quickly adjust your equipment. You Interact to draw, stow, or swap items you have up to twice.
Double Draw.name: Double Draw

Double Or Nothing.description: You've truly lucked out. Like some of the greatest worlanisi luck manipulators to come before you, you can hold onto your connection with luck even after you've used it. You can use your lucky number twice a day instead of once.
Double Or Nothing.name: Double Or Nothing

Double Tap.description:
Requirements You're wielding a gun.

You fire two shots at the same target in quick succession. You @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.actions.Item.sLikawnrJJzHMYeC]{Aim} and then make two Strikes against your mark. Apply the multiple attack penalty normally. If both attacks hit, combine their damage. You add any precision damage only once, to the attack of your choice. Apply the target's resistances and weaknesses only once.
Double Tap.name: Double Tap

Down to the Wire.description:
Trigger The final action on your turn is a 1-action directive.

You act quickly to show your teammates exactly how it's done. Resolve the directive you just issued as though it was a 2-action version instead of the 1-action that you used.
Down to the Wire.name: Down to the Wire

Dozens of Cousins.description: You always know where to find family, and family is everything. When you're in a settlement or an area you could conceivably meet another ysoki, you can spend 1 hour asking around to find a cousin of yours. The cousin begins with an attitude of friendly toward you and will grant you simple Requests, so long as they would be reasonable to ask (subject to GM discretion). You can attempt to make a more substantial @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.actions.Item.DCb62iCBrJXy0Ik6]{Request}, usually for a favor in exchange. The GM decides the DC based on the difficulty of the favor and the amount of risk it poses to your cousin.
Dozens of Cousins.name: Dozens of Cousins

Draconic Breath.description:
Frequency once per day

Beyond emulating dragonkin's energy breath, you've now learned to channel the power of a true dragon, able to spew forth its potent energy. Choose a type of damage that corresponds to a specific dragon. You can exhale this energy as a @Template[cone|distance:15] or @Template[line|distance:30] that deals @Damage[14d6[untyped],4d6[persistent,untyped]|options:area-damage]{14d6 damage plus 4d6 persistent} damage of the chosen type (basic @Check[reflex|against:class-spell|basic|options:area-effect,inflicts:frightened] save using the higher of your class DC or spell DC). On a critical failure, a target also becomes @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{Frightened 2}.
Draconic Breath.name: Draconic Breath

Draconic Influence.description: In pursuit of an equal friendship with their dragon neighbors, many ryphorians have learned to take on their large, winged forms. You can cast @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.spells.Item.5c692cCcTDXjSEzk]{Dragon Form} as a 6th-rank primal innate spell once per day. You must transform into the same battle form each time you cast this innate spell, chosen when you select this feat. When you reach 17th level, you can heighten the spell to 8th rank when you cast it.
Draconic Influence.name: Draconic Influence

Draconic Lethality.description:
Your draconic body is a weapon. When you select this feat, you gain one of the following unarmed attacks of your choice: claw, horn, jaws, or tail. Each of these attacks is in the brawling weapon group and has the listed damage die and traits.

  • Claw 1d6 slashing (agile, finesse, unarmed)
  • Horn 1d6 piercing (finesse, unarmed)
  • Jaws 1d6 piercing (grapple, unarmed)
  • Tail 1d6 bludgeoning (sweep, trip, unarmed)

At 5th level, whenever you get a critical hit with one of these attacks, you get its critical specialization effect.

Special You can take this feat four times. Each time you do, select a different attack from the options listed above.
Draconic Lethality.name: Draconic Lethality

Draconic Senses.description: You have an impressive sense of smell, passed down through the generations from a dragon ancestor. You gain imprecise scent with a range of 40 feet. The GM might double the range if you're downwind from the creature or halve the range if you're upwind, at their discretion.
Draconic Senses.name: Draconic Senses

Dragon's Tenacity.description: Your mind and body have the resilience of your dragon progenitors. You gain a +1 circumstance bonus to saving throws against fear effects, sleep effects, and effects that would cause you to become @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.6uEgoh53GbXuHpTF]{Paralyzed}. This bonus increases to +2 against spells and magic items that have these effects.
Dragon's Tenacity.name: Dragon's Tenacity

Dragonkin Breath.description:
Your exhalations are infused with energy, like your dragon ancestors of old. You can exhale a @Template[cone|distance:15] that deals @Damage[ceil(@actor.level/2)d4[@actor.flags.system.dragonkinBreath.damageType]|options:area-damage] damage (@Check[reflex|against:class-spell|basic|options:area-effect] save against the higher of your class DC or spell DC). After using this attack, you can't use it again for [[/r 1d4 #Recharge Dragonkin Breath]]{1d4 rounds}. At 3rd level and every 2 levels thereafter, the damage increases by 1d4.

Special When you select this feat, choose your breath's damage type and weapon group: acid (corrosive), bludgeoning (hammer), cold (cryo), electricity (shock), fire (flame), piercing (spear), slashing (knife), or sonic (sonic). This choice is permanent. This ability has the trait associated with the type of damage it deals.
Dragonkin Breath.name: Dragonkin Breath

Dragonkin Lore.description:
You're trained in skills passed down through generations of dragonkin. You gain the trained proficiency rank in Athletics and Society. If you would automatically become trained in one of those skills (from your background or class, for example), you instead become trained in a skill of your choice.

You also gain the @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.feats.Item.BocFD2KV0qgUC76x]{Additional Lore} general feat for Dragonkin Lore.
Dragonkin Lore.name: Dragonkin Lore

Dragonkin Weapon Familiarity.description:
You wield weapons favored by the Skyfire Legion. You are trained with the skyfire sword, flamethrower, and machine gun. In addition, you gain access to all uncommon weapons with the dragonkin trait. For the purposes of proficiency, you treat any of these that are martial weapons as simple weapons and any that are advanced weapons as martial weapons.

At 5th level, whenever you get a critical hit with one of these weapons, you get its critical specialization effect.
Dragonkin Weapon Familiarity.name: Dragonkin Weapon Familiarity

Drain Blood.description:
Frequency once per 10 minutes

Requirements A creature within your reach is taking persistent bleed damage, or is @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.kWc1fhmv9LBiTuei]{Grabbed}, @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.6uEgoh53GbXuHpTF]{Paralyzed}, @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.VcDeM8A5oI6VqhbM]{Restrained}, @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.fBnFDH2MTzgFijKf]{Unconscious}, or willing.

You jab your proboscis into the required creature to consume their blood. Attempt an @Check[athletics|against:fortitude] check against the target's Fortitude DC. You automatically succeed on this check if the target is paralyzed, unconscious, or willing (but you still roll to see if you get a critical success). On a success, the creature becomes @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.4D2KBtexWXa6oUMR]{Drained 1} (@UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.4D2KBtexWXa6oUMR]{Drained 2} on a critical success), and you gain temporary Hit Points equal to the target's level that last for 10 minutes.
Drain Blood.name: Drain Blood

Dramatic Blocking.description: Thanks to years of practice, you know how to use every inch of the stage and give a fantastic performance even in tight quarters. While you can act, you aren't @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.AJh5ex99aV6VTggg]{Off-Guard} to @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.iU0fEDdBp3rXpTMC]{Hidden}, @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.VRSef5y1LmL2Hkjf]{Undetected}, or flanking creatures of your level or lower.
Dramatic Blocking.name: Dramatic Blocking

Dramatic Reading.description:
You recite a memorable catchphrase or monologue delivered by a famous media character. Attempt a @Check[media-lore|against:will] or @Check[performance|against:will] check against the Will DC of a single enemy within 30 feet.

You can target up to two targets within range if you have expert proficiency in Media Lore or Performance, four if you're a master, and eight if you're legendary.

Critical Success The target takes a –1 status penalty to Perception checks and Will saves for 1 minute.

@UUID[Compendium.sf2e.feat-effects.Item.mpoTONLPMyb14mO9]{Effect: Dramatic Reading (Critical Success)}

Success The target takes a –1 status penalty to Perception checks and Will saves for 1 round.

@UUID[Compendium.sf2e.feat-effects.Item.IPIYAY9bTGetPw12]{Effect: Dramatic Reading (Success)}

Critical Failure The target is temporarily immune to Dramatic Reading for 1 hour.
Dramatic Reading.name: Dramatic Reading

Dream Sanctuary.description: You can pull a chunk of the ethereal realm of dreams into reality, providing you and allies with a measure of safety. You can cast cozy crashpad as a 3rd-rank arcane innate spell once per day, except it comes with a vendor constructed entirely based on your desires (though once chosen, it can't be changed). You can order items from this attendant, with an item level equal to or less than half your level (rounded up). As long as you pay for these items, they appear at the end of the 12-hour duration or when you Dismiss the spell.
Dream Sanctuary.name: Dream Sanctuary

Drift Blink.description:
Frequency once per minute

Trigger An enemy's Strike would hit you, and you weren't already @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.DmAIPqOBomZ7H95W]{Concealed}, @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.iU0fEDdBp3rXpTMC]{Hidden}, or undetected to that enemy.

You momentarily slip into the Drift, becoming concealed against the triggering Strike. If the flat check for concealment fails, the Strike misses you. After resolving the triggering Strike, you reemerge from the Drift in an unoccupied space adjacent to your original square.
Drift Blink.name: Drift Blink

Drift Hop.description:
Frequency once per day

You travel across the battlefield via the Drift. You teleport up to a distance equal to your Speed within your line of sight. If you're in the Drift, the distance you can teleport is doubled.
Drift Hop.name: Drift Hop

Drift Strike.description:
Frequency once every 10 minutes

Requirements Your last action was a melee Strike that critically hit a creature.

You launch the creature you hit with the required Strike into the Drift to reposition it across the battlefield. The creature is teleported to a location of your choice up to a distance of 20 feet from its starting location and within your line of sight. If you're in the Drift, the distance you can teleport the creature is doubled. The creature must be able to fit in its new location, and its new location must be unoccupied. The creature can attempt a @Check[will|against:class-spell] save.

Critical Success The creature is unaffected.

Success The distance you can teleport the creature is halved, and it can't be moved to a location that is hazardous or would result in a fall.

Failure You teleport the creature up to the noted distance.

Critical Failure As failure, but the distance you can teleport the creature is doubled.
Drift Strike.name: Drift Strike

Drift-Touched.description:
Frequency once per day

You were born or gestated inside the Drift, and hyperspace is always a part of you. With a thought, you seize a fragment of the Drift and temporarily transplant it onto the battlefield as an intangible barrier of colorful light. This shimmering field appears within 30 feet and is straight and vertical, stretching up to 10 feet long and 10 feet high. The barrier grants concealment to creatures targeted through it, and it sheds colorful bright light for 10 feet on each side and dim light for the next 10 feet. You can ignore any concealment granted by the barrier. The barrier lasts for 5 rounds.
Drift-Touched.name: Drift-Touched

Drop Tail.description:
Trigger You would be reduced to 0 Hit Points.

Requirements You have a tail.

In an embarrassing act of desperation, you sacrifice your tail to save your life. You're reduced to 1 Hit Point, rather than 0 Hit Points, and don't gain the @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.fBnFDH2MTzgFijKf]{Unconscious} or wounded conditions. Your tail falls off and flails around wildly, distracting your foes. You Stride up to your Speed, and don't trigger reactions due to this movement. Your tail grows back over 24 hours. While your tail is regrowing, you don't have a tail, your Speed is reduced by 5 feet, and you take a –2 status penalty to Acrobatics checks.
Drop Tail.name: Drop Tail

Drop and Move.description:
Requirements You're in bipedal posture.

You can use the momentum of shifting your form to quickly gallop into battle. You @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.actions.Item.L2k363LraGLUZIgM]{Change Posture} from bipedal to quadrupedal and Stride up to your Speed.
Drop and Move.name: Drop and Move

Drug Resistant.description: You have experimented with mind-altering substances enough that drugs and poisons of all kinds have a harder time affecting you. You gain poison resistance equal to half your level.
Drug Resistant.name: Drug Resistant

Dual Aim.description:
Your sharpshooter skills improve. You can have two marks at a time instead of one. When you @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.actions.Item.sLikawnrJJzHMYeC]{Aim}, you can select two marks, rather than one.

@UUID[Compendium.sf2e.feat-effects.Item.SjauZALDFxxkSNbl]{Effect: Dual Aim}
Dual Aim.name: Dual Aim

Dual Bond.description: While some claim you're incapable of forming a partner bond as deep as other dragonkin can, it's undeniable that you have more flexibility and freedom when it comes to bonding. You can maintain any number of partner bonds at once. Your bonded partners don't automatically count as being bonded with one another.
Dual Bond.name: Dual Bond

Dubious Knowledge.description: You're a treasure trove of information, but not all of it comes from reputable sources. When you fail (but don't critically fail) a Recall Knowledge check using any skill, you learn the correct answer and an erroneous answer, but you don't have any way to differentiate which is which. This can occur as knowing something is significant, but not whether it's good or bad.

featPrerequisites.0: trained in a skill with the Recall Knowledge action

Dubious Knowledge.name: Dubious Knowledge

Durable IMAS.description: You've adjusted your IMAS to tolerate stress more effectively. You gain a +1 circumstance bonus to saving throws against effects that would make you @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.6uEgoh53GbXuHpTF]{Paralyzed} or give you a penalty to your Speed, including those that would make you suppressed.
Durable IMAS.name: Durable IMAS

Dust Devil Spin.description: You position yourself to rapidly spin your foot orb without moving, kicking up a thick plume of dust. Until the end of your next turn, any creature in your square (including yourself) becomes @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.DmAIPqOBomZ7H95W]{Concealed}, though they can't use this concealment to [[/act hide]] or [[/act sneak]], as normal for concealment where your position is still obvious. If you are in a sterile environment without significant dirt or dust on the floor, you have to instead rely on a reserve of detritus stored in your cilia. You cannot use this action again for 10 minutes, or until you Step or Stride into a dirty square.
Dust Devil Spin.name: Dust Devil Spin

Dutiful Adherence.description: You ensure that your knowledge in a task is absolute. You gain the @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.feats.Item.BocFD2KV0qgUC76x]{Additional Lore} feat and the @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.feats.Item.W6Gl9ePmItfDHji0]{Assurance} feat for the chosen Lore. When you forgo rolling a skill check using Assurance for the associated Lore, you receive a result of 11 + your proficiency bonus (instead of 10 + your proficiency bonus).
Dutiful Adherence.name: Dutiful Adherence

Dwarvatonic Weight.description:
Heightened gravity barely affects you thanks to your sturdy body. Ignore the effects of high and extreme gravity on your carrying capacity, falling damage, jumping distance, and Speed.

You don't take bludgeoning damage every minute in extreme gravity. Additionally, while in high gravity, your first weapon Strike each round that uses a melee weapon that deals bludgeoning, slashing, or piercing damage gains a status bonus to damage equal to the number of weapon damage dice (or twice the number of weapon damage dice in extreme gravity).
Dwarvatonic Weight.name: Dwarvatonic Weight

Dwarven Gravity Hammer.description:
You know how to effectively hurl yourself like a cannonball directly into your opponents. You Stride twice in a straight line, dealing @Damage[ternary(gte(@actor.level,19),8,ternary(gte(@actor.level,16),6,4))d8[bludgeoning]|options:area-damage] damage to each creature in your path (@Check[reflex|against:class-spell|basic|options:area-effect] save against your class or spell DC, whichever is higher). You move until you meet an obstruction or finish Striding twice. The damage increases to 6d8 at level 16 and 8d8 at level 19.

Special If you have @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.feats.Item.tjaiwqPAVetw2Gla]{Dwarven Zero-G Familiarity}, enemies have a –2 circumstance penalty to their Reflex saves against your Gravity Hammer in low or zero gravity. You can also @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.actions.Item.FF5KgZHj345s2moq]{Push Off} instead of Striding, using a creature in the line to Push Off.
Dwarven Gravity Hammer.name: Dwarven Gravity Hammer

Dwarven Honor.description:
Honor is the pillar of traditional dwarven ideals. When someone @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.actions.Item.ewwCglB7XOPLUz72]{Lies} to you, you automatically roll a secret Perception check to [[/act sense-motive]] against them. You also gain a +2 circumstance bonus to Diplomacy checks to [[/act make-an-impression]] on creatures that value truth and respect the honor of your word.

Special Hryngar culture cares less for honor but teaches to capitalize on its absence. If you have the @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.heritages.Item.JGQFlHY0J0LluvlH]{Deep Space Hryngar} heritage, you instead gain the bonus to Make an Impression on individuals who value crime and deceit.
Dwarven Honor.name: Dwarven Honor

Dwarven Zero-G Familiarity.description: Dwarves who have spent their lives aboard orbital clanholdings or Star Citadels find themselves at ease in low gravity environments. You aren't @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.AJh5ex99aV6VTggg]{Off-Guard} or @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.i3OJZU2nk64Df3xm]{Clumsy} due to being @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.z1ucw4CLwLqHoAp3]{Untethered} in zero-g. At 13th level, you gain a climb Speed of 20 feet while in low gravity or zero-g.
Dwarven Zero-G Familiarity.name: Dwarven Zero-G Familiarity

Eager Assistant.description: You love helping your friends and allies achieve their goals. At the start of your turn, you gain one additional reaction, which you can use only to Aid.
Eager Assistant.name: Eager Assistant

Eager Combatant.description:
Trigger You roll Athletics or Intimidation for initiative.

You eagerly stride into battle, giving no thought to the consequences. You Stride in a straight line directly toward an enemy.
Eager Combatant.name: Eager Combatant

Early Adopter.description: Though cutting-edge technology has only recently arrived in your home world, you've proven yourself to be a natural with new trinkets and devices the moment you get your hands on them. You become trained in Crafting. If you would automatically become trained in Crafting (from your background or class, for example), you instead become trained in another skill of your choice. You gain a +1 circumstance bonus on Crafting checks to @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.actions.Item.1OagaWtBpVXExToo]{Recall Knowledge} about tech items.
Early Adopter.name: Early Adopter

Eat It!.description: Your caustic stomach is the safest place to hide your goods. You Interact to eat an item of 1 Bulk or less. The item takes @Damage[1d6[acid]] damage every hour it stays in your stomach. You're @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.fesd1n5eVhpCSS18]{Sickened} with a value equal to the total Bulk of items you have in your stomach and can't reduce your sickened value below that total while they remain there. You can regurgitate any number of items as a single action into your hands or your square.
Eat It!.name: Eat It!

Eclipse Strike.description:
Your attacks create a brilliant eclipse that veil you from the enemy's view. Make a Strike with your solar weapon or your solar flare. On a hit, you create an impressive display of solar energy between you and your foe. Increase the level of cover you receive from your enemy by one step. Lesser cover becomes standard cover, or standard cover becomes greater cover in the case of creatures at least one size category larger than you. This effect lasts until the start of your next turn.

Graviton-Attuned For the duration, if you don't have any cover against an attack targeting you, you gain lesser cover against that attack.

Photon-Attuned For the duration, if the target you struck provides you cover against an enemy's attack, that enemy takes a –1 circumstance penalty to their attack roll.
Eclipse Strike.name: Eclipse Strike

Efficient Analysis.description: Your penchant for understanding other beings and gathering information allows you to quickly assess anyone before you. You can cast the @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.spells.Item.NkvRoN33RbDg3fl9]{Analyze Target} cantrip as an occult innate spell at will. A cantrip is heightened to a spell rank equal to half your level rounded up. Once per day, as part of Casting the Spell, you can attempt a @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.actions.Item.1OagaWtBpVXExToo]{Recall Knowledge} check as a free action on the target, or a single creature among the targets if you cast it on multiple creatures.
Efficient Analysis.name: Efficient Analysis

Efficient Assistant.description:
Frequency once per 10 minutes

Helping others comes so naturally to you that you instantly prepare yourself to help your ally with a task. This counts as preparing to help an ally for the purpose of using the @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.actions.Item.HCl3pzVefiv9ZKQW]{Aid} reaction. You must still explain to the GM exactly how you're helping.
Efficient Assistant.name: Efficient Assistant

Efficient Crafter.description: You are a highly skilled crafter, and you can make larger batches than normal in the same time. When you Craft consumables or ammunition, you increase the quantity that you can craft at one time by one half; for example, you can make six of a given consumable at a time instead of four. You must still pay the costs for the raw materials of the additional items.
Efficient Crafter.name: Efficient Crafter

Efficient Craftwork.description: Through thousands of hours spent mastering a craft and hundreds of iterations on the process, you're able to consistently deliver quality results with minimal waste. When Crafting during downtime, if you critically fail a check, you fail instead, and when you succeed, you critically succeed instead.
Efficient Craftwork.name: Efficient Craftwork

Efficient Motion.description: Time is precious and not to be wasted, and your mastery of efficiency allows you to shave seconds off even the most mundane tasks. You become @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.nlCjDvLMf2EkV2dl]{Quickened} until the end of your turn.
Efficient Motion.name: Efficient Motion

Effortless Concentration.description:
Trigger Your turn begins.

You maintain your active spells with hardly a thought. You immediately gain the effects of a Sustain action for one of your active mystic spells.
Effortless Concentration.name: Effortless Concentration

Effortless Influencer.description:
You've become such a master manipulator that spotting an opening to ply your influence has become second nature. You gain the @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.feats.Item.W6Gl9ePmItfDHji0]{Assurance} skill feat three times for Deception, Diplomacy, and Intimidation. Furthermore, when you succeed at a check with Deception, Diplomacy, or Intimidation, allies within 60 feet who witnessed your success gain a +1 status bonus to the next check they attempt with that skill within 1 minute (or a +2 bonus if your check was a critical success).

@UUID[Compendium.sf2e.feat-effects.Item.ZQM4vfHEKgxvNJik]{Effect: Effortless Influencer}
Effortless Influencer.name: Effortless Influencer

Eldritch Bond.description: You channel strange power from beyond this reality, granting creatures in your bond the power to reform their bodies into powerful, aberrant shapes. You gain the @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.spells.Item.Y8Y0LS6sh4pkxPsq]{Eldritch Bond} epiphany spell.
Eldritch Bond.name: Eldritch Bond

Elebrian Cantrip.description:
You enhance your performances with delightful magical tricks, going far beyond normal sleight of hand. Choose one cantrip from the following list: @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.spells.Item.h7IhypLwItepwhou]{Adhere}, @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.spells.Item.0zU8CPejjQFnhZFI]{Figment}, @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.spells.Item.Qw3fnUlaUbnn7ipC]{Prestidigitation}, or @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.spells.Item.pwzdSlJgYqN7bs2w]{Telekinetic Hand}. You can cast this cantrip as an arcane innate spell at will. A cantrip is heightened to a spell rank equal to half your level rounded up.

Special You can select this feat more than once. If you do, you must select a different cantrip.
Elebrian Cantrip.name: Elebrian Cantrip

Elebrian Lore.description:
Your people's dwindling numbers hasn't stopped you from learning everything there is to know about your ancestral past. You are trained in Arcana and Society. If you would automatically become trained in one of those skills (from your background or class, for example), you instead become trained in a skill of your choice.

You also gain the @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.feats.Item.BocFD2KV0qgUC76x]{Additional Lore} general feat for Elebrian Lore.
Elebrian Lore.name: Elebrian Lore

Elebrian Magic.description:
Your arcane aptitude grows as you learn how to better entrance an audience with magic. Choose one 1st-rank spell from the following list: @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.spells.Item.vLA0q0WOK2YPuJs6]{Charm}, @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.spells.Item.V1cojmrEOWkJ1yPF]{Glow Up}, @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.spells.Item.i35dpZFI7jZcRoBo]{Illusory Disguise}, or @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.spells.Item.yV7Ouzaoe7DHLESI]{Ventriloquism}. You can cast this spell as an arcane innate spell once per day.

Special You can select this feat more than once. If you do, you must select a different spell.
Elebrian Magic.name: Elebrian Magic

Electrical Engineer.description: You can fuel battery-powered devices by drawing electricity from different sources. Doing so takes 1 minute of work and an adjacent source of power appropriate to the device. If the source of power is a technological creature or hazard, it must have been destroyed within the last 10 minutes and provides charges equal to twice its level. If the source is a facility capable of charging a battery, the battery-powered device operates as if the battery were always fully charged. If you're a master in Crafting, you can connect a device to a power source as a 3-action activity. If you're legendary, it takes 1 action.
Electrical Engineer.name: Electrical Engineer

Electrical Shielding.description: Your body is insulated from electrical attacks. You gain electricity resistance equal to half your level. Additionally, you gain the @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.actions.Item.mrcKklMzhRG4WcbH]{Redirect Current} reaction.
Electrical Shielding.name: Electrical Shielding

Electrify LFAN.description:
Frequency once per hour

You send currents of electricity coursing through your LFAN, electrifying everything you're holding. Until the end of your current turn, your Strikes deal an additional @Damage[1d6[electricity]] damage per weapon damage die.
Electrify LFAN.name: Electrify LFAN

Electrolocation.description: Your cilia are sensitive to detecting electric signatures of nearby creatures. You gain electromagnetic sense as an imprecise sense with a range of 15 feet. Electromagnetic sense allows you to detect nearby creatures and technological objects, but you might have to use the [[/act seek]] action to find an undetected creature in an environment with too much electromagnetic radiation, such as inside the engine room of a starship or near a powerful source of radio waves.
Electrolocation.name: Electrolocation

Electrolocation Mastery.description: Your cilia have become even more sensitive to detecting electric signatures of nearby creatures. Your electromagnetic sense becomes a precise sense with a range of 15 feet and an imprecise sense with a range of 60 feet.
Electrolocation Mastery.name: Electrolocation Mastery

Electromagnetic Flight.description: Your personal electromotive force is strong enough to propel you. You gain a fly Speed equal to your land Speed.
Electromagnetic Flight.name: Electromagnetic Flight

Electromagnetic Hover.description: Your cilia emit an electromagnetic field around your body that causes you to hover ever so slightly above solid ground. While hovering above solid ground, you ignore difficult terrain. Damaging effects originating from the surface of the ground, such as caltrops or an electrified floor, don't affect you, but effects extending far enough above the ground, like moving through a fire, might still affect you, at the GM's discretion.
Electromagnetic Hover.name: Electromagnetic Hover

Electromagnetic Whiskers.description: You've honed your whiskers' sensitivity to the degree that you can sense the movement of the weak electric fields emitted by potential enemies. You gain electromagnetic sense as an imprecise sense out to 15 feet. Electromagnetic sense allows you to detect nearby living and technological creatures, but you might have to use the @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.actions.Item.BlAOM2X92SI6HMtJ]{Seek} action to find an undetected creature in an environment with too much electromagnetic radiation, such as inside the engine room of a spaceship or near a powerful source of radio waves.
Electromagnetic Whiskers.name: Electromagnetic Whiskers

Electron Sprinkles.description:
Frequency once per day

You siphon off a few extra electrons you weren't using to empower your weapon. You can cast @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.spells.Item.SbBqa1HStMrV47fb]{Supercharge Weapon} as a 1st-rank arcane innate spell once per day, except the additional damage is electricity instead of being the same damage type of the weapon. Casting this spell in this way also fully charges the weapon's battery if it has one.
Electron Sprinkles.name: Electron Sprinkles

Electrotether Ball.description:
By quickly spinning your magnetic orb while channeling primal energy through it, you can create a tether of electricity that can pull objects and creatures across the battlefield, including yourself.

You can cast @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.spells.Item.Cbj7tDkb2ZTp10Cg]{Electrotether} as a 3rd-rank primal innate spell twice per day, but the target becomes "one creature, unattended object, or metal structure."

If you target an unattended object, you immediately pull the object into your square and can grab the item if you have a free hand. If you target a metal surface, such as the side of a starship or building, you are immediately moved to the structure (this movement doesn't trigger reactions based on movement) and [[/act climb]].
Electrotether Ball.name: Electrotether Ball

Elemental Favor.description: Even though the calling of your blood doesn't lie squarely with the summerborn or winterborn, you feel that you can nudge it in one direction or the other to help protect you. You gain resistance to cold and fire equal to half your level.
Elemental Favor.name: Elemental Favor

Elusive Target.description:
Trigger A Strike targeting you fails.

You move out of the way as you elude your attackers. You Step.
Elusive Target.name: Elusive Target

Elven Caution.description:
Frequency once per day

Trigger You roll initiative.

You don't trust others and are always ready to move when a situation sours. You Stride up to half your Speed.
Elven Caution.name: Elven Caution

Embrace the Magic.description:
You understand that the galaxy is a wondrous place full of arcane mysteries and strange phenomena. You can cast the @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.spells.Item.gpzpAAAJ1Lza2JVl]{Detect Magic} cantrip as an arcane innate spell at will. A cantrip is heightened to a spell rank equal to half your level rounded up.

In addition, you gain a +1 circumstance bonus to skill checks to Identify Magic.
Embrace the Magic.name: Embrace the Magic

Emotional Defiance.description:
Frequency once per hour

Trigger You fail a Will saving throw against a mental effect.

You refuse to allow others to influence or manipulate your emotions. Reroll the triggering saving throw and use the better result.
Emotional Defiance.name: Emotional Defiance

Emotional Maestro.description: Your ability to detect the emotions of others is unparalleled. Your emotion sense becomes a precise sense with a range of 120 feet.
Emotional Maestro.name: Emotional Maestro

Emotionless.description: Your inhibited or malfunctioning emotional processors make it difficult for you to feel strong emotions. You gain a +1 circumstance bonus to saving throws against emotion effects. If you roll a success on a saving throw against an emotion effect, you get a critical success instead.
Emotionless.name: Emotionless

Empathetic Connection.description:
Winning friends and influencing people are among the things that humans do best, and you know that objective is best accomplished using your innate magical empathy.

You gain @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.spells.Item.D442XMADp01qJ7Cs]{Mindlink} as a 1st-rank occult innate spell at-will. When you cast this spell, you can allow the willing target of the spell to impart information to you instead. After you cast this spell, the target is temporarily immune to your mindlink innate spell for 24 hours.
Empathetic Connection.name: Empathetic Connection

Empathetic Healing.description: Your bond with your partner allows you to literally feel their pain, making it easier to treat their injuries. You gain the @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.feats.Item.wYerMk6F1RZb0Fwt]{Battle Medicine} feat even if you don't meet the prerequisites, but you can only use it on your bonded partner unless you're trained in Medicine. When you succeed with @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.feats.Item.wYerMk6F1RZb0Fwt]{Battle Medicine} or @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.actions.Item.1kGNdIIhuglAjIp9]{Treat Wounds}, your bonded partner gains a circumstance bonus to the number of Hit Points they regain equal to 5 HP at DC 20, 10 HP at DC 30, or 15 HP at DC 40.

featPrerequisites.0: You have a bond with the Sympathetic Bond feat or dragonkin partner bond feature.

Empathetic Healing.name: Empathetic Healing

Empathetic Shout.description:
Frequency once per day

Trigger An ally within 30 feet takes damage.

Many shirrens form especially empathetic bonds with their friends. You shout out to your friend when they're injured, forming a connection that shields them from pain. Your ally takes half the Hit Point damage from the triggering effect, and you take the remainder of the damage. When you take damage through this link, you don't apply any resistances, weaknesses, or other abilities you have to that damage; you simply take that amount of damage.
Empathetic Shout.name: Empathetic Shout

Empathetic Twitch.description: Your whiskers instinctively twitch and provide you with feedback about a target's current disposition. You gain a +2 circumstance bonus to Perception checks to [[/act sense-motive]] for targets within 30 feet of you that are not immune to emotion or mental effects.
Empathetic Twitch.name: Empathetic Twitch

Empathic Conduit.description: You sense others' baseline emotional states from afar. When you feint using Absolute Empathy, you can do so at a range of up to 60 feet, instead of just melee reach. If you succeed, the opponent is @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.AJh5ex99aV6VTggg]{Off-Guard} against your melee and ranged attacks.
Empathic Conduit.name: Empathic Conduit

Empathic Pulse.description: Your whiskers buzz with energy as empathic pulses collect within them that you can unleash in a burst of intense emotions. You can cast @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.spells.Item.wRNRWwCEbmSxbHDl]{Vibe Check} four times per day as a 2nd-rank occult innate spell, selecting a different emotion each time. You can cast vibe check as a 4th-rank spell by using two daily uses of the spell, but you still only project a single emotion when you cast vibe check this way.
Empathic Pulse.name: Empathic Pulse

Empowered Scales.description: You catch periodic glimpses of the immediate future and can use your insight to predict your foes' moves before they make them. Once per day, you can cast @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.spells.Item.XSujb7EsSwKl19Uu]{Bless} or @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.spells.Item.Gb7SeieEvd0pL2Eh]{Sure Strike} as a 1st-rank spell. The tradition of this spell matches the tradition of the cantrip you gained from Sigiled Scales.
Empowered Scales.name: Empowered Scales

Encode Presence.description:
Frequency once per hour

You instinctively encode your presence, obscuring your identity and scrambling your visual appearance to technological visual sensors. You become @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.DmAIPqOBomZ7H95W]{Concealed} to all technological visual sensors, such as security cameras, ocular cybernetic augmentations, and the visual processors of technological constructs, for 1 minute. As the nature of this effect still leaves your location obvious, you can't use this concealment to Hide or @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.actions.Item.VMozDqMMuK5kpoX4]{Sneak}.
Encode Presence.name: Encode Presence

Encore.description:
Frequency once per day

You consistently rehearse your best bits so that you're always ready for an encore. During this turn, the next action you take can be an ability with a frequency of once per day and that you've used only once today. This doesn't allow you to reuse spell slots or abilities from 20th-level feats or features.
Encore.name: Encore

Encyclopedic Recall.description:
Frequency once per round

You swiftly calculate and cross-reference several subjects at once. You instantly use up to three Recall Knowledge actions. If you have any special abilities or free actions that would normally be triggered when you Recall Knowledge, you can't use them for these actions. At 13th level, you can instead use up to four Recall Knowledge actions. At 17th level, you can instead use up to five Recall Knowledge actions.
Encyclopedic Recall.name: Encyclopedic Recall

Endlessly Adaptive.description: Your varied life experiences let you adapt to nearly any situation. When you gain skill feats using adaptive talent, you gain two additional skill feats. In addition, you can adapt to the day's challenges by spending 10 minutes to plan. If you do, you can reselect the feats chosen with adaptive talent as if you'd made your daily preparations. You can't trade out feats with limited-use abilities that you've already used that day.
Endlessly Adaptive.name: Endlessly Adaptive

Enduring Echolocation.description: You perceive your surroundings as much by echolocation as by your other senses. Your echolocation becomes a precise sense to a range of 60 feet (or 120 feet underwater), in addition to the imprecise sense out to 120 feet (or 240 feet underwater).
Enduring Echolocation.name: Enduring Echolocation

Energy Consumption.description:
Your body has adapted over to consume the excess energy it uses to shield itself, allowing it to neutralize other forms of energy that could harm it. When you use your @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.feats.Item.hvWJRc0dGF3ivrb6]{Energy Deflection} reaction, if the attack was a failure or critical failure, you gain temporary Hit Points equal to your level; you also gain the @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.feats.Item.lmowZWTzJaZfM3bb]{Energy Shielding} feat (selecting a different type of energy). These temporary Hit Points and the Energy Shielding feat last 1 minute.

@UUID[Compendium.sf2e.feat-effects.Item.g1J6DOxBQkacvbyE]{Effect: Energy Consumption}
Energy Consumption.name: Energy Consumption

Energy Deflection.description:
Trigger You are the target of a ranged attack that would deal at least one type of damage you selected with Energy Shielding.

Requirements You're aware of the attack and are not @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.AJh5ex99aV6VTggg]{Off-Guard} against it.

You leverage the magical energy clinging to your body to counter similar harmful attacks. You gain a +2 circumstance bonus to AC against the triggering attack.
Energy Deflection.name: Energy Deflection

Energy Eternal.description: You know that energy is eternal—changing, shifting, and reforming, but never truly extinguished. Just as you were born from the death of a star, so too are you born again upon your own death. If you would die, your body explodes in a miniature burst of energy, and you're reborn as a microscopic, slumbering novian, which grows to your full size (usually Tiny) over the course of 24 hours. At the end of this time, you awaken fully healed in the space you died.
Energy Eternal.name: Energy Eternal

Energy Infusion.description: You infuse your attacks with necromantic or radiant energies from beyond the material Universe. You infuse your attacks with spiritual energy for 1 minute. All weapons you're wielding and your unarmed Strikes become magical and either deal 1 additional spirit damage and gain the unholy trait against living creatures, or deal 1 additional spirit damage and gain the holy trait against undead.
Energy Infusion.name: Energy Infusion

Energy Shielding.description:
While traversing the Diaspora, you've witnessed countless magical anomalies and survived to tell the tale. This persistent exposure to magical energy has rubbed off on you, leaving traces of magic behind that shield your body from harmful energy. Select one of the following types of energy damage: acid, cold, electricity, fire, or sonic. You gain resistance 5 to that damage type.

Special You can select this feat multiple times. Each time you do, select a different energy type.
Energy Shielding.name: Energy Shielding

Enhanced Echolocation.description: You've learned to quiet your other senses and focus your attention on your echolocation. The range of your echolocation imprecise sense doubles to 60 feet (or 120 feet underwater), and you gain the @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.actions.Item.0vqXr3SYakIa19k3]{Focus Senses} action.
Enhanced Echolocation.name: Enhanced Echolocation

Enhanced Senses.description: Your natural senses improve with careful practice or through the use of specific techniques. Increase the range of one of your senses by 10 feet if it's a precise sense or by 30 feet if it's an imprecise sense.

featPrerequisites.0: a sense with a listed range

Enhanced Senses.name: Enhanced Senses

Enhanced Shell.description: You've enhanced your exoskeleton with cybernetics or biotech to make it even sturdier. The item bonus to AC from your exoskeleton increases to +4. You can use the @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.actions.Item.d4vJxq49lUb7fGXq]{Install Upgrade} activity to install armor upgrades into your exoskeleton; your exoskeleton has two upgrade slots.
Enhanced Shell.name: Enhanced Shell

Enlarge Quantum Field.description: Your quantum field slowly encroaches on reality. Increase your quantum field's radius by 10 feet. Until your quantum field deactivates, once per turn when you Sustain the quantum field, increase its radius by an additional 5 feet (to a maximum of 50 additional feet).
Enlarge Quantum Field.name: Enlarge Quantum Field

Enlarged Proboscis.description:
Your proboscis has become particularly deadly to those around you and is either longer, stronger, or more flexible. Your proboscis gains two of the following traits: backstabber, backswing, forceful, reach 10 feet (counts as two traits), sweep, trip, versatile S.

Special If you select reach, you can use the @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.feats.Item.BdAAZgzwcNwjNmML]{Drain Blood} ancestry feat or the @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.actions.Item.L0MLZNUoJ6lTlBZu]{Siphon Poison} action of the bloodfilter orocoran heritage from up to 10 feet away.
Enlarged Proboscis.name: Enlarged Proboscis

Enlightened Rivener.description: You've mastered your anger and can maintain the rivener transformation indefinitely. You permanently become Large, and your reach increases by 5 feet. You can use Enter Rivener State once per hour, rather than once per day. When you Enter Rivener State, your size and reach don't increase, you don't become stupefied, and you don't become @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.HL2l2VRSaQHu9lUw]{Fatigued} when the transformation ends. You still gain the bonus to damage.
Enlightened Rivener.name: Enlightened Rivener

Enlightenment.description: You understand the true nature of your connection and how it stretches across the vast pillars of reality. Your vitality network has a maximum capacity of 200 Hit Points and regains 20 Hit Points at the start of each turn instead of 8. You can bond with any number of willing creatures.
Enlightenment.name: Enlightenment

Ensnaring Vines.description: You conjure plants from every surface to ensnare your foes. You can cast @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.spells.Item.JbAcSLu62TU1OgNF]{Tangling Creepers} once per hour as a 6th-rank primal innate spell.
Ensnaring Vines.name: Ensnaring Vines

Entangling Mycelium.description: You allow your spores to spread. The ground in your square becomes difficult terrain for all non-fungi creatures for 1 minute. If you're already in a square affected by Entangling Mycelium, the fungus spreads and all non-diagonal adjacent squares become difficult terrain for 1 minute.
Entangling Mycelium.name: Entangling Mycelium

Enter Rivener State.description:
You embrace your anger, willingly entering a controlled rivener state and maintaining your mental faculties. Your body grows and expands, becoming Large. Your equipment grows with you, but returns to its natural size if removed. Your reach increases by 5 feet, and you gain a +2 status bonus to melee damage. You become @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.e1XGnhKNSQIm5IXg]{Stupefied 1}. This transformation lasts for 10 minutes, or until you choose to end it early as a single action that has the concentrate trait. When your transformation ends, you become @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.HL2l2VRSaQHu9lUw]{Fatigued} for 10 minutes.

At 13th level and 17th level, the bonus damage increases by 2
Enter Rivener State.name: Enter Rivener State

Entu Spore Caps.description: The fungal caps all over your body release toxic spores when disturbed. Each time you become @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.kWc1fhmv9LBiTuei]{Grabbed} by a creature or an adjacent creature hits you with an attack, you deal @Damage[(ternary(gte(@actor.level,17),5,ternary(gte(@actor.level,13),4,ternary(gte(@actor.level,9),3,2))))[poison]] damage to that creature. This damage increases to 3 at 9th level, 4 at 13th level, and 5 at 17th level.
Entu Spore Caps.name: Entu Spore Caps

Entu Spore Cloud.description:
Frequency once per hour

You spew a dense cloud of fungal spores. Plants and fungi are immune to this effect, but all other creatures in a @Template[emanation|distance:10] must attempt a @Check[fortitude|against:class-spell|options:inflicts:blinded,inflicts:dazzled] save against the higher of your class DC or spell DC with the following results.

Critical Success No effect.

Success The creature is @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.TkIyaNPgTZFBCCuh]{Dazzled} for 1 round.

Failure The creature is dazzled and can see only 10 feet away for 1 round.

Critical Failure The creature is @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.XgEqL1kFApUbl5Z2]{Blinded} for 1 round.
Entu Spore Cloud.name: Entu Spore Cloud

Envenom Magazine.description:
Frequency once every 10 minutes

You spit venom into the magazine of a weapon you're holding, or a similar ranged weapon held by a willing adjacent creature. Each Strike or use of Auto-Fire with the chosen weapon until the start of your next turn that deals acid, bludgeoning, poison, piercing, or slashing damage, also deals an additional 2d6 poison damage.

@UUID[Compendium.sf2e.feat-effects.Item.2i0i7JDaUdAXc0bJ]{Effect: Venomous Cocktail}
Envenom Magazine.name: Envenom Magazine

Environmental Adaptation.description:
Your body contains polymers that you can rapidly reconfigure to resist extreme temperatures. You treat environmental cold and heat effects as if they were two steps less extreme (incredible cold becomes severe, extreme cold becomes mild, and so on).

Additionally, you gain resistance equal to half your level to your choice of cold or fire. You can change your choice during daily preparations, as well as with the @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.actions.Item.aswV37TglbLLXmAA]{Instantaneous Adaptation} reaction.
Environmental Adaptation.name: Environmental Adaptation

Envoy Dedication.description:
You gain the @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.class-features.Item.f9dNcZi9kzbaGl8M]{Envoy Directives} class feature, but do not gain the Lead by Example benefits of the Get 'Em! envoy directive. You become trained in Deception, Diplomacy, or Intimidation plus another skill of your choice. If you were already trained in Deception, Diplomacy, and Intimidation, you instead become trained in an additional skill of your choice. You also become trained in envoy class DC.

@UUID[Compendium.sf2e.journals.JournalEntry.vx5FGEG34AxI2dow.JournalEntryPage.tJZr2a7hVMpeMvU0]{Envoy}
Envoy Dedication.name: Envoy Dedication

Epitome of Calm.description: By exerting absolute control over your emotions, you stay perpetually composed. You diffuse any effects related to emotions that impact you, making you immune to emotion effects.
Epitome of Calm.name: Epitome of Calm

Erudite Offense.description:
You use your knowledge about a creature to focus your attacks. Choose a creature within 30 feet of you that you're aware of. Attempt a @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.actions.Item.1OagaWtBpVXExToo]{Recall Knowledge} check against that target, following the standard rules for Recall Knowledge with the following additional effect.

Critical Success You understand the exact timing and location to strike your opponent. The target is @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.AJh5ex99aV6VTggg]{Off-Guard} against all attacks that you attempt against it until the end of your next turn.

Success The target is off-guard against the next attack that you attempt against it before the end of your current turn.
Erudite Offense.name: Erudite Offense

Erudite Strike.description:
Frequency once per day

Education is a powerful weapon—and so are guns; fortunately, you wield both to devastating effect. Attempt a @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.actions.Item.1OagaWtBpVXExToo]{Recall Knowledge} check against a target you're aware of within 30 feet. You can use this result in place of your next attack roll. If you critically fail the Recall Knowledge check, you are overcome with analysis paralysis and become @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.dfCMdR4wnpbYNTix]{Stunned 2}.
Erudite Strike.name: Erudite Strike

Esoteric Education.description:
For all their practicality, broader fields of study don't capture your imagination when there are more specialized disciplines you might explore. Choose two Lore skill subcategories. You gain the Additional Lore general feat for both skills.

Special You can take this feat three times. Each time you do, you gain the Additional Lore general feat for a new subcategory of Lore, and you become trained in one other Lore skill subcategory of your choice.
Esoteric Education.name: Esoteric Education

Eternal Devotion.description: Once per month, when you die, you can choose to invoke your devotion to a single willing living creature you know. Your life essence becomes inextricably bound to that creature, letting you survive beyond death. Your body immediately disappears, and after 1 month, you return to life at maximum Hit Points, appearing within 30 feet of the target of your devotion. If the target of your devotion dies, then you immediately die. If you die and choose not to use this ability, your spirit might return as a ghost or other spirit under the GM's control.
Eternal Devotion.name: Eternal Devotion

Etheric.description: You became a borai through a botched resurrection attempt—perhaps a magic spell was disrupted, a religious rite went awry, or faulty technology went haywire, resulting in your condition. Your soul is loosely tethered to your body, allowing you to temporarily shield your living form from the ravages of the void. You gain the @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.actions.Item.kF6CV5Jo4gfz4gVs]{Soul Shield} reaction.
Etheric.name: Etheric

Evasive Jet.description:
Frequency once per day

Trigger A creature that you can see targets you with an attack.

Requirements You aren't encumbered. With a reflexive burst from your siphons, you try to flit away from the attack. You gain a +2 circumstance bonus to AC against the triggering attack. If the attack fails or critically fails, you can also Stride or Swim up to 10 feet as part of the reaction.

Special If you have the @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.feats.Item.bED9St8ppMEfJljL]{Spray Ink} feat, you can also expel a puff of ink as part of this reaction. In addition to the circumstance bonus to AC, you're @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.DmAIPqOBomZ7H95W]{Concealed} against the triggering attack.
Evasive Jet.name: Evasive Jet

Even More Smashing!.description: Your attacks have become so powerful that they can shatter armor and shields. When you Strike a creature that has hardness (such as a construct with construct armor) or an enemy using an action such as @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.feats.Item.jM72TjJ965jocBV8]{Shield Block}, you deal additional damage to that creature or shield equal to your level or the target's hardness (whichever is lower).
Even More Smashing!.name: Even More Smashing!

Ever Vigilant.description: Your extra set of eyes allows you to constantly be aware of your surroundings. You aren't @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.AJh5ex99aV6VTggg]{Off-Guard} to flanking creatures of your level or lower.
Ever Vigilant.name: Ever Vigilant

Exact Retribution.description:
Trigger You @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.feats.Item.HYdihFZR4TDtFT2z]{Swear Vengeance}.

You riposte as you're almost brought low. Make a single Strike against the triggering creature. If this Strike brings a foe to 0 Hit Points, the triggering activation of Swear Vengeance doesn't count against its frequency, and your @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.Yl48xTdMh3aeQYL2]{Wounded} condition decreases by 1.
Exact Retribution.name: Exact Retribution

Exaggerated Tales.description: Goblin stories are legendary. When you spend 1 minute telling a story, you can attempt a @Check[performance|against:will] check against up to 5 creatures' Will DCs to enrapture them. On a success, the creature listens incredulously, becoming @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.AdPVz7rbaVSRxHFg]{Fascinated} for the duration.
Exaggerated Tales.name: Exaggerated Tales

Excavating Tentacles.description: Your reinforced tentacles wrap together to burrow through the ground. You gain a burrow Speed of 15 feet for as long as your tentacles are wrapped together, and then you Burrow. You take a -10-foot status penalty to your land and fly Speeds until you unwrap your tentacles as a free action.
Excavating Tentacles.name: Excavating Tentacles

Exceptional Artisan.description: You take great pride in the mastery of your craft. Gain a skill feat in for a skill that you're at least a master in. You also gain @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.feats.Item.W6Gl9ePmItfDHji0]{Assurance} in that skill.

featPrerequisites.0: master in at least one skill

Exceptional Artisan.name: Exceptional Artisan

Exceptional Reach.description: You can leverage your size and strength alongside lengthy and heavy weapons to strike foes who would normally be safe from you. While in this stance, when you wield a melee weapon that requires two hands and doesn't have reach, you can change between a typical two-handed grip and an extended two-handed grip using an Interact action. Weapons wielded in your extended two-handed grip have a reach of 10 feet.
Exceptional Reach.name: Exceptional Reach

Exchange Student.description: You have spent substantial time around the other peoples of the Szandite Collective, and you know their cultures as well as that of atraxids. Select binnaquid, fonqugon, hardor, mecanaic, ord, or phasorq. You can select ancestry feats from the chosen ancestry, in addition to your character's own ancestries, as long as the ancestry feats don't require any physiological feature that you lack, as determined by the GM. When you select this feat, you additionally gain one 1st-level ancestry feat from your chosen ancestry.
Exchange Student.name: Exchange Student

Exclusively Quadrupedal.description: You use your middle arms as feet so much that you've lost the ability to use them as arms. You lose the @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.actions.Item.L2k363LraGLUZIgM]{Change Posture} action, and you can no longer be in bipedal posture. Your land Speed increases to 40 feet. You gain the @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.feats.Item.u8Fd0gMjCu24MBSd]{Solid Stance} feat. If you already had the Solid Stance feat, you can retrain that feat to another ancestry feat when you select this feat.
Exclusively Quadrupedal.name: Exclusively Quadrupedal

Executive Aide.description: You've been granted your own administrative assistant who uses drones to deliver you useful items for a nominal fee. You can use @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.feats.Item.bh2jHyyYrkLMsIdX]{Prescient Planner} even if you've already used it after purchasing goods, and you can use it as a single action instead of a 2-action activity, during which a corporate drone appears to deliver the item directly into your hand. In addition, five times per day, you can use Prescient Planner to pull out a common consumable item of up to 6 levels lower than your level.
Executive Aide.name: Executive Aide

Expand Mental Network.description: You can connect with other minds, even if they aren't your host's. You can cast @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.spells.Item.D442XMADp01qJ7Cs]{Mindlink} as a 1st-rank occult innate spell twice per day.
Expand Mental Network.name: Expand Mental Network

Expanded Connection.description: Increase the number of spells in your repertoire and number of spell slots you gain from mystic archetype feats by 1 for each spell rank other than your two highest mystic spell slots.
Expanded Connection.name: Expanded Connection

Expanded Expertise.description: You don't know everything, but you sure know how to learn it. You become a master in the Lore skill you learn each day during your daily preparations. At 15th level, you become legendary.

featPrerequisites.0: expertise and more expertise phasorq heritage

Expanded Expertise.name: Expanded Expertise

Expanded Senses.description:
You know that when it comes to surviving a dangerous situation, every moment counts. To that end, you've trained long and hard to improve your natural senses, pushing them to the limits of their ability. Select an imprecise sense you have, such as hearing or scent. The range of the selected imprecise sense increases to 120 feet.

Special: You can select this feat more than once. Each time you do, select a different imprecise sense you possess.
Expanded Senses.name: Expanded Senses

Expanded Solar Reserves.description: Your starburst markings can store much greater reserves of solar energy, enabling you to heal yourself more frequently. The frequency of Siphon Solar Vitality increases to once per hour, rather than once per day.
Expanded Solar Reserves.name: Expanded Solar Reserves

Expansive Verse.description: Your songs become more complex and tinged with greater magic. Each day during your daily preparations, you can choose one common 2nd-rank spell from the occult spell list. You can cast this spell as an occult innate spell once before your next daily preparations.
Expansive Verse.name: Expansive Verse

Expedition Assistant.description: You studied the methodologies of one of Jhavom's fine expeditionary academies and know a few magical standbys for dangerous missions. You can cast @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.spells.Item.VynaowCerc7B4yvI]{Akashic Download} and @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.spells.Item.7P4eBdqWcgQJAFCa]{Shifting Surge} as 1st-rank divine innate spells once per day each.
Expedition Assistant.name: Expedition Assistant

Expeditious Search.description: You have a system that lets you search at great speed, finding details and secrets twice as quickly as others can. When Searching, you take half as long as usual to @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.actions.Item.TiNDYUGlMmxzxBYU]{Search} a given area. This means that while exploring, you double the Speed you can move while ensuring you've Searched an area before walking into it (up to half your Speed). If you're legendary in Perception, you instead Search areas four times as quickly.
Expeditious Search.name: Expeditious Search

Expense Account.description: Your boss provides you with useful gifts emblazoned with the company's logo, even though the delivery seems to cost as much as the actual item. You gain the @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.feats.Item.bh2jHyyYrkLMsIdX]{Prescient Planner} and @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.feats.Item.lHFz4MmebvPqTb0A]{Prescient Consumable} general feats. When using Prescient Planner, you can find and draw the item from a worn container as a 2-action activity rather than taking 1 minute. You pick up new gifts the next time you're able to purchase goods.
Expense Account.name: Expense Account

Experienced Laborer.description:
Your hold has worked as laborers for generations, and as a result you've become an expert not only at the work that you do, but commanding respect and fair treatment from your employers.

You become trained in a Lore skill of your choosing. In addition, you gain a +2 circumstance bonus to Diplomacy checks to @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.actions.Item.plBGdZhqq5JBl1D8]{Gather Information} when consulting other professionals related to the chosen Lore skill.
Experienced Laborer.name: Experienced Laborer

Experienced Professional.description: You carefully safeguard your professional endeavors to prevent disaster. When you use Lore to @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.actions.Item.QyzlsLrqM0EEwd7j]{Earn Income}, if you roll a critical failure, you instead get a failure. If you're an expert in Lore, you gain twice as much income from a failed check to Earn Income, unless it was originally a critical failure.
Experienced Professional.name: Experienced Professional

Experienced Smuggler.description:
You often smuggle things past the authorities. When the GM rolls your Stealth check to see if a passive observer notices a small item you've concealed, the GM uses the number rolled or 10—whichever is higher—as the result of your die roll, adding it to your Stealth modifier to determine your Stealth check result. If you're a master in Stealth, the GM uses the number rolled or 15, and if you're legendary in Stealth, you automatically succeed at hiding a small concealed item from passive observers. This provides no benefits when a creature attempts a Perception check while actively searching you for hidden items.

PFS Note This feat allows you to Earn Income with Underworld Lore with tasks of your level -1 (instead of the normal level -2).
Experienced Smuggler.name: Experienced Smuggler

Experienced Tracker.description: Tracking is second nature to you, and when necessary you can follow a trail without pause. You can @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.actions.Item.EA5vuSgJfiHH7plD]{Track} while moving at full Speed by taking a –5 penalty to your Survival check. If you're a master in Survival, you don't take the –5 penalty. If you're legendary in Survival, you no longer need to roll a new Survival check every hour when tracking, though you still need to roll whenever there are significant changes in the trail.
Experienced Tracker.name: Experienced Tracker

Experienced Translator.description: You have a great deal of experience with a wide variety of people and languages, and you can pass your skills along to others. You can cast @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.spells.Item.vTQvfYu2llKQedmY]{Translate} as a 2nd-rank arcane innate spell at will.
Experienced Translator.name: Experienced Translator

Expert Guidance.description: You lead others by teaching and imparting insights onto them. Whenever an ally selects you as the target of their attempt to @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.actions.Item.tfa4Sh7wcxCEqL29]{Follow the Expert}, you increase the circumstance bonus they receive to their skill check by an additional +1, or an additional +2 if you have master proficiency rank or higher (for a total of +3 for expert, +5 for master, and +6 for legendary).
Expert Guidance.name: Expert Guidance

Expert Set-Up.description:
Trigger You roll initiative.

Whether by patient analysis or a moment of inspiration, you're prepared for combat. You can Interact to draw a weapon, or you can Step.

featPrerequisites.0: Lime-blooded Madrosarai heritage or Stone-blooded Madrosarai heritage

Expert Set-Up.name: Expert Set-Up

featPrerequisites.1: master in Arcana or Occultism, depending on paradox

Explosive Deflection.description:
Trigger You're in the area of a grenade explosion.
