Requirements You're aware of the attack, wielding a gun, and not @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.AJh5ex99aV6VTggg]{Off-Guard}.

You attempt to detonate the grenade with a well-timed shot from your gun. Expend an amount of ammunition from your gun equal to its usage, as if you'd fired the gun. You gain a +4 circumstance bonus to your Reflex save against the triggering grenade. Determine if you succeed on your save before rolling for anyone else in the area. If you succeed on your Reflex save, you cause the grenade to explode prematurely. Select a space of your choice directly between you and the attacker. The deflected grenade explodes in the selected space, and you don't need to save again if you're in the new explosion area.
Explosive Deflection.name: Explosive Deflection

Explosive Engineering.description:
Frequency once per day

You can craft technology quickly at the expense of safety. Once per day, you can @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.actions.Item.rmwa3OyhTZ2i2AHl]{Craft} an Item you know the formula for with the consumable and tech traits. You can reduce the time it would take to finish Crafting the item to 10 minutes instead of 4 days, and you reduce the materials needed for each 10 minutes of Crafting taken as you seek out more scrap (so by about half). On a critical failure, you cause an explosion and take @Damage[1d6[fire]] damage per item level, destroying the raw materials.
Explosive Engineering.name: Explosive Engineering

Explosive Surprise.description: You've mastered the infamous ysoki martial art of spitting a live grenade from your mouth. It takes 10 minutes to safely prepare a grenade and store it in your cheek pouch. As a single action, you can draw and throw this specially prepared grenade using your mouth. You don't need a free hand to do so.
Explosive Surprise.name: Explosive Surprise

Express Driver.description: You know how to get there fast. When calculating your travel Speed for the day while piloting a vehicle, you can attempt a Piloting check to increase your vehicle's travel Speed for long-term overland or aerial travel. The DC is determined by the GM but is typically based on the vehicle's piloting DC or a difficulty based on the environment, whichever is harder. On a success, double your vehicle's travel Speed for the day. This has no effect on your vehicle's movement in encounters or on starships traveling through the Drift.
Express Driver.name: Express Driver

Extend Directive.description:
Trigger Your turn begins, and you issued a 2-action directive on your last turn.

With exceptional flair, you can repeat your orders with a single word or gesture. You immediately issue the 1-action version of the directive that you issued on your previous turn.
Extend Directive.name: Extend Directive

Extended Family.description: You always have an inkling where you can find extended family. You become trained in Diplomacy. If you would automatically become trained in Diplomacy (from your background or class, for example), you instead become trained in another skill of your choice. When you attempt to [[/act make-an-impression]] or to make a Request from another ysoki, you gain a +1 circumstance bonus to your checks.
Extended Family.name: Extended Family

Extended Vitality.description: You can feel and reach out to your bonded allies regardless of range. You can @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.actions.Item.UeMHbnnaXDa3sGfG]{Transfer Vitality} to any bonded ally as long as they're on the same planet as you.
Extended Vitality.name: Extended Vitality

Extra Hands.description:
Your gravitational field has strengthened, and your ability to manipulate objects within it has improved. Your gravitational field grants you two additional hands, following the rules for characters with more than two hands. The @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.actions.Item.oW81CfM9ebxXnrw3]{Switch Hands} action gains the novian trait when you switch to or from any of your gravity hands.

Special A novian with Extra Hands can select the @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.feats.Item.EPeo604ByeeAx3AL]{All Hands on Deck} and @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.feats.Item.61txGmMLr22B93cU]{Double Draw} standardized ancestry feats.
Extra Hands.name: Extra Hands

Extreme Accuracy.description: When you @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.actions.Item.sLikawnrJJzHMYeC]{Aim}, the benefits apply if your mark is within range up to your weapon's fourth range increment. Additionally, you ignore the penalty for attacking your mark at up to four range increments away.
Extreme Accuracy.name: Extreme Accuracy

Extreme Copaxi Superstition.description: You're so accustomed to being wary around magic that you've undergone physiological changes that make your body resistant to it. You gain a +1 circumstance bonus to saving throws against spells and magical effects. Increase the bonus you gain from @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.feats.Item.0LxPR5Sw7D5MA8cm]{Copaxi Superstition} to a +2 circumstance bonus (or a +3 circumstance bonus if the effect changes gravity or can cause you to fall @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.j91X7x0XSomq8d60]{Prone}).
Extreme Copaxi Superstition.name: Extreme Copaxi Superstition

Eyes Open.description: You're of the school of thought that an alert halfling is a halfling who stays alive, and you keep your head on a swivel out of habit. You gain a +2 circumstance bonus to Perception checks made as initiative rolls.
Eyes Open.name: Eyes Open

Eyeswide Detective Dedication.description:
Access member of the Eyeswide Agency

The agency has provided you with some psychic training that helps you question suspects and track down leads. You gain limited telepathy with a range of 30 feet. If you already have limited telepathy, increase its range by 30 feet. You also become an expert in Society and gain the @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.feats.Item.X2jGFfLU5qI5XVot]{Streetwise} skill feat. If you already have the Streetwise skill feat, whenever you use Society to Gather Information and get a critical failure, you get a failure instead.

featPrerequisites.0: Wis +2 or ability to cast occult spells

Eyeswide Detective Dedication.name: Eyeswide Detective Dedication

Face in the Crowd.description:
You know how to get lost in a crowd. You can use cover from crowds to Hide and @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.actions.Item.VMozDqMMuK5kpoX4]{Sneak}, gaining a +2 circumstance bonus to your Stealth checks when in a crowd of at least 10 creatures and a +4 circumstance bonus to your Stealth checks when in a crowd of at least 100 creatures. Hidden creatures don't count as members of a crowd. If you're a master in Deception you only need 5 creatures to get these bonuses.

@UUID[Compendium.sf2e.feat-effects.Item.IaICLG7zwOV4OKgM]{Effect: Face in the Crowd}
Face in the Crowd.name: Face in the Crowd

Fading Presence.description: Sometimes, people forget about you, and it's happening more and more lately. Increase the DC of attempts to @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.actions.Item.plBGdZhqq5JBl1D8]{Gather Information} on you by 1 for each Gap-touched feat you have. Additionally, you gain a +1 status bonus to Stealth checks to [[/act avoid-notice]].
Fading Presence.name: Fading Presence

Fan the Hammer.description:
Frequency once per round

Requirements Your last action this turn was an Area Fire or Auto-Fire.

You hold down the trigger and continue blasting. You Area Fire or Auto-Fire, ignoring your weapon's unwieldy trait. You don't designate a primary target with this attack, and creatures you damage with this attack don't gain the @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.enA7BxAjBb7ns1iF]{Suppressed} condition.
Fan the Hammer.name: Fan the Hammer

Fantastic Ferocity.description:
Trigger You use Shobhad Ferocity.

You continue to battle even as you acquire mortal injuries. Make a single Strike. If this Strike brings a foe to 0 Hit Points, this activation of Shobhad Ferocity doesn't count against its frequency.
Fantastic Ferocity.name: Fantastic Ferocity

Far-Reaching Mind.description: Through rigorous mental exercises or natural talent, your psychic senses extend farther than average. Increase the ranges of your limited telepathy and thoughtsense by 10 feet each.
Far-Reaching Mind.name: Far-Reaching Mind

Fascinating Performance.description:
When you @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.actions.Item.EEDElIyin4z60PXx]{Perform}, compare your result to the Will DC of one observer. If you succeed, the target is @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.AdPVz7rbaVSRxHFg]{Fascinated} by you for 1 round. If the observer is in a situation that demands immediate attention, such as combat, you must critically succeed to fascinate it and the Perform action gains the incapacitation trait. You must choose which creature you're trying to fascinate before you roll your check, and the target is then temporarily immune for 1 hour.

If you're an expert in Performance, you can fascinate up to four observers; if you're a master, you can fascinate up to 10 observers; and if you're legendary, you can fascinate any number of observers at the same time.
Fascinating Performance.name: Fascinating Performance

Fast Recovery.description: Your body quickly bounces back from afflictions. You regain twice as many Hit Points from resting. Each time you succeed at a Fortitude save against an ongoing disease or poison, you reduce its stage by 2, or by 1 against a virulent disease or poison. Each critical success you achieve against an ongoing disease or poison reduces its stage by 3, or by 2 against a virulent disease or poison. In addition, you reduce the severity of your drained condition by 2 when you rest for a night instead of by 1.
Fast Recovery.name: Fast Recovery

Fast Synergy.description: People follow your lead because you help push them to their ultimate potential. Each of your allies gain a second reaction if they start their turn within 100 feet of you and can perceive you. This second reaction can only be used for directives you issue.
Fast Synergy.name: Fast Synergy

Fastest Route.description: By recalculating variables like traffic, weather, and attacks from giant space tardigrades, you can determine the best way to get from here to there, and you might even wildly claim to be able to get there in a shorter distance than it actually is. When you succeed at a Piloting check to [[/act navigate]], you critically succeed instead. If you critically fail a Piloting check to [[/act plot-course]], you fail instead.
Fastest Route.name: Fastest Route

Fatal Error.description:
Frequency once per day

You can wield the Gap to muddle a creature's existence, potentially deleting them as thoroughly as if you killed them. Choose one creature within 30 feet. The target must attempt a @Check[will|against:class-spell|options:inflicts:slowed] save against your class DC or spell DC, whichever is higher.

Critical Success The target is unaffected.

Success The target is @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.xYTAsEpcJE1Ccni3]{Slowed 1} for 1 round.

Failure The target is slowed 1 for 1 minute.

Critical Failure As failure, and the target must attempt a @Check[fortitude|against:class-spell|traits:death] save against the same DC. If it fails, it dies. All records and memories of the creature become hazy, similar to those of the Gap. This critical failure effect has the death trait.
Fatal Error.name: Fatal Error

Favored Disguise.description: You create a favored disguise that you can call upon at a moment's notice. When you Impersonate, you can decide that the disguise becomes your favored disguise. If you have a holoskin or can Change Shape, you can always adopt your favored disguise when Impersonating. You still roll Deception for the Impersonate check but count any critical failure results as failures instead. You can have one favored disguise and gain an additional favored disguise you can employ at expert, master, and legendary proficiency in Deception.
Favored Disguise.name: Favored Disguise

Fearless.description: Whether it comes from a sense of duty or a desire to succeed, you rarely flinch when confronted by fearsome foes. If you roll a success on a saving throw against a fear effect, you get a critical success instead.
Fearless.name: Fearless

Fearsome.description:
You're as fearsome as a dragon. You gain the trained proficiency rank in Intimidation. If you would automatically become trained in Intimidation (from your background or class, for example), you instead become trained in a skill of your choice.

You also gain the @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.feats.Item.xQMz6eDgX75WX2ce]{Intimidating Glare} skill feat.
Fearsome.name: Fearsome

Feather Step.description: You step carefully and quickly. You can Step into difficult terrain.
Feather Step.name: Feather Step

Feelings Brain.description: While you've got just as many emotions as other people, you've got an entire brain dedicated to keeping them under control so they don't interfere with the rest of your brains. You gain a +1 circumstance bonus to saves against emotion effects, and if you roll a success on a save against an emotion effect, you get a critical success instead.
Feelings Brain.name: Feelings Brain

Feign Death.description:
Trigger You take damage.

You lie @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.j91X7x0XSomq8d60]{Prone} and Impersonate a corpse. As long as you don't take any actions requiring anything other than your mind, you appear dead. To see through your ruse, a creature must succeed at a check against your Deception DC, either by Seeking or Recalling Knowledge. You can Ready an Action without ending this effect if you're a master in Deception.
Feign Death.name: Feign Death

Ferocious Berating.description: You use your encyclopedic knowledge about a foe like a cudgel, energetically castigating and criticizing them with your quick wit and knowledge. You [[/act demoralize]] a target using a skill that could be used to @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.actions.Item.1OagaWtBpVXExToo]{Recall Knowledge} about that target instead of using Intimidation. If you succeed, in addition to the effects of Demoralize, you gain information about the target as though you had succeeded at a check to Recall Knowledge about them with the skill you used in place of Intimidation.
Ferocious Berating.name: Ferocious Berating

Ferocious Recovery.description: When you bounce back from the brink of death, you experience a spike of adrenaline that allows you to ignore grievous injury. Whenever you use @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.feats.Item.gD7l0iYrsdKMCmyV]{Shobhad Ferocity}, you gain temporary Hit Points equal to your level that last for 1 minute.
Ferocious Recovery.name: Ferocious Recovery

Fierce Defender.description:
Trigger An enemy you can observe damages your ally.

If one of your own is harmed, it awakens the monstrous side of you. When one or more of your allies takes damage from an enemy, you gain a +2 circumstance bonus to Deception checks to [[/act feint]] and Intimidation checks to [[/act demoralize]] the triggering enemy until the end of your next turn.
Fierce Defender.name: Fierce Defender

Fight for the Fallen.description:
Frequency once per 10 minutes

Requirements You're within 30 feet of an ally with the dying condition.

You seethe as you see a friend, ally, or companion laid low. This anger hones your vision into a laser-like focus, allowing you to do what needs to be done. Make a Strike, rolling the attack twice and taking the better result.
Fight for the Fallen.name: Fight for the Fallen

Filtering Tentacles.description:
The sensory tentacles covering the lower part of your face are sensitive enough to detect toxins. You gain a +1 circumstance bonus to saving throws against ingested or inhaled poisons.

Special You can take this feat only at 1st level, and you can't retrain out of or into this feat.
Filtering Tentacles.name: Filtering Tentacles

Fire Fighter.description:
You have impeccable control over your natural flames and wield them to excellent effect during battle. You gain the critical specialization effects for your burning tendril and solar flare unarmed attacks (whichever you possess). In addition, you gain one of the following benefits of your choice.

  • Broad Flame: Your burning tendril gains the sweep trait.
  • Empowered Flame: Your burning tendril gains the boost 1d8 trait.
  • Explosive Flare: Your solar flare releases a small burst of flame on a hit, dealing 1 fire damage per weapon damage die to all creatures adjacent to the target.
  • Long-Range Flare: Your solar flare's range increment increases by 15 feet.

Special You can take this feat twice, selecting from the benefits you haven't yet chosen.

featPrerequisites.0: Ancestral Unarmed Attack (burning tendril or solar flare)

Fire Fighter.name: Fire Fighter

Fish in a Barrel.description: As the old saying goes: hitting easy targets is like shooting fish in a barrel. You @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.actions.Item.sLikawnrJJzHMYeC]{Aim} and then make a ranged Strike against a @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.j91X7x0XSomq8d60]{Prone} or @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.eIcWbB5o3pP6OIMe]{Immobilized} creature not benefiting from cover. Treat a success as a critical success. If you roll a critical success, the creature is @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.AJh5ex99aV6VTggg]{Off-Guard} and @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.enA7BxAjBb7ns1iF]{Suppressed} until the beginning of your next turn.
Fish in a Barrel.name: Fish in a Barrel

Fissile Budding.description:
Frequency once per day

You can use Change Shape to split two of your identities into two different bodies, each using a unique form and identity. Each copy Strides to an unoccupied square. Both you and your copy act on your turn and use the same pool of actions, the same multiple attack penalty, and the same pool of Hit Points, but if both forms take damage from the same effect, such as from an attack or spell with area damage, you apply the damage only once. In the case of an effect with a save that affects both forms, you take the worse result and apply it to both forms. When this effect ends, you choose one of the two forms as your actual form and the other version of you Strides once toward you before becoming an arm that melds with your body as soon as it occupies the same square as you. If you can't retrieve your arm, you lose the ability to Change Shape into that copy's form and lose the use of that limb until it regrows in 1 week. This effect automatically ends if you are reduced to 0 Hit Points, if you occupy the same square as your copy, or after 1 minute.
Fissile Budding.name: Fissile Budding

Fixation.description: You're fascinated with a particular topic, such as the religion of a small sect of worshippers, the process of spaghettification, or the songs sung by asterays. You gain the @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.feats.Item.BocFD2KV0qgUC76x]{Additional Lore} feat and the @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.feats.Item.W6Gl9ePmItfDHji0]{Assurance} feat for the chosen Lore.
Fixation.name: Fixation

Flame Belch.description:
Your body has developed a reserve of extra chemicals that can be used to produce smaller expulsions. You gain a flame belch ranged unarmed attack with a range increment of 30 feet that deals 1d4 fire damage. When you critically succeed at a flame belch Strike, the target takes persistent fire damage equal to half your level (minimum 1). Flame belches don't add critical specialization effects. You take a –2 circumstance penalty on attacks with your flame belch if you can't use your @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.ancestry-features.Item.jjVH7W3IhgaJ5Yct]{Fire Breath}.

Special If you have @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.feats.Item.hQtGqN3eCCr6U64e]{Admixture Breath}, you can use it to change the type of damage you deal with Flame Belch.
Flame Belch.name: Flame Belch

Flamespewer.description:
You like to tinker with your weapons so that they can spit fire. During your daily preparations, you can tinker with one tech weapon, using an upgrade slot to apply a @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.equipment.Item.49Qja6ALTUaQuVIb]{chem tank} to the weapon until your next daily preparations. The weapon deals fire damage and gains the boost 1d6 and critical (flame) traits. If it already dealt fire damage, it gains the boost 1d8 trait instead. Each time you boost the weapon, it expends 1 chem.

@UUID[Compendium.sf2e.feat-effects.Item.ohgzmXpRpt3meJX6]{Effect: Flamespewer}
Flamespewer.name: Flamespewer

Flashing Fit.description: Years of careful attention to your look have given you a deep understanding of the interplay between color, texture, and light, and you know how to make your outfit catch anyone's eye. You gain @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.spells.Item.RQjSQVZRG497cJhX]{Vibrant Pattern} as a 6th-rank primal innate spell that you can cast once per day. At 17th level, increase the area of your vibrant pattern innate spell to a @Template[type:burst|distance:20].
Flashing Fit.name: Flashing Fit

Flatten Body.description: You can flatten your body completely to avoid getting hurt. Change Shape and Drop Prone to @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.actions.Item.ust1jJSCZQUhBZIz]{Take Cover} by hunkering down. You can Hide and @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.actions.Item.VMozDqMMuK5kpoX4]{Sneak} due to the greater cover and don't lose the benefits of Take Cover when you Sneak.
Flatten Body.name: Flatten Body

Fleet.description: You move more quickly on foot. Your Speed increases by 5 feet.
Fleet.name: Fleet

Flexible Augmentations.description: You gain the @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.feats.Item.sEb6KmjQVdWNTqiu]{Augmented Body} general feat and can choose an augmentation that costs 500 credits or less. You can swap out the augmentation you chose with this feat during your daily preparations, but the new augmentation must always have the same type (so a biotech augmentation can't replace a cybernetic augmentation). Any augmentation you choose with this feat is considered to be worth at least 500 credits for purposes of calculating the difference between prices when swapping your augmentations.
Flexible Augmentations.name: Flexible Augmentations

Flexible Grip.description:
Frequency once per round

Your extra thumb allows you to quickly shift control of weapons that normally require more concentration to manage. You Interact to change your grip on an item you're holding from one-handed to two-handed or vice-versa.
Flexible Grip.name: Flexible Grip

Flicker Strike.description:
You attack a target with your solar weapon, harnessing the collision's energy to attack another foe at the speed of light. Make a Strike with your solar weapon. On a hit, you teleport up to your Speed into an unoccupied square within reach of a different creature and then immediately make a solar weapon Strike against them. If your initial Strike fails, you don't teleport, and the action ends.

Graviton-Attuned Increase the range to double your Speed.

Photon-Attuned If a Strike made as part of this action is a critical success, the struck target is @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.TkIyaNPgTZFBCCuh]{Dazzled} until the end of its next turn.
Flicker Strike.name: Flicker Strike

Flickering Existence.description:
Frequency once per minute

Suddenly, you vanish and reappear in a flash of static. You Step, moving up to 10 feet instead of 5 feet.
Flickering Existence.name: Flickering Existence

Flight Specialist.description: Whether by natural appendages or through some personal modification, you can fly. You gain a fly Speed equal to your ancestry's Flight Specialist entry.
Flight Specialist.name: Flight Specialist

Flip the Script.description:
Frequency once per day

Trigger You roll initiative.

All the world is a stage and you know the script—you anticipate the direction of the scene and then change it up on your opponents. You can choose to roll twice and take the better result, substituting Performance for the statistic you would normally use for initiative.
Flip the Script.name: Flip the Script

Floating Balance.description: You are accustomed to floating free in the wide ocean and don't lose your cool when you have nothing within reach. You don't gain the clumsy or @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.AJh5ex99aV6VTggg]{Off-Guard} conditions when untethered.
Floating Balance.name: Floating Balance

Floating Flight.description: The membranous webbing between your limbs and torso grows strong enough to function as true wings when you're floating. When you're in low or zero gravity, you gain a Fly speed equal to your Swim speed.
Floating Flight.name: Floating Flight

Floral Shifter.description:
When you change between your flowering and seeding states, you perform other subtle alterations to your body to enhance your abilities. You can change between a flowering state and a seeding state by spending 1 week of downtime.

If you're flowering, your pleasant aroma makes you more charming. You gain a +1 circumstance bonus to Diplomacy checks to [[/act make-an-impression options=floral-shifter:flowering traits=olfactory]]; this effect has the olfactory trait. The bonus increases to +2 if you're a master in Diplomacy. If you're seeding, you instead gain immunity to falling damage whenever you're in an atmosphere.
Floral Shifter.name: Floral Shifter

Fluent in Critter.description: You're obsessed with animals and communicating with them, consuming countless videos, recordings, and first-person accounts to hone your ability to speak with them. When you attempt a Diplomacy check to [[/act make-an-impression]] on or make a [[/act request]] of an animal, roll twice and take the better result.
Fluent in Critter.name: Fluent in Critter

Fluid Anatomy.description:
Frequency once per hour

Trigger An enemy scores a critical hit against you with a Strike.

Your anatomy adjusts to distribute damage from vital areas. The triggering attack deals only the damage it would deal on a hit (typically normal damage instead of double damage). Any other effects of the attack caused by a critical hit still occur, such as critical specializations effects. Until the beginning of your next turn, you're @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.AJh5ex99aV6VTggg]{Off-Guard} against the triggering enemy.
Fluid Anatomy.name: Fluid Anatomy

Fly Anything.description: You can intuit how even the most interesting vehicles function. You can pilot a ship even if it would be physiologically impossible for you, including those that require telepathy or other supernatural abilities. You can use Piloting instead of Crafting to @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.actions.Item.bT3skovyLUtP22ME]{Repair} a part of a vehicle, starship, or mech with a –2 circumstance penalty as long as you have the appropriate parts available to you. You can use Piloting instead of Computers to Hack a vehicle, starship, or mech with a –2 circumstance penalty.
Fly Anything.name: Fly Anything

Focus Pheromones.description:
Frequency once per hour

You can purposefully deploy your pheromones to manipulate the reactions of those around you. If your next action is to attempt a Deception check to @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.actions.Item.GkmbTGfg8KcgynOA]{Create a Diversion}, a Diplomacy check to @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.actions.Item.DCb62iCBrJXy0Ik6]{Request}, or an Intimidation check to @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.actions.Item.2u915NdUyQan6uKF]{Demoralize}, roll that skill check twice and use the better result.
Focus Pheromones.name: Focus Pheromones

Fog of War.description:
Requirements You're wielding an area or automatic weapon.

The flash and smoke from your frenzied gunfire conceals you from any enemies who might be left standing in the aftermath. You @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.actions.Item.oc0ZKnk5zD0GXqZi]{Area Fire} or @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.actions.Item.6ctkxUnVwqooSvgg]{Auto-Fire}. You leave behind a cloud of smoke and dust within the area that lasts until the end of your next turn or until dissipated by a strong wind (whichever happens first). Creatures in the area have the @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.DmAIPqOBomZ7H95W]{Concealed} condition, and all other creatures are concealed to them.
Fog of War.name: Fog of War

Foil Senses.description: You are adept at foiling creatures' special senses and cautious enough to safeguard against them at all times. Whenever you use the @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.actions.Item.IE2nThCmoyhQA0Jn]{Avoid Notice}, @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.actions.Item.XMcnh4cSI32tljXa]{Hide}, or @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.actions.Item.VMozDqMMuK5kpoX4]{Sneak} actions, you are always considered to be taking precautions against special senses.
Foil Senses.name: Foil Senses

Folded Paradoxes.description: Your paradoxical nature has become multifaceted. During daily preparations, you can replace one of your paradox spells with a spell of another paradox that grants training in the prerequisite paradox skill.

featPrerequisites.0: master in a paradox skill for a paradox other than your chosen paradox

Folded Paradoxes.name: Folded Paradoxes

Follow Their Lead.description:
Trigger An adjacent ally Strides.

You synchronize your movement to that of your allies, moving alongside them to keep close in the fray. Stride after the triggering ally, remaining adjacent to your ally for the duration of their movement until they stop or you've moved a distance equal to your Speed, whichever occurs first.
Follow Their Lead.name: Follow Their Lead

Follow the Bouncing Maraquoi.description:
Years of practice leaping from kvash to kvash, kicking off of walls, and racing your peers through the canopy weren't just good fun, they've translated wonderfully into close combat. You gain the @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.feats.Item.X8iSUF1m0eezmrjs]{Wall Jump} skill feat. You can use Wall Jump to make additional jumps off of creatures your size or larger as if they were walls. Once per turn, when you make an additional jump off a creature in this way, you can also attempt to [[/act shove]] or [[/act trip]] that creature as a free action.

Special If you have @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.feats.Item.qTVOJcpxkrjHEMqC]{Leaping Expertise}, you can jump off a wall to increase your fly Speed by 10 when using a jetpack or jump jet.
Follow the Bouncing Maraquoi.name: Follow the Bouncing Maraquoi

Follow-Up Fire.description:
Frequency once per round

Requirements You're wielding two guns, and your last action was a ranged Strike that missed.

When at first you don't succeed, shoot again. Make a second ranged Strike using the weapon you're wielding that you didn't fire with. This Strike doesn't count the multiple attack penalty from the prior attack but does count toward future multiple attack penalties.
Follow-Up Fire.name: Follow-Up Fire

Fonqon Climber.description: As someone who tends to the upper branches of fonqon trees, you spend much more time climbing than most fonqugons and are much better at it. Your climb Speed increases to 20 feet, and you can @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.actions.Item.pprgrYQ1QnIDGZiy]{Climb} with your "legs" rather than your hands, so you have free use of your hands while Climbing and can perform tasks such as using tools or firing weapons.
Fonqon Climber.name: Fonqon Climber

Fool the Camera.description: You know how to fool security cameras and tech items that confer special senses, such as scopes. Whenever you use the @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.actions.Item.IE2nThCmoyhQA0Jn]{Avoid Notice}, @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.actions.Item.XMcnh4cSI32tljXa]{Hide}, or @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.actions.Item.VMozDqMMuK5kpoX4]{Sneak} actions, you're always considered to be taking precautions against special senses from tech items. In addition, you gain a +2 circumstance bonus to your Stealth DC to Avoid Notice by cameras and technological hazards.
Fool the Camera.name: Fool the Camera

For the Queen!.description:
Formian queens are famous for their ability to psychically call upon the various components of their hive to fight, defend, or flee as they desire. You can channel your queen's telepathic power to motivate your own allies into a battle frenzy. Up to 10 willing allies within range of your telepathy become @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.nlCjDvLMf2EkV2dl]{Quickened} for 1 minute and can use the extra action only to Stride or Strike. While quickened in this way, they have a +2 status bonus to saving throws against mental effects.

@UUID[Compendium.sf2e.feat-effects.Item.FIdFX4WI50vzf6Pc]{Effect: For the Queen!}
For the Queen!.name: For the Queen!

Forager.description:
While using Survival to Subsist, if you roll any result worse than a success, you get a success. On a success, you can provide subsistence living for yourself and four additional creatures, and on a critical success, you can take care of twice as many additional creatures. You can choose to support half the number of creatures with a comfortable living.

Increase the number of additional creatures you feed on a success to eight if you're an expert in Survival, 16 if you're a master, and 32 if you're legendary.
Forager.name: Forager

Forgiving Anatomy.description:
Frequency once per 10 minutes

Trigger You would take bludgeoning or sonic damage. You're able to use your internal invertebrate physics to minimize damage to yourself.

You gain resistance 10 against the triggering damage and don't gain the clumsy, @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.9PR9y0bi4JPKnHPR]{Deafened}, @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.fesd1n5eVhpCSS18]{Sickened}, or @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.dfCMdR4wnpbYNTix]{Stunned} conditions due to the attack or any ability triggered by the attack.

Special If you have @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.feats.Item.X3BtZ3OY5OMzF9WF]{Ancestral Resistance} (bludgeoning or sonic), you gain resistance 20 against the attack instead.
Forgiving Anatomy.name: Forgiving Anatomy

Forgotten Heritage.description: The distant memories of your heritage, once lost and long forgotten, begin to manifest physically. You gain a heritage from your ancestry in addition to this versatile heritage. If an ability from this new heritage conflicts with an ability from your versatile heritage, you choose which of the conflicting abilities your character has, as normal. You count as having that heritage for the purposes of qualifying for feats.
Forgotten Heritage.name: Forgotten Heritage

Forgotten in the Crowd.description:
You can leverage your forgettable appearance to escape your pursuers. You gain @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.spells.Item.XXqE1eY3w3z6xJCB]{Invisibility} as a 2nd-rank arcane innate spell once per day, targeting yourself only.

Special If you have the @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.feats.Item.N68CjcvYmLF35KrD]{Face in the Crowd} skill feat, you can cast invisibility twice per day instead of once per day.
Forgotten in the Crowd.name: Forgotten in the Crowd

Formian Biotoxin.description: Your body generates a special biotoxin that you can deliver with your jaws. Your jaws unarmed attack deals an additional @Damage[1d4[persistent,poison]] damage. Additionally, on a critical hit with your jaws Strike, the target must succeed at a Fortitude save against the higher of your class DC or spell DC or be @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.MIRkyAjyBeXivMa7]{Enfeebled 1} for 1 round (or 1 minute on a critical failure).
Formian Biotoxin.name: Formian Biotoxin

Formian Scent.description: All formians use pheromones as a supplementary form of communication, and you've become especially adept at detecting scents. You gain imprecise scent with a range of 30 feet. In addition, you gain a +2 circumstance bonus to Perception checks whenever you're trying to locate an undetected creature that's within the range of your scent.
Formian Scent.name: Formian Scent

Fortified Monument.description: Tapping into the divine magic that keeps the erosion of centuries at bay allows you to harden your body. You can cast @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.spells.Item.HAaRcHfN4g83eSEC]{Cairn Form} twice per day as a 6th-rank divine innate spell that can only target yourself. In addition to the normal effects of cairn form, whenever a creature damages you with an unarmed attack or non-reach melee weapon, the attacking creature takes @Damage[8[bludgeoning]] damage.
Fortified Monument.name: Fortified Monument

Fortune Favors the Bold.description:
Requirements Your last action was a Strike that critically hit a Large or larger creature.

People think you're just lucky, but in truth, you're simply always prepared to seize an opportunity when it presents itself, even in the face of seemingly impossible odds. Automatically [[/act shove]] the target 10 feet away from you. The target is @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.AJh5ex99aV6VTggg]{Off-Guard} until the end of your current turn.
Fortune Favors the Bold.name: Fortune Favors the Bold

Foul Fragrance.description: You mix your resin with other chemicals to make yourself repellent to specific attackers. When you select this feat, choose one trait from among animal, beast, celestial, dragon, elemental, fey, fiend, fungus, giant, ooze, plant, spirit, undead, or any ancestry trait, such as human or ysoki. Any creature with that trait that starts its turn within a @Template[type:emanation|distance:10] of you or attacks you with a jaws attack must succeed at a @Check[type:fortitude|against:class-spell|options:inflicts:sickened] save against the higher of your class DC or spell DC or become @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.fesd1n5eVhpCSS18]{Sickened 1} (@UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.fesd1n5eVhpCSS18]{Sickened 2} on a critical failure). A creature that succeeds at its save is temporarily immune to all foul fragrance auras for 24 hours. You can change which trait you choose by spending 1 day of downtime adjusting your internal chemistry.
Foul Fragrance.name: Foul Fragrance

Four Arm Brains.description: You've dedicated a few extra brains to control more than the typical number of armlike appendages for a fonqugon. You have four "arms," which allows you to wield and hold up to four hands' worth of weapons and equipment. At any time, one pair of "hands" is designated as your active hands. You can change this designation from one pair of hands to another by taking the @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.actions.Item.oW81CfM9ebxXnrw3]{Switch Hands} action. You can wield items only with your active hands.
Four Arm Brains.name: Four Arm Brains

Four-Armed Climber.description:
Your additional limbs make you exceptionally adept at vertical movement. You gain a climb Speed of 10 feet. If you @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.actions.Item.FF5KgZHj345s2moq]{Push Off} in zero gravity while your inactive hands are not holding anything, you float up to your Speed instead of half your Speed.

Special If you have the glacierborn shobhad heritage, the climb Speed granted by this feat is instead equal to half your Speed. If you have the offworld shobhad heritage, you gain a +5-foot status bonus to your Speed when you Push Off in zero gravity.
Four-Armed Climber.name: Four-Armed Climber

Four-Armed Copaxi.description: You've grown an additional pair of arms beyond the pair that most copaxis have. Your four arms allow you to wield and hold up to four hands' worth of weapons and equipment. At any time, one pair of hands is designated as your active hands. You can change this designation from one pair of hands to another by taking the @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.actions.Item.oW81CfM9ebxXnrw3]{Switch Hands} action. You can wield items only with your active hands.
Four-Armed Copaxi.name: Four-Armed Copaxi

Fractal-Lite.description:
Frequency once per day.

Like the seeds of a dandelion or the intricate connections that allow raxilite Gowan starships to break apart into many smaller independent vessels, you've engineered your body and equipment to be able to break apart into smaller pieces.

In this state, you're amorphous. You lose any item bonus to AC and all other effects and bonuses from armor, and you use your proficiency rank in unarmored defense. You gain resistance 8 to physical damage and are immune to precision damage. You can't cast spells, activate items, or use actions that have the attack or manipulate trait. You gain a fly Speed of 10 feet if you didn't already have a fly Speed, and you can slip through tiny cracks. You can reassemble your body and your gear as a single action. If you haven't reassembled yourself after 5 minutes, safety protocols automatically activate to rebuild you.
Fractal-Lite.name: Fractal-Lite

Franchise Manager Dedication.description:
You become trained in Society and gain the @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.feats.Item.eR73a0yWba7clUyC]{Management Material} skill feat. You can use Deception, Diplomacy, or Intimidation instead of Society to @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.actions.Item.OX4fy22hQgUHDr0q]{Make an Impression} ([[/act make-an-impression skill=deception]], [[/act make-an-impression skill=intimidation]]) or @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.actions.Item.AJstokjdG6iDjVjE]{Impersonate} ([[/act make-an-impression skill=diplomacy]], [[/act make-an-impression skill=intimidation]]) a professional using Management Material. You can @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.actions.Item.HCl3pzVefiv9ZKQW]{Aid} an ally using [[/act aid skill=deception]]{Deception}, [[/act aid skill=diplomacy]]{Diplomacy}, or [[/act aid skill=intimidation]]{Intimidation} instead of any other skill, depending on what style of management you think will help encourage them.

Special You can take this feat even if you already have the @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.feats.Item.MRfRe8pL4rzDrXRE]{AbadarCorp Rep Dedication} feat and haven't taken two additional AbadarCorp rep archetype feats. Franchise manager archetype feats count as AbadarCorp rep archetype feats, and vice versa, for purposes of completing the archetypes.

featPrerequisites.0: trained in Deception, Diplomacy, or Intimidation

Franchise Manager Dedication.name: Franchise Manager Dedication

Frenzy.description:
Frequency once per day

Requirements An ally you can see was damaged by an enemy since the end of your last turn.

With little regard for your own safety, you fly into a frenzy to protect those you care about, gaining a +2 status bonus to melee attack rolls and a –2 status penalty to AC for 1 minute.
Frenzy.name: Frenzy

Frequent Drifter.description: Your connection to the Drift grows even stronger, allowing you to travel through it more often. The frequency of Drift Hop changes to once per hour.
Frequent Drifter.name: Frequent Drifter

Friendly Face.description: You can use Change Shape to transform into a specific individual. As long as you have studied the individual for at least 10 minutes, creatures you do not interact with will not suspect your disguise unless your behavior is markedly different, or the creature has an intimate familiarity with the individual.
Friendly Face.name: Friendly Face

Frightening Display.description: You disgorge your stomach out of your mouth in a disturbing display of your aberrant heritage. Attempt a single Intimidation check to @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.actions.Item.2u915NdUyQan6uKF]{Demoralize} each enemy within 30 feet. Regardless of the results of your check, each creature is then temporarily immune to Frightening Display for 1 minute.
Frightening Display.name: Frightening Display

Frilled Vesk Glide.description: You can use your neck frill to glide slowly through the air, 5 feet down and up to 25 feet forward through the air. As long as you spend at least 1 action gliding each round and haven't yet reached the ground, you remain in the air at the end of your turn.
Frilled Vesk Glide.name: Frilled Vesk Glide

From Hope.description: You believe that even in the face of the impossible, from hope spring miracles. Much like Lajok's rekindled light, you always carry this spark of hope in your heart and can focus upon it to make magic. You regain 1 Focus Point, up to your usual maximum.
From Hope.name: From Hope

Fruitful Psychic.description: Your psychic abilities continue to expand as your mind starts to meld with the world around you. You gain @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.spells.Item.J6vNvrUT3b1hx2iA]{Entangling Flora} and @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.spells.Item.hk2mTLH9DIvNqDuS]{Verdant Code} as 2nd-rank primal innate spells. You can cast each of these primal innate spells once per day.
Fruitful Psychic.name: Fruitful Psychic

Fundamental Understanding.description:
Trigger A creature, trap, or similar object within your quantum field casts a spell that you don't have in your spell repertoire, and you're aware of the casting.

If the triggering spell is common and you're trained in the associated skill for the spell's tradition, you automatically identify the spell being cast (you still roll to attempt to get a critical success but can't get a worse result than a success). You or a visible ally within 60 feet targeted by this spell gain a +1 circumstance bonus to your saving throw or your AC against it (or a +2 circumstance bonus if you rolled a critical success).
Fundamental Understanding.name: Fundamental Understanding

Fungal Evolution.description:
You can grow into an enormous fungal beast. Once per day, you can cast @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.spells.Item.zCcfPS4y5SrZzU2x]{Plant Form} as a 5th-rank primal innate spell. When you reach 17th level, you can heighten the spell to 6th rank when you cast it. When you cast this spell, you gain the following special abilities:

  • Speed 30 feet

  • Resistances acid 10, poison 10

  • Melee 1 tendril (reach 20 feet), Damage 2d6 bludgeoning plus Grab.

  • Targets @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.kWc1fhmv9LBiTuei]{Grabbed} by your tendril take @Damage[2d4[persistent,poison]] damage.
Fungal Evolution.name: Fungal Evolution

Fungal Strider.description: Your body's natural secretions cover your tracks. Outside of an urban environment, you're always considered to be Covering Tracks, even if you chose a different activity in exploration mode. You take a –2 circumstance penalty to @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.actions.Item.SB7cMECVtE06kByk]{Cover Tracks} in an urban environment due to your messy footsteps.
Fungal Strider.name: Fungal Strider

Furious Flap.description: The muscles that control your membranous wings are particularly well developed, and you know how to use them to catch enemies off guard with their power. Once per day while in an area of atmosphere, you can flap your wings to cast @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.spells.Item.g8QqHpv2CWDwmIm1]{Gust of Wind} as a primal innate spell. If you're submerged in liquid, you can instead cast @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.spells.Item.jfVCuOpzC6mUrf6f]{Hydraulic Push}. After you've cast the spell, you can move up to half your Speed (or half your swim Speed if submerged) as a free action.
Furious Flap.name: Furious Flap

Galactic Bond.description:
You can bond with a number of additional home worlds equal to your Wisdom modifier (minimum 1), which count against your bond limit. Planetary Bond's edicts, anathemas, and effects now extend to all bonded planets.

At 14th level, add teleport to your primal spell list. You learn the @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.spells.Item.7DN13ILADW2N9Z1t]{Commune} ritual, but can only use Nature to cast this ritual.

At 18th level, treat all bonded planets as within the same solar system as you when casting a spell with the teleport trait. Regardless of your current location, you can cast wrathful storm as a primal innate spell once per day using your spell DC.
Galactic Bond.name: Galactic Bond

Galaxy Brain.description:
Frequency once per day

In an instant, your mind becomes a psychic supercomputer. You become @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.nlCjDvLMf2EkV2dl]{Quickened} for 1 minute. You can use your extra action only to Recall Knowledge, make psychic shock Strikes, activate your psychic shock's boost trait, @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.actions.Item.BlAOM2X92SI6HMtJ]{Seek}, @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.actions.Item.1xRFPTFtWtGJ9ELw]{Sense Motive}, or activate abilities with the contemplative trait.
Galaxy Brain.name: Galaxy Brain

Galloping Grip.description: You've perfected the skill of moving around on four limbs while holding on to objects or weapons in your middle hands. While in quadrupedal posture, you can still hold one object or weapon of light Bulk in each of your middle limbs. You can't designate these hands as your active hands until you've returned to bipedal posture with @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.actions.Item.L2k363LraGLUZIgM]{Change Posture}.

featPrerequisites.0: You don't have the Consistently Quadrupedal feat.

Galloping Grip.name: Galloping Grip

Galvanic Onslaught.description: You can hold on to your natural static charge. Rather than gradually dissipating, it waits to jump to the closest conductor. Your unarmed Strikes deal an additional @Damage[1d6[electricity]] damage on a hit. On a critical hit, the jolt jumps to up to two other creatures of your choice within 10 feet of the target, dealing an equal amount of electricity damage. At 15th level, this damage ignores the target's electricity resistance (and the other creatures' electricity resistance on a critical hit).
Galvanic Onslaught.name: Galvanic Onslaught

Gelid Bite.description: Your linnorm heritage has begun to manifest more as you've become more powerful. Your jaws Strike deals an additional @Damage[1d6[cold]] damage. On a critical hit, the target is also @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.enA7BxAjBb7ns1iF]{Suppressed} until the end of your next turn, unless it succeeds at a @Check[fortitude|against:class-spell] save against your class DC or spell DC, whichever is higher.
Gelid Bite.name: Gelid Bite

General Training.description:
Your adaptability manifests in your mastery of a range of useful abilities. You gain a 1st-level general feat. You must meet the feat's prerequisites, but if you select this feat during character creation, you can select the feat later in the process in order to determine which prerequisites you meet.

Special You can select this feat multiple times, choosing a different feat each time.
General Training.name: General Training

Generic Dictionary.description: Your extensive database of knowledge and experiences enables you to readily break codes and crack passwords. You become trained in Computers and can use Computers to [[/act decipher-writing skill=computers]]. You gain the @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.feats.Item.Bi0wdUuHsLxvSqrJ]{Digital Ambassador} skill feat and can successfully communicate using the feat with a @Check[flat|dc:12|showDC:all] (@Check[flat|dc:8|showDC:all]{DC 8} if you're legendary in Society or Computers).
Generic Dictionary.name: Generic Dictionary

Genetic Environmental Adaptation.description:
Your molecular structure is more resistant to certain damage types. You gain additional resistance to the damage type chosen with @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.feats.Item.CE9d04nIDzkWDbQp]{Molecular Modification}. Your resistance to the chosen damage type equals your level, instead of half your level.

Special If you've taken Molecular Modification multiple times, you can take this feat multiple times, each time gaining additional resistance to a different damage type chosen with Molecular Modification.
Genetic Environmental Adaptation.name: Genetic Environmental Adaptation

Genetic Guise.description:
You've lived among other creatures and cultures for most of your life, and you can alter your body and demeanor to precisely mimic a humanoid.

You can cast @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.spells.Item.2qGqa33E4GPUCbMV]{Humanoid Form} as a 5th-rank occult innate spell once per day, except the duration is increased to 1 hour.
Genetic Guise.name: Genetic Guise

Genetic Pioneer Self-Perfection.description:
Frequency once per day

You know that changing your body is cheap, but gear is expensive. When you Invest an Item that has the apex trait, you can change the attribute your apex item increases to another attribute of your choice.
Genetic Pioneer Self-Perfection.name: Genetic Pioneer Self-Perfection

Gentle Boost.description: Humans familiar with low-gravity environments are also better trained at dealing with the complete loss of gravity. At the end of each round in which you're @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.z1ucw4CLwLqHoAp3]{Untethered}, attempt a @Check[flat|dc:11]. On a success, you ignore the @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.i3OJZU2nk64Df3xm]{Clumsy} and @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.AJh5ex99aV6VTggg]{Off-Guard} conditions imposed by being in zero gravity for 1 round and can increase or decrease the number of squares you move by up to 10 feet (up to 20 feet on a critical success).
Gentle Boost.name: Gentle Boost

Get Them!.description: When you use @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.actions.Item.cmCtfURzpbzkxWsy]{Get 'Em!}, you can choose any number of enemies within range instead of a single target (you still only Strike one target if you spent 2 actions).
Get Them!.name: Get Them!

Get in There!.description:
You urge your allies to hustle into the fight or to get out of the way. Until the beginning of your next turn, you and your allies within 100 feet who can sense you gain a +5-foot status bonus to Speed. As your envoy level increases, increase the bonus by an additional 5 feet at 7th level, 12th level, and 17th level.

@UUID[Compendium.sf2e.feat-effects.Item.dAcHJiPDtqxxrR4Z]{Effect: Get in There!}

Lead by Example If you used two actions, Step or Stride. Each of your allies within 100 feet who can sense you can immediately Step or Stride up to half their Speed (rounded down to the nearest 5 feet) as a reaction.
Get in There!.name: Get in There!

Ghost Courier Dedication.description:
You've grown accustomed to the unpredictable and ever-changing nature of the Ghost Levels. You become trained in Survival or become an expert in it if you were already trained. You gain the @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.feats.Item.YtbPw4FSa86QAdRq]{Urban Survivalist} skill feat.

Additionally, you've learned how to create and interpret coded symbols used for communication on the Ghost Levels. You learn the Courier Marks language, a language that's only expressed in written symbols. You can always [[/act decipher-writing skill=occultism]] using Occultism.
Ghost Courier Dedication.name: Ghost Courier Dedication

Gift of Gadrathar.description:
Frequency once per hour

You can manipulate the effects of gravity on your own body enough to allow you to fly. You gain a fly Speed equal to your land Speed for 10 minutes.
Gift of Gadrathar.name: Gift of Gadrathar

Gifted Mentor.description: You have a knack for mentoring others. Whenever you successfully Aid an ally, you increase the circumstance bonus that you would grant them by +1, or by +2 on a critical success. Whenever an ally @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.actions.Item.tfa4Sh7wcxCEqL29]{Follows the Expert}, and the expert they choose to follow is you, the circumstance bonus they gain to their skill check based on your proficiency is increased by +1.
Gifted Mentor.name: Gifted Mentor

Gigafuroid Form.description:
You trigger a dormant survival instinct to temporarily turn into your species' ultimate evolution. You can cast @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.spells.Item.wp09USMB3GIW1qbp]{Animal Form} as a 5th-rank primal innate spell once per day, except instead of choosing an animal, your battle form is an aberration with a Speed of 30 feet and climb Speed of 30 feet, resistance 10 to acid and poison damage, darkvision, precise scent 60 feet, and an unarmed tentacle Strike (reach 15 feet) that deals 2d10 bludgeoning damage plus 2d6 acid damage. You can spend an action after you hit a creature with your tentacle to @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.bestiary-ability-glossary-srd.Item.Tkd8sH4pwFIPzqTr]{Grab} the target. You also gain the @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.actions.Item.Wt3PzHoo3BauvifP]{Gunk Spray} ability while in this battle form.

@UUID[Compendium.sf2e.feat-effects.Item.FqUokahAJwpV6lbE]{Effect: Gigafuroid Form}
Gigafuroid Form.name: Gigafuroid Form

Give 'Em the Slip.description:
Predators have treasured your people for centuries, and you've learned how to use your unique anatomy to slip out of their grasp. Your pliable body, lack of bones, and protective shell make you extremely hard to hold on to. You can attempt a Stealth check to Escape in addition to the existing options (but this action still has the attack trait). You gain a +2 circumstance bonus to your first attempt to Escape each round.

[[/act escape skill=stealth]]
Give 'Em the Slip.name: Give 'Em the Slip

Glad-Hand.description: First impressions are your strong suit. When you meet someone in a casual or social situation, you can immediately attempt a Diplomacy check to @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.actions.Item.OX4fy22hQgUHDr0q]{Make an Impression} on that creature rather than needing to converse for 1 minute. If you fail, you can engage in 1 minute of conversation and attempt a new check at the end of that time rather than accepting the failure or critical failure result.
Glad-Hand.name: Glad-Hand

Glide.description: You extend your powerful membranes and flap your powerful arms in carefully controlled patterns, creating enough lift to carry you through the air. You gain a fly Speed of 20 feet.
Glide.name: Glide

Gliding Wings.description:
The winglike membranes that stretch between your arms and torso let you maneuver while floating without a solid point to push off from. While in low gravity or zero gravity, you can take the @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.actions.Item.FF5KgZHj345s2moq]{Push Off} action without having a solid surface within reach.

In addition, when falling in such an environment, you can move 5 feet horizontally in the direction of your choice for every 20 vertical feet you fall. Subtract this distance moved horizontally from the distance you fell when calculating fall damage.
Gliding Wings.name: Gliding Wings

Glimpse of the Bloom.description: Through years of practice, you've honed your ability to see through tricks and illusions of the First World. Once per day, you can cast @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.spells.Item.uqlxMQQeSGWEVjki]{Truesight} as a primal innate spell; use the higher of your class DC or spell DC, whichever is higher, minus 10 for any associated counteract checks.
Glimpse of the Bloom.name: Glimpse of the Bloom

Glimpse the Pattern.description:
You see now; you understand. Your powers come with a price, and your fate is not your own. You're a part of something greater—a pawn in motion within a vast and complex pattern, executing commands long planned and twice foreseen. You're beholden to a higher power, and it has plans for you.

If your innate spells are divine, you can cast @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.spells.Item.sX2o0HH4RjJDAZ8C]{Divine Decree} once per day as a 7th-rank divine innate spell.

If your innate spells are occult, you can cast @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.spells.Item.8kJbiBEjMWG4VUjs]{Warp Mind} once per day as a 7th-rank occult innate spell.
Glimpse the Pattern.name: Glimpse the Pattern

Glitch Shot.description: You can manipulate and disrupt technology at a greater range. You can use @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.feats.Item.Y6E0Y4RYM6KlSBxo]{Glitching Memory} at a range of 60 feet.
Glitch Shot.name: Glitch Shot

Glitching Memory.description:
Frequency once per turn

You've learned how to harness the mechanics of the Gap to disrupt technology. You touch an adjacent object or creature with the tech trait. If the target is an unwilling creature or is held by an unwilling creature, the creature attempts a @Check[reflex|against:class-spell|options:inflicts:glitching] save against your class DC or spell DC, whichever is higher. On a failure, the target becomes @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.6A2QDy8wRGCVQsSd]{Glitching 1}. On a critical failure, the target becomes @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.6A2QDy8wRGCVQsSd]{Glitching 2}.
Glitching Memory.name: Glitching Memory

Glitter Cloud.description:
Frequency once per hour

You've learned to take advantage of your glitter to help you disappear, rather than stand out. You vigorously shake out your fur, creating a cloud of glitter around you that moves with you and hides your exact location, granting you @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.DmAIPqOBomZ7H95W]{Concealment} until the end of your next turn. You can then Step or Stride.
Glitter Cloud.name: Glitter Cloud

Glitter Everywhere.description: You've learned how to further use your beloved glitter to your advantage, shaking it off at the right moment to helpfully share it with enemies. When you successfully [[/act feint]] a creature, it becomes @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.TkIyaNPgTZFBCCuh]{Dazzled} until the end of your turn. If you critically succeed, the creature is dazzled until the start of your next turn. The creature can use an Interact action to remove the dazzled condition.
Glitter Everywhere.name: Glitter Everywhere

Glow Painter.description: Nearly all talphis decorate themselves with swirling, glowing patterns to identify themselves in the dark, and because it looks nice, but you take it to another level by truly immersing yourself in the luminescent art form. You cover yourself and your armor with enough glowing patterns to emit dim light within 15 feet of you. While you emit light, you also gain a +1 circumstance bonus to Performance checks to [[/act perform]]. You can cover or uncover the light with an Interact action.
Glow Painter.name: Glow Painter

Gnarefuroid Lore.description: You are closely connected to ancient gnarefuroid colonies and know how your species survived eons in a hostile universe. You become trained in Crafting and Survival. If you would automatically become trained in one of those skills (from your background or class, for example), you instead become trained in a skill of your choice. You also gain the @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.feats.Item.BocFD2KV0qgUC76x]{Additional Lore} general feat for Gnarefuroid Lore.
Gnarefuroid Lore.name: Gnarefuroid Lore

Go for the Eyes!.description: Like a squox fighting off a larger predator, you know it's best to dash into dangerous encounters, focus on a single enemy, and go right for their eyes (or other optical receptors). You Stride, then @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.actions.Item.QNAVeNKtHA0EUw4X]{Feint}, then make a melee Strike against the target of your Feint. You can use Acrobatics instead of Deception for this [[/act feint skill=acrobatics]], if desired, and the target takes a –2 circumstance penalty to their Perception DCs against your Feint if they're larger than you.
Go for the Eyes!.name: Go for the Eyes!

Go to Ground!.description:
You succinctly direct your allies to find cover by any means necessary. You and all allies within 60 feet count any form of lesser cover as standard cover until the start of your next turn.

Lead by Example If you used two actions, @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.actions.Item.ust1jJSCZQUhBZIz]{Take Cover}. Any allies within 60 feet can Take Cover as a reaction.
Go to Ground!.name: Go to Ground!

Gooey Engulf.description:
Frequency once per round

You can Stride and move through spaces of any creatures in your path. Any creature your size or smaller whose space you move through can attempt a @Check[reflex|against:athletics] save against your Athletics DC to avoid being engulfed. A creature unable to act automatically critically fails this save. If a creature succeeds at its save, it can choose to either be pushed aside or pushed in front of you at the end of your movement. You can only attempt to Gooey Engulf the same creature once per turn. You can contain as many creatures as can fit in your space.

A creature that fails its save is pulled into your body. It is @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.kWc1fhmv9LBiTuei]{Grabbed} and @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.xYTAsEpcJE1Ccni3]{Slowed 1}, and it must hold its breath or start suffocating. The creature takes @Damage[1d6[acid]] damage at the end of each of its turns while engulfed (this damage can be improved by @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.equipment.Item.b12tnjobe9IrphII]{hardlight handwraps} as though it were an unarmed attack). An engulfed creature can get free by [[/act escape dc=athletics]]{Escaping} against your Athletics DC. An engulfed creature can attack you but only with an unarmed attack or weapons of light Bulk or less. You're @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.AJh5ex99aV6VTggg]{Off-Guard} against these attacks. If you take piercing or slashing damage equaling or exceeding one fourth of your remaining Hit Points from a single attack or spell, the engulfed creature cuts itself free. A creature that gets free by either method can immediately breathe and exits your space. If you fall asleep, are knocked @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.fBnFDH2MTzgFijKf]{Unconscious}, or die, all creatures you've engulfed are automatically released.
Gooey Engulf.name: Gooey Engulf

Gooey Engulf (Entu).description:
Frequency once per round

You can Stride and move through spaces of any creatures in your path. Any creature your size or smaller whose space you move through can attempt a @Check[reflex|against:athletics] save against your Athletics DC to avoid being engulfed. A creature unable to act automatically critically fails this save. If a creature succeeds at its save, it can choose to either be pushed aside or pushed in front of you at the end of your movement. You can only attempt to Gooey Engulf the same creature once per turn. You can contain as many creatures as can fit in your space.

A creature that fails its save is pulled into your body. It's @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.kWc1fhmv9LBiTuei]{Grabbed} and @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.xYTAsEpcJE1Ccni3]{Slowed 1}, and it must hold its breath or start suffocating. The creature takes @Damage[1d6[acid]] damage at the end of each of its turns while engulfed (this damage can be improved by @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.equipment.Item.b12tnjobe9IrphII]{hardlight handwraps} as though it were an unarmed attack). An engulfed creature can get free by [[/act escape dc=athletics]]{Escaping} against your Athletics DC. An engulfed creature can attack you but only with an unarmed attack or weapons of light Bulk or less. You're @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.AJh5ex99aV6VTggg]{Off-Guard} against these attacks. If you take piercing or slashing damage equaling or exceeding one fourth of your remaining Hit Points from a single attack or spell, the engulfed creature cuts itself free. A creature that gets free by either method can immediately breathe and exits your space. If you fall asleep, are knocked @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.fBnFDH2MTzgFijKf]{Unconscious}, or die, all creatures you've engulfed are automatically released.
Gooey Engulf (Entu).name: Gooey Engulf (Entu)

Goolife.description: You've learned how to maintain your ooze form, allowing you to experience the glory of your primordial form more frequently. You can use @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.actions.Item.pO1wkgklxp9j1taY]{Become Ooze} with a frequency of once per 10 minutes, rather than once per day. If you fall asleep in your ooze form, you remain in that form until you wake up.
Goolife.name: Goolife

Gorge.description:
You force yourself to metabolize more flesh, gristle, and bone than you can normally stomach, gorging on as much of your grisly meal as possible to bolster your body's necromantic healing processes. When you @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.feats.Item.8ftl9i9rmorxoBow]{Consume Flesh}, you gain a number of temporary Hit Points equal to 10 plus half your level, rounded down. These temporary Hit Points last for 10 minutes.

@UUID[Compendium.sf2e.feat-effects.Item.b3bGLDuzs0lKS1Oq]{Effect: Gorge}
Gorge.name: Gorge

Goring Rush.description: You use the momentum of your body to charge at your opponent with your horns. Stride twice or @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.actions.Item.FF5KgZHj345s2moq]{Push Off} once, then make a horns Strike. If you moved at least 20 feet from your starting position, your horns Strike also deals 1d6 persistent bleed damage.
Goring Rush.name: Goring Rush

Got 'Em.description:
Frequency once per round

Trigger An ally's Strike hits the target of your Get 'Em!

You provide a quick follow-up to your ongoing directive, encouraging your ally when they successfully hit your designated target. Your ally gains a status bonus to damage equal to your Charisma modifier.

@UUID[Compendium.sf2e.feat-effects.Item.73I9yj9XlxcBLXfa]{Effect: Got 'Em}
Got 'Em.name: Got 'Em

Grabbing Pincer.description: Your massive pincer can crush your foes and never let go. Your pincer unarmed attack deals 1d8 damage instead of 1d6 and gains the versatile S trait.
Grabbing Pincer.name: Grabbing Pincer

Grace of the Ages.description:
Frequency once per day

Trigger You're damaged by an attack.

Elves might be under attack from all sides metaphorically, but you don't intend to let that be the case for you literally. You Step away from the triggering attacker. If an effect with an Escape DC prevents you from Stepping, you can attempt to [[/act escape]] the effect instead.
Grace of the Ages.name: Grace of the Ages

Grand Soul!.description: You've attuned your senses beyond their natural limits. Your emotionsense becomes a precise sense, and its range increases by 10 feet (this is cumulative with the @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.feats.Item.IjyfyYMloBQHEsjm]{Enhanced Senses} standardized ancestry feat). The range of your limited telepathy increases to the range of your emotionsense.
Grand Soul!.name: Grand Soul!

Grandmother's Curse.description:
Frequency once per hour

You make the sign of Lao Shu Po's eye and curse a creature with inescapable visions from the Netherworld. Choose a creature you can see within 30 feet. The target must attempt a @Check[will|against:class-spell] save against your class DC or spell DC, whichever is higher.

Critical Success The target is unaffected.

Success The target is @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.e1XGnhKNSQIm5IXg]{Stupefied 1} for 1 round.

Failure The target is @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.e1XGnhKNSQIm5IXg]{Stupefied 2} for 2 rounds.

Critical Failure The target is stupefied 2 and @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{Frightened 1} for 1 minute.
Grandmother's Curse.name: Grandmother's Curse

Grandmother's Favorite.description: Your steadfast faith in Grandmother Rat yields more rewards. You gain @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.spells.Item.sX2o0HH4RjJDAZ8C]{Divine Decree} as a 7th-rank divine innate spell once per day. Additionally, once per month, whenever you would die, your body instead transforms into a swarm of dispersing rats. After [[/r 1d6 #days]]{1d6 days}, these rats gather in a safe space of the GM's choosing (a site dedicated to Lao Shu Po, if possible) and reform your body. You're returned to life at your maximum Hit Points.
Grandmother's Favorite.name: Grandmother's Favorite

Grandmother's Lore.description:
You follow Lao Shu Po's teachings and aren't afraid to lie, cheat, or steal to get what you desire. Thanks to your extra devotion, you gain the trained proficiency rank in Deception and Thievery. If you would automatically become trained in one of those skills (from your background or class, for example), you instead become trained in a skill of your choice.

You gain the @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.feats.Item.BocFD2KV0qgUC76x]{Additional Lore} general feat for Lao Shu Po Lore.
Grandmother's Lore.name: Grandmother's Lore

Grapple Dance.description:
Frequency once per day

You've studied ancient kasathan martial techniques of using a combatant's own bodyweight against them to gain the upper hand in battle.

You [[/act grapple skill=acrobatics]] a target, using Acrobatics against the target's Fortitude DC instead of Athletics. You can continue to use Acrobatics instead of Athletics for further attempts to Grapple the target until they @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.actions.Item.SkZAQRkLLkmBQNB9]{Escape} or are otherwise freed from being grappled by you.
Grapple Dance.name: Grapple Dance

Grappling Theft.description: You grab hold of your foe with your powerful primary limbs, temporarily distracting them. If you critically succeed your check to [[/act grapple]] an enemy, you can attempt to [[/act steal]] something from the enemy as a free action. You gain a +1 circumstance bonus to your Thievery check to Steal, as your grapple makes it difficult for your foe to keep track of your vestigial arms. You can Steal any immediately accessible item of light Bulk or less on the enemy's person, such as a holstered weapon or a serum hanging from a belt, but not anything inside a container or anything the enemy is holding. The GM makes the final determination on what you can Steal in this way.
Grappling Theft.name: Grappling Theft

Grasping Tendrils.description:
You've adapted more of your tendrils and limbs with complex musculature and cellular structures, improving articulation and fine motor skills. Increase your number of arms by two. At any time, one pair of your hands is designated as your active hands. You can change this designation from one pair of hands to another by taking the Switch Hands action, which is a single action. You can only wield items with your active hands.

Special You can take this feat multiple times.
Grasping Tendrils.name: Grasping Tendrils

Gravitational Master.description: You have spent so much time in zero-g that you can control your own personal gravity. You gain @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.spells.Item.0mNmVi9CLXor3McX]{Personal Gravity} as a 3rd-rank primal innate spell that you can cast once per day.
Gravitational Master.name: Gravitational Master

Graviton Flight.description:
You know that there's no such thing as a true zero-gravity environment. You're sensitive to the ebbs and flows of microgravity and can use it to propel yourself even when you're floating @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.z1ucw4CLwLqHoAp3]{Untethered}. When you're in an area of zero gravity, you gain a fly Speed of 30 feet, and you can Fly in zero gravity.

Special You can use the @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.feats.Item.SVjJGIvTodhDjpaD]{Weightless Defense} feat while Flying in zero gravity, even if you're not untethered. The benefits end if you stop Flying or leave zero gravity.
Graviton Flight.name: Graviton Flight

Gravity Grasp.description:
You can seize and move objects from afar using your gravitational field, although your control is clumsy, and you can't perform actions with these objects. You grasp one unattended object of light Bulk or less within 30 feet and move it slowly 15 feet in any direction, up to a maximum distance of 30 feet away from you. You can Sustain Gravity Grasp for up to 1 minute, moving the object an additional 15 feet each time. If the object is in the air when this effect ends, it falls.

Special If you're a black hole novian, dense novian, or massive novian, you can grasp one unattended object of 1 Bulk or less, rather than light Bulk or less.
Gravity Grasp.name: Gravity Grasp

Gravity Slam.description: You've learned to exert your gravitational field not only over objects but other creatures. You become trained in Athletics. If you would automatically become trained in Athletics (from your background or class, for example), you instead become trained in another skill of your choice. You gain the @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.feats.Item.KxaYlC50zzHysJj8]{Titan Wrestler} skill feat, and you gain a +1 circumstance bonus on Athletics checks to [[/act disarm]], [[/act grapple]], [[/act reposition]], [[/act shove]], and [[/act trip]].
Gravity Slam.name: Gravity Slam

Gravity Surge.description: You can utilize your powers with enough force to grab items held by other creatures. You can [[/act disarm]] or [[/act steal]] from a creature up to 15 feet away instead of only adjacent creatures.
Gravity Surge.name: Gravity Surge

Gravity Swipe.description: When you use @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.feats.Item.YqAY8XtOL9u6pyiw]{Gravity Grasp}, the range at which you can move objects increases to 60 feet. In addition, whenever you use Gravity Grasp, you can choose to pull the target object directly into one of your free hands from up to the maximum range of Gravity Grasp. You also gain the @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.actions.Item.P5FKQOFiuApG9QyG]{Seize Object} action.
Gravity Swipe.name: Gravity Swipe

Gravity Tether.description:
Requirements You have at least one hand free, and the target is an item you can hold in one hand that's unattended or that you're carrying in a bag, pack, pouch, or other container.

Your concentrated center of gravity has evolved to form a supernatural aura of sorts that you can leverage to your advantage. By focusing on this personal gravity field, you can call a single item into your hand from up to 30 feet away.
Gravity Tether.name: Gravity Tether

Grazing Shot.description:
Requirements You have a mark.

You take your time to line up a shot that's sure to hit. Make a ranged Strike with your gun against your mark. It gains the following failure effect.

Failure Your attack deals minimum damage to the target. (Calculate this damage as if every die you would roll has a result of 1.)
Grazing Shot.name: Grazing Shot

Greater Epiphany.description: You see into the truth of the cosmos through your connection. You gain the greater epiphany spell for your chosen connection.
Greater Epiphany.name: Greater Epiphany

Greater Unleashed Anger.description: You hone your anger into a prolonged duration, allowing you to overcome foes in the heat of battle. Your @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.feats.Item.SAkw1zr6z8PKV3ZF]{Unleashed Anger} lasts for 10 minutes without the need to Sustain it. While in this form, increase your reach by 5 feet.
Greater Unleashed Anger.name: Greater Unleashed Anger

Greater Warp.description: You breach the veil of paradoxical understanding. You gain the greater warp spell for your paradox.
Greater Warp.name: Greater Warp

Grouchy Nature.description:
Frequency once per hour

In a universe of optimists, dwarves can be down-to-earth grumps. If you spend more than 1 minute grumbling or grousing, you gain a +2 circumstance bonus to the next skill check you make within a minute of your continued grumbling.
Grouchy Nature.name: Grouchy Nature

Groundbreaking Stride.description: Your innate connection to nature allows you to move through certain environments that might slow others down and hamper the movements of your allies and enemies alike. You ignore non-magical difficult terrain due to plant life if you're a summerborn ryphorian or due to ice and snow if you're a winterborn ryphorian, and you treat those kinds of greater difficult terrain as normal difficult terrain.
Groundbreaking Stride.name: Groundbreaking Stride

Group Coercion.description:
You can strong-arm people effectively, even when you don't have them isolated. When you @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.actions.Item.tHCqgwjtQtzNqVvd]{Coerce}, you can compare your Intimidation check result to the Will DCs of up to five targets instead of one.

It's possible to get a different degree of success for each target. The number of targets you can Coerce in a single action increases to 10 if you're an expert, 25 if you're a master, and 50 if you're legendary.
Group Coercion.name: Group Coercion

Group Impression.description: When you @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.actions.Item.OX4fy22hQgUHDr0q]{Make an Impression}, you can compare your Diplomacy check result to the Will DCs of up to 10 targets you conversed with, with no penalty. The number of targets increases to 20 if you're an expert, 50 if you're a master, and 100 if you're legendary.
Group Impression.name: Group Impression

Guarded Thoughts.description: Your psychic training allows you to block attempts to read your thoughts. Any effect that specifically attempts to read your mind to glean information must succeed at a counteract check against the higher of your class DC or your spell DC to do so successfully; otherwise, it gains no information. The counteract rank is equal to half your level rounded up.
Guarded Thoughts.name: Guarded Thoughts

Guilt Trip.description:
Trigger A creature you can see damages you with a melee Strike.

You give your attacker a look of utter disappointment so heartbreaking that it causes them to feel shame for their actions. The attacker must succeed at a @Check[will|against:class-spell] saving throw against your class DC or spell DC, whichever is higher, or become @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.fesd1n5eVhpCSS18]{Sickened 1} from the guilt. On a critical failure, they fail to follow through on the attack, reducing the triggering damage dealt to you by their Strength modifier.
Guilt Trip.name: Guilt Trip
