Gun Expert.description: Your proficiency ranks for simple and martial guns increase to expert.

featPrerequisites.1: expert in any kind of weapon or unarmed attack

Gun Expert.name: Gun Expert

Hair Trigger.description:
Trigger The last creature you @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.actions.Item.sLikawnrJJzHMYeC]{Aimed} at since the start of your last turn uses a manipulate action or a move action, makes a ranged attack, or leaves a square during a move action.

Requirements You're wielding a gun.

You attempt a ranged Strike against the triggering creature. This Strike doesn't count toward your multiple attack penalty, and your multiple attack penalty doesn't apply to this Strike.
Hair Trigger.name: Hair Trigger

Hammer the Nail.description: You adjust the angle of your barrage to maximize the ammunition's impact on creatures' bodies. Increase the distance creatures are pushed by your @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.feats.Item.fSqUeSAFhvBfq4sE]{Shoving Shot} to 5 feet on a success, 10 feet on a failure, and 20 feet on a critical failure. In addition, on a critical failure, the target is also knocked @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.j91X7x0XSomq8d60]{Prone}.
Hammer the Nail.name: Hammer the Nail

Hampering Flare.description: You focus on your flare, setting up a blast of energy to disorient your foes. Make a ranged Strike with your solar flare. If this attack hits, the target is @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.AJh5ex99aV6VTggg]{Off-Guard} until the start of your next turn or until it Takes Cover, whichever comes first.
Hampering Flare.name: Hampering Flare

Hampering Shot.description:
Requirements You're wielding a gun.

You skillfully line up your shot to hinder your foe. You @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.actions.Item.sLikawnrJJzHMYeC]{Aim} and then make a ranged Strike against your mark. If the Strike hits, the creature becomes @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.AJh5ex99aV6VTggg]{Off-Guard} until the end of your next turn.
Hampering Shot.name: Hampering Shot

Hang in There.description:
You encourage yourself or an ally, psyching them up for a coming challenge and granting them temporary Hit Points. Choose yourself or an ally within 30 feet, then attempt a @Check[diplomacy|dc:20|showDC:all] check. If you have master proficiency in Diplomacy, you can instead attempt a @Check[diplomacy|dc:30|showDC:all] check to increase the temporary Hit Points gained on a successful check by 5. If you have legendary proficiency, you can instead attempt a @Check[diplomacy|dc:40|showDC:all] check to increase the temporary Hit Points gained on a successful check by 10. These temporary Hit Points last for 1 minute. The target is then temporarily immune to your Hang in There for 1 day.

Critical Success The target gains temporary Hit Points equal to double their level plus your Charisma modifier.

Success The target gains temporary Hit Points equal to their level plus your Charisma modifier.

Failure The target is unaffected, and you can't use Hang in There again for 1 minute.

Critical Failure The target is unaffected, and you can't use Hang in There again for 1 hour.
Hang in There.name: Hang in There

Hang in There (Nu)Friend!.description: Your absolute dedication to your friends lets you call upon some galactic power to keep them safe in their darkest hour. You can cast @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.spells.Item.Hnc7eGi7vyZenAIm]{Breath of Life} as a 5th-rank divine innate spell once per day; however, you only restore @Damage[5[healing]] Hit Points instead of 5d8.
Hang in There (Nu)Friend!.name: Hang in There (Nu)Friend!

Hard-Fought Freedom.description:
Frequency once per day

Trigger You become @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.eIcWbB5o3pP6OIMe]{Immobilized}, @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.kWc1fhmv9LBiTuei]{Grabbed}, or @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.VcDeM8A5oI6VqhbM]{Restrained}.

You're at your fiercest when fighting against being constrained. You cast @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.spells.Item.aqRYNoSvxsVfqglH]{Unfettered Movement} as a 4th-rank occult innate spell targeting yourself.
Hard-Fought Freedom.name: Hard-Fought Freedom

Hardened Plates.description: Your plates are reinforced even further, your soul hardening with it. Your @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.equipment.Item.BJsogI1a5WSUHudq]{Hellforged Armor} is considered heavy armor instead of medium armor, its Strength requirement increases to +4, its item bonus to AC increases by 1, and it gains the bulwark trait.
Hardened Plates.name: Hardened Plates

Hardened in the Vault.description: Your body was forged in the Vault of Vorlath by mercenaries who were subjected to brutal experimentation. You gain the @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.feats.Item.I0BhPWqYf1bbzEYg]{Diehard} feat. Once per day, if you fail the flat check to remove persistent damage, you can reroll the check as a free action and take the higher result; this is a fortune effect.
Hardened in the Vault.name: Hardened in the Vault

Hardor Spine.description: Your spines aren't just for show; they're sturdy enough to use as weapons. You gain a spine unarmed attack that deals 1d6 piercing damage. Your spines are in the brawling group and have the finesse, hardor, and unarmed traits.
Hardor Spine.name: Hardor Spine

Hardy Transplant.description: You're an unstoppable transplant who has adapted to thrive in brutal environments vastly different from the lush forests of Castrovel. You always count as adapted to a planet's environment, and you always take half damage from environmental effects such as from cold, heat, or corrosive atmospheres.
Hardy Transplant.name: Hardy Transplant

Harmonic Convergence.description:
Dissonance grants you some clarity and a brief second wind in stressful situations. When you use an action with the disharmony trait, you gain a number of temporary Hit Points equal to half your level until the start of your next turn.

@UUID[Compendium.sf2e.feat-effects.Item.WUHSeAxZXX3Fin3S]{Effect: Harmonic Convergence}
Harmonic Convergence.name: Harmonic Convergence

Harmonic Sensitivity.description: You've developed keen organs that have a sensitivity to sound—and you know how to put them to use. You become trained in Performance or gain the Assurance skill feat with Performance if you're are already trained in that skill. In addition, you can accurately recall a melody or lyrics you've heard within the last week, granting you a +2 circumstance bonus to all Deception and Performance checks that involve mimicking speech or a specific sound.
Harmonic Sensitivity.name: Harmonic Sensitivity

Harmonic Shielding.description: You've learned to compensate for your hypersensitivity to sound. You gain sonic resistance equal to half your level. If you roll a success on a saving throw against a sonic effect, you get a critical success instead.
Harmonic Shielding.name: Harmonic Shielding

Harness Cosmic Forces.description: You're among the most powerful of sarcesians and can harness the cosmic forces of the universe to create incredible stellar phenomena. Select one of the following spells, which you can cast once per day as a 7th-rank arcane innate spell: @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.spells.Item.0jadeyQIItIuRgeH]{Eclipse Burst} or @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.spells.Item.a3aQxCpoj1q1NQxC]{Sunburst}.
Harness Cosmic Forces.name: Harness Cosmic Forces

Harnessing Fate.description: You have become a master at manipulating the ebb and flow of fortune's fickle tide. When you gain the @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.actions.Item.AWjKNTF00nagdA7j]{Lucky Break} reaction, you only become immune to @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.feats.Item.UxnOyz4dOECDaEv9]{Unlucky for Some} for 10 minutes.
Harnessing Fate.name: Harnessing Fate

Head Fake.description:
Frequency once per 10 minutes

With two sets of eyes, two facial expressions, and sometimes conflicting body language, you have a natural ability to mislead your opponents. Attempt to [[/act feint]]. If you succeed, your target is @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.AJh5ex99aV6VTggg]{Off-Guard} against your ranged attacks in addition to melee attacks, and you can immediately attempt a Strike at the same target.
Head Fake.name: Head Fake

Head of Steam.description:
One talphi saying states that life is better in motion, and many talphis are better in motion as well; it takes you a second to get up to speed, but your body is built to capitalize on the momentum you generate. The more you move, the faster you go. Your Speed increases by 5 feet until the beginning of your next turn after each action you spend to Stride.

@UUID[Compendium.sf2e.feat-effects.Item.rxk6UxIuCushWnId]{Effect: Head of Steam}
Head of Steam.name: Head of Steam

Heads Up.description: Your better half (or other head, anyway) is carefully monitoring your surroundings, making you twice as likely to be ready when danger arises. You gain a +2 circumstance bonus to Perception checks for initiative.
Heads Up.name: Heads Up

Headstrong.description: You became a borai through your own stubborn willfulness. When you died, you refused to accept your death and clung to your corpse, forcing your soul back into your body and regaining life along with it. You gain a +1 circumstance bonus to Will saving throws against fear and effects that would make you @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.yblD8fOR1J8rDwEQ]{Confused} or @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.9qGBRpbX9NEwtAAr]{Controlled} and to your Will DC against attempts to @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.actions.Item.2u915NdUyQan6uKF]{Demoralize} you.
Headstrong.name: Headstrong

Heart of Planets Lost.description: You grew up hearing stories about Damiar and Iovo, the long-destroyed sarcesian home worlds remembered today only in legends, shattered rock, and the hearts of your people. You gain the @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.feats.Item.BocFD2KV0qgUC76x]{Additional Lore} general feat for Damiar Lore, Iovo Lore, and Diaspora Lore.
Heart of Planets Lost.name: Heart of Planets Lost

Heart of a Sun.description: You have the soul of a true sun and are impervious to even the hottest flames. You become immune to fire.
Heart of a Sun.name: Heart of a Sun

Heavy Exoskeleton.description: Your chitinous plates have thickened in response to heavy punishment. Every bit of scar tissue that forms on your plates and every healed fracture have built your natural defenses into a protective layer that's truly a sight to behold. Your exoskeleton becomes heavy armor, and your proficiency in your exoskeleton armor becomes equal to your proficiency in medium armor. Your armor now grants a +5 item bonus to AC, has a +1 Dex cap, a check penalty of –2, a –10-foot penalty to Speed, and a Strength threshold of +3. It has a Bulk of 3 and the bulwark, comfort, and exposed traits. It's in the plate armor group. You can wear flight suits, but no other armor.
Heavy Exoskeleton.name: Heavy Exoskeleton

Heavy Shell.description: Your shell is structured in such a way to allow for easier movement of objects. Increase your maximum and encumbered Bulk limits by 4. You can rest normally while wearing medium armor.
Heavy Shell.name: Heavy Shell

Heed the Hive Mind.description:
The queen and other members of your colony are ever-present in your mind. When you roll a success on a saving throw against an effect that would directly control your actions, you get a critical success instead.

Special If you have the queen's court formian heritage, when you roll a critical failure on a saving throw against an effect that would directly control your actions, you get a failure instead.
Heed the Hive Mind.name: Heed the Hive Mind

Hefty Hauler.description: You can carry more than your frame implies. Increase your maximum and encumbered Bulk limits by 2.
Hefty Hauler.name: Hefty Hauler

Heightened Metabolic Adaptation.description: Your body can adapt and change even faster than most other copaxis. You can retrain using your @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.ancestry-features.Item.rwdjsNymGgpO9UBK]{Regenerative Evolution} feature over 1 week of downtime instead of 1 month. At 13th level, you can use regenerative evolution to retrain one feat or skill increase during your daily preparations. You can't use regenerative evolution to retrain Heightened Metabolic Adaptation.
Heightened Metabolic Adaptation.name: Heightened Metabolic Adaptation

Heightened Paranoia.description:
You witnessed the ritual that supposedly rekindled Sota's flame up close, and while it was certainly impressive, you don't believe it should've worked. You can't seem to shake the feeling that something else is at work behind the scenes—something dangerous and unknown. Whatever it is, you intend to face this threat head on. When you succeed on a Will saving throw against an effect that could impose the @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.yblD8fOR1J8rDwEQ]{Confused}, @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.9qGBRpbX9NEwtAAr]{Controlled}, or @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{Frightened} condition, you get a critical success instead.

Special You can't select this feat if you have the @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.feats.Item.fXQxrEuO2ER8fUgW]{Determined Optimist} feat.

featPrerequisites.0: trained in Arcana, Occultism, or Religion

Heightened Paranoia.name: Heightened Paranoia

Heightened Thoughtsense.description:
Your psychic awareness expands, granting you sharper perception at close range and a wider sensory field overall. Increase the range of your vague thoughtsense by 10 feet. In addition, you gain thoughtsense as an imprecise sense with a range of 5 feet.

At 9th level, your vague thoughtsense becomes an imprecise sense.
Heightened Thoughtsense.name: Heightened Thoughtsense

Hellknight Dedication.description:
Your infernal countenance is a scourge. You gain expert proficiency in Intimidation (or in another skill in which you're trained of your choice if you were already an expert in Intimidation). You become trained in light armor and medium armor. If you already were trained in light armor and medium armor, you gain training in heavy armor as well. Whenever you gain a class feature that grants you expert or greater proficiency in any type of armor (but not unarmored defense), you also gain that proficiency in the armor types granted to you by this feat. You gain the armor specialization effects of that armor and one additional armor upgrade. Your resistance (or reduction from critical hits) from that armor's specialization is 1 higher than normal and you gain an item bonus to Intimidation checks equal to 1 + your armor's resilience value.

Hellknight Orders

Hellknight OrderEdictsInfernal Damage and Resistance
Order of the Chainpunish lawbreakerselectricity
Order of the Crucibletest civilizationscold
Order of the Eclipsecontrol dangerous informationvoid
Order of the Pyrepurge subversive media with firefire

@UUID[Compendium.sf2e.journals.JournalEntry.vx5FGEG34AxI2dow.JournalEntryPage.FBSAwwkdBfmHPb2D]{Hellknight}
Hellknight Dedication.name: Hellknight Dedication

Helping Hand.description:
Frequency once every 10 minutes

In the blink of an eye, you ready yourself to help your ally with a task. This counts as preparing to help an ally for the purposes of using the @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.actions.Item.HCl3pzVefiv9ZKQW]{Aid} reaction. You must still explain to the GM exactly how you're helping.
Helping Hand.name: Helping Hand

Hero's Edge.description: You fight hardest when the odds are at their most dire, and the specter of death looms over you. As long as you have temporary Hit Points from @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.feats.Item.a9ER2amvCuQEJODm]{Heroic Last Stand}, your Strikes and spells deal additional damage. You gain a status bonus to damage with your Strikes equal to the number of weapon damage dice. Spells you cast from spell slots gain a status bonus to damage equal to the level of the spell; this bonus applies only to spells that deal damage and don't have a duration.
Hero's Edge.name: Hero's Edge

Hero's Perseverance.description: Like the heroes who inspire you, you rally yourself to persevere against death itself. When you use Heroic Last Stand, you gain temporary Hit Points equal to twice your level for 1 minute, rather than equal to your level for 1 minute.
Hero's Perseverance.name: Hero's Perseverance

Heroic Last Stand.description:
Frequency once per day

Requirements You have less than one-quarter of your Hit Points remaining.

You fight fearlessly for your friends. You gain temporary Hit Points equal to your level for 1 minute. As long as you have these temporary Hit Points, you gain a +1 circumstance bonus to Will saves against fear effects and a +2 circumstance bonus to your Will DC against attempts to @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.actions.Item.2u915NdUyQan6uKF]{Demoralize} you.
Heroic Last Stand.name: Heroic Last Stand

Hey, Buddy.description:
Frequency once per day

Trigger You fail a saving throw

Requirements You're adjacent to at least one ally.

You fly better with a copilot or a trusted ally you've formed a tight bond with. Reroll the triggering saving throw and use the better result. If your ally also rolled a saving throw against the same effect, they can reroll the triggering saving throw and use the better result.
Hey, Buddy.name: Hey, Buddy

Hidden Hands.description: Your vestigial hands might lack in strength, but they make up for it in subtlety. You can manipulate objects with your smaller middle limbs while pretending to be otherwise occupied, drawing attention away from your clandestine activities. You gain the @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.feats.Item.hVZbnsDuXihggylt]{Subtle Theft} feat. As long as your primary hands are holding or wielding items other than an infiltrator's toolkit, the circumstance penalty to notice your misdeeds extends to attempts to [[/act disarm]] a Device or Pick a Lock.
Hidden Hands.name: Hidden Hands

Hidden Identity.description: Unlike others with the power of song, you like to be able to fly under the radar when you need to. You've developed a second identity in the process. You become trained in Deception. If you're already trained in Deception, you instead become trained in another skill of your choice. You gain the @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.feats.Item.XeL6uygxW4u2vMkF]{Favored Disguise} skill feat, and the @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.actions.Item.9moYuimhiXJTkkkc]{Skitter Idol Transformation} activity.
Hidden Identity.name: Hidden Identity

Hidden Talent.description: You have niche expertise or esoteric training that you often fall back on when you find yourself in a rut. You gain the @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.actions.Item.CwOcMVOyIIWuJn0R]{One Up} reaction.
Hidden Talent.name: Hidden Talent

Historian.description: You become trained in a Lore skill of your choice. You can spend 10 minutes checking your notes or research materials to @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.actions.Item.1OagaWtBpVXExToo]{Recall Knowledge} about a piece of history with any Lore skill in which you aren't trained, using your highest Lore skill modifier instead of your modifier with that skill.
Historian.name: Historian

History Buff.description: You've cataloged countless customs, histories, and traditions. You can cast hypercognition once per day as a 3rd-rank occult innate spell. You can use your modifier for the Lore skill you chose for Historian in place of any other skill modifier when attempting a @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.actions.Item.1OagaWtBpVXExToo]{Recall Knowledge} check while casting @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.spells.Item.ZYoC630tNGutgbE0]{Hypercognition}.
History Buff.name: History Buff

Hobnobber.description: You are skilled at learning information through conversation. The @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.actions.Item.plBGdZhqq5JBl1D8]{Gather Information} exploration activity takes you half as long as normal (typically reducing the time to 1 hour). If you're a master in Diplomacy and roll a critical failure to Gather Information, you get a failure instead. There is still no guarantee that a rumor you learn with Gather Information is accurate.
Hobnobber.name: Hobnobber

Hold Hands.description:
Requirements You are adjacent to an ally.

You learned that supporting members of your pair or pod also makes you stronger. You join hands with an adjacent willing ally, which occupies one of each of your hands. For 1 round, while you remain adjacent to that ally and holding hands, you gain a +1 circumstance bonus to AC. Additionally, you and your ally gain a +2 circumstance bonus to your saving throws against attempts to [[/act demoralize]], [[/act reposition]], [[/act shove]], or [[/act trip]] either of you.

@UUID[Compendium.sf2e.feat-effects.Item.jJX6rYoKEW0neDu6]{Effect: Hold Hands}
Hold Hands.name: Hold Hands

Hold the Line.description:
Frequency once per day

As part of your daily preparations, you make a motivating speech to 10 or fewer allies. Your allies must be able to perceive you during this time, but this doesn't otherwise impede their own preparation. When one of these allies is reduced to 0 Hit Points and isn't immediately killed, you can call out to them to ignite their sense of duty. The creature avoids being knocked out and remains at 1 Hit Point, and its @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.Yl48xTdMh3aeQYL2]{Wounded} condition increases by 1. Additionally, it gains a +5 foot status bonus to its Speed until the end of its next turn and a +1 status bonus to its first attack before the end of its next turn.

@UUID[Compendium.sf2e.feat-effects.Item.rb5747jApJjOApkA]{Effect: Hold the Line}
Hold the Line.name: Hold the Line

Hold the Link.description:
When you're psychically harmed, it causes pain you won't soon forget, but you've learned to grab hold of that pain and share it with your psychic attacker, to teach them what it feels like. When you use the Shared Link reaction, after you resolve its effects, the targeted creature takes a –1 status penalty to saves against mental effects and has a weakness to mental effects equal to half your level until the end of your next turn.

Special If the target has resistance (but not immunity) to mental damage, it instead loses its resistance for the duration.

@UUID[Compendium.sf2e.feat-effects.Item.WV7zGeEKrGlL7XlH]{Effect: Hold the Link}
Hold the Link.name: Hold the Link

Hologram Skeptic.description: You easily spot the tiny glitches and imperfections in holograms. Even if you aren't Searching, you always attempt a check to disbelieve holograms and effects with the illusion and tech traits that normally require you to @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.actions.Item.TiNDYUGlMmxzxBYU]{Search} or Interact with them.
Hologram Skeptic.name: Hologram Skeptic

Home Turf.description:
Whether it's your apartment, laboratory, or starship, your senses are particularly keen in the place you call home.

Select one familiar location to be your home turf. While in your home turf, you gain a +1 circumstance bonus to Stealth, Survival, and Perception checks and DCs.

You lose this bonus for 24 hours if there are any major alterations to your home turf, including temporary or illusory changes to the environment from the use of spells and effects that cause difficult terrain, temporary structures, and many witchwarper abilities. You don't lose your bonus due to changes in light level, gravity, or temperature (unless those changes cause significant alterations to the environment, such as starting a fire).
Home Turf.name: Home Turf

Homebrewed Core.description:
You were originally designed or built by an independent foundry, without some of the restrictions and safety mechanisms that would be in place for most other xenometric android production facilities. Choose one of the following.

  • You're one size larger than your ancestry, up to Large. You gain a +1 circumstance bonus to Intimidation checks to [[/act demoralize]]. Add the @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.feats.Item.wxDASXmKkVwvpwau]{Stretching Reach} standardized ancestry feat to your available standardized ancestry feats.
  • You're one size smaller than your ancestry but no smaller than Small. You gain a +1 circumstance bonus to Stealth checks to [[/act hide]] and [[/act sneak]]. Add the @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.feats.LK6niBb38mEraYRS] standardized ancestry feat to your available standardized ancestry feats.
  • You have an additional pair of limbs but can only have one pair active at a time. You can change which of your limbs are active with the @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.actions.Item.oW81CfM9ebxXnrw3]{Switch Hands} action. Add the @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.feats.Item.EPeo604ByeeAx3AL]{All Hands on Deck} and @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.feats.Item.61txGmMLr22B93cU]{Double Draw} standardized ancestry feats to your available standardized ancestry feats.
Homebrewed Core.name: Homebrewed Core

Homegrown Skills.description: By avoiding relying on superfluous augmentations, you have sharpened your senses and your skills. During daily preparations, when choosing a skill for @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.feats.Item.W6Gl9ePmItfDHji0]{Assurance}, you can also choose an additional skill feat that you qualify for in that same skill.
Homegrown Skills.name: Homegrown Skills

Homeguard.description: Your Homeguard training has prepared you for anything. You gain a +2 circumstance bonus to initiative rolls, and when you tie an adversary's initiative roll, you always go first.
Homeguard.name: Homeguard

Homing Mote.description: You've come to rely on ranged motes as much as you do your solar weapon. Triple the range increment of your solar flare. When you make a solar flare Strike against a target within your first range increment, you ignore the target's concealment and cover.
Homing Mote.name: Homing Mote

Horn-Cone Mastery.description: Your horn-cones have grown far more sensitive, as you've finally achieved some semblance of your ancestors' ability to hunt through psychic mastery alone and can track the locations of thinking creatures with incredible accuracy. Your thoughtsense becomes a precise sense.
Horn-Cone Mastery.name: Horn-Cone Mastery

Horns of the Hunter.description: Though your psychic abilities still pale in comparison to your ancient worlanisi kin, you've honed the sensitivity of your horn-cones so that you can better triangulate your prey based on stray thoughts hanging in the environment around you. The range of your imprecise thoughtsense increases to 30 feet, and you gain a +2 circumstance bonus to [[/act track rollOption="horns-of-the-hunter"]] thinking creatures that aren't otherwise immune to mental effects.
Horns of the Hunter.name: Horns of the Hunter

Host's Final Gift.description:
Frequency once per day

Trigger You're reduced to 0 Hit Points and would gain the @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.yZRUzMqrMmfLu0V1]{Dying} condition or would otherwise die.

Requirements You have a willing host.

In a final act of bravery and gratitude, your host has decided that preserving your gift of intelligence is more important than preserving itself. Your host prevents you from dying and takes the brunt of whatever force would cause you to die, allowing your body to absorb its rapidly decaying form and regain Hit Points equal to @Damage[(6d8 + floor(@actor.level))[healing]]{6d8 plus half your level}. If the cause of your death was a condition or effect that would still cause you to die after regaining Hit Points, such as a high value on the doomed condition, you lose the condition or effect as the host creature dies in your stead. You lose the benefits of your heritage and any ancestry feats that require your heritage or having a host until you can find and merge with another host.
Host's Final Gift.name: Host's Final Gift

Hostile Gravity.description:
Frequency once per day

You extend your innate ability to alter your personal gravity to harm another creature within 120 feet, the intense pressure buckling their bones. You deal @Damage[10d8[bludgeoning]] damage to the creature with a @Check[type:fortitude|against:class-spell|basic] save against the higher of your class DC or spell DC. On a failure, the creature also becomes @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.enA7BxAjBb7ns1iF]{Suppressed} and @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.xYTAsEpcJE1Ccni3]{Slowed 1} until the beginning of your next turn.
Hostile Gravity.name: Hostile Gravity

Hot Ride.description: One gobbo's junk heap is your own hot ride. You learn the formula for four tech vehicles of your level or lower. Vehicles you @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.actions.Item.rmwa3OyhTZ2i2AHl]{Craft} gain a @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.actions.Item.bWD4NpW0NB8aDwZF]{Pickle Switch}.
Hot Ride.name: Hot Ride

Howl of the Deep.description:
Frequency once per 10 minutes

You've embraced your aberrant nature to a terrifying degree. You rise up to your full height, drawing the howling winds through your ear canals and your mouth, and create a terrifying cacophony with a matching display. You attempt to [[/act demoralize]] all creatures within 20 feet; you don't take a penalty when you attempt to Demoralize a creature that doesn't understand your language. You can use Performance in place of Intimidation when you use Howl of the Deep.

[[/act demoralize skill=performance]]
Howl of the Deep.name: Howl of the Deep

Hug Master.description: A good, solid hug makes everything better, and you're bringing hugs to the battlefield. You gain the @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.feats.Item.KxaYlC50zzHysJj8]{Titan Wrestler} skill feat. Additionally, you gain a +1 circumstance bonus to Athletics checks to @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.actions.Item.PMbdMWc2QroouFGD]{Grapple} and to your Fortitude DC to avoid being Grappled.
Hug Master.name: Hug Master

Hulking Corpsefolk.description: You're a mountain of flesh, having managed to increase your girth in irreversible ways. Perhaps you absorbed enough physical material to do so, or maybe you've completed mysterious, inexplicable necromantic rituals. Increase your size category to Large, and increase your reach by 5 feet.
Hulking Corpsefolk.name: Hulking Corpsefolk

Hull Hop.description: A starship hull can be a dangerous place. When the need arises, you can use your internal hydraulics to launch yourself to safety. You gain a fly Speed equal to your land Speed for 10 minutes.
Hull Hop.name: Hull Hop

Hunker Down.description:
Trigger You would be hit by a ranged attack.

When the shooting starts, everyone envies the one with the armored shell on their back. You @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.actions.Item.HYNhdaPtF1QmQbR3]{Drop Prone}, hiding beneath the thickest parts of your exoskeleton to avoid some of the damage. You gain resistance to physical damage equal to half your level (minimum 1) while you're @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.j91X7x0XSomq8d60]{Prone} this way.
Hunker Down.name: Hunker Down

Hunter's Leap.description: The key to a good jump isn't speed, and it isn't technique. It's a powerful set of legs, and you've got some of the strongest. You gain the @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.feats.Item.HJYQlmGTdtyGWr6a]{Powerful Leap} skill feat, even if you don't meet the prerequisites. You treat all falls as if they were 10 feet less than the actual distance traveled, or 40 feet less if you're falling immediately after you Leap.
Hunter's Leap.name: Hunter's Leap

Hurl Ally.description:
Requirements You are adjacent to an ally or your ally is riding you and you have one or more hands free.

You use your innate strength to hurl an ally across the battlefield. Pick up an adjacent ally of your size or smaller and throw them to an unoccupied space you can see within 20 feet, or within 40 feet if you throw your bonded partner. Their movement doesn't trigger reactions. Your ally ends this movement on their feet and treats the fall as 20 feet lower, or 40 feet lower if you throw your bonded partner.
Hurl Ally.name: Hurl Ally

Hurry.description: You urge an ally to pick up the pace and contribute more to the events happening around them. One ally within 30 feet who can sense you becomes @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.nlCjDvLMf2EkV2dl]{Quickened} for 1 round. They can use the extra action to Interact, Step, or Stride. The target is then temporarily immune to Hurry for the next 10 minutes.
Hurry.name: Hurry

Hush.description:
Frequency once per day

You fall utterly silent and focus strenuously on a problem at hand. You attempt to @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.actions.Item.1OagaWtBpVXExToo]{Recall Knowledge} with a +2 circumstance bonus to the skill check. If you would get a critical failure, you get a failure instead, and if you would get a success, you get a critical success instead.
Hush.name: Hush

Hybrid Technique.description:
Requirements You're wielding an area or automatic weapon.

You can combine methods into a deadly new hybrid technique. Choose two soldier feats that take 2 actions to use, require you to wield an area or automatic weapon, and cause you to make an Area Fire or Auto-Fire attack as part of its effects. You Area Fire or Auto-Fire once and then apply the additional effects and benefits of both selected feats to the attack.
Hybrid Technique.name: Hybrid Technique

Hyper.description: You're full of energy, and you often bound into action faster than your friends can keep up. Your Speed increases by 5 feet.
Hyper.name: Hyper

Hyperfixated Researcher.description: You're notorious for your discipline to the point that you can leverage your fame to ask favors of fans and colleagues. You can use the Lore skill that you gain from @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.feats.Item.dvNOrgjzXgwvaRjQ]{Voracious Reader} to @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.actions.Item.plBGdZhqq5JBl1D8]{Gather Information}. You gain a +2 circumstance bonus to Diplomacy checks to [[/act make-an-impression]] on people interested in your chosen discipline. If you're legendary in the Lore skill, this circumstance bonus increases to +4.
Hyperfixated Researcher.name: Hyperfixated Researcher

Hypertelepathy.description: Your connection to a hive mind gives you even greater telepathic potential than most other telepathic species can even dream of. Increase the range of your limited telepathy to 200 feet. Once per day, when you @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.actions.Item.1OagaWtBpVXExToo]{Recall Knowledge}, you can use the skill modifier of a willing ally within range of your telepathy instead of your own.
Hypertelepathy.name: Hypertelepathy

Hypnotic Melody.description:
Frequency once per 10 minutes

You command the attention of those who can hear you with a truly haunting song. Attempt a Performance check and compare it to the Will DC of each creature in a @Template[type:emanation|distance:15]. Regardless of the result, each creature then becomes immune to your Hypnotic Melody for 24 hours.

Critical Success The target is @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.HL2l2VRSaQHu9lUw]{Fatigued} and @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.AdPVz7rbaVSRxHFg]{Fascinated} with you for 1 round as your song seems to lull them to sleep.

Success The target is fatigued for 1 round.

Failure The target is unaffected.
Hypnotic Melody.name: Hypnotic Melody

I Can Do Better.description:
Frequency once per hour

Trigger You fail or critically fail a saving throw or skill check at the same time that an ally within 30 feet succeeds or critically succeeds at the same save or check.

You, like many atraxids, are highly competitive, and you can't stand to see one of your friends succeeding while you are failing. Reroll the triggering check, but you must use the new result, even if it's worse.
I Can Do Better.name: I Can Do Better

I Can't Tell If You're Flirting.description: Sometimes, the subtlety of sarcasm and innuendo is lost on you. You respond better to direct communication. You gain a +1 circumstance bonus to saves against mental effects. If you roll a success on a saving throw against a mental effect, you get a critical success instead. If you roll a failure to [[/act coerce]] or Influence a creature, you get a critical failure instead.
I Can't Tell If You're Flirting.name: I Can't Tell If You're Flirting

I'll Be Back.description:
Frequency once per day

Trigger You regain consciousness after being @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.fBnFDH2MTzgFijKf]{Unconscious}.

Even when you're downed, you get right back into the thick of things once recovered. You Stand and Interact to draw a weapon or grab an unattended weapon.
I'll Be Back.name: I'll Be Back

I'm No Rat.description: You can tell especially convincing lies when it comes to protecting others. When you [[/act lie]] to authority figures to protect someone else, you can roll twice and use the better result. If your Lie is found out, you can't use this effect on that authority figure again until you've regained their trust (usually by improving their attitude toward you).
I'm No Rat.name: I'm No Rat

I'm the Real One!.description:
Trigger You become @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.kWc1fhmv9LBiTuei]{Grabbed} or @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.VcDeM8A5oI6VqhbM]{Restrained} by another creature or you grab or restrain another creature.

Requirements You can use Change Shape to assume the appearance of that creature.

You Change Shape to assume the appearance of the other creature. All other creatures must use the @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.actions.Item.BlAOM2X92SI6HMtJ]{Seek} action to attempt a Perception check against your Deception DC to determine which creature is real and which is an imitation. A creature who doesn't know which creature you are must succeed at a @Check[flat|dc:11] when targeting either of you with an attack, spell, or other effect. If the check fails, the attack, spell, or effect targets the other creature instead.

Abilities such as telepathy or the mystic's group chat feature may automatically allow a creature to determine which creature is which, but an aware creature must still use the @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.actions.Item.sn2hIy1iIJX9Vpgj]{Point Out} action to indicate to others which creature is which. An imitated creature might have a signal or phrase that indicates to their allies which creature is which, but doing so in the din of battle is an action with the auditory or visual trait.
I'm the Real One!.name: I'm the Real One!

Icy Spelunker.description: You spent time exploring the icy caves of Kalo-Mahoi's crust, and climbing comes nearly as easily to you as walking. You gain a Climb speed of 25 feet, and you treat difficult terrain from ice and snow as normal terrain.
Icy Spelunker.name: Icy Spelunker

Ignore Radiation.description: Exposure to low levels of cosmic radiation over a long period of time has made your cells more resilient. You gain a +1 circumstance bonus to Fortitude saving throws against poison; this bonus increases to +2 against radiation.
Ignore Radiation.name: Ignore Radiation

Ikeshti Lore.description: Life on Akiton is hard, but thanks to your brood-minder, you learned the skills necessary to thrive. You become trained in Crafting and Survival. If you would automatically become trained in one of those skills (from your background or class, for example), you instead become trained in a skill of your choice. You also gain the @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.feats.Item.BocFD2KV0qgUC76x]{Additional Lore} general feat for Ikeshti Lore.
Ikeshti Lore.name: Ikeshti Lore

Immediate Relaxation.description:
Trigger A foe hits you with a melee weapon or unarmed attack that deals physical damage.

You relax yourself the instant you are hit to minimize the damage it deals to your body. You fall @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.j91X7x0XSomq8d60]{Prone} and are @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.dfCMdR4wnpbYNTix]{Stunned 1}. Attempt a @Check[flat|dc:6]. On a success, you take minimum damage from the attack, and on a critical success, if the attack was a critical hit, you don't take double damage.
Immediate Relaxation.name: Immediate Relaxation

Immense Gravity.description: You exude a much stronger gravitational field than most novians, enabling you to exert your personal gravity upon your surroundings from a farther distance. Your reach increases to 10 feet. In addition, you double the range of all the following novian feats you possess: @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.feats.Item.YqAY8XtOL9u6pyiw]{Gravity Grasp} and @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.feats.Item.2en3arTothKuIOB9]{Gravity Swipe}.
Immense Gravity.name: Immense Gravity

Impeccable Crafting.description: You craft flawless creations with great efficiency. Whenever you roll a success at a Crafting check to make an item of the type you chose with @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.feats.Item.QLeMH5mQgh28sa5o]{Specialty Crafting}, you get a critical success instead.
Impeccable Crafting.name: Impeccable Crafting

Impeding Shot.description:
Requirements You're wielding a gun.

You hinder your target with a shot. You @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.actions.Item.sLikawnrJJzHMYeC]{Aim} and then make a ranged Strike against your mark. If the Strike hits, the target is @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.xYTAsEpcJE1Ccni3]{Slowed 1} until the end of its next turn. If the target is flying, it also falls 10 feet.
Impeding Shot.name: Impeding Shot

Impenetrable Mind.description: You resist mental control with supernatural skill. You become immune to the @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.yblD8fOR1J8rDwEQ]{Confused} and @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.9qGBRpbX9NEwtAAr]{Controlled} conditions. Whenever you gain the @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.e1XGnhKNSQIm5IXg]{Stupefied} condition, you immediately reduce the value of the condition by 1. This feat doesn't apply if you impose the condition on yourself.
Impenetrable Mind.name: Impenetrable Mind

Imperious Nature.description:
Your legendary abilities set you apart from the rest of humanity, and you can project an air of majesty that inspires compliance in those around you.

Once per day, you can cast @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.spells.Item.aIHY2DArKFweIrpf]{Command} as a 7th-rank occult innate spell using the higher of your class DC or spell DC (@Check[will|against:class-spell|traits:auditory,concentrate,manipulate,mental,occult|options:spell]). Because you're projecting your presence more so than words, this effect loses the linguistic trait.
Imperious Nature.name: Imperious Nature

Implacable Grappler.description: You combine your impressive stature and additional limbs to become a fierce wrestler. You gain the @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.feats.Item.KxaYlC50zzHysJj8]{Titan Wrestler} skill feat and a +1 circumstance bonus to your Fortitude DC against @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.actions.Item.PMbdMWc2QroouFGD]{Grapple} or @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.bestiary-ability-glossary-srd.Item.Tkd8sH4pwFIPzqTr]{Grab} attempts.
Implacable Grappler.name: Implacable Grappler

Impressive Lungs.description: You have excellent lung capacity. You gain the @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.feats.Item.aJUXbe9HJVvv0Mxa]{Breath Control} general feat. You do not need to breathe for up to 10 minutes after leaving a vacuum.
Impressive Lungs.name: Impressive Lungs

Impressive Performance.description: Your performances inspire admiration and win you fans. You can [[/act make-an-impression skill=performance]] using Performance instead of Diplomacy. If you spend at least 10 minutes performing in front of an audience, you can Make an Impression targeting up to 10 members of the audience who were there for the whole performance, without taking the normal penalty. The number of targets increases to 20 for a 1-hour performance and 50 for a 2-hour performance.
Impressive Performance.name: Impressive Performance

Impressive Storage.description: Your ability to compress and store objects within your own body is unparalleled. The amount of material you can store in the extradimensional space within your body increases to 50 Bulk.
Impressive Storage.name: Impressive Storage

Improv Workshop.description: Your stage experience has taught you how to improvise in just about any situation, and you know how to share your insight with others. You gain the @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.feats.Item.9jGaBxLUtevZYcZO]{Untrained Improvisation} general feat. In addition, you gain the @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.actions.Item.QQSO7DzeNKCWf9XW]{Once More with Feeling} action.
Improv Workshop.name: Improv Workshop

Improved Conductivity.description: By imitating your ancestors' diet, taking synthetic supplements, or unlocking your genetic potential with magic, you've enhanced your bioelectrical network. All your Strikes or spells with the attack trait that deal electricity damage gain the arc trait. If you're wielding an active forcefield, it regenerates twice its normal HP for 1 round after you hit an enemy with an arc attack.
Improved Conductivity.name: Improved Conductivity

Improved Elebrian Magic.description:
Choose one 3rd-rank or lower arcane spell. You can cast that spell as a 3rd-rank arcane innate spell once per day. If this is your 13th-level ancestry feat, instead choose a 5th-rank or lower arcane spell, and you can cast it as a 5th-rank arcane innate spell once per day. If this is your 17th-level ancestry feat, instead choose a 7th-rank or lower arcane spell, and you can cast it as a 7th-rank arcane innate spell once per day.

Special You can select this feat more than once. If you do, you must select a different spell.
Improved Elebrian Magic.name: Improved Elebrian Magic

Improved Seismic Sensitivity.description: Like the ancient kucharn, you've honed your underground senses to detect faraway threats. Increase the range of your tremorsense to 120 feet.
Improved Seismic Sensitivity.name: Improved Seismic Sensitivity

Improved Storage.description: Your body is a literal black hole, capable of absorbing and compressing material within yourself. The amount of material you can store in the extradimensional space within your body increases to 2 Bulk.
Improved Storage.name: Improved Storage

Improved Undead Senses.description: Your ability to sense living and undead energies improves, and you learn how to differentiate between entities you can sense in an area. Your lifesense becomes a precise sense with a range of 60 feet.
Improved Undead Senses.name: Improved Undead Senses

Improvised Construction.description: Though your surroundings might have changed, you're adept at bending them to your purposes: you grab whatever is close at hand and build your own tools, shelters, and in this case, protection. Where others might struggle to find cover from enemy fire, you can piece together safety from the most meager supplies. You gain the @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.feats.Item.9S5mBcJujWOYCE6j]{Barricade} general feat. If you construct a barricade in a natural environment, it falls apart after two turns instead of at the end of your next turn.
Improvised Construction.name: Improvised Construction

Improvised Legend.description: You can use @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.actions.Item.WFFYDg0sgjaXCeq6]{Improvised Mastery} once per hour, rather than twice per day.
Improvised Legend.name: Improvised Legend

In Another Life.description: Whenever you rest, you behold different versions of yourself in other realities. During your daily preparations, select one ancestry feat for your ancestry that you meet the prerequisites for and don't already have. You gain that feat until your next daily preparations.
In Another Life.name: In Another Life

In Hylax's Name.description: You've studied under some of the foremost Hylaxian scholars in the galaxy deep in the Forever Halls, or another center of worship, to gain a greater understanding of the Forever Queen's teachings. You carry the evidence of those studies with you in the form of a religious symbol, relic of your faith, or other meaningful memento. You become trained in Religion. If you would automatically become trained in Religion (from your background or class, for example), you instead become trained in another skill of your choice. You gain the @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.feats.Item.x7EMZNMavris2aHY]{Student of the Canon} feat.
In Hylax's Name.name: In Hylax's Name

In the Face of Danger.description: Your exemplary courage and mental fortitude carry you through the most daunting of situations. When you roll a success on a saving throw against a fear effect, you get a critical success instead. In addition, you gain a +1 circumstance bonus to Will saves against fear effects and a +2 circumstance bonus to your Will DC against attempts to [[/act demoralize]] you.
In the Face of Danger.name: In the Face of Danger

Incredible Ferocity.description: You are an implacable foe whose ability to escape death is nearly unrivaled. You can use @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.feats.Item.gD7l0iYrsdKMCmyV]{Shobhad Ferocity} once per hour, rather than once per day.
Incredible Ferocity.name: Incredible Ferocity

Incredible Improvisation.description:
Frequency once per day

Trigger You attempt a check using a skill you're untrained in.

A stroke of brilliance gives you a major advantage with a skill despite your inexperience. Gain a +4 circumstance bonus to the triggering skill check.
Incredible Improvisation.name: Incredible Improvisation

Incredible Initiative.description: You react more quickly than others can. You gain a +2 circumstance bonus to initiative rolls.
Incredible Initiative.name: Incredible Initiative

Incredible Tenacity.description: As you've progressed through life, you've taken your role as a stalwart worker to heart, and your bloodline surges to support you in your duties. You can use @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.actions.Item.NAqdTW3tC0eqGiIq]{Madrosarai Tenacity} with a frequency of once per hour, rather than once per day.
Incredible Tenacity.name: Incredible Tenacity

Indecisive Youth.description: It might have taken you a bit longer to find your niche than most of your ilk. After a couple extra internships and some trial and error, you're a bit of a mecenaic-of-all-trades. You gain the trained proficiency rank in two skills of your choice.
Indecisive Youth.name: Indecisive Youth

Independent LFAN.description:
Frequency once per day

You have a rudimentary artificial intelligence in your LFAN that you can activate to accelerate your LFAN-based activities. You become @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.nlCjDvLMf2EkV2dl]{Quickened} for 1 minute. You can spend this extra action only to Strike with a weapon held in your LFAN, Interact with an object with your LFAN, or perform an action with the LFAN trait.

Special if you have the @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.feats.Item.HMrxQvSTPSbaUmUd]{Brawler LFAN} feat, you can spend this extra action to [[/act disarm]], [[/act grapple]], [[/act reposition]], [[/act shove]], or [[/act trip]].
Independent LFAN.name: Independent LFAN

Independent Minds.description: You've learned how to keep mental effects limited to one head first hit, rather than letting them cloud both your minds. Each round you're affected by a mental effect, you can attempt a @Check[flat|dc:10]. On a success, one of your heads is clearminded enough to ignore the mental effect for that round, allowing you to act normally.
Independent Minds.name: Independent Minds

Inexorable.description: The plant or fungus your body is based upon has a penchant for becoming a multi-planetary invasive species. When you're not on your home world, you gain a +1 circumstance bonus to saving throws against diseases and poisons. When you succeed at a saving throw against an affliction that's benefiting from this bonus, you improve your condition by 2 stages (or by 1 stage if the affliction is virulent).
Inexorable.name: Inexorable

Infernal Armaments.description:
Frequency once per 10 minutes

You infuse your weapons with the might of Hell. For the next minute, on your first weapon Strike each round, you gain a status bonus to damage equal to twice the number of weapon damage dice; this extra damage is determined by your chosen Hellknight order.
Infernal Armaments.name: Infernal Armaments

Infernal Bulwark.description: Armor you wear gains the bulwark trait. You become trained in heavy armor, or become an expert in heavy armor if you were already trained. Your Hellknight regalia grants you resistance equal to half your level when you wear it, determined by your chosen Hellknight order.
Infernal Bulwark.name: Infernal Bulwark

Infinite Aim.description: You're a sharpshooter who doesn't need a scope or stance to shoot your best shot. You can @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.actions.Item.sLikawnrJJzHMYeC]{Aim} as a free action.
Infinite Aim.name: Infinite Aim

Infinite Ammo Trick.description:
Frequency once every 2 rounds

You forget how many shots you've taken, and for a second, so does reality. Make a Strike with a weapon you're wielding. This Strike doesn't use any ammo or battery usage. You don't apply any benefits from special ammunition to this Strike.
Infinite Ammo Trick.name: Infinite Ammo Trick

Infinite Magic.description: You borrow spells from other realities. Twice per day, you can cast a 9th-rank or lower spell after you've run out of spell slots of the appropriate spell rank; the two spells you cast with this feat must be of different spell ranks.
Infinite Magic.name: Infinite Magic

Influence.description:
Frequency once per day

Trigger You're about to roll a Deception, Diplomacy, or Intimidation check, but you haven't rolled yet.

With masterful timing and a careful choice of words, you can manipulate the emotions and thoughts of others. You roll the triggering Deception, Diplomacy, or Intimidation check twice, and use the higher result.
Influence.name: Influence

Infodump.description:
You muster myriad minutiae that you subsequently use to overwhelm a creature's mind with pointless trivia. Attempt a check to Recall Knowledge against the Will DC of a creature you're aware of within 60 feet; you can use any skill for which you can Recall Knowledge, not just a skill associated with the target's traits. Rather than remembering useful information, you recite facts at the target. Regardless of your result, the creatures within 60 feet become temporarily immune to your attempts to Infodump with that skill for 24 hours.

Critical Success The target is @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.e1XGnhKNSQIm5IXg]{Stupefied 2} for [[/gmr 1d4 #rounds]]{1d4 rounds}.

Success The target is @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.e1XGnhKNSQIm5IXg]{Stupefied 1} for [[/gmr 1d4 #rounds]]{1d4 rounds}.

Failure The target is unaffected.

Critical Failure You trip over your own thoughts, becoming stupefied 1 until the beginning of your next turn.

Special You can Infodump using speech or limited telepathy. If you Infodump through speech, this ability gains the auditory trait.
Infodump.name: Infodump

Infused Spell.description: You infuse your magic with vital energy that empowers the target of your spell. Pick a spell and reduce your vitality network's total by a number equal to twice the spell's rank. If your next action is to cast that spell, one bonded ally you target with that spell becomes @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.nlCjDvLMf2EkV2dl]{Quickened} until the end of your next turn and can use the extra action for only Strike and Stride actions.
Infused Spell.name: Infused Spell

Inheritor of Star's Glory.description:
Frequency once per day

You are the prime inheritor of your progenitor star's power and can don this star's lost legacy as a crown, growing in size and power, resplendent in glory. You become Small (or Medium, if you're a massive novian). Your equipment grows with you but returns to normal size if removed. You gain a +2 status bonus to melee damage and Intimidation checks, and the area of your solar luminance (and @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.actions.Item.JdLNIaTM4eyI9Luo]{Absorb Light}, if you're a black hole novian) is doubled. This transformation lasts for 1 minute. You can end this glorious transformation early as a single action, which has the concentrate trait.
Inheritor of Star's Glory.name: Inheritor of Star's Glory

Inner Ear Temblor.description: Nothing escapes your ears so long as they move even an inch. You gain tremorsense as a vague sense with a range of 30 feet. This means you can use your ears to determine if a creature is present, but you can't pinpoint their location. Creatures that haven't moved or don't make sounds (such as those under the effects of a silence spell) remain undetected to you.
Inner Ear Temblor.name: Inner Ear Temblor

Inner Peace.description: You never lose your cool. When you become @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{Frightened} or @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.e1XGnhKNSQIm5IXg]{Stupefied}, you immediately reduce the value of the condition by 1. When you would gain the @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.yblD8fOR1J8rDwEQ]{Confused} or @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.9qGBRpbX9NEwtAAr]{Controlled} condition, you can attempt a @Check[flat|dc:16]. On a success, you don't get the confused or controlled condition.
Inner Peace.name: Inner Peace

Inner Wellspring.description:
Frequency once per day

When you must endure times of extreme stress and pain, you dig deep and draw on the memories or stories of your lost ancestral home world of Golarion, tapping into inner reserves of power to pull off just one more miracle. You regain 1 Focus Point.
Inner Wellspring.name: Inner Wellspring

Insatiable Speedster.description: Even the natural limitations of your own biology won't get between you and your need for speed! You can use @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.feats.Item.ydQ7gfZubVug7xLK]{Need for Speed} once per hour, rather than once per day.
Insatiable Speedster.name: Insatiable Speedster

Insatiable Student.description: You're an insatiable student, determined to learn and experience everything you can, as quick as you can—even if the knowledge gained quickly gets buried under new information. During your daily preparations, you gain the @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.feats.Item.BocFD2KV0qgUC76x]{Additional Lore} feat with one Lore skill of your choice. This proficiency lasts until you prepare again. Since this proficiency is temporary, you can't use it as a prerequisite for a permanent character option, like a feat.
Insatiable Student.name: Insatiable Student

Inscrutable Countenance.description: Your face lacks most of the expressive features other creatures use to read nonverbal cues, and combined with your silence, this works to your advantage in social situations. You're trained in Deception (or another skill of your choice if you were already trained in Deception), and you gain a +1 circumstance bonus to Deception checks to Lie to non-plant creatures and to Deception DCs against [[/act sense-motive]] checks.
Inscrutable Countenance.name: Inscrutable Countenance

Instant Genetic Recall.description:
You can quickly access your genetic database of knowledge and experiences. Choose a skill you're expert in that has the @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.actions.Recall Knowledge] action. You gain the @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.feats.Item.W6Gl9ePmItfDHji0]{Assurance} and @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.feats.Item.H3I2X0f7v4EzwxuN]{Automatic Knowledge} skill feats for the chosen skill.

Special You can select this feat multiple times, choosing a different skill each time.

featPrerequisites.0: expert in a skill with the Recall Knowledge action

Instant Genetic Recall.name: Instant Genetic Recall

Instinctive Aim.description: You draw your gun and take careful aim with the same motion. You Interact to draw a ranged weapon or Switch Hands and then @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.actions.Item.sLikawnrJJzHMYeC]{Aim} with that ranged weapon.
Instinctive Aim.name: Instinctive Aim

Instinctive Collaborator.description: Cooperation is a fundamental value on Raxil, and you were raised to always look for opportunities to work collaboratively with others. You gain a +2 circumstance bonus to checks to Aid, and your allies gain a +2 circumstance bonus to checks to Aid you.
Instinctive Collaborator.name: Instinctive Collaborator

Instinctive Hold.description:
Trigger Your turn begins, and you're grabbing or restraining a creature within your reach.

Directed by the sensitive nerves entwined within each of your limbs, your tentacles reflexively cling onto whatever you're grappling, even if your attention is directed elsewhere. Attempt a @Check[flat|dc:16]. If you succeed, you can extend the duration of the grappled creature's @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.kWc1fhmv9LBiTuei]{Grabbed} or @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.VcDeM8A5oI6VqhbM]{Restrained} condition until the end of your next turn. If you have any special abilities or free actions that would normally be triggered when you [[/act grapple]] a creature, you can't use them as part of this action.
Instinctive Hold.name: Instinctive Hold

Instinctive Telepath.description: You've trained to telepathically communicate with anyone. The range of your limited telepathy increases to 100 feet. You can communicate with creatures that don't share your language with limited telepathy, and you permanently gain the effects of @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.spells.Item.SwUiVavHKMWG7t5K]{Truespeech}.
Instinctive Telepath.name: Instinctive Telepath

Intensified Psychic Shock.description:
You focus your telepathic attacks further, broadcasting your psychic power with greater range and area. Your psychic shock unarmed attack gains the boost (1d6) trait, requiring no battery to boost your attack. By spending 10 minutes in intense concentration, you can reconfigure your mind to apply one of the following benefits to your psychic shock. This benefit lasts until you reconfigure to another benefit.

  • Extended Shock: Increase the range increment of your psychic shock by 15 feet.
  • Mind Crusher: Your psychic shock gains the fatal d8 trait.
  • Peer Pressure: Your psychic shock gains the arc trait, but it deals mental damage rather than electricity damage.
  • Psychic Wave: Your psychic shock gains the splash trait.
Intensified Psychic Shock.name: Intensified Psychic Shock

Intensify Shell.description:
Frequency once per day

You channel your internal chemicals to enhance your shell, turning it into an additional layer of temporary protection. For 1 minute, you gain a +2 status bonus to AC and resistance 10 to physical damage, but you take a –10-foot status penalty to your Speeds.
Intensify Shell.name: Intensify Shell

Interdimensional Cheek Portal.description: You've made some dimensional adjustments to your cheek pouches for spacious storing, allowing you to defy the laws of physics. When you store items in your cheek pouches, they no longer significantly alter your speech. You can store up to 10 Bulk of items in your cheek pouches, and items stored in your cheek pouches can have a dimension longer than 1 foot, so long as they could still reasonably fit in your mouth. While stored in your extradimensional pouches, these items are virtually undiscoverable, and the DC to detect the items is equal to the higher of your class DC or spell DC + 10.
Interdimensional Cheek Portal.name: Interdimensional Cheek Portal

Internal Chemistry.description: You tweak your anatomy and bodily systems to metabolize pharmaceuticals more efficiently. Regain additional Hit Points equal to half your level when you restore Hit Points to yourself using a consumable item with the healing trait.
Internal Chemistry.name: Internal Chemistry

Internal Compartment.description:
You can hide a small object of up to light Bulk inside a hollow cavity on one of your forearms. It takes three @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.actions.Item.pvQ5rY2zrtPI614F]{Interact} actions to store an object in this way.

You gain a +4 circumstance bonus to the DCs of checks for others to @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.actions.Item.BlAOM2X92SI6HMtJ]{Seek} or @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.actions.Item.RDXXE7wMrSPCLv5k]{Steal} objects stored inside your arm.

If you store a weapon in your arm, you can use a single action to Interact to draw the weapon into the hand corresponding to your internal cavity, then Strike with the weapon.
Internal Compartment.name: Internal Compartment

Intestinal Fortitude.description:
Many humans like to experiment when it comes to sampling alien flavors, and you consider yourself a connoisseur. As a result of you treating the galaxy like a smorgasbord, you've developed a strong immune system.

You gain a +1 circumstance bonus to saving throws against diseases and poisons. You reduce the DC of flat checks to recover from persistent poison damage from 15 to 10.
Intestinal Fortitude.name: Intestinal Fortitude

Intimidating Athlete.description: Your physique is so impressive that your acts of strength astound your foes. When you succeed or critically succeed at an Athletics check to [[/act grapple]], [[/act reposition]], [[/act shove]], or [[/act trip]], you can, as a free action, attempt an Athletics or Intimidation check to [[/act demoralize]] one creature within 30 feet. You also gain the @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.feats.Item.xQMz6eDgX75WX2ce]{Intimidating Glare} skill feat, even if you don't meet the prerequisites.
Intimidating Athlete.name: Intimidating Athlete

Intimidating Glare.description: You can @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.actions.Item.2u915NdUyQan6uKF]{Demoralize} with a mere glare. When you do, Demoralize loses the auditory trait and gains the visual trait, and you don't take a penalty if the creature doesn't understand your language.
Intimidating Glare.name: Intimidating Glare

Intimidating Prowess.description: In situations where you can physically menace the target when you @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.actions.Item.tHCqgwjtQtzNqVvd]{Coerce} or @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.actions.Item.2u915NdUyQan6uKF]{Demoralize}, you gain a +1 circumstance bonus to your Intimidation check and you ignore the penalty for not sharing a language. If your Strength modifier is +5 or higher and you are a master in Intimidation, this bonus increases to +2.
Intimidating Prowess.name: Intimidating Prowess

Intimidating Roar.description: You can unleash the same primal pahtra war cries as your ancient ancestors. You gain the @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.feats.Item.ePObIpaJDgDb9CQj]{Battle Cry} skill feat. While your [[/act demoralize]] action still has the auditory trait, you don't take a penalty when you Demoralize a creature that doesn't speak your language. Additionally, you gain a +1 circumstance bonus to Demoralize animals.
Intimidating Roar.name: Intimidating Roar

Intimidating Shot.description: You attempt to @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.actions.Item.2u915NdUyQan6uKF]{Demoralize} a foe with your ranged weapon by firing it into the air, using ammo equal to the weapon's expend and the weapon's maximum range rather than the usual range of 30 feet. This check doesn't take a –4 circumstance penalty if the target doesn't share a language with you.
Intimidating Shot.name: Intimidating Shot

Intimidating Taunt.description:
You taunt your enemy mercilessly, forcing them to acknowledge you as an immediate threat. Attempt an @Check[intimidation|against:will] check and compare it to the Will DC of one enemy creature within 60 feet. This action has the auditory trait or visual trait, depending on how you taunt your enemy.

Critical Success Your taunts sting hard. Until the start of your next turn, any hostile actions that the creature takes must include you as a target or include you in the area; otherwise, the creature takes a –2 circumstance penalty to attack rolls and to its save DC for those hostile actions.

Success As critical success, but only the first hostile action that the creature takes is affected.

Failure The creature is unaffected.

@UUID[Compendium.sf2e.feat-effects.Item.B0ZDwyk4qOr7hp4e]{Effect: Intimidating Taunt}
Intimidating Taunt.name: Intimidating Taunt

Intuitive Talent.description:
Frequency once per hour

You enjoy embracing new experiences and have a knack for picking up new skills and talents, sometimes over the course of countless lifetimes, as your semi-dead nature grants you a wider perspective. Choose a skill that you're untrained in. Until the beginning of your next turn, you become trained in the chosen skill.
Intuitive Talent.name: Intuitive Talent

Inventor.description:
You are a genius at Crafting, easily able to determine how things are made and create new inventions. You can spend downtime to invent a common formula that you don't know. This works just like the Craft activity: you spend half the Price of the formula up front, attempt a Crafting check, and on a success either finish the formula by paying the difference or work for longer to decrease the Price. The difference is that you spend the additional time in research, design, and development, rather than in creating an item. Once it's complete, you add the new formula you invented to your formula book.

The GM might allow you to invent uncommon or rare formulas, typically with an increased DC. You need the @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.feats.Item.xWY5omyIcILNR7y1]{Magical Crafting} feat to invent hybrid and magical formula.
Inventor.name: Inventor

Invigorating Trinket.description:
Frequency once per day

One of your personal trinkets carries your memory of eager early mornings and the rush of energy to start a task. You grasp a personal trinket and allow it to invigorate you with a pleasant memory. You become @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.nlCjDvLMf2EkV2dl]{Quickened} for 1 minute and can use the extra action each round for only Strike and Stride actions.
Invigorating Trinket.name: Invigorating Trinket

Invoke the Leviathan.description:
Frequency once per day

A typical ijtikri's leviathan transformation is their last act in life, irreversibly swelling to immense size before seeding the sea with new life. You aren't typical; you can transform into a Gargantuan ijtikri leviathan battle form for 1 minute. You can Dismiss this effect. When the effect ends, the revitalizing gases from your leviathan body fill a @Template[type:emanation|distance:30], restoring @Damage[5d8[healing]|options:area-damage] Hit Points to living creatures in the area. You gain the following statistics and abilities.

  • AC = 22 + your level. Ignore your armor's check penalty and Speed reduction.
  • 10 temporary Hit Points.
  • Speed 10 feet, fly 40 feet, swim 60 feet
  • The following unarmed melee attacks. You're trained with this attack, and your attack modifier is +25. This attack is Strength based. If your unarmed attack modifier is higher, you can use it instead. Melee 1 tentacle (backswing, grapple, reach 30 feet), Damage 3d10+15 bludgeoning; Area Fire 2 wail (@Template[type:cone|distance:60]), Damage 3d10+15 sonic (basic Reflex save versus the higher of your class DC or spell DC)

  • Acrobatics modifier of +15 and Athletics modifier of +25, unless your own modifiers are higher.
Invoke the Leviathan.name: Invoke the Leviathan

Iomedae's Barrage.description:
Frequency once per day

You channel your spirit into a mighty barrage from a celestial plasma cannon. Iomedae's barrage Auto-Fires in a @Template[type:cone|distance:15] or a @Template[type:line|distance:30], dealing @Damage[(floor(@actor.level/2 - 1))d6[fire], (floor(@actor.level/2 - 1))d6[spirit]|traits:holy] damage with the holy trait (@Check[type:reflex|dc:resolve(@actor.attributes.classOrSpellDC.value)]). At 12th level and every 2 levels thereafter, the fire and spirit damage each increase by 1d6. A creature that gets a critical failure on this Reflex save is also @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.XgEqL1kFApUbl5Z2]{Blinded} for 1 round.
Iomedae's Barrage.name: Iomedae's Barrage

Iomedae's Helm.description: You touch an adjacent ally who is affected by a spell or other magical effect with the mental trait due to failing a Will save and has a duration of no longer than 1 minute. That ally can immediately attempt a Will save against the effect's DC, ending the condition on a success. This can't end the effect for any creatures other than your target ally. Regardless of the result of the save, your ally is temporarily immune to Iomedae's Helm for 10 minutes.
Iomedae's Helm.name: Iomedae's Helm

Iomedae's Shield.description:
You manifest your faith as a shield. Your armor and the armor of up to five allies you can see within 30 feet gains the benefits of an activated @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.equipment.Item.6ZW9IcSwd4WCFuf6]{Tactical Force Field} upgrade with 14 Hit Points that replenishes 2 Hit Points on your turn but does not protect from critical hits like a normal force field. The force field lasts for one minute. After receiving the benefits of Iomedae's Shield, you and your allies are immune to the effect for one hour.

At level 10, this becomes a @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.equipment.Item.2637b5l0hxitACkR]{Superior Force Field} with 26 HP and replenishes 5 Hit Points on your turn, and at level 16, this becomes an @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.equipment.Item.6hunzJ4gwfNT58vl]{Ultimate Force Field} with 37 HP and replenishes 7 Hit Points on your turn.
Iomedae's Shield.name: Iomedae's Shield

Iomedae's Sword.description: You've trained to fight the ancient enemies of lost Golarion. When you deal damage to a demon, devil, dragon, or undead with a weapon, you deal persistent spirit damage with the holy trait equal to the number of weapon damage dice. When you deal damage to one of these creatures with a spell cast from a spell slot that does not have a duration, you deal persistent spirit damage with the holy trait equal to the spell's rank.
Iomedae's Sword.name: Iomedae's Sword

Iron Guts.description: Nothing turns your stomach. When you succeed at a Fortitude save to retch, reduce your sickened value by 2 (or by 3 on a critical success). Any disease you contract with a level lower than your own loses the virulent trait.
Iron Guts.name: Iron Guts

It Has Pockets!.description: The pockets you've created in your fur have strengthened, and you love finding ways to hold more choices for your friends in them. You gain the @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.feats.Item.bh2jHyyYrkLMsIdX]{Prescient Planner} general feat. You can use Prescient Planner as a 2-action activity once per day, and you can procure ammunition and batteries in addition to the usual items available. These items must meet the usual level, Bulk, and other requirements, and you must still pay the Price of the chosen item.
It Has Pockets!.name: It Has Pockets!

It's Who You Know.description: You call on your extensive network for help with skulduggery. When you @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.actions.Item.plBGdZhqq5JBl1D8]{Gather Information} or @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.actions.Item.ftG89SjTSa9DYDOD]{Create a Forgery}, you do it in half the normal time.
It's Who You Know.name: It's Who You Know

Izalraan Gatherer's Lore.description: You have a deep understanding of plants, and you rarely make mistakes about them. You become trained in Life Science Lore and Nature. If you would automatically become trained in one of those skills (from your background or class, for example), you instead become trained in another skill of your choice. If you get a critical failure on a Life Science Lore or Nature check to @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.actions.Item.1OagaWtBpVXExToo]{Recall Knowledge} about plants, you get a failure instead.
Izalraan Gatherer's Lore.name: Izalraan Gatherer's Lore

Izalraan Hunter's Shot.description:
Frequency once per round

You use the shot of your weapon to help your allies hunt down prey. Strike a creature undetected by one or more of your allies, but not undetected to you. If you hit the target, you [[/act point-out]] the creature to your allies.
Izalraan Hunter's Shot.name: Izalraan Hunter's Shot

Izalraan Leader's Ingenuity.description: You're entrusted with keeping your society's advanced technology a secret. You can modify one item with the tech trait as a 1-hour activity. Once modified, a creature must use a [[/act seek]] action to attempt a Crafting or Perception check against your Crafting DC to recognize that the item has the tech trait. Otherwise, it appears as an item with the analog trait, even if they see it used. The disguised item must appear to be the same general type of item, such as disguising a fangblade as a greatsword or a hypopen as an herbal remedy. Some items might be too high-tech to disguise as an analog item and can be disguised as a magic item instead, but doing so allows other creatures to use Arcana, Nature, Occultism, or Religion to attempt to determine the item's true nature.
Izalraan Leader's Ingenuity.name: Izalraan Leader's Ingenuity

Jet.description:
Requirements You aren't encumbered.

Whether expelling air or water, your siphons enable quick bursts of speed. You @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.actions.Item.d5I6018Mci2SWokk]{Leap}, Stride, or Swim in a straight line, gaining a +10-foot status bonus to your Speeds during that movement. After you use Jet, you can't do so again for [[/r 1d4 #Recharge Jet]]{1d4 rounds}. You can't Jet in a vacuum and similar environments that lack air or fluid you can expel.
Jet.name: Jet

Jolted Alive.description:
Frequency once per hour

Trigger You take electricity damage.

What electrocutes other species, you instead consider an energizing snack. You gain a number of temporary Hit Points equal to half your level or your electricity resistance, whichever is greater. These temporary Hit Points last for 1 minute.
Jolted Alive.name: Jolted Alive

Jungle Adaptation.description:
You're part of a colony that builds inside massive trees rather than below the ground. You become trained in Nature and Survival. If you would automatically become trained in Nature or Survival (such as from your background or class, for example), you instead become trained in another skill of your choice. You gain a climb Speed of 5 feet.

Special If you take the @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.feats.Item.vwX3DQxsk04bTCBq]{Climbing Specialist} ancestry feat, you gain a climb Speed of 30 feet instead of 20 feet.
Jungle Adaptation.name: Jungle Adaptation

Junkyard Resistance.description:
You resist the most common hazards of your unsavory habitat. Choose one damage type: acid, piercing, or poison. You gain resistance equal to half your level to that damage type.

Special You can take this feat multiple times. Each time you do, select a different damage type.
Junkyard Resistance.name: Junkyard Resistance

Just Happy to Help!.description:
Helping your companions gives you a rush that no common drug could replicate. After you successfully @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.actions.Item.HCl3pzVefiv9ZKQW]{Aid} an ally, you gain a +1 circumstance bonus to skill checks using the same skill for 10 minutes.

@UUID[Compendium.sf2e.feat-effects.Item.3sB7LkiM8MPMugBm]{Effect: Just Happy to Help!}
Just Happy to Help!.name: Just Happy to Help!

Just Kidding.description:
Trigger An ally critically fails to @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.actions.Item.tHCqgwjtQtzNqVvd]{Coerce}, @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.actions.Item.OX4fy22hQgUHDr0q]{Make an Impression}, or Request.

You attempt to play off a social misstep as a joke. Attempt a Performance check against the same DC as your ally's check. If you succeed, your ally treats their critical failure as a failure.
Just Kidding.name: Just Kidding

Just Like Rehearsal.description: Life often imitates art, and you've learned to deploy your dramatic training in dangerous situations, whether it's using your talent for pratfalls to cushion a real drop or faking out an enemy with your improv antics. You gain the @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.feats.Item.Q6vXNDmTwDom59GV]{Feign Death} feat, ignoring the prerequisites. In addition, you can use Performance instead of Deception to [[/act create-a-diversion skill=performance]].
Just Like Rehearsal.name: Just Like Rehearsal

Just the Thing....description:
Cost the Price of the chosen item

You've traveled far and wide, bringing supplies and equipment from place to place and picking up interesting objects in your travels. In fact, you've got an interesting item right… here! You Interact to pull an item you hadn't previously declared that you purchased out of your pocket—this item must be any common item of half your level or less with a Bulk of 1 or less. It must be a piece of adventuring gear (from the table in Starfinder Player Core or other sources of adventuring gear) and can't be a weapon, armor, ammunition, magic item, pharmaceutical item, or other treasure.
Just the Thing....name: Just the Thing...

Kalo Lore.description:
Growing up among the blooms and glowing spires of Kalo-Mahoi has instilled in you a deep appreciation of the beauty around you, both natural and constructed. You're trained in Crafting and Nature.
