If you would automatically become trained in one of those skills (from your background or class, for example), you instead become trained in a skill of your choice.

You also gain the @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.feats.Item.BocFD2KV0qgUC76x]{Additional Lore} general feat for Kalo Lore.
Kalo Lore.name: Kalo Lore

Kasatha Lore.description:
You've studied the kasathan traditions of balance and harmony. You gain the trained proficiency rank in Diplomacy and Society. If you would automatically become trained in one of those skills (from your background or class, for example), you instead become trained in a skill of your choice.

You also gain the @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.feats.Item.BocFD2KV0qgUC76x]{Additional Lore} general feat for Kasatha Lore.
Kasatha Lore.name: Kasatha Lore

Kasatha Weapon Elegance.description:
You've learned how to adapt your martial expertise to wield other weapons. When wielding a weapon you aren't proficient with, treat your level as your proficiency bonus.

At 11th level, you become trained in all weapons.
Kasatha Weapon Elegance.name: Kasatha Weapon Elegance

Kasathan Weapon Familiarity.description:
You have a respect for melee combat, and you've trained to wield a few more elegant examples in battle. You gain access to all uncommon weapons with the kasatha trait. You have familiarity with weapons with the kasatha trait plus the dueling sword, plasma sword, shock truncheon, and singing spear—for the purposes of proficiency, you treat any of these that are martial weapons as simple weapons and any that are advanced weapons as martial weapons.

At 5th level, whenever you get a critical hit with one of these weapons, you get its critical specialization effect.
Kasathan Weapon Familiarity.name: Kasathan Weapon Familiarity

Keep Rolling.description: Nothing can stop a talphi who doesn't want to be stopped. If you Stride immediately before attempting to [[/act tumble-through]] an enemy's space, you gain a +2 circumstance bonus to the attempt. If you critically succeed, your enemy's space isn't considered difficult terrain.
Keep Rolling.name: Keep Rolling

Keep Them in Your Sights.description: You always keep a target marked and in your sights, even if they move. When you @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.actions.Item.sLikawnrJJzHMYeC]{Aim}, the benefits apply if your mark is within your weapon's first or second range increment, rather than only within the first.
Keep Them in Your Sights.name: Keep Them in Your Sights

Khizar Lore.description:
Whether in isolation or in communion with others of your kind, you've contemplated the nature of your ancestry for many years. You gain the trained proficiency rank in Nature and Survival. If you would automatically become trained in one of those skills (from your background or class, for example), you instead become trained in a skill of your choice.

You also gain the @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.feats.Item.BocFD2KV0qgUC76x]{Additional Lore} feat for Khizar Lore.
Khizar Lore.name: Khizar Lore

Kick it Into Overdrive.description:
Frequency once per hour

Trigger Your turn begins.

With a steadying breath and a moment of intense focus, you push yourself beyond your limits, gaining incredible speed for a short period of time. You become @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.nlCjDvLMf2EkV2dl]{Quickened} until the end of your turn, and you can use the extra action only to Stride. When you use this ability, you can instead choose to become quickened until the end of your next turn, but at the end of this duration, you become @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.HL2l2VRSaQHu9lUw]{Fatigued} for 2 rounds as your body recovers. You can still only use the extra action from quickened to Stride with this effect.
Kick it Into Overdrive.name: Kick it Into Overdrive

Kill Shot.description:
Requirements You're wielding a gun.

You take careful aim at your mark and shoot to kill. You @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.actions.Item.sLikawnrJJzHMYeC]{Aim} and then make a ranged Strike against your mark. If this attack is a success (but not a critical success), you deal maximum damage. Calculate this damage as if every die you would roll has a maximum result. On a critical success, roll the result normally, but if the double damage would be less than the result of a maximum damage on a normal success, use the maximum damage on the success instead.

If you spent 3 actions and your attack was a critical success, then you deal maximum damage and double the damage of that result as normal.
Kill Shot.name: Kill Shot

Kill Steal.description:
Trigger An ally ends their turn after hitting a creature two or more times or critically hitting a creature.

Requirements You're wielding a gun.

You fire a quick shot at a foe your ally is focusing their attacks on. You @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.actions.Item.sLikawnrJJzHMYeC]{Aim} at the creature your triggering ally hit and then make a ranged Strike against that creature.
Kill Steal.name: Kill Steal

Kindle Blaze.description:
Trigger You take fire damage.

Be they solar rays or blazing flames, light and heat are a part of you. For 1 minute, you glow from within, shedding bright light in a 30-foot radius (and dim light to the next 30 feet). While you glow in this way, your body is flush with warmth—you treat environmental cold effects as if they were one step less extreme (incredible cold becomes extreme, extreme cold becomes severe, and so on). You also gain a +1 circumstance bonus to saves against attacks, spells, and other effects that have the cold trait.
Kindle Blaze.name: Kindle Blaze

Kinesthetic Awareness.description: You have an exceedingly precise control over your body. When you succeed at a check to [[/act balance]], you get a critical success instead. If you roll a critical failure at a check to Balance, you get a failure instead.
Kinesthetic Awareness.name: Kinesthetic Awareness

Kip Up.description: You stand up. This movement doesn't trigger reactions.
Kip Up.name: Kip Up

Kiss it Better.description:
Requirements You have a hand free and are adjacent to an ally who isn't at full Hit Points.

You perform a token medical effort to convince an ally they've recovered from an injury. Attempt a Deception check with the same DC as for @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.actions.Item.1kGNdIIhuglAjIp9]{Treat Wounds}. On a success, the target gains temporary Hit Points equal to half the corresponding amount of Hit Points from Treat Wounds. These temporary Hit Points last 1 round. Kiss It Better doesn't remove the wounded condition. The target is temporarily immune to Kiss It Better for 24 hours.
Kiss it Better.name: Kiss it Better

Knight of Golarion Dedication.description:
You have familiarity with all weapons in the sword weapon group. For the purposes of proficiency, treat any of these that are martial weapons as simple weapons and any that are advanced weapons as martial weapons. If you are at least expert, you gain that weapon's critical specialization effect. You've studied lost Golarion's ancient cultures. You become trained in two of the following that you were not already trained in: Golarion Lore, Iomedae Lore, or a Lore skill associated with an ancestry or culture from Lost Golarion, such as Goblin, Halfling, Human, or Orc.

@UUID[Compendium.sf2e.journals.JournalEntry.vx5FGEG34AxI2dow.JournalEntryPage.F7Na3LjOknIosP83]{Knight of Golarion}
Knight of Golarion Dedication.name: Knight of Golarion Dedication

Know Your Audience.description: You always have an uncanny knack for understanding your audience. You gain a +2 circumstance bonus to Perception checks to [[/act sense-motive rollOption="know-your-audience"]] if your target's attitude toward you is indifferent or better.
Know Your Audience.name: Know Your Audience

Knowledge Bomb.description:
You spew information about a topic you're passionate about that no one asked for. Choose a creature within 30 feet of you that you're aware of. Attempt a Lore check against that target's Will DC. Regardless of your result, the creature is temporarily immune to your attempts to Knowledge Bomb it for 10 minutes.

Critical Success The creature becomes @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.e1XGnhKNSQIm5IXg]{Stupefied 2} for 1 round.

Success The creature becomes @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.e1XGnhKNSQIm5IXg]{Stupefied 1} for 1 round.
Knowledge Bomb.name: Knowledge Bomb

Knowledge Module.description: You can temporarily upload additional skills thanks to your semi-technological nature. During your daily preparations, you become trained in one skill of your choice. This proficiency lasts until you prepare again. Since this proficiency is temporary, you can't use it as a prerequisite for a skill increase or a permanent character option like a feat.
Knowledge Module.name: Knowledge Module

Korasha Self-Perfection.description: You have perfected what it means to be a korasha and embody lashunta values around physical strength and might. Increase your maximum Hit Points by your level. When you succeed at an attempt to [[/act shove]] or [[/act trip]], you critically succeed instead.
Korasha Self-Perfection.name: Korasha Self-Perfection

LFAN Modder.description: You're always tinkering with your LFAN, making sure that it's in good repair and experimenting with methods to grant it new functionality. You can retrain all feats with the LFAN trait as a part of your daily preparations. You can use the Implant Augmentation downtime activity even if you don't meet the prerequisites. If you're an expert in Crafting or Medicine, you can @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.actions.Item.Iy3IsWEfMLGiVAPv]{Implant Augmentation} in 10 minutes per item level of the augmentation. If you're a master in Crafting or Medicine, you can Implant Augmentation in 1 minute per item level.
LFAN Modder.name: LFAN Modder

Labyrinthine Mind.description: Your true feelings and thoughts are tucked away in the twisting corridors of your mind, such that you and, more importantly, others have difficulty accessing them. When you roll a success on a saving throw against an emotion effect or a @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.spells.Item.KHnhPHL4x1AQHfbC]{Mind Reading} spell, you get a critical success instead.
Labyrinthine Mind.name: Labyrinthine Mind

Land Feet First.description: You always seem to land on your feet. You become trained in Acrobatics. If you're already trained in that skill, you instead become trained in another skill of your choice. You gain the @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.feats.Item.LQw0yIMDUJJkq1nD]{Cat Fall} skill feat.
Land Feet First.name: Land Feet First

Land on Your Foe.description:
Requirements You are climbing on a surface at least 10 feet directly above a target.

You leap down on your target with all the acrobatic grace of a falling squox. You attempt to [[/act trip skill=acrobatics]] the target using Acrobatics instead of Athletics, then land in an unoccupied space of your choice adjacent to the target.
Land on Your Foe.name: Land on Your Foe

Large Body, Small Tunnel.description: Though many of the tunnels on your home world appear to be too small for a towering person like you, you've worked out strategies to bend, twist, and balance your way through the tightest spots. You gain the Quick Squeeze skill feat. When you critically fail an Acrobatics check to Squeeze, you get a failure instead.
Large Body, Small Tunnel.name: Large Body, Small Tunnel

Large Reach.description: Using your large size, you can extend your reach to attack targets that are farther away. When you wield a melee weapon that requires two hands and doesn't have reach, you can change between a typical two-handed grip and an extended two-handed stretch using an Interact action. Weapons wielded in your extended stretch gain a reach of 10 feet.
Large Reach.name: Large Reach

Lashunta Lore.description:
You've studied the lives and achievements of other lashuntas who have improved both their psychic powers and their communities. You gain the trained proficiency rank in Occultism and Society. If you would automatically become trained in one of those skills (from your background or class, for example), you instead become trained in a skill of your choice.

You also gain the @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.feats.Item.BocFD2KV0qgUC76x]{Additional Lore} general feat for Lashunta Lore.
Lashunta Lore.name: Lashunta Lore

Lasting Coercion.description: When you successfully @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.actions.Item.tHCqgwjtQtzNqVvd]{Coerce} someone, the maximum time they comply increases to a week, still determined by the GM. If you're legendary, the maximum increases to a month.
Lasting Coercion.name: Lasting Coercion

Latch On.description:
Requirements You have a creature @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.kWc1fhmv9LBiTuei]{Grabbed} with your jaws.

Having two mouths to feed is said to take more energy, and you're no exception. You make a jaws Strike against the grabbed creature. On a hit, you gain temporary Hit Points equal to half your level for 1 minute.

@UUID[Compendium.sf2e.feat-effects.Item.iOkzEDtx1953uD26]{Effect: Latch On}
Latch On.name: Latch On

Launch Plasma.description:
Frequency once per day

You can launch a ball of plasma and stellar ejecta across the battlefield that explodes on impact, raining plasma and flame in a small area. Launch Plasma deals @Damage[ceil(@actor.level/2)d6[fire]] damage in a @Template[burst|distance:5] within 60 feet. Each creature in the area must attempt a @Check[reflex|against:class-spell|basic] save against the higher of your class DC or spell DC. On a critical failure, a creature also takes @Damage[(ceil(@actor.level/2))[persistent,electricity]] damage.

At 7th level and every 2 levels thereafter, the fire damage increases by 1d6, and the persistent electricity damage increases by 1. At 17th level, the area increases to a @Template[burst|distance:10].

Special If you're a @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.heritages.Item.RkL11sNqvXcpa6UL]{Volatile Novian}, Launch Plasma and @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.actions.Item.KhX0FDMxGVgHjXdU]{Mini-Nova's} damage dice are both increased to d8s.
Launch Plasma.name: Launch Plasma

Launching Jump.description:
Requirements You're in quadrupedal posture.

You use the momentum from lifting yourself up into bipedal posture to propel yourself into a high leap. You @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.actions.Item.L2k363LraGLUZIgM]{Change Posture} from quadrupedal to bipedal and [[/act high-jump]] or @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.actions.Item.d5I6018Mci2SWokk]{Leap} with a +2 circumstance bonus to Athletics. You don't automatically fail if you don't Stride as part of the activity. You remain in bipedal posture when you land.

Special If you have the @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.feats.Item.ZBhvJ9O8MvBFAlhq]{Quick Jump} skill feat, this activity is also reduced to 1 action.
Launching Jump.name: Launching Jump

Leading Role.description:
Frequency once per hour

You played a leading role in a long-running, popular production, and you frequently like to fall back on this character to get through difficult situations. You can roll a Performance check in place of a skill check to accomplish any other task.
Leading Role.name: Leading Role

Leaping Expertise.description:
Controlling your body as you fly through the air has become second nature. You can @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.actions.Item.d5I6018Mci2SWokk]{Leap} greater distances horizontally by spending additional actions. If you do, increase the limit on how far you can Leap by 5 feet for each additional action spent. Additionally, you can [[/act long-jump]] in a different direction than the direction you were Striding.

Special When you @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.actions.Item.cS9nfDRGD83bNU1p]{Fly} using a jet pack or jump jets while your feet are on the ground, you can spring upward to increase your fly Speed by 10 feet for the duration of the move action.
Leaping Expertise.name: Leaping Expertise

Learned From the Tunnels.description: You've managed to hone your prior experience in the tunnels of Apostae and can employ them when faced with almost any hazard or environmental threat. You can use your @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.heritages.Item.62rt3ufujy6vnhq0]{Apostae delver} heritage to reroll on traps every hour instead of every day. In addition, you can use this reroll against any effect caused by a hazard, instead of just traps.
Learned From the Tunnels.name: Learned From the Tunnels

Learning Experience.description: Your body can partially absorb persistent damage to learn from it. Before you roll damage from a persistent effect, you can choose to take half damage from the effect. When you do, you automatically fail your flat check to end the persistent damage and you can immediately @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.actions.Item.1OagaWtBpVXExToo]{Recall Knowledge} as a free action to recall information related to the source of the persistent damage. If you have any special abilities or free actions that would normally be triggered when you Recall Knowledge, you can't use them with this action.
Learning Experience.name: Learning Experience

Leg Brain.description: You've got a brain or two that can control especially long or nimble "legs" or otherwise give you increased locomotion. Your Speed increases by 5 feet.
Leg Brain.name: Leg Brain

Legacy of Betrayal.description:
Frequency once per day

Trigger You're about to attempt a saving throw against an enemy's ability.

Requirements You believed the triggering enemy was your ally within the last hour.

You understand deeply that others can never be trusted. Reroll the triggering saving throw. You must use the second result, even if it's worse.
Legacy of Betrayal.name: Legacy of Betrayal

Legend Weaver.description: You're an incredibly talented storyteller, making legends come to life. You gain @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.spells.Item.Ucf8eynbZMfUucjE]{Illusory Scene} as a 6th-rank occult innate spell. You can cast this spell once per day. When you cast illusory scene in this way, the spell automatically adapts to suit its audience. A deaf creature that witnesses the illusion additionally sees the characters in the scene visually signing their dialogue. A blind creature that witnesses the illusion additionally hears an audio description of the scene. A deafblind creature that witnesses the illusion additionally receives a psychic impression of the scene and its dialogue in their mind.
Legend Weaver.name: Legend Weaver

Legendary Codebreaker.description: Your skill with languages and codes is so great that you can decipher information with little more than a quick read through a text. You can @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.actions.Item.d9gbpiQjChYDYA2L]{Decipher Writing} using Society while reading at normal speed. If you slow down and spend the full amount of time that's ordinarily required and roll a success, you get a critical success; if you critically succeed while spending the normal amount of time, you gain a nearly word-for-word understanding of the document.
Legendary Codebreaker.name: Legendary Codebreaker

Legendary Linguist.description: You're so skilled with languages you can create a pidgin instantly. You can always talk to any creature that has a language—even a language you don't know—by creating a new pidgin language that uses simplified terms and conveys basic concepts. To do so, you must first understand at least what medium of communication the creature uses (speech, sign language, and so on).
Legendary Linguist.name: Legendary Linguist

Legendary Medic.description: You've discovered medical breakthroughs or techniques that achieve miraculous results. Once per day for each target, you can spend 1 hour treating that target and attempt a Medicine check to remove a disease or the @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.XgEqL1kFApUbl5Z2]{Blinded}, @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.9PR9y0bi4JPKnHPR]{Deafened}, @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.3uh1r86TzbQvosxv]{Doomed}, or @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.4D2KBtexWXa6oUMR]{Drained} condition. Use the DC of the disease or of the spell or effect that created the condition. If the effect's source is an artifact, above 20th level, or similarly powerful, increase the DC by 10.
Legendary Medic.name: Legendary Medic

Legendary Negotiation.description: You can negotiate incredibly quickly in adverse situations. You attempt to @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.actions.Item.OX4fy22hQgUHDr0q]{Make an Impression} and then @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.actions.Item.DCb62iCBrJXy0Ik6]{Request} your opponent cease their current activity and engage in negotiations. You take a –5 penalty to your Diplomacy check. Generally, the DC of this check is the creature's Will DC, although your GM may modify it based on the situation. Some creatures may be unable to stop regardless of their personal desires, and even those who agree to parley might ultimately find your arguments lacking and return to violence.
Legendary Negotiation.name: Legendary Negotiation

Legendary Performer.description: Your fame has spread throughout the galaxy. Creatures who have any listed skill in Society have heard of you and usually have an attitude toward you one step better than normal, depending on your reputation and the creature's disposition. For instance, if you're well-known for cruel and demanding behavior, creatures might be intimidated by you, rather than be friendly toward you. When you @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.actions.Item.QyzlsLrqM0EEwd7j]{Earn Income} with Performance, you attract higher-level audiences than your location would allow, as audiences flock to see you. For instance, famous socialites and spectra might travel to a dive bar in a backwater port to hear you perform. Typically, this increases the audiences available to your level or by two levels, whichever is higher.
Legendary Performer.name: Legendary Performer

Legendary Professional.description: Your fame has spread throughout the galaxy (for instance, if you have Warfare Lore, you might be a legendary general or tactician). This works as @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.feats.Item.467qQoiy6bjWU1G8]{Legendary Performer}, except you gain higher-level jobs when you @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.actions.Item.QyzlsLrqM0EEwd7j]{Earn Income} with Lore.
Legendary Professional.name: Legendary Professional

Legendary Sneak.description: You're always sneaking unless you choose to be seen, even when there's nowhere to hide. You can @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.actions.Item.XMcnh4cSI32tljXa]{Hide} and @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.actions.Item.VMozDqMMuK5kpoX4]{Sneak} even without cover or being @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.DmAIPqOBomZ7H95W]{Concealed}. When you employ an exploration tactic other than @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.actions.Item.IE2nThCmoyhQA0Jn]{Avoiding Notice}, you also gain the benefits of Avoiding Notice unless you choose not to.
Legendary Sneak.name: Legendary Sneak

Legendary Survivalist.description: You can survive indefinitely without food or water and can endure severe, extreme, and incredible cold and heat without taking damage from doing so.
Legendary Survivalist.name: Legendary Survivalist

Legendary Thief.description: Your ability to @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.actions.Item.RDXXE7wMrSPCLv5k]{Steal} defies belief. You can attempt to Steal something that is actively wielded or that would be extremely noticeable or time consuming to remove (like worn shoes or armor). You must do so slowly and carefully, spending at least 1 minute (and significantly longer for items that are normally time consuming to remove, like armor). Throughout this duration you must have some means of staying @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.iU0fEDdBp3rXpTMC]{Hidden}, such as the cover of darkness or a bustling crowd. Even if you succeed, if the item is extremely prominent—like a suit of full plate armor—onlookers will quickly notice it's gone after you steal it.
Legendary Thief.name: Legendary Thief

Legendary Troll.description:
Requirements You or your target are using a comm unit, datapad, or other computer.

Attempt a @Check[deception|against:will] check against the Will DC of a target within 60 feet. On a success, the target is @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.AJh5ex99aV6VTggg]{Off-Guard} for 1 round, and on a critical success, it's @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.yblD8fOR1J8rDwEQ]{Confused} for 1 round. The target's reaction gives you information about it as though you'd attempted to @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.actions.Item.1OagaWtBpVXExToo]{Recall Knowledge} using an appropriate skill and received the same result on your roll. The target is then temporarily immune to your Legendary Troll attempts for 24 hours.
Legendary Troll.name: Legendary Troll

Lengthy Diversion.description: When you critically succeed to @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.actions.Item.GkmbTGfg8KcgynOA]{Create a Diversion}, you continue to remain @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.iU0fEDdBp3rXpTMC]{Hidden} after the end of your turn. This effect lasts for an amount of time that depends on the diversion and situation, as determined by the GM (minimum 1 additional round).
Lengthy Diversion.name: Lengthy Diversion

Let Me Try.description:
Frequency once per 10 minutes

Requirements Your last action was a critically failed Strike.

Though one of your heads is primarily responsible for your body, the second can exert control some of the time—especially when they see your primary head make a mistake. You Strike with a different weapon or unarmed attack, and your multiple attack penalty for this attack is –3 (–2 with an agile attack) on your second attack of the turn instead of –5, and –6 (–4 with an agile attack) on your third or subsequent attack of the turn, instead of –10.
Let Me Try.name: Let Me Try

Let it Ride.description: Building perfect luck is a lifelong quest, and you push farther and farther down that shimmering road; you've gained more control over your natural luck than ever before, and you can use it to manipulate your lucky number with greater precision. You can choose your lucky number instead of rolling.
Let it Ride.name: Let it Ride

Let's Go.description:
Frequency once per day

Your boundless enthusiasm is infectious, and you can share some of that energy and can-do attitude with your allies. You and all allies within @Template[emanation|distance:60]{60 feet} gain a +10-foot status bonus to Speed and the @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.nlCjDvLMf2EkV2dl]{Quickened} condition for 4 rounds. Creatures can use the extra action each round only to Stride.

@UUID[Compendium.sf2e.feat-effects.Item.YSEse0Vs6r639go5]{Effect: Let's Go}

Special If you have the @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.feats.Item.L9IUYeXqWVrGlgke]{Supersonic Speed} feat, you and each ally gain @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.DmAIPqOBomZ7H95W]{Concealment} until the start of their next turn if they Stride while quickened from Let's Go. As usual for concealment involving an obvious visual manifestation, you can't use this concealment to @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.actions.Item.XMcnh4cSI32tljXa]{Hide}.
Let's Go.name: Let's Go

Let's Jam.description:
Frequency once per hour

You spin up your musical instruments to drop the bass and pick up the pace. All allies within 30 feet who can perceive you can @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.actions.Item.UHpkTuCtyaPqiCAB]{Step}, @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.actions.Item.Bcxarzksqt9ezrs6]{Stride} up to half their speed, or @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.actions.Item.ust1jJSCZQUhBZIz]{Take Cover} as a reaction.
Let's Jam.name: Let's Jam

Lie to Me.description: You can use Deception to weave traps to trip up anyone trying to deceive you. If you can engage in conversation with someone trying to @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.actions.Item.ewwCglB7XOPLUz72]{Lie} to you, use your Deception DC if it is higher than your Perception DC to determine whether they succeed. This doesn't apply if you don't have a back-and-forth dialogue, such as when someone attempts to Lie during a long speech.
Lie to Me.name: Lie to Me

Life Bond.description: You can speak with animals and plants. Any living creature you summon is considered part of your bond and doesn't count against the maximum number of creatures in your bond. During your daily preparations, choose one of the following spells: @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.spells.Item.4YnON9JHYqtLzccu]{Summon Animal}, @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.spells.Item.lpT6LotUaQPfinjj]{Summon Elemental}, @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.spells.Item.hs7h8f4Z1ZNdUt3s]{Summon Fey}, or @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.spells.Item.jSRAyd57kd4WZ4yE]{Summon Plant or Fungus}. You add the selected spell to your spell repertoire and signature spells until your next daily preparations.
Life Bond.name: Life Bond

Life Preserver.description: An innate wellspring of protective magic guards you from unexpected environmental danger. You can cast @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.spells.Item.ShwUELLERVMtdjwE]{Life Seal} once per day as a 3rd-rank primal innate spell. You can target only yourself, but the duration increases to 10 minutes.
Life Preserver.name: Life Preserver

Life-Giving Light.description:
Frequency twice per day

You suffuse your natural glow with healing light. You regain Hit Points equal to your level (@Damage[@actor.level[healing]]). All allies within the light of your solar luminance gain temporary Hit Points equal to half your level for 1 minute.

@UUID[Compendium.sf2e.feat-effects.Item.w9PcqHsnbIm11p8M]{Effect: Life-Giving Light}
Life-Giving Light.name: Life-Giving Light

Lifelike.description: You appear not as an android, but a traditional organic creature. You become trained in Deception and gain a +2 circumstance bonus to checks to @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.actions.Item.AJstokjdG6iDjVjE]{Impersonate} living creatures as your biotech changes your body's shape or texture as part of the disguise. Creatures recognize you as a @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.heritages.Item.aiw7v52ME0Pfe88l]{Biotech Android} only if they succeed at a @Check[perception|defense:deception] check against your Deception DC, and you don't have to attempt a Deception check to interact with someone to conceal the fact that you're a biotech android; a check happens only if someone else tries to uncover your heritage.
Lifelike.name: Lifelike

Light 'Em Up.description:
Requirements You're wielding an area or automatic weapon.

Your opponents can run, but they can't hide! You spray your weapon in the general direction of an unseen enemy, revealing its location. You Area Fire or Auto-Fire. If the primary target is @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.DmAIPqOBomZ7H95W]{Concealed}, you don't need to attempt a flat check to target it, and if it's @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.iU0fEDdBp3rXpTMC]{Hidden}, the DC of the flat check to target it is 5.

When you @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.enA7BxAjBb7ns1iF]{Suppress} a concealed creature with this attack, the debris around it helps reveal its current position, and no flat check is needed to target it; If it's hidden, the DC of the flat check to target it becomes 5, and the creature can't become undetected. This benefit lasts as long as the creature remains suppressed.
Light 'Em Up.name: Light 'Em Up

Line 'em Up.description:
Requirements You're wielding a gun.

You fire a single trick shot that passes through multiple foes. Make a ranged Strike with your gun against a target within your first range increment. Apply this attack against all creatures in a straight line between you and your target. This attack ignores any lesser cover the targets would provide one another. Roll damage only once, and apply it to each creature you hit. Line 'Em Up counts as two attacks for your multiple attack penalty.
Line 'em Up.name: Line 'em Up

Linguistic Master.description: Your mastery of language reaches supernatural levels. You can cast @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.spells.Item.SwUiVavHKMWG7t5K]{Truespeech} as a 5th-rank occult innate spell once per day on yourself only. You gain a +1 status bonus to Diplomacy checks for the duration of the spell when speaking to creatures with whom you already shared a language before Casting the Spell.
Linguistic Master.name: Linguistic Master

Linguistic Prodigy.description: You gain two additional languages of your choice, selected from among the common and uncommon languages available to you. Every time you take the @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.feats.Item.P9HCz0uR6xPHuw72]{Multilingual} feat, you gain another new language in addition to the two you gain from that feat.
Linguistic Prodigy.name: Linguistic Prodigy

Linnorm Bite.description: Your ancestors swore allegiance to a linnorm long ago. Though your family is no longer bound to serve the creature, a bit of its influence remains in you, manifesting in particularly long and sharp teeth. You gain a jaws unarmed attack that deals @Damage[1d6[piercing]] damage. Your jaws are in the brawling group and have the finesse and unarmed traits.
Linnorm Bite.name: Linnorm Bite

Listen to the Stone.description: You open your mind to the whispers of the land and learn its secrets. You can cast @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.spells.Item.YIMampGpij4Y30yE]{Speak with Stones} once per day as a 5th-rank primal innate spell. Additionally, you can use Nature to [[/act track skill=nature]] and [[/act seek skill=nature]] instead of Survival and Perception. You gain a +2 circumstance bonus when you use Nature to Track and Seek in an environment with natural or worked stone floors.
Listen to the Stone.name: Listen to the Stone

Living Battery.description:
Your body produces an overabundance of electrical energy, which you can emit as a blast of lightning or use to power technological devices. You can cast the @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.spells.Item.kBhaPuzLUSwS6vVf]{Electric Arc} cantrip as a divine innate spell at will. A cantrip is heightened to a spell rank equal to half your level rounded up.

When you cast electric arc, you can also target batteries or tech items powered by batteries (in any combination). If you target a battery or tech item powered by a battery, that item isn't damaged. Instead, it regains 2 charges per spell rank. If the target is a tech item that needs a battery but doesn't currently have one, treat the item as if it had a battery with 2 charges per spell rank for 1 minute.
Living Battery.name: Living Battery

Living Furnace.description: Forged in a sun's flames, your body is a living furnace that releases an abundance of thermal energy. You become inured to high temperatures, and your body sheds a pleasant heat that can stave off the cold. You gain resistance 4 to fire. You and creatures within 20 feet of you treat environmental cold effects as if they were one step less extreme (incredible cold becomes extreme, extreme cold becomes severe, and so on).
Living Furnace.name: Living Furnace

Living Submersible Mount.description: You can reshape your body to provide a safe means of undersea travel for trusted allies. When another PC rides you as a mount while you're using the @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.actions.Item.XYLK5aZ2WAMJGRAc]{Living Submersible} ability, your expert coordination allows them to take three actions at the start of their turn rather than the two they normally could take while riding another PC. You still gain only two actions at the start of your turn, instead of three, as you spend one action keeping your rider safely contained within a protective foam layer on your back.
Living Submersible Mount.name: Living Submersible Mount

Load-Bearing Hero.description:
Trigger You and one adjacent ally attempt a Reflex or Fortitude save against the same effect.

Whether holding up a crumbling ceiling or jumping into a fireball, you interpose yourself between your ally and incoming danger. The result of your save becomes one degree worse, but the result of your ally's save becomes one degree higher.
Load-Bearing Hero.name: Load-Bearing Hero

Logical Paradox.description:
Frequency once per day

You have a particular interest in the inconsistencies of reality and the material universe that you've read about in philosophical texts. You overload a technological foe's logic processes by posing a paradoxical problem to them. The tech creature must have an Intelligence modifier of –3 or higher, and they must understand the language you speak. The creature attempts a @Check[will|against:class-spell|options:inflicts:glitching,inflicts:stupefied] saving throw against the higher of your class DC or spell DC. Any creature targeted by Logical Paradox becomes immune to it for 24 hours, no matter the result of their saving throw.

Critical Success The creature's logic processes are strong enough to understand your logical paradox, and it has no effect.

Success The creature becomes @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.6A2QDy8wRGCVQsSd]{Glitching 1}.

Failure The creature becomes @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.6A2QDy8wRGCVQsSd]{Glitching 2}.

Critical Failure The creature becomes glitching 2 and is also @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.e1XGnhKNSQIm5IXg]{Stupefied 2} for as long as it remains glitching.
Logical Paradox.name: Logical Paradox

Long Legs.description: You've learned to stretch your legs and adjust your posture, allowing your strides to cover more ground. Your Speed increases by 5 feet.
Long Legs.name: Long Legs

Long Tail.description: You've trained yourself to exploit the extra reach of your prehensile tail and can use that particular detail to your advantage. You can Interact to pick up, pass, or take items with your tail up to 5 feet further than your usual reach with your hands. You can Release items held by your tail into an adjacent square. @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.equipment.Item.KA4zMLBuYb3DgUe6]{Tailblades} you wield gain the reach trait.
Long Tail.name: Long Tail

Long Whiskered.description: Your whiskers function as advanced electroreceptors, allowing you to orient yourself more easily. At the end of each round in which you're untethered, attempt a @Check[flat|dc:15]. On a success, you ignore the @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.i3OJZU2nk64Df3xm]{Clumsy} and @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.AJh5ex99aV6VTggg]{Off-Guard} conditions imposed by being in zero-g for 1 minute.
Long Whiskered.name: Long Whiskered

Long-Legged.description: Your sure-footed nature combines with your natural height and long legs to give you an exceptionally impressive stride. Your Speed increases by 5 feet.
Long-Legged.name: Long-Legged

Long-Term Concealment.description: The giant, ravenous, and persistent predators of Xofirth can follow even the weakest trail. By adapting your travel regimen, you've learned to hide any trace of your passing from beasts and intelligent beings alike. When you [[/act avoid-notice]], you also gain the benefits of Cover Tracks unless you choose to forgo them.
Long-Term Concealment.name: Long-Term Concealment

Longrifle Reload.description:
Frequency once per 10 minutes

Requirements You are wielding a ranged weapon with reload 1 or greater.

You've learned unique techniques for wielding ranged weapons, honed through generations of experience and passed down through traditional teachings and intensive hands-on training. Strike with a ranged weapon in your active hands and then either Interact to reload that weapon or Switch Hands.

Special If you have the sniper shobhad heritage and are wielding a shobhad longrifle in your active hands while holding another weapon from the sniper weapon group in your inactive pair of hands, the frequency of this feat is instead once per round.
Longrifle Reload.name: Longrifle Reload

Look Alive.description:
You warn your ally to move away from danger. You can use @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.feats.Item.60BRmtuNHT6mpJOH]{Watch Out} before an ally in range attempts a Reflex save in addition to its original trigger. If you do, the circumstance bonus applies to their Reflex save against the triggering effect.

When you use Watch Out and the triggering attack fails or critically fails, or your ally succeeds or critically succeeds at the saving throw, your ally can also Stride up to 10 feet as a free action.
Look Alive.name: Look Alive

Looking Out for Myself.description: With two sets of reflexes, you have twice the self-preservation instincts. You gain a +1 circumstance bonus to AC and saving throws against hazards. If you fail a saving throw or take damage from a hazard, this bonus increases to +2 until the end of your next turn.
Looking Out for Myself.name: Looking Out for Myself

Loosed Psychic.description: Your psychic potential expands, encouraged by your blood. Choose one 1st-rank occult spell and one 2nd-rank occult spell. You can cast each of these spells once per day as occult innate spells.
Loosed Psychic.name: Loosed Psychic

Loosen Skin.description:
Trigger You would take persistent bleed damage.

The unique anatomy of talphis, wherein your loose skin hides your neck and extends to your elbows and knees, makes your body look much larger than it actually is and has plenty of give to resist more serious damage. When you're struck by an attack that would do persistent bleed damage, roll a @Check[flat|dc:10]. On a success, you steer the blow into a relatively safe part of your body, and the condition ends immediately.
Loosen Skin.name: Loosen Skin

Loping Vines.description: The vines you use to move—what others call your limbs—are extra long. Increase your land Speed and climb Speed by 5 feet.
Loping Vines.name: Loping Vines

Lowered Legs.description: Your legs can bend and retract to let you make ample use of odd sources of cover. You can [[/act take-cover]] as though you were @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.j91X7x0XSomq8d60]{Prone} even while standing.
Lowered Legs.name: Lowered Legs

Lucky Improviser.description: You're a master improviser with a bit of talent at everything—even if you have no idea what you're doing. You gain the @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.feats.Item.9jGaBxLUtevZYcZO]{Untrained Improvisation} general feat. In addition, you gain the @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.actions.Item.00RryKnz4fXq455m]{Beginner's Luck} action.
Lucky Improviser.name: Lucky Improviser

Lucky Like A Squox.description:
Frequency Once per day

Trigger You're about to roll initiative.

Your quick reflexes and cautious nature combine to keep you hidden when trouble finds you. You Step. If you have cover, greater cover, or @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.DmAIPqOBomZ7H95W]{concealment} after you Step, you can roll Stealth for initiative as if you were @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.actions.Item.IE2nThCmoyhQA0Jn]{Avoiding Notice}.
Lucky Like A Squox.name: Lucky Like A Squox

Lucky Shot.description:
Frequency once per hour

In the heat of combat, all the skill in the world doesn't mean anything if you don't have a little luck on your side. When you critically hit with a Strike against a target, before you roll the damage, you can choose to roll the damage dice pool twice and take the better of the two results.
Lucky Shot.name: Lucky Shot

Luminous Wings.description: Your energy wings shed bright light in a 20-foot radius (and dim light to the next 20 feet). You can extinguish or rekindle this light using a single action, which has the concentrate trait.
Luminous Wings.name: Luminous Wings

Lush Psychic.description: Your connection to the psychic energy of the natural world grows and anchors your abilities. You gain @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.spells.Item.QiW8VNdBf0SFUq69]{Cellular Stimulant} and @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.spells.Item.TTwOKGqmZeKSyNMH]{Gentle Landing} as 1st-rank primal innate spells. You can cast each one of these primal innate spells once per day.
Lush Psychic.name: Lush Psychic

Machine Saboteur.description: You were created to fight other synthetic creatures. When you roll a critical hit against a creature with the tech trait, the target becomes glitching 1.
Machine Saboteur.name: Machine Saboteur

Mageslayer.description: As a result of generational war between your peoples, you've trained in special antimagic techniques to battle elven and lashunta spellcasters. You gain a mageslayer claw unarmed attack that deals @Damage[1d6[slashing]] damage, is in the brawling weapon group, and has the finesse, primal, and unarmed traits. A creature you Strike with your mageslayer claw must attempt a Will save against the higher of your class DC or spell DC. On a failure, the creature becomes @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.e1XGnhKNSQIm5IXg]{Stupefied 1} for 1 minute (or @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.e1XGnhKNSQIm5IXg]{Stupefied 2} on a critical failure).
Mageslayer.name: Mageslayer

Magic Coagulant.description: Your blood works to assist you and even helps others who try to heal your wounded form. You can use @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.feats.Item.wYerMk6F1RZb0Fwt]{Battle Medicine} and @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.actions.Item.1kGNdIIhuglAjIp9]{Treat Wounds} without a medkit, and your allies don't need a medkit to use Battle Medicine on you or Treat your Wounds. The first time each day, when someone rolls a failure or a critical failure on a check to use Battle Medicine on you or Treat your Wounds, the magic in your blood coagulates to assist and increases the degree of success by one step, even if you're @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.fBnFDH2MTzgFijKf]{Unconscious}.
Magic Coagulant.name: Magic Coagulant

Magic Collate Ball.description:
Your jeweled orb has a lattice to process magic that can automatically troubleshoot and correct calculations in magical formulas to prevent mishaps when using unfamiliar magic.

You become trained in a skill matching the tradition of the innate spell you gained with the jeweled orb bantrid heritage. The relevant skills are Arcana for arcane, Nature for primal, Occultism for occult, or Religion for divine. If you were already trained in the relevant skill, you become trained in another one of those skills. You gain the @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.feats.Item.uR62fVC9FyQAMCO1]{Trick Magic Item} skill feat.
Magic Collate Ball.name: Magic Collate Ball

Magic Fortification.description: With arcane blood in your veins, you can deflect the worst effects of magic. You gain a +1 circumstance bonus to saving throws against arcane spells and effects.
Magic Fortification.name: Magic Fortification

Magical Crafting.description: You can @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.actions.Item.rmwa3OyhTZ2i2AHl]{Craft} magic items, though some have other requirements. When you select this feat, you gain formulas for four common magic items of 2nd level or lower.
Magical Crafting.name: Magical Crafting

Magical Guardian.description: Your desire to protect the people you care about from harm has kindled the spark of magic in your soul, and you can share that spark with others. You can cast the @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.spells.Item.izcxFQFwf3woCnFs]{Guidance} and @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.spells.Item.RA7VKcen3p56rVyZ]{Forbidding Ward} cantrips as divine innate spells at will. A cantrip is heightened to a spell rank equal to half your level rounded up. Whenever you cast one of these spells on your bonded partner, you increase the range of the spell to 60 feet, rather than 30 feet.
Magical Guardian.name: Magical Guardian

Magical Savior.description: When push comes to shove, you're more than willing to give your life in place of an ally's. You gain @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.spells.Item.yHujiDQPdtXW797e]{Spirit Link} as a 3rd-rank divine innate spell. You can cast this spell once per day. If you cast this spell on your bonded partner, spirit link is heightened to 4th-rank and you can increase the range of spirit link to 60 feet, rather than 30 feet.
Magical Savior.name: Magical Savior

Magically Melodious.description: Halfling musicians have a magical trick handed down from artist to artist, so they're always prepared for an impromptu gig. You become trained in Performance. If you would automatically become trained in Performance (from a background or class, for example), you instead become trained in a skill of your choice. Additionally, you gain @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.spells.Item.yvs1zN5Pai5U4CJX]{Summon Instrument} as an occult innate cantrip. A cantrip is heightened to a spell rank equal to half your level rounded up.
Magically Melodious.name: Magically Melodious

Magitech Core.description: Your body incorporates a number of magical and technological components, granting you some innate magical power. You gain the @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.feats.Item.IEQmMRA1uMPb0rJo]{Ancestral Cantrip} feat from your ancestry or from the android ancestry. You're trained in the skill associated with the tradition of the cantrip you learned this way (Arcana for arcane, Religion for divine, Occultism for occult, or Nature for primal). If you would automatically become trained in that skill (from your background or class, for example), you instead become trained in a skill of your choice.
Magitech Core.name: Magitech Core

Magitech Weapon Adjustment.description: You've learned to cast some simple energy manipulation spells to help get additional versatility out of your and your allies' weapons. You can cast @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.spells.Item.2iQKhCQBijhj5Rf3]{Infuse Vitality} and @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.spells.Item.7P4eBdqWcgQJAFCa]{Shifting Surge} once per day each as 1st-rank arcane innate spells.
Magitech Weapon Adjustment.name: Magitech Weapon Adjustment

Magnetic Projectile.description: By quickly reversing the polarity on a portion of your magnetic foot orb, you can launch items attached to you at your enemies. You gain a magnetic projectile unarmed attack in the sling weapon group with a range increment of 30 feet that deals 1d4 bludgeoning, piercing, or slashing damage—as appropriate for the object you hurled. You must have a metallic object of at least light Bulk attached to your foot orb as ammunition for this attack, but no specific traits or magic properties of the thrown item affect the attack or the damage.
Magnetic Projectile.name: Magnetic Projectile

Magnetic Sweeper.description: Your magnetic foot orb picks up loose metal objects that you can retrieve later. Whenever you leave a square, you can pick up one unattended object of 1 Bulk or less that is mostly made out of metal with your foot orb. Your foot orb can hold 4 Bulk of items, and the first 2 Bulk of these items don't count against your Bulk limits. These items are considered stowed and must be drawn in order to be used.
Magnetic Sweeper.name: Magnetic Sweeper

Major Miner.description: You pass through earth and stone almost as easily as air. It's no longer a matter of digging, but rather becoming one with the ground and allowing it to carry you to your destination. When you @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.actions.Item.H6v1VgowHaKHnVlG]{Burrow}, you can choose whether or not you leave behind a tunnel. If you choose to leave a tunnel, creatures one size larger than you or smaller can use the hole, but creatures one size larger than you have to @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.actions.Item.kMcV8e5EZUxa6evt]{Squeeze}. If you don't leave a tunnel, you can [[/act sneak]] while Burrowing at your full movement speed.
Major Miner.name: Major Miner

Make Them Pay.description: When your enemies have you cornered, you become ever more vicious. If the next action you use is to Cast a Spell that deals damage to a single target, and if that spell doesn't have a duration, you gain a circumstance bonus to its damage equal to twice the sum of your @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{Frightened} and @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.Yl48xTdMh3aeQYL2]{Wounded} conditions (to a maximum of +12) if you have one or both conditions.
Make Them Pay.name: Make Them Pay

Make a Tiny Target.description: You pull your limbs and other vulnerable body parts in tight, hiding mostly inside your protective shell. You gain resistance to physical damage equal to half your level (rounded up) until the end of your next turn. However, with your limbs in your shell, it becomes difficult to move. You gain the @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.eIcWbB5o3pP6OIMe]{Immobilized} condition until the end of your next turn.
Make a Tiny Target.name: Make a Tiny Target

Malfunction Aura.description: For one reason or another, machines around you often spontaneously break down. Whenever an enemy starts its turn adjacent to you, it must attempt a @Check[fortitude|against:class-spell|options:inflicts:glitching] save against the higher of your class DC or spell DC. On a failure, the target's wielded tech items (or the target itself if it has the tech trait) becomes @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.6A2QDy8wRGCVQsSd]{Glitching 1} (@UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.6A2QDy8wRGCVQsSd]{Glitching 2} on a critical failure) as long as it remains adjacent to you. Regardless of the result of the save, the creature is then temporarily immune to your Malfunction Aura for 24 hours.
Malfunction Aura.name: Malfunction Aura

Management Material.description: Anyone who speaks with you about a job, workplace, or office skill set assumes you're a professional in that setting unless you intentionally present yourself differently. You can use [[/act make-an-impression]]{Society} to @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.actions.Item.OX4fy22hQgUHDr0q]{Make an Impression} on a professional or to Impersonate a type of professional or a specific individual professional. If you use the normally required skills in those situations, you receive a +1 circumstance bonus to the check instead.
Management Material.name: Management Material

Manifold Evolution.description: You've cataloged the genetic code from countless ancestries you've encountered, and you can draw upon any of them to enhance and evolve your body. Increase the number of ancestries you can select with @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.feats.Item.YaS0LQv3YCfiBRgR]{Convergent Evolution} to six. You gain two additional ancestry feats you qualify for of 13th level or lower, chosen from among the ancestries selected with Convergent Evolution. You can retrain one or both of these selected feats once per day during your daily preparations.
Manifold Evolution.name: Manifold Evolution

Manifold Harmonies.description: The strange music that lurks inside you is always straining to get out. You can harness it more readily than most, much to the dismay of any enemies standing in your way. The frequency of Hypnotic Melody and Shocking Howl becomes once per round. Creatures that fail their Will saves against your Hypnotic Melody or Shocking Howl become @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.MIRkyAjyBeXivMa7]{Enfeebled 1} (@UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.MIRkyAjyBeXivMa7]{Enfeebled 2} on a critical failure).
Manifold Harmonies.name: Manifold Harmonies

Manifold Masters.description: You've broadened your senses and are better able to comprehend the unseen answers all around you. When you use Student of the Unseen during your daily preparations, you gain @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.feats.Item.BocFD2KV0qgUC76x]{Additional Lore} twice.
Manifold Masters.name: Manifold Masters

Mantarider.description: You have trained in the ceremonial art of combat mounted upon a manta and can apply your experience to other forms of mobile combat. Reduce the penalty when attacking from a vehicle that has moved within the last round to 0 (or –2 if the vehicle is uncontrolled or any action in the last round had the reckless trait). You don't take a penalty to Reflex saves while mounted.
Mantarider.name: Mantarider

Maratan Athlete.description: To navigate the wilds of Marata, you ask more of your body than most. You become trained in Athletics. If you would automatically become trained in Athletics (from your background or class, for example), you instead become trained in another skill of your choice. When you fall, you can [[/act grab-an-edge]] using your tail with an Athletics check instead of Acrobatics.
Maratan Athlete.name: Maratan Athlete

March!.description: You form up with allies and move in unison. Stride once. You can choose up to two willing allies adjacent to you at the start of your movement to move with you as a reaction. All allies end their movement adjacent to you, but not adjacent to one another, forming a line or triangle. Creatures moving with March! can't move further than the lowest Speed used by any other creature in that march.
March!.name: March!

March! Two Three Four.description: Whether with subtle telepathy or your natural leadership skills, you're able to link up and move with allies more efficiently. You can @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.feats.Item.THJ7dyZrMqMOJznr]{March!} as a single action instead of two actions.
March! Two Three Four.name: March! Two Three Four

Martial Vocational Training.description: Your training with an unconventional weapon has taught you the basics of how to use that weapon for its original nonviolent purpose. While wielding a weapon with the professional trait, you become trained in one skill listed for that weapon's professional trait. If you were already trained in that skill, you become an expert instead. You also gain @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.feats.Item.W6Gl9ePmItfDHji0]{Assurance} in that skill while wielding the weapon.
Martial Vocational Training.name: Martial Vocational Training

Mascot Power!.description: Your soulfeel has attracted and bound the spirit of a creature to you. When you select this feat, choose @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.spells.Item.4YnON9JHYqtLzccu]{Summon Animal} or @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.spells.Item.hs7h8f4Z1ZNdUt3s]{Summon Fey}. You can cast the chosen spell as a primal innate spell once per day, heightened to half your level rounded up.
Mascot Power!.name: Mascot Power!

Masked.description: Your masked face prevents others from scrutinizing your appearance, and you've learned to leverage this uncertainty to your advantage in social situations. While your mouth is covered, increase the DC of any Perception check to @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.actions.Item.1xRFPTFtWtGJ9ELw]{Sense Motive} against you by 2. You gain a +1 circumstance bonus to @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.actions.Item.ewwCglB7XOPLUz72]{Lie}, make a @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.actions.Item.DCb62iCBrJXy0Ik6]{Request}, or @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.actions.Item.OX4fy22hQgUHDr0q]{Make an Impression}.
Masked.name: Masked

Masks Under Masks.description: Even if you are forced to reveal your natural appearance, you have an additional layer of security in the form of a backup shapeshifting identity. Choose one form during your daily preparations. Waving away your ability to transform as some unrelated magic or technology, you gain a +3 circumstance bonus to Deception checks to Lie that the chosen form is your true form. You can tell lies that protect your identity even against magical spells, and effects like truesight reveal the chosen form as your true form. You revert to this form if you become the target of a spell or effect that causes you to unwillingly shift back to your true form.
Masks Under Masks.name: Masks Under Masks

Massive Fists.description: You punch with brutal force akin to a club or rock. Your fist unarmed attacks don't have the nonlethal trait and gain the shove weapon trait.
Massive Fists.name: Massive Fists

Master Hunter.description: For a maraquoi, hearing is a full-body experience. While most of your kind can use their hypersensitive hearing to track the world around them with great precision, you've taken the ability to the next level. By concentrating on the vibrations rolling across thousands of receptors on your skin, you can pick up on the slightest movement and use it to find hidden enemies. Your dermal hearing becomes a precise sense.
Master Hunter.name: Master Hunter

Master Plan.description: During your daily preparations, you can review stratagems with up to five allies. Later, you can quickly advise each of these allies on your schemes using the @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.actions.Item.ygvLiQmneqp1pjWb]{New Plan} reaction.
Master Plan.name: Master Plan

Master Planner.description: You've scheduled your life down to the minute, prioritizing your strict deadlines to the point of manifesting mysterious powers that maximize your entire team's the productivity. You gain @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.spells.Item.o6YCGx4lycsYpww4]{Haste} as an 8th-rank occult innate spell that you can cast once per day. When you cast this innate haste spell the first time each day, you can choose to cast it as a 3rd-rank occult innate spell instead of 8th-rank. If you do, you can cast it two more times that day as a 3rd-rank occult innate spell.
Master Planner.name: Master Planner

Master Spy.description: Your proficiency rank for Perception increases to master.
Master Spy.name: Master Spy

featPrerequisites.1: legendary in Arcana or Occultism, depending on paradox

Masterful Imitation.description: You've studied certain creatures enough that you can transform into them. If you are a master in a Lore skill that can be used to identify a category of creatures, you can use Change Shape to transform your appearance to that of a Small or Medium creature of that category.

featPrerequisites.0: master in one or more Lore skills

Masterful Imitation.name: Masterful Imitation

Maximize Profits.description: You've learned to maximize your potential earnings. Whenever you would fail an @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.actions.Item.QyzlsLrqM0EEwd7j]{Earn Income} check, you get a success instead.
Maximize Profits.name: Maximize Profits

Maze Lost.description: You constantly wander the maze of life, moving from one interest to the next; as a result, it's easy to forget past passions while delving into others. You gain the @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.feats.Item.BocFD2KV0qgUC76x]{Additional Lore} feat, as well as the benefits of @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.feats.Item.XvX1EyxWbbBF32NV]{Unmistakable Lore} for that Lore subcategory, even if you don't meet the prerequisites. You can retrain Maze Lost to a different Lore skill subcategory with 1 day of downtime.
Maze Lost.name: Maze Lost

Mazer's Endurance.description: Your focus is so powerful that it's easy for you to lose track of self care, but fortunately, you've trained to endure periods of stress. You're never @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.HL2l2VRSaQHu9lUw]{Fatigued} as a result of hunger or starvation as long as you spend time during your daily preparations solving or creating a puzzle or riddle. You only need to sleep for 2 hours a day, and you need only 4 hours of rest between your daily preparations. Choose a Lore skill related to the puzzle or riddle you worked on. Until your next daily preparations, you become trained in that skill, and if you roll a critical failure on a check to @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.actions.Item.1OagaWtBpVXExToo]{Recall Knowledge} with that Lore skill, you get a failure instead.
Mazer's Endurance.name: Mazer's Endurance

Meandering Mind.description:
Requirements Your quantum field is active.

You allow your mind to wander to things you find pleasant, briefly shutting out all realities and protecting you from harm. You gain a +2 status bonus to saving throws against mental effects until the start of your next turn.
Meandering Mind.name: Meandering Mind

Mediator.description: You're a talented diplomat or mediator who's skilled at making a good impression and accustomed to finding compromises, brokering deals, and forging strong social connections. You gain the trained proficiency rank in Diplomacy. If you would automatically become trained in Diplomacy (from your background or class, for example), you instead become trained in a skill of your choice. You also gain a +1 circumstance bonus to Diplomacy checks to @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.actions.Item.OX4fy22hQgUHDr0q]{Make an Impression}.
Mediator.name: Mediator

Medicinal Trinket.description: Some trinkets are useful for medicinal purposes. You have found another trinket of light Bulk that can serve as a tool for certain traditional medicinal uses and can @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.actions.Item.qVNVSmsgpKFGk9hV]{Conceal an Object} of negligible Bulk inside of it. You can use your Medicinal Trinket as a medkit when you @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.actions.Item.1kGNdIIhuglAjIp9]{Treat Wounds}. The first time each day you use the Medicinal Trinket to use @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.feats.Item.wYerMk6F1RZb0Fwt]{Battle Medicine} or Treat Wounds on yourself, you gain additional temporary Hit Points equal to your level that last for 1 hour, regardless of the result of the attempt.
Medicinal Trinket.name: Medicinal Trinket

Meditative Analysis.description:
You briefly meditate on the nature of your foe and their role in the wider cosmos. Attempt a check to @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.actions.Item.1OagaWtBpVXExToo]{Recall Knowledge} about a creature. On a success, you gain a +1 circumstance bonus to your next Strike with a solar weapon against the target this round. If your Strike hits, you can choose which attunement benefit you gain for that strike. The subject of your check is temporarily immune to Meditative Analysis for 1 day.

@UUID[Compendium.sf2e.feat-effects.Item.kxaRFiXRKMNpasnu]{Effect: Meditative Analysis}
Meditative Analysis.name: Meditative Analysis

Meld with Nature.description: You can blend effortlessly into nature. You can [[/act hide]] in natural environments even without cover or @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.DmAIPqOBomZ7H95W]{concealment}, and you don't become automatically @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.1wQY3JYyhMYeeV2G]{Observed} in a natural environment if you end your [[/act sneak]] without cover or concealment.
Meld with Nature.name: Meld with Nature

Melodic Adaptation.description:
You can hear the thrum of magic as if it were a swirling note, a shifting melody, a harmonic chord, or a percussive beat, pulsing in tune with your heart. You can detect the presence of magic as though you were always using a 1st-rank @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.spells.Item.gpzpAAAJ1Lza2JVl]{Detect Magic} spell. This detects magic within a @Template[type:emanation|distance:30].

At 13th level, the rank of detect magic increases to 3rd. At 17th level, the rank of detect magic increases to 4th.

featPrerequisites.0: trained in Arcana, Nature, Occultism, or Religion

Melodic Adaptation.name: Melodic Adaptation

Memories of Ashok.description: With unparalleled focus, you can tap into and sift through the memories of every contemplative who has come before. You can cast the @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.spells.Item.hp6Q64dl7xbdn4gQ]{Collective Memories} ritual once per week as the primary caster. When you do so, you can ignore the rare incense cost; if you do so, you become @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.4D2KBtexWXa6oUMR]{Drained 2} after completing the ritual.
Memories of Ashok.name: Memories of Ashok

Memories of Before.description:
Frequency once per day

Trigger You fail a skill check or saving throw.

You were alive during the Gap, but like everyone else, you remember nothing from that time. You're haunted by centuries of lost experiences that shaped you into a form you can't identify. Reroll the triggering check, but you must use the new result, even if it's worse. You become @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{Frightened 1}.
Memories of Before.name: Memories of Before

Memories of Valor.description:
Frequency once per day

While the memories of most enshrined vesk are hazy and ephemeral, with some concentration you can recall memories of your amalgamated souls vividly enough to apply your experiences.

Choose one skill. You temporarily increase your proficiency rank with that skill by one step for 1 minute (from untrained to trained, trained to expert, and expert to master). This temporary increase adjusts your proficiency bonus and allows you to use skill actions based on this increased proficiency as normal. Memories of Valor can't increase a skill's proficiency rank beyond master.
Memories of Valor.name: Memories of Valor

Memory Hole.description:
Frequency once every 10 minutes

Trigger You become @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{Frightened}.

You let your memory forget the immediate past to better move beyond its trauma. Reduce your frightened value by 1.
Memory Hole.name: Memory Hole

Memory Matrix.description: You refuse to surrender your autonomy and have erected mental bulwarks and technological protocols to safeguard your mind and memories. Whenever you attempt a Will save against a spell or effect that would give you the @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.yblD8fOR1J8rDwEQ]{Confused} or @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.9qGBRpbX9NEwtAAr]{Controlled} condition, roll that save twice and use the higher result (this is a fortune effect). If you would start your turn confused or controlled, you can immediately attempt a @Check[flat|dc:5]. On a success, you fight that mental control, becoming @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.6uEgoh53GbXuHpTF]{Paralyzed} until the end of your turn rather than acting against your will. If you roll a 20 on this flat check, you immediately end the confused or controlled condition.
Memory Matrix.name: Memory Matrix

Memory Recovery.description: You retain instincts and fragmentary memories from the androids who previously occupied your body or from ancient programming embedded in your system. During your daily preparations, you can tap into these archived memories to become trained in one skill of your choice. This proficiency lasts until you prepare again. Since this proficiency is temporary, you can't use it as a prerequisite for a skill increase or a permanent character option like a feat.
Memory Recovery.name: Memory Recovery

Memory Shield.description:
Frequency once per day

Trigger You take damage from an effect that deals vitality damage.

You draw upon precious memories from your life to shield you against the energies that would nominally purge undead creatures from the universe. You gain resistance to the triggering damage equal to your level.
Memory Shield.name: Memory Shield

Menacing Growl.description:
Requirements A creature within 30 feet has the frightened condition.

You snarl ferociously at a creature within 30 feet, menacing them with bared teeth. Increase the value of the frightened condition by 1 (maximum 3). The target then becomes temporarily immune to your Menacing Snarl for 24 hours.

As long as the target is frightened, you gain a +1 circumstance bonus to melee Strikes against that creature, and damage dealt to the creature by your melee Strikes deals an additional @Damage[1[mental]] damage per damage die.
Menacing Growl.name: Menacing Growl

Menacing Huff.description: Your stature cuts a threatening figure, such that even a forceful breath can feel like a threat to smaller beings. You become trained in Intimidation. If you're already trained in Intimidation (from your background or class, for example), you become trained in another skill of your choice. You gain the @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.feats.Item.xQMz6eDgX75WX2ce]{Intimidating Glare} skill feat. You also gain a +1 circumstance bonus to [[/act demoralize]] targets that are smaller than you.
Menacing Huff.name: Menacing Huff

Menacing Laughter.description: Your laughter (or other vocalization) remains audible over the din of your weapons fire. Attempt an Intimidation check to @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.actions.Item.2u915NdUyQan6uKF]{Demoralize} each creature within 30 feet who's @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.enA7BxAjBb7ns1iF]{Suppressed}.
Menacing Laughter.name: Menacing Laughter

Menacing Men.description: Many find your size, and the aberrant nature of your appearance, intimidating. You've learned to use that to your advantage, frightening smaller foes without ever opening your mouth. You gain the Intimidating Glare skill feat. You gain a +1 circumstance bonus to [[/act demoralize]] a target that's smaller than you.
Menacing Men.name: Menacing Men

Menacing Snarl.description:
Frequency once per hour

Trigger You frighten a creature.

You snarl, hiss, shout, or otherwise verbally menace the triggering creature as you frighten them. Increase the value of the frightened condition by 1 (maximum 3).
Menacing Snarl.name: Menacing Snarl

Menacing Spines.description: With your build, and that collection of brutal-looking spines, you don't need to say much to frighten your opponents. You're trained in Intimidation (or another skill of your choice if you were already trained in Intimidation). You gain the Intimidating Glare skill feat.
Menacing Spines.name: Menacing Spines

Mental Deflection.description:
Trigger A creature Casts a Spell with the mental trait.

Requirements You have at least 1 Focus Point.

When a foe Casts a Spell that has the mental trait and you can see or otherwise detect its manifestations, you use your psychic powers to disrupt it. You expend 1 Focus Point to counter the triggering creature's casting of the spell. You then attempt to counteract the triggering spell using your spellcasting attribute modifier plus your spellcasting proficiency bonus as your counteract modifier and half your level, rounded up, as your counteract rank.
Mental Deflection.name: Mental Deflection

Mental Interference.description:
You force link the target's mind to your bond and share a confusing glimpse of your connection. Attempt a skill check with your connection skill against the Will DC of a foe you can see within 30 feet. The target is them temporarily immune for 1 hour.

Critical Success The target takes a –1 status penalty to attack rolls and a –2 status penalty to Will saves for 1 minute. This effect ends early if it uses a single action with the concentrate trait to shake off the effects of the interference or immediately after you target it with a hostile action.

Success As critical success, but the penalty to Will saves is –1.

Critical Failure You become @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.AJh5ex99aV6VTggg]{Off-Guard} against the next attack the target attempts against you before the end of your next turn.

@UUID[Compendium.sf2e.feat-effects.Item.gKDw3GcOiOYMMK1k]{Effect: Mental Interference}
Mental Interference.name: Mental Interference

Mental Override.description:
Frequency once per day

Trigger You fail a Will saving throw against a mental effect.

You bolster your host's mental defenses. Reroll the triggering saving throw and use the better result.
Mental Override.name: Mental Override

Metabolic Manipulation.description: Through careful experimentation and selective adaptation, you've manipulated your immune system and internal chemistry to better fight off illness and infection. You gain the @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.feats.Item.N8Xz5fuW6o7GW124]{Fast Recovery} skill feat and the @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.actions.Item.VIv5Gt3yndrk0qgb]{Targeted Immunization} action.
Metabolic Manipulation.name: Metabolic Manipulation

Metallic Augmentation Xtractor.description: Your latest augmentation is a multifunction unit capable of processing metals of all types for a variety of purposes, a Metallic Augmentation Xtractor (MAX). You can use the benefits of the jury-rigging raxilite heritage once every 10 minutes, even if you don't have the heritage. If you have the heritage, you recover a number of Hit Points equal to seven times your level instead of five times your level.
Metallic Augmentation Xtractor.name: Metallic Augmentation Xtractor

Metaphysical Understanding.description: You can protect yourself against effects associated with the fundamental foundations of the cosmos. You gain a +1 circumstance bonus to all saving throws against divine effects.
Metaphysical Understanding.name: Metaphysical Understanding

Method Actor.description: You like to live as the character you're playing, which makes your performances incredibly convincing. Whenever you would critically fail a Deception check to @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.actions.Item.AJstokjdG6iDjVjE]{Impersonate}, you fail instead.
Method Actor.name: Method Actor

Meyel's Melody.description: Divine rhythm pulses through your blood, and your life is the music. You gain a +2 status bonus to Performance checks. In addition, you can use Performance to [[/act create-a-diversion skill=performance]]{Create a Diversion}, [[/act demoralize skill=performance]]{Demoralize}, or [[/act make-an-impression skill=performance]]{Make an Impression}. If you listen to music while resting, you regain a number of additional Hit Points equal to your level.
Meyel's Melody.name: Meyel's Melody

Meyel's Tailspin.description:
Requirements You're @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.j91X7x0XSomq8d60]{Prone}.

This technique allows you to use the momentum of your attack with the assistance of your tail to spin back onto your feet. Make a melee Strike with your claws or a @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.equipment.Item.PIdM8V0m8nLEI73e]{Battle Ribbon}, then Stand. You don't take the –2 circumstance penalty for attacking while prone, and your Stand action doesn't trigger reactions from the target of your Strike.
Meyel's Tailspin.name: Meyel's Tailspin

Mighty Guardian.description: The magical spark you use to protect others grows in power. You can cast @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.spells.Item.d7Lwx6KAs47MtF0q]{Share Life} and @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.spells.Item.HTou8cG05yuSkesj]{Status} as 2nd-rank divine innate spells, once per day each.
Mighty Guardian.name: Mighty Guardian

Mighty Membranes.description:
The cellular walls that make up your hardened exterior have adapted to protect you from a multitude of threats. Choose one of the following energy damage types: acid, electricity, fire, or sonic. You gain resistance equal to half your level against the damage type you chose.

Special You can take this feat multiple times. Each time you do so, select a different damage type.
Mighty Membranes.name: Mighty Membranes

Mighty Shoulders.description: Even among your kind, you possess a powerful build with broad shoulders and overlapping chitinous plates that makes your anatomy well suited to carrying heavy loads. Increase your maximum carried Bulk and the amount of Bulk you can carry before becoming encumbered by 2. When you're encumbered, reduce the penalty to your Speeds by 5 feet.
Mighty Shoulders.name: Mighty Shoulders

Mind Over Matter.description: Your telekinetic capabilities extend beyond personal levitation, allowing you to handle nearby objects with precision. Your telekinesis grants you the equivalent of two additional hands, following the rules for characters with more than two hands as detailed in Starfinder Player Core. However, each of the telekinetic hands can wield only items of 1 Bulk or less. The @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.actions.Item.oW81CfM9ebxXnrw3]{Switch Hands} action gains the contemplative trait when you switch to or from your telekinetic hands.
Mind Over Matter.name: Mind Over Matter

Mindrender.description: You've honed your thoughts into a deadly weapon that can shatter a foe's mind. You gain a psychic shock ranged unarmed attack with a range increment of 30 feet and the agile trait. The weapon deals 1d4 mental damage and is in the mental weapon group.
Mindrender.name: Mindrender

Mindward Shield.description: Your solar shield acts as an anchor for your mind as much as your body. When your Raise your solar Shield, you gain the shield's circumstance bonus to Will saves. In addition, while you have your solar shield raised, you can Shield Block when you take damage as a result of a failed Will save, in addition to its usual trigger. If you do, the triggering damage bypasses your solar shield's object immunities.
Mindward Shield.name: Mindward Shield

Mineral Shield.description:
Your deep connection to the earth allows you to shape it to your own purposes, sometimes without even using your hands. You seek out particles of dust and stone around you and draw them to yourself, creating a calcified shield of stone around your limbs. This counts as using the @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.actions.Item.xjGwis0uaC2305pm]{Raise a Shield} action, giving you a +1 circumstance bonus to AC until the start of your next turn, but it doesn't require a hand to use.

While the mineral shield is in effect, you can use the @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.feats.Item.jM72TjJ965jocBV8]{Shield Block} reaction with your mineral shield and can use it to reduce damage only from effects that deal electricity or fire damage. This shield has Hardness 5, but if used underground or in a foundry or junkyard where scraps of metal are plentiful, the shield gains resistance 5 to electricity and fire. After you use Shield Block, the effect ends.
