Special You can improve your shield by applying shield improvements to a small stone trinket with negligible Bulk that you must be wearing when you use Mineral Shield.
Mineral Shield.name: Mineral Shield

Mire Tracker.description: If you can track something in the stinking, shifting swamps of the Mire, it puts you in company with some of the finest trackers in the galaxy. You gain the @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.feats.Item.4tTkRyOQ0VuRBac3]{Terrain Expertise} feat for swamps and sewers, and you can [[/act track]] while moving at full Speed while you're in a swamp or sewer.
Mire Tracker.name: Mire Tracker

Mission Briefing.description: Coming prepared to mission briefings gives you extra time to ask questions and research a topic relevant to your next adventure. You are trained in Mission Lore, a special Lore skill that can be used only to @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.actions.Item.1OagaWtBpVXExToo]{Recall Knowledge}, but on any topic related to an assignment, mission, or quest performed on behalf of another individual or organization. If you fail a check to Recall Knowledge with Mission Lore, you get the effects of the @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.feats.Item.1Bt7uCW2WI4sM84P]{Dubious Knowledge} skill feat unless the question was already answered during a mission briefing. If you have legendary proficiency in Society, you gain expert proficiency in Mission Lore, but you can't increase your proficiency rank in Mission Lore by any other means.
Mission Briefing.name: Mission Briefing

Mobile Aim.description: You're rarely still, and you've learned to reliably hit your targets even while moving. You Stride and then @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.actions.Item.sLikawnrJJzHMYeC]{Aim} with a gun you're wielding.
Mobile Aim.name: Mobile Aim

Molecular Modification.description:
You modify your body's genetics to resist certain damage types. You gain resistance to acid, bludgeoning, cold, electricity, fire, piercing, poison, slashing, or sonic damage equal to half your level.

Special You can take this feat multiple times. Each time you do so, select a different damage type.
Molecular Modification.name: Molecular Modification

Molting Metamorphosis.description:
You've gained precise control over where and when your chitinous exoskeleton molts. You can spend a week of downtime to retrain any other ancestry feat.

In addition, you can spend a week of downtime to permanently change your appearance. You retain a roughly similar height (within 6 inches) and weight (within 50 pounds), but your face shape, coloring, sex, and even distinctive mannerisms change to adapt to your new body type. Changing your appearance gives you a +4 circumstance bonus to Deception checks to prevent others from recognizing you. You can retrain your ancestry feat and change your appearance at the same time, even if you're using effects like @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.spells.Item.y0Vy7iNL3ET8K00C]{Dreaming Potential}.
Molting Metamorphosis.name: Molting Metamorphosis

Momentum.description:
Requirements Your last action was a successful solar weapon Strike.

You use the momentum of your last attack to maneuver around the battlefield, either by leaving photonic images or making great gravity-assisted leaps. Step twice.

Graviton-Attuned You move 10 feet with each Step, rather than 5 feet.

Photon-Attuned You leave an afterimage in the square you started in. This image lasts until the end of your next turn but ends early if another creature enters the space. This afterimage counts as an ally to you and your allies for the purposes of flanking.
Momentum.name: Momentum

Monitoring Bond.description: As long as you and your bonded partner are on the same plane of existence and both alive, you can communicate telepathically together and both remain aware of one another's present state, general direction and distance from one another, and if they are conscious, @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.fBnFDH2MTzgFijKf]{Unconscious}, or dying. You both know any conditions affecting one another, except those that the affected character does not know about.
Monitoring Bond.name: Monitoring Bond

Monster Crafting.description:
You can use the parts of monsters to aid in crafting. You can use the body of a monster to help @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.actions.Item.rmwa3OyhTZ2i2AHl]{Craft} items, using Survival instead of Crafting for the Craft activity when you do so. If parts of the monster's body are valuable, you can expend them toward the item's raw material cost as well. (The GM makes the determination if the monster's entry doesn't list any valuable materials from its body.)

If you spend additional days working on the item, reduce the Price using the monster's level instead of your own. Certain items may require specific creatures in their Craft requirement.
Monster Crafting.name: Monster Crafting

Monstrous Frenzy.description: The more time you spend in combat, the more threats you see to your allies and the harder you work to protect your chosen family. Though it can be difficult to channel your fervor, you've found the strength to call upon it more and more. You can use Frenzy with a frequency of once per hour, rather than once per day. When you enter a frenzy, the status bonus to attack rolls also applies to damage, but the penalty to AC increases to –3.
Monstrous Frenzy.name: Monstrous Frenzy

Moodscales.description: Your scales automatically change color to match your current temperament. This has the same effect as a @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.equipment.Item.VYtnxv13EtkyggD4]{Moodskin} augmentation, though it doesn't count as an augmentation and doesn't count toward your implant limit. When you select this feat, you can decide which colors correspond to each mood. Your keen awareness of your mood grants you a +1 circumstance bonus to saving throws against emotion effects. If you roll a success on a saving throw against an emotion effect, you get a critical success instead.
Moodscales.name: Moodscales

Mother Tongue.description: Your connection to the First World is strong. Whenever you meet a fey creature in a social situation, you can immediately attempt a Diplomacy check to [[/act make-an-impression]] on that creature rather than needing to converse for 1 minute. You take a –4 circumstance penalty to the check. If you fail, you can engage in 1 minute of conversation and attempt a new check at the end of that time rather than accepting the failure or critical failure result. In addition, you gain a +2 circumstance bonus to both Perception checks and saving throws against fey.
Mother Tongue.name: Mother Tongue

Mount.description:
You are proud to serve as a mount for your trusted allies. This might be a natural development, or it might be the result of intense training to ensure you can operate as a mount for your allies.

When another PC rides you as a mount, your expert coordination allows them to gain three actions at the start of their turn rather than the two they normally would for riding another PC. You still gain only two actions at the start of your turn instead of three, however, as you spend the third action keeping your ally balanced on your back and ensuring they're firmly mounted.
Mount.name: Mount

Mounted Unity.description: Your ability to bear your bonded partner into battle has further improved, and you act as one body and one mind. When your bonded partner rides you as a mount, you gain three actions at the start of your turn, rather than the two you normally would.
Mounted Unity.name: Mounted Unity

Mournful Howl.description:
Requirements You're within 30 feet of an ally with the dying condition.

The sight of an ally near death overwhelms you with sorrow. In an act of frustration, you unleash a mournful, keening howl that forces your enemies to share in your heartbreak. You deal @Damage[floor((@actor.level - 1)/2)d6[mental]|traits:nonlethal] nonlethal mental damage to all enemies in a @Template[emanation|distance:30] (@Check[will|against:class-spell|basic|options:area-effect] save using your class DC or spell DC, whichever is higher). The damage increases by 1d6 for every two levels you have beyond 13th.
Mournful Howl.name: Mournful Howl

Muck Trawler.description: The thick murky waters of the Deepmarsh are navigable to those who understand their tricks. You ignore difficult terrain and uneven ground caused by swamps and sewers. You don't gain the @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.AJh5ex99aV6VTggg]{Off-Guard} condition for not having a swim Speed during aquatic combat. If you have a swim Speed, you ignore non-magical difficult terrain while swimming underwater, but not greater difficult terrain.
Muck Trawler.name: Muck Trawler

Multi-Armed Grab.description:
Requirements You have a creature grappled or @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.VcDeM8A5oI6VqhbM]{Restrained} using one or more active limbs.

You use all of your available limbs to hold on tight. You use your second pair of arms to hold on to the @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.kWc1fhmv9LBiTuei]{Grabbed} or restrained target. If you're in quadrupedal posture, you automatically @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.actions.Item.L2k363LraGLUZIgM]{Change Posture} to bipedal as part of this action. The grabbed creature takes a –2 circumstance penalty to @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.actions.Item.SkZAQRkLLkmBQNB9]{Escape} being grabbed by you until the end of your next turn.

@UUID[Compendium.sf2e.feat-effects.Item.5KDHxCnc923wtc9M]{Effect: Multi-Armed Grab}
Multi-Armed Grab.name: Multi-Armed Grab

Multi-Legged Copaxi.description: You've grown more legs than a typical copaxi, or your legs are especially long, increasing the length of your strides. Your Speed increases by 5 feet.
Multi-Legged Copaxi.name: Multi-Legged Copaxi

Multi-Stemmed.description: Your body has two primary "trunks," one of which has diverged in nature from the other. Choose one khizar heritage that you don't already have; you gain that heritage and its benefits.
Multi-Stemmed.name: Multi-Stemmed

Multilingual.description:
You easily pick up new languages. You learn two new languages, chosen from common languages, uncommon languages, and any others you have access to. You learn an additional language if you are or become a master in Society and again if you are or become legendary.

Special You can select this feat multiple times. Each time, you learn additional languages.
Multilingual.name: Multilingual

Multitalented.description: You've learned to split your focus between multiple classes with ease. You gain a 2nd-level multiclass dedication feat, even if you normally couldn't take another dedication feat until you take more feats from your current archetype.
Multitalented.name: Multitalented

Multiverse Magic.description: Your paradoxical nature has given you access to magic that isn't associated with your spellcasting tradition. You can have one spell in your spell repertoire (not one on your paradox's spell list) that isn't from your spellcasting tradition. Select this spell when you select this feat. You can cast that spell as a spell of your spellcasting tradition, and it becomes a signature spell. You can change the spell you choose when you gain a level.
Multiverse Magic.name: Multiverse Magic

Mutable Manifestation.description: With practice, you can make on-the-fly battlefield adjustments to your weapon, letting you choose the perfect attack for a situation. When you @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.actions.Item.3xDhpvORBmK6AtcI]{Attune}, you can change the damage type of your solar weapon (but not its traits or weapon group), as if you'd @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.actions.Item.uvtdqSfKD6oXNA29]{Re-Forge Solar Weapon}.
Mutable Manifestation.name: Mutable Manifestation

Mutanter Goblin.description:
Your mutations are manifold. You gain one mutation from the @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.heritages.Item.WQCUa3yAIwoGKdad]{Mutant Goblin} heritage.

Special You can select this feat multiple times.
Mutanter Goblin.name: Mutanter Goblin

Mutantest Goblin.description:
You continue to mutate your body further to gain even more strange powers. You gain one mutation from the @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.heritages.Item.WQCUa3yAIwoGKdad]{Mutant Goblin} heritage.

Special If you have @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.feats.Item.fg4EVwA3e5IwA9Gy]{Mutanter Goblin}, you also gain the @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.feats.Item.sEb6KmjQVdWNTqiu]{Augmented Body} general feat but must choose a biotech augmentation.
Mutantest Goblin.name: Mutantest Goblin

Muzzle Flash.description:
Requirements You're wielding a gun.

Your attack distracts your foe. You @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.actions.Item.sLikawnrJJzHMYeC]{Aim} and then make a ranged Strike against your mark. If the Strike hits, the creature becomes @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.TkIyaNPgTZFBCCuh]{Dazzled} until the end of your next turn if it's within your first range increment.
Muzzle Flash.name: Muzzle Flash

My Friends Are My Power!.description:
The rush you get from helping your companions becomes even more intense in the heat of battle. When you successfully @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.actions.Item.HCl3pzVefiv9ZKQW]{Aid} an ally's attack, you gain a +1 circumstance bonus to your attack rolls until the end of your next turn.

@UUID[Compendium.sf2e.feat-effects.Item.JCLJ0NqggwDuoCeQ]{Effect: My Friends Are My Power!}
My Friends Are My Power!.name: My Friends Are My Power!

Mycelium Armor.description:
Frequency once per day

You use some of your host's energy to trigger immense growth in your mycelium network, growing a protective layer of tough, oozy fungus. For 1 minute, you gain a +2 status bonus to AC and resistance 10 to physical damage, and are @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.i3OJZU2nk64Df3xm]{Clumsy 1}. If you gain Hit Points or temporary Hit Points while this ability is active, until the end of your next turn, you deal an additional @Damage[2d6[poison]] damage with all your unarmed melee Strikes.
Mycelium Armor.name: Mycelium Armor

Mystic Dedication.description:
Choose a @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.class-features.Item.68j2yQ0lamRuR6oF]{Connection}. You become trained in the connection's skill or, if you were already trained, you become trained in a skill of your choice. You don't gain any other abilities from your choice of connection. You gain the @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.class-features.Item.kvyqzqiWsIrBZt6h]{Mystic Bond} class feature.

You cast spells like a mystic and gain the Cast a Spell activity. You gain a spell repertoire with two common cantrips from the spell list granted by your connection, from the spells granted by your connection, or any other cantrips of that tradition you learn or discover. You're trained in the spell attack modifier and spell DC statistics. Your key spellcasting attribute for mystic archetype spells is Wisdom, and they are mystic spells of your connection's tradition.

@UUID[Compendium.sf2e.journals.JournalEntry.vx5FGEG34AxI2dow.JournalEntryPage.qvvveaB7dnbiJjgG]{Mystic}
Mystic Dedication.name: Mystic Dedication

Nanite Arena.description:
The nanites in your synthetic cortex surge outward, dynamically connecting to one another to form a network of hardlight plates for 1 minute or until you use an Interact action to return all the nanites into your body. While the nanites are out in this way, you have the following characteristics.

  • As a 1-action activity, you can create a 1-foot thick, 5-foot long wall of hardlight in a point you can see within 30 feet. The wall has AC 10, Hardness 30, and 70 Hit Points, and it's immune to critical hits and precision damage. The wall blocks physical effects from passing through it but doesn't block line of sight.
  • You can use your senses as if you were in the position of any of these walls.
  • If a creature is adjacent to one of the hardlight walls while moving, it can spend 5 feet of movement to teleport to a square adjacent to any of the other hardlight walls.
  • While at least one hardlight wall is out, and if you're adjacent to a hardlight wall or it's between you and your attacker, you can use @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.feats.Item.jM72TjJ965jocBV8]{Shield Block} as if you had a shield raised, using the hardlight wall's Hardness and Hit Points. The wall disappears after the reaction is used.
Nanite Arena.name: Nanite Arena

Nanite Armament Boost.description:
Requirements You're wielding a weapon.

You pour your nanites into your weapon, empowering its next attacks. The weapon deals electricity damage instead of its normal damage type, and it gains the boost 1d4 trait until the end of your next turn.
Nanite Armament Boost.name: Nanite Armament Boost

Nanite Armament Efficiency.description: You manipulate your nanites more efficiently. When you use @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.feats.Item.PYOgmegDpeiynDiK]{Nanite Armament Boost}, you also take the Boost action.
Nanite Armament Efficiency.name: Nanite Armament Efficiency

Nanite Armament Overcharge.description: You gain even greater control over your nanites when using them to power up your weapons. When you use @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.feats.Item.PYOgmegDpeiynDiK]{Nanite Armament Boost}, your weapon gains the boost d8 trait instead of boost d4.
Nanite Armament Overcharge.name: Nanite Armament Overcharge

Nanite Communication.description: Your nanites can reshape your synthetic cortex to enable you to communicate mentally with creatures within 30 feet. You can communicate only with creatures that share a language with you. This doesn't give you any access to their thoughts, and it communicates no more information than normal speech would.
Nanite Communication.name: Nanite Communication

Nanite Form.description:
Frequency once per day

You change into a swarm of nanites for up to 1 minute or until you spend a single action to return to your normal shape. You become Huge, gain the swarm trait, and gain a fly Speed of 40 feet. As a swarm, you have the following characteristics.

  • You're immune to the @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.kWc1fhmv9LBiTuei]{Grabbed}, @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.j91X7x0XSomq8d60]{Prone}, and @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.VcDeM8A5oI6VqhbM]{Restrained} conditions.
  • You have weakness 5 to area and splash damage.
  • You can occupy the same space as other creatures and must do so to use your damaging ability.
  • As a 2-action activity, you can deal 10d6 acid damage to all creatures sharing your space (basic Reflex save with a DC equal to your class DC or spell DC, whichever is higher).
  • You can't speak, Cast Spells, use manipulate actions requiring your hands, Activate magic items, or make any Strikes with your normal body.
  • You don't gain the swarm mind ability, so you're still affected normally by mental effects.
Nanite Form.name: Nanite Form

Nanite Hardlight Construction.description: You can use your nanites and their hardlight projectors to form hardlight gear. You can cast @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.spells.Item.TUj8eugNqAvB1vVR]{Creation} as a 5th-rank arcane innate spell once per day. The item you create is a hardlight projection and has no monetary value; it also doesn't need to be made of earthen or plant-derived matter. It can't replicate a specific item, such as the key card to a specific lock, unless you have intricate knowledge of what the specific item looks like and how it works, such as knowing the data that needs to be on the keycard for it to open the lock. It otherwise functions as a mundane item of its kind until your next daily preparations, though it vanishes if you move more than 100 feet away from it.
Nanite Hardlight Construction.name: Nanite Hardlight Construction

Nanite Repair.description:
Frequency once per hour

You can use your nanites to repair objects. You touch a common tech item with a level up to your level with the @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.6dNUvdb1dhToNDj3]{Broken} or @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.6A2QDy8wRGCVQsSd]{Glitching} condition. It loses the broken condition until the end of your turn, allowing you to use the item as normal. You also reduce the glitching value of the item you touch by 1.
Nanite Repair.name: Nanite Repair

Nanite Scream.description: The nanites in your synthetic cortex not only enable you to mentally communicate with others, but you can also mentally attack your enemies. You can cast @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.spells.Item.EhN3GjdjXChMdiFk]{Share Pain} and @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.spells.Item.qkehzRdn7JeGrR6E]{Void Whispers} as 3rd-rank arcane innate spells once per day each.
Nanite Scream.name: Nanite Scream

Nanite Shield.description: Your nanites form into a network of hardlight projectors to create a protective barrier. You can cast the @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.spells.Item.TVKNbcgTee19PXZR]{Shield} cantrip as an arcane innate spell at will. A cantrip is heightened to a spell rank equal to half your level rounded up. When you use the @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.feats.Item.jM72TjJ965jocBV8]{Shield Block} reaction granted by the spell, your nanites surge back into your body, allowing you to Step as part of the same reaction.
Nanite Shield.name: Nanite Shield

Nanite Strangulation.description: The nanites in your synthetic cortex enable you to psychically reach out and grasp a vital part of a creature's anatomy and lift them. Once per day, you can cast @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.spells.Item.OudLZtxmg6gI1UEL]{Telekinetic Strangulation} as a 6th-rank arcane innate spell.
Nanite Strangulation.name: Nanite Strangulation

Nanite Surge.description:
Frequency once per hour

Trigger You attempt a skill check requiring three actions or fewer.

You stimulate your nanites, forcing your body to temporarily increase its efficiency. You gain a +2 status bonus to the triggering skill check. In addition, your circuitry glows, lighting a @Template[emanation|distance:10] with dim light for 1 round.
Nanite Surge.name: Nanite Surge

Nanite Tantrum.description: The nanites in your cortex are supercharged, enabling you to hurl objects in your environment. Once per day, you can cast @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.spells.Item.64DDZxOrmr4ddqs2]{Telekinetic Tantrum} as a 9th-rank arcane innate spell.
Nanite Tantrum.name: Nanite Tantrum

Nanite Tool.description:
Frequency once per day

You can use your nanites to create the perfect tool for a job. Outside of combat, you can have your nanites form a toolkit of a level no higher than half your level (minimum 0). The item lasts for 1 minute. Because your nanites must be actively working to provide the tool, you can't use other feats that require the use of your nanites while you're using them as a tool.
Nanite Tool.name: Nanite Tool

Natural Ambition.description: You were raised to be ambitious and always reach for the stars, leading you to progress quickly in your chosen field. You gain a 1st-level class feat for your class. You must meet the prerequisites, but you can select the feat later in the character creation process in order to determine which prerequisites you meet.
Natural Ambition.name: Natural Ambition

Natural Born Speedster.description: You've lived your life chasing the thrill of high speeds, so driving fast vehicles was a natural fit. You become trained in Piloting. If you are already trained in Piloting, you become trained in a Lore skill related to vehicles, such as Gambling Lore, Starship Lore, Travel Lore, or Vehicle Lore. You gain the @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.feats.Item.X5jW9JALKAKV18xj]{Express Driver} skill feat.
Natural Born Speedster.name: Natural Born Speedster

Natural Camouflage.description: Your scales blend in with the rocks and rubble of your home world. While you're outdoors on Akiton or a similar planet, and you're in a desert, mountain, or plains terrain, you don't need cover to @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.actions.Item.XMcnh4cSI32tljXa]{Hide} or @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.actions.Item.VMozDqMMuK5kpoX4]{Sneak} from creatures at least 10 feet away from you.
Natural Camouflage.name: Natural Camouflage

Natural Empathy.description: You have an empathic understanding of nature and can use your limited telepathy to communicate with plants and fungi, even if you don't share a common language. You can ask questions of, receive answers from, and use the Diplomacy skill with plants and fungi. In most cases, wild plants and fungi will give you time to make your case. You gain a +1 circumstance bonus to your checks to @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.actions.Item.OX4fy22hQgUHDr0q]{Make an Impression} on plants and fungi.
Natural Empathy.name: Natural Empathy

Natural Grace.description:
Frequency once per day

Trigger You fail an Acrobatics check or Reflex saving throw.

You have an almost supernatural control of your movements, which can sometimes save you in dangerous situations. You can reroll the triggering skill check or saving throw, using the second result even if it's worse.
Natural Grace.name: Natural Grace

Natural Hunter.description:
You have the keen instincts of a hunter and know to go for the throat. If you're a sharp-toothed vlaka, the damage you deal with your jaws increases to 1d8, and your jaws lose the finesse trait and gain the grapple trait. Otherwise, you gain a jaws unarmed attack that deals 1d4 piercing damage. Your jaws are in the brawling group and have the finesse and unarmed traits.

In either case, whenever you score a critical hit with your jaws unarmed attack, your target takes 1 persistent bleed damage per weapon damage die, in addition to the other effects of a critical hit.
Natural Hunter.name: Natural Hunter

Natural Skill.description: Your ingenuity allows you to learn a wide variety of skills. You gain the trained proficiency rank in two skills of your choice.
Natural Skill.name: Natural Skill

Necrogourmand.description: Whether through atonement, supernatural evolution, or mutation, your internal organs have regrown and reconnected to your soul in such a way that you can gain pleasure from eating and drinking once again, giving you a flushed, healthy appearance. This gives you a +1 status bonus on @Check[deception|options:necrogourmand] checks to appear as a non-undead creature. You can also now receive healing from items with the vitality trait that are eaten, ingested, absorbed, or injected (such as serums or oils), but you only receive half the normal amount of healing (rounded up).
Necrogourmand.name: Necrogourmand

Necrotized.description: You became a borai intentionally through necromantic experimentation conducted by yourself or someone else before you died. This experimentation has strengthened your defenses against death but has also made you look more like a corpse than a living being. You gain the Diehard feat, and death effects no longer kill you if they reduce you to 0 Hit Points. This keeps you from being automatically killed or from having your dying value automatically decrease, but it doesn't make you immune to other parts of the spell or effect. For example, you can still take mental damage and become frightened by a vision of death spell, you just don't instantly die from it.
Necrotized.name: Necrotized

Need for Speed.description:
Frequency once per day

You're always spinning your wheel, and you can strain your body and mind to push yourself beyond your normal limits. You become @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.nlCjDvLMf2EkV2dl]{Quickened} for 4 rounds. You can use the extra action each round only to Stride.
Need for Speed.name: Need for Speed

Network Attunement.description:
Target any number of your bonded allies within 120 feet

Feeling the surge of your strong communal bond, you temporarily attune your vitality network to the spiritual wavelength of your allies. Each ally can immediately choose to transfer up to 20 Hit Points from your vitality network into themselves or up to 20 Hit Points from themselves into the vitality network.
Network Attunement.name: Network Attunement

Network Shield.description:
Trigger You're hit by an attack.

You condense the energy of your vitality network into a shield. The triggering attack reduces your vitality network's Hit Points instead of your own, up to twice your level. Any remaining damage after your Vitality Network is reduced to 0 Hit Points is dealt to you instead.
Network Shield.name: Network Shield

Network of Know-How.description: Your synthetic brain is able to absorb a massive amount of practical knowledge, granting you the ability to accomplish various tasks you aren't specialized in. You gain the @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.feats.Item.9jGaBxLUtevZYcZO]{Untrained Improvisation} general feat. In addition, you can attempt skill actions that normally require you to be an expert, even if you're only untrained or trained.
Network of Know-How.name: Network of Know-How

Neutralizing Skin.description: Your skin is always moist, covered in a layer of secretions that keep your body from drying out. These secretions are powerful enough to partially neutralize any acid that comes into contact with your skin. You gain acid resistance equal to half your level.
Neutralizing Skin.name: Neutralizing Skin

Never A Step Wrong.description: You might have three left feet, but you also have three right feet. You have spent years perfecting traditional atraxid dancing. You become trained in Performance. You gain the Impressive Performance feat. When you attempt a Performance check to [[/act make-an-impression]] on a creature with more than two legs or hands, if you roll a critical failure, you get a failure instead.
Never A Step Wrong.name: Never A Step Wrong

Never Again.description:
Trigger You're about to gain the @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.yblD8fOR1J8rDwEQ]{Confused} or @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.9qGBRpbX9NEwtAAr]{Controlled} condition.

You refuse to surrender your autonomy ever again, and you've trained your mind to instinctively shake off mental control. Attempt a @Check[flat|dc:17]. On a success, you don't gain the triggering condition.
Never Again.name: Never Again

Never the Sucker.description: Others might be victims of ill omens or portents of doom, but you can shrug off even the darkest of tidings. Your luck might have faltered temporarily, leaving you in a precarious spot, but you can always trust it to help you set things right. When you would reduce the doomed condition by 1, reduce it by 2 instead. You also gain the @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.actions.Item.4yr6PSebbNdw9ofY]{Game Face} reaction.
Never the Sucker.name: Never the Sucker

New Epiphany.description: Through dedication or serendipity, you've branched out to explore other connections to the fundamental building blocks of the cosmos. You learn the initial epiphany spell of a connection that grants training in the prerequisite connection skill.

featPrerequisites.0: expert in a connection skill other than that of your chosen connection

New Epiphany.name: New Epiphany

New Path.description:
Frequency once per day

With a short moment of introspection, you can reposition yourself within the maze of life to find a new vocation. You can spend 10 minutes to Retrain the Lore skill you chose with @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.feats.Item.zW0sKlxIJHMhkly8]{Maze Lost} to a different subcategory.
New Path.name: New Path

Newborn Incarnate.description: You conjure forth a visage of the psychic imprint from the Newborn that imbues your heritage. You can cast @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.spells.Item.O6VQC1Bs4aSYDa6R]{Mask of Terror} as a 7th-rank occult innate spell once per day.
Newborn Incarnate.name: Newborn Incarnate

Nictitating Membrane.description:
Requirements You are @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.XgEqL1kFApUbl5Z2]{Blinded} or @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.TkIyaNPgTZFBCCuh]{Dazzled} with a duration of 1 minute or less.

You have a well-developed nictitating membrane, which you use to see underwater and clear out obstructions. If you are dazzled due to an effect other than Nictitating Membrane, reduce the flat check DC to target a creature with concealment caused by your dazzled condition from 5 to 3 until the end of your next turn. If you are blinded, attempt a @Check[flat|dc:10]. On a success, you remove the blinded condition and gain the dazzled condition instead for the same duration as the blinded condition. You cannot use this to remove a permanent blinded condition.
Nictitating Membrane.name: Nictitating Membrane

Night Eyes.description: Whether from hunting at night or having a deep connection to the void of space, you're at home in darkness. You become trained in Stealth. You gain the @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.feats.Item.beyw5bdA5hkQbmaG]{Terrain Stalker} skill feat, except instead of selecting a form of difficult terrain, you can use the feat in areas of dim light and darkness.
Night Eyes.name: Night Eyes

Nightvision Adaptation.description: The nanites in your ocular processors have adapted to darkness, enhancing your ability to see in the dark. You gain darkvision.
Nightvision Adaptation.name: Nightvision Adaptation

Nimble Crawl.description: You can @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.actions.Item.Tj055UcNm6UEgtCg]{Crawl} incredibly swiftly—up to half your Speed, rather than 5 feet. If you're a master in Acrobatics, you can Crawl at full Speed, and if you're legendary, you aren't @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.AJh5ex99aV6VTggg]{Off-Guard} while @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.j91X7x0XSomq8d60]{Prone}.
Nimble Crawl.name: Nimble Crawl

Nimble Runner.description: Few places are as hazardous to run through as the scrublands of Marata, and few people spend as much of their time running as young maraquois. You've gained an otherworldly expertise in placing your feet just right to rush over even the roughest ground. When you Stride, ignore the first 10 feet of non-magical difficult terrain, or treat 10 feet of non-magical greater difficult terrain as difficult terrain.
Nimble Runner.name: Nimble Runner

Nimble Tail.description: You have an incredibly nimble tail that helps you balance in zero gravity; this could be a hereditary gift from your ancestors as they adapted to spaceflight or the result of personal augmentation. You can use your tail to @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.actions.Item.FF5KgZHj345s2moq]{Push Off} while in zero-g without needing a free hand. In addition, you ignore the clumsy and @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.AJh5ex99aV6VTggg]{Off-Guard} penalties while @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.z1ucw4CLwLqHoAp3]{Untethered} in zero gravity.
Nimble Tail.name: Nimble Tail

Nimbus Block.description: You've combined the strength of your defensive powers such that your solar nimbus bolsters your solar shield. When you Shield Block a melee attack with your solar shield, as long as either you or your shield take damage from the attack, you can use Nimbus Ward as a free action.
Nimbus Block.name: Nimbus Block

Nimbus Ward.description:
Trigger You would be damage by an attack, spell, or other effect.

Requirements You're aware of the triggering effect and not offguard.

You harness your solar nimbus to protect yourself from harm. You gain resistance equal to half your level (rounded up) until the start of your next turn. You choose the type of resistance when you use this action, depending on your current attunement.

You can use Nimbus Ward as a reaction only when the requirements and trigger are met, but you can use it as a 1-action activity without the requirements or trigger being met.

Graviton-Attuned Your resistance can be one of the following types of damage: bludgeoning, force, piercing, or slashing.

Photon-Attuned Your resistance can be one of the following types of energy damage: acid, cold, electricity, fire, or sonic.
Nimbus Ward.name: Nimbus Ward

No Cause for Alarm.description:
You attempt to reduce panic. Attempt a @Check[diplomacy] check, comparing it to the Will DC of creatures in a @Template[emanation|distance:10] around you who are @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{Frightened}. Each of them is temporarily immune for 1 hour.

Critical Success Reduce the creature's frightened value by 2.

Success Reduce the creature's frightened value by 1.
No Cause for Alarm.name: No Cause for Alarm

No Memory Left Behind.description: By honoring the memories of each of your amalgamated souls, you've learned how to better learn from their experiences. You can use @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.feats.Item.qFl7dW2TBrekxk35]{Memories of Valor} once per hour instead of once per day.
No Memory Left Behind.name: No Memory Left Behind

No! My Baubles!.description: You carry so many trinkets around with you that you're only a little heartbroken when they shatter. You can use Treasure on My Heart once per hour instead of once per day.
No! My Baubles!.name: No! My Baubles!

Nomad's Guard.description: You have learned a technique practiced by shobhad boxers and warriors to fend off strikes from fists and blades. As long as you have at least one free hand (including an inactive hand), your fist unarmed attack gains the parry trait.
Nomad's Guard.name: Nomad's Guard

Nomad's Persistence.description: Shobhad-neh survive in conditions that would grind other species to exhaustion. When you would become @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.HL2l2VRSaQHu9lUw]{Fatigued}, attempt a @Check[flat|dc:17]. On a success, you aren't fatigued. If the fatigued condition has an underlying cause that you don't address, such as a lack of rest, you must attempt this check again at an interval determined by the GM until you fail the check or address the underlying cause.
Nomad's Persistence.name: Nomad's Persistence

Nondescript Features.description: People and machines both struggle to discern your features, making you difficult to keep track of in a crowd. You become trained in Society (or another skill of your choice if you're already trained) and gain the @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.feats.Item.49lDxXmZZ0eJFI78]{Blend In} skill feat.
Nondescript Features.name: Nondescript Features

Nonlethal Force.description:
You avoid harm when you can help it. During your daily preparations, you can designate a weapon on your person. It gains the nonlethal trait while you wield it. If you designate a new weapon during daily preparations, the previously designated weapon loses the nonlethal trait.

@UUID[Compendium.sf2e.feat-effects.Item.7pjshxAsWzyJRcze]{Effect: Nonlethal Force}
Nonlethal Force.name: Nonlethal Force

Nonlethal Spell.description: You can alter offensive spells to be less deadly. If your next action is to Cast a Spell that deals damage and doesn't have the death or void trait, that spell gains the nonlethal trait.
Nonlethal Spell.name: Nonlethal Spell

Nonlethal Spell (Peacekeeper).description: You can alter offensive spells to be less deadly. If your next action is to Cast a Spell that deals damage and doesn't have the death or void trait, that spell gains the nonlethal trait.
Nonlethal Spell (Peacekeeper).name: Nonlethal Spell (Peacekeeper)

Nonnegotiable Command.description:
Frequency once per 10 minutes

You bark a simple command to spur your allies to action. Select @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.actions.Item.Bcxarzksqt9ezrs6]{Stride}, @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.actions.Item.VjxZFuUXrCU94MWR]{Strike}, or @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.actions.Item.UHpkTuCtyaPqiCAB]{Step}. Your allies who can perceive your command can use their reaction to take the action you selected. This action gains the auditory trait if you shout, but not if you use telepathy.
Nonnegotiable Command.name: Nonnegotiable Command

Nonthreatening Visage.description: Let's face it—you're not scaring anyone; many find something inherently disarming about small, low-slung, cheerful talphis, and you're prepared to take full advantage of it. You gain the @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.feats.Item.B6HbYsLBWb1RR6Fx]{Charming Liar} skill feat as a bonus feat. Additionally, you gain a +1 circumstance bonus to Deception checks for initiative.
Nonthreatening Visage.name: Nonthreatening Visage

Nostalgia for Worlds Lost.description: You miss your home world of Aucturn, and even if you don't want to go back to your time there, the thought of its strange vistas fills your heart with fond memories. If you would critically fail a saving throw against an emotion effect, you get a failure instead. In addition, you gain the @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.actions.Item.QYBx5xYENl3hXZPB]{Thoughts of a Lost Home} action.
Nostalgia for Worlds Lost.name: Nostalgia for Worlds Lost

Not Falling for That.description:
Frequency once per day

Trigger You would be reduced to 0 Hit Points but not immediately killed.

This isn't your last limdive. You avoid being knocked out and remain at 1 Hit Point, and your @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.Yl48xTdMh3aeQYL2]{Wounded} condition increases by 1. For the next minute, you gain a +1 circumstance bonus to your AC and a +5-foot status bonus to your Speed.
Not Falling for That.name: Not Falling for That

Not So Vestigial.description: You've trained your vestigial limbs for combat, and once you have control of an enemy with your larger and more powerful limbs, the smaller, sneakier ones go to work. You're permanently @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.nlCjDvLMf2EkV2dl]{Quickened}. You can this extra action only to [[/act disarm]], [[/act grapple]]{grab}, or [[/act trip]] a creature.
Not So Vestigial.name: Not So Vestigial

Not as Bad as it Looked.description:
Frequency twice per day

Trigger You or an ally you can see within 15 feet rolls a critical failure on a saving throw or skill check.

Even when you or your ally's luck seems to run out, it's not as bad as it seems. The triggering critical failure becomes a failure instead.
Not as Bad as it Looked.name: Not as Bad as it Looked

Not in the Face.description:
Trigger A creature targets you with a melee attack.

You wave your arms to shield your face from harm and cower, acting meek and pitiful. Attempt a @Check[deception|against:will] check against the triggering creature's Will DC. The triggering creature is then immune to Not in the Face for 1 hour.

Critical Success Your attacker has second thoughts about harming you and is thoroughly thrown off. It takes a –2 status penalty to attack and damage rolls against you until the start of its next turn.

Success Your attacker is thrown off. It takes a –1 status penalty to attack rolls against you until the start of its next turn.

Failure Your attacker is temporarily thrown off. It takes a –1 status penalty to the triggering attack roll.

Critical Failure Your attacker is unaffected.

@UUID[Compendium.sf2e.feat-effects.Item.8uHTQ6ha3CT79fS6]{Effect: Not in the Face}
Not in the Face.name: Not in the Face

Novel Approach.description: Sure, one of your heads has already tried, but that's why you've got a spare! Your other half can offer a fresh perspective in high-pressure situations and patch up holes in your allies that you might have missed. Once per day, you can use Battle Medicine on a creature that's temporarily immune due to having already been treated with Battle Medicine.
Novel Approach.name: Novel Approach

Novel Mutation.description:
You present evolutions distinct from any other members of your species, like your ancestors developed for an environment different than your peers, but no records indicate how or what happened to necessitate your variance. Genetic or temporal attempts to trace your family history or lineage find nothing.

You gain one 1st-level ancestry feat you qualify for from an ancestry different from yours. That ancestry feat has the Gap-touched trait for you.
Novel Mutation.name: Novel Mutation

Novice Necrovite.description: Your studies as a necrovite have progressed, and you've learned how to influence mindless undead. You can use Diplomacy to [[/act make-an-impression]] on mindless undead or [[/act request]] simple tasks of them. If the undead creature is controlled by a creature with a higher level than yours, you typically need a critical success on your Diplomacy skill check.
Novice Necrovite.name: Novice Necrovite

Nuar Lore.description:
Nuars are no strangers to wandering the stars and exploring alien worlds, meeting other nuars along the way. You possess an innate sense of location that never leaves you truly lost. You become trained in Piloting and Survival. If you're already trained in one of those skills (from your background or class, for example), you instead become trained in a skill of your choice.

You also gain the @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.feats.Item.BocFD2KV0qgUC76x]{Additional Lore} general feat for Nuar Lore.
Nuar Lore.name: Nuar Lore

Nuke Form.description:
With a flash of nuclear fire, you suddenly transform into a radioactive monster, gaining the effects of a 7th-rank @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.spells.Item.1K6AYGisvo9gqdhs]{Elemental Form} for 1 minute. You gain immunity to radiation in this form. Creatures struck by your tendril must attempt a Fortitude save against mild radiation sickness. This radiation uses the higher of your class DC or spell DC in place of the radiation's normal Fortitude DC, has an immediate onset, and the interval between each stage is 1 round (but it doesn't cause glitching).

Saving Throw @Check[fortitude|against:class-spell|traits:disease]

Stage 1 @Damage[1d4[poison]] and @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.fesd1n5eVhpCSS18]{Sickened 1} (1 round)

Stage 2 @Damage[1d6[poison]] and @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.fesd1n5eVhpCSS18]{Sickened 2} (1 round)

Stage 3 @Damage[1d6[poison]] and @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.fesd1n5eVhpCSS18]{Sickened 3} (1 round)
Nuke Form.name: Nuke Form

Nutritionist.description: Your cilia are even more selective about the molecules they siphon for nutrients. You gain a +1 circumstance bonus to saving throws against diseases and poisons. If you roll a success on a saving throw against a disease or poison, you get a critical success instead. If you have a different ability that would improve the save in this way (such as the soldier's tough as nails class feature), if you roll a critical failure on the save, you get a failure instead.
Nutritionist.name: Nutritionist

Objects in Motion.description:
Requirements Your last action was a successful @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.actions.Item.7blmbDrQFNfdT731]{Shove}.

You leverage your knowledge of energy, mass, and motion against your opponents to manipulate their battlefield positioning. The Shoved creature continues moving. They're pushed back an additional 5 feet, or 10 feet if the required Shove was a critical success. If they would collide with a solid surface due to this movement, you immediately attempt to @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.actions.Item.ge56Lu1xXVFYUnLP]{Trip} them as a free action, even if they're no longer within your reach.
Objects in Motion.name: Objects in Motion

Oddity Identification.description: When you become aware of a magical effect or see a spell being cast, you can immediately determine if it twists minds (with the mental trait), fights against fortune (with the fortune or misfortune trait), or reveals secrets (with the detection, prediction, revelation, or scrying traits). At the GM's discretion, similar effects can also fall into these categories. When you [[/act identify-magic skill=occultism]] or [[/act recall-knowledge skill=occultism]] to learn more about these effects, you can always use Occultism without penalty and gain a +2 circumstance bonus.
Oddity Identification.name: Oddity Identification

Off the Top of my Head.description:
Frequency once per day

Your incredible processing power and near-perfect recall allow you to refocus even in stressful situations. You regain 1 Focus Point, up to your usual maximum.
Off the Top of my Head.name: Off the Top of my Head

Offensive Defense.description:
Requirements You have a force field upgrade in your armor or are holding a tech shield.

You overcharge a shield to create a concussive blast that repulses nearby foes. You @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.actions.Item.oc0ZKnk5zD0GXqZi]{Area Fire} using your force field or shield, dealing @Damage[2d10[bludgeoning]|options:area-damage,forced-movement] damage in a @Template[burst|distance:5]{5-foot radius burst} excluding yourself centered on one corner of a square you occupy. This attack has the tracking +1 trait and is in the shield weapon group. A creature that fails its save is pushed back 5 feet. If you have the primary target class feature, the primary target Strike uses your force field or shield.

Special If you're using a force field or shield that's superior or better, the tracking trait increases to +2, or +3 if ultimate or better. Likewise, if it's elite or better, the damage increases to @Damage[3d10[bludgeoning]|options:area-damage,forced-movement|shortLabel], or @Damage[4d10[bludgeoning]|options:area-damage,forced-movement|shortLabel] if paragon.
Offensive Defense.name: Offensive Defense

Offensive Subroutine.description: Nanites augment your attacks. You can choose to activate @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.feats.Item.JS24EjgLYcHB9E3T]{Nanite Surge} when you attempt an attack roll, instead of when you attempt a skill check. If you do, you gain a +1 status bonus to the triggering attack roll.
Offensive Subroutine.name: Offensive Subroutine

On A Roll.description: Nothing will stop you from moving forward. Each time you use an action with the move trait, you gain a +2 circumstance bonus to saves against effects that would impose the @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.HL2l2VRSaQHu9lUw]{Fatigued}, @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.eIcWbB5o3pP6OIMe]{Immobilized}, @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.6uEgoh53GbXuHpTF]{Paralyzed}, @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.xYTAsEpcJE1Ccni3]{Slowed}, or @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.enA7BxAjBb7ns1iF]{Suppressed} conditions until the end of your next turn. When you would be fatigued, immobilized, paralyzed, slowed, or suppressed for at least 2 rounds, reduce that duration by 1 round.
On A Roll.name: On A Roll

One with the Newborn.description:
You acknowledge that you are connected to the Newborn, now and forever, and have embraced the nascent godling as family. You become trained in Religion. If you would automatically become trained in this skill (from your background or class, for example), you instead become trained in another skill of your choice. You gain the @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.feats.Item.BocFD2KV0qgUC76x]{Additional Lore} general feat for Newborn Lore.

In addition, the first time each day that you gain the dying condition, the Newborn—or perhaps some other unknown force—automatically stabilizes you. You lose the dying condition, though you remain @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.fBnFDH2MTzgFijKf]{Unconscious} at 0 Hit Points.
One with the Newborn.name: One with the Newborn

One with the Stone.description:
You've achieved a full connection with the spirit of the rock, and the minerals meld with your body to aid you the moment you call. You can cast @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.spells.Item.wzctak6BxOW8xvFV]{Enlarge} once per hour as a 4th-rank primal innate spell targeting only yourself. When you do, you gain temporary Hit Points equal to your level for as long as the spell is in effect.

@UUID[Compendium.sf2e.feat-effects.Item.EKRBg0ydRsHdvc7G]{Effect: One with the Stone}
One with the Stone.name: One with the Stone

One with the Void.description: You've become so soaked in void energies from your studies that you're empowered by them. You gain void healing until you Dismiss the effect.
One with the Void.name: One with the Void

One-Izalguun Band.description: You use your multiple limbs to play two or more instruments at the same time, creating your own melodies, counter-melodies, and harmonies to impress your audience. You gain the @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.feats.Item.lFwfUvH2708rl6i3]{Virtuosic Performer} skill feat and can apply its benefits to keyboards, percussion, strings, synths, and winds.
One-Izalguun Band.name: One-Izalguun Band

Only Slightly Dead.description: Your living body is flush with vitality, which easily hides your ichor-filled veins from sight. You don't have to attempt Deception checks against a creature's Perception DC to successfully Impersonate yourself as a living member of your ancestry or hide your borai heritage, nor do you require a disguise kit for such Impersonations. This is a non-magical effect that doesn't protect against detection, revelation, or scrying effects. Additionally, when a creature actively attempts a Perception check against you, you gain a +4 circumstance bonus to your Deception DC, but only for the purposes of seeing through your disguise when you're Impersonating yourself as a living member of your ancestry or otherwise attempting to hide your borai heritage.
Only Slightly Dead.name: Only Slightly Dead

Oozy Brains.description: Your brains are just as oozy as the rest of your "body." You can move through a gap at least 2 inches wide without Squeezing and can [[/act squeeze]] through a gap at least 1 inch wide. When you're struck by a critical hit that deals physical damage, roll a @Check[flat|dc:20]. On a success, the hit becomes a normal hit.
Oozy Brains.name: Oozy Brains

Opening Roar.description: At the start of a combat encounter, if you are aware of your foes and aren't attempting to @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.actions.Item.VMozDqMMuK5kpoX4]{Sneak} or Hide, you can roll an Intimidation check for your initiative and can use the result to @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.actions.Item.2u915NdUyQan6uKF]{Demoralize} one observed foe.
Opening Roar.name: Opening Roar

Opening Volley.description:
Requirements You're wielding a gun and a melee weapon.

You shoot your target, then you follow up with a melee attack to keep the pressure on your foe. Make a ranged Strike with your held gun. If the Strike is successful, your next melee attack this round against the same target gains a +2 circumstance bonus to the attack roll.
Opening Volley.name: Opening Volley

Operative Dedication.description:
You become trained in simple and martial guns. You become trained in operative class DC.

You gain the @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.actions.Item.sLikawnrJJzHMYeC]{Aim} action, it doesn't deal additional damage, but still reduces the bonus to AC your mark gains from cover (which does not increase as you gain levels).

@UUID[Compendium.sf2e.journals.JournalEntry.vx5FGEG34AxI2dow.JournalEntryPage.GRlMj9GBfQurYjR0]{Operative}
Operative Dedication.name: Operative Dedication

Operative Exploit.description: You gain the exploit of your chosen specialization.
Operative Exploit.name: Operative Exploit

Operative Resiliency.description: You gain 3 additional Hit Points for each operative archetype class feat you have. As you continue selecting operative archetype class feats, you continue to gain additional Hit Points in this way.

featPrerequisites.1: class granting no more Hit Points per level than 6 + your Constitution

Operative Resiliency.name: Operative Resiliency

Opportune Retort.description:
Trigger A creature critically fails on a melee attack roll against you.

You take advantage of the opening in your foe's defenses. Make a ranged Strike against the triggering creature.
Opportune Retort.name: Opportune Retort

Opportunistic Hug.description:
Trigger A creature critically fails a melee Strike against you.

Requirements The triggering creature is within your reach, you have at least one free active hand, and your target is no more than one size larger than you.

You seize the opportunity to give your foe a big hug to help them feel better or calm down. You attempt an Athletics check to @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.actions.Item.PMbdMWc2QroouFGD]{Grapple} the triggering creature.

Special If you have the Titan Wrestler skill feat, you can use Opportunistic Hug against creatures up to two sizes larger than you, or up to three sizes larger than you if you're legendary in Athletics.
Opportunistic Hug.name: Opportunistic Hug

Optimistic Failure.description: You're an eternal optimist, and you wouldn't have it any other way! No matter how close you come to failing at a task (or how often you fail), you know if you just keep trying, you're bound to succeed. You can use @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.feats.Item.R0Vh8IFDSTTY8EIM]{Aw, Nuts!} once per hour, rather than once per day.
Optimistic Failure.name: Optimistic Failure

Orbital Defense.description:
Trigger You take damage from an enemy or hazard.

Requirements Satellites are currently orbiting you due to @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.feats.Item.3MFMVtHgpTvX3dlu]{Pull Into Orbit}.

You exert precise control over the debris that's orbiting you, purposefully placing it between you and harm to shield your body. You gain resistance equal to half your level against the triggering damage. Pull into Orbit immediately ends.
Orbital Defense.name: Orbital Defense

Orc Kinship.description:
The Quest for Sky caused many wars between orcs and dwarves in the past, but now, you're the only ones who can truly understand each other. You've spent time around orcs and learned from them, and you proudly count yourself among their friends.

You gain the @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.feats.Item.ihN8gkHSdPG9Trte]{Adopted Ancestry} general feat and must select orc as the feat's chosen ancestry. You also gain one 1st-level @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.ancestries.Item.lSGWXjcbOa6O5fTx]{Orc} ancestry feat.
Orc Kinship.name: Orc Kinship

Otherworldly Spell.description: Your spell has an odd appearance or cosmetic effect. If the next action you use is to Cast a Spell, creatures with the ability to Cast that Spell don't automatically know what the spell is. In addition, creatures that witness your spellcasting take a –2 circumstance penalty to checks to identify the spell with @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.actions.Item.1OagaWtBpVXExToo]{Recall Knowledge} and checks to counteract the spell and its effects.
Otherworldly Spell.name: Otherworldly Spell

Overcome Shame.description:
Frequency once per 10 minutes

Trigger You critically fail a Strike against an enemy.

You clear your mind of distractions and focus on your foe, determined to overcome the shame of your failure lest it forever blemish your reputation. The next time before the end of your turn that you attempt a Strike with the same weapon and target as the triggering attack, you roll the attack roll twice and use the higher result. If the attack misses, you're overwhelmed with shame, becoming @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.AJh5ex99aV6VTggg]{Off-Guard} until the end of your next turn.
Overcome Shame.name: Overcome Shame

Overcrowd.description: For as long as you are Small or smaller, you can end your movement in the same square as a Small or smaller ally. Only two creatures total can share the same space when using this ability or a similar one.
Overcrowd.name: Overcrowd

Overgrown Psychic.description: Your psychic abilities stimulate growth in the world around you. If the next action you use is to Cast a primal innate Spell, you make plants grow around you in a @Template[emanation|distance:15]. Other creatures treat this area as difficult terrain for 1 minute.
Overgrown Psychic.name: Overgrown Psychic

Overkill.description: Sometimes there's no better way to assure success than to pin a hapless enemy with concentrated firepower. When you @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.enA7BxAjBb7ns1iF]{Suppress} a creature with Area Fire or Auto-Fire and only one creature was in the area of your attack, or when you use @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.feats.Item.6AMH5DfG2cSz1tY0]{Concentrated Shot}, the target takes @Damage[1d10[persistent,bleed]] damage. If you critically hit it with your primary target Strike, this increases to @Damage[2d10[persistent,bleed]] damage.
Overkill.name: Overkill

Overly Helpful.description:
Trigger An ally is about to use an action that requires a skill check or attack roll.

You're always willing to jump in and help, even if you don't know what you're doing. You @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.actions.Item.HCl3pzVefiv9ZKQW]{Aid} a willing ally, even if you didn't prepare to help them ahead of time. You gain a +4 circumstance bonus on your check to Aid, but after the triggering check, your ally becomes @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.i3OJZU2nk64Df3xm]{Clumsy 1} until the end of their current turn.
Overly Helpful.name: Overly Helpful

Overproduction.description:
Frequency once per day

Your cilia help you to consume slowly even as they absorb nutrients, drawing out some extra potency from alchemical items. When you consume an alchemical item that has a duration of 1 minute or longer, that item's duration is doubled.
Overproduction.name: Overproduction

Overwatch.description:
Trigger A suppressed creature within your weapon's first range increment makes a ranged attack or leaves a square during a move action it's using.

You concentrate fire on a specific target operating within your weapon's threat range. Make a ranged Strike against the triggering creature, ignoring the unwieldy trait of weapons you wield for this Strike. On a critical hit, if the triggering action was a move action, you disrupt that action.
Overwatch.name: Overwatch

Overwhelming Assault.description: You overwhelm the defenses of suppressed foes. Your multiple attack penalty for attacks against suppressed targets is –4 (–3 with an agile weapon) on your second attack of the turn instead of –5, and –8 (–6 with an agile weapon) on your third and subsequent attacks of the turn instead of –10.
Overwhelming Assault.name: Overwhelming Assault

Overwhelming Ego.description: You can focus your mental Strikes with truly devastating precision. Whenever you critically hit using your psychic shock unarmed Strike, you get its critical specialization effect. The first time each round you hit an enemy you can sense with your thoughtsense using a psychic shock Strike, you deal an additional @Damage[1d4[persistent,mental]] damage to your target.
Overwhelming Ego.name: Overwhelming Ego

Overwhelming Shot.description: You pierce through your foe's resistance with a well-timed shot. You @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.actions.Item.sLikawnrJJzHMYeC]{Aim} and then make a Strike against your mark. Select one of the following damage types: acid, bludgeoning, cold, electricity, fire, mental, piercing, poison, slashing, or sonic damage. Your shot ignores an amount of the target's resistance to the selected damage type equal to your level. If the creature has a weakness to the selected damage type, increase that weakness by an amount equal to half your level. A creature's immunities are unaffected.
Overwhelming Shot.name: Overwhelming Shot

Pahtra Caterwaul.description:
Your strange singing voice can cause a moment's reconsideration or hesitation. Attempt a @Check[performance|against:will] check against the Will DC of a target within 30 feet. The target then becomes temporarily immune to your Pahtra Caterwaul for 24 hours.

Critical Success The target becomes @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{Frightened 1} and @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.e1XGnhKNSQIm5IXg]{Stupefied 1} as long as it's frightened.

Success The target becomes frightened 1.
Pahtra Caterwaul.name: Pahtra Caterwaul

Pahtra Lore.description:
You're an expert in both the traditional and modern pahtra performing arts. You gain the trained proficiency rank in Acrobatics and Performance. If you would automatically become trained in one of those skills (from your background or class, for example), you instead become trained in a skill of your choice.

You also gain the @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.feats.Item.BocFD2KV0qgUC76x]{Additional Lore} general feat for Pahtra Lore.
Pahtra Lore.name: Pahtra Lore

Paint Splash.description: Infused with primal magic, you can use your glowing pigment to dazzle your enemies in a spray of glittering paint. You can cast revealing light as a 2nd-rank primal innate spell. You can't use @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.spells.Item.0qaqksrGGDj74HXE]{Revealing Light} again until you spend 1 hour to forage for new pigments. It takes only 10 minutes to find these pigments if you're in an environment with a plethora of minerals appropriate for your paint, such as an underground cave or a vehicle paint and auto body shop.
Paint Splash.name: Paint Splash

Paragon Mageslayer.description:
Frequency once per 10 minutes

Trigger An enemy within 10 feet attempts to Cast a Spell or Activate a magic item.

You emit a burst of disruptive telepathic waves that disrupt the triggering creature's magic. Attempt a counteract check against the triggering effect; your counteract rank equals half your level (rounded up), and for the roll, use your attack roll modifier with your mageslayer claw.
Paragon Mageslayer.name: Paragon Mageslayer

Paranoid Lookout.description: You are ever vigilant and refuse to be caught unaware, always watching for enemies. Whether agents of Kadrical or corporate spies come after you, you'll be ready to move quickly if they appear. When you roll initiative while using the @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.actions.Item.kV3XM0YJeS2KCSOb]{Scout} exploration activity, you can roll twice and take the better result.
Paranoid Lookout.name: Paranoid Lookout

Pardon Me.description: You distract your foes with a clever comment as you maneuver around them. You can use @Check[deception|against:will|options:action:tumble-through] instead of Acrobatics to @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.actions.Item.21WIfSu7Xd7uKqV8]{Tumble Through} using the target's Will DC instead of Reflex DC. When you successfully Tumble Through using Deception, the foe whose space you passed through is @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.enA7BxAjBb7ns1iF]{Suppressed} until the end of its next turn.
Pardon Me.name: Pardon Me

Parkour.description: You dash forward, unhindered by obstacles or walls. Stride and @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.actions.Item.JUvAvruz7yRQXfz2]{Long Jump} or @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.actions.Item.2HJ4yuEFY1Cast4h]{High Jump} (in any order). You must start your movement on a horizontal surface. During this movement, you can ignore difficult terrain and run up vertical surfaces, like walls, at your full Speed. If you end the Stride off the ground, you fall after taking your next action or when your turn ends, whichever comes first (though you can @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.actions.Item.3yoajuKjwHZ9ApUY]{Grab an Edge}, if applicable).
Parkour.name: Parkour

Part of Me for You.description:
Requirements An adjacent ally is dying.

You give a substantial piece of yourself to bring an adjacent ally back from the brink, breaking a part of your body off to use your restorative body chemistry for emergency aid. Don't increase the value of the target's wounded or dying condition for 1 minute due to the results of recovery checks or losing the dying condition. The targeted creature immediately rolls a recovery check. The target is then immune to Part of Me for You for 24 hours.

Special The frequency of Restorative Tissues becomes once per 10 minutes rather than once per day.
Part of Me for You.name: Part of Me for You

Partial Corpsefolk.description: You died from massive traumatic injuries that caused you to lose body parts, or you rotted for a long time before you were brought back as an undead. There is no hiding your undead nature from onlookers unless you are wholly disguised, but you can manipulate your broken shards in creative ways. Your reduced mass gives you a +5-foot status bonus to your land Speed. In addition, you can spend 1 action that has the manipulate trait to break off a jagged piece of your own body to create a commercial @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.equipment.Item.V0LgOSOvkNvs2i0x]{Knife}. You can create a number of knives at a time equal to your Constitution modifier. They can't be sold and don't function for others. Effects that enhance your natural attacks, such as hardlight handwraps, apply their effects to a commercial knife created in this way while you're wielding it.
Partial Corpsefolk.name: Partial Corpsefolk

Partitioned Focus.description:
Frequency once per day

Your brain can process complex calculations subconsciously and save the answers for when they're needed most. You gain 1 Focus Point. If you don't spend this Focus Point by the end of this turn, you lose it.
Partitioned Focus.name: Partitioned Focus

Passive Environment Processing.description: Even while otherwise preoccupied, you can dedicate some of your brains to scanning your environment for threats. You can cast scan environment as a primal innate cantrip at will. A cantrip is heightened to a spell rank equal to half your level rounded up. You can cast this innate cantrip even while performing other tasks, such as resting, traveling, talking, fighting, or even casting other spells, but not while sleeping or otherwise @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.fBnFDH2MTzgFijKf]{Unconscious}. Additionally, once per day when you cast scan environment, you can change its casting time to 1 round instead of 10 minutes.
Passive Environment Processing.name: Passive Environment Processing

Passive Income.description: You're a creditor who has done business with many, many debtors. You can @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.actions.Item.QyzlsLrqM0EEwd7j]{Earn Income} using Intimidation as long as you're in a settlement or other area where your debtors have access to you. When you Earn Income using Intimidation, you spend no time gathering money; instead, it's delivered to you by a debtor at the end of the day, allowing you to simultaneously perform other downtime activities as long as you can still spend a few minutes every hour interacting with your debtors (such as Earning an Income by running a bar or Retraining at a gymnasium).
Passive Income.name: Passive Income

Patient Waiter.description: In traditional processes, a large part of an individual's life is spent waiting; you add value by reducing the amount of time wasted by waiting. You gain a +2 circumstance bonus to initiative rolls.
Patient Waiter.name: Patient Waiter

Pause Button.description:
Frequency once per day

You vanish from existence, severing your connection to reality for a moment. You cease to exist and disappear from your space, ending all ongoing conditions or effects on you. You return to the same space (or the closest unoccupied space if the same space is then occupied) immediately before the start of your next turn. When you return, you regain any ongoing conditions or effects from before you disappeared.
Pause Button.name: Pause Button

Peaceful Resolution.description: Hylax teaches peace, even when bloodshed seems inevitable in a given situation, and that diffusing a fight is always worth a try. Before you reach the point of no return, you make one last overture to your foe using all the wisdom that you've learned from the elders, your religion, or your family. You gain the @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.feats.Item.A0TNeMNvyY8QpmLz]{Legendary Negotiation} feat even if you don't meet the feat's prerequisites. If you are in combat and haven't struck the opponent you're attempting to negotiate with, the penalty to your Diplomacy check is reduced to –2.
Peaceful Resolution.name: Peaceful Resolution

Peacekeeper Adornments.description: You customize your armor with the symbols and seals of your command. You treat medium armor as light armor when determining your proficiency, and you treat heavy armor as medium armor. You customize your armor with Peacekeeper Adornments, gaining the armor specialization effects of that armor. While wearing this armor, you gain an item bonus to Intimidation checks equal to your armor's resilience value.
Peacekeeper Adornments.name: Peacekeeper Adornments

Peacekeeper Dedication.description:
You make peace with a grin and a gun. You become trained in Society or become an expert in it if you were already trained. You have familiarity with weapons with the nonlethal trait—for the purpose of proficiency, you treat any of these that are martial weapons as simple weapons and any that are advanced weapons as martial weapons.

At 5th level, whenever you get a critical hit with one of these weapons, you get its critical specialization effect.
Peacekeeper Dedication.name: Peacekeeper Dedication

Peacekeeper’s Armory.description:
You've drilled with countless weapons. You become trained in all martial weapons. If you're already trained in martial weapons, you become expert in a single weapon you're trained in.

Special You can select this feat more than once. Each time you do, you become expert in a weapon you're trained in.
Peacekeeper’s Armory.name: Peacekeeper’s Armory

Peek.description: You shoot and then duck out of the way to avoid retaliation and errant gunfire. Make a ranged Strike, then @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.actions.Item.ust1jJSCZQUhBZIz]{Take Cover}.
Peek.name: Peek

Percussive Maintenance.description:
Requirements You're holding a tech item that has the glitching condition.

You try to repair an item by smashing it against a hard surface. Attempt a @Check[flat|dc:10].

Critical Success Reduce the glitching condition by 2.

Success Reduce the glitching condition by 1.
Percussive Maintenance.name: Percussive Maintenance

Perfect Synergy.description:
Frequency once per round

You've mastered the art of collaboration, developing a means to lend others your own energy and cognitive capability. An ally within 30 feet is @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.nlCjDvLMf2EkV2dl]{Quickened} for 1 round. They can use this extra action only to Stride or Strike. That ally is temporarily immune to Perfect Synergy for 10 minutes.
Perfect Synergy.name: Perfect Synergy

Perfectly Balanced.description: You've come closer to finding balance between two extremes of energy, learning how to expel or draw in excess heat when necessary. You gain resistance 5 to cold and fire. Additionally, you gain the @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.actions.Item.9P2ZptR0PrYyiJFl]{Redirect Energy} reaction.
Perfectly Balanced.name: Perfectly Balanced

Perfectly-Attuned.description: You have absolute control and understanding of your attunement with the stellar forces of the cosmos. If you would become graviton- or photon-attuned, you instead become perfectly-attuned. When you're perfectly-attuned, you can choose which attunement bonus to benefit from (either graviton- or photon-attuned) when using any of your abilities. If any of your abilities require you to be in a specific attunement state, being perfectly-attuned counts as your choice of graviton- or photon-attuned.
Perfectly-Attuned.name: Perfectly-Attuned

Performance Review.description:
Trigger An ally within 30 feet of you critically fails a Strike

You quickly review your ally's strategy and give them the advice they need to improve their performance. The next Strike the triggering ally makes before the end of their turn has the same multiple attack penalty as the critically failed Strike, but it counts toward their multiple attack penalty as normal.
Performance Review.name: Performance Review

Peril Delver.description:
You know how to spot trouble. When using the @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.actions.Item.kV3XM0YJeS2KCSOb]{Scout} exploration activity, you gain a +2 circumstance bonus to your initiative roll instead of +1, but your allies still only receive a +1.

Special If you have @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.feats.Item.2kwXTUjYYhoAGySr]{Incredible Initiative}, you instead gain a +3 circumstance bonus to your initiative when using the Scout exploration activity.
Peril Delver.name: Peril Delver

Persistent Confidence.description: You always believe in yourself. You can use Confident Actualization once per hour, rather than once per day.
Persistent Confidence.name: Persistent Confidence

Persistent Protection.description: You trust that your deceased bonded partner is with you, even from beyond the grave. You can use Spirit's Protection once per hour, rather than once per day.
Persistent Protection.name: Persistent Protection

Persistent Quantum Field.description:
Frequency once per day

You can create a stable quantum field. You @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.actions.Item.ZoMpqQgDdlT13Jp0]{Warp Reality} with a duration of 1 minute.
Persistent Quantum Field.name: Persistent Quantum Field

Persistent Tactics.description:
You've learned which survival tactics work best for you and rely on them frequently. Select one of the following feats or abilities you possess: @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.actions.Item.6fsMvO0jXtK8gYkH]{Puff Up}, @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.feats.Item.Wb4vtGqg2Cl2FF1k]{Shed Skin}, @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.feats.Item.32W1Pnex4xbhx5Bj]{Squirt Blood}. You can use the selected ability once per 10 minutes, rather than once per hour.

Special You can take this feat more than once, selecting a different ability each time.

featPrerequisites.0: Puff Up, Shed Skin, or Squirt Blood

Persistent Tactics.name: Persistent Tactics

Personal Legend.description: You've begun to develop your personal legend about nuar history, tailored from your own study and interests. While not necessarily factual, the legend is captivating when you tell it. You can use any Lore skill in which you're trained to [[/act make-an-impression]] or [[/act create-a-diversion]], instead of using Diplomacy and Deception respectively. You take a –2 circumstance penalty to your Diplomacy checks using Lore if the target isn't interested in or trained in the same or a related Lore skill (creatures are trained in the skills listed in their stat blocks).
Personal Legend.name: Personal Legend

Personal Sacrifice.description:
Frequency once per day

Trigger You are about to attempt a skill check, attack roll, or saving throw.

In this world, there are few things more noble than a personal sacrifice. You use one of your personal trinkets to empower yourself. You do not roll the triggering check but instead earn a critical success. When you use this ability, the personal trinket is destroyed.
Personal Sacrifice.name: Personal Sacrifice

Personal Trinket.description:
You have an object that comforts you, such as a favorite rock, a childhood stuffed animal, or another trinket. While you hold your personal trinket, you gain a +1 circumstance bonus on saving throws and to Will DCs against fear effects. If your personal trinket is ever lost or destroyed, you can gain another one by spending 1 week of downtime searching for a suitable replacement.

Additionally, you gain the @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.actions.Item.cx5V4zwJFbsKG1ri]{Self Soothe} action.
Personal Trinket.name: Personal Trinket

Pharmacologically Impervious.description: A common way to try to stave off the Bleaching is to experiment with substances. As a result, each new generation of gnomes becomes more inured to toxic and hazardous materials. You gain poison resistance equal to half your level as well as a +1 circumstance bonus to Fortitude saves against diseases and poisons.
Pharmacologically Impervious.name: Pharmacologically Impervious

Phasorq About Town.description: You're built for the fast-paced social existence of a big city or busy space station. You become trained in Society. If you would already be trained in Society (from your background or class, for example), you instead become trained in another skill of your choice. In addition, you gain the Streetwise skill feat.
Phasorq About Town.name: Phasorq About Town

Phasorq Whiz.description: You become trained in Computers and Medicine. If you would automatically become trained in one of those skills (from your background or class, for example), you instead become trained in another skill of your choice. You also gain the Additional Lore general feat for Phasorq Lore.
Phasorq Whiz.name: Phasorq Whiz

Pheromone Connection.description: You learned to manipulate your pheromones in compensation for a lack of telepathy. You can [[/act make-an-impression traits=olfactory]] with your pheromones, which causes your attempt to lose the auditory and linguistic traits and instead gain the olfactory trait. If you use your pheromones to enhance your speech (by retaining the auditory and linguistic traits while also adding the olfactory trait to the action), you gain a +2 circumstance bonus to this check. When modified in this way, a failure on a check to Make an Impression becomes a critical failure instead.
Pheromone Connection.name: Pheromone Connection

Philosophical Damnation.description: Your understanding of the underlying nature of the multiverse allows you to call into question the existence of other beings. Once per day, you can cast @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.spells.Item.zdzeVZlKHkMAt2Rf]{Death Sentence} as an 8th-rank divine innate spell.
