Philosophical Damnation.name: Philosophical Damnation

Philosophical Font.description: You constantly accumulate knowledge about philosophies and multiversal understanding. During your daily preparations, you can call upon that knowledge and gain the trained proficiency rank in two Lore skills of your choice related to philosophies, religions, or the cosmos. You might select something like Abaddon Lore and Prophecies of Kalistrade Lore or Pharasma Lore and Boneyard Lore. This proficiency lasts until you prepare again. Since this proficiency is temporary, you can't use it as a prerequisite for a skill increase or a permanent character option like a feat.
Philosophical Font.name: Philosophical Font

Phishing Expertise.description: You're skilled at running digital fraud schemes. You can Create a Forgery using [[/act create-forgery skill=computers]]{Computers} instead of Society. Digital forgeries are compared against your Computers DC. Using information gained from a successful forgery usually requires additional checks, including Deception and Society, and casting too wide a net runs the risk of a potential victim figuring out your ruse and turning you in to the authorities.
Phishing Expertise.name: Phishing Expertise

Photosynthetic Regeneration.description:
Frequency once per day

Requirements You're exposed to natural sunlight.

Your body regenerates by taking in nutrients from natural sunlight. You gain regeneration 20 for 1 minute.
Photosynthetic Regeneration.name: Photosynthetic Regeneration

Phreaker.description:
You've learned how to hack using alternative methods. You can use Computers to Disable a Device or Hack a system using any computer, comm unit, or terminal instead of a hacking toolkit. If you're an expert in Computers and the equipment you use is at least 3rd level, you gain a +1 item bonus to Disable a Device or Hack.

Special If you have the @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.feats.Item.abcKcLvAGE5AKig4]{Combat Hack} or @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.feats.Item.0ZNErs9RICfOw1Nf]{Digital Diversion} skill feat, you can use this feat to Combat Hack or @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.actions.Item.GkmbTGfg8KcgynOA]{Create a Diversion} without a hacking toolkit.
Phreaker.name: Phreaker

Pick On Someone My Size.description: You know how to talk down creatures of larger size from making the mistake of attacking your allies. You become trained in Intimidation, or you gain the @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.feats.Item.xQMz6eDgX75WX2ce]{Intimidating Glare} skill feat if you were already trained. You gain a +1 circumstance bonus to your Intimidation checks to [[/act demoralize]] creatures of a larger size than you that attacked an ally since the beginning of your last turn.
Pick On Someone My Size.name: Pick On Someone My Size

Picklecore Music.description:
Picklecore, a blend of improvised jug band music, electronica, and power tools, is your jam. Attempt a @Check[performance|against:will|traits:auditory,linguistic] check against the Will DC of a single enemy or willing ally within 30 feet. This has all the usual traits and restrictions of a Performance check to sing. This can affect up to two targets within range if you have expert proficiency in Performance, four if you have master proficiency, and eight if you have legendary proficiency.

Critical Success If the target doesn't have the goblin trait, they become @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.AJh5ex99aV6VTggg]{Off-Guard} until the start of your next turn or the next time they're hit by a Strike, whichever comes first. If the target has the goblin trait, they instead gain a +5-foot status bonus to its Speeds for 1 round.

@UUID[Compendium.sf2e.feat-effects.Item.mKWPyxaEKvO5RrZx]{Effect: Picklecore Music (Critical Success)}

Success If the target doesn't have the goblin trait, they become off-guard against the next attack that you attempt against it before the end of your current turn.

Critical Failure You accidentally perform conventional music. As critical success, except goblins are affected as if they were non-goblins and vice versa.
Picklecore Music.name: Picklecore Music

Pickpocket.description: You can @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.actions.Item.RDXXE7wMrSPCLv5k]{Steal} or @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.actions.Item.ijZ0DDFpMkWqaShd]{Palm an Object} that's closely guarded, such as in a pocket, without taking the –5 penalty. You can't steal objects that would be extremely noticeable or time consuming to remove (like worn shoes or armor or actively wielded objects). If you're a master in Thievery, you can attempt to Steal from a creature in combat or otherwise on guard. When doing so, Stealing requires 2 actions instead of 1, and you take a –5 penalty.
Pickpocket.name: Pickpocket

Pin Down.description:
Trigger A creature you're observing succeeds at their saving throw against your @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.actions.Item.oc0ZKnk5zD0GXqZi]{Area Fire} or @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.actions.Item.6ctkxUnVwqooSvgg]{Auto-Fire} attack.

You focus your weapons fire on a resilient target in order to suppress them with the sheer ferocity of your assault. The required target must succeed at a @Check[will|against:soldier] save against your class DC or become @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.enA7BxAjBb7ns1iF]{Suppressed} until the start of your next turn.
Pin Down.name: Pin Down

Pinpoint Thoughtsense.description: You can track the minds around you with astonishing precision. Your thoughtsense becomes a precise sense.
Pinpoint Thoughtsense.name: Pinpoint Thoughtsense

Pirate's Parry.description:
Trigger An adjacent enemy attempts a melee Strike against you.

Requirements You are wielding a gun and a melee weapon with the agile trait or a phase cutlass.

You parry the triggering Strike with your melee weapon, gaining a +2 circumstance bonus to your AC against the attack. If the triggering Strike is a critical failure, you may attempt a ranged Strike against the triggering creature. This ranged Strike does not trigger reactions from the target.
Pirate's Parry.name: Pirate's Parry

Planar Survival.description: You can Subsist using Survival on different planes, even those without resources or natural phenomena you normally need. For instance, you can forage for food without penalty even if the plane lacks food that could normally sustain you. A success on your check to Subsist also prevents damage done by the plane to you and anyone else you support with Subsist. This applies only to damage dealt by the general conditions of the plane, not smaller hazards.
Planar Survival.name: Planar Survival

Planetary Bond.description:
Your bond has grown into a kinship with all that lives on your planet. You're constantly under the effects of @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.spells.Item.BBvV7qoXGdw09q1C]{Speak with Animals} and @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.spells.Item.qvwIwJ9QBihy8R0t]{Speak with Plants} while on your planet. You are considered a native of any planet in your bond. Creatures native to your planet feel an instinctual connection to you, granting a +2 circumstance bonus to Diplomacy checks when making a @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.actions.Item.DCb62iCBrJXy0Ik6]{Request} from them. Particularly helpful creatures may agree to minor tasks like delivering messages or spying on an area, but they won't do dangerous jobs or fight for you.

You vow to protect your bonded world. Gain the following edicts and anathemas.

Edicts defend your world from extraterrestrial threats, protect its natural resources from exploitation, form bonds with lifeforms on your planet

Anathemas disturb or harm your planet's ecosystem, plunder your planet's natural resources, exploit your planet's lifeforms

If your powers are lost due to anathema, you lose the effects of this feat and cannot bond with another planet only if you repent by conducting an @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.spells.Item.7Fd4lxozd11MQ55N]{Atone} ritual.
Planetary Bond.name: Planetary Bond

Planetary Reincarnation.description: Your bonded world revives you. Add breath of life to your primal spell list. While on a bonded planet, if you cast @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.spells.Item.Hnc7eGi7vyZenAIm]{Breath of Life} and target a member of your bond, @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.actions.Item.UeMHbnnaXDa3sGfG]{Transfer Vitality} to restore Hit Points to the target. If you do, the target regains additional Hit Points equal to their level (without spending any Hit Points from your vitality network), if they also follow the edicts and anathema of Planetary Bond. If you are on a bonded planet, you can cast breath of life on yourself when you would die, even if you are @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.fBnFDH2MTzgFijKf]{Unconscious}.
Planetary Reincarnation.name: Planetary Reincarnation

Plant Rumor.description:
Trigger You perceive a creature attempting a check using Deception, Diplomacy, or Intimidation against another creature's Will DC.

You intercede in a conversation to subtly damage another's reputation and make their argument less compelling. The creature targeted by the triggering check gains a +2 circumstance bonus to its Will DC for that check.

@UUID[Compendium.sf2e.feat-effects.Item.7tSTaSqLPYwPzbMx]{Effect: Plant Rumor}
Plant Rumor.name: Plant Rumor

Plantlike.description: You can become virtually indistinguishable from a common tree or tangled vines. You gain a +1 circumstance bonus to Stealth checks when you're in a natural area that contains flora, and you can use Deception to Impersonate plant life, including stationary plants like shrubs or plant creatures like ksariks. You gain a +1 circumstance bonus to these checks.
Plantlike.name: Plantlike

Plasma Ejection.description:
You unleash an ejection of plasma, hitting every creature in your choice of a @Template[type:emanation|distance:10] or in a @Template[type:line|distance:30]. Each creature in the area takes @Damage[((1 + floor(@actor.level / 2))d6)[fire]|options:area-damage,plasma-ejection-base-damage] damage with a @Check[reflex|against:solarian|basic|options:area-effect] save against your class DC. A creature that critically fails its save additionally takes @Damage[1d8[persistent,electricity]] damage.

Graviton-Attuned A creature that fails its save is knocked @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.j91X7x0XSomq8d60]{Prone}.

Photon-Attuned Increase the fire damage to d8s.

Level (+2) The damage increases by 1d6 (or 1d8 if you're photon-attuned).
Plasma Ejection.name: Plasma Ejection

Plated Deflection.description: You've mastered using your own plate scales or worn armor to absorb devastating strikes. You gain the @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.actions.Item.Z8GMkB50OfXBX67a]{Plate Deflection} reaction.

featPrerequisites.0: plated vesk heritage or Armor Ace

Plated Deflection.name: Plated Deflection

Plentiful Bile.description:
You have an unending supply of toxins and bile. Select one of the following abilities you possess: @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.feats.Item.iUdoilRjGH6dI9qI]{Coat in Bile}, @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.actions.Item.oKLA4xGqOkugw45C]{Slitherskin}, or @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.feats.Item.M8Kr3GSzRQFsu8QZ]{Spew Acidic Bile}. If you selected Coat in Bile or Spew Acidic Bile, the frequency of the selected ability becomes once per 10 minutes, rather than once per day. If you selected Slitherskin, the frequency of Slitherskin becomes once per 10 minutes, rather than once per hour.

Special You can take this feat more than once, selecting a different ability you possess each time.

featPrerequisites.0: Coat in Bile, slitherskin orocoran heritage, or Spew Acidic Bile

Plentiful Bile.name: Plentiful Bile

Plentiful Cirrisensors.description: You've acclimated to constantly using multiple cirrisensors in all directions as a defense mechanism. You can't be flanked by creatures of your level or lower.
Plentiful Cirrisensors.name: Plentiful Cirrisensors

Power Slide.description: You throw the vehicle into a barely controlled skid, turning sharply to evade pursuit. You Drive with a –2 penalty to your Piloting check, gaining the effects of the Drive action for the same number of actions you spent to Power Slide. At the end of the movement, if you succeed, you can turn the vehicle up to 90 degrees. If you critically succeed at your Piloting check, you can instead turn the vehicle up to 180 degrees.
Power Slide.name: Power Slide

Powerful Exhalation.description: Your ability to breathe energy is unparalleled. The area of your Dragonkin Breath increases to a @Template[type:cone|distance:30] and the damage dice are d6s instead of d4s. If you have the critical specialization effect of any weapon, a creature that gets a critical failure on their Reflex save against your dragonkin breath are affected by its corresponding critical weapon specialization effect.
Powerful Exhalation.name: Powerful Exhalation

Powerful Leap.description: You can jump 5 feet up with a vertical @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.actions.Item.d5I6018Mci2SWokk]{Leap} without making a @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.actions.Item.2HJ4yuEFY1Cast4h]{High Jump}. You also increase the horizontal distance when you Leap, including as part of a High Jump or @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.actions.Item.JUvAvruz7yRQXfz2]{Long Jump}, by 5 feet.
Powerful Leap.name: Powerful Leap

Powerful Limbs.description: It's not your fault being the biggest and the strongest. When fighting is inevitable, you've learned to use your superior bulk to grab and restrain smaller enemies. If nothing else, a foe in your grasp is less likely to harm your allies. Your powerful upper limbs have had plenty of practice wrestling, grabbing, and restraining smaller foes. You gain a +2 circumstance bonus on Athletics checks to [[/act grapple]] foes that are at least one size category smaller than you.
Powerful Limbs.name: Powerful Limbs

Practical Theologian.description: Your research and your religion make up two sides of the same coin for you, and to grow in one means to grow in both. You become trained in one Lore skill of your choice. Whenever your proficiency in Religion increases to expert or better, you also gain that new proficiency rank with the chosen Lore skill.
Practical Theologian.name: Practical Theologian

Practiced Escape.description:
Trigger A creature @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.actions.Item.PMbdMWc2QroouFGD]{Grabs}, @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.eIcWbB5o3pP6OIMe]{Immobilizes}, or @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.VcDeM8A5oI6VqhbM]{Restrains} you.

You've trained in close quarters combat and practiced how to escape a hold, or similar situations. You attempt to @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.actions.Item.SkZAQRkLLkmBQNB9]{Escape}. If you succeed or critically succeed, you can also Stand or Step.
Practiced Escape.name: Practiced Escape

Practiced Leader.description:
Your guidance provides your allies with exceptional assistance on tasks that are second nature to you. When your allies @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.actions.Item.tfa4Sh7wcxCEqL29]{Follow the Expert} and choose you as their expert, they gain a +3 circumstance bonus if you're an expert in the skill, or a +4 circumstance bonus if you're at least a master in the skill.

@UUID[Compendium.sf2e.feat-effects.Item.yNCAi4KGVSur8i26]{Effect: Practiced Leader}
Practiced Leader.name: Practiced Leader

Practiced Navigator.description: You've traveled to hundreds of places scattered across dozens of worlds and glimpsed wonders both beautiful and strange. When you roll a success on a Piloting check to Navigate or Plot Course, or on a Survival check to Sense Direction, you get a critical success instead. In addition, you gain a +10-foot circumstance bonus to Speed during overland travel.
Practiced Navigator.name: Practiced Navigator

Practiced Professional.description: Your attention to detail makes you stand out in your field, and your work comes to you automatically at the direst times. Gain the @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.feats.Item.W6Gl9ePmItfDHji0]{Assurance} feat for a skill of your choice. When you make an attack with a weapon that has the professional trait for a skill for which you have Assurance, you gain a +1 circumstance bonus to the attack roll.
Practiced Professional.name: Practiced Professional

Practiced Purification.description:
Frequency twice per day

You've studied medicine further to help others overcome illness and addiction. Choose an affliction and up to two of the following conditions affecting an adjacent ally: @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.yblD8fOR1J8rDwEQ]{Confused}, @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.9qGBRpbX9NEwtAAr]{Controlled}, @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.4D2KBtexWXa6oUMR]{Drained}, @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{Frightened}, @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.fesd1n5eVhpCSS18]{Sickened}, @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.e1XGnhKNSQIm5IXg]{Stupefied}. You reduce the stage of that affliction by 1 and the value of the conditions by 1. If the target still has the affliction or at least one of the conditions, attempt a @Check[medicine|options:counteract] check to counteract those remaining afflictions and conditions. Your counteract rank is equal to half your level rounded up.

featPrerequisites.0: expert in Medicine or Doctor in Training

Practiced Purification.name: Practiced Purification

Practiced Scion.description: You've honed your primal connection to the fonqon trees. Choose one 1st-rank primal spell and one 2nd-rank primal spell. You can cast each of these spells once per day as primal innate spells.
Practiced Scion.name: Practiced Scion

Precise Coagulation.description: You can precisely control your oozy body's coagulation when you're wounded to prevent unwanted seepage. Your DC on flat checks to end persistent bleed damage is reduced from 15 to 10, or from 10 to 5 after receiving especially appropriate assistance.
Precise Coagulation.name: Precise Coagulation

Predator's Eye.description: Your eye magnifies distant targets as well as a scope. You can adjust your sight in that eye as a single action to @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.actions.Item.BlAOM2X92SI6HMtJ]{Seek} a specific creature with a +2 circumstance bonus to your Perception check, or Seek to search a 10-foot square up to 100 feet away for any undetected or @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.iU0fEDdBp3rXpTMC]{Hidden} creatures or objects. You don't take penalties for an object or creature being too far away unless you're more than 2 miles away.
Predator's Eye.name: Predator's Eye

Predatory.description:
Battle is a dance, and you've honed your body into an instrument as exquisite as it is deadly. When you select this feat, you gain your choice of a claw unarmed attack or a jaws unarmed attack. Both of these attacks are in the brawling weapon group.

A claw unarmed attack deals 1d6 slashing damage and has the agile, finesse, pahtra, and unarmed traits.

A jaws unarmed attack deals 1d6 piercing damage and has the finesse, grapple, pahtra, and unarmed traits.

At 5th level, whenever you get a critical hit with one of these attacks, you get its critical specialization effect.

Special You can take this feat a second time. If you do, select the other attack from the options above.
Predatory.name: Predatory

Predatory Trance.description:
Frequency once per minute

You're an experienced warrior who can tap into your predatory instincts and completely focus on a single creature you can detect—to the exclusion of everything else. Those incapable of understanding these instincts might even believe you've lost your senses. The GM rolls a secret counteract check against any illusion, morph, or polymorph effect on a target, but only for the purposes of determining whether you see through it, with a counteract rank of 6 and a counteract modifier equal to your Perception modifier.

You get a +2 status bonus to Perception checks when you [[/act seek]] the chosen creature and to Survival checks to [[/act track]] the chosen creature, but all other creatures become @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.iU0fEDdBp3rXpTMC]{Hidden} to you. This lasts 1 minute, until the target dies, or until you fall @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.fBnFDH2MTzgFijKf]{Unconscious}, whichever comes first. If you take damage, you can voluntarily end your trance as a reaction, which has the concentrate trait.
Predatory Trance.name: Predatory Trance

Predict Outcome.description:
Frequency once per hour

You spend 10 minutes opening yourself to the mysteries of the multiverse by peering across different timelines or analyzing probability simulations. You gain the effects of @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.spells.Item.41TZEjhO6D1nWw2X]{Augury}, except you learn only about the dangers ahead; any results of "good" are instead "nothing," and results of "mixed" are instead "bad."

If you're legendary in Arcana or Occultism, you take only 1 minute to Predict Outcome.
Predict Outcome.name: Predict Outcome

Predictive Positioning.description:
Trigger An enemy damages you.

Requirements Your quantum field is active.

You reposition to a space you'd occupy in a different reality, free from incoming danger. You instantly teleport up to your Speed to an area within your quantum field. This movement doesn't trigger reactions based on movement and ignores hazards and terrain, but can't pass through walls or other such obstructions.
Predictive Positioning.name: Predictive Positioning

Predictive Strike.description:
Frequency once per 10 minutes

Requirements The target is within range of your limited telepathy.

You reach out and sense the surface thoughts of your foe, helping you predict exactly where they're going to be so you can strike true. Attempt a Perception check to [[/act sense-motive]].

Critical Success As success, except your attack also it deals 2 additional precision damage if you're trained in Perception, 4 if you're expert, 6 if you're master, and 8 if you're legendary.

Success The next time you make an attack roll against the target, roll twice and use the better result. If your attack is a critical hit, the target is so surprised by the efficacy of your attack that they're also @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.AJh5ex99aV6VTggg]{Off-Guard} until the beginning of your next turn.
Predictive Strike.name: Predictive Strike

Prehensile Limbs.description: One of your tails or tendrils functions like an extra hand and is capable of performing some precision tasks. You can hold one extra hand's worth of equipment with your prehensile limb, and you can use your prehensile limb to perform Interact actions. Your prehensile limb can be paired with another hand when you designate your active hands with the @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.actions.Item.oW81CfM9ebxXnrw3]{Switch Hands} action, and you can wield a shield or weapon in your prehensile limb when it's one of your active hands.
Prehensile Limbs.name: Prehensile Limbs

Prehensile Tail.description: Your tail functions like an extra limb. You can hold one extra hand's worth of equipment with your tail, and you can use your tail to perform Interact actions. You tail is considered one pair of hands for the purposes of designating your active hands with the @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.actions.Item.oW81CfM9ebxXnrw3]{Switch Hands} action.
Prehensile Tail.name: Prehensile Tail

Prescient Consumable.description: You can predict which consumables you might need in advance. When using @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.feats.Item.bh2jHyyYrkLMsIdX]{Prescient Planner}, you can procure a consumable item from your backpack, instead of a piece of adventuring gear. The consumable item must still be common with a level no higher than half your level, and its Bulk must be low enough that carrying it wouldn't have made you encumbered.
Prescient Consumable.name: Prescient Consumable

Prescient Planner.description:
Cost the Price of the chosen item

Requirements You haven't used this ability since the last time you were able to purchase goods.

You regularly create convoluted plans and contingencies, using your resources to enact them. You take 1 minute to remove your backpack, then carefully remove an item you hadn't previously declared that you purchased—you intuited that you would come to need the item and purchased it at the latest opportunity. The item must be a piece of adventuring gear, and can't be a weapon, armor, serum, magic item, or other treasure. It must be common with a level no higher than half your level, and its Bulk must be low enough that carrying it wouldn't have made you encumbered.
Prescient Planner.name: Prescient Planner

Press Your Luck.description: Now that you've gained otherworldly control over your own luck, you've learned to share your fortune with your allies. When an ally you can see rolls your lucky number, you can pass the good luck over to them and change their roll to a 20. Doing so counts as using your lucky number for the day.
Press Your Luck.name: Press Your Luck

Press-Gang the Soul.description:
Trigger You reduce an enemy to 0 Hit Points with a phase cutlass.

Your phase cutlass steals some of the enemy's vitality, press-ganging it into eternal servitude. As long as you are wielding a @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.equipment.Item.eBWGwv3rryQkHfh4]{Phase Cutlass} with stolen vitality, you can cast @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.spells.Item.Sqo1uzSmebVWpqoT]{Wisp Ally} as a divine innate spell at will, heightened to a spell rank equal to half your level. Using wisp ally this way requires and permanently releases one soul press-ganged with your phase cutlass. The first time each round you Strike with your phase cutlass, you immediately gain the effects of the Sustain a Spell action, which you can use only to extend the duration of and control a wisp ally spell cast using that phase cutlass.
Press-Gang the Soul.name: Press-Gang the Soul

Pressure Plates.description:
Frequency once per round

Requirements You're taking persistent bleed damage.

When you're bleeding, you can strategically realign your chitinous plates to apply pressure, staunch your wounds, and improve your chances of stopping the bleeding altogether. Attempt a flat check to recover from the persistent bleed damage. The DC of this check is 10 instead of 15. Even if you fail, the DC of the recovery check to stop the bleeding at the end of your turn is reduced to 10 this round as well.
Pressure Plates.name: Pressure Plates

Preternatural Skill.description: Your ability to focus on your interests encourages rapid talent growth, allowing you to leap ahead in your studies. You gain the @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.feats.Item.W6Gl9ePmItfDHji0]{Assurance} feat for up to two Lore skills you're trained in. You can retrain Preternatural Skill to gain Assurance for one different Lore skill with 1 day of downtime.
Preternatural Skill.name: Preternatural Skill

Prey's Attendance.description: You're practiced in keeping your eyestalks moving independently to better monitor for threats. This allows you to keep an eye on everything nearby and have battlefield control. You gain all-around vision. This lets you see in all directions and prevents you from being flanked.
Prey's Attendance.name: Prey's Attendance

Prey's Prowess.description: On Xofirth, you're one of the smallest sentient life-forms, and you've had to develop techniques to avoid much larger predators in a variety of situations. You become trained in Athletics or Survival. If you're already trained in both of those skills (from your background or class, for example), you instead become trained in another skill of your choice. Choose one kind of terrain from the following list: muddy, rocky, sandy, sloped, undergrowth. You ignore difficult terrain or uneven ground of that type.
Prey's Prowess.name: Prey's Prowess

Primafloral Adaptation.description: You can draw on a wellspring of primal power to cast @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.spells.Item.m2xFMNyQiUKQDRaj]{Energy Aegis} as a 7th-rank primal innate spell once per day.
Primafloral Adaptation.name: Primafloral Adaptation

Primal Ooze.description: You were born from a fonqon tree that was especially suffused with primal energies. You gain a +1 circumstance bonus to saving throws against primal spells and effects.
Primal Ooze.name: Primal Ooze

Primal Polyps.description: You've reconnected with some of the primal cosmic power of Tabrid Minor's copi, and it infuses the polyps of your body with energy. You can cast @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.spells.Item.Et8RSCLx8w7uOLvo]{Sound Body} and @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.spells.Item.aqRYNoSvxsVfqglH]{Unfettered Movement} as 7th-rank primal innate spells. You can cast each of these primal innate spells once per day.
Primal Polyps.name: Primal Polyps

Primal Vitality.description: As far removed as you might be from your First World ancestry, some spark of it still beats within you, giving you a supernaturally powerful connection to life. You Stride twice and can pass through other creatures' spaces without needing to [[/act tumble-through]]. Creatures of your choice whose space you pass through recover @Damage[@actor.level[healing]] Hit Points equal to your level. A creature with void healing treats this as a void effect. You gain temporary Hit Points equal to your level at the end of your movement. These last for 1 minute.
Primal Vitality.name: Primal Vitality

Primary Target.description: You gain the primary target class feature.
Primary Target.name: Primary Target

Prime Inheritor.description: You're the inheritor of your progenitor star's stellar glory. Your mere presence terrifies your enemies and emboldens your allies. You gain a +1 status bonus to Diplomacy and Intimidation checks. This bonus increases to +4 against novians. In addition, you gain the @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.actions.Item.lTxbKyZoxEJWqHjX]{Unleash Majesty} action.
Prime Inheritor.name: Prime Inheritor

Prismatic Display.description: You rapidly shift the colors of your skin to throw off the senses of those around you. Attempt a @Check[deception|against:perception] check against the Perception DCs of all creatures within melee reach. On a success, the creature becomes @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.i3OJZU2nk64Df3xm]{Clumsy 1} until the end of your turn (@UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.i3OJZU2nk64Df3xm]{Clumsy 2} on a critical success). Regardless of the result of your check, each creature is then temporarily immune to Prismatic Display for 10 minutes.
Prismatic Display.name: Prismatic Display

Prismeni Lore.description:
You've learned to leverage your intrinsic link to the Drift, making you an excellent pilot. You gain the trained proficiency rank in Piloting and Stealth. If you would automatically become trained in one of those skills (from your background or class, for example), you instead become trained in a skill of your choice.

You also gain the @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.feats.Item.BocFD2KV0qgUC76x]{Additional Lore} general feat for Prismeni Lore.
Prismeni Lore.name: Prismeni Lore

Proleptic Parry.description:
Trigger A Telepredicted creature targets you with a mental effect.

Requirements You have a bonus against the target using Telepredict.

You gain a +1 circumstance bonus to Will saving throws against the triggering effect. Increase this bonus to +2 if you've dealt mental damage to the target since the last time you used Telepredict. If you roll a critical success on the saving throw, the target takes @Damage[5d4[mental]] damage and becomes @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.e1XGnhKNSQIm5IXg]{Stupefied 1} until the end of your next turn.
Proleptic Parry.name: Proleptic Parry

Promising Pharmaceutical.description: You've learned to distill your blood into a potent pharmaceutical. During your daily preparations, you can create one dose of this medicine, which is a unique consumable serum with the effects of both a @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.equipment.Item.HWHdAQArhRauTpm6]{tactical medpatch} and an @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.equipment.Item.sOnw25eL6RJuc5rE]{advanced hypopen}. This medicine remains potent until your next daily preparations, at which point it breaks down and is useless. You can never sell the medicine created in this way. At 13th level, your medicine instead functions as both an @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.equipment.Item.55nSLw1aQ0K0rK2L]{advanced medpatch} and a @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.equipment.Item.kJmAAmnck30kNx2X]{superior hypopen}. At 17th level, your medicine instead functions as both a @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.equipment.Item.6VDHl7xkSp8Sc8yy]{superior medpatch} and an @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.equipment.Item.gRZxPwfmz3O0bgOt]{elite hypopen}.

featPrerequisites.0: bloodfilter orocoran heritage, trained in Crafting or Medicine

Promising Pharmaceutical.name: Promising Pharmaceutical

Prop Closet.description:
You've practiced enough with prop replica weapons that you can draw on these experiences in a real fight. Select a common advanced or martial weapon. You have familiarity with this weapon for the purposes of proficiency, and you treat this advanced weapon as a martial weapon, or martial weapon as a simple weapon.

At 5th level, whenever you get a critical hit with this weapon, you get its critical specialization effect.
Prop Closet.name: Prop Closet

Propelled Polyp Print.description: You have remarkable control over the polyps on your body. When you cast @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.spells.Item.pwzdSlJgYqN7bs2w]{Telekinetic Hand}, as long as you have line of effect and line of sight to your hand, you can use your telekinetic hand as the origin point for your spells that have a line or cone area. Additionally, you gain the @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.actions.Item.RNEFfOL4d6WkTTpP]{Polyp Print} activity.
Propelled Polyp Print.name: Propelled Polyp Print

Prophet.description:
You can divine the future. You can cast @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.spells.Item.pkcOby5prOausy1k]{Read Omens} and @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.spells.Item.Jmxru8zMdYMRuO5n]{Vision of Death} each once per day as 4th-rank spells. The tradition of this spell matches the tradition of the cantrip you gained from @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.feats.Item.Kgtj8NRoBnWCK9qw]{Sigiled Scales}.

At 17th level, the rank of vision of death increases to 6th.
Prophet.name: Prophet

Prophet's Premonition.description: Your magical scale markings give you insight into the future. You can cast @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.spells.Item.41TZEjhO6D1nWw2X]{Augury} twice per day as a 2nd-rank spell. The tradition of this spell matches the tradition of the cantrip you gained from @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.feats.Item.Kgtj8NRoBnWCK9qw]{Sigiled Scales}.
Prophet's Premonition.name: Prophet's Premonition

Propulsive Shield.description:
You fire blasts of solar energy through your raised shield, harnessing its gravitational force to propel your attacks. When you make a solar flare Strike while you have your solar shield raised, increase the range increment of your solar flare by 10 feet and increase the damage your solar flare deals by 1 per weapon damage die.

Graviton-Attuned The additional damage is bludgeoning damage. You gain a +2 circumstance bonus to the @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.actions.Item.ge56Lu1xXVFYUnLP]{Trip} attempt on a critical success.

Photon-Attuned The additional damage is fire damage. Increase the persistent fire damage on a critical success to 1d8.
Propulsive Shield.name: Propulsive Shield

Protect the Pack.description:
Requirements You're adjacent to an ally.

You're determined to protect your allies from harm—even if it hurts! Select one adjacent ally. Until the beginning of your next turn, you shield them with your body; any lesser cover you grant them is instead standard cover, though they can't use standard cover granted by you to Hide.
Protect the Pack.name: Protect the Pack

Protection of the Past.description:
Frequency once per day

Trigger You would fail a save against a spell or effect with the void trait.

The darkness between the stars isn't simply a void for your people, it's a storehouse for a great reserve of energy, built by generation after generation of maraquois. When the darkness threatens to take hold of you, the power of that ancestral wellspring swells forth and lifts you up. You reroll the triggering saving throw with a +1 status bonus. You must use the second result, even if it's worse.
Protection of the Past.name: Protection of the Past

Protective Bulk.description:
No matter the dangers posed to your person, you've always prioritized the safety of your allies over your own wellbeing. Whenever you Raise a Shield or position a weapon with the parry trait defensively, you can choose to increase the AC of up to two adjacent allies instead of your own. If you have the Stretching Reach feat, increase the effective range of your protection by 5 feet. As long as the selected allies remain within your reach and your shield is raised, they gain the circumstance bonus to AC from your shield or weapon, while you take a –1 circumstance penalty to AC while concentrating on the defense of those around you.

@UUID[Compendium.sf2e.feat-effects.Item.0vdPkTib9LO8dj2y]{Effect: Protective Bulk}

Special If you have the @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.feats.Item.jM72TjJ965jocBV8]{Shield Block} feat, during this time, you can trigger Shield Block when you have your shield raised and one of the selected allies would take damage from a physical attack, but you can't use Shield Block to protect yourself.
Protective Bulk.name: Protective Bulk

Protective Subroutine.description: Your nanites can augment your defenses. You can choose to activate @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.feats.Item.JS24EjgLYcHB9E3T]{Nanite Surge} when you attempt a saving throw, instead of when you attempt a skill check. If you do, you gain a +2 status bonus to the triggering saving throw.
Protective Subroutine.name: Protective Subroutine

Prototype Electroencephalon.description:
Frequency once every 10 minutes

Trigger You're critically hit by an attack.

When Eox's atmosphere burned, necrovites crafted devices called electroencephalons in order to house their souls and transition themselves into undead beings who could survive the eons since that cataclysmic event. You've learned the basics of this technology and have crafted a similar device. Attempt a @Check[flat|dc:10]. On a success, the triggering hit becomes a normal hit.
Prototype Electroencephalon.name: Prototype Electroencephalon

Proudhome Puff.description: You've integrated a fungal biotech to help manage your growth. You vent spores from your body in a @Template[emanation|distance:30], dealing @Damage[max(ceil(@actor.level/2),7)d4[poison]|options:area-damage] damage to creatures in the area with a basic @Check[fortitude|against:class-spell|basic|options:area-effect,inflicts:sickened] save against the higher of your class DC or spell DC. The damage increases by 1d4 for every two levels you have beyond 13th level. A creature that fails its save is also @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.fesd1n5eVhpCSS18]{Sickened 1} (@UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.fesd1n5eVhpCSS18]{Sickened 2} on a critical failure). You can't use Proudhome Puff again for [[/r 1d4 #Recharge Proudhome Puff]]{1d4 rounds}.
Proudhome Puff.name: Proudhome Puff

Psychic Bully.description: You can leverage your telepathic abilities to influence the minds of others, imparting orders or inflaming fears. You can cast @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.spells.Item.aIHY2DArKFweIrpf]{Command} and @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.spells.Item.4koZzrnMXhhosn0D]{Fear} as 1st-rank occult innate spells. You can cast each of these occult innate spells once per day.

featPrerequisites.0: korasha lashunta or unbound lashunta heritage

Psychic Bully.name: Psychic Bully

Psychic Constellation.description: You effortlessly juggle an assortment of gear with your telepathy, giving you the appearance of a solar cerebellum orbited by planetoid items. You gain a second set of telekinetic hands, per Mind Over Matter, granting a typical contemplative six hands total. While at least one of your telekinetic hands is empty, you can deflect incoming attacks, granting your fist attack the parry trait. You gain the @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.actions.Item.fQJ8xyZH3Dch5xtN]{Eccentric Orbit} free action.
Psychic Constellation.name: Psychic Constellation

Psychic Droning.description:
Frequency once per hour

You let out a psychic droning sound that interferes with telepathic communication. Other creatures in a @Template[emanation|distance:15] around you must attempt a @Check[will|against:spell-class|options:area-effect,damaging-effect,inflicts:confused,inflicts:deafened] save against the higher of your class DC or spell DC.

Critical Success The creature is unaffected.

Success The creature is @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.9PR9y0bi4JPKnHPR]{Deafened} and is unable to communicate telepathically for 1 round.

Failure As success, and the creature also takes @Damage[3d8[mental]|options:area-damage] damage.

Critical Failure As success, and the creature also takes @Damage[6d8[mental]|options:area-damage] damage and is @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.yblD8fOR1J8rDwEQ]{Confused} until the end of their next turn.
Psychic Droning.name: Psychic Droning

Psychic Fungal Mastery.description: Your potent psychic powers have steadily grown as you and your host's minds merge and evolve, granting you additional magic. Choose one 1st-rank or 2nd-rank spell with the fungus or plant trait or from the occult spell list. You can cast that spell as a 2nd-rank occult innate spell once per day.
Psychic Fungal Mastery.name: Psychic Fungal Mastery

Psychic Fungus.description: You've awakened dormant psychic abilities in your host by unlocking atrophied sensory and nervous organs. Choose one cantrip that has the fungus or plant trait or is from the occult spell list. You can cast this cantrip as an occult innate spell at will. A cantrip is heightened to a spell rank equal to half your level rounded up.
Psychic Fungus.name: Psychic Fungus

Psychic Interrogation.description:
Requirements You share a language with the target, who is in range of your limited telepathy.

You mentally ambush a creature. Telepathically ask a question of a non-allied creature that you can see within range of your limited telepathy. The target must attempt a @Check[type:will|against:class-spell] saving throw against the higher of your class DC or spell DC. Regardless of the result, the target is temporarily immune to your Psychic Interrogation for 1 hour.

Critical Success The target is unaffected.

Success The target is slightly distracted by your question and can't use reactions until the end of your next turn.

Failure The target's mind is consumed by the thought of your question. They can't use reactions until the end of your next turn and are @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.e1XGnhKNSQIm5IXg]{Stupefied 1} for 1 minute. They can end the stupefied condition early by taking an action to telepathically reply to your question. They don't have to answer truthfully, but you gain a +2 circumstance bonus to your Perception DC if the target attempts to Lie to you, which increases to +4 if you have the Psychic Investigation feat.

Critical Failure As failure, but the target becomes @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.e1XGnhKNSQIm5IXg]{Stupefied 2}.
Psychic Interrogation.name: Psychic Interrogation

Psychic Investigation.description: You're constantly casting your mind out as you search for clues. You gain a +2 circumstance bonus to Perception checks to [[/act sense-motive]] and to [[/act seek]] creatures who aren't immune to mental effects and within range of your limited telepathy, and a +2 circumstance bonus to your Perception DC against such creatures attempting to Lie to you.
Psychic Investigation.name: Psychic Investigation

Psychic Investigator.description: You can use your telepathic abilities to quickly assess your circumstances or subtly glean information from the minds of others. You can cast @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.spells.Item.ZYoC630tNGutgbE0]{Hypercognition} and @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.spells.Item.KHnhPHL4x1AQHfbC]{Mind Reading} as 3rd-rank occult innate spells. You can cast each of these occult innate spells once per day.

featPrerequisites.0: Psychic Bully, Psychic Scholar, or Psychic Talent

Psychic Investigator.name: Psychic Investigator

Psychic Irregularity.description: Other psychic ancestries find the aberrant nature of your prowess to be unusual, and it can be difficult for them to adapt to contact with your mind. You gain mental resistance equal to half your level (minimum 1).
Psychic Irregularity.name: Psychic Irregularity

Psychic Master.description: Your psychic abilities have grown stronger. Choose one common 2nd-rank spell from the occult spell list. You can cast that spell as an occult innate spell once per day.
Psychic Master.name: Psychic Master

Psychic Mastery.description: Your psychic abilities have grown stronger, allowing you to tap into entirely new dimensions of psychic power. Choose one common 2nd-rank spell from the occult spell list. You can cast that spell as an occult innate spell once per day.
Psychic Mastery.name: Psychic Mastery

Psychic Paragon.description: Your psychic abilities have grown stronger. Choose one common 6th-rank spell from the occult spell list. You can cast that spell as an occult innate spell once per day.
Psychic Paragon.name: Psychic Paragon

Psychic Retaliation.description: The psychic static that shrouds your mind is a weapon as much as a defense. Whenever you use Static Shield and succeed at the triggering save, if the source of the mental effect was a creature, your psychic static lashes out at them and deals mental damage equal to half your level (or equal to your level on a critical success, @Damage[(floor(@actor.level/2))[mental]], @Damage[(@actor.level)[mental]]).
Psychic Retaliation.name: Psychic Retaliation

Psychic Scholar.description: You can transfer vast amounts of information to the minds of others in mere moments. You can cast @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.spells.Item.D442XMADp01qJ7Cs]{Mindlink} as a 1st-rank occult innate spell twice per day.

featPrerequisites.0: Damaya Lashunta or Unbound Lashunta heritage

Psychic Scholar.name: Psychic Scholar

Psychic Talent.description: Your psychic abilities have developed beyond simple communication. Choose one cantrip from the occult spell list. You can cast this cantrip as an occult innate spell at will. A cantrip is heightened to a spell rank equal to half your level rounded up.
Psychic Talent.name: Psychic Talent

Psychic Wedge.description:
Your mastery of your psychic powers makes your targets more susceptible to later spells. When a creature fails or critically fails a saving throw against one of your innate spells gained from an ancestry feat, they take a –1 status penalty to saving throws against your other innate spells until the end of your next turn.

@UUID[Compendium.sf2e.feat-effects.Item.S3GNkuot8Ll6m0vK]{Effect: Psychic Wedge}

featPrerequisites.1: at least one innate spell granted by an ancestry feat

Psychic Wedge.name: Psychic Wedge

Pull Into Orbit.description:
Frequency once per 10 minutes

You exert your gravitational field upon your surroundings, causing small objects, debris, and stellar ejecta from your own body to orbit you like miniature satellites. These satellites grant you lesser cover until the beginning of your next turn.

At 9th level and every 4 levels thereafter, your satellites remain in orbit for 1 additional round, up to a maximum of 4 rounds at 17th level.
Pull Into Orbit.name: Pull Into Orbit

Pulonis Softstep.description: You're so light on your feet you can even move through tall grass without leaving any tracks. You gain the @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.feats.Item.c9fHUSI5lRdXu1Ic]{Feather Step} general feat, even if you don't meet its prerequisites. You can @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.actions.Item.SB7cMECVtE06kByk]{Cover Tracks} using Acrobatics instead of Survival.
Pulonis Softstep.name: Pulonis Softstep

Pulse Light.description: You surge your internal light in a brilliant flash, disorienting everyone nearby and revealing anything that would try to hide from your sight. You can cast @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.spells.Item.0qaqksrGGDj74HXE]{Revealing Light} as a 2nd-rank primal innate spell once per hour, except it doesn't dazzle moonflowers and moonflower leshies.
Pulse Light.name: Pulse Light

Pungent Astrazoan.description: You emit the reeking smell of rotting meat when you disgorge your stomach. While you can thoroughly mask the scent by shapeshifting to eat like other species, disgorging your stomach to intentionally emit this vile odor can come in handy when you are trying to dissuade predators, whether they are hungry beasts or murderous mobsters. You become trained in Deception and gain the @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.feats.Item.HEBXaS656MZTiWFu]{Lengthy Diversion} skill feat as a bonus feat, even if you don't meet its prerequisites.
Pungent Astrazoan.name: Pungent Astrazoan

Punishing Salvo.description:
Requirements Your last action this turn was an @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.actions.Item.oc0ZKnk5zD0GXqZi]{Area Fire} attack.

You know unleashing a barrage of gunfire can bring most enemies low. You make a follow-up Strike against your primary target using the same weapon. Ignore the unwieldy trait on your weapon when using this action. This doesn't make a new area attack and is treated as a Strike made using primary target.
Punishing Salvo.name: Punishing Salvo

Punishing Spines.description:
Frequency once per 10 minutes

Trigger You are hit with an unarmed Strike or an adjacent creature hits you with a melee weapon Strike.

Your long, sharp spines and tough, spiked ridges protect your body. You defend yourself by reflexively Striking the triggering creature with your spine unarmed attack.
Punishing Spines.name: Punishing Spines

Punitive Strike.description:
Trigger A creature within your reach uses a manipulate action, makes a ranged Strike, uses a move action, or leaves a square during a move action it's using.

Your foe's momentary lapse in defense gives you an opening Make a melee Strike against the triggering creature, ignoring the unwieldy trait on any weapons you're wielding for this Strike. This Strike doesn't count toward your multiple attack penalty, and your multiple attack penalty doesn't apply to this Strike.
Punitive Strike.name: Punitive Strike

Purge Stomach.description:
Frequency once per day

Trigger You gain the @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.fesd1n5eVhpCSS18]{Sickened} condition or fail a save against an ingested poison.

Requirements You can use @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.ancestry-features.Item.jjVH7W3IhgaJ5Yct]{Fire Breath}.

Thanks to control of your stomach, you can expel foreign substances in your body with ease. Reduce your sickened condition by 2, and immediately attempt a saving throw with a +2 circumstance bonus against any ingested poisons you've been exposed to within the last minute. You can't use @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.ancestry-features.Item.jjVH7W3IhgaJ5Yct]{Fire Breath} for [[/r 1d4 #rounds]]{1d4 rounds}.
Purge Stomach.name: Purge Stomach

Push It.description: Whenever you succeed at a Piloting check, the vehicle you're piloting gains a +10-foot circumstance bonus to all its Speeds until the end of your turn. If you critically succeed, this bonus increases to +15 feet.
Push It.name: Push It

Put Your Heads Together.description:
Frequency once per day

Trigger You attempt a check to @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.actions.Item.1OagaWtBpVXExToo]{Recall Knowledge}.

Your head would clearly be lost if it wasn't for your other head. For the triggering check, one of your heads can attempt to Aid the other. For the purposes of this check, both of your heads use the same skill bonuses.
Put Your Heads Together.name: Put Your Heads Together

Put it Back Together.description: When outside technology started streaming into Marata, industrious maraquois didn't simply accept it: they wanted to learn how it worked. You love taking new toys apart to see what makes them tick—but unlike most, you can always put them back together. You become trained in Crafting. If you would automatically become trained in Crafting (from your background or class, for example), you instead become trained in another skill of your choice. You gain a +2 circumstance bonus to Crafting checks to Craft a formula by reverse engineering it from an item you possess.
Put it Back Together.name: Put it Back Together

Puzzling Outburst.description:
You quickly shout a mind-bending brainteaser at one creature within 30 feet. That creature must attempt a Will saving throw against your choice of your @Check[will|against:deception]{Deception} or your @Check[will|against:crafting]{Crafting}. Regardless of the result, the creature is then temporarily immune to your Puzzling Outburst for 24 hours.

Critical Success The creature figures out your riddle so fast that your ego is bruised. You cannot use Puzzling Outburst for 10 minutes.

Success The creature is unaffected.

Failure The creature is stumped and becomes @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.e1XGnhKNSQIm5IXg]{Stupefied 1} for one minute.

Critical Failure The creature is completely stumped by your riddle and is @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.e1XGnhKNSQIm5IXg]{Stupefied 2} for one minute.
Puzzling Outburst.name: Puzzling Outburst

Quad Juggle.description: When you take the @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.actions.Item.L2k363LraGLUZIgM]{Change Posture} action, you can @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.actions.Item.oW81CfM9ebxXnrw3]{Switch Hands} and put away or swap any number of items between your hands.
Quad Juggle.name: Quad Juggle

Quadrupedal Speed.description: You can run incredibly fast on all fours. Your Speed is 30 feet as long as you have two free hands.
Quadrupedal Speed.name: Quadrupedal Speed

Quantum Aura.description: You can become the nexus of the warped reality you create. Each time you use @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.actions.Item.ZoMpqQgDdlT13Jp0]{Warp Reality} to activate your quantum field, you can choose for your quantum field to be an aura around you that moves with you. If you do, your Warp Reality action gains the aura trait, and the quantum field you create is a 10-foot-radius emanation.
Quantum Aura.name: Quantum Aura

Quantum Breadth.description: Your repertoire expands, and you can cast more spells of your paradox's tradition each day. Increase the number of spells in your repertoire and number of spell slots you gain from witchwarper archetype feats by 1 for each spell rank other than your two highest witchwarper spell slots.
Quantum Breadth.name: Quantum Breadth

Quantum Entanglement.description: You prevent creatures from leaving your quantum field and returning to reality. Until the start of your next turn, any creature who begins its turn inside your quantum field must succeed at a @Check[will|against:witchwarper] saving throw against your witchwarper class DC to move outside your quantum field. On a failure, the action is disrupted. A creature that succeeds at this save is immune to your Quantum Entanglement for 24 hours.
Quantum Entanglement.name: Quantum Entanglement

Quantum Negation.description: You expose a target to a reality in which they don't exist. You learn the @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.spells.Item.d1weVZHIiCXhTlqg]{Quantum Negation} warp spell.
Quantum Negation.name: Quantum Negation

Quantum Recycle.description:
Frequency once per day

Trigger You cast a 2nd-rank or higher spell, and the spell targets a creature or area within your quantum field.

You expertly manipulate the effects of your quantum field to ensure that some of the energy from your spell is preserved and can be harnessed again. You regain an expended spell slot one spell rank lower than the triggering spell.
Quantum Recycle.name: Quantum Recycle

Quantum Research.description: You become a true embodiment of your paradox and surpass what mortals can achieve in your reality. You gain an additional 10th-rank spell slot.
Quantum Research.name: Quantum Research

Queen's Magic.description:
Except for queens, most formians possess little in the way of inherent magical ability. You're no queen, but you're in close proximity with your queen as a member of her court, and she often channels her magic through your close telepathic bond.

You can cast @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.spells.Item.gKKqvLohtrSJj3BM]{Force Barrage} and @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.spells.Item.VlNcjmYyu95vOUe8]{Translocate} as 4th-rank primal innate spells once per day each. For 1 minute after casting either spell, the range of your @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.ancestry-features.Item.N9EDgQPjWcSS6rSb]{Limited Telepathy} quadruples.
Queen's Magic.name: Queen's Magic

Quick Break.description: You learn to prepare your natural weapons much more quickly than before. Breaking off knives from your body loses the manipulate trait and becomes a free action instead of a 1-action activity, and your unarmed attacks are now treated as though they had the advanced weapon improvement.
Quick Break.name: Quick Break

Quick Climb.description: When Climbing, you move 5 more feet on a success and 10 more feet on a critical success, up to your Speed. If you're legendary in Athletics, you gain a climb Speed equal to your Speed.
Quick Climb.name: Quick Climb

Quick Coercion.description: You can [[/act coerce]] a creature after 1 round of conversation instead of 1 minute. You still can't Coerce a creature in the midst of combat, or without engaging in a conversation.
Quick Coercion.name: Quick Coercion

Quick Disguise.description: You can set up a disguise in one-tenth the usual time (generally 1 minute). If you're a master in Deception, you can create a full disguise and @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.actions.Item.AJstokjdG6iDjVjE]{Impersonate} as a 3-action activity. If you're legendary, it takes a single action.
Quick Disguise.name: Quick Disguise

Quick Identification.description: You can Identify Magic swiftly. You take only 1 minute when using Identify Magic to determine the properties of an item, ongoing effect, or location, rather than 10 minutes. If you're a master, it takes a 3-action activity, and if you're legendary, it takes 1 action.

featPrerequisites.0: trained in Arcana, Nature, Occultism, or Religion

Quick Identification.name: Quick Identification

Quick Install.description: You take only 1 minute to Install an Upgrade. If you're legendary in Crafting, you can Install an Upgrade as a 3-action activity.
Quick Install.name: Quick Install

Quick Jump.description: You can use @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.actions.Item.2HJ4yuEFY1Cast4h]{High Jump} and @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.actions.Item.JUvAvruz7yRQXfz2]{Long Jump} as a single action instead of 2 actions. If you do, you don't perform the initial Stride (nor do you fail if you don't Stride 10 feet).
Quick Jump.name: Quick Jump

Quick Legs.description: You have six highly coordinated legs, so it's easy to get around the battlefield. You Step up to three times.
Quick Legs.name: Quick Legs

Quick Polyp Repopulation.description: The polyps that form your exoskeleton adapt and regrow more quickly than usual. Reduce the DC of flat checks to end persistent damage on you by 2.
Quick Polyp Repopulation.name: Quick Polyp Repopulation

Quick Recognition.description: You Recognize Spells swiftly. Once per round, you can @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.feats.Item.MjQyTcV8Jiv1Jtln]{Recognize a Spell} using a skill in which you're a master as a free action.

featPrerequisites.0: Master in Arcana, Nature, Occultism or Religion

Quick Recognition.name: Quick Recognition

Quick Repair.description: For you, the @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.actions.Item.bT3skovyLUtP22ME]{Repair} activity loses the exploration trait and takes 1 minute instead of 10 minutes. If you're a master in Crafting, it takes 3 actions. If you're legendary, it takes 1 action.
Quick Repair.name: Quick Repair

Quick Squeeze.description: You Squeeze 5 feet per round (10 feet on a critical success). If you're legendary in Acrobatics, you Squeeze at full Speed.
Quick Squeeze.name: Quick Squeeze

Quick Stow.description:
Frequency once per round

You're trained in the trick of quickly moving items into your cheek pouches. You Interact to store one held item in your cheek pouches (provided it fits).
Quick Stow.name: Quick Stow

Quick Study.description:
Trigger You roll initiative.

You can take the scholar out of the library, but you can't take the library out of the scholar—even when matters turn violent. You can attempt to @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.actions.Item.1OagaWtBpVXExToo]{Recall Knowledge} against a creature you're observing within 30 feet.
Quick Study.name: Quick Study

Quick Swap.description:
Trigger You're wielding a two-handed weapon, and an enemy creature moves adjacent to you.

You can switch weapons in stressful situations so that you quickly set yourself up to punish incoming foes. You stow your current weapon and draw another two-handed weapon. If you have multiple sets of arms, you can instead Switch Hands.
Quick Swap.name: Quick Swap

Quick Swim.description: You Swim 5 feet farther on a success and 10 feet farther on a critical success, to a maximum of your Speed. If you're legendary in Athletics, you gain a swim Speed equal to your Speed.
Quick Swim.name: Quick Swim

Quick Unlock.description: You can @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.actions.Item.2EE4aF4SZpYf0R6H]{Pick a Lock} using 1 action instead of 2.
Quick Unlock.name: Quick Unlock

Quickened Casting.description:
Frequency once per day

You accelerate your spellcasting. If your next action is to cast a mystic cantrip or a mystic spell that's at least 2 ranks lower than the highest-rank mystic spell slot you have, reduce the number of actions to cast it by 1 (minimum 1 action).
Quickened Casting.name: Quickened Casting

Quickened Processor.description: You can quickly identify your surroundings, and you can use that information to your advantage while in the midst of danger or while in the process of piloting vehicles in hazardous situations. You gain a +1 circumstance bonus to Perception checks for initiative rolls and a +2 circumstance bonus to Piloting checks for initiative rolls.
Quickened Processor.name: Quickened Processor

Quiet Allies.description: You're skilled at moving with a group. When you are @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.actions.Item.IE2nThCmoyhQA0Jn]{Avoiding Notice} and your allies @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.actions.Item.tfa4Sh7wcxCEqL29]{Follow the Expert}, you and those allies can roll a single Stealth check, using the lowest modifier, instead of rolling separately. This doesn't apply for initiative rolls.
Quiet Allies.name: Quiet Allies

Quip.description:
Trigger A creature within 30 feet is damaged by an ally's Strike.

You follow up on your ally's success by hurling a cunning, well-timed taunt at a foe they wounded. Attempt to @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.actions.Item.2u915NdUyQan6uKF]{Demoralize} the triggering creature.
Quip.name: Quip

Radiant Bond.description: When you @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.actions.Item.UeMHbnnaXDa3sGfG]{Transfer Vitality}, you can select any number of bonded allies to transfer to, though the total maximum number of Hit Points you can transfer doesn't increase.
Radiant Bond.name: Radiant Bond

Radiant Zone.description:
The reality you conjure is much brighter than your own. The area of your quantum field becomes bright light. Creatures who begin their turn in your quantum field must attempt a @Check[fortitude|against:witchwarper|options:area-effect,inflicts:dazzled,inflicts:blinded] save against your class DC; creatures with light blindness treat their result as one step worse.

Success The creature is unaffected.

Failure The creature is @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.TkIyaNPgTZFBCCuh]{Dazzled} for 1 round.

Critical Failure The creature is @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.XgEqL1kFApUbl5Z2]{Blinded} for 1 round, then dazzled for 1 round.
Radiant Zone.name: Radiant Zone

Radiation Resistant.description: You're resistant to radiation due to long-term exposure triggering changes in your biology. You gain poison resistance equal to your level against damage from radiation effects and a +1 circumstance bonus to Fortitude saves against radiation effects.
Radiation Resistant.name: Radiation Resistant

Radioactive Core.description: You've been exposed to so much radiation that you become radioactive. When a creature Strikes you with a melee unarmed attack or Grabs you, it takes @Damage[1d4[persistent,poison]] damage.
Radioactive Core.name: Radioactive Core

Radioactive Resistance.description: Maybe it was your environment, genetics, or even something you ate, but you've developed a resistance to radiation. You gain resistance to fire and poison damage from radiation effects equal to half your level and a +1 circumstance bonus to Fortitude saves against radiation.
Radioactive Resistance.name: Radioactive Resistance

Raise Crystalline Strands.description:
Frequency once per day

Trigger An enemy's Strike against you is a critical hit.

You position your fortified crystalline hair to absorb some of the blow from an otherwise lethal attack. The triggering attack deals only the amount it would deal on a hit (typically full damage instead of double damage). Any other effects caused by a critical hit still occur. It takes a day for your shattered hair to regrow, and until it does, you take a –2 circumstance penalty to Diplomacy checks with other moyishuus.
Raise Crystalline Strands.name: Raise Crystalline Strands

Range Sniper.description:
You've trained to engage your foes from afar and leverage your keen vision to improve your accuracy. You reduce the penalty for attacking beyond your first range increment by 1, to a minimum of 0. If you're in a vacuum, you instead reduce the penalty for attacking beyond your first range increment by 2, to a minimum of 0.

In addition, you gain the @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.actions.Item.K2wMNyK4JGwgrjVL]{Line Up the Shot} action.
Range Sniper.name: Range Sniper

Rapid Excavations.description: You drill through the earth with great speed. During your daily preparations, select an implement you use for mining, like a pick, drill, laser, or razing weapon. You gain a burrow Speed of 15 feet while holding or wielding the item, or 20 feet if the item expends ammunition or charges when used.
Rapid Excavations.name: Rapid Excavations

Rapid Mantel.description: You easily pull yourself onto ledges. When you @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.actions.Item.3yoajuKjwHZ9ApUY]{Grab an Edge}, you can pull yourself onto that surface and stand. You can use Athletics instead of a Reflex save to Grab an Edge. If you Climb or @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.actions.Item.d5I6018Mci2SWokk]{Leap} to within 5 feet beneath the top of an edge, you can pull yourself onto the surface and stand as part of that action.
Rapid Mantel.name: Rapid Mantel

Rascal-Light.description:
You have a free tactical flashlight built into your LFAN. Using this flashlight doesn't interfere with your ability to use your hands or your LFAN to interact with or hold other objects. Additionally, you gain the @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.feats.Item.0ZNErs9RICfOw1Nf]{Digital Diversion} skill feat and can Create a Diversion using Computers instead of Deception by rapidly manipulating the settings on your flashlight. When you do, Create a Diversion gains the visual trait.

[[/act create-a-diversion skill=computers traits=visual variant=gesture]]

[[/act create-a-diversion skill=computers traits=visual variant=trick]]

[[/act create-a-diversion skill=computers traits=visual variant=distracting-words]]
Rascal-Light.name: Rascal-Light

Rat Race.description: You channel your ancestral ability to maximize movement in any situation. You Stride three times.
Rat Race.name: Rat Race

Rat Retinal HUD.description: You've had your retinas modified, granting you a permanent HUD that takes reads on your surroundings. You gain an @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.equipment.Item.GBtIO5fqFGD9Dzk1]{Autorecognition Lens} augmentation that can't be removed and that doesn't use an augmentation slot. You become trained in Computers. If you would automatically become trained in Computers (from your background or class, for example), you instead become trained in another skill of your choice. Once per day, you can @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.actions.Item.Yn4jLPVWVE1vtAaF]{Access Infosphere} as a 3-action activity on a creature you're observing with your HUD whose name you've identified.
Rat Retinal HUD.name: Rat Retinal HUD

Ravenous Restoration.description: You have a colossal appetite for a creature your size, and you find that a good meal always hits the spot. Once per day, you can eat a snack or meal as a 10-minute activity. When you do, you regain a number of Hit Points equal to 1d6 plus your level (@Damage[(1d6 + @actor.level)[healing]]).
Ravenous Restoration.name: Ravenous Restoration

Razor Scrap.description: Your temporary shells are dangerous if shattered. If a creature breaks or destroys your shield with an unarmed attack or melee weapon without the reach trait, it takes @Damage[1d6[bleed]] damage from the shrapnel.
Razor Scrap.name: Razor Scrap

Reach Spell.description: You can extend the range of your spells. If the next action you use is to Cast a Spell that has a range, increase that spell's range by 30 feet. As is standard for increasing spell ranges, if the spell normally has a range of touch, you extend its range to 30 feet.
Reach Spell.name: Reach Spell

Reactive Flicker.description:
Frequency once per hour

Trigger An enemy's Strike or targeted effect would hit you.

You try to time your temporal displacement to avoid attacks. You gain a +2 circumstance bonus to your AC against the triggering attack, potentially causing a successful hit into a miss or a critical success into a success. If this changes the result of the attack, you can Step up to 10 feet.
Reactive Flicker.name: Reactive Flicker

Reactive Shapeshifting.description:
Trigger You roll initiative.

You can change at a moment's notice. You Change Shape and gain a +2 circumstance bonus on the triggering initiative roll if you used Deception to roll initiative.
Reactive Shapeshifting.name: Reactive Shapeshifting

Read 'Em Like A Book.description:
Trigger An enemy you can sense rolls for initiative.

You've mastered reading people in all circumstances, even before a fight breaks out. Roll Perception to [[/act sense-motive]] against your target. If you succeed, your initiative roll is equal to the target's initiative plus 1. If you critically succeed, your initiative is equal to the target's initiative plus 2, and the target is @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.AJh5ex99aV6VTggg]{Off-Guard} to you until the start of its turn.
Read 'Em Like A Book.name: Read 'Em Like A Book

Read Lips.description: You can read lips of others nearby who you can clearly see. The language read must be one that you know. When you're at your leisure, you can do this automatically. In encounter mode or when attempting a more difficult feat of lipreading, you're @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.AdPVz7rbaVSRxHFg]{Fascinated} and @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.AJh5ex99aV6VTggg]{Off-Guard} during each round in which you focus on lip movements, and you must succeed at a Society check (DC determined by the GM) to successfully read someone's lips.
Read Lips.name: Read Lips

Read Mental Dossier.description: To you, the mind is an open book. You can cast @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.spells.Item.KHnhPHL4x1AQHfbC]{Mind Reading} as an innate occult spell once per day. Use your Intelligence as your spellcasting attribute for this innate spell if its modifier is higher than your Charisma modifier.
Read Mental Dossier.name: Read Mental Dossier

Ready For Trouble.description: You learned your lesson after one-too-many encounters with deadly mechanisms and rigged ruins. You gain the @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.feats.Item.FnAzJ4DIRPJJaGv7]{Danger Awareness} feat. You can use Delve Lore to disarm traps from alien or historically significant locations.
Ready For Trouble.name: Ready For Trouble

Ready Reload.description:
Requirements You're wielding a two-handed ranged weapon with a reload of 2 or more, and your last action was an attack that expended ammo from the weapon.

You know that reloading a weapon can be a delicate process, but you've mastered how to do so in the middle of combat, starting while still in the act of firing your weapon. You Interact to reload your weapon twice. Unlike most Interact actions, you don't need a free hand to reload your ranged weapon in this way.
Ready Reload.name: Ready Reload

Ready for Anything.description:
Frequency once per day

Lacking the additional protections and advantages granted by augmentations that many others take for granted, you have nurtured a habit of being prepared for every eventuality. You swap the skill feat granted to you by @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.feats.Item.qSTvfezx51sel3a4]{Homegrown Skills} for another skill feat you qualify for.
Ready for Anything.name: Ready for Anything

Ready to Roll.description:
Trigger You roll initiative.

You instinctively react to trouble by directing your allies to act at the exact moment their intervention would matter most. Issue a 1-action directive.
Ready to Roll.name: Ready to Roll

Realized Epiphany.description:
Frequency once per minute

You've come to learn that your vitality network isn't just a manifestation of your magic, it's a metaphysical representation of your connection. If your next action is to cast an epiphany spell, you can expend 20 Hit Points from your vitality network to cast it, rather than spending a Focus Point.
Realized Epiphany.name: Realized Epiphany

Really Get Em!.description: You gain the Lead by Example benefit for your Get 'Em! directive, except you and your allies get a +2 status bonus to damage on both the initial and subsequent Strikes.
Really Get Em!.name: Really Get Em!

Reassuring Presence.description:
Frequency once per 10 minutes

Trigger An ally within 30 feet becomes frightened.

You'll never quite understand why non-atraxids find your appearance unsettling, but at this point you're used to it. You're adept at using subtle body language to keep others calm, which comes in handy when your friends are frightened due to any source. The value of your ally's frightened condition is reduced by 1.
Reassuring Presence.name: Reassuring Presence

Rebuke Cataclysm.description:
Frequency once per day

Trigger You critically fail a saving throw.

You were taught not to give up, even in a situation as dire as the end of your home world. You treat your critical failure as a failure. If you begin @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.yZRUzMqrMmfLu0V1]{Dying} as a result of the failure, your first recovery check has a DC equal to 5 + your current dying value.
Rebuke Cataclysm.name: Rebuke Cataclysm

Recite Gap History.description: You can speak a truth about the Gap that causes you to vanish from others' perceptions temporarily. You gain @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.spells.Item.wfleiawxsfhpRRwf]{Disappearance} as an 8th-rank occult innate spell that you can cast only on yourself once per day.
Recite Gap History.name: Recite Gap History

Recode Creation.description: You can read some of your story in the grand narrative of all creation, setting a metaphysical bookmark in case you lose your place. Once per day, when you would die, you instead cease to physically exist for 1 minute. At the end of this duration, your body is rewritten into existence from the grand narrative, appearing at full Hit Points in the location you disappeared from. Do not increase the value of your @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.Yl48xTdMh3aeQYL2]{Wounded} condition.
Recode Creation.name: Recode Creation

Recognize Spell.description:
Trigger A creature within line of sight casts a spell that you don't have prepared or in your spell repertoire, or a trap or similar object casts such a spell. You must be aware of the casting.

If you are trained in the appropriate skill for the spell's tradition and it's a common spell of 2nd rank or lower, you automatically identify it (you still roll to attempt to get a critical success, but can't get a worse result than success). The highest rank of spell you automatically identify increases to 4 if you're an expert, 6 if you're a master, and 10 if you're legendary. The GM rolls a secret Arcana, Nature, Occultism, or Religion check, whichever corresponds to the tradition of the spell being cast. If you're not trained in the skill, you can't get a result better than failure.

Critical Success You correctly recognize the spell and gain a +1 circumstance bonus to your saving throw or your AC against it.

Success You correctly recognize the spell.

Failure You fail to recognize the spell.

Critical Failure You misidentify the spell as another spell entirely, of the GM's choice.

featPrerequisites.0: trained in Arcana, Nature, Occultism or Religion

Recognize Spell.name: Recognize Spell

Red Eye.description: Your eyes burn with a red hue and glow like embers when in areas of darkness or shade. You gain darkvision.
Red Eye.name: Red Eye

Reflexive Hypotheses.description:
No matter how engrossed you are in other tasks, part of your mind can't help but stay curious about your surroundings.

You become trained in a Lore skill about a specific environment, planet, plane, or settlement. You can move at full Speed while using the Investigate activity.

Choose one of the following: Arcana, Nature, Occultism, Religion, or Society. While using any other exploration activity, you also Investigate your surroundings, though only to Recall Knowledge using the chosen skill and any Lore skills you have.
Reflexive Hypotheses.name: Reflexive Hypotheses

Refresh Cirrisensors.description:
Frequency once per round

Your cirrisensors regenerate and help you shrug off afflictions. Attempt to counteract an effect of your choice imposing one of these conditions on you: @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.XgEqL1kFApUbl5Z2]{Blinded}, @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.TkIyaNPgTZFBCCuh]{Dazzled}, @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.9PR9y0bi4JPKnHPR]{Deafened}, @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.fesd1n5eVhpCSS18]{Sickened}, or @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.e1XGnhKNSQIm5IXg]{Stupefied}. This counteract check uses your Fortitude modifier against the target's DC, and your counteract rank is equal to half your level rounded up. If you didn't counteract the effect, but you would have if its counteract rank were 2 lower, you instead suppress the effect until the beginning of your next turn. The effect's duration doesn't elapse while it's suppressed in this way.

This effect can't cure curses, diseases, or other long-term afflictions with these conditions as part of their normal state, but it can temporarily remove the condition. If the underlying affliction isn't treated, any counteracted conditions return after 24 hours.
Refresh Cirrisensors.name: Refresh Cirrisensors

Regenerative Blood.description: You use ritualistic prayer to gain supercharged regenerative abilities, giving your blood the power to heal wounds and regrow lost limbs, even when applied to others. You can cast @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.spells.Item.2Vkd1IxylPceUAAF]{Regenerate} as a 7th-rank primal innate spell twice per day.
Regenerative Blood.name: Regenerative Blood

Regional Manager.description: You can use the @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.actions.Item.HCl3pzVefiv9ZKQW]{Aid} reaction to help an ally, even if you haven't prepared to do so. If one or more of your allies are your employees, after you Aid an ally at a skill check that doesn't have the attack trait, you can also Aid any other ally who's also one of your employees who attempts the same skill check for the same purpose that round as a free action rather than a reaction. An ally is also your employee as long as they spend at least one day of Downtime per week @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.actions.Item.QyzlsLrqM0EEwd7j]{Earning Income} on behalf of your company. They keep any income they earn, but on a Critical Failure your company's reputation might suffer.
Regional Manager.name: Regional Manager

Release Radiation.description:
Frequency once per hour

Like the star or supernova you wish to emulate, you've learned to focus and release bursts of radiation. All non-novian creatures in a @Template[type:emanation|distance:10] must attempt a @Check[fortitude|against:class-spell] save against the higher of your class DC or spell DC.

Critical Success The creature is unaffected.
