Success The creature is @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.fesd1n5eVhpCSS18]{Sickened 1} for 1 round.

Failure The creature is @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.fesd1n5eVhpCSS18]{Sickened 2} for 2 rounds.

Critical Failure The creature is sickened 2 for 1 minute.
Release Radiation.name: Release Radiation

Relentless Aim.description: You take careful aim with your shots so that your bullets ricochet off solid surfaces. When determining if you have line of effect to a target you've aimed at, you can choose one solid surface within your weapon's first range increment to ricochet your shot to hit your target; determine line of effect from the chosen ricochet surface, rather than your location. If the creature is @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.VRSef5y1LmL2Hkjf]{Undetected}, the GM still rolls a flat check in secret to see if you missed, but the flat check becomes DC 5.
Relentless Aim.name: Relentless Aim

Relentless Endurance.description:
Frequency once per hour

Trigger You take damage.

You bounce back stronger after a hit, ready to continue the fight. You gain 1d8+4 temporary Hit Points that last for 1 minute. Increase this amount by 1d8+4 at 6th level and every 4 levels thereafter.
Relentless Endurance.name: Relentless Endurance

Relentless Roller.description:
Frequency once per hour

Trigger You would become @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.i3OJZU2nk64Df3xm]{Clumsy}, @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.MIRkyAjyBeXivMa7]{Enfeebled}, @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.xYTAsEpcJE1Ccni3]{Slowed}, or @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.enA7BxAjBb7ns1iF]{Suppressed}.

Faced with helplessness, you channel your restlessness into a relentless desire to always move faster even when you are feeling sluggish. You gain a +20-foot status bonus to all your Speeds for 1 round.
Relentless Roller.name: Relentless Roller

Relentless Tentacles.description:
Requirements You used your last action this turn to [[/act grapple]] a creature within your reach.

You bring additional limbs to bear, ensuring that you either ensnare your target or wrap your captured prey in additional tentacles. Attempt to Grapple the target, but the attempt's multiple attack penalty is only –3 if it's your second attack on your turn or –6 if it's the third or subsequent attack. If the target is already @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.kWc1fhmv9LBiTuei]{Grabbed} or @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.VcDeM8A5oI6VqhbM]{Restrained} by you, replace Grapple's effects with the following.

Critical Success If your target was grabbed, it's now restrained until the end of your next turn unless you move or your target Escapes. Until the end of your next turn, you gain a +1 circumstance bonus to your Athletics DC to resist the target's attempts to Escape.

Success You wrap additional limbs around the target. Until the end of your next turn, you gain a +1 circumstance bonus to your Athletics DC to resist the target's attempts to Escape, and you increase the flat check DC it must attempt when attempting a manipulate action to 7.

Failure You fail to wrap additional limbs around your target, but it remains grabbed or restrained.
Relentless Tentacles.name: Relentless Tentacles

Reliable Expert.description: Your knowledge of a specific subject is especially reliable thanks to the brain you've dedicated to thinking about it. You gain the @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.feats.Item.BocFD2KV0qgUC76x]{Additional Lore} feat and the @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.feats.Item.W6Gl9ePmItfDHji0]{Assurance} feat for the chosen Lore. Once per day when you forgo rolling a skill check using Assurance for the associated Lore, you can choose to receive a result of 13 + your proficiency bonus (instead of 10 + your proficiency bonus).
Reliable Expert.name: Reliable Expert

Reliable Grace.description: You have exceptional control over your body. You can use @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.feats.Item.GExi3NDWqhfICneX]{Natural Grace} once per hour, rather than once per day.
Reliable Grace.name: Reliable Grace

Religious Talisman.description: You can construct and bless a religious symbol of your deity in 10 minutes. While such talismans are traditionally scraps of paper with a religious symbol drawn on them, they can take many forms, including body art, a sticker, or even a virtual emoji. You can create a talisman only for yourself and for the deity you worship. As long as you continue to engage in activities that match your deity's edicts you gain a +1 status bonus to initiative rolls. If you violate your deity's anathema, the talisman is destroyed, and you take a –1 status penalty to initiative rolls and Perception checks until you complete an @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.spells.Item.7Fd4lxozd11MQ55N]{Atone} ritual.
Religious Talisman.name: Religious Talisman

Remarkable Crafter.description: You have trained in numerous areas of crafting, learning how many different kinds of useful items are put together. You are trained in Crafting. You gain the Specialty Crafting feat, and you can choose two specialties from the list instead of one.
Remarkable Crafter.name: Remarkable Crafter

Remix World's Rhythm.description: Whether through intense musical training, magical insight, or Meyel's divine blessing, you can feel the rhythm of the world around you and tug on time's chords to manipulate its melody and flow. You gain @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.spells.Item.o6YCGx4lycsYpww4]{Haste} and @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.spells.Item.WsUwpfmhKrKwoIe3]{Slow} as 3rd-rank primal innate spells. You can cast each of these spells once per day.
Remix World's Rhythm.name: Remix World's Rhythm

Remote Access.description: You know how to probe computer systems with your mind as easily as others might handle a hacking toolkit. You can communicate wirelessly with technological devices within 10 feet, allowing you to attempt Computers checks on these devices without a user interface or hacking toolkit. If you can already attempt Computers checks at range, you increase the distance that you can do so by an additional 10 feet.
Remote Access.name: Remote Access

Repair Module.description:
Frequency once per day

You trigger your body's self-repair programming, stimulating your body's nanites to heal your wounds. You gain fast healing equal to half your level for 1 minute. While Repair Module is active, if you use @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.feats.Item.JS24EjgLYcHB9E3T]{Nanite Surge} or @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.feats.Item.OlSfsaJSE4Lk7wkt]{Nanite Form}, this fast healing ends.
Repair Module.name: Repair Module

Repeating Role.description: Just like giving an encore performance of one of your most iconic roles, you learn how to better use your training off the set. You can now use @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.feats.Item.oRZuA2FNSAcI9hO6]{Role Repertoire} once per hour instead of once per day.
Repeating Role.name: Repeating Role

Repository of Divinity.description: The writings on your shell expand to include a vast array of knowledge about the entities found across the multiverse. Choose either @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.spells.Item.lTDixrrNKaCvLKwX]{Summon Celestial} or @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.spells.Item.29ytKctjg7qSW2ff]{Summon Fiend}. Once per day, you can cast the chosen spell as a divine innate spell heightened to half your level rounded up. The creature summoned must match the theme of the philosophical treatises marked on your shell, such as a creature with the angel trait if your treatise is on enlightenment achieved through virtuous acts.
Repository of Divinity.name: Repository of Divinity

Repurpose Mystic Power.description: Your polyps can absorb hostile magic and repurpose it to fuel your body. Whenever you succeed at a saving throw against a spell or magical effect, you gain temporary Hit Points equal to double the spell's rank, or equal to the level of the magical effect if it isn't a spell. These temporary Hit Points last until the end of your next turn.
Repurpose Mystic Power.name: Repurpose Mystic Power

Reroot.description:
Frequency once per day

Trigger You are reduced to 0 Hit Points but not immediately killed.

You never want to depend on the ground beneath your roots, but in desperate times it can be your most reliable ally. Your roots reach deep into the ground and draw enough life-giving nutrients to give you one last chance. You are not knocked out and regain Hit Points equal to 6d8 plus half your level. Your wounded condition still increases by 1 as though you had been dying and recovered. You cannot move until you take an Interact action to draw your roots back to the surface.
Reroot.name: Reroot

Researched Spell Resistance.description:
While humans lacks the innate magic of other ancestries, they makes up for it with the ability to learn the mystical arts and protect themselves from magical threats.

Choose one of the four spell traditions in which you're an expert in its corresponding skill (arcane for Arcana, primal for Nature, occult for Occultism, and divine for Religion). You gain a +1 circumstance bonus to all saving throws against spells and effects with the corresponding tradition's trait. If you are or become a master in a skill corresponding to a previously chosen spell tradition, you can choose another tradition in which you're trained in its corresponding skill. You can repeat this process until you've chosen all four spell traditions.

featPrerequisites.0: expert in Arcana, Nature, Occultism, or Religion

Researched Spell Resistance.name: Researched Spell Resistance

Resilient Polyps.description:
Thanks to your focus on your body's health as it grows new polyps, your polyps are especially resilient. Increase your maximum Hit Points by your level. When you have the dying condition, the DC of your recovery checks is equal to 9 + your dying value (instead of 10 + your dying value).

If you also have the @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.feats.Item.AmP0qu7c5dlBSath]{Toughness} feat, the Hit Points gained from it and this feat are cumulative, and the DC of your recovery checks is equal to 6 + your dying value.
Resilient Polyps.name: Resilient Polyps

Resonant Weapon.description: You release a pulse of spiritual energy into one weapon you're holding, making it resonate with immaterial soul stuff. Until the beginning of your next turn, your weapon gains the effects of the ghost killer weapon fusion. At 17th level, it deals an additional 1d6 spirit damage.
Resonant Weapon.name: Resonant Weapon

Restorative Chatter.description:
Frequency once per day

Requirements You must have at least three allies within 30 feet who you can communicate with.

Your body physically heals when you can communicate with your allies. You can choose if your communication with allies is auditory or visual, and this action gains that trait when used. You gain fast healing equal to half your level for 1 minute. While Restorative Chatter is active, if you no longer meet the requirements, this fast healing ends.
Restorative Chatter.name: Restorative Chatter

Restorative Shapeshifting.description:
Frequency once per minute

Trigger You use Change Shape.

You renew and reinforce your body with elements of your new form. You gain a number of temporary Hit Points equal to half your level (minimum 1) that last until the end of your next turn.
Restorative Shapeshifting.name: Restorative Shapeshifting

Restorative Tissues.description:
Frequency once per day

Compounds that occur naturally within your leaves have healing effects on other creatures, and you're always finding new ways to harness them. You coat an adjacent willing creature's wounds in your own blood. You lose 1 Hit Point for every 2 levels you have. This damage can't be resisted, prevented, or negated in any way. The target creature regains @Damage[1d6[healing]] Hit Points for every Hit Point you lost.
Restorative Tissues.name: Restorative Tissues

Retch Rally.description: When you're sick, both of your heads feel it, and they each have an incentive to do something about it. When you attempt to reduce the sickened condition, you can roll twice and take the better result. If you critically succeed, reduce your sickened value by 3.
Retch Rally.name: Retch Rally

Retrotech.description: You might not remember your past, but some part of you has an innate understanding of the basic layout and user interfaces of ancient pre-Gap technology. You become trained in your choice of Computers or Crafting. If you're already trained in both, you instead become trained in a Lore skill related to technology. You gain a +2 circumstance bonus to @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.actions.Item.1OagaWtBpVXExToo]{Recall Knowledge} checks using Computers, Crafting, or Piloting to identify ancient technology designed before the Gap.
Retrotech.name: Retrotech

Return to Roots.description: You expand the ways organisms can thrive in adverse settings. You can cast @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.spells.Item.J6vNvrUT3b1hx2iA]{Entangling Flora} and @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.spells.Item.hk2mTLH9DIvNqDuS]{Verdant Code} once per day each as 3rd-rank primal innate spells.
Return to Roots.name: Return to Roots

Return to the River.description: You have a soul-deep connection to the River Between. When you're in mortal peril, the River Between beckons you home and into its embrace. When you would die, you don't. Instead, you are encased in a cocoon of golden solar energy and disappear, teleporting across the galaxy to the River Between. [[/r 2d6 #days]]{2d6 days} later, this chrysalis hatches, and you emerge fully healed in a random location along the River Between in the Diaspora.
Return to the River.name: Return to the River

Reunite.description:
Frequency once per hour

Requirements You and your bonded partner are on the same planet.

With a centering breath, you fill your mind with thoughts of your bonded partner and will yourself to their side. You teleport into an unoccupied space of your choice adjacent to your bonded partner. If there is no adjacent space available, you teleport into the closest unoccupied space.
Reunite.name: Reunite

Revitalized by the Drift.description:
The Drift revitalizes your spirit and restores your vitality, physically healing your wounds. If you rest for 10 minutes while within the Drift, you gain Hit Points equal to your @Damage[(@actor.level *@actor.system.abilities.con.mod)[healing]]{Constitution modifier × your level}. This is cumulative with any healing you receive from @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.actions.Item.1kGNdIIhuglAjIp9]{Treat Wounds}.

Once per hour, you can focus or meditate on your inherent connection to the Drift. This is a 10-minute activity that has the concentrate and exploration traits. When you do, you're treated as if you'd rested for 10 minutes while in the Drift, save that the number of Hit Points you regain from this feat is halved.
Revitalized by the Drift.name: Revitalized by the Drift

Revivification Protocol.description:
Frequency once per day

Trigger You have the dying condition and are about to attempt a recovery check.

Your nanites are programmed to automatically revive you. You're restored to 1 Hit Point, lose the dying and unconscious conditions, and can act normally on this turn. You gain or increase the wounded condition as normal when losing the dying condition in this way.
Revivification Protocol.name: Revivification Protocol

Ride.description: When you @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.actions.Item.q9nbyIF0PEBqMtYe]{Command an Animal} you're mounted on to take a move action (such as Stride), you automatically succeed instead of needing to attempt a check. Any animal you're mounted on acts on your turn, like a minion. If you @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.actions.Item.PM5jvValFkbFH3TV]{Mount} an animal in the middle of an encounter, it skips its next turn and then acts on your next turn.
Ride.name: Ride

Ride the River Between.description: Reaching across space, you connect with the River Between and seize a fragment of its solar stream, inundating the battlefield in golden light and solar energy. This trickle of the River Between fills a @Template[type:line|distance:100] that is 10 feet in diameter, starts from your square, and remains for 1 minute. Once the river forms, you can move to any square within the river (this movement does not trigger reactions). The area is bright light and counts as a vacuum for the purposes of a sarcesian using their energy wings. Non-sarcesians in the area when you use Ride the River Between, or who later enter the area, must succeed at a @Check[fortitude|against:class-spell] save or become @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.TkIyaNPgTZFBCCuh]{Dazzled} for 1 round (1 minute on a critical failure). Creatures affected by this ability are temporarily immune for 24 hours. The DC of this save is equal to the higher of your spell DC or class DC.
Ride the River Between.name: Ride the River Between

Rip Current.description: You have a mystical connection to the powerful currents of Kalo-Mahoi and their interactions with the blooms, and you've learned to call upon them to wash powerful outsiders away through portals between planes. You gain @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.spells.Item.bay4AfSu2iIozNNW]{Banishment} as an 8th-rank primal innate spell that you can cast once per day. You can cast the spell targeting up to 10 willing creatures, who treat the results of their Will save as two degrees of success lower.
Rip Current.name: Rip Current

Rip, Tear.description: Your skull plates or teeth have grown sharper over time, or you have painstakingly carved them to do maximum damage when using them in combat. Your unarmed jaws attack now inflicts 1d6 persistent bleed damage on a successful hit (double on a critical hit). If your weapon damage ever increases, the number of dice for your bleed damage also increases by the same amount.
Rip, Tear.name: Rip, Tear

Rising to the Challenge.description:
Frequency once per day

Trigger You critically fail a skill check.

Requirements You're not in a combat encounter.

Whether you're boogying down in a dance-off or striving for the highest score on a test, you treat any challenge as seriously as a fight to the death. Reroll the triggering skill check and use the second result.
Rising to the Challenge.name: Rising to the Challenge

River Rider.description: The water is a second home to you. You've grown used to weightlessness, to being carried by the flow or your own inertia, and it's not so different from moving in zero gravity. When you Push Off, you can move your full Speed. You aren't clumsy due to being @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.z1ucw4CLwLqHoAp3]{Untethered} in zero gravity.

featPrerequisites.0: song of the river ord heritage

River Rider.name: River Rider

Road Roller.description: The slopes and roads of Hibb are kept in phenomenal condition, and you've mastered the bantrids' method for cleaning the roads for one another. You Stride. You clear through any squares of non-magical difficult terrain (but not greater difficult terrain) in which the source of the terrain could be crushed, such as dense undergrowth, or swept aside, such as debris or rubble.
Road Roller.name: Road Roller

Robust Core.description: Your design is one of the most common ones among your kind, and for good reason; it's robust, durable, and scalable. This gives you incredibly versatility in your development. You gain a general feat of your choice, and you must meet the feat's prerequisites.
Robust Core.name: Robust Core

Robust Recovery.description: You learned folk medicine to help recover from diseases and poison, and using it diligently has made you especially resilient. When you Treat a Disease or a Poison, or someone else uses one of these actions on you, increase the circumstance bonus granted on a success to +4, and if the result of the patient's saving throw is a success, the patient gets a critical success.
Robust Recovery.name: Robust Recovery

Rocket Jump.description:
Requirements You're wielding an area (burst) weapon.

You fire your weapon as you jump, using the explosion to propel yourself to new heights or just out of a situation more dangerous than an explosion. You make an Area Fire and then @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.actions.Item.d5I6018Mci2SWokk]{Leap}, using your weapon to add a status bonus to the distance traveled equal to double the burst of your weapon. You must be somewhere within the area of the weapon's area attack, but you don't have to save against the effect of your attack.

Movement made as part of this action doesn't trigger reactions, though Area Fire still triggers them normally.
Rocket Jump.name: Rocket Jump

Rodnarth Survivor.description: When anyone asks how tough you are, all you have to say is, "I'm from Rodnarth." You've survived more extreme disasters than most can count, and your body has adapted to danger by storing a small reservoir of primal energy from the fonqon trees. The first time each day you would die because of the dying condition, your body draws on this reservoir, and you instead survive. Your remain at 1 Hit Point, and your dying value becomes 0, but you gain a wounded value equal to 1 less than the dying value that would normally kill you (typically @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.Yl48xTdMh3aeQYL2]{Wounded 3}).
Rodnarth Survivor.name: Rodnarth Survivor

Role Repertoire.description:
Frequency once per day

You've played many roles and picked up a surprising amount of eclectic knowledge while preparing to play them. Roll any [[/act recall-knowledge skill=performance]] check using Performance instead of Lore.
Role Repertoire.name: Role Repertoire

Roll Model.description:
You've made your foot orb into a living work of couture art, becoming what young bantrids often call a baller. Whether you've incorporated it into stunning performances as a diva or use it to impress others who might not have even encountered a bantrid before, people can't help but admire your taste and style.

You either become trained in Diplomacy and gain the @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.feats.Item.KpFetnUqTiweypZk]{Group Impression} skill feat, or you become trained in Performance and gain the @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.feats.Item.xqAdXRd2gSQcqp5E]{Impressive Performance} skill feat. If you're already trained in one of these skills, you must take the other one and can choose from either skill feat. If you're trained in both skills, you become trained in a different skill of your choice instead and can choose from either skill feat.
Roll Model.name: Roll Model

Roller Coaster.description: Your above-average control over your foot orb offers you the extra spin you need to coast effortlessly. When you Step, you can move 10 feet instead of 5. This enables you to Step into and within difficult terrain as long as you can meet the extra movement cost.
Roller Coaster.name: Roller Coaster

Rub It In.description:
Frequency once per 10 minutes

Trigger A creature fails a saving throw against your spell or other ability.

You are quite competitive and rub it in that your enemy failed. That enemy takes a –1 circumstance penalty to their next saving throw, skill check, or attack roll made before the end of their next turn.

@UUID[Compendium.sf2e.feat-effects.Item.xBbC7n21cv29kMOq]{Effect: Rub It In}
Rub It In.name: Rub It In

Rubbery Body.description: Your body is rubbery, and you bounce against surfaces. When you fall, reduce the falling damage you take as though you'd fallen half the distance. In addition, you gain the @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.actions.Item.qOh7Oq5r9uc3EswW]{Bounce Back} reaction.
Rubbery Body.name: Rubbery Body

Rugged Survivalist.description: You have experience surviving in some of the most extreme situations in the galaxy. You gain the @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.feats.Item.8qebBeOJsyRIchcu]{Forager} skill feat. In addition, you can perform other downtime activities while you @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.actions.Item.49y9Ec4bDii8pcD3]{Subsist} as long as they're feasible in your environment, such as finding raw materials to @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.actions.Item.rmwa3OyhTZ2i2AHl]{Craft} or @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.actions.Item.QyzlsLrqM0EEwd7j]{Earning Income} using Survival by live streaming your foraging.
Rugged Survivalist.name: Rugged Survivalist

Ruin Delver.description: You're fascinated by the ancient ruins scattered across Lajok's surface and orbit. Whether you're a scrapper harvesting materials for reuse, an innovator looking for a unique technological wonder, or a scholar hoping to glean secrets of the past, you enter these ancient sites, heedless of the danger. You gain a +1 circumstance bonus to Perception checks to find hazards, to skill checks to disable hazards, to AC against attacks made by hazards, and to saves against hazards.
Ruin Delver.name: Ruin Delver

Run Hot.description:
Requirements You're wielding an area weapon.

You hold down the trigger and push your weapons to their absolute limits with a ceaseless barrage of firepower. @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.actions.Item.oc0ZKnk5zD0GXqZi]{Area Fire} twice with the required weapon, ignoring the unwieldy trait of your weapon. Creatures in the area of the second Area Fire attack gain a +2 circumstance bonus to their save.

After you use this action, your weapon must cool off and can't be used until after your next turn or until you take any amount of cold damage.
Run Hot.name: Run Hot

Run, Cowards!.description: You use your weapon to help corral panicked enemies. An enemy who critically fails a save against your Area Fire or Auto-Fire is @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.sDPxOjQ9kx2RZE8D]{Fleeing} for 1 round.
Run, Cowards!.name: Run, Cowards!

Running Shot.description:
Requirements You're wielding a gun.

You rush forward, firing a precisely aimed shot at your enemy while you're on the move. @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.actions.Item.sLikawnrJJzHMYeC]{Aim} and then Stride up to your Speed. At any point during this movement, you can make a ranged Strike with the gun you're wielding.
Running Shot.name: Running Shot

Rush of Adrenaline.description:
Frequency once per hour

Trigger You succeed at a saving throw.

You know that nothing in life is guaranteed, and you feel invigorated every time you overcome the challenges life throws at you. You're certain that you'll live to see another day. You gain a number of temporary Hit Points equal to your level that last for 1 minute. If you critically succeeded on the triggering save, you are also @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.nlCjDvLMf2EkV2dl]{Quickened} during your next turn and can use your extra action only to Stride or Strike.
Rush of Adrenaline.name: Rush of Adrenaline

Sacrificial Shell.description:
Trigger An attack, spell, or effect would deal damage to you.

Requirements Your shell isn't broken.

An ijtikri's shell is tough enough to discourage foes from striking vital organs, but you're brave enough to literally block attacks head-on. You gain resistance equal to your Constitution modifier plus your level against all damage from the triggering attack or effect. After resolving the effect, your shell is broken, during which time you are @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.i3OJZU2nk64Df3xm]{Clumsy 1} and lose your resistance to precision damage granted by your mantle ability. The first time per day that someone successfully uses the Medicine skill to @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.actions.Item.1kGNdIIhuglAjIp9]{Treat your Wounds} while your shell is broken, their efforts also repair your shell. Your shell is also repaired fully when you rest for 8 hours.
Sacrificial Shell.name: Sacrificial Shell

Sacrificial Shell (Gnarefuroid).description:
Your shell represents an incredible collection of priceless objects, but your life is worth more than your precious baubles. If you have a shell and would die, you instead gain temporary Hit Points equal to twice your level that last for 1 minute. Your shell breaks, leaving hazardous terrain in a @Template[type:emanation|distance:10] centered on you that deals piercing damage equal to half your level (@Damage[(floor(@actor.level/2))[piercing]|shortLabel]) for each square a creature moves through. Whether you use the shards of your broken shell or new materials, rebuilding a new shell is a downtime activity that takes 8 hours.

@UUID[Compendium.sf2e.feat-effects.Item.5DDF5QmysOpq5bGF]{Effect: Sacrificial Shell (Gnarefuroid)}
Sacrificial Shell (Gnarefuroid).name: Sacrificial Shell (Gnarefuroid)

Sales Pitch.description: You've perfected the art of convincing others to see things your way. You can use [[/act make-an-impression skill=business-lore]]{Business Lore} or [[/act make-an-impression skill=corporate-lore]]{Corporate Lore} to @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.actions.Item.OX4fy22hQgUHDr0q]{Make an Impression} and, on a success or critical success, you shift your target's attitude one step higher. Whether or not Make an Impression is successful, the target becomes temporarily immune to Sales Pitch for 24 hours.
Sales Pitch.name: Sales Pitch

Salvo.description: You've attached a nervous system–integrated weapon mount to your LFAN that you can activate to efficiently fire an arc of electricity. This Semi-Autonomous LFAN Version Omega (or SALVO) deals @Damage[((max(7,ceil(@actor.level/2)))d4)[electricity]] damage (@Check[reflex|against:class-spell|basic] save against the higher of your class DC or spell DC). After using SALVO, you can't use it again for [[/r 1d4 #Recharge Salvo]]{1d4 rounds}. At 15th level and every 2 levels thereafter, the damage increases by 1d4.
Salvo.name: Salvo

Sanctified Shell.description: The writing on your shell has evolved to become a divine script, either to a deity or to a philosophy unto itself. Depending on the spell you selected for @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.feats.Item.1VASwc82sDKVAbMd]{Repository of Divinity}, you become sanctified and gain either the holy or unholy trait (holy for @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.spells.Item.lTDixrrNKaCvLKwX]{Summon Celestial}, or unholy for @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.spells.Item.29ytKctjg7qSW2ff]{Summon Fiend}). Your @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.ancestry-features.Item.jjVH7W3IhgaJ5Yct]{Fire Breath} gains the sanctified trait, and you can choose to deal spirit damage instead of fire damage.

featPrerequisites.1: You have neither the holy nor unholy trait

Sanctified Shell.name: Sanctified Shell

Sanctuary Kin.description: Your magical spark wards your allies, protecting them from attacks. You can cast @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.spells.Item.8xRzLhwGL7Dgy3EZ]{Sanctuary} as a 1st-rank divine innate spell once per day. You can cast the spell as a reaction triggered when your bonded partner is the target of an attack, as long as your partner is within 40 feet and you can perceive them and their attacker. If you do, the spell has a range of 40 feet and can target only your bonded partner.
Sanctuary Kin.name: Sanctuary Kin

Sanguine Wellspring.description:
Frequency once per day

You channel some of the power of your blood into your spellcasting abilities to help support them. You regain 1 Focus Point, up to your usual maximum.

featPrerequisites.0: You have a focus pool and a spellcasting class feature that grants arcane spells.

Sanguine Wellspring.name: Sanguine Wellspring

Sapping Psychic.description: As your connection grows, you become adept at pulling energy out of the world around you. You gain @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.spells.Item.rBh2PjtbDGAjbcu6]{Discharge} and @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.spells.Item.gPvtmKMRpg9I9D7H]{Earthbind} as 3rd-rank primal innate spells. You can cast each of these primal innate spells once per day.
Sapping Psychic.name: Sapping Psychic

Sarcesian Lore.description: You've taken the lessons of your people to heart. You gain the trained proficiency rank in Arcana and Piloting. If you would automatically become trained in one of those skills (from your background or class, for example), you instead become trained in a skill of your choice. You also gain the @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.feats.Item.BocFD2KV0qgUC76x]{Additional Lore} general feat for Sarcesian Lore.
Sarcesian Lore.name: Sarcesian Lore

Sarcesian Weapon Familiarity.description:
You're accustomed to fighting from afar—really far! You gain access to weapons in the sniper group and all uncommon weapons with the sarcesian trait. You have familiarity with weapons in the sniper group and all weapons with the sarcesian trait—for the purposes of proficiency, you treat any of these that are martial weapons as simple weapons, and any that are advanced weapons as martial weapons.

At 5th level, whenever you get a critical hit with one of these weapons, you get its critical specialization effect.
Sarcesian Weapon Familiarity.name: Sarcesian Weapon Familiarity

Savvy Architect.description:
You understand the intricacies of architecture, especially the construction of sturdy tunnels and buildings. You become trained in Crafting. If you're already trained in Crafting, you instead gain the @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.feats.Item.QLeMH5mQgh28sa5o]{Specialty Crafting} skill feat for architecture.

You also gain a +2 circumstance bonus to Perception checks to notice dangerous structures. This bonus applies to checks to discover mechanical and environmental traps incorporated into walls, doors, ceilings, or other parts of a structure.

If you aren't using the [[/act seek]] action or searching, the GM automatically rolls a secret check for you to notice hazards incorporated into a structure anyway. This check doesn't gain your normal circumstance bonus.

featPrerequisites.0: Builder Formian or Worker Formian heritage

Savvy Architect.name: Savvy Architect

Saw it Coming.description:
Trigger You're about to roll initiative.

You read the demeanor, body language, and instinctive tics of your foes as easily as you read a comm unit, allowing you to react a moment before those around you and gain an edge in the coming battle. You gain a +1 circumstance bonus to your initiative roll, and you can immediately do one of the following: Interact to draw a weapon, Step, or Stride.
Saw it Coming.name: Saw it Coming

Scare to Death.description:
You can frighten foes so much, they might die. Attempt an @Check[intimidation|defense:will] check against the Will DC of a living creature within 30 feet of you that you sense or observe and who can sense or observe you. If the target can't hear you or doesn't understand the language you are speaking, you take a –4 circumstance penalty. The creature is temporarily immune for 1 minute.

Critical Success The target must attempt a @Check[fortitude|against:intimidation] save against your Intimidation DC. On a critical failure, it dies. On any other result, it becomes @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{Frightened 2} and is @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.sDPxOjQ9kx2RZE8D]{Fleeing} for 1 round. The critical failure effect has the death trait.

Success The target becomes frightened 2.

Failure The target becomes @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{Frightened 1}.

Critical Failure The target is unaffected.
Scare to Death.name: Scare to Death

Scatter Thoughts.description:
Frequency once per day

Trigger You're targeted by a mental effect.

You can shield your mind by using similar techniques that your ancestors once mastered to escape the Swarm. You block the intruding effect by scattering your thoughts, making you immune to the triggering mental effect for the next minute.
Scatter Thoughts.name: Scatter Thoughts

Scattering Fire.description: Your overwhelming onslaught scatters enemies like leaves in the wind. When you @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.feats.Item.fSqUeSAFhvBfq4sE]{Shoving Shot}, all creatures in the area attempt the Fortitude save to avoid forced movement, rather than just your primary target.
Scattering Fire.name: Scattering Fire

Schooled in Secrets.description:
You notice the signs and symbols that members of mystery cults and other secret societies use to declare their affiliation to fellow members. You can use Occultism in place of Diplomacy to [[/act gather-information skill=occultism]]{Gather Information} about such groups and in place of Deception to [[/act impersonate skill=occultism]]{Impersonate} a member of these groups.

If you belong to a secret cult, lodge, sect, or similar organization, you automatically recognize members of your group unless they are specifically attempting to conceal their presence from you. They also recognize your standing unless you are specifically concealing it.
Schooled in Secrets.name: Schooled in Secrets

Scion of the Fonqon Trees.description:
While all fonqugons are children of the fonqon trees, you're a rare fonqugon whose gestation took place over the course of 17 days instead of the typical seven, which often occurs when a fonqon tree is in especially dire circumstances. As such, you're much more connected to the trees' primal magic than a typical fonqugon. Choose one cantrip from the primal spell list. You can cast this cantrip as a primal innate spell at will. A cantrip is heightened to a spell rank equal to half your level rounded up.

Fonqugons must adapt to meet any challenge or threat that arises, and your magic is equally adaptable. By spending 1 day of downtime in a natural environment with any trees, you can change the cantrip you chose with this feat to a different primal cantrip.

Special You can take this feat only at 1st level, and you can't retrain into this feat.
Scion of the Fonqon Trees.name: Scion of the Fonqon Trees

Scope Sight.description: Viewing your marks through a scope is as instinctive as opening your eyes. Whenever you @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.actions.Item.sLikawnrJJzHMYeC]{Aim}, you can Interact to Activate a sight weapon upgrade.
Scope Sight.name: Scope Sight

Scorching Lifeblood.description:
Frequency once per day

You accelerate the blood in your veins, charging latent magical energies within. For 1 minute, any adjacent creature that touches you, deals piercing or slashing damage to you, or hits you with a melee unarmed attack takes 3d6 fire damage.
Scorching Lifeblood.name: Scorching Lifeblood

Scramble Tech.description: With a thought, you can infect a technological creature or device with a short-lived virus, causing the object to glitch and malfunction. You can cast @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.spells.Item.rBh2PjtbDGAjbcu6]{Discharge} as a 3rd-rank divine innate spell twice per day.
Scramble Tech.name: Scramble Tech

Scrap Shield.description: You've incorporated detritus and adhesive resin to your body to build temporary layers to your shell. As part of your daily preparations, you create either one commercial @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.equipment.Item.T0E2WL0QBpaUSlNL]{Compact Shield} or one commercial @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.equipment.Item.7fIZAOxTqKohRhVv]{Carbon Shield} from detritus and your excretions. This shield can't be sold, repaired, upgraded, or altered in any way, and it disintegrates when you next make your daily preparations. You can use the @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.feats.Item.jM72TjJ965jocBV8]{Shield Block} reaction with this shield.
Scrap Shield.name: Scrap Shield

Scrapper's Barricade.description:
You gain the @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.feats.Item.9S5mBcJujWOYCE6j]{Barricade} general feat. You can Barricade using resin and hazardous debris from your own body. Any attack that fails to hit you while you have cover from this barricade destroys it, dealing @Damage[4d8[acid]|options:area-damage] damage to each creature in a @Template[type:cone|distance:20] originating from the barricade with a basic @Check[reflex|against:spell-class|basic|options:area-effect] save against the higher of your class or spell DC. You must spend 10 minutes collecting new debris and resin before you can make another barricade in this way.

Special You can use @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.feats.Item.p9zewmzMJZXdKO33]{Adhering Acid} on your barricade to make any creature that fails a Reflex save against your barricade @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.i3OJZU2nk64Df3xm]{Clumsy 1} until the start of your next turn.
Scrapper's Barricade.name: Scrapper's Barricade

Scrapper's Ingenuity.description:
You take great delight in breaking down objects to their component parts so they can be rebuilt into something new. You gain a +1 circumstance bonus on Thievery checks to @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.actions.Item.cYdz2grcOcRt4jk6]{Disable Device} and @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.actions.Item.2EE4aF4SZpYf0R6H]{Pick Lock}. Whenever you successfully Disable Device, you harvest useful parts from the device for future use, gaining a +1 circumstance bonus on your next Crafting check to Craft or Repair. If the device you disabled was of a level higher than your own, this bonus increases to +2.

@UUID[Compendium.sf2e.feat-effects.Item.hcH7IdEjC2wUVfaK]{Effect: Scrapper's Ingenuity}
Scrapper's Ingenuity.name: Scrapper's Ingenuity

Scrounge for Food.description: You're highly skilled at making a succulent meal out of whatever you find lying around. You gain the @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.feats.Item.BocFD2KV0qgUC76x]{Additional Lore} feat for Cooking Lore. You can use Cooking Lore in place of Survival to [[/act subsist skill=cooking-lore]]. Additionally, you gain the @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.feats.Item.1Eceqc6zbMj2x0q9]{Seasoned} skill feat.
Scrounge for Food.name: Scrounge for Food

Scrub Psyche.description:
Trigger You or an ally fail a save against a mental effect while within your quantum field.

You scrub all traces of the triggering effect from the target's mind. The target rerolls their saving throw against the triggering effect and must use the second result, even if it's worse.
Scrub Psyche.name: Scrub Psyche

Scrupulous Stalker.description:
Frequency once per round

You quickly scan your surroundings for threats. You @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.actions.Item.BlAOM2X92SI6HMtJ]{Seek}. If you use electromagnetic sense, you gain a +2 circumstance bonus to this check.
Scrupulous Stalker.name: Scrupulous Stalker

Scurry to Safety.description:
Trigger You become @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{Frightened}.

When the going gets tough, the best choice is often to find somewhere safe to hide quickly. You Step or Stride.
Scurry to Safety.name: Scurry to Safety

Search High and Low!.description:
You alert your allies to look for enemies and @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.iU0fEDdBp3rXpTMC]{Hidden} things in a stressful situation, coordinating their efforts so they can do so more efficiently. Until the beginning of your next turn, you and your allies gain a +2 circumstance bonus to Perception checks to @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.actions.Item.BlAOM2X92SI6HMtJ]{Seek}. As your envoy level increases, increase the bonus to +3 at 7th level, +4 at 12th level, and +5 at 17th level.

@UUID[Compendium.sf2e.feat-effects.Item.E5oRUzuYh5rLlPzu]{Effect: Search High and Low!}

Lead by Example If you used two actions, Seek. Each of your allies within 100 feet who can sense you can also immediately Seek as a reaction.
Search High and Low!.name: Search High and Low!

Seasoned.description: You've mastered the preparation of many types of food and drink. You gain a +1 circumstance bonus to checks to @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.actions.Item.rmwa3OyhTZ2i2AHl]{Craft} food and drink, including serums if you have @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.feats.Item.VRLHQPDkjy0gbxBY]{Serum Crafting}. If you are a master in one of the prerequisite skills, this bonus increases to +2.

featPrerequisites.0: trained in Alcohol Lore, Cooking Lore, or Crafting

Seasoned.name: Seasoned

Secondary Directive.description:
Requirements Your last action this turn was issuing a 2-action directive.

You follow-up your issued directive with an understood order by attacking a notable foe. Make a Strike. If the Strike hits, the target is affected by a 1-action @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.actions.Item.cmCtfURzpbzkxWsy]{Get 'Em}.
Secondary Directive.name: Secondary Directive

Secret-Keeper.description: You're astonishingly good at keeping secrets. You gain a +4 circumstance bonus to Deception checks to Lie when it involves protecting a secret you believe is only known by 10 or fewer people. When you use Deception to [[/act lie]], you don't take a penalty to Deception checks while subject to a spell or effect that would compel you to tell the truth. Whenever you're subject to an effect that attempts to extract a secret from you, including any effect that would read your thoughts or make you controlled, you can attempt to counteract the effect using your Deception modifier as the counteract modifier, with a counteract rank equal to half your level (rounded up). You can attempt to counteract each effect only once per round.
Secret-Keeper.name: Secret-Keeper

Secrete Numbing Saliva.description:
Frequency once per hour

Requirements Your last action was a successful Strike with your stomach-mouth jaws unarmed attack.

Your stomach-mouth secretes numbing saliva into your target, exposing them to the poison.

Numbing Saliva (injury, poison)

Saving Throw @Check[fortitude|against:class-spell] (the higher of your class or spell DC)

Maximum Duration 6 rounds

Stage 1 @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.i3OJZU2nk64Df3xm]{Clumsy 1} (1 round)

Stage 2 clumsy 1 and @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.enA7BxAjBb7ns1iF]{Suppressed} (1 round)

Stage 3 @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.i3OJZU2nk64Df3xm]{Clumsy 2} and suppressed (1 round)
Secrete Numbing Saliva.name: Secrete Numbing Saliva

Secrets In The Dark.description: More lurks in the tunnels than most understand. You've taken the time to study the strange and otherworldly things that lurk in the shadows. You become trained in Occultism. If you would automatically become trained in Occultism (from your background or class, for example), you can instead become trained in a skill of your choice. You gain a +1 circumstance bonus to Decipher Writing or Identify Magic with Occultism.
Secrets In The Dark.name: Secrets In The Dark

See the Pattern.description:
Frequency once per day

You spend 10 minutes going over clues you've learned about an investigation to draw a line to a possible solution. Choose a creature you've met and interacted with or studied for at least an hour, or a mystery that you've been investigating for at least a day, and ask a question about that topic that wouldn't normally fall under the purview of @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.actions.Item.1OagaWtBpVXExToo]{Recall Knowledge}. The question must be specific and answerable, as determined by the GM. Some examples include, "Did the tech entrepreneur really kill his assistant?" or "Was the hacker collective responsible for the data theft?" You gain a flash of insight that allows you to know whether or not your line of thinking is on the right track, such as figuring out who to ask next, though you don't receive a definitive answer to your question. The GM determines your flash of insight.
See the Pattern.name: See the Pattern

Seedling Reincarnation.description: When you die, a seed sprouts from your body. The seedling is a copy of you lacking any of your memories, though it has vague memories of your relationships and might feel fond of your allies or distrustful of your enemies. Over 1d6 weeks, the seedling grows into a miniature version of you with the same attributes and abilities (but Small instead of Medium). Over 1d6 months, you grow to your original size. A new seedling germinates in you over 10 years; if you die again before then, the seedling dies too.
Seedling Reincarnation.name: Seedling Reincarnation

Seedpod Lure.description: You grow a floating secondary seedpod you can use to fool other creatures. You gain a +1 circumstance bonus to @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.actions.Item.GkmbTGfg8KcgynOA]{Create a Diversion} or @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.actions.Item.QNAVeNKtHA0EUw4X]{Feint}. Once every 10 minutes, you can deploy this lure as a move action. It remains deployed for 1 minute or until you Dismiss it. Any creature targeting you with an attack must attempt a @Check[flat|dc:5]; on a failure, the creature hits the seedpod lure instead of you, destroying it. A new one grows after 10 minutes of rest.
Seedpod Lure.name: Seedpod Lure

Seedpod Surveillance.description: Once per day, you can deploy your seedpod as a single action, which has the concentrate trait. When deployed this way, your seedpod can travel up to 200 feet away from you, with a fly Speed of 20 feet. Moving the seedpod is a free action, which you can take once per turn, and you can sense through it in all directions as if using your normal senses. After 1 minute, the seedpod returns directly to you at its normal Speed.
Seedpod Surveillance.name: Seedpod Surveillance

Seemingly Random Study.description: Who says topics can't be randomly connected? Whenever you attempt a check to @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.actions.Item.1OagaWtBpVXExToo]{Recall Knowledge}, you can roll the Lore skill you gained from @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.feats.Item.zW0sKlxIJHMhkly8]{Maze Lost} with a –3 circumstance penalty instead of rolling with a normally applicable skill.
Seemingly Random Study.name: Seemingly Random Study

Seismic Sensitivity.description: You've spent significant time underground, and as a result, your antennae are particularly sensitive to vibrations. You gain tremorsense as an imprecise sense with a range of 30 feet.
Seismic Sensitivity.name: Seismic Sensitivity

Sense Abnormalities.description: You possess an uncanny sixth sense for ambient magic. You can sense the presence of magic auras as though you were always using a 1st-rank @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.spells.Item.gpzpAAAJ1Lza2JVl]{Detect Magic} spell. This detects magic in your field of vision only. When you @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.actions.Item.BlAOM2X92SI6HMtJ]{Seek}, you gain the benefits of a 3rd-rank detect magic spell on things you see (in addition to the normal benefits of Seeking). You can turn this sense off and on with a free action at the start or the end of your turn.
Sense Abnormalities.name: Sense Abnormalities

Sense Emotions.description: You can detect the emotions of others, though you lack the ability to sort out the complexities of these emotions. You gain emotion sense as an imprecise sense with a range of 30 feet. This means you can detect and determine the location of creatures that possess emotions. You gain a +2 circumstance bonus to Perception checks when using the @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.actions.Item.BlAOM2X92SI6HMtJ]{Seek} action to find @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.iU0fEDdBp3rXpTMC]{Hidden} or undetected creatures within the range of your emotion sense who's under an emotion effect, such as rage, the frightened condition, or any spell with the emotion trait.
Sense Emotions.name: Sense Emotions

Sense Life.description: You can detect the vital essence of creatures. You gain lifesense as an imprecise sense with a range of 30 feet. This means you can sense the vital essence of living and undead creatures within range. You can distinguish between the vitality energy animating living creatures and the void energy animating undead creatures, much as sight distinguishes colors.
Sense Life.name: Sense Life

Sensitive Antennae.description:
Your antennae are covered in fine hairs that make them more sensitive to psychic vibrations than most. You gain thoughtsense as a vague sense with a range of 30 feet. This means you can use your antennae to determine if a creature is within range. Your thoughtsense detects only thinking creatures, so a creature that's unthinking or otherwise immune to mental effects can't be perceived using your thoughtsense. This doesn't give you the ability to read or understand their thoughts.

At 9th level, this becomes an imprecise sense.
Sensitive Antennae.name: Sensitive Antennae

Sensitive Rhinophores.description: You possess a pair of rodlike structures that let you taste the air or water around you, making you alert to the presence of others via scent. You gain imprecise scent with a range of 30 feet; this range increases to 60 feet when you're underwater. The GM will usually double the range if you're downwind or downstream or halve the range if you're upwind or upstream.
Sensitive Rhinophores.name: Sensitive Rhinophores

Septocular.description: You've learned to grow additional eyes all over your body, enhancing your visual processing and the range of your eyesight. When you use Change Shape, you can choose to gain all-around vision until you change forms again. During this time, you take a –3 circumstance penalty to Deception checks and Deception DCs to Impersonate a different ancestry, unless the ancestry you are Impersonating normally has seven or more eyes.
Septocular.name: Septocular

Sequester Form.description:
Frequency once per minute

Trigger You're targeted by a mental effect.

You can shield your consciousness by blocking one of your neural networks from the others, cutting yourself off from the identity until it's safe. You Change Shape and become immune to the triggering mental effect. You are no longer immune and the mental effect continues to affect you if you Change Shape into any form that shares an ancestry with that form before the duration of the mental effect expires.
Sequester Form.name: Sequester Form

Serious-Minded.description: You don't have time to let your emotions control your actions. You gain a +1 circumstance bonus to saving throws against emotion effects. Additionally, if you roll a success on a saving throw against an emotion effect, you get a critical success instead.
Serious-Minded.name: Serious-Minded

Serpentine Scurry.description:
1 to 3

You've learned to make use of your exceptional balance and your ankles that can rotate 180 degrees to run in almost any direction without warning, easily throwing off the expectations of any potential predators. You Stride for each action you use to Serpentine Scurry. If you change directions after moving 5 feet or more, any further movement you make as part of Serpentine Scurry doesn't trigger reactions based on movement.

Special If you have the @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.feats.Item.ZBhvJ9O8MvBFAlhq]{Quick Jump} skill feat, you can instead Stride, [[/act high-jump]], or [[/act long-jump]] for each action you use to Serpentine Scurry.
Serpentine Scurry.name: Serpentine Scurry

Serum Crafting.description: You can Craft serums and medical items with the consumable trait, though some have other requirements. When you select this feat, you gain formulas for four common serums of 2nd level or lower.
Serum Crafting.name: Serum Crafting

Serum Sponge.description: You can slowly inject a serum or spell ampoule into your foot orb as a 1-minute activity, storing it to be absorbed by your body later. You can have only one serum or spell ampoule in your body at a time. You can activate and consume the absorbed fluid by squeezing your orb with your cilia without needing a free hand. An injected serum or spell ampoule left in your foot orb is gradually absorbed by your body and is consumed without any effect after 24 hours.
Serum Sponge.name: Serum Sponge

Seven-Eyed Scrutiny.description: Your brain efficiently processes each of your eyes' input, creating composite images that reveal what would otherwise remain hidden. When you [[/act seek]] or use the @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.actions.Item.TiNDYUGlMmxzxBYU]{Search} exploration activity, you gain the benefits of the @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.spells.Item.jwK43yKsHTkJQvQ9]{See the Unseen} spell until the end of your next turn.
Seven-Eyed Scrutiny.name: Seven-Eyed Scrutiny

Shake it Off.description:
Frequency once per day

Trigger You fail a saving throw.

Your mental and physical fortitude allow you to resist disastrous harm. You reroll the triggering check, but you must use the new result, even if it's worse than your first roll. Unless you roll a critical success, you become @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.enA7BxAjBb7ns1iF]{Suppressed} until the end of your next turn as you shake off the ill effects.
Shake it Off.name: Shake it Off

Shambling Corpsefolk.description: Most creatures mistake you for a mindless, shambling zombie or even a lifeless corpse, and you've learned how to use your sepulchral appearance to your advantage. You gain the @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.feats.Item.Q6vXNDmTwDom59GV]{Feign Death} feat, even if you don't meet the prerequisites. You gain a +2 circumstance bonus when using Deception to roll initiative if you are @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.actions.Item.AJstokjdG6iDjVjE]{Impersonating} a corpse when combat begins.
Shambling Corpsefolk.name: Shambling Corpsefolk

Shameless Request.description: Shameless requests are your specialty. When you Request something, you reduce any DC increases for making an outrageous request by 2, and if you roll a critical failure for your Request, you get a failure instead. While this means you can never cause your target to reduce their attitude toward you by making a Request, they eventually tire of requests, even though they still have a positive attitude toward you.
Shameless Request.name: Shameless Request

Shape Statue.description:
You use the power that animates your body to reshape your living stone and transform into one of your comrades. That comrade must be a common Medium-sized humanoid ancestry prevalent where your unit fought (typically in Veskarium space). While these disguises resemble specific individuals, the age of most animate enshrined vesk makes it challenging to find anyone who has personally met any specific enshrined warrior. If you've fought alongside enough or otherwise formed a close bond with a member of your party, your GM might allow you to transform into them as well.

Using Shape Statue counts as creating a disguise for the @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.actions.Item.AJstokjdG6iDjVjE]{Impersonate} use of Deception, but without a @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.equipment.Item.Jvp0x2Sc82WVpExT]{holoskin} or similar disguise, you take a penalty to imitate a non-constructed ancestry. You can remain in your new form indefinitely, but you revert to your base form after 1 hour of @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.fBnFDH2MTzgFijKf]{Unconsciousness} or 1 minute after death.
Shape Statue.name: Shape Statue

Share Quantum Aura.description:
Frequency once per 10 minutes

You temporarily share your quantum field with an ally. You cause your quantum field to emanate from an ally you can see instead of yourself. The ally gains all the benefits of your quantum field, and your warp spells originate from your ally instead of you until your quantum field deactivates. If you cast warp spells at other targets, you must still have line of sight to the target, but the spell originates from your ally for purposes of determining its range and line of effect.
Share Quantum Aura.name: Share Quantum Aura

Shared Reverb.description:
Trigger You take mental damage or fail a save against a mental effect.

The connections that your horn-cones form are bidirectional, which has left you sensitive to psychic attacks, but you can repurpose your vulnerability into a weapon. The source of the triggering effect takes mental damage equal to your weakness to mental damage.
Shared Reverb.name: Shared Reverb

Sharpest Teeth.description: Vampires have nothing on your ability to draw blood with every bite. When you successfully hit with your jaws unarmed attack, your target takes 1 persistent bleed damage, or @Damage[1d4[persistent,bleed]] damage on a critical hit.
Sharpest Teeth.name: Sharpest Teeth

Sharpshooter.description: Your ranged Strikes against the target of your Aim using the required ranged weapon deal an additional 1d4 precision damage until the end of your turn. This damage increases to 2d4 at 6th level.
Sharpshooter.name: Sharpshooter

Shattering Impact.description:
You pour all your effort into making a single attack with your solar weapon that's so powerful it shatters the weapon. Strike with your solar weapon. The Strike deals one additional weapon damage die. Your solar weapon shatters and must be manifested to continue using it.

Graviton-Attuned On a hit, the target takes a –10-foot status penalty to Speed until the start of your next turn.

@UUID[Compendium.sf2e.feat-effects.Item.Ll3uZdiSqaszP3fn]{Effect: Shattering Impact}

Photon-Attuned On a hit, you additionally deal persistent fire damage equal to half your level, rounded up.
Shattering Impact.name: Shattering Impact

Shearing Beak.description: Powerful muscles anchor your beak, enabling you to take devastating bites out of any target you can immobilize. You gain a beak unarmed attack that deals @Damage[1d8[slashing]] damage. Your beak is in the brawling group and has the backstabber, grapple, razing, and unarmed traits. However, the beak is awkward to deploy as a weapon. You take a –2 circumstance penalty to beak Strikes against targets that aren't @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.kWc1fhmv9LBiTuei]{Grabbed}, helpless, @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.j91X7x0XSomq8d60]{Prone}, or @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.VcDeM8A5oI6VqhbM]{Restrained}. Even if an effect increases your melee reach, your beak's reach can't exceed 5 feet.
Shearing Beak.name: Shearing Beak

Shed Shell.description: When you need extra mobility, you can leave your cumbersome, protective shell behind. When you don't have your shell, your Speeds increases by 5 feet; you gain a +2 status bonus to Acrobatics, Stealth, and Thievery checks; and you gain weakness to physical damage equal to half your level (rounded up). You can't use any actions that require a shell until you return to your shell by using Shed Shell again. Regrowing a new shell takes 1 week of downtime, but a variety of prosthetic shells are available, as @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.equipment.Item.vJvy0qPz2Mcd7yXl]{Prosthetic Limb}.
Shed Shell.name: Shed Shell

Shed Skin.description:
Frequency once per hour

Trigger You attempt to @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.actions.Item.SkZAQRkLLkmBQNB9]{Escape}.

You rapidly shed a layer of your skin and slip away from a tight or sticky situation, living to fight (or flee) another day. You gain a +2 circumstance bonus on the triggering Escape, and on all attempts to Escape for 3 rounds. If the triggering Escape was successful, you can additionally Stand or Step (or Stride up to your Speed on a critical success).
Shed Skin.name: Shed Skin

Shedding Flurry.description:
Trigger You're struck by a critical hit from a melee attack.

Reacting quickly to danger, your body shakes and vibrates, causing you to shed some fur that can throw off the attacks of even the most experienced warrior. Attempt a @Check[flat|dc:17]. If you're successful, the attack becomes a normal hit.
Shedding Flurry.name: Shedding Flurry

Shell Insurance.description: The shell that protects most of your body has always been a part of you, and it has taught you valuable lessons in improving your defense and mobility when wearing armor. You gain the armor specialization effect of light armor. If you're trained in medium or heavy armor, you gain the respective armor specialization effects of those armors as well and reduce the Speed penalty of medium and heavy armor by 5 feet.
Shell Insurance.name: Shell Insurance

Shell Magic.description: The minerals constituting your mantle gradually absorb primal energy that you can extrude and shape. Choose one cantrip from the primal spell list. You can cast this cantrip as a primal innate spell at will. A cantrip is heightened to a spell rank equal to half your level rounded up.
Shell Magic.name: Shell Magic

Shell Shower.description:
Frequency once per round

Whether you got tired of getting hit in the face or slipping on bullet casings in the middle of a fight, you've learned how to redirect your weapon's spent ammunition or terrain warping vented energy while firing off a barrage. After you make an @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.actions.Item.oc0ZKnk5zD0GXqZi]{Area Fire} or @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.actions.Item.6ctkxUnVwqooSvgg]{Auto-Fire} attack with a weapon, make any number of squares adjacent to you difficult terrain. If a square was already difficult terrain, it instead becomes greater difficult terrain. Any difficult or greater difficult terrain created by this action remains in place until cleared.
Shell Shower.name: Shell Shower

Sheltering Limbs.description: Your limbs and trunk grow strong and thick enough to shield your allies from danger. You can share your space with up to one willing ally. While an ally is sharing space with you or occupying an adjacent square, your ally gains the benefits of lesser cover. The ally can @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.actions.Item.ust1jJSCZQUhBZIz]{Take Cover} to increase the bonus to standard cover.
Sheltering Limbs.name: Sheltering Limbs

Sheltering Mucous.description: You fill the nooks and crannies of your armor with a thick mucous that helps you feel more comfortable. You don't become @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.HL2l2VRSaQHu9lUw]{Fatigued} if you sleep while wearing armor. You gain the @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.actions.Item.DQSW4YEotxrLJIEl]{Mucous Spurt} reaction.
Sheltering Mucous.name: Sheltering Mucous

Shield Block.description:
Trigger While you have your shield raised, you would take physical damage (bludgeoning, piercing, or slashing) from an attack.

You snap your shield in place to ward off a blow. Your shield prevents you from taking an amount of damage up to the shield's Hardness. You and the shield each take any remaining damage, possibly breaking or destroying the shield.
Shield Block.name: Shield Block

Shield Companion.description:
Requirements You have an ally within reach.

You've studied the defensive tactics of squires and chroniclers who have found that the best form of defense is to protect your more capable allies. You @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.actions.Item.xjGwis0uaC2305pm]{Raise a Shield} to give an adjacent ally the circumstance bonus from your shield to their AC instead of you as long as the selected ally remains adjacent to you. These benefits last until the start of your next turn or until you're no longer adjacent to your ally, whichever happens first. If you have the @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.feats.Item.jM72TjJ965jocBV8]{Shield Block} feat, you can trigger Shield Block when you have your shield raised and the selected ally would take physical damage from an attack. You gain no bonus from Raising your Shield this way and can't Shield Block if you would take damage.
Shield Companion.name: Shield Companion

Shifter's Eye.description: You are a master at spotting other people in disguise. When you come within 10 feet of a creature that is disguised, transformed, or Impersonating a specific creature, the GM rolls a secret Perception check for you to realize that the creature is disguised, even if you didn't spend an action to @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.actions.Item.BlAOM2X92SI6HMtJ]{Seek} against that creature.
Shifter's Eye.name: Shifter's Eye

Shifter's Feint.description: You suddenly change your appearance to create an opening for your next attack. Change Shape and @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.actions.Item.QNAVeNKtHA0EUw4X]{Feint}. You gain a circumstance bonus to your Deception check to Feint equal to the number of steps between your sizes when you Change Shape (+1 if you are one size smaller or larger, +2 if you are two sizes smaller or larger, and so on). Regardless of the results of your check, each creature who observes you Change Shape is temporarily immune to Shifter's Feint for 1 minute.
Shifter's Feint.name: Shifter's Feint

Shifter's Orientation.description: Your malleable body makes it easier for you to reposition and rebalance yourself. Once every 10 minutes, when you Change Shape, you can gain the effects of the @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.spells.Item.t0oFlhMhNOHbb6rG]{Reorient} cantrip.
Shifter's Orientation.name: Shifter's Orientation

Shifter's Reach.description: You can stretch your body into long tentacular limbs to strike enemies from further away. For 1 minute, increase your reach when you're delivering touch range spells and making unarmed Strikes to 10 feet. This doesn't change the reach of your melee weapon attacks.
Shifter's Reach.name: Shifter's Reach

Shifter's Shove.description: You use the explosive momentum of shifting to help push a creature away from you. Change Shape into a larger size and @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.actions.Item.7blmbDrQFNfdT731]{Shove}. You gain a circumstance bonus to your Athletics check to Shove equal to the number of steps between your sizes when you Change Shape (+1 if you are one size larger, +2 if you are two sizes larger, and so on).
Shifter's Shove.name: Shifter's Shove

Shifter's Squeeze.description: You can easily contort and resize your limbs to squeeze into smaller spaces. You gain the trained proficiency rank in Acrobatics. If you are already trained in Acrobatics (from your background or class, for example), you instead become trained in a skill of your choice. You gain the @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.feats.Item.3G8xUlgCjRmRJNfP]{Quick Squeeze} feat.
Shifter's Squeeze.name: Shifter's Squeeze

Shifting Plates.description:
Frequency once per day

Trigger You fail a Fortitude or Reflex saving throw.

Your chitin can shift and overlap in unpredictable ways, protecting you when you're unable to protect yourself. You can reroll the triggering saving throw, using the second result even if it's worse.
Shifting Plates.name: Shifting Plates

Shifting Smuggler.description: When you @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.actions.Item.34E7k2YRcsOU5uyl]{Change Shape}, you can @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.actions.Item.qVNVSmsgpKFGk9hV]{Conceal an Object} inside a cavity in your body or Interact to grab an object stored inside your body. You can store up to four items of light Bulk or less if you are Large, three items of light Bulk or less if you are Medium, or two items of light Bulk or less if you are Small. If you Change Shape into a smaller-sized body, the excess items fall to the ground in your square. None of these items can have a dimension longer than 1 foot.
Shifting Smuggler.name: Shifting Smuggler

Shiny.description: Your personality shines bright in a galaxy of stars. You become trained in Performance (or another skill if you're already trained in Performance), and you gain a +3 circumstance bonus on checks to @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.actions.Item.HCl3pzVefiv9ZKQW]{Aid} for Deception, Diplomacy, Intimidation, and Performance checks.
Shiny.name: Shiny

Shirren Lore.description:
Your ability to adapt to various beliefs instills you with knowledge of many cultures. You gain the trained proficiency rank in Diplomacy and Society. If you would automatically become trained in one of those skills (from your background or class, for example), you instead become trained in a skill of your choice.

You also gain the @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.feats.Item.BocFD2KV0qgUC76x]{Additional Lore} general feat for Shirren Lore.
Shirren Lore.name: Shirren Lore

Shobhad Ferocity.description:
Frequency once per day

Trigger You would be reduced to 0 Hit Points, but not immediately killed.

Centuries of living on a brutal and unforgiving planet has endowed many shobhad with an implacable will to survive despite debilitating injuries. You avoid being knocked out and remain at 1 Hit Point, and your @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.Yl48xTdMh3aeQYL2]{Wounded} condition increases by 1.
Shobhad Ferocity.name: Shobhad Ferocity

Shobhad Lore.description:
You're well-versed in the stories of your people. You become trained in Nature and Survival. If you would automatically become trained in one of those skills (from your background or class, for example) you instead become trained in a skill of your choice. You also gain the @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.feats.Item.BocFD2KV0qgUC76x]{Additional Lore} general feat for Shobhad Lore.

Special If you have the urban shobhad heritage, you also gain the Additional Lore general feat for Ysoki Lore.
Shobhad Lore.name: Shobhad Lore

Shobhad Special.description:
Requirements You have at least one hand free and are wielding a two-handed ranged weapon that doesn't have the area trait in your inactive hands.

Invented by a talented shobhad sniper over a thousand years ago, the so-called "shobhad special" is a devastating maneuver that is only possible by a creature with the shobhad-neh's unique combination of size, strength, extra limbs, and cultural sniping techniques. Much to your pride, you're one of the few who have mastered it. Attempt a fist Strike against a creature at least one size smaller than you. If the attack is successful, you deal no damage but the target is immediately thrown up to 30 feet in a direction of your choice. Then, Switch Hands and make a ranged Strike against the target with the required weapon; the target is @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.AJh5ex99aV6VTggg]{Off-Guard} against this Strike. Regardless of whether this Strike is successful, the creature then falls @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.j91X7x0XSomq8d60]{Prone} in whatever space is appropriate based on your throw.

Special If you have the @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.feats.Item.KxaYlC50zzHysJj8]{Titan Wrestler} skill feat, you can use Shobhad Special against creatures up to your size, or up to one size larger than you if you're legendary in Athletics.
Shobhad Special.name: Shobhad Special

Shobhad Spirit-Blessed.description: You come from a line of shobhad spiritualists attuned to the whispers of the little spirits that encircle all things. Choose a 1st-rank divine or primal spell, either a common spell or another to which you have access. You can cast that spell once per day as an innate primal spell.
Shobhad Spirit-Blessed.name: Shobhad Spirit-Blessed

Shobhad Weapon Familiarity.description:
You gain access to all uncommon weapons with the shobhad trait. You have familiarity with weapons with the shobhad trait, plus the cryopike, fangblade, and hammer. For the purposes of proficiency, you treat any of these that are martial weapons as simple weapons and any that are advanced weapons as martial weapons.

At 5th level, whenever you get a critical hit with one of these weapons, you get its critical specialization effect.
Shobhad Weapon Familiarity.name: Shobhad Weapon Familiarity

Shocking Howl.description:
Frequency once per 10 minutes

Trigger A creature within 30 feet attempts a ranged Strike against you.

You exclaim suddenly, creating a powerful jolt to the triggering creature's nerves and potentially disrupting its attack. The creature must attempt a @Check[will|against:class-or-spell] save against the higher of your class DC or spell DC. Regardless of the result, it becomes immune to Shocking Howl for 1 hour.

Critical Success The creature is unaffected.

Success The triggering attack roll takes a –1 status penalty.

Failure The triggering attack roll takes a –2 status penalty.

Critical Failure The shot is completely disrupted and automatically misses.
Shocking Howl.name: Shocking Howl

Shooting Star.description:
Frequency once per 10 minutes

You launch yourself across the battlefield, emulating the brightest shooting stars. You Stride up to twice your Speed in a straight line. You're @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.DmAIPqOBomZ7H95W]{Concealed} during this movement.
Shooting Star.name: Shooting Star

Shore Scuttle.description:
Requirements You have at least one hand free. Your powerful limbs help anchor you to surfaces, allowing you to pull yourself through shallows and even lean your body almost parallel to the ground without falling over. You can choose to fall @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.j91X7x0XSomq8d60]{Prone}. You then either [[/act crawl]] 10 feet (if prone) or Stride up to your Speed (if not prone), ignoring difficult terrain caused by shallow water. If you're prone, you can then Stand.

Special If an ability (such as the @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.feats.Item.5I97q0FfAeXcUQhs]{Nimble Crawl} skill feat) allows you to Crawl more than 10 feet as an action, you can instead Crawl up to that distance when you Shore Scuttle.
Shore Scuttle.name: Shore Scuttle

Shot on the Run.description:
Requirements You're wielding an area or automatic weapon.

By preparing your weapon while on the move, you ready yourself to fire a salvo as soon as you're in position. Stride up to your Speed, and then @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.actions.Item.oc0ZKnk5zD0GXqZi]{Area Fire} or @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.actions.Item.6ctkxUnVwqooSvgg]{Auto-Fire}.
Shot on the Run.name: Shot on the Run

Shoving Shot.description:
Requirements You're wielding an area or automatic weapon.

You use the blast of your weapon to push back your adversaries. You Area Fire or Auto-Fire. Your primary target must attempt a @Check[fortitude|against:soldier|options:forced-movement] save against your class DC.

Failure The target is pushed back 10 feet. If using an area (burst) weapon, the target is pushed away from the burst's center point.

Critical Failure As failure, but the target is pushed 15 feet.
Shoving Shot.name: Shoving Shot

Show of Flame.description:
Trigger A creature fails its Reflex save against your @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.ancestry-features.Item.jjVH7W3IhgaJ5Yct]{Fire Breath}.

Your flames are a fearsome sight to behold, blazing through all who oppose you. Choose one creature that failed its Reflex save against your @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.ancestry-features.Item.jjVH7W3IhgaJ5Yct]{Fire Breath}. Attempt an Intimidation check to [[/act demoralize]] that enemy; you don't take a penalty for not sharing a language.
Show of Flame.name: Show of Flame

Show-Off.description:
howing off isn't just something you do, it's part of who you are. You can use Performance to [[/act demoralize skill=performance]], [[/act lie skill=performance]], or [[/act make-an-impression skill=performance]]. If you've just done something impressive—such as rolling a critical success on an attack, save, or check—you gain a +2 circumstance bonus to Performance checks for 1 minute, as the memory of your impressive feat hangs in the air. The GM has final say on if an action was impressive enough to merit this bonus.

@UUID[Compendium.sf2e.feat-effects.Item.JNIAimpO48hgxhfN]{Effect: Show-Off}
Show-Off.name: Show-Off

Shroud of Shattered Spirits.description:
Frequency once per day

Trigger An enemy's Strike or targeted effect would hit you, and you weren't already @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.DmAIPqOBomZ7H95W]{Concealed}, @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.iU0fEDdBp3rXpTMC]{Hidden}, or undetected to that enemy.

Your mere presence attracts restless spirits, haunted objects, spiritually active substances, and fragmented souls, like a magnet attracts metal. You manifest these spirit shards in a chaotic whirlwind around you that you barely control with your thoughts. You become concealed until the beginning of your next turn, and the flat check for concealment applies to the triggering Strike or effect that would've hit you. If the flat check fails, the Strike or effect misses you.
Shroud of Shattered Spirits.name: Shroud of Shattered Spirits

Shy.description: Whether through magical training, a technomagical body rig, or superior escape and evasion training, you've managed to learn how to fade from plain sight. You can cast @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.spells.Item.XXqE1eY3w3z6xJCB]{Invisibility} as a 2nd-rank arcane innate spell twice per day, but the spell has a duration of only 5 minutes each time.
Shy.name: Shy

Sidestep.description:
Trigger The attack roll for a Strike targeting you fails.

You deftly step out of the way of an attack, letting the blow continue to the creature next to you. You redirect the attack to a creature of your choice that's adjacent to you and within range or reach of the triggering attack. The attacker rerolls the Strike's attack roll against the new target.
Sidestep.name: Sidestep

Sigiled Scales.description:
Your scales are marked with tiny sigils. When you select this feat, choose if you were blessed by a god or by an aberrant force. You can tap into the latent magic in your scales to cast a cantrip as an innate spell at will. A cantrip is heightened to a spell rank equal to half your level rounded up.

If you are blessed by a god, choose one cantrip from the divine spell list. You can cast this cantrip as a divine innate spell at will.

If you are blessed by an aberrant force, choose one cantrip from the occult spell list. You can cast this cantrip as an occult innate spell at will.
