Whenever you cast an innate spell granted by your Sigiled Scales or a feat that lists Sigiled Scales as a prerequisite, the sigils on your scales glow with magical energy, shedding bright light in a 10-foot radius for a number of minutes equal to the spell's rank.
Sigiled Scales.name: Sigiled Scales

Sign Language.description:
You learn the sign languages associated with the languages you know, allowing you to sign and understand signs. Sign languages typically require both hands to convey more complex concepts, and they are visual rather than auditory.

Sign language is difficult to understand during combat due to the level of attention needed, unlike basic gestures like pointing at a foe to suggest a target. Sign language is hard to use in areas of low visibility, just like speech is difficult in a noisy environment.
Sign Language.name: Sign Language

Silent Tide.description: Stalking great finned beasts through the kelp forests of Kalo-Mahoi has taught you to move silently and smoothly through the cover of foliage. While sneaking, you ignore difficult terrain caused by foliage and underbrush and treat greater difficult terrain caused by foliage or underbrush as difficult terrain. In addition, you can move at your full swim Speed when you @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.actions.Item.VMozDqMMuK5kpoX4]{Sneak} while swimming. If you have another ability that allows you to move at full speed while Sneaking, you also gain a +2 status bonus to checks to Sneak while Swimming.
Silent Tide.name: Silent Tide

Singularity.description:
Frequency once per hour

Requirements You're graviton-attuned.

You call upon a shred of the unstoppable cosmic force that eventually destroys all things. You concentrate and manifest the pinpoint center of a black hole within 60 feet. This occupies a single 5-foot space. Creatures within the singularity's space take @Damage[(max((2*floor(@actor.level / 2) - 4),10))d8[void]|options:area-damage] damage with a @Check[reflex|against:solarian|basic|options:area-effect] save against your class DC. Any creature dropped to 0 Hit Points by this effect is torn asunder and pulled into the singularity, leaving no remains. Until the end of your next turn, light can't pass through the singularity's space and all adjacent squares, shrouding it in darkness that even creatures with darkvision or greater darkvision can't see through. Any creature that starts its turn in the darkness must succeed at a @Check[fortitude|against:solarian|basic|options:area-effect,inflicts:slowed] save against your class DC or become @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.xYTAsEpcJE1Ccni3]{Slowed 1} for that turn.

Level (+2) Increase the damage by 2d8.
Singularity.name: Singularity

Siphon Solar Vitality.description: Your starburst markings store solar energy that you can tap into to revitalize your body and magically heal your wounds. You regain Hit Points equal to @Damage[(@actor.level+ 1d6)[healing]](1d6 plus your character level). If you're in an area of natural sunlight, you instead regain Hit Points equal to @Damage[((2*@actor.level)+1d6)[healing]] (1d6 plus twice your character level).
Siphon Solar Vitality.name: Siphon Solar Vitality

Situational Awareness.description: You Ready a directive. If the trigger you designated occurs before the start of your next turn, you can use the 2-action version of the directive instead of the 1-action.
Situational Awareness.name: Situational Awareness

Size Up.description:
Frequency once per hour

You spend 1 minute observing a specific individual, 10 minutes researching a specific individual on the infosphere, or 1 hour networking and gathering information. This subject is your asset. If you assess your asset via observation, you don't need to know their identity, but if you assess your asset via research or networking, you must know their identity, which requires at least two relevant pieces of information about them. Examples of relevant information could include their name, their place of origin, their current residence, the name of their parent or significant other, their employer, or their organizational affiliation. The GM determines what constitutes relevant information for this purpose, based on the asset you've selected.

You gain a +1 circumstance bonus to Deception, Diplomacy, Intimidation, and Perception checks against or in relation to your asset, and a +1 circumstance bonus to attempts to @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.actions.Item.1OagaWtBpVXExToo]{Recall Knowledge} about your asset.

You gain the benefits of the 2-action @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.actions.Item.cmCtfURzpbzkxWsy]{Get 'Em!} when using 1-action Get 'Em! on an asset.

You can maintain a number of assets equal to your Charisma modifier. If you Size Up other assets after that, your new asset replaces a previous one.

@UUID[Compendium.sf2e.feat-effects.Item.RBWwGxsrxPBKi3X7]{Effect: Size Up}
Size Up.name: Size Up

Size of the Ancients.description:
Frequency once per day

You undergo a rapid physical change, increasing in size to rival dragonkin of the ancient past. You grow to size Huge. Your equipment grows with you, but it returns to its natural size if removed or dropped. Your reach increases by 5 feet (or by 10 feet if you are a shipborn dragonkin), and you gain a +4 status bonus to melee damage. This transformation lasts for 10 minutes. You can end this transformation early as a single action that has the concentrate trait.
Size of the Ancients.name: Size of the Ancients

Skill Training.description:
You become trained in the skill of your choice.

Special You can select this feat multiple times, choosing a new skill to become trained in each time.
Skill Training.name: Skill Training

Skilled Bodyguard.description:
Your bulk and dexterous limbs are incredibly useful for ensuring that you keep your smaller allies out of harm's way. You move a number of willing, adjacent creatures that are smaller than you up to 5 feet each in a direction of your choice; the number of creatures you can move is equal to the number of unoccupied hands you currently have (including your inactive pair of hands). This counts as forced movement (meaning you cannot move a target into hazardous terrain or a space they cannot occupy).

Special If you have the @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.feats.Item.KxaYlC50zzHysJj8]{Titan Wrestler} skill feat, you can use Skilled Bodyguard to move a creature of any size.
Skilled Bodyguard.name: Skilled Bodyguard

Skillful Encouragement.description:
You offer an ally advice and encouragement, granting them the inspiration they need to push themselves further in the face of a challenge. During a combat encounter, select an ally within 60 feet. That ally gains a +2 circumstance bonus to their skill checks until the beginning of your next turn. That ally then becomes temporarily immune to your Skillful Encouragement for 1 hour. If you said this advice verbally, Skillful Encouragement gains the auditory trait. If you signed this advice, Skillful Encouragement gains the visual trait.

@UUID[Compendium.sf2e.feat-effects.Item.TMarUs51Jg7v3g3f]{Effect: Skillful Encouragement}
Skillful Encouragement.name: Skillful Encouragement

Skirmish Strike.description: You attack as you move, staying mobile as you fight and keeping your enemies on their toes. Either Step and then Strike, or Strike and then Step.
Skirmish Strike.name: Skirmish Strike

Skitching.description:
Requirements You have at least one hand free.

While you're unable to accelerate as quickly as most vehicles, you can keep up with them by hanging onto them. Attempt an @Check[acrobatics|against:ac] or @Check[athletics|against:ac] check with a DC equal to the vehicle's AC. On a success, you hang onto that vehicle and remain adjacent to the vehicle as it moves, and you can @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.actions.Item.bG91dbtbgOnw7Ofx]{Board} the vehicle without an additional check. You can let go of the vehicle at any point without spending an action; if you do, you gain a circumstance bonus to your land Speed equal to the vehicle's Speed until the end of your next turn. Each time you move farther than your land Speed without this bonus, you must succeed at a Fortitude saving throw or lose control and move in a straight line up to your land Speed.
Skitching.name: Skitching

Skitter Wrastle.description: You're overeager to get to grips with your foes (or just give an ally an unexpected big hug). You Step and attempt an Athletics check to [[/act grapple]] a creature.
Skitter Wrastle.name: Skitter Wrastle

Skittermander Lore.description:
You're gregarious and friendly but also passionately interested in the history of your people, going out of your way to learn traditional stories and unearth lost secrets. You gain the trained proficiency rank in Diplomacy and Society. If you would automatically become trained in one of those skills (from your background or class, for example), you instead become trained in a skill of your choice.

You also gain the @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.feats.Item.BocFD2KV0qgUC76x]{Additional Lore} general feat for Skittermander Lore, and you learn Morandomandranan, the original skittermander language that has long been suppressed by the Veskarium.
Skittermander Lore.name: Skittermander Lore

Skulking Strike.description:
Trigger An enemy occupying the same space as you uses a manipulate action or a move action, makes a ranged attack, or leaves a square during a move action it's using.

You launch a surprise attack from below. Make a melee Strike against the triggering creature. If your attack is a critical hit and the trigger was a manipulate action, you disrupt that action. This Strike doesn't count toward your multiple attack penalty, and your multiple attack penalty doesn't apply to this Strike.
Skulking Strike.name: Skulking Strike

Sky-Save.description:
Requirements You have at least one hand free and your target is no more than one size larger than you.

You swoop down, use your arms to grab your friend, and fly them off to safety. You Fly or @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.feats.Item.SToQWyRke76PwAvh]{Tail Glide} for each action you used to Sky-Save. At any point during this movement, you can seize hold of one willing ally within reach, taking them with you for the duration of your movement. When Sky-Save ends, choose if you are carrying the ally (making the ally @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.kWc1fhmv9LBiTuei]{Grabbed}) or Release the ally (the ally must be willing to be Released).
Sky-Save.name: Sky-Save

Skyguard.description: You earned your space legs in the Skyguard, Kalo-Mahoi's space navy. You become trained in Piloting, and you gain a +1 circumstance bonus to Piloting checks to Navigate and Stunt. If you're already trained in Piloting, you become trained in another skill of your choice. You gain the @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.feats.Item.VPFiluVQoj8F2Ho0]{Stunt Maneuver} skill feat, even if you don't meet the prerequisites of the feat.
Skyguard.name: Skyguard

Slick Mucus.description:
Frequency once every 10 minutes

You secrete a slick and slippery slime when speed is of the essence. Until the end of your turn, when you leave a square, you use @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.ancestry-features.Item.F7aBUHwgBVRdyZJe]{Slime Squirt} in that square. If you're @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.kWc1fhmv9LBiTuei]{Grabbed}, @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.eIcWbB5o3pP6OIMe]{Immobilized}, or @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.VcDeM8A5oI6VqhbM]{Restrained}, you can attempt to Escape with a +2 circumstance bonus. You can then Stride. During this Stride, you have a +10-foot circumstance bonus to your Speed.
Slick Mucus.name: Slick Mucus

Slime Spray.description:
Frequency once every 10 minutes

With extra effort, you can spray your slime in a @Template[type:cone|distance:15], causing the area to become difficult terrain for non-osharu creatures for 1 minute.
Slime Spray.name: Slime Spray

Slimy Osharu.description: You excrete more slime than most osharus. @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.ancestry-features.Item.F7aBUHwgBVRdyZJe]{Slime Squirt} no longer has a frequency. Additionally, you can Slime Squirt as a free action, but after using it as a free action, you can't use Slime Squirt again for 1 minute.
Slimy Osharu.name: Slimy Osharu

Slip From Sight.description:
Frequency once per hour

Trigger You successfully use Stealth to Hide and become @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.iU0fEDdBp3rXpTMC]{Hidden} from all your current foes, or use Stealth to @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.actions.Item.VMozDqMMuK5kpoX4]{Sneak} and become undetected to all your current foes.

Using clever technology, magical talent, a divine blessing, or uncanny luck, you slip from sight completely, becoming @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.zJxUflt9np0q4yML]{Invisible} for 1 minute, or until you take a hostile action, whichever comes first.
Slip From Sight.name: Slip From Sight

Slip Through.description:
Trigger You become @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.kWc1fhmv9LBiTuei]{Grabbed}, @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.eIcWbB5o3pP6OIMe]{Immobilized}, or @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.VcDeM8A5oI6VqhbM]{Restrained}.

Your slick fur assists you in sliding out of narrow crevices, slipping restraints, or evading the crushing jaws of predators. You attempt to @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.actions.Item.SkZAQRkLLkmBQNB9]{Escape}.
Slip Through.name: Slip Through

Slippery Secrets.description: You elude and evade attempts to uncover your true nature or intentions. When a spell or magical effect tries to read your mind, detect whether you are lying, or reveal your identity, you can attempt a Deception check against the spell or effect's DC. If you succeed, the effect reveals nothing.
Slippery Secrets.name: Slippery Secrets

Smashing!.description: You focus your energy and concentrate on your target to find cracks and flaws you can exploit before you Strike. This Strike gains the razing trait, dealing additional damage to objects equal to double the number of weapon damage dice. On a critical hit, a targeted tech item becomes @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.6A2QDy8wRGCVQsSd]{Glitching 1}.
Smashing!.name: Smashing!

Smelling Brain.description: You have an entire brain just for processing scents. You gain imprecise scent with a range of 30 feet. This means you can use your sense of smell to determine the location of a creature. The GM will usually double the range if you're downwind from the creature or halve the range if you're upwind. In addition, you gain a +2 circumstance bonus to Perception checks whenever you're trying to locate an undetected creature that's within the range of your scent.
Smelling Brain.name: Smelling Brain

Smiling False.description: You tell fibs so naturally that even as you're pulling the wool over their eyes, people see the best in you. You become trained in Deception. If you would automatically become trained in Deception (from a background or class, for example), you instead become trained in a skill of your choice. You gain the @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.feats.Item.B6HbYsLBWb1RR6Fx]{Charming Liar} skill feat.
Smiling False.name: Smiling False

Smooth Diversions.description:
You're practiced in the art of diverting attention quickly and subtly. When you succeed at an attempt to @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.actions.Item.GkmbTGfg8KcgynOA]{Create a Diversion}, you can immediately @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.actions.Item.VMozDqMMuK5kpoX4]{Sneak} or Step as a free action.

Additionally, creatures only become aware you were trying to trick them if you critically fail to Create a Diversion. Otherwise the creature assumes that your diversion was part of your regular bravado.
Smooth Diversions.name: Smooth Diversions

Smooth Operator.description: Your glistening skin oils make it harder to pin you down. Whenever you roll a success on a check to Escape or a saving throw against an effect that would impose the @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.kWc1fhmv9LBiTuei]{Grabbed}, @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.eIcWbB5o3pP6OIMe]{Immobilized}, or @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.VcDeM8A5oI6VqhbM]{Restrained} condition on you, you get a critical success instead. Whenever a creature rolls a failure on a check to [[/act grapple]], [[/act shove]], or [[/act trip]] you, it gets a critical failure instead.
Smooth Operator.name: Smooth Operator

Smug Affirmation.description: Having overcome countless challenges in your rise to power, your self-confidence isn't just bluster and brains; it's supported by empirical evidence! Your Shielding Arrogance reaction can now also trigger whenever a foe within range of your thoughtsense critically fails an attack against you or critically fails a skill check attempted against you (such as an Intimidation check to @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.actions.Item.2u915NdUyQan6uKF]{Demoralize} you or an Acrobatics check to @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.actions.Item.21WIfSu7Xd7uKqV8]{Tumble} around you). Increase the number of temporary Hit Points you gain from @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.actions.Item.wI0g2nRfu2d0YFAd]{Shielding Arrogance} to [[/r 2d8]] plus your character level. Increase this by [[/r 1d8]] at 13th level and by an additional [[/r 1d8]] at 17th level.
Smug Affirmation.name: Smug Affirmation

Snap Shut.description:
Frequency once per 10 minutes

Trigger An enemy hits you with a Strike, or you attempt a Reflex save.

Your reflexes kick in as you throw your armplates in front of yourself in times of danger. You drop all held items; if you have @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.feats.Item.I32QIsNQhioRMmjt]{Bulky Armplates}, instead choose one arm and drop anything it's carrying. You immediately [[/act take-cover]] and gain the effects of greater cover against the triggering attack.
Snap Shut.name: Snap Shut

Soaring Vulkarisu.description: You extend your broad membranes and flap your powerful arms in carefully controlled patterns, creating enough lift to carry you through the air. You gain a fly Speed equal to your land Speed.
Soaring Vulkarisu.name: Soaring Vulkarisu

Social Chameleon.description: You integrated yourself completely into another culture, whether through honest immersion or duplicitous subterfuge. As a result, you've adopted the mannerisms of your hosts. You gain the @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.feats.Item.ihN8gkHSdPG9Trte]{Adopted Ancestry} general feat and your choice of a 1st-level common ancestry feat from the chosen ancestry.
Social Chameleon.name: Social Chameleon

Soft Paw, Sharp Claw.description:
Trigger An ally attempts a Diplomacy or Intimidation check to [[/act coerce]] or [[/act make-an-impression]].

Brenneri ambassadors refer to alternating tones in negotiations as soft paw, sharp claw. If the triggering check is a Diplomacy check, you attempt an Intimidation check, and vice versa. Your ally uses the higher of the two results for their triggering check.
Soft Paw, Sharp Claw.name: Soft Paw, Sharp Claw

Solar Barrage.description: You can fire off multiple shots with your solar flare in short succession. Make three solar flare Strikes against different targets, each with a –2 circumstance penalty. These attacks count toward your multiple attack penalty, but the penalty doesn't increase until after you've made the attacks.
Solar Barrage.name: Solar Barrage

Solar Flare.description: You can create and maintain a solar flare, but do not add your Strength modifier to damage rolls with your solar flare or any additional benefits based on your attunement.
Solar Flare.name: Solar Flare

Solar Manifestation Expert.description: Your proficiency ranks for solar flare, solar weapon, and your solarian class DC increases to expert.

featPrerequisites.1: expert in any kind of weapon or unarmed attack

Solar Manifestation Expert.name: Solar Manifestation Expert

Solar Nimbus.description: You gain the Nimbus Surge reaction, but do not gain any additional benefits based on your attunement.
Solar Nimbus.name: Solar Nimbus

Solar Rampart.description: Your training has helped you adapt to bulkier armor. You're trained in heavy armor. Whenever you gain a class feature that grants you expert or greater proficiency in medium armor, you also gain that proficiency in heavy armor. You treat armor you wear of 2 Bulk or higher as though it were 1 Bulk lighter (to a minimum of 1 Bulk).
Solar Rampart.name: Solar Rampart

Solar Shield.description:
You've developed a new solar manifestation—a small shield of stellar energy that orbits you. This energy shield has the attuned and solarian traits and doesn't require a hand to use. You can Raise a Shield, giving you a +1 circumstance bonus to AC until the start of your next turn. You gain the Shield Block general feat.

@UUID[Compendium.sf2e.feat-effects.Item.q5W7fV1wXvqBFxt8]{Effect: Solar Shield}

While the shield is raised, you can use the Shield Block reaction with your shield. The shield has Hit Points equal to 5 plus twice your level and Hardness equal to half your level, rounded up. Your shield can't be broken, but if it's destroyed, you can't manifest a new shield for 10 minutes. If your shield vanishes due to you losing attunement, when you Attune to reform it, the shield returns with however many Hit Points it previously had. The shield regains all its lost Hit Points during your daily preparations and whenever you rest for at least 10 minutes, even if it's been destroyed.

Graviton-Attuned If your shield is destroyed, it releases a shock wave. Adjacent enemies must succeed at a @Check[fortitude|against:solarian] save against your class DC or be @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.enA7BxAjBb7ns1iF]{Suppressed} for 1 round (2 rounds on a critical failure).

Photon-Attuned If your shield is destroyed, it releases a flash of light. Adjacent enemies must succeed at a @Check[fortitude|against:solarian] save against your class DC or be @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.TkIyaNPgTZFBCCuh]{Dazzled} for 1 round (@UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.XgEqL1kFApUbl5Z2]{Blinded} for 1 round on a critical failure).
Solar Shield.name: Solar Shield

Solar Weapon Customization.description: You can select up to one trait for your solar weapon. When you reach level 6, you can choose a second trait, or the reach or two-hand 1d10 trait instead of two traits.
Solar Weapon Customization.name: Solar Weapon Customization

Solar Wind.description: You can partly discorporate your body, becoming a blur of stellar matter pushed by invisible solar winds. While photonattuned, you gain a +10-foot circumstance bonus to Speed and can move through the space of a single unwilling creature each time you Stride.
Solar Wind.name: Solar Wind

Solarian Dedication.description:
You gain the stellar attunement class feature, but you do not Attune as a free action when you roll initiative. You become trained in solar flare, solar weapon, and solarian class DC.

You can manifest a solar weapon. Your weapon has the attuned and solarian traits, but you can't select additional traits and it gains no benefits based on your attunement. You gain the @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.actions.Item.uvtdqSfKD6oXNA29]{Re-Forge Solar Weapon} action.

@UUID[Compendium.sf2e.journals.JournalEntry.vx5FGEG34AxI2dow.JournalEntryPage.M0qBmGZ6Gbi9DHzE]{Solarian}
Solarian Dedication.name: Solarian Dedication

Solarian's Resiliency.description: You gain 3 additional Hit Points for each solarian archetype class feat you have. As you continue selecting solarian archetype class feats, you continue to gain additional Hit Points in this way.

featPrerequisites.1: class granting no more Hit Points per level than 8 + your Constitution modifier

Solarian's Resiliency.name: Solarian's Resiliency

Soldier Dedication.description:
You become trained in Intimidation. If you were already trained in Intimidation, you instead become trained in a skill of your choice. Increase your maximum and encumbered Bulk limits by 2. You become trained in soldier class DC.

You become trained in light armor and medium armor. If you already were trained in light armor and medium armor, you gain training in heavy armor as well. Whenever you gain a class feature that grants you expert or greater proficiency in any type of armor (but not unarmored defense), you also gain that proficiency in the armor types granted to you by this feat. If you have a class feature that grants you expert proficiency in unarmored defense and you're 13th level or higher, you also become an expert in the armor types granted to you by this feat.

@UUID[Compendium.sf2e.journals.JournalEntry.vx5FGEG34AxI2dow.JournalEntryPage.pNf6YRj0ilnSYwcn]{Soldier}
Soldier Dedication.name: Soldier Dedication

Soldier's Resiliency.description: You gain 3 additional Hit Points for each soldier archetype class feat you have. As you continue selecting soldier archetype class feats, you continue to gain additional Hit Points in this way.

featPrerequisites.1: class granting no more Hit Points per level than 8 + your Constitution modifier

Soldier's Resiliency.name: Soldier's Resiliency

Soldier's Toughness.description: Your proficiency rank in Fortitude saves increases to master.
Soldier's Toughness.name: Soldier's Toughness

Soldier's Training.description:
Constant drills and combat experience leave you with reflexes capable of making snap decisions. Choose one soldier class feat you have that grants a reaction. At the start of your turn, you gain an additional reaction that you can only use for the selected class feat or an action granted by the selected class feat.

You can change the reaction selected for this feat when you make your daily preparations as long as the new feat meets the requirements.
Soldier's Training.name: Soldier's Training

Solid Stance.description: When you stand on four legs, you dig into the ground firmly, making yourself particularly difficult to move. While in quadrupedal posture, you gain a +4 circumstance bonus to your Fortitude or Reflex DCs against attempts to [[/act reposition]], [[/act shove]], or [[/act trip]] you. This bonus also applies to saving throws against spells or effects that attempt to move you or knock you @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.j91X7x0XSomq8d60]{Prone}. When you move, except to Stand, you lose the benefits of this feat until the beginning of your next turn.
Solid Stance.name: Solid Stance

Something to Protect.description:
You speak a powerful line that emphasizes your convictions and unwillingness to give up. You and each of your allies that heard or saw you gains temporary Hit Points equal to your level and a +1 status bonus to Will saves, AC, and attacks until the start of your next turn.

@UUID[Compendium.sf2e.feat-effects.Item.F8kgMkcz23UXS7k7]{Effect: Something to Protect}
Something to Protect.name: Something to Protect

Song of My People.description: You perform a mournful dirge tinged with supernatural grief that compels the soul of a lost comrade to return to its body. You can cast @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.spells.Item.Hnc7eGi7vyZenAIm]{Breath of Life} once per day as a 7th-rank primal innate spell. It gains the auditory trait.
Song of My People.name: Song of My People

Song of Whimsy.description:
Frequency once per day

Your performances, vocal or otherwise, can tap into the same riotous primal energy as that of the First World, warping reality to the whimsy of your soul's emotional spectrum. Roll [[/r 1d20 #Song of Whimsy]] and consult the table below for your result. If the result's emotion doesn't match your current soulfeel, attune your soulfeel to that emotion. If the effect requires a saving throw, use the higher of your class DC or spell DC.

d20EmotionEffect
1–3FuryAll enemies within 30 feet must attempt a Will save. If they fail, they become @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.yblD8fOR1J8rDwEQ]{Confused} for 3 rounds (or 1 minute on a critical failure), and their latent anger causes them to deal an additional @Damage[3d4[persistent,bleed]] damage with all Strikes against allies.
4–6JoyYou and all allies within 30 feet reduce your frightened conditions by 1, end any persistent mental damage, and gain 25 temporary Hit Points that last until the end of your next turn.
7–9SorrowAll enemies within 30 feet become @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.enA7BxAjBb7ns1iF]{Suppressed} until the end of your next turn and must attempt a Will save. If they fail, they become @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.xYTAsEpcJE1Ccni3]{Slowed 1} for 3 rounds (or 1 minute on a critical failure).
10–12WonderAll enemies within 30 feet become @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.TkIyaNPgTZFBCCuh]{Dazzled} until the end of your next turn and must attempt a Will save. On a failure, they become @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.e1XGnhKNSQIm5IXg]{Stupefied 2} for 3 rounds (or 1 minute on a critical failure).
13+Current soulfeelSelect the effect that corresponds to your current soulfeel attunement.
Song of Whimsy.name: Song of Whimsy

Sonic Sync.description: Your crystals grant you a resonant defense against certain effects, though they often disrupt your soulfeel. You gain resistance 5 to sonic damage. In addition, if you critically fail a save against a damaging sonic effect, you can change your soulfeel to a different emotion as a free action.
Sonic Sync.name: Sonic Sync

Soothing Anchor.description:
Frequency once every 10 minutes

Requirements Your last action was to Sustain your quantum field or had the anchoring trait.

You concentrate more deeply on your anchor to soothe yourself. You gain temporary Hit Points equal to your character level that last for 1 round.
Soothing Anchor.name: Soothing Anchor

Soul Furnace.description:
Frequency once per affliction every 24 hours

Your soul becomes fuel, burning away your life force to purge an affliction. Choose a disease or poison you're afflicted by. Lose a number of Hit Points equal to the level of the affliction. Attempt a new saving throw against the affliction, as though you were at the end of its listed interval. If you fail or critically fail this save, don't increase the affliction's stage.
Soul Furnace.name: Soul Furnace

Soul Sustenance.description: Your soul is radiant and can sustain your living body indefinitely, without the need for outside nourishment. You don't need to eat or drink, and you count your Constitution modifier as one higher while determining how much you heal from resting.
Soul Sustenance.name: Soul Sustenance

Soul-Soother.description: You have a deep understanding of emotions and mental health. You become trained in one of the following skills of your choice: Diplomacy or Medicine. If you would automatically become trained in both of those skills (from your background or class, for example), you instead become trained in a skill of your choice. In addition, if you roll a critical failure on a Will save against an emotion effect, you get a failure instead.
Soul-Soother.name: Soul-Soother

Soul-Sworn Bravery.description:
You've deepened the bonds of your soul-sworn oaths. As long as you are within 10 feet of the target of your soul-sworn oath, you each gain a +1 circumstance bonus to your Will save against fear effects. If you are both @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{Frightened}, whenever the value of the frightened condition decreases for one of you, it decreases by 1 for the other as well.

@UUID[Compendium.sf2e.feat-effects.Item.qWKEoeSiev5IosQ8]{Effect: Soul-Sworn Bravery}
Soul-Sworn Bravery.name: Soul-Sworn Bravery

Soul-Sworn Oath.description: You can swear a soul-sworn oath with one other willing sapient creature, empathically bonding your souls to one another. Swearing this bond is a 10-minute activity that you must both participate in. A soul-sworn oath lasts until you or the target choose to end it as a free action. You can only have one soul-sworn oath active at a time. If you attempt to swear a second soul-sworn oath, the first soul-sworn oath immediately ends. You and the target of this oath can communicate with each other mentally, as if you had limited telepathy with a range of 60 feet. In addition, as long as you can communicate mentally with one another, you share each other's languages.
Soul-Sworn Oath.name: Soul-Sworn Oath

Soulfire.description:
Your understanding of your own emotions and soul deepens profoundly. You gain additional benefits depending on your current soulfeel attunement.

Fury: You gain a +2 circumstance bonus to your Athletics checks.

Joy: You gain a fly Speed of 20 feet.

Sorrow: You gain a burrow Speed of 10 feet.

Wonder: You gain a +2 circumstance bonus to your Perception checks.

Special If you have @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.feats.Item.yKvCJEbGwZ3PaZh0]{Mascot Power!}, the summoned minion gains the same benefits of Soulfire as you.
Soulfire.name: Soulfire

Space Pirate Dedication.description:
As a plunder-seeking spacefarer, you become trained in Piloting, or become an expert in it if you were already trained. You have familiarity with all cutlasses, flails, rapiers, and weapons with the razing trait. For the purposes of proficiency, treat any of these that are martial weapons as simple weapons and any that are advanced weapons as martial weapons. If you are at least expert, you gain that weapon's critical specialization effect.

Additionally, you gain the @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.actions.Item.8zWFGKRXg1SxIwFH]{Holo-Roger} action.

@UUID[Compendium.sf2e.journals.JournalEntry.vx5FGEG34AxI2dow.JournalEntryPage.9W89zXYRobxnEOA3]{Space Pirate}
Space Pirate Dedication.name: Space Pirate Dedication

Spacewyrm Slayer.description:
You remember tales of legendary dwarven heroes who battled spacefaring dragon raiders, and you keep their epic deeds alive in your heart.

Select a magical tradition. When you successfully Strike against a dragon, you gain a circumstance bonus to your damage equal to the number of weapon damage dice. This bonus increases to double the number of weapon damage dice if your target dragon has the trait associated with the magical tradition you selected when you gained this feat.
Spacewyrm Slayer.name: Spacewyrm Slayer

Speak with Spirit.description: You can speak clearly with creation itself. You gain @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.spells.Item.BBvV7qoXGdw09q1C]{Speak with Animals}, @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.spells.Item.qvwIwJ9QBihy8R0t]{Speak with Plants}, and @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.spells.Item.Nf6GqoHkNbfWJDQT]{Speak with Computers} as 4th-rank primal innate spells, and @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.spells.Item.YIMampGpij4Y30yE]{Speak with Stones} as a 5th-rank primal innate spell. You can cast one of these spells once per day.
Speak with Spirit.name: Speak with Spirit

Specialized Operative.description: Choose a specialization. You become trained in one skill determined by your specialization; if you were already trained in that skill, you instead become trained in another skill of your choice. You gain a skill feat associated with that skill. You don't gain any other benefits from your specialization.
Specialized Operative.name: Specialized Operative

Specialty Crafting.description:
Your training focused on Crafting one particular kind of item. Select one of the specialties listed below; you gain a +1 circumstance bonus to Crafting checks to Craft items of that type. If you are a master in Crafting, this bonus increases to +2. If it's unclear whether the specialty applies, the GM decides. Some specialties might apply only partially. For example, if you were making an Abadarcorp travel suit and had specialty in textiles, the GM might give you half your bonus because the item requires both armorsmithing and textiles to craft.

SpecialtyApplicable Items
ArmorsmithingArmor, shields and upgrades
ArtistryFine art, including jewelry and solarian crystals
AutomotivesVehicles, including spaceships
ChemicalsAlcohol, ammunition, explosives, and fuel
ComputerComm units, datapads, and virtual items
EngineeringTech gadgets and accessories
GunsmithingFirearms and firearm upgrades
Life ScienceBiotechnology and some pharmaceuticals
RoboticsDrones, mechs, and robots
TextilesClothing, leather, and polymer armor
Specialty Crafting.name: Specialty Crafting

Spectra Ascendant.description: Whether through a quirk of your bloodline, the interference of powerful spectra, or Triune's blessing, your body has been flooded by the essence of the Drift, transforming you into a spectra. You cease aging. You gain darkvision, the cosmic trait, and a fly Speed equal to your land Speed. While you're in the Drift, your fly Speed is equal to double your land Speed. Additionally, you gain the @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.actions.Item.VQH9rEQuNb06NQ4b]{Cosmic Blast} action.
Spectra Ascendant.name: Spectra Ascendant

Spectra Transmission.description:
Frequency once per hour

You can project your speech through wireless transmission, rather than speaking aloud, causing your words to emit from unsecured technological devices as either audio, text, or both. For example, your voice could emit audibly from an intercom or appear as text on a vidscreen or holosign. Select an unsecured technological device within 100 feet. For 1 minute, you can choose to transmit anything you say through that output device, rather than say it aloud. You can change which device you use as an output as a single action. Doing so doesn't extend the duration.
Spectra Transmission.name: Spectra Transmission

Spectrasoul.description: You became a prismeni after a close encounter with one or more spectra. You can communicate mentally with spectra and with intelligent constructs with the tech trait within 30 feet. You don't need to share a language to communicate with such creatures in this way. This doesn't give you any special access to their thoughts and communicates no more information than normal speech would.
Spectrasoul.name: Spectrasoul

Speed of Thought.description: You have honed your telekinetic maneuverability, enabling greater bursts of speed. Increase your fly Speed by 5 feet. In addition, you gain the @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.actions.Item.r1bUsyDwcwuN3MUG]{Telekinetic Sprint} action.
Speed of Thought.name: Speed of Thought

Spellsail.description: You can ride the waves of energy left in the wake of your spells. If the next action you use is to @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.actions.Item.aBQ8ajvEBByv45yz]{Cast a Spell} that targets a creature within 60 feet, you teleport to an open space adjacent to the spell's target.
Spellsail.name: Spellsail

Spellsurge Ammo.description:
Frequency once per turn

Trigger You cast a non-cantrip spell.

You siphon spell energy into one weapon or grenade you're wielding. Until the end of your turn, the weapon or grenade deals extra force damage equal to the rank of the spell and gains the magical trait if it didn't have it already. If the spell deals damage, the extra damage becomes the same type as the triggering spell.
Spellsurge Ammo.name: Spellsurge Ammo

Spelunker.description:
You're experienced in moving through spaces that are too small for you. This might be from the caverns of Apostae or a similar world.

You become trained in Acrobatics. If you would automatically become trained in Acrobatics (from your background or class, for example), you instead become trained in another skill of your choice. You gain the @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.feats.Item.3G8xUlgCjRmRJNfP]{Quick Squeeze} feat.
Spelunker.name: Spelunker

Spew Acidic Bile.description:
Frequency once per day

You spew bile in a broad spray, violently vomiting in a @Template[type:cone|distance:30]. Your bile deals @Damage[(ceil(@actor.level/2)-2)d6[acid],(ceil(@actor.level/2)-2)d6[poison]|options:area-damage] damage to creatures in the area, with a basic Reflex save against the higher of your class DC or spell DC. On a failure, a creature is also @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.fesd1n5eVhpCSS18]{Sickened 1} (@UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.fesd1n5eVhpCSS18]{Sickened 2} on a critical failure). At 11th level and every two levels thereafter, the acid damage and the poison damage each increase by 1d6.
Spew Acidic Bile.name: Spew Acidic Bile

Spiked Exoskeleton.description: You have spikes extending from your external shell. These spikes deal @Damage[1d4[piercing]] damage to a creature that @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.actions.Item.PMbdMWc2QroouFGD]{Grapples} you or hits you with an unarmed attack.
Spiked Exoskeleton.name: Spiked Exoskeleton

Spine Defense.description: Your spines are sturdy enough to serve double duty. Your spine unarmed attack gains the parry trait. The circumstance bonus to your AC from parrying increases to +2 against any target you hit with a Strike using your spine this turn.
Spine Defense.name: Spine Defense

Spirit's Protection.description:
Frequency once per day

Trigger You fail a saving throw.

In times of great stress, you can still feel the flickers of your deceased partner's heartbeat pounding in time with yours, steering you to safety or girding your mind from assault. Their spirit still protects you from beyond the grave. You can reroll the triggering saving throw and use the better result.
Spirit's Protection.name: Spirit's Protection

Spirit-Blessed Protections.description: The spirits of the planet Akiton protect you from being harmed by the forces of the natural world. You gain a +1 status bonus to saves against primal spells.
Spirit-Blessed Protections.name: Spirit-Blessed Protections

Spiritual Wards.description: Your spiritual guardians ward you against all but the most potent of magics. You have resistance 20 against spirit damage and damage from primal spells.
Spiritual Wards.name: Spiritual Wards

Spongy But Strong.description: Your body is notably resilient, even for an ooze. You gain the @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.feats.Item.I0BhPWqYf1bbzEYg]{Diehard} general feat.
Spongy But Strong.name: Spongy But Strong

Spore Shot.description:
Frequency once every 10 minutes

You channel extra spores into one of your spore pods, preparing it to choke your target. Make a spore pod Strike. If it hits, you deal spore pod damage as normal and your target must succeed at a @Check[fortitude|against:class-spell] save against the higher of your class DC or spell DC or become @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.i3OJZU2nk64Df3xm]{Clumsy 1} for 1 minute (or @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.i3OJZU2nk64Df3xm]{Clumsy 2} on a critical failure). You also gain the critical specialization effect for your spore pod Strike.
Spore Shot.name: Spore Shot

Spot Healing.description:
Trigger An adjacent bonded ally takes damage.

You quickly expend energy from your vitality network toward a bonded ally. @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.actions.Item.UeMHbnnaXDa3sGfG]{Transfer Vitality} to the triggering ally.
Spot Healing.name: Spot Healing

Spotlight.description:
You can focus your light, shining it onto a specific location or target like a mobile spotlight to ensure no detail passes unseen. You shine a focused, bright light in a 5-foot radius burst within 40 feet (within 120 feet if you're a bright novian). You [[/act point-out]] one creature in your spotlight. Creatures gain a +1 circumstance bonus on Perception checks to [[/act seek]] within the area of this focused light.

Spotlight lasts a number of rounds equal to half your level (minimum 1 round). While Spotlight is active, and for an hour after Spotlight ends, the area of your solar luminance is halved.
Spotlight.name: Spotlight

Spray Ink.description:
Frequency once per round

A special gland near your siphons produces a viscous ink that you can squirt at a foe within 15 feet. The target must attempt a @Check[reflex|against:class-spell] save against the higher of your class DC or spell DC. The target then becomes immune to your Spray Ink for 1 minute.

Success The target is unaffected.

Failure The target is @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.TkIyaNPgTZFBCCuh]{Dazzled} until the end of your next turn.

Critical Failure The target is @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.XgEqL1kFApUbl5Z2]{Blinded} until the beginning of your next turn and dazzled until the end of your next turn.
Spray Ink.name: Spray Ink

Spread the Love.description:
Requirements You're wielding an area or automatic weapon.

You skillfully line up your attack to harry two targets within your blast zone with equal lethality. You Area Fire or Auto-Fire, selecting two different primary targets, rather than one.
Spread the Love.name: Spread the Love

Spread the Wealth.description: Why should you keep all the luck for yourself? When you're a living, breathing good luck charm, it's important to spread the success to your friends, especially when they're in need of a helping hand. When you Aid, as long as you're an expert or better in the skill you're using, failures and critical failures to Aid instead count as successes.
Spread the Wealth.name: Spread the Wealth

Sprint.description: You sprint at top speed to chase down a foe or flee a dangerous situation. Stride up to four times. You can increase the number of actions this activity takes to 3 to Stride up to six times.
Sprint.name: Sprint

Sprinter.description: Years of darting between cactus-like plants, climbing the twisting, gnarled trunks of kvashes, and leaping across giant chasms have paid off. Your Speed increases by 5 feet.
Sprinter.name: Sprinter

Spryflight.description: Your quick reflexes and impeccable balance assist you in zero gravity. You can @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.actions.Item.FF5KgZHj345s2moq]{Push Off} in zero-g without needing a free hand. You also ignore the @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.AJh5ex99aV6VTggg]{Off-Guard} and @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.i3OJZU2nk64Df3xm]{Clumsy} penalties while @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.z1ucw4CLwLqHoAp3]{Untethered} in zero gravity.
Spryflight.name: Spryflight

Squirt Blood.description:
You squirt blood from one of your eyes at a creature within 30 feet. The target must attempt a @Check[fortitude|against:class-spell] save against your class DC or spell DC, whichever is higher, with the following results.

Critical Success The target is unaffected.

Success The target is disgusted by the display, becoming @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.fesd1n5eVhpCSS18]{Sickened 1}.

Failure The target is struck in the face, becoming @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.TkIyaNPgTZFBCCuh]{Dazzled} for 1 round, or until they Interact once to clean the blood away.

Critical Failure The target is struck in the face, becoming dazzled for 2 rounds, or until they Interact twice to clean the blood away.
Squirt Blood.name: Squirt Blood

Squishy Cover.description: You might blend into the background, but your allies can use your bulk as cover. When you [[/act hide]], one adjacent ally your size or smaller can use a reaction to Step and Hide behind you, gaining the @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.DmAIPqOBomZ7H95W]{Concealed} condition until either one of you moves.
Squishy Cover.name: Squishy Cover

Squox Stance.description: Using a technique developed by studying the defensive motions of wild squoxes, you get on all fours and bury your claws deeply into the ground, wiggling your tail around in a frenzy as if it were a separate creature with a mind of its own. Until you move, you gain a +1 circumstance bonus to your Fortitude and Reflex DCs against attempts to [[/act shove]], [[/act reposition]], or [[/act trip]] you. This bonus also applies to saving throws against spells or effects that attempt to move you or knock you @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.j91X7x0XSomq8d60]{Prone}. Furthermore, until you move, when you successfully [[/act feint]] a creature of your level or lower while that creature is flanking you, flanking doesn't make you @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.AJh5ex99aV6VTggg]{Off-Guard} to that creature (though that creature can still help its other allies flank you).
Squox Stance.name: Squox Stance

Stalks in the Back of Your Head.description: There's no difference between front and back for a mecenaic. You can look, move, and point your arms in either direction interchangeably. You aren't @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.AJh5ex99aV6VTggg]{Off-Guard} when flanked and gain a +1 circumstance bonus to Perception checks for initiative.
Stalks in the Back of Your Head.name: Stalks in the Back of Your Head

Stand Aside.description: You use your large size and extra limbs to quickly aid your smaller allies in making room for you. Stride up to your Speed. If you end your movement in a position where one or more of your spaces are occupied by an ally, each such ally can immediately Step as a free action so that they are no longer occupying the same space as you. If this isn't possible, you must end your movement so that you aren't sharing a space with an ally, as normal.
Stand Aside.name: Stand Aside

Star Brand.description:
Requirements Your last action was a successful solar flare or solar weapon Strike against a creature.

You brand the creature with potent solar energy that keeps it visible and attracts your solar flare. When targeting the branded creature, increase the range increment of your solar flare by 60 feet. If the branded creature is @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.zJxUflt9np0q4yML]{Invisible}, or later becomes invisible, it's @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.DmAIPqOBomZ7H95W]{Concealed} instead. If the branded creature was already concealed for any other reason, it's no longer concealed.

The brand lasts 10 minutes but ends immediately if the branded creature is slain or you Star Brand a different creature.
Star Brand.name: Star Brand

Star Swimmer.description: You have adapted to swimming gracefully among the stars. You are not clumsy or @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.AJh5ex99aV6VTggg]{Off-Guard} while moving in zero-g environments. Additionally, you can move in zero-g using your swim Speed as though it were a fly Speed and you had the cosmic trait.
Star Swimmer.name: Star Swimmer

Starfinder Field Agent Dedication.description:
You are a trained agent of the Starfinder Society. You become an expert in Society. You gain the @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.feats.Item.BocFD2KV0qgUC76x]{Additional Lore} feat for Starfinder Lore; if you were already trained in Starfinder Lore, you also become trained in a Lore skill of your choice.

Special You can take this feat if you have the @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.feats.Item.i5OwninARF668ud8]{Xenoarchaeologist Archetype Dedication} feat even if you haven't taken two additional xenoarchaeologist feats. Xenoarchaeologist archetype feats count as Starfinder field agent feats, and vice-versa, for purposes of completing the archetypes.

@UUID[Compendium.sf2e.journals.JournalEntry.vx5FGEG34AxI2dow.JournalEntryPage.KeDD3FTsGyj5lSnT]{Starfinder Field Agent}
Starfinder Field Agent Dedication.name: Starfinder Field Agent Dedication

Starfinder Provisions.description: The Starfinder Society provides you with provisions to aid you on your adventures. Each day during your daily preparations while you're in a settlement, a Starfinder Society delivery drone delivers two consumable items with an item level no higher than half your level. The drone might not be able to arrive if you're in a remote location or based on GM's discretion. If you receive a subsequent delivery and have items remaining from the prior delivery, you must return any unused consumables to the drone before receiving new stock.
Starfinder Provisions.name: Starfinder Provisions

Starship Mechanic.description: Like many atraxids, you have spent a great deal of time building and repairing starships. You can @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.actions.Item.1OagaWtBpVXExToo]{Recall Knowledge} about starships using Crafting instead of Piloting. When you critically fail a Crafting check to Recall Knowledge about starships, you get a failure instead.
Starship Mechanic.name: Starship Mechanic

Start Again.description: When a fight is about to break out, it's best to be on your toes; you take a split second to connect with your luck to stay ahead of the game. You can trigger @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.feats.Item.O9vr3SRZJPlotj5t]{Blue Mood} after you roll initiative, in addition to its normal trigger, to reroll your initiative and take the higher of the two results. This counts as a usage of Blue Mood, as normal.
Start Again.name: Start Again

Startling Shift.description:
Frequency once every 10 minutes

You pulse and strobe your pigmentation in bright and luminescent tones to confuse and distract your enemies. Attempt a @Check[deception|against:will] check and compare it to the Will DC of each creature in a @Template[type:emanation|distance:40]. The creatures are then temporarily immune to Startling Shift for 24 hours.

Critical Success The creature is @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.AdPVz7rbaVSRxHFg]{Fascinated} by you for as long as it can see you (unless it stops being fascinated, as normal for the condition) and is @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.TkIyaNPgTZFBCCuh]{Dazzled} for 1 round or as long as it's fascinated, whichever is longer.

Success The creature is fascinated by you for 1 round and is dazzled for 1 round.

Failure The creature is dazzled for 1 round.

Critical Failure The creature is unaffected.
Startling Shift.name: Startling Shift

Stash Steal.description: You know how to prepare for the unforeseen and can instantly recognize the signs of buried stashes from others who share your diligence. You gain the @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.feats.Item.bh2jHyyYrkLMsIdX]{Prescient Planner} general feat. You can use Prescient Planner as a 2-action activity once per day to find a buried stash of goods, and you can procure ammunition and batteries in addition to the usual items available. These items must meet the usual level, Bulk, and other requirements, and you must still pay the price of the chosen item, usually by buying similar goods and burying them for later, even if that means other vulkarisu get to it first.
Stash Steal.name: Stash Steal

Stash for Later.description:
Alright, you admit it: you're a bit of a hoarder. But you maintain that all those things you've been squirreling away aren't useless! In fact, you swear you'll find a use for them one day! If only you can remember where you stashed everything...

You become trained in Survival. If you're already trained in Survival, you instead become trained in another skill of your choice. You can spend 3 actions burying up to a light Bulk of goods, or 10 minutes burying up to 10 Bulk of goods. This usually requires suitable terrain you can dig through, such as loose dirt or sand, but a GM might allow you to bury your stash in other terrain, such as a junkyard or behind the drywall of an office building. In most cases, creatures have a chance to detect your stash only if they use the @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.actions.Item.BlAOM2X92SI6HMtJ]{Seek} action to attempt a @Check[perception|against:survival|traits:action:seek,concentrate,secret] check against your Survival DC. If you're relatively close by, such as in the same settlement, you can usually retrieve your stash in an hour without any problems.
Stash for Later.name: Stash for Later

Statistical Anomaly.description:
Frequency once per hour

Trigger You critically fail a saving throw or skill check.

It's unclear whether your luck is very good or very bad; more research may be necessary. Reroll the triggering check or save and use the second result. If the triggering skill check is for Delve Lore or the triggering saving throw is to avoid a trap's effects, the frequency for this effect becomes once per 10 minutes.
Statistical Anomaly.name: Statistical Anomaly

Steady Advance.description: An object in motion stays in motion, and a person of your mass is rarely acted upon by an outside force. You Stride twice or @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.actions.Item.FF5KgZHj345s2moq]{Push Off} once, gaining a +2 circumstance bonus to your AC against any reactions triggered by your movement. A creature that attempts such a reaction and fails its attack roll becomes @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.AJh5ex99aV6VTggg]{Off-Guard} until the beginning of your next turn.
Steady Advance.name: Steady Advance

Steady Balance.description: You can keep your balance easily, even in adverse conditions. Whenever you roll a success using the @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.actions.Item.M76ycLAqHoAgbcej]{Balance} action, you get a critical success instead. You're not @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.AJh5ex99aV6VTggg]{Off-Guard} while attempting to Balance on narrow surfaces and uneven ground.
Steady Balance.name: Steady Balance

Steady Descent.description: By making minor adjustments to gravitational forces on your body, you make a controlled descent instead of falling. You glide slowly toward the ground, 5 feet down and up to 25 feet horizontally through the air. As long as you spend at least 1 action gliding each round and haven't yet reached the ground, you remain in the air at the end of your turn. If you use Steady Descent in zero gravity, you instead move up to half your fastest Speed in a direction of your choice.
Steady Descent.name: Steady Descent

Steady Trinket.description: One of your personal trinkets has seen you through a long illness, recovery from an injury, or days aboard a ship dealing with motion sickness. Holding on to the object fills you with memories of being treated with tender care. You suppress the sickened condition for 10 minutes.
Steady Trinket.name: Steady Trinket

Stellar Rush.description:
You rush forward with a blast of stellar energy, getting into the thick of combat with ease. Stride twice. You gain a +10-foot circumstance bonus to your Speed during these moves.

Graviton-Attuned When you finish your Strides, enemies within 15 feet of you must attempt a @Check[fortitude|against:solarian|options:area-effect,forced-movement] save against your class DC. On a failure, they're pulled directly toward you, ending in an adjacent square if possible. You select the order these enemies are moved.

Photon-Attuned When you finish your Strides, you create a photon field in a @Template[type:burst|distance:15] centered on you. Until the start of your next turn, creatures outside the photon field are @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.DmAIPqOBomZ7H95W]{Concealed} to creatures inside the field.
Stellar Rush.name: Stellar Rush

Stellar Shield Collapse.description:
Trigger Your Solar Shield is destroyed while you have it raised.

Requirements You haven't used Black Hole or Supernova within the last 10 minutes.

Your solar shield collapses in on itself.

Graviton-Attuned Immediately use @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.feats.Item.51dFA09erqAeMt39]{Black Hole} as a free action (if you have the Black Hole feat).

Photon-Attuned Immediately use @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.feats.Item.71DtcZirJ9bbKMTY]{Supernova} as a free action (if you have the Supernova feat).

featPrerequisites.0: Solar Shield plus either Black Hole or Supernova

Stellar Shield Collapse.name: Stellar Shield Collapse

Step Between.description:
Frequency once every 10 minutes

Requirements You're adjacent to a vertical surface, such as a wall.

You Stride. This Stride does not trigger reactions normally triggered by movement. You can move through other creatures' spaces as though you were Tiny. During this Stride, if you're ever not adjacent to the required surface, your Stride ends.

Special If you're @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.z1ucw4CLwLqHoAp3]{Untethered}, you can Step Between as long as you're touching any surface. You ignore the untethered condition during your Stride as part of this action.
Step Between.name: Step Between

Sticky Secretions.description: You produce abundant adhesive resin. You become trained in Athletics. If you're already trained in Athletics (from your background or class, for example), you become trained in another skill of your choice. You gain a +1 circumstance bonus to your Fortitude or Reflex DC against attempts to [[/act shove]] or [[/act reposition]] you. Additionally, you gain the @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.actions.Item.6YOkLkTcNWxROKEG]{Goo Grab} reaction.
Sticky Secretions.name: Sticky Secretions

Stinging Tendril.description:
Your tendrils have barbs that can deliver toxins. You gain a tendril unarmed attack that deals 1d6 poison damage in the dart weapon group and has the agile, finesse, injection, and unarmed traits.

At 5th level, whenever you get a critical hit with this attack, you get its critical specialization effect.
Stinging Tendril.name: Stinging Tendril

Stinking Slime.description: Your slime assails the olfactory receptors. Non-osharu creatures that begin their turn adjacent to any square affected by @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.ancestry-features.Item.F7aBUHwgBVRdyZJe]{Slime Squirt} or @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.feats.Item.64rwZGS8fKt8P5Ae]{Slime Spray} must attempt a @Check[fortitude|against:class-spell] save against the higher of your class DC or spell DC. On a failure, they become @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.fesd1n5eVhpCSS18]{Sickened 1} (@UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.fesd1n5eVhpCSS18]{Sickened 2} on a critical failure).
Stinking Slime.name: Stinking Slime

Stitch Flesh.description: You can use @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.actions.Item.1kGNdIIhuglAjIp9]{Treat Wounds} to restore Hit Points to undead creatures, not just living ones. The techniques you use to do so vary, but all require sutures, bandages, and other tools included in a medkit. Some conditions that might raise the DC of treating undead's wounds differ from that of living creatures. For instance, the GM might increase the DC if the undead is being treated in a Pharasmin medbay or the wounds were caused by powerful vital energy.
Stitch Flesh.name: Stitch Flesh

Stocky Frame.description: Your squat form and low center of gravity make you remarkably sturdy. You gain a +1 circumstance bonus to Athletics checks to [[/act force-open]], [[/act reposition]], and [[/act shove]] as well as to your Fortitude DCs against attempts to Reposition and Shove you. When you succeed at an Athletics check to Reposition or Shove, you get a critical success instead.
Stocky Frame.name: Stocky Frame

Stone-Faced Inscrutability.description: Your mineralized mantle and practiced stoicism ensure that others sense your emotions only when you want them to. Other creatures take a –2 circumstance penalty to Perception checks to [[/act sense-motive]] against you. In addition, if you roll a success on your saving throw against an emotion effect, you get a critical success instead.
Stone-Faced Inscrutability.name: Stone-Faced Inscrutability

Stop Them in Their Tracks.description:
Requirements You've @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.actions.Item.sLikawnrJJzHMYeC]{Aimed} at a target.

With a deadly authority, you order your target to halt in their tracks, drop their weapons, and surrender. You attempt to @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.actions.Item.2u915NdUyQan6uKF]{Demoralize} your mark. This check doesn't take the –4 circumstance penalty if the target doesn't share a language with you. On a critical success, your mark is also @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.eIcWbB5o3pP6OIMe]{Immobilized} for 1 round.
Stop Them in Their Tracks.name: Stop Them in Their Tracks

Stout Roots.description: Your wide, powerful build and experience carrying massive loads of equipment from job to job have left you surprisingly nimble while burdened. You gain a +5-foot circumstance bonus to your Speed while you have any penalty to your Speed.
Stout Roots.name: Stout Roots

Streetwise.description: You know about life on the streets and feel the pulse of your local settlement. You can use your Society modifier instead of your Diplomacy modifier to [[/act gather-information skill=society]]. In any settlement you frequent regularly, you can use the Recall Knowledge action with Society to know the same sorts of information that you could discover with Diplomacy to Gather Information. The DC is usually significantly higher, but you know the information without spending time gathering it. If you fail to recall the information, you can still subsequently attempt to Gather Information normally.
Streetwise.name: Streetwise

Strength in Numbers.description:
Frequency once per 10 minutes

Trigger You roll a saving throw.

Requirements You're adjacent to two allies.

Herd mentality is strong in humans, but it's also a survival mechanism that has stood the test of time and served them well. You roll the saving throw twice but must use the second result, even if it's worse.
Strength in Numbers.name: Strength in Numbers

Stretching Reach.description: You can leverage your size to extend your reach. When you wield a melee weapon that requires two hands and doesn't have reach, you can change between a typical two-handed grip and an extended two-handed stretch using an Interact action. Weapons wielded in your extended stretch gain a reach of 10 feet.
Stretching Reach.name: Stretching Reach

Stretching Reach (Nuar).description: You can leverage your size to extend your reach. When you wield a melee weapon that requires two hands and doesn't have reach, you can change between a typical two-handed grip and an extended two-handed stretch using an Interact action. Weapons wielded in your extended stretch gain a reach of 10 feet.
Stretching Reach (Nuar).name: Stretching Reach (Nuar)

Stretchy Strike.description: Your anatomy possesses a certain amount of flexibility that you can utilize to attack foes who would be just out of reach. Your unarmed attacks and melee weapons you wield gain a reach of 10 feet until the beginning of your next turn. Make a melee Strike against a creature within your reach.
Stretchy Strike.name: Stretchy Strike

Stride Between.description: You see and step into the liminal spaces that are hidden throughout the Universe. You Stride twice; these Strides do not trigger reactions normally triggered by movement.
Stride Between.name: Stride Between

Strike From the World's Core.description: You use the power of the world's core to move through the earth and Strike your foe. You gain the @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.actions.Item.JZGy20v74pSYR7yF]{Drill Rush} action and can use @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.feats.Item.hfICrKOU1m8UChoi]{Channel the World's Core} with a frequency of once per minute, rather than once per day.
Strike From the World's Core.name: Strike From the World's Core

Strobe Light.description:
Frequency once per 10 minutes

Trigger A creature hits you with an attack.

Requirements You're aware of the attack and not @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.AJh5ex99aV6VTggg]{Off-Guard} against it.

You strobe and pulse your brilliant light erratically, throwing off your attacker's aim at the last second with a display worthy of the hottest nightclubs and starriest skies. You become @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.DmAIPqOBomZ7H95W]{Concealed} against the triggering attack.
Strobe Light.name: Strobe Light

Strobe Master.description: You have excellent light control and can strobe so fast that it makes would-be attackers sick. If a creature fails its flat check to hit you due to concealment caused by Strobe Light, it becomes @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.fesd1n5eVhpCSS18]{Sickened 1}.
Strobe Master.name: Strobe Master

Strong Swimmer.description: Whether the canal thruways of Jhavom, the seas off the coast of Zhast, or the murky depths of the Mire, you are no stranger to water and are strong from spending so much time swimming. Increase your swim Speed to 30 feet.
Strong Swimmer.name: Strong Swimmer

Stubborn Corpse.description: You're willful and stubborn, and you refuse to accept your own failure—traits that have served you well in life and after death. When you critically fail a saving throw against a mental effect, you get a failure instead. Additionally, you gain the @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.actions.Item.SdPRiTobzR8adtXq]{Deny Failure} reaction.
Stubborn Corpse.name: Stubborn Corpse

Stubborn Endurance.description: You're exceptionally difficult to kill. The DC of your recovery checks is equal to 9 + your dying value, or 8 + your dying value if you have the Toughness general feat. In addition, whenever someone returns you to life using magic that would normally leave you debilitated for a week (such as @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.spells.Item.IkGYwHRLhkuoGReG]{Raise Dead} or the @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.spells.Item.kqhPt9344UkcGVYO]{Resurrect} ritual), you don't suffer that condition.
Stubborn Endurance.name: Stubborn Endurance

Stubborn Persistence.description: Humans are renowned for their ability to persist through the most grueling of trials that would leave others ready to drop. When you would become @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.HL2l2VRSaQHu9lUw]{Fatigued}, attempt a @Check[flat|dc:17]. On a success, you aren't fatigued. If the fatigued condition has an underlying cause that you don't address, such as lack of rest, you must attempt the check again at an interval determined by the GM until you fail the flat check or address the underlying cause.
Stubborn Persistence.name: Stubborn Persistence

Student of the Canon.description: You've researched many faiths enough to recognize notions about them that are unlikely to be true. If you roll a critical failure at a Religion check to Decipher Writing of a religious nature or to Recall Knowledge about the tenets of faiths, you get a failure instead. When attempting to Recall Knowledge about the tenets of your own faith, if you roll a failure, you get a success instead, and if you roll a success, you get a critical success instead.
Student of the Canon.name: Student of the Canon

Student of the Unseen.description: You study the subtle, intangible forces that can be found in every particle and mote of magic in the universe around you. During your daily preparations, you can meditate on these spiritual and celestial mysteries and gain the @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.feats.Item.BocFD2KV0qgUC76x]{Additional Lore} skill feat in any Lore skill subcategory of your choice. This feat (and your proficiency in the Lore skill granted by it) lasts until you make your daily preparations again. Since both the feat and proficiency are temporary, you can't use them to satisfy a prerequisite for a skill increase or permanent character option (like a feat).
Student of the Unseen.name: Student of the Unseen

Studious Engineer.description: You've spent enough time around the machines your people build to understand all manner of contraptions, often by sight alone. You're trained in Crafting (or another skill of your choice if you were already trained in Crafting). You gain a +2 circumstance bonus to Crafting checks to @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.actions.Item.1OagaWtBpVXExToo]{Recall Knowledge} about a tech item you can see.
Studious Engineer.name: Studious Engineer

Stunt Double.description:
You've trained hard to tackle physical challenges of all types as part of your entertainment career. You gain a climb Speed or a swim Speed equal to your land Speed.

Special You can select this feat more than once.
Stunt Double.name: Stunt Double

Stunt Maneuver.description: Whether you're a natural ace or a veteran pilot, you can push a vehicle to perform incredible stunts. Remove the reckless trait when you attempt a Stunt with a –1 penalty. If you're a master in Piloting, remove the reckless trait when you attempt a Stunt with a –2 penalty or lower. If you're legendary in Piloting, remove the reckless trait from any Stunt you attempt.
Stunt Maneuver.name: Stunt Maneuver

Stunt Work.description:
Frequency once per day

Trigger You're about to roll a saving throw.

You've performed countless risky stunts and flashy tricks for an audience, and your uncanny luck always seems to keep you safe. For the triggering saving throw, you can roll twice and take the better result.
Stunt Work.name: Stunt Work

Sturdy Scrap.description: You build more durable temporary shells. The shield you create with @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.feats.Item.JeGhKyXLpV99DxEP]{Scrap Shield} is tactical grade. You can create an advanced shield at 9th level, a superior shield at 13th level, and an elite shield at 17th level. In addition, you can use Scrap Shield to create a @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.equipment.Item.n7My3cvLdfygf9xp]{Riot Shield}.
Sturdy Scrap.name: Sturdy Scrap

Sturdy Vine.description: You've grown a stout vine that you can use to bludgeon enemies. You gain a vine unarmed attack, which is in the brawling weapon group, deals 1d6 bludgeoning damage, and has the khizar, sweep, trip, and unarmed traits.
Sturdy Vine.name: Sturdy Vine

Stylish Jeweler.description:
You have an eye for the ideal jewelry needed for any occasion. In 10 minutes, you can craft the perfect accessories for one creature for one social event. The accessories confer a +2 item bonus to Diplomacy checks to [[/act make-an-impression]] at that event. A creature can only have one set of accessories per day, and they go out of style after 24 hours and can no longer be used. The accessories have negligible monetary value.

@UUID[Compendium.sf2e.equipment.Item.oY475DZHPB78o0TC]{Atraxid Jewelry}
Stylish Jeweler.name: Stylish Jeweler

Subtle Coloration.description: You can alter your body's color to better vanish into your surroundings. As long as an observer is at least 20 feet away from you, you don't need cover from that observer to [[/act hide]] or [[/act sneak]]. This lasts until you move to an area with substantially different terrain.
Subtle Coloration.name: Subtle Coloration

Subtle Theft.description: When you successfully @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.actions.Item.RDXXE7wMrSPCLv5k]{Steal} something, observers (creatures other than the creature you stole from) take a –2 circumstance penalty to their Perception DCs to detect your theft. Additionally, if you first @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.actions.Item.GkmbTGfg8KcgynOA]{Create a Diversion} using Deception, taking a single @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.actions.Item.ijZ0DDFpMkWqaShd]{Palm an Object} or Steal action doesn't end your @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.VRSef5y1LmL2Hkjf]{Undetected} condition.
Subtle Theft.name: Subtle Theft

Sucker Grip.description: Your limbs' myriad suckers provide you unrivaled grip strength,. You gain a +1 circumstance bonus to Athletics checks to [[/act force-open]], and you don't take an item penalty when Forcing something Open for not having a crowbar or other suitable tool. When you roll a success on a check to Force Open, you get a critical success instead. In addition, while you're in contact with a floor or other solid surface, you gain a +1 circumstance bonus to your Fortitude and Reflex DCs against attempts to [[/act disarm]], [[/act reposition]], [[/act shove]], or [[/act trip]] you.
Sucker Grip.name: Sucker Grip

Suction Cups.description: You @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.actions.Item.34E7k2YRcsOU5uyl]{Change Shape} to sprout hundreds of suction cups across your limbs. You gain a 15-foot climb Speed as long as you're wearing light armor or no armor.
Suction Cups.name: Suction Cups

Sudden Withdrawal.description:
Trigger An enemy critically hits you with a Strike.

The importance of preserving your body, and your time, has been drilled into your head your entire life. Now that you have more experience in the field, you're able to combine that mentality with quick reflexes to protect yourself against the most dangerous threats. You Make a Tiny Target.
Sudden Withdrawal.name: Sudden Withdrawal

Summerborn Awakening.description:
Frequency once per day

You tap into a primordial connection with the seasonal change your species bases much of its physiology on. You accelerate that change around you, tapping into primal powers to cause verdant growth nearby. For the next minute, each time you Step or Stride, you create difficult terrain in each square you leave during your movement that lasts for 10 minutes.
Summerborn Awakening.name: Summerborn Awakening

Super Climber.description: You can reach even the highest levels of atraxid cities in no time. Your climb Speed increases to 30 feet.
Super Climber.name: Super Climber

Super Sensilla.description: You've practiced using your sensilla so much that they've developed into a permanent sensory organ. You have imprecise tremorsense with a range of 20 feet. When you @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.feats.Item.OjxLbgV4KSq6NIYm]{Activate Sensilla}, instead of its normal effect, you increase the range of your tremorsense to 100 feet until the start of your next turn.
Super Sensilla.name: Super Sensilla

Super Soul!.description: You've learned to open your mind to the wavelengths of those around you, beyond merely sensing their emotions. You gain limited telepathy. You can communicate mentally with creatures within 30 feet that share a language with you, and they can mentally respond. This doesn't give you any access to their thoughts and communicates no more information than normal speech would.
Super Soul!.name: Super Soul!

Super Sticky.description: Your body is very sticky. You gain a +2 circumstance bonus to your Fortitude and Reflex DCs against attempts to [[/act reposition]], [[/act shove]], or [[/act trip]] you. This bonus also applies to saving throws against spells or effects that attempt to force you to move or knock you @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.j91X7x0XSomq8d60]{Prone}. In addition, if any effect would force you to move 10 feet or more, you're moved only half the distance.
Super Sticky.name: Super Sticky

Super Swimmer.description: You are among the strongest swimmers on Czelle. Your swim Speed increases to 40 feet.
Super Swimmer.name: Super Swimmer

Superhero Landing.description: You spread the strain of your fall throughout your large build, cushioning the impact. Treat falls as 20 feet shorter. If you're an expert in Athletics, treat falls as 50 feet shorter, and 100 feet if you're a master. If you're legendary in Athletics, you always land on your feet and don't take damage, regardless of the distance of the fall. If you land @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.j91X7x0XSomq8d60]{Prone}, you also land in quadrupedal posture regardless of your posture at the beginning of the fall and drop anything you were holding in your middle arms, unless you have @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.feats.Item.DEuIMGGhC8p10OpN]{Galloping Grip} or another ability that allows you to hold objects in quadrupedal form.
Superhero Landing.name: Superhero Landing

Supernatural Soothing.description: When words fail and tempers flare, you center your emotions and then release your peaceful thoughts in a soothing, psychic calm. Once per day, you can cast either @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.spells.Item.b515AZlB0sridKSq]{Calm} or @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.spells.Item.EfFMLVbmkBWmzoLF]{Clear Mind} as an occult innate spell, heightened to half your level rounded up.
Supernatural Soothing.name: Supernatural Soothing

Supernova.description:
Frequency once per 10 minutes

Requirements You're photon-attuned.

You unleash your pent-up energy, causing it to erupt like the stellar events that birth and end stars. You can choose to affect creatures in a @Template[type:emanation|distance:30]{15-foot} or @Template[type:emanation|distance:30]. Each affected creature takes @Damage[(@actor.level)d8[fire]|options:area-damage] damage and must attempt a @Check[reflex|against:solarian|options:area-effect,damaging-effect] save against your class DC. If you choose the 30-foot option, you instead deal @Damage[(@actor.level)d6[fire]|options:area-damage] damage.

Critical Success The creature is unaffected.

Success The creature takes half damage and is @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.TkIyaNPgTZFBCCuh]{Dazzled} for 1 round.

Failure The creature takes full damage and is @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.XgEqL1kFApUbl5Z2]{Blinded} for 1 round.

Critical Failure The creature takes double damage and is blinded for 1 minute.

Level (+1) Increase the damage by 1d8 (or 1d6 for the 30-foot option).
Supernova.name: Supernova

Supersonic Speed.description: You move incredibly fast, becoming a colorful blur of erratic motion. When you Stride while @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.nlCjDvLMf2EkV2dl]{Quickened} from Zoomies, you gain concealment until the start of your next turn. As usual for concealment involving an obvious visual manifestation, you can't use this concealment to Hide.
Supersonic Speed.name: Supersonic Speed

Suppressing Fire.description: You gain the suppressing fire class feature.
Suppressing Fire.name: Suppressing Fire
