Supreme Scion.description: You're among the most powerful scions of the fonqon trees. Choose one 3rd-rank primal spell and one 4th-rank primal spell. You can cast each of these spells once per day as primal innate spells.
Supreme Scion.name: Supreme Scion

Surface Strider.description: Through diligent training, you've learned to stretch your ability to remain out of the water for extended periods. You gain the amphibious trait.
Surface Strider.name: Surface Strider

Surprising Escape.description:
Trigger You become @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.kWc1fhmv9LBiTuei]{Grabbed}, @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.eIcWbB5o3pP6OIMe]{Immobilized}, or @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.VcDeM8A5oI6VqhbM]{Restrained}.

Your extreme flexibility and deceptively compact frame make it easy for you to escape a variety of confines, and your quick reaction time means you can do so in a flash! You attempt to @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.actions.Item.SkZAQRkLLkmBQNB9]{Escape}.
Surprising Escape.name: Surprising Escape

Surprising Pop-Up.description:
Requirements You're in quadrupedal posture.

You're deft enough at using your middle limbs in both postures to immediately use them when changing. You @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.actions.Item.L2k363LraGLUZIgM]{Change Posture} from quadrupedal to bipedal posture, @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.actions.Item.oW81CfM9ebxXnrw3]{Switch Hands} from your top hands to your middle hands, and can Strike using a weapon in your middle hands or an unarmed attack.
Surprising Pop-Up.name: Surprising Pop-Up

Survey Wildlife.description: You can spend 10 minutes assessing the area around you for signs of creatures. Attempt a Survival check against a DC determined by the GM based on how obvious the signs are. On a success, you can attempt a @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.actions.Item.1OagaWtBpVXExToo]{Recall Knowledge} check with a –2 penalty to learn more about the creatures just from these signs. If you're a master in Survival, you don't take the penalty.
Survey Wildlife.name: Survey Wildlife

Survivor's Instincts.description:
Trigger You are about to roll a Reflex save against a hazard

You've learned to react to Akiton's dangers at a moment's notice, and you trust your instincts to see you through. You gain a +1 circumstance bonus to the triggering saving throw.
Survivor's Instincts.name: Survivor's Instincts

Suspend Animation.description:
Trigger You gain the dying condition.

You have spent a lifetime quietly waiting underwater, barely even breathing. When most necessary, you can slow down your body's functions to give your allies time to help you before you succumb to your injuries. As you lose consciousness, you slow down your bodily functions to stave off death a little longer. Your dying condition cannot increase for any reason until after your next turn (including a failed recovery check).
Suspend Animation.name: Suspend Animation

Swamp Walker.description: You spend enough time moving around in swamps that they don't slow you down, and you've grown accustomed to having to keep an eye out while inhabiting those swamps. You ignore difficult terrain due to water and mud. You can see twice as far in murky water as a normal creature would, and you can see as far in clear water as you would be able to in air.
Swamp Walker.name: Swamp Walker

Swampy Retch.description: You grew up in a germy swamp, giving you an excellent immune system. You retch in an attempt to recover from the sickened condition. On a success, you reduce your sickened value by 2 (or by 4 on a critical success). On a failure, you reduce your sickened value by 1.
Swampy Retch.name: Swampy Retch

Swap Upgrades.description:
Frequency once per day

Requirements You are holding a repair kit, or you are wearing it and have a hand free.

You've meticulously prepared your gear to allow for quick adjustments in the field without damaging any delicate components. You draw and Install an Upgrade into a wielded weapon or worn armor. You can uninstall and stow an upgrade as part of this activity. If you have master proficiency in Crafting, you can Install two upgrades.
Swap Upgrades.name: Swap Upgrades

Swarm Evolution.description: Whether gradual or in an instant burst of glorious evolution, you've metamorphosed into a powerful Swarm-like creature. You gain a +2 status bonus to saves against fear, and you gain acid resistance equal to half your level. You can cast @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.spells.Item.O6VQC1Bs4aSYDa6R]{Mask of Terror} as a 7th-rank primal innate spell once per day.
Swarm Evolution.name: Swarm Evolution

Swarm Tactician.description: You're adept at leveraging groups of allies to accomplish your goals. When at least two of your allies are flanking an enemy, that enemy is @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.AJh5ex99aV6VTggg]{Off-Guard} to your melee attacks.
Swarm Tactician.name: Swarm Tactician

Sway the Heart, Stoke the Spirit.description:
You orate an inspiring speech that rallies your allies, cleansing their body and mind of harmful conditions and stoking their spirit for the ongoing battle. If you say this speech, Sway the Heart, Stoke the Spirit gains the auditory trait. If you sign this speech, Sway the Heart, Stoke the Spirit gains the visual trait. You and all allies in a @Template[type:emanation|distance:60] benefit from a 4th-rank @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.spells.Item.EfFMLVbmkBWmzoLF]{Clear Mind} and a 4th-rank @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.spells.Item.Et8RSCLx8w7uOLvo]{Sound Body} spell. Additionally, your allies gain a +1 circumstance bonus to Will saves for 1 minute.

@UUID[Compendium.sf2e.feat-effects.Item.XmdJvu33YRjQbLsz]{Effect: Sway the Heart, Stoke the Spirit}
Sway the Heart, Stoke the Spirit.name: Sway the Heart, Stoke the Spirit

Swear Vengeance.description:
Frequency once per day

Trigger You would be reduced to 0 Hit Points but not immediately killed by a creature you're aware of.

You swear vengeance against the creature who almost brought you down, committing yourself to their destruction. You avoid being knocked out and remain at 1 Hit Point, and your @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.Yl48xTdMh3aeQYL2]{Wounded} condition increases by 1. You also become @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.nlCjDvLMf2EkV2dl]{Quickened} for 1 round and can use the extra action to Stride toward or make a Strike against the triggering creature.
Swear Vengeance.name: Swear Vengeance

Swerveshift.description:
Trigger A creature targets you with an attack.

Requirements You are aware of the attack and are not @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.AJh5ex99aV6VTggg]{Off-Guard} to the triggering attack.

You quickly Change Shape into a smaller size to avoid getting hit. You gain a circumstance bonus to AC, Fortitude DC, and Reflex DC against the triggering attack equal to the number of steps between your sizes when you Change Shape (+1 if you are one size smaller, +2 if you are two sizes smaller, and so on).
Swerveshift.name: Swerveshift

Swift Reposition.description:
Trigger You're about to roll a Reflex saving throw, but you haven't rolled yet.

Sensing danger, you can leap and twist your body away from the threat. You Step or @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.actions.Item.d5I6018Mci2SWokk]{Leap} and gain a +2 circumstance bonus on your Reflex save. You must still roll the Reflex save even if this ability moves you out of range of the triggering effect.
Swift Reposition.name: Swift Reposition

Swift Sneak.description: You can move your full Speed when you @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.actions.Item.VMozDqMMuK5kpoX4]{Sneak}. You can use Swift Sneak while Burrowing, Climbing, Flying, or Swimming instead of Striding if you have the corresponding movement type.
Swift Sneak.name: Swift Sneak

Swimming Specialist.description: Whether by natural appendages or some personal modification, you can swim. You gain a swim Speed equal to your ancestry's Swimming Specialist entry.
Swimming Specialist.name: Swimming Specialist

Switch Target.description:
Trigger The creature you've currently @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.actions.Item.sLikawnrJJzHMYeC]{Aimed} at gains the @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.yZRUzMqrMmfLu0V1]{Dying} or @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.fBnFDH2MTzgFijKf]{Unconscious} condition.

Requirements You're wielding a gun.

As your target falls, you immediately home in on the next. You Aim at a different creature.
Switch Target.name: Switch Target

Swoltrid.description:
Inspired by the anatomy of other species in the Pact Worlds, you've augmented yourself with humanoid arms, whether cybernetic or biotech, that would put even world-class bodybuilders to shame.

You gain a second pair of arms. At any time, one pair of hands is designated as your active hands. You can take the @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.actions.Item.oW81CfM9ebxXnrw3]{Switch Hands} action to change your active hands. Add the @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.feats.Item.EPeo604ByeeAx3AL]{All Hands on Deck} and @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.feats.Item.61txGmMLr22B93cU]{Double Draw} ancestry feats to your list of standardized ancestry feats.
Swoltrid.name: Swoltrid

Swooping Rescue.description:
Requirements You have at least one hand free.

You swoop down, use your strong cilia to grab your friend, and fly them off to safety. Fly twice. At any point during this movement, you can [[/act grapple]] one willing ally within reach. You gain a +2 circumstance bonus to your Athletics check to @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.actions.Item.PMbdMWc2QroouFGD]{Grapple} your ally if you have two free hands or they have a free hand and are aware of you. The @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.kWc1fhmv9LBiTuei]{Grabbed} condition ends once you have completed your movement.
Swooping Rescue.name: Swooping Rescue

Symbiotic Summon.description: You can instantly merge with a creature you summon. If the next action you use is to Cast a Spell that summons a minion, you merge with the minion instead of summoning them. This works like @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.spells.Item.wp09USMB3GIW1qbp]{Animal Form}, except your form's Size, Speeds, AC, senses, attacks, and Athletics modifiers are identical to the summoned creature (you don't gain temporary Hit Points). If you're reduced to 0 Hit Points while merged with your summoned minion, the effect ends, and you return to your normal self with half as many Hit Points as you originally had when you first merged with your summoned minion.
Symbiotic Summon.name: Symbiotic Summon

Sympathetic Bond.description: Dragonkin have the ability to form permanent bonds with a chosen partner. Some ryphorians, through countless years of close proximity to the draconic inhabitants of Triaxus, have learned to emulate this ability to a limited degree. You can form a temporary bond with one willing sapient creature as a 10-minute activity that can only be attempted if you and your partner share a deep bond. Once formed, this bond lasts for 1 day. When you're within 30 feet of this bonded creature, you both gain a +1 circumstance bonus to Will saves.
Sympathetic Bond.name: Sympathetic Bond

Sync Up.description:
Frequency once per day

You've learned to hone your psychic abilities to create a bespoke hive mind. You let out a psychic battle cry that links yourself and up to 10 allies within range of your limited telepathy into a temporary hive mind for 3 rounds, allowing them to communicate telepathically with everyone else in the hive mind.

You and the allies in your hive mind become @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.nlCjDvLMf2EkV2dl]{Quickened} for 3 rounds and can use the extra action only to Step, Stride, or prepare to @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.actions.Item.HCl3pzVefiv9ZKQW]{Aid}. For the duration, you and all allies in your hive mind can't be flanked. If an ally in your hive mind uses a ranged Strike against a target being flanked by two other allies in your hive mind, that target is @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.AJh5ex99aV6VTggg]{Off-Guard} to that Strike.

Allies who leave the range of your limited telepathy lose all benefits of being in your hive mind as long as they remain outside of your limited telepathy.
Sync Up.name: Sync Up

Synchronized Action.description: Your ability to ride your bonded partner into battle has further improved, and you act as one body and one mind. When you ride your bonded partner as a mount, you gain three actions at the start of your turn, rather than the two you normally would.
Synchronized Action.name: Synchronized Action

Synchronized Initiative.description:
Trigger You and your bonded partner roll the same skill for initiative, but get different results.

You and your bonded partner act in utter synchronicity with one another, reacting to danger and entering battle as one. You and your bonded partner use the higher result between your initiative rolls, but use the lower Perception or skill modifier.
Synchronized Initiative.name: Synchronized Initiative

Syncretic Epiphany.description: Plumbing the depths of your own connection, you understand how your piece of reality interconnects with another. You learn the advanced epiphany spell of the connection that grants training in the prerequisite connection skill.

featPrerequisites.0: master in a connection skill for a connection that you've learned the initial epiphany for and that isn't your chosen connection

Syncretic Epiphany.name: Syncretic Epiphany

Synergistic Assistance.description:
1 to 3

Brenneris often live and work in pairs to take advantage of different areas of expertise, inspired by the old adage that says two heads are always better than one. You stick close to your companions so you can help one another in a jam. You gain an extra reaction at the start of each of your turns that can only be used to Aid.
Synergistic Assistance.name: Synergistic Assistance

Synthesize Vapor.description:
Frequency once per hour

You create a cloud of vapor around yourself. This vapor lasts for 1 minute or until you move. You become @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.DmAIPqOBomZ7H95W]{Concealed} within the mist, and other creatures outside the mist become concealed to you.
Synthesize Vapor.name: Synthesize Vapor

Synthesized Black Hole.description:
Frequency once per day

Your core pierces into the void and creates a black hole that tears apart the souls of everyone around you. All creatures within a @Template[emanation|distance:10] take @Damage[8d6[void]|options:area-damage] damage with a basic @Check[fortitude|against:class-spell|options:area-effect] save against the higher of your class DC or spell DC. A creature that fails this save is also pulled 5 feet toward you (or pulled 10 feet toward you and knocked @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.j91X7x0XSomq8d60]{Prone} on a critical failure). For 1 minute, any creature that ends its turn within a @Template[emanation|distance:10] around you takes @Damage[5d6[void]|options:area-damage] damage (basic Fortitude save against the higher of your class DC or spell DC).

If you aren't glitching, you can choose to become @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.6A2QDy8wRGCVQsSd]{Glitching 1} when you use Synthesized Black Hole to increase the radius of the emanation from 10 feet to @Template[emanation|distance:30]{30 feet}. You can't reduce your glitching value for as long as Synthesized Black Hole is in effect, but you can Dismiss the effect.
Synthesized Black Hole.name: Synthesized Black Hole

Synthetic Physiology.description:
Your unusual synthetic physiology enables you to resist aliments even better than most constructed or biological organisms. You gain a +2 circumstance bonus to saving throws against diseases, poisons, and radiation. If you roll a success on a saving throw against a disease, poison, or radiation, you get a critical success instead.

If you roll a critical failure on the save, you get a failure instead.
Synthetic Physiology.name: Synthetic Physiology

Synthetic Speech.description: You can cast @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.spells.Item.Nf6GqoHkNbfWJDQT]{Speak with Computers} once per day as a 4th-rank arcane innate spell.

featPrerequisites.0: artificial scion android or networked android heritage

Synthetic Speech.name: Synthetic Speech

System Overload.description: You generate an overwhelming surge of electricity from within your body, engulfing yourself in a storm of sparks that causes nearby tech to malfunction. You can cast @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.spells.Item.5cMDrC3jX1yrxOzh]{Overload Systems} as a 7th-rank arcane innate spell once per hour. Raxilites and raxilite technology are immune to this spell, and you can choose up to four squares to exclude from the area of the spell.
System Overload.name: System Overload

Szandite Crystal Scholar.description: You have studied szandite crystals extensively, and you can tap into their power. You gain the Additional Lore general feat for Szandite Lore. By focusing for 1 minute, you know the direction and approximate distance to the nearest szandite crystal within 500 feet.
Szandite Crystal Scholar.name: Szandite Crystal Scholar

Tactical Advance.description:
Requirements You aren't @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.D5mg6Tc7Jzrj6ro7]{Encumbered}.

You dodge, roll, and weave out of danger, leaving no openings for attack as you move across the battlefield. Stride up to your Speed. This movement doesn't trigger reactions.
Tactical Advance.name: Tactical Advance

Tactical Bond.description: You and your bonded partner have learned to physically shield one another from harm. If you would grant lesser cover to your bonded partner (including when your partner is using you as a mount), or your bonded partner would grant lesser cover to you, standard cover is granted instead.
Tactical Bond.name: Tactical Bond

Tactical Bully.description:
Requirements Your last action was a successful @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.actions.Item.7blmbDrQFNfdT731]{Shove}.

You use your size and strength to push and position your enemies around the battlefield. You attempt to @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.actions.Item.ge56Lu1xXVFYUnLP]{Trip} the creature you successfully Shoved, even if the target is no longer in your reach. If you have a tail attack, you gain a +2 circumstance bonus to your Trip attempt.
Tactical Bully.name: Tactical Bully

Tactical Flicker.description: You've trained to use your reality issues to your advantage in a fight. When you use @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.feats.Item.YjzC7qufs8F739ac]{Flickering Existence}, you can make one Strike before or after the movement.
Tactical Flicker.name: Tactical Flicker

Tactical Swap.description:
Frequency once per round

Requirements Your last ranged Strike this turn missed or hit and failed to damage the target.

You swap weapons with a practiced motion. You Switch Hands or Interact to swap your current weapon for another. Make a Strike against the required target with your newly drawn weapon.
Tactical Swap.name: Tactical Swap

Tag Team.description:
Trigger The target of your @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.actions.Item.cmCtfURzpbzkxWsy]{Get 'Em!} is critically hit by an ally's attack or critically fails a Reflex save against an ally's attack or spell.

You seize the opening your ally has provided, quickly attacking your foe. Make a Strike against the triggering creature. If it's a ranged Strike, it must be in your weapon's first range increment. This Strike doesn't count toward your multiple attack penalty, and your multiple attack penalty doesn't apply to this Strike.
Tag Team.name: Tag Team

Tail Glide.description: You can use your fluffy tail to guide your descent when falling through the air. You glide slowly toward the ground, 5 feet down and up to 25 feet forward through the air. As long as you spend at least 1 action Tail Gliding each round and have not yet reached the ground, you remain in the air at the end of your turn.

featPrerequisites.0: Sky-Sworn Vulkarisu heritage or Cat Fall

Tail Glide.name: Tail Glide

Take 'Em Alive!.description:
You urge your allies to take down your enemies without incurring any loss of life. Until the beginning of your next turn, you and your allies can add the nonlethal trait to your attacks with weapons (without taking the normal penalty), and to your spells that deal damage and don't have the death or void trait.

Lead by Example If you used two actions, Strike a target with a nonlethal attack. On a success, you gain a status bonus to damage equal to your Charisma modifier. On a critical success, an ally within 30 feet can Strike the target as a reaction using a nonlethal attack.

@UUID[Compendium.sf2e.feat-effects.Item.fa4T1oR8S0lF5888]{Effect: Take 'Em Alive}
Take 'Em Alive!.name: Take 'Em Alive!

Take Me Seriously.description:
Trigger You fail at an attempt to [[/act demoralize]] a creature. You bare your teeth in aggression at your target.

It loses temporary immunity to your attempts to Demoralize it until the end of your next turn, and its attitude toward you decreases by one step. The creature then becomes immune to Take Me Seriously for 24 hours.
Take Me Seriously.name: Take Me Seriously

Take the Wheel.description: You Board and Take Control of an adjacent vehicle.
Take the Wheel.name: Take the Wheel

Tale Spinner.description: You keep your people's stories alive with magic. You can cast @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.spells.Item.0zU8CPejjQFnhZFI]{Figment} and @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.spells.Item.Qw3fnUlaUbnn7ipC]{Prestidigitation} as occult innate spells at will. A cantrip is heightened to a spell rank equal to half your level rounded up.
Tale Spinner.name: Tale Spinner

Talented Tracker.description: Your keen nose makes you an excellent tracker. You gain the trained proficiency rank in Survival. If you would automatically become trained in Survival (from your background of class, for example), you instead become trained in a skill of your choice. You gain a +1 circumstance bonus to Survival checks to @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.actions.Item.EA5vuSgJfiHH7plD]{Track}. This bonus increases to +2 when tracking by scent. You also gain the @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.feats.Item.urQZwmzg2kS53vd5]{Experienced Tracker} skill feat.
Talented Tracker.name: Talented Tracker

Talon Transporter.description: You've learned to carry additional supplies using your talons. You gain the Hefty Hauler skill feat. If you already have this feat, instead increase your maximum and encumbered Bulk limits by 2. While floating or flying you may use your feet as an additional pair of hands, but only to carry up to 4 Bulk of creatures or items beyond your maximum encumbrance.
Talon Transporter.name: Talon Transporter

Teachings of the Forgefather.description: You have learned magic common among questbound dwarves that focuses on Torag's lessons and the New Quest for Sky. You gain the ancestry feats @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.feats.Item.IEQmMRA1uMPb0rJo]{Ancestral Cantrip} (divine; @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.spells.Item.3VucgRc8FRPGy9NI]{Seek the Stars}) and @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.feats.Item.IEQmMRA1uMPb0rJo]{Ancestral Cantrip} (divine; @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.spells.Item.TVKNbcgTee19PXZR]{Shield}).
Teachings of the Forgefather.name: Teachings of the Forgefather

Tech Caster.description: Your ability to control and empower technological devices has improved. You gain @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.spells.Item.yXD9uU8w8uFD2OBQ]{Delete} and @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.spells.Item.SbBqa1HStMrV47fb]{Supercharge Weapon} as 1st-rank divine innate spells. You can cast each of these divine innate spells once per day.
Tech Caster.name: Tech Caster

Tech Crafting.description: You can Craft level 1 or higher tech items, though some have other requirements. When you select this feat, you gain formulas for four common tech items of 2nd level or lower.
Tech Crafting.name: Tech Crafting

Tech Familiarity.description: You have an intuitive understanding of computers, machines, and other technological devices. You become trained in Computers and Crafting. If you would automatically become trained in one of those skills (from your background or class, for example), you instead become trained in a skill of your choice.
Tech Familiarity.name: Tech Familiarity

Techentu.description:
You can permanently merge with a willing or destroyed creature with the tech trait. If the creature is mindless, it gains awareness and can choose whether to accept the symbiosis (depending on the circumstances gauged by the GM or determined by a @Check[flat|dc:10]).

If you succeed, you can no longer use @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.actions.Item.81EiW8ycG0Tmyl7x]{Tactical Symbiosis}, but you gain basic environmental protections, protection against extreme cold and extreme heat, and a +3 status bonus to saves against disease, poison, and radiation. You gain a +2 circumstance bonus to Disguise yourself as the creature you merged with, and you can communicate with your host's kin and other compatible models likely serving the same function or built by the same manufacturer, as though you'd cast @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.spells.Item.Nf6GqoHkNbfWJDQT]{Speak with Computers}.
Techentu.name: Techentu

Technology Breaker.description: You have spent so much time learning about how things work that you have also learned how to break them in the most efficient manner possible. You can cast @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.spells.Item.5cMDrC3jX1yrxOzh]{Overload Systems} as a 5th-rank arcane innate spell once per day.
Technology Breaker.name: Technology Breaker

Technomagical Scrapper.description: Given how most humans don't have ancestral home worlds of their own, many must scrape and scavenge to get by. You become trained in Crafting and your choice of Arcana, Nature, Occultism, or Religion. If you were already trained in Crafting, you become an expert instead. If you were already trained in Arcana, Nature, Occultism, and Religion, you become an expert in one of those skills instead. You can @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.actions.Item.bT3skovyLUtP22ME]{Repair} items that have both the magic and tech traits without a @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.equipment.Item.vLGDUFrg4yGzpTQX]{repair toolkit} and without taking a −2 circumstance penalty, improvising tools from whatever you have at hand.
Technomagical Scrapper.name: Technomagical Scrapper

Technosymbiote.description:
Requirements You're holding or adjacent to an unattended tech object.

You have learned how to adapt your thought patterns to that of a tech device and can merge with a tech object to understand what it knows. This allows you to learn what the computer knows as if you spent an hour scanning the computer or engaging it in a conversation using @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.spells.Item.Nf6GqoHkNbfWJDQT]{Speak with Computers}. You can [[/act hack]] the computer to access protected systems without needing a @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.equipment.Item.qqjDcCW118ySAlAS]{hacking toolkit} and can Hack using [[/act hack skill=diplomacy]]{Diplomacy} or [[/act hack skill=nature]]{Nature} instead of Computers. If the targeted object is an augmentation, you implant the augmentation.
Technosymbiote.name: Technosymbiote

Tectonic Psychic.description: Your psychic connection to the environment stretches to the ground below and manipulates lava as though it were alive. You gain @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.spells.Item.IarZrgCeaiUqOuRu]{Wall of Fire} and Uncanny Eruption as 7th-rank primal innate spells. You can cast each of these primal innate spells once per day.
Tectonic Psychic.name: Tectonic Psychic

Tectonic Tactician.description: You've learned how to fight enemies without leaving the safety of your tunnels. Your tremorsense provided by @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.feats.Item.B0X7FCPZjUTfIE9z]{Tunnel Vision} becomes a precise sense. While underground, you can target enemies you detect using tremorsense with Strikes, Area Fire, and Auto-Fire as long as the only material between you and the enemy is something you could normally move through using your burrow Speed. Unless you use adamantine ammunition, ranged attacks made through solid ground have their range increments halved, and you take a –2 circumstance penalty to your attack roll for ranged attacks that pass through the ground.
Tectonic Tactician.name: Tectonic Tactician

Telekinetic Ability.description: You have spent enough time honing your psychic skills with telepathic messages that you can now manipulate objects using only your mind. You gain @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.spells.Item.mrDi3v933gsmnw25]{Telekinetic Maneuver} as a 2nd-rank occult innate spell that you can cast once per day.
Telekinetic Ability.name: Telekinetic Ability

Telekinetic Titan.description: Straining every neuron, you briefly supercharge your telekinetic abilities. Choose Charisma, Intelligence, or Wisdom when you activate this ability. For 1 minute, you can carry Bulk equal to 7 + the chosen attribute modifier before becoming encumbered, and you can hold and carry a total Bulk of 12 + the chosen attribute modifier. Your telekinetic hands can hold and wield objects heavier than 1 Bulk, and you ignore the effects of your atrophied ability. Finally, you gain the @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.actions.Item.gNUrQ8jimAvAA0xg]{Telekinetic Lift} action. When the duration ends, you become @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.HL2l2VRSaQHu9lUw]{Fatigued} for 1 minute, and your telekinetic hands drop any objects they can no longer hold.
Telekinetic Titan.name: Telekinetic Titan

Telepathic Conduit.description:
Lashunta When you use limited telepathy to communicate with another creature, you act as a conduit for their thoughts, allowing them to respond to you for a few scant moments—if they wish. The creature can give you a brief response as a reaction, or as a free action at the beginning of their next turn as long as they remain within range of your telepathy.

Shirren When you use limited telepathy to communicate with another creature, the creature can give you a brief response as a reaction, or as a free action at the beginning of their next turn.
Telepathic Conduit.name: Telepathic Conduit

Telepathic Onslaught.description: You unleash powerful telepathic feedback to assail the minds of your foes and render them unwell. Any number of enemy creatures you can sense within range of your limited telepathy take @Damage[14d6[mental]] damage with a @Check[will|against:class-spell|basic] save against the higher of your class DC or spell DC. You can choose for any of these creatures to take nonlethal instead of lethal damage from Telepathic Onslaught. On a failure, creatures are also @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.fesd1n5eVhpCSS18]{Sickened 1} (or @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.fesd1n5eVhpCSS18]{Sickened 2} on a critical failure).
Telepathic Onslaught.name: Telepathic Onslaught

Telepredict.description:
You read the subtle cues of a target's brainwaves to anticipate the mental state of a single creature within range of your limited telepathy that you can detect with thoughtsense. You gain a +1 circumstance bonus to Deception checks and Intimidation checks targeting the creature, to saves against the target's effects that have the fear trait, and to your Will DC against the target's Intimidation skill actions, such as @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.actions.Item.2u915NdUyQan6uKF]{Demoralize}. If you deal mental damage to the target, increase this bonus to +2.

You can Telepredict the actions of only one creature at a time. Telepredict ends if you use it on a different creature or the creature leaves the range of your limited telepathy.
Telepredict.name: Telepredict

Tenacious Flame.description:
The flame from your @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.ancestry-features.Item.jjVH7W3IhgaJ5Yct]{Fire Breath} now lingers on targets. When a target fails its save against your Fire Breath, it also takes 1d6 persistent fire damage. The damage increases to 2d6 at 13th level and 3d6 at 17th level.

Special If you use @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.feats.Item.hQtGqN3eCCr6U64e]{Admixture Breath} to change the damage type of your Fire Breath, the persistent damage changes to match the new damage type.
Tenacious Flame.name: Tenacious Flame

Tenacious Grip.description: Your hands maintain a firm grip on anything they hold. You gain a +2 circumstance bonus to your Reflex DC when defending against checks to [[/act disarm]] you. A creature that succeeds at a check to Disarm you gains only a +1 circumstance bonus on further attempts to Disarm you, and you take only a –1 circumstance penalty to attacks with the held item.
Tenacious Grip.name: Tenacious Grip

Tentacle Whip.description: You grow a tentacle that can lash out like a whip. You gain a tentacle unarmed attack that deals 1d6 bludgeoning damage. Your tentacle is in the brawling weapon group and has the barathu, finesse, reach, and unarmed traits.
Tentacle Whip.name: Tentacle Whip

Tenth Life.description:
Trigger You are reduced to 0 Hit Points and would gain the @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.yZRUzMqrMmfLu0V1]{Dying} condition or would otherwise die.

You've discovered the fabled occult pahtra art of cheating death or have made substantial contingencies that help keep that legend alive. You prevent yourself from dying and regain Hit Points equal to @Damage[(6d8+floor(@actor.level/2))[healing]]{6d8 plus half your level}. If the cause of your death was a condition or effect that would still cause you to die after regaining Hit Points, such as a high value on the @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.3uh1r86TzbQvosxv]{Doomed} condition, you suppress that condition for 1 minute.
Tenth Life.name: Tenth Life

Termorsense.description: Without eyes to pierce the darkness, you've developed new, more creative ways to track your foes. You have a finely honed ability to feel other creatures moving through vibrations in the ground. You gain tremorsense as an imprecise sense with a range of 30 feet.
Termorsense.name: Termorsense

Terrain Expertise.description:
Your experience in navigating a certain type of terrain makes you supremely confident while doing so. You gain a +1 circumstance bonus to Survival checks in one of the following types of terrain, chosen when you select this feat: aquatic, arctic, desert, forest, mountain, plains, sky, space, swamp, or underground.

Special You can select this feat more than once, choosing a different type of terrain each time.
Terrain Expertise.name: Terrain Expertise

Terrain Stalker.description:
Select one type of difficult terrain from the following list: rubble, snow, or underbrush. While @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.VRSef5y1LmL2Hkjf]{Undetected} by all non-allies in that type of terrain, you can @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.actions.Item.VMozDqMMuK5kpoX4]{Sneak} without attempting a Stealth check as long as you move no more than 5 feet and do not pass within 10 feet of an enemy during your movement.

During exploration, this also allows you to automatically approach within 15 feet of other creatures while @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.actions.Item.IE2nThCmoyhQA0Jn]{Avoiding their Notice}, as long as they aren't actively @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.actions.Item.TiNDYUGlMmxzxBYU]{Searching} or on guard.

Special You can select this feat multiple times. Each time, choose a different type of terrain.
Terrain Stalker.name: Terrain Stalker

Terrified Retreat.description: When you critically succeed at the @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.actions.Item.2u915NdUyQan6uKF]{Demoralize} action, if the target's level is lower than yours, the target is @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.sDPxOjQ9kx2RZE8D]{Fleeing} for 1 round.
Terrified Retreat.name: Terrified Retreat

Terrifying Bravado.description:
Trigger You critically succeed on a save against a fear effect whose source was a creature, or a creature fails or critically fails an Intimidation check to @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.actions.Item.2u915NdUyQan6uKF]{Demoralize} you.

You laugh at your enemy's failed attempts to bully you, turning the tables on your foe with a display of terrifying bravado. You attempt an Intimidation check to Demoralize the triggering creature.
Terrifying Bravado.name: Terrifying Bravado

Terrifying Negotiator.description:
Trigger You roll Diplomacy or Intimidation for initiative.

You know negotiations fail and aren't afraid to resort to force when they do. You attempt to [[/act demoralize]] a foe you were observing and engaged in conversation with for at least 1 minute.
Terrifying Negotiator.name: Terrifying Negotiator

Terror-Forming.description:
Requirements You're wielding an area or automatic weapon.

Your weapon blasts apart the battlefield and leaves it a ruinous waste. You Area Fire or Auto-Fire. You don't designate a primary target, but instead make each square in the area of your attack difficult terrain. If a square was already difficult terrain, it becomes greater difficult terrain. Any difficult or greater difficult terrain created by this action remains in place and can't be changed without extensive engineering or magic.
Terror-Forming.name: Terror-Forming

Tetrodotoxic Beak.description: Venomous glands near your mouth can give your saliva toxic properties. Your beak unarmed strike deals an additional 1 persistent poison damage. This increases to 2 persistent poison damage if your beak deals at least three weapon damage dice. In addition, you gain the @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.actions.Item.cShf7HifoNI7XzKd]{Toxic Tear} action.
Tetrodotoxic Beak.name: Tetrodotoxic Beak

That'll Show 'Em.description: When you warn an ally of an attack, you follow up with a shot at your enemy. The first time each round you use your @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.feats.Item.60BRmtuNHT6mpJOH]{Watch Out} reaction, you can make a melee or ranged Strike against the triggering creature. This Strike doesn't count toward your multiple attack penalty, and your multiple attack penalty doesn't apply to this Strike. If you hit, your target is @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.enA7BxAjBb7ns1iF]{Suppressed} until the start of its next turn.
That'll Show 'Em.name: That'll Show 'Em

The Ancestral Wellspring Overflows.description: Through study and meditation, you've found a powerful link to the great gifts your ancestors have prepared for you. Through your connection with the ancestral wellspring, you have access to the combined wisdom of thousands of generations. From their place between the stars, they can guide your actions and tell you things about the world around you that you'd never learn on your own. You are permanently @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.nlCjDvLMf2EkV2dl]{Quickened} and can use that extra action only to @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.actions.Item.1OagaWtBpVXExToo]{Recall Knowledge}.
The Ancestral Wellspring Overflows.name: The Ancestral Wellspring Overflows

The Bigger They Are.description: You've learned to make good use of your diminutive stature and angle your attacks when fighting larger enemies. If you critically hit a Large or larger enemy with a ranged Strike while using a weapon that fires projectile ammo, you knock them @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.j91X7x0XSomq8d60]{Prone}. A creature knocked prone by your unusually angled shots learns how to brace for impact, becoming immune to The Bigger They Are for 24 hours.
The Bigger They Are.name: The Bigger They Are

The Gift of Glow.description:
Frequency once per day

Using readily available materials, you create pieces of art to inspire those who have inspired you. Choose an ally. You spend 1 hour to @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.actions.Item.rmwa3OyhTZ2i2AHl]{Craft} a gift of negligible Bulk or larger with the consumable and primal traits, decorated with the talphis' signature glowing paint. As long as the chosen ally wears this gift, they can draw inspiration from it as an Interact action to gain a +1 status bonus to their next attack roll, Perception check, saving throw, or skill check until the start of their next turn and gain temporary Hit Points equal to your Charisma modifier + character level that last for 1 minute. The glow from your gift fades after 24 hours as it crumbles to dust.

Special If you're legendary in Crafting, you can make up to five tokens per day, but each must be made for a different ally.
The Gift of Glow.name: The Gift of Glow

The Harder They Fall.description:
Trigger A Large or larger creature within your melee reach is hit by a melee attack from one of your allies.

You have become accustomed to dealing with creatures much larger than you, and you know very well how to use their size against them. The triggering creature must attempt a @Check[reflex|against:class-spell|options:damaging-effect,inflicts:prone] save against the higher of your class or spell DC. On a failure, the creature falls @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.j91X7x0XSomq8d60]{Prone} and takes @Damage[(max(floor(@actor.level/2),1))[bludgeoning]] damage equal to half your level.
The Harder They Fall.name: The Harder They Fall

The Hunter, Not the Hunted.description: Marata's fiercest predators are also some of its most cunning hunters, leaving little sign when attempting to remain unseen. You gain a +1 circumstance bonus to [[/act hide]] and [[/act sneak]] in natural terrain and a +1 circumstance bonus to Survival checks to @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.actions.Item.SB7cMECVtE06kByk]{Cover Tracks} and [[/act track]] in natural terrain. You're always considered to be Covering Tracks, even if you chose a different activity in exploration mode.
The Hunter, Not the Hunted.name: The Hunter, Not the Hunted

The Science of Motion.description: Your extensive scientific knowledge of astronomy, astrophysics, and stellar phenomenon have given you insight into the underpinnings of the universe—particularly motion. You can use this knowledge to more easily move your foes across the battlefield. You gain a +1 circumstance bonus to Athletics checks to @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.actions.Item.lOE4yjUnETTdaf2T]{Reposition}, @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.actions.Item.7blmbDrQFNfdT731]{Shove} or @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.actions.Item.ge56Lu1xXVFYUnLP]{Trip}. If you critically fail an Athletics check to Reposition, Shove or Trip, you get a failure instead.

featPrerequisites.1: one space-related Lore (such as Astronomy Lore, Physical Science Lore, or Sun Lore)

The Science of Motion.name: The Science of Motion

The Universal Language.description: You're well versed in using the subtle art of body language to convey the basics of your intentions, even when you don't share a language with whom you're attempting to communicate. You can use Diplomacy to [[/act make-an-impression]] without a shared language with your target. When you do, Make an Impression loses the auditory and linguistic traits, and you can attempt the Diplomacy check with a –2 circumstance penalty. When you do share at least one language with your target, you instead gain a +1 circumstance bonus to Make an Impression.
The Universal Language.name: The Universal Language

Theory of Everything.description: Your fervently religious approach to acquiring information gives you insights and understanding into a broad array of subjects. You gain the @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.feats.Item.BocFD2KV0qgUC76x]{Additional Lore} skill feat. During your daily preparations, you can recontextualize your insights and change the chosen Lore skill for any of your Additional Lore skill feats, unless they're being used as a prerequisite for a permanent character option that your new Lore skill won't satisfy.

featPrerequisites.0: legendary in one or more Lore skills, follower of Yaraesa

Theory of Everything.name: Theory of Everything

Thermal Conversion.description:
Frequency once per hour

Requirements You are in an area of severe, extreme, or incredible heat, or you were dealt fire damage within the last round.

Your body has adapted to convert ambient thermal energy into kinetic energy to boost your speed. You Stride up to double your Speed. In addition, you become @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.nlCjDvLMf2EkV2dl]{Quickened} until the end of your next turn. You can only use the extra action from quickened to Stride.
Thermal Conversion.name: Thermal Conversion

Thick Skin.description: Forged by the blowing sands of Dorjo and the teeth of thousands of microscopic predators, your skin has become calloused and strong. You gain piercing resistance equal to half your level (minimum 1).
Thick Skin.name: Thick Skin

Thick Skins.description:
Each of your forms has unusually thick skin. Your DC on flat checks to end persistent bleed damage is reduced from 15 to 10, or from 10 to 5 after receiving especially appropriate assistance.

Special You can use the @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.feats.Item.7yIxWfNZ7yEKs0Fd]{Restorative Shapeshifting} feat to attempt an additional flat check to end persistent bleed damage, but this is not considered especially appropriate assistance.
Thick Skins.name: Thick Skins

Thief's Tale.description: You've trained your tail to move with incredible precision, practicing a specific set of underhanded skills until they become second nature. When you attempt to [[/act disable-device]] or [[/act pick-a-lock]], if you're holding no items other than tools to help you Disable a Device or Pick a Lock, you can spend an additional action to use your tail to help with the attempt. You gain a +2 circumstance bonus to your check to Disable a Device or Pick a Lock. On a success or critical success, you achieve an additional success if the device or lock requires more than one success.
Thief's Tale.name: Thief's Tale

This You, Queen?.description:
The hottest socials on the infosphere might change with time, but the way those spaces fill up with drama and gossip is a truth that lasts forever. Luckily, you've been saving every embarrassing holo and compromising remark you've found on the infosphere to your personal archives for centuries.

You can roll a Computers check instead of an Intimidation check when you use the [[/act coerce skill=computers]] action, threatening to share copies of an embarrassing infosphere moment from the target's past. On a success, in addition to the normal effects of Coerce, the target is temporarily immune to any additional Coerce attempts from you for 24 hours. On a failure, they're instead immune for 1 week, and on a critical failure, they're immune for 1 month.
This You, Queen?.name: This You, Queen?

Thorny.description:
Frequency once every 10 minutes

Your body is covered in thorns, spines, or other sharp protrusions, which you can position defensively. For 1 minute, adjacent creatures that hit you with a melee attack, as well as creatures that hit you with melee unarmed attacks, take @Damage[@actor.level[piercing]] damage equal to your level.
Thorny.name: Thorny

Thoroughly Slimed.description: Your sprayed slime thickens on contact with air, giving it some substantial stopping power and possibly even locking foes in place. When you use @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.ancestry-features.Item.F7aBUHwgBVRdyZJe]{Slime Squirt} or @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.feats.Item.64rwZGS8fKt8P5Ae]{Slime Spray}, creatures in the area must attempt a @Check[reflex|against:class-spell] save against the higher of your class DC or spell DC. On a failure, they become @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.i3OJZU2nk64Df3xm]{Clumsy 1} for 1 round. On a critical failure, they become @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.i3OJZU2nk64Df3xm]{Clumsy 2} and @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.eIcWbB5o3pP6OIMe]{Immobilized} for 1 round.
Thoroughly Slimed.name: Thoroughly Slimed

Thought-Piercing Horns.description: Pain is in the mind as well as in the body, which your horns make abundantly clear on contact. Your unarmed horns attack deals an additional 1d6 mental damage. On a critical hit, the target also becomes @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.e1XGnhKNSQIm5IXg]{Stupefied 2} until the beginning of your next turn.
Thought-Piercing Horns.name: Thought-Piercing Horns

Thoughtful Insight.description: You know that it's more important to act wisely than it is to act quickly. When you take the time to consider a problem from all angles, you come up with an insightful revelation. You gain @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.spells.Item.pkcOby5prOausy1k]{Read Omens} as a 4th-rank occult innate spell. You can cast this spell once per day.
Thoughtful Insight.name: Thoughtful Insight

Thunderous Slam.description:
Requirements You're in bipedal posture.

You squat down from bipedal posture to quadrupedal posture with enough force to send tremors through the ground around you. You @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.actions.Item.L2k363LraGLUZIgM]{Change Posture} from bipedal posture to quadrupedal posture. Each creature within 10 feet of you must attempt a @Check[reflex|against:class-spell] saving throw against the higher of your class DC or spell DC.

Critical Success The creature is unaffected.

Success The creature is @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.AJh5ex99aV6VTggg]{Off-Guard} until the end of your turn.

Failure The creature falls @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.j91X7x0XSomq8d60]{Prone}.

Critical Failure The creature falls prone and takes @Damage[1d6[bludgeoning]] damage.
Thunderous Slam.name: Thunderous Slam

Timber!.description:
Trigger You become @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.fBnFDH2MTzgFijKf]{Unconscious}, dying, or dead while standing.

You fall like a mighty tree, dealing @Damage[7d6[bludgeoning]|options:area-damage] damage to each creature in a @Template[type:line|distance:10] originating from your square with a @Check[reflex|against:class|basic] save against your class DC; on a critical failure, a medium or smaller creature falls @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.j91X7x0XSomq8d60]{Prone} and is @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.eIcWbB5o3pP6OIMe]{Immobilized} until your body is removed.
Timber!.name: Timber!

Timely Team Up.description:
Frequency once per 10 minutes

Trigger An ally within your sight is damaged by an enemy.

Against all odds, you've made friends you value dearly. When they're in trouble, you rush to their aid, regardless of the danger it could put you in. Stride up to three times, ending your movement in a space adjacent to the triggering ally. You're @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.AJh5ex99aV6VTggg]{Off-Guard} until the beginning of your next turn.
Timely Team Up.name: Timely Team Up

Tinkering Fingers.description: You grew up learning to tinker with devices, repair objects, and take things apart. You're trained in Crafting. If you're trained in Crafting from another source (from your background or class, for example), you instead become trained in a skill of your choice. You can @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.actions.Item.bT3skovyLUtP22ME]{Repair} an item without using a @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.equipment.Item.vLGDUFrg4yGzpTQX]{repair toolkit} without taking the –2 circumstance penalty, improvising tools from whatever you have at hand. You gain a +1 circumstance bonus to Crafting checks to Repair an item when you have a repair toolkit.
Tinkering Fingers.name: Tinkering Fingers

Titan Wrestler.description: You can attempt to @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.actions.Item.Dt6B1slsBy8ipJu9]{Disarm}, @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.actions.Item.PMbdMWc2QroouFGD]{Grapple}, @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.actions.Item.lOE4yjUnETTdaf2T]{Reposition}, @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.actions.Item.7blmbDrQFNfdT731]{Shove}, or @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.actions.Item.ge56Lu1xXVFYUnLP]{Trip} creatures up to two sizes larger than you, or up to three sizes larger than you if you're legendary in Athletics.
Titan Wrestler.name: Titan Wrestler

Too Stubborn to Die.description:
Frequency once per day

Trigger You would die.

You return from the brink of death, hauling yourself back to consciousness through exhaustion and pain. If you have the dying or @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.fBnFDH2MTzgFijKf]{Unconscious} conditions, you lose the dying and unconscious conditions. If you're at 0 Hit Points, you have 1 Hit Point. Increase the value of your wounded and doomed conditions by 1. You can use this reaction while unconscious.
Too Stubborn to Die.name: Too Stubborn to Die

Toppling Shot.description:
Requirements You're wielding a gun.

You aim your shots to unbalance your foe, pushing them back or knocking them over. You @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.actions.Item.sLikawnrJJzHMYeC]{Aim} and then make a ranged Strike against your mark. If the Strike hits, the target is knocked back 5 feet. If this forced movement would cause them to collide with a creature or object, both the target and the creature (if any) take bludgeoning damage equal to your Aim damage. On a critical hit, the target is also knocked @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.j91X7x0XSomq8d60]{Prone}.
Toppling Shot.name: Toppling Shot

Torag's Protection.description:
Trigger You're struck by a critical hit that deals damage.

Frequency once per day

Though Torag fails to answer the prayers of his followers, you know that in your most trying moments, his gaze sometimes falls upon you. Attempt a @Check[flat|dc:15]. If you're successful, the attack becomes a normal hit.
Torag's Protection.name: Torag's Protection

Total Know-It-All.description: The depth of your knowledge is matched only by your ability to recall it at a moment's notice. You gain the @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.feats.Item.H3I2X0f7v4EzwxuN]{Automatic Knowledge} general feat and can apply it to any skill you're expert in as long as you have @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.feats.Item.W6Gl9ePmItfDHji0]{Assurance} in that skill. You can also cast @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.spells.Item.ZYoC630tNGutgbE0]{Hypercognition} as a 3rd-rank occult innate spell once per day.
Total Know-It-All.name: Total Know-It-All

Touch The Sky.description: There's nothing you love more than soaring through the air. When you fly, you don't count moving upward (straight up or diagonally) as moving through difficult terrain. This does not apply to flying with equipment or vehicles, such as jet packs and hover boards.
Touch The Sky.name: Touch The Sky

Toughness.description: Your body can withstand more punishment than most before succumbing. Increase your maximum Hit Points by your level. You reduce the DC of recovery checks by 1.
Toughness.name: Toughness

Toxic Breath.description:
Your stomach contents can become especially toxic to outsiders. When you use @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.ancestry-features.Item.jjVH7W3IhgaJ5Yct]{Fire Breath}, you can choose to deal poison damage instead of fire damage. If a creature fails its Reflex save against your Fire Breath when it deals poison damage, it becomes @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.fesd1n5eVhpCSS18]{Sickened 1} (@UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.fesd1n5eVhpCSS18]{Sickened 2} on a critical failure).

Special If you have @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.feats.Item.t2VyYuvHMM4ynUei]{Purge Stomach}, you can still use your Fire Breath while under the effects of Purge Stomach as long as you choose to deal poison damage.
Toxic Breath.name: Toxic Breath

Toxic Runoff.description:
You secrete enough poisonous chemicals to afflict other creatures. As part of your daily preparations, you create two doses of gnarefuroid toxin. These poisons can't be properly used by any other creature, have no value, and become inert when you next make your daily preparations. The poison's save DC uses the higher of your class or spell DC.

Gnarefuroid Toxin (injury, poison)

Saving Throw @Check[type:fortitude|against:class-spell]

Maximum Duration 6 rounds

Stage 1 @Damage[1d6[poison]] damage and @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.MIRkyAjyBeXivMa7]{Enfeebled 1} (1 round)

Stage 2 1d6 poison damage, enfeebled 1, and @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.i3OJZU2nk64Df3xm]{Clumsy 1} (1 round)

Stage 3 @Damage[2d6[poison]] damage, enfeebled 1, and clumsy 1 (1 round)
Toxic Runoff.name: Toxic Runoff

Toxic Transference.description: You use your body's built-up toxins to enhance your natural attacks, making them poisonous. Whenever you deal damage with an unarmed Strike you gained from @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.feats.Item.iac0qVH4SDzCXOyc]{Compact Predator}, you deal an additional 1 poison damage per weapon damage die of the attack. Whenever you @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.actions.Item.6fsMvO0jXtK8gYkH]{Puff Up} or @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.feats.Item.32W1Pnex4xbhx5Bj]{Squirt Blood}, you additionally deal poison damage equal to half your level.

featPrerequisites.0: Compact Predator, Puff Up, or Squirt Blood

Toxic Transference.name: Toxic Transference

Train Animal.description:
You spend time teaching an animal to do a certain action. You can either select a basic action the animal already knows how to do (typically those listed in the @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.actions.Item.q9nbyIF0PEBqMtYe]{Command an Animal} action) or attempt to teach the animal a new basic action. The GM determines the DC of any check required and the amount of time the training takes (usually at least a week). It's usually impossible to teach an animal a trick that uses critical thinking. If you're expert, master, or legendary in Nature, you might be able to train more unusual creatures, at the GM's discretion.

Success The animal learns the action. If it was an action the animal already knew, you can Command the Animal to take that action without attempting a Nature check. If it was a new basic action, add that action to the actions the animal can take when Commanded, but you must still roll.

Failure The animal doesn't learn the trick.
Train Animal.name: Train Animal

Trampling Stride.description:
Requirements You're in quadrupedal posture.

You trot forth, crushing your enemies under your feet! You Stride up to double your Speed and can move through the spaces of creatures at least one size smaller than you, trampling each creature whose space you enter. You can attempt to trample the same creature only once in a single Trampling Stride. You deal bludgeoning damage equal to your fist unarmed attack against these creatures with a basic Reflex save against the higher of your class DC or spell DC.
Trampling Stride.name: Trampling Stride

Transcended Existence.description: Your understanding of your connection transcends the limits of other mortals, granting you access to the most powerful spells. You gain an additional 10th-rank spell slot.
Transcended Existence.name: Transcended Existence

Transforming Huddle.description: You can adjust your body's size and shape to take advantage of obstacles on the battlefield. Change Shape into a Small-sized form and @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.actions.Item.ust1jJSCZQUhBZIz]{Take Cover}; you can Take Cover to gain standard cover if you would have lesser cover from a creature after you Change Shape; if you would have standard cover from a creature, you gain greater cover instead.
Transforming Huddle.name: Transforming Huddle

Transgnomanist.description: You have an obsession with augmentations and take pride in discovering new things for your enhanced body to do. You gain the @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.feats.Item.sEb6KmjQVdWNTqiu]{Augmented Body} general feat. Once per day, when you attempt a skill check as part of using the augmentation you gained from this feat, you can gain a +1 item bonus to the check.
Transgnomanist.name: Transgnomanist

Trash Tunneler.description: You comfortably slither through mounds of loose debris. You gain a burrow Speed of 15 feet.
Trash Tunneler.name: Trash Tunneler

Travel-Tongue.description: Somewhere along your travels, picking up new languages became as easy as breathing—some of your colleagues even suspect you might be blessed by the god Weydan! You can speak, read, and understand any language.
Travel-Tongue.name: Travel-Tongue

Treasure on My Heart.description:
Frequency once per day

Trigger You would take damage from a Strike.

Requirements You have at least one item of L Bulk.

As your life flashes before your eyes, you realize one of the trinkets you've been hoarding can soften the incoming blow. You gain resistance to the triggering damage equal to your level, and one item of L Bulk of your choice on your person is destroyed.
Treasure on My Heart.name: Treasure on My Heart

Trek the Frigid Wastes.description: You've spent many long years traversing Lajok's surface, moving from city to city or hunting for food and resources. You're accustomed to moving across slippery ice sheets and plowing through deep snow. When moving over ice or snow in arctic terrain, you always gain the benefits of the @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.actions.Item.SB7cMECVtE06kByk]{Cover Tracks} action without needing to use the activity or having to move half your Speed. You don't treat icy terrain as uneven ground (though it's still difficult terrain for you), and you ignore difficult terrain caused by snow.
Trek the Frigid Wastes.name: Trek the Frigid Wastes

Tremor-Tuned.description: You can hear a pin drop on a windy day and can even triangulate a vague estimation of where that pin came from. Your tremorsense becomes a precise sense with a range of 30 feet.
Tremor-Tuned.name: Tremor-Tuned

Tremorsense.description: Even with eyes that can see through the thickest darkness, you know some threats remain invisible. You've learned to listen to the ground beneath your feet, feeling the subtle shifts in vibrations as they run up your legs and interpreting them with lightning speed. You gain tremorsense as an imprecise sense with a range of 30 feet.
Tremorsense.name: Tremorsense

Trick Magic Item.description:
You examine a magic item you normally couldn't use in an effort to fool it and activate it temporarily. For example, this might allow a soldier to cast a spell from a spell gem or spellchip or allow a mystic to cast a spell that's not on their connection's tradition list using a spell gem. You must know what activating the item does, or you can't attempt to trick it.

Attempt a check using the skill matching the item's magic tradition, or matching a tradition that has the spell on its list, if you're trying to cast a spell from the item. The relevant skills are Arcana for arcane, Nature for primal, Occultism for occult, Religion for divine, or any of the four for an item that has the magical trait and not a tradition trait. The GM determines the DC based on the item's level (possibly adjusted depending on the item or situation).

If you activate a magic item that requires a spell attack modifier or spell DC and you don't have proficiency in the relevant statistic, use your level as your proficiency bonus and the highest of your Intelligence, Wisdom, or Charisma modifiers. If you're a master in the appropriate skill for the item's tradition, you instead use the trained proficiency bonus; if you're legendary, you instead use the expert proficiency bonus.

Success For the rest of the current turn, you can spend actions to activate the item as if you could normally use it.

Failure You can't use the item or try to trick it again this turn, but you can try again on subsequent turns.

Critical Failure You can't use the item, and you can't try to trick it again until your next daily preparations.

featPrerequisites.0: trained in Arcana, Nature, Occultism, or Religion

Trick Magic Item.name: Trick Magic Item

Trifaction Negotiator.description: You honed your negotiation skills from balancing the triad of elves, formians, and lashuntas on Castrovel. When you attempt to [[/act make-an-impression]], you can choose two non-ally targets. You gain a +2 circumstance bonus to your check against one target, and a –2 circumstance penalty against the other target. If you succeed against both targets, you critically succeed against both instead.
Trifaction Negotiator.name: Trifaction Negotiator

Tripartite Mind.description:
Trigger You would gain the @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.yblD8fOR1J8rDwEQ]{Confused}, @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.9qGBRpbX9NEwtAAr]{Controlled}, @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.sDPxOjQ9kx2RZE8D]{Fleeing}, @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{Frightened}, or @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.e1XGnhKNSQIm5IXg]{Stupefied} condition.

You create duplicates of your consciousness capable of fending off mental intrusion. Attempt to counteract an effect of your choice imposing one of the triggering conditions, using half your level rounded up as your counteract rank and your spell attack modifier as the counteract modifier.
Tripartite Mind.name: Tripartite Mind

Triple Jump.description: You can jump from enemy to enemy and never have to touch the ground. Instead of being able to [[/act shove]] or [[/act trip]] a creature once per turn, you can Shove, Strike, or Trip a creature you use as a wall for @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.feats.Item.X8iSUF1m0eezmrjs]{Wall Jump} up to three times per turn, but only once per creature per round.
Triple Jump.name: Triple Jump

Triune's Chosen.description: Triune chose you specifically to become a prismeni. You hold the All-Code close in your heart and cherish the data it's imparted upon you. You become trained in Religion and Triune Lore. You have familiarity with the pulse gauntlet, and for the purpose of determining your proficiency, the pulse gauntlet is a simple weapon. Whenever you gain a class feature that grants you expert or greater proficiency in simple weapons, you also gain that proficiency in the pulse gauntlet.
Triune's Chosen.name: Triune's Chosen

True Leader.description: You've worked with a team for so long that you've learned to convey orders with a glance, a single word, or the tiniest flick of your hand (or suitable appendage, depending on ancestry). Once per turn, you can issue a 1-action envoy directive as a free action. This directive doesn't count toward your total number of directives issued this turn.
True Leader.name: True Leader

True Vulkari.description: Your mastery of Vulkari transcends mere linguistics. You're affected by a constant @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.spells.Item.SwUiVavHKMWG7t5K]{Truespeech} spell.
True Vulkari.name: True Vulkari

Tunnel Scout.description: The body of a talphi is small to begin with, and most of what's there is empty space. You learn to manipulate your joints a bit, finding a little extra flexibility here and there, and you can push your way through almost any space without difficulty. You gain the @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.feats.Item.3G8xUlgCjRmRJNfP]{Quick Squeeze} feat. Tight spaces not tight enough to require the Squeeze action aren't difficult terrain for you.
Tunnel Scout.name: Tunnel Scout

Tunnel Vision.description: You have spent enough time in tunnels to have grown in tune with the vibrations of the earth, and you can sense when something disturbs its natural rhythm. You gain tremorsense as an imprecise sense with a range of 30 feet.
Tunnel Vision.name: Tunnel Vision

Twin Draw.description:
Requirements You have two free hands.

You've practiced smoothly drawing and taking aim with two weapons. Draw up to two one-handed weapons and @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.actions.Item.sLikawnrJJzHMYeC]{Aim}.
Twin Draw.name: Twin Draw

Twin Guard.description:
Trigger A creature within your reach critically hits you with a melee Strike, and you're wielding two solar weapons.

You raise one of your weapons to intercept a particularly deadly attack. You gain resistance equal to your level against the triggering attack. One of your solar weapons shatters and is no longer manifested.
Twin Guard.name: Twin Guard

Twin Shooter.description: You're especially dangerous while brandishing twin guns. As long as you're wielding two simple guns, both guns gain the agile trait.
Twin Shooter.name: Twin Shooter

Twin Weapons.description:
You have a second solar weapon. When you take this feat or Re-Forge Solar Weapon, choose its traits separately from your first weapon. You can select a different damage type, traits, and weapon group for this second solar weapon. Add the agile and twin traits to the list of weapon traits you can apply to your solar weapons.

@UUID[Compendium.sf2e.feat-effects.Item.gABm4VTVRcfbv5sG]{Effect: Solar Weapon (Twin Weapons)}
Twin Weapons.name: Twin Weapons

Twisted Dark Zone.description: You expose this reality to a realm of pure darkness filled with gibbering voices and otherworldly entities. The area of your quantum field functions as though it were an area of 2nd-rank @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.spells.Item.4GE2ZdODgIQtg51c]{Darkness}. Creatures that begin their turn in the area must succeed at a @Check[will|against:class] save against your class DC or become @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.yblD8fOR1J8rDwEQ]{Confused} for 1 round (this is an incapacitation effect). The creature then becomes immune for 24 hours. If this darkness is successfully counteracted, the quantum field's other effects remain.
Twisted Dark Zone.name: Twisted Dark Zone

Twitching Muscles.description: When you died, your muscles and sinew knotted themselves together more tightly than when you were alive, allowing for more tightly controlled and rapid movements. You gain a +5-foot status bonus to your land Speed.
Twitching Muscles.name: Twitching Muscles

Two Lives.description:
Frequency once per day

Trigger You would die.

One of your heads might be dead, but your other head can drag you back into the realm of the living through sheer force of will. You don't die. Instead, if you have the dying or @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.fBnFDH2MTzgFijKf]{Unconscious} conditions, you lose the dying and unconscious conditions. If you're at 0 Hit Points, you have 1 Hit Point. Increase the value of your wounded condition by 1. You are @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.e1XGnhKNSQIm5IXg]{Stupefied 1} and can't use any abilities that depend on two heads until you're healed to greater than half your maximum HP. You can use this reaction while unconscious, but not if your body would be destroyed, such as by the @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.spells.Item.r7ihOgKv19eJQnik]{Disintegrate} spell.
Two Lives.name: Two Lives

Two Minds, One Soul.description:
Trigger You, your bonded partner, or both you and your bonded partner would roll a Will saving throw against a spell or effect that could impose the @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.yblD8fOR1J8rDwEQ]{Confused} or controlled condition.

Requirements You and your bonded partner are within 60 feet of one another, and are willing.

You and your bonded partner are two halves of the same spirit, entwined together in different bodies. Both you and your bonded partner roll the triggering Will saving throw. The triggering creature (or creatures) uses the higher result. Both you and your bonded partner are affected by the triggering spell or effect, even if it would normally only affect one of you.
Two Minds, One Soul.name: Two Minds, One Soul

Ultimate Spacefarer.description: You're capable of surviving in the void of space indefinitely. While you maintain suspended respiration, you are immune to inhaled threats. Additionally, as long as you use suspended respiration, you don't need to eat or drink. Once per day as a free action, you can suspend respiration in atmosphere with these benefits for 1 minute.
Ultimate Spacefarer.name: Ultimate Spacefarer

Um, Actually.description:
Frequency once per day

Trigger An ally that you can hear and can hear you fails a skill check.

You chime in at the last minute with a bit of helpful and, more importantly, accurate information. You use the @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.actions.Item.HCl3pzVefiv9ZKQW]{Aid} action. If you succeed, you can retroactively add the circumstance bonus to the check. This might change the outcome of the check.
Um, Actually.name: Um, Actually

Unauthorized Helldriver.description:
Helldrives are unique tools of the hellforged, but your unique hardware means you can replicate the effects of a tool most adventurers rarely ever see: a Helldrive. You can spend a single Interact action to connect yourself to a starship. While you're connected, you gain +1 circumstance bonus to Piloting checks and can grant this circumstance bonus to the pilot of the vessel as well by spending a single action with the concentrate trait. Once per day, you can give a starship you're connected to the ability to travel long distances in space as if it had a Drift Engine.

@UUID[Compendium.sf2e.feat-effects.Item.IgDTjR6XT2nlZU26]{Effect: Unauthorized Helldriver}
Unauthorized Helldriver.name: Unauthorized Helldriver

Unbound Self-Perfection.description:
You defined self-perfection and will let no other voices influence you. Your control over your mind is resolute, allowing you to shake off the worst effects your foes impart.

Whenever you attempt a saving throw against an ability that would impart the @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.yblD8fOR1J8rDwEQ]{Confused} or @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.9qGBRpbX9NEwtAAr]{Controlled} condition you roll twice and take the better result; this is a fortune effect.

If you have the confused or controlled condition, you can attempt a Will save to end the effect at the start of each of your turns.
Unbound Self-Perfection.name: Unbound Self-Perfection

Uncanny Awareness.description: You are in tune with your surroundings and can instinctively sense when danger is near. You gain a +2 circumstance bonus to Perception checks for initiative rolls. If your initiative roll result is tied with that of an opponent, you go first, regardless of whether you rolled Perception or not. The first time each day that you roll Perception for initiative, you roll initiative twice and use the higher result.
Uncanny Awareness.name: Uncanny Awareness

Uncanny Comprehension.description: You take in your surroundings, instantly opening your mind up to the answers hidden all around you and the clues their presence has left behind. You instantly use up to three Recall Knowledge actions. If you have any special abilities or free actions that would normally be triggered when you Recall Knowledge, you can't use them for these actions. The first time one of these attempts to Recall Knowledge uses a Lore skill you selected with Additional Lore, you roll the associated Recall Knowledge check twice and use the higher result. That Recall Knowledge check gains the fortune trait.
Uncanny Comprehension.name: Uncanny Comprehension

Uncanny Knowledge.description:
Frequency once per round

Your keen senses and clever intellect help you maintain a constant and instinctive conversation with the narrative of existence, giving you uncanny knowledge of your surroundings and circumstances. You attempt a check to @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.actions.Item.1OagaWtBpVXExToo]{Recall Knowledge}. If you roll a success, you get a critical success instead.
Uncanny Knowledge.name: Uncanny Knowledge

Uncanny Wonder.description:
Frequency once per 10 minutes

Trigger An enemy critically fails a melee Strike against you.

The uncanny movements you make to avoid the incoming Strike confuse and distract your assailant. The triggering creature is @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.AJh5ex99aV6VTggg]{Off-Guard} to the next Strike made against it by any ally before the start of your next turn.

Special The frequency of Uncanny Wonder is once per minute as long as your soulfeel is attuned to wonder.
Uncanny Wonder.name: Uncanny Wonder

Uncontrollable.description: You refuse to let anyone control you. Whenever you attempt a Will save against a spell or effect that would give you the @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.yblD8fOR1J8rDwEQ]{Confused} or @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.9qGBRpbX9NEwtAAr]{Controlled} condition, roll twice and use the higher result. If you would start your turn confused or controlled, you can immediately attempt a @Check[flat|dc:5]. On a success, you fight that mental control, becoming @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.6uEgoh53GbXuHpTF]{Paralyzed} until the end of your turn rather than acting against your will. If you roll a 20 on this check, you immediately end the confused or controlled condition.
Uncontrollable.name: Uncontrollable

Unconventional Expertise.description: You've continued to advance your powers using your unconventional weapon. Whenever you gain a class feature that grants you expert or greater proficiency in certain weapons, you also gain that proficiency in the weapon you chose for Unconventional Weaponry.
Unconventional Expertise.name: Unconventional Expertise

Unconventional Weaponry.description:
You've familiarized yourself with a particular weapon, potentially from another ancestry or culture. Choose an uncommon simple or martial weapon with a trait corresponding to an ancestry (such as vesk) or that is common in another culture (including a deity's favored weapon). You gain access to and familiarity with that weapon. For the purposes of proficiency, you treat a martial weapon as a simple weapon.

If you are trained in martial weapons or guns, you can choose an advanced weapon. You gain access to that weapon, and for the purpose of determining your proficiency, that weapon is a martial weapon.
Unconventional Weaponry.name: Unconventional Weaponry

Undead Empathy.description: For you, other undead creatures are easy to read, and you have a knack for dealing with them that others lack. You can influence mindless undead and communicate rudimentary orders to your minions. You can use Diplomacy to [[/act make-an-impression]] on mindless undead or make simple requests of them. If the undead creature currently is already in the thrall of a creature whose level is higher than yours, you typically need to roll a critical success (at GM discretion).
Undead Empathy.name: Undead Empathy

Undead Scholar.description: Your people's long history of clashing with Eox has made you wary. You become trained in Religion. If you were already trained in Religion, you become trained in another skill of your choice. You gain a +1 circumstance bonus to checks to Recall Knowledge about undead creatures.
Undead Scholar.name: Undead Scholar

Undead Senses.description: Your senses changed and improved after you died. Now you can feel the vitality energy radiating from living creatures and the void surrounding other undead entities like you. You gain lifesense as an imprecise sense with a range of 10 feet, allowing you to pinpoint the locations of (and distinguish between) living and undead creatures, but not other unliving beings such as constructs.
Undead Senses.name: Undead Senses

Undead Slayer.description:
You leverage your extensive knowledge of undead during combat. You gain a +1 circumstance bonus to damage with weapons and unarmed attacks against undead creatures. If your attack would deal more than one weapon die of damage, the bonus is equal to the number of weapon dice or unarmed attack dice.

Furthermore, when you succeed or critically succeed at a check to Recall Knowledge against an undead creature that you can see, you identify a weak spot in their defenses—for 1 minute, you gain access to the critical specialization effects of all weapons and unarmed attacks for attacks you make against that specific creature.

@UUID[Compendium.sf2e.feat-effects.Item.jtlZPjobJNXLol7S]{Effect: Undead Slayer}
Undead Slayer.name: Undead Slayer

Undead Understanding.description:
Frequency once per day

Your experience living with undead has helped you understand the necromantic energies that animate the undead brain and the intrinsic forces that keep such creatures animate. You sense the void energy that makes up a mindless undead foe's consciousness. One mindless undead foe within 60 feet must attempt a @Check[will|against:class-spell] saving throw against the higher of your class DC or spell DC.

Failure The undead creature loses immunity to mental effects until the beginning of your next turn.

@UUID[Compendium.sf2e.feat-effects.Item.FDhS17NbYyFKt3pG]{Effect: Undead Understanding (Failure)}

Critical Failure The undead creature loses immunity to mental effects for 1 minute.

@UUID[Compendium.sf2e.feat-effects.Item.WloLZGDERsq9JDP7]{Effect: Undead Understanding (Critical Failure)}
Undead Understanding.name: Undead Understanding

Underfoot.description: You use your size against larger foes, quickly moving around them to avoid notice or stay out of reach. As long as you're Small, you can end a successful @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.actions.Item.21WIfSu7Xd7uKqV8]{Tumble Through} action in a Medium or larger enemy's space. The enemy must have appropriate limbs or otherwise leave you enough room for this maneuver, as determined by the GM. You couldn't, for example, occupy the space of an ooze that matches the full dimensions of the square.
