While you occupy an enemy's space, that enemy is @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.AJh5ex99aV6VTggg]{Off-Guard} to you.

featPrerequisites.0: shipborn ysoki or tunnel ysoki heritage

Underfoot.name: Underfoot

Underfoot Stampede!.description: You weave and veer between the legs of your enemies, causing them to fall over as you race across the battlefield. Stride twice, each in a straight line. You can move through the spaces of creatures that are at least one size larger than you, attempting to [[/act trip]] each creature whose space you enter. All attacks count toward your multiple attack penalty, but the penalty doesn't increase until after you've made all of them. You can attempt to Trip the same creature only once in a single Underfoot Stampede!
Underfoot Stampede!.name: Underfoot Stampede!

Underwater Athlete.description: You excel at underwater sports, and you are now particularly adept at feats of strength while unburdened by gravity. You can use this to your advantage in combat. When you successfully [[/act grapple]] a creature while underwater or in zero gravity, your target must attempt a saving throw against the higher of your class DC or Athletics DC. On a failure, the target is @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.MIRkyAjyBeXivMa7]{Enfeebled 1} until the end of its next turn.
Underwater Athlete.name: Underwater Athlete

Underwater Combatant.description: You've learned how to wield nearly any weapon effectively while underwater. You don't take the –2 penalty for making melee slashing or bludgeoning Strikes while underwater. Your ranged attacks aren't affected by being underwater. You can use weapons that deal fire damage underwater.
Underwater Combatant.name: Underwater Combatant

Underwater Stalker.description:
Your coloration camouflages you nicely in aquatic environments, and you know how to take full advantage of that. While underwater, you can [[/act sneak]] without attempting a Stealth check as long as you move no more than 5 feet and do not pass within 10 feet of an enemy during your movement.

You can move at full Speed while using the [[/act avoid-notice]] exploration activity in an aquatic environment, and you can use another exploration activity that does not attract unnecessary attention while Avoiding Notice.
Underwater Stalker.name: Underwater Stalker

Underwater Weapons Expert.description: You have spent a lot of time using weapons underwater, and you know how to modify them to function as well as they would on land. By spending 10 minutes with a weapon, you alter it to function better underwater for the next 24 hours. If it is a bludgeoning or slashing weapon, the wielder no longer takes a –2 circumstance penalty to attack rolls with it. If it is a ranged weapon, its range increment is no longer halved.
Underwater Weapons Expert.name: Underwater Weapons Expert

Undying.description:
Frequency once per hour

Trigger You have the dying condition and are about to attempt a recovery check.

You have died once before and have no intention of dying ever again; your soul stubbornly resuscitates your body when you would otherwise perish. You are restored to 1 Hit Point, lose the dying and @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.fBnFDH2MTzgFijKf]{Unconscious} conditions, and can act normally on this turn. You increase your wounded condition as normal.
Undying.name: Undying

Undying Defiance.description: You laugh at holy symbols and delight in the sound of faltering prayers. You are more in tune with your existence as an undead than many other corpsefolk are, and you can now leverage that to hold off those who would wield religious energies to try and unmake you. You gain a +1 circumstance bonus to all saving throws against divine effects and spells.
Undying Defiance.name: Undying Defiance

Unexpected Downsize.description:
You use your experience and training as a manager to aggressively compel a foe within 30 feet into believing they've been fired. Roll a @Check[type:deception|against:will] check against the target's Will DC. If you're a leader in the organization, you can roll a @Check[type:diplomacy|against:will] or @Check[type:society|against:will] check instead. The target must be a member of an organization (such a corporation, cult, gang, or military) or working on behalf of that organization. The head of an organization is immune to the effects of Unexpected Downsize.

Critical Success The creature becomes @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.I1ffBVISxLr2gC4u]{Unfriendly} to all creatures from the same organization to which it wasn't already @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.ud7gTLwPeklzYSXG]{Hostile}, even those that were previously allies. It treats no one as an ally for 1 minute.

Success As success, but the effect ends after 1 round.

Critical Failure The target knows you're bluffing and becomes immune to your Unexpected Downsize for 24 hours.
Unexpected Downsize.name: Unexpected Downsize

Unexpected Solution.description:
Frequency once per day

Trigger You're about to attempt a skill check or saving throw.

Your reckless tactics surprise others when they occasionally work. You roll twice and take the better result. If you destroy a consumable item of half your level or higher in the process, you gain a +1 circumstance bonus to the triggering roll.
Unexpected Solution.name: Unexpected Solution

Unfathomable Sorrow.description:
Frequency once per 10 minutes

Trigger An enemy causes you to become frightened or take persistent mental damage.

The depth of your sorrow causes the negativity coming from others to cascade back at them. The triggering creature becomes @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{Frightened 1}, and that enemy can't reduce their frightened condition below 1 until the beginning of your next turn.

Special The frequency of Unfathomable Sorrow is once per minute as long as your soulfeel is attuned to sorrow.
Unfathomable Sorrow.name: Unfathomable Sorrow

Unforgiving Fury.description:
Frequency once per 10 minutes

Trigger You critically succeed at a Strike.

Violence further fuels your fury and resilience. You gain a number of temporary Hit Points equal to your Charisma modifier until the end of your next turn.

Special The frequency of Unforgiving Fury is once per minute as long as your soulfeel is attuned to fury.
Unforgiving Fury.name: Unforgiving Fury

Unhindered Advance.description: When you use @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.feats.Item.c0TkeJ8LytJ5A6A1]{Tactical Advance}, you ignore difficult terrain and greater difficult terrain.
Unhindered Advance.name: Unhindered Advance

Unified Theory.description: You understand the common underpinnings of the four traditions of magic and magical essences. Whenever you use a skill action or a skill feat that requires a Nature, Occultism, or Religion check, depending on the magic tradition, you can use Arcana instead. If you would normally take a penalty or have a higher DC for using Arcana on other magic (such as when using Identify Magic), you no longer do so.
Unified Theory.name: Unified Theory

Universal Telepath.description:
Frequency once per day

Communication via mere words is a limitation of lesser minds. Your thoughts weave meaning from words, feelings, mental imagery, and ineffable stimuli for 10 minutes, during which you can communicate using your limited telepathy without sharing a language.

At 17th level, you can activate this feat at will.
Universal Telepath.name: Universal Telepath

Universal Translation.description:
A lack of shared language can be a pernicious challenge for negotiations, interrogations, and diplomatic relations. As part of your ambassador corps training, you learned how to quickly establish linguistic connections with others.

You can attempt a Deception, Diplomacy, or Intimidation check with the linguistic trait that targets a creature that does not share a language with you. These attempts take a −4 circumstance penalty to the check. Furthermore, you can translate for your ambassador partner when they attempt any Deception, Diplomacy, or Intimidation check with the linguistic trait as a reaction with the auditory trait.
Universal Translation.name: Universal Translation

Universal Translator.description: By activating your arcane sensory organ and analyzing ancestral memories and arcane lore, you can communicate with all kinds of people, animals, and even plants. You gain @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.spells.Item.BBvV7qoXGdw09q1C]{Speak with Animals}, @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.spells.Item.qvwIwJ9QBihy8R0t]{Speak with Plants}, and @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.spells.Item.vTQvfYu2llKQedmY]{Translate} as 3rd-rank arcane innate spells. You can cast each spell once per day.
Universal Translator.name: Universal Translator

Unknowing Polyglot.description: You have a deep and innate understanding of the foundations of communication as a whole. You learn an additional language. You get a +2 status bonus to @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.actions.Item.d9gbpiQjChYDYA2L]{Decipher Writing} and can make such attempts even if you're untrained.
Unknowing Polyglot.name: Unknowing Polyglot

Unleash Hell!.description:
Frequency once per day

Requirements wearing armor customized with Hellknight regalia.

Your armor unleashes a gout of hellfire in a @Template[type:cone|distance:30], dealing @Damage[(@actor.level)d6[@actor.flags.system.hellknight.order-damage]|options:area-damage] damage per level of a type determined by your chosen Hellknight order (@Check[reflex|against:class-spell|basic|options:area-effect]); a creature takes @Damage[(@actor.level)d6[spirit]|options:area-damage]{spirit damage} instead if that would be more detrimental (as determined by the GM).
Unleash Hell!.name: Unleash Hell!

Unleash Pneuma.description:
You unleash a portion of your spiritual essence—either the vitality of your living body or the void of your undead soul—in a violent burst around you. You deal @Damage[5d6[untyped]] damage of your selected type (see below) to all adjacent creatures (basic Reflex save using your class DC or spell DC, whichever is higher). At 11th level and every 2 levels thereafter, this damage increases by 1d6.

When you take this feat, choose either vitality or void. Once chosen, this selection can't be changed. Unleash Pneuma deals the chosen damage type and gains the chosen trait.

Special You can take this feat twice, but you must select a different damage type each time. If you do, Unleash Pneuma's frequency becomes once per day per damage type, rather than once per day.
Unleash Pneuma.name: Unleash Pneuma

Unleash Sota's Flame.description:
Channeling the heat of Sota's rekindled sun, you unleash a blast of plasma across the battlefield. You deal @Damage[10d8[fire]] damage in a @Template[line|distance:120]. For 1 minute afterward, your body is awash with solar energy. Creatures that Grab you or that hit you with an unarmed Strike or a non-reach melee weapon take @Damage[1d6[fire]] damage. Creatures in the area must attempt a @Check[reflex|against:class-spell] save using your class DC or spell DC, whichever is higher.

Critical Success The creature is unaffected.

Success The creature takes half damage.

Failure The creature takes full damage, plus @Damage[1d6[electricity]] damage, and is @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.TkIyaNPgTZFBCCuh]{Dazzled} for 1 round.

Critical Failure The creature takes double damage, plus @Damage[1d6[persistent,electricity]] damage, and is @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.XgEqL1kFApUbl5Z2]{Blinded} for 1 round. For 1 minute afterward, your body is awash with solar energy. Creatures that Grab you or that hit you with an unarmed Strike or a non-reach melee weapon take @Damage[1d6[fire]] damage.
Unleash Sota's Flame.name: Unleash Sota's Flame

Unleashed Anger.description:
You unleash your contained anger at a situation. Your size increases to Large, and you're @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.i3OJZU2nk64Df3xm]{Clumsy 1}. You gain a +1 status bonus to melee damage. This doesn't change your Speed, reach, or other statistics except as noted here. Your worn equipment automatically resizes to suit your new form, though it immediately returns to its original size if it leaves your possession. These effects last for 1 round. You can Sustain for up to 10 minutes, though you must then spend at least 10 minutes in your natural form before using Unleashed Anger again.

Special If you're a red-blooded madrosarai, you can use @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.actions.Item.Mfih4GjatO1sw2Ug]{Controlled Rage} as a free action right after using Unleashed Anger. If you do, you gain a +2 status bonus to melee damage.
Unleashed Anger.name: Unleashed Anger

Unliving Memories.description: Some element of your borai nature gives you flashes from the beyond: visions from the afterlife you were intended for or might still one day obtain. You gain the trained proficiency rank in Religion. If you're already trained in Religion, you instead become trained in another skill of your choice. You gain the @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.feats.Item.BocFD2KV0qgUC76x]{Additional Lore} feat for a Lore subcategory about a specific plane tied to your afterlife (such as Heaven, Hell, Nirvana, or Outer Rifts Lore).
Unliving Memories.name: Unliving Memories

Unlucky for Some.description:
Trigger You critically fail a saving throw or an enemy's Strike against you is a critical hit.

Requirements You don't have the @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.actions.Item.AWjKNTF00nagdA7j]{Lucky Break} reaction.

You gain the Lucky Break reaction for 24 hours and become immune to Unlucky for Some for 24 hours.
Unlucky for Some.name: Unlucky for Some

Unmistakable Lore.description: You never get information about your areas of expertise wrong. When you Recall Knowledge using any Lore subcategory in which you're trained, if you roll a critical failure, you get a failure instead. If you're a master in a Lore subcategory, on a critical success, you gain even more information or context than usual.
Unmistakable Lore.name: Unmistakable Lore

Unquenchable Breath.description: When you use Dragonkin Breath, a creature who fails or critically fails its saving throw takes @Damage[2d6[persistent,@actor.flags.system.dragonkinBreath.damageType]] damage of the same type. On a critical failure, the flat check to remove persistent damage increases to DC 20 (or DC 15, if the flat check would be reduced because the creature has an appropriate type of help). If you apply a critical weapon specialization effect that also deals persistent damage of the same type, apply this persistent damage in addition to the base persistent damage.
Unquenchable Breath.name: Unquenchable Breath

Unrelenting Joy.description:
Frequency once per 10 minutes

Requirements You're @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{Frightened} or taking persistent mental damage.

Your outlook on life is full of boundless hope. Reduce your frightened condition by 1. If you're taking persistent mental damage, roll a @Check[flat|dc:15] to see if you recover from that persistent mental damage.

Special The frequency of Unrelenting Joy is once per minute as long as your soulfeel is attuned to joy.
Unrelenting Joy.name: Unrelenting Joy

Unseen Tides.description: The surge of Kalo-Mahoi's ever-present tides courses in your blood, and you can feel their pull wherever you go. You gain @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.spells.Item.aqRYNoSvxsVfqglH]{Unfettered Movement} as a 4th-rank primal innate spell that you can cast once per day.
Unseen Tides.name: Unseen Tides

Unsettling Display.description: You can @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.actions.Item.2u915NdUyQan6uKF]{Demoralize} those around you by shifting your muscular and skeletal systems around. When you do, Demoralize loses the auditory trait and gains the visual trait, and you don't take a penalty if the creature doesn't understand your language.
Unsettling Display.name: Unsettling Display

Unstable Flare.description:
You supercharge your solar flare and unleash multiple simultaneous blasts at all foes in an area. Make a solar flare Strike with a –2 circumstance penalty against each enemy in a @Template[type:burst|distance:15] centered on any point within your solar flare's first range increment. Each attack counts toward your multiple attack penalty, but you don't increase your penalty until you've made all your attacks.

Graviton-Attuned You can Stride up to half your speed once as a free action immediately before or after making your attacks.

Photon-Attuned You're @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.DmAIPqOBomZ7H95W]{Concealed} to each target of this attack until the start of your next turn.
Unstable Flare.name: Unstable Flare

Unstable Overdrive.description:
Frequency once per day

You push your circuitry to its physical limits, maximizing your physical and mental capabilities. You become @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.nlCjDvLMf2EkV2dl]{Quickened} and @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.6A2QDy8wRGCVQsSd]{Glitching 1} for 1 minute. You can use your extra action only to Stride or Strike. While quickened in this way, you gain a +2 status bonus to your AC, attack rolls, and saving throws. You can't reduce your glitching value until you lose the quickened condition.
Unstable Overdrive.name: Unstable Overdrive

Unstoppable Directives.description:
Your confidence is a battery that keeps your allies going. When you use a directive that grants temporary Hit Points, increase the temporary Hit Points by your level. When you use a directive that doesn't grant temporary Hit Points, you can grant one ally affected by that directive temporary Hit Points equal to half your level. These temporary Hit Points last for 1 minute.

@UUID[Compendium.sf2e.feat-effects.Item.HB8lDFxU86aAl50M]{Effect: Unstoppable Directives}
Unstoppable Directives.name: Unstoppable Directives

Unstoppable Inertia.description:
Frequency once per 10 minutes

Trigger You would become @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.HL2l2VRSaQHu9lUw]{Fatigued}, @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.eIcWbB5o3pP6OIMe]{Immobilized}, @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.6uEgoh53GbXuHpTF]{Paralyzed}, @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.xYTAsEpcJE1Ccni3]{Slowed}, or @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.enA7BxAjBb7ns1iF]{Suppressed}.

You refuse to stop moving, pushing yourself beyond effects that would stop most creatures. You delay the effects of the triggering condition until the end of your next turn. Each time you use a move action while the condition is being delayed, you continue to delay the condition an additional round, up to 6 rounds. If the condition has a duration, the duration begins to elapse only after the delay. You can't further delay or prevent the condition after this ability ends.
Unstoppable Inertia.name: Unstoppable Inertia

Untrained Improvisation.description: You've learned how to handle situations when you're out of your depth. Your proficiency bonus to untrained skill checks is equal to your level –2. This improves to your level –1 at 5th level and your full level at 7th level. This doesn't allow you to use the skill's trained actions.
Untrained Improvisation.name: Untrained Improvisation

Unusual Treatment.description: Your medical training extends to less obvious conditions. When you succeed against a DC 20 check to @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.actions.Item.1kGNdIIhuglAjIp9]{Treat Wounds}, you can also reduce the value of one @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.i3OJZU2nk64Df3xm]{Clumsy}, @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.MIRkyAjyBeXivMa7]{Enfeebled}, or @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.e1XGnhKNSQIm5IXg]{Stupefied} condition on the patient by 1. If you're able to treat more than one creature at once, choose only one to gain this benefit. A creature can benefit from Unusual Treatment only once per day. If the condition results from an affliction, the affliction isn't cured, though the condition is reduced as long as the affliction remains at that stage. If you are a master in Medicine, add the @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.4D2KBtexWXa6oUMR]{Drained} condition to the list of conditions you can remove if you succeed at a DC 30 check. If you are legendary in Medicine, you reduce the chosen condition by 2 instead of by 1.
Unusual Treatment.name: Unusual Treatment

Upright Rest.description: You sleep in quadrupedal posture with the rest of your body mostly upright, allowing you to easily sleep in armor. You can sleep in armor overnight without being @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.HL2l2VRSaQHu9lUw]{Fatigued} the next day. If you were already fatigued before sleeping, the armor doesn't prevent you from recovering from being fatigued.
Upright Rest.name: Upright Rest

Urban Roots.description: You were either created in a densely populated area such as a city or have spent significant time in one. As a result, you've learned to apply your intuition and knowledge from the wilderness to the streets of metropolises and the narrow corridors of massive starships alike. You become trained in Survival (or another skill if you're already trained in Survival), and you gain the @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.feats.Item.YtbPw4FSa86QAdRq]{Urban Survivalist} skill feat.
Urban Roots.name: Urban Roots

Urban Survivalist.description: You can use [[/act subsist skill=survival]]{Survival} in place of Society to Subsist in cities, space stations, and other settlements. You can also use @Check[survival] instead of Perception to notice hazards in these environments; if you find a hazard in this way, you can also use Survival instead of Thievery to [[/act disable-device skill=survival]]{Disable the Device}.
Urban Survivalist.name: Urban Survivalist

Urchin.description:
Frequency once every 10 minutes

Trigger A creature Grabs you or successfully Strikes you with an unarmed melee strike or a non-reach melee weapon.

You flex the spines running down the back of your head and neck as a defensive response. The attacking creature takes @Damage[(floor((@actor.level + 1) / 3 + 1))d6[piercing]] damage, with a @Check[reflex|against:class-spell|basic] save against your class DC or spell DC, whichever is higher. On a critical failure, the target also takes @Damage[(floor((@actor.level + 1) / 3 + 1))[persistent,bleed]] damage. At 8th level and every 3 levels thereafter, the damage increases by 1d6, and the persistent bleed damage increases by 1.
Urchin.name: Urchin

Use the Scenery.description: Performing for an audience has made you aware of your surroundings. You're always looking for ways to use the scenery to your advantage, setting yourself up to show your best angle to the world—or hide it! You always gain an additional +1 status bonus when you @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.actions.Item.ust1jJSCZQUhBZIz]{Take Cover}.
Use the Scenery.name: Use the Scenery

Used to It.description:
Trigger You're struck by a critical hit that deals energy damage or critically fail a saving throw against an effect that deals energy damage.

You're used to taking serious amounts of damage from all kinds of extreme Rodnarth weather, from acid quakes to lightning waves. Attempt a @Check[flat|dc:15]. On a success, the triggering attack becomes a normal hit, or you fail the saving throw against the triggering effect instead of critically failing.
Used to It.name: Used to It

Vapor Form.description:
Frequency once per hour

You can transform your body into a gaseous vapor. In this state, you're amorphous. You lose any item bonus to AC and all other effects and bonuses from armor, and you use your proficiency rank in unarmored defense. You gain resistance 8 to physical damage and are immune to precision damage. You can't cast spells, activate items, or use actions that have the attack or manipulate trait. You gain a fly Speed equal to your normal fly Speed and can slip through tiny cracks. This form lasts for 5 minutes or until you Dismiss it.
Vapor Form.name: Vapor Form

Vault Guard.description: Your training under the elite mercenaries in the Vault were brutal for your body and your mind, but they've hardened your constitution and left you with rare expertise. You've done plenty of drills wearing the heaviest equipment, and you're quick to adapt to even the most specialized protective gear. You're trained in heavy armor. Whenever you gain a class feature that grants you expert or greater proficiency in medium armor, you also gain that proficiency in heavy armor.
Vault Guard.name: Vault Guard

Vector Reflector.description:
Trigger A @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.enA7BxAjBb7ns1iF]{Suppressed} creature damages you with a Strike.

Your armor absorbs some of the kinetic energy of your opponent's attack. You gain resistance equal to half your level against the triggering damage (or equal to your level if you have the @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.class-features.Item.T78VQC8oaD1Odz1k]{Armor Storm} fighting style). If the triggering creature is within reach, attempt an Athletics check to @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.actions.Item.7blmbDrQFNfdT731]{Shove} it.
Vector Reflector.name: Vector Reflector

Veil of Ink.description:
Frequency once per 10 minutes

You vent most of your ink all at once, filling a small area with obscuring droplets. You create a stationary cloud of ink in a @Template[type:emanation|distance:10] centered on your current location. Creatures are @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.DmAIPqOBomZ7H95W]{Concealed} while inside the cloud, and creatures outside the area are concealed to creatures inside the cloud. The ink dissipates at the start of your next turn. This ability functions equally effectively above or below water.
Veil of Ink.name: Veil of Ink

Vengeful Gore.description:
Frequency once per hour

Trigger An adjacent enemy deals damage to you with an unarmed melee Strike.

With an angry bellow, you lean into your horns to gore the offending opponent. Make a horns Strike against the triggering creature. If the attack is a success, the creature takes an additional 2d6 bleed damage.
Vengeful Gore.name: Vengeful Gore

Venomous Cocktail.description: You can enhance your natural venom by imbibing more poison, allowing it to mix with your natural poison production. You Interact to draw (if necessary) and chug a dose of poison or one piece of projectile ammunition from a weapon you're holding that deals poison damage. Add 1d4 poison damage to the next Strike you make with your venomous jaws. The damage increases to two dice if your held weapon is advanced grade or superior grade, three dice if the weapon is elite grade or ultimate grade, and four dice if the weapon is paragon grade. On a critical hit, roll these dice after doubling the weapon's damage.
Venomous Cocktail.name: Venomous Cocktail

Vent Crawler.description: You're a sneaky stowaway who knows that vents are the best way to get around aboard a ship or station. You become trained in Acrobatics. If you would automatically become trained in Acrobatics (from your background or class, for example), you instead become trained in a skill of your choice. You gain the @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.feats.Item.3G8xUlgCjRmRJNfP]{Quick Squeeze} skill feat.
Vent Crawler.name: Vent Crawler

Vent Gas.description:
Frequency once per hour

You vent gas to propel yourself forward. All squares in a @Template[type:emanation|distance:5] become filled with gas. All creatures in the gas become @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.DmAIPqOBomZ7H95W]{Concealed}, and all creatures outside the gas become concealed to creatures within it. This gas disperses at the beginning of your next turn.

You gain a +10-foot circumstance bonus to all your Speeds until the start of your next turn. Then you Stride.
Vent Gas.name: Vent Gas

Verdant Psychic.description: Your psychic abilities manifest in a supernatural connection to the natural world, particularly the jungles on Castrovel and on planets with similar environments. You gain the @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.spells.Item.uZK2BYzPnxUBnDjr]{Tangle Vine} and @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.spells.Item.nf8q0zvJDnnkzANe]{Scan Environment} cantrips as primal innate spells at will. These cantrips are heightened to half your level.
Verdant Psychic.name: Verdant Psychic

Verdant Sense.description: You can sense changes to flora and fauna within the range of your limited telepathy. You gain a +1 circumstance bonus to Perception checks to find living environmental hazards. Even if you aren't @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.actions.Item.TiNDYUGlMmxzxBYU]{Searching}, you can attempt to find living environmental hazards that normally require you to be Searching.

featPrerequisites.1: Xenowarden or follower of the Green Faith

Verdant Sense.name: Verdant Sense

Versatile Outfit.description: You are known for your astounding custom outfits and pride yourself on designing versatile and reconfigurable garments, allowing you to create nearly any look in a matter of moments. You can use the Crafting skill rather than Deception to Impersonate another person, and can do so in 1 minute rather than the usual 10 minutes. You don't need a disguise kit to Impersonate a specific person when using Crafting to do so, and a maker's toolkit grants a +1 item bonus to the check.
Versatile Outfit.name: Versatile Outfit

Vesk Weapon Familiarity.description:
You're trained with all doshkos. In addition, you gain access to all uncommon weapons with the vesk trait. For the purposes of proficiency, you treat any of these that are martial weapons as simple weapons and any that are advanced weapons as martial weapons.

At 5th level, whenever you get a critical hit with one of these weapons, you get its critical specialization effect.
Vesk Weapon Familiarity.name: Vesk Weapon Familiarity

Veskarium Logistics Specialist.description: The Veskarium has a proud tradition of training disciplined quartermasters whose contributions to the empire's success through logistical acumen rival those of the greatest vesk warriors. You gain the @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.feats.Item.lHFz4MmebvPqTb0A]{Prescient Consumable} and @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.feats.Item.bh2jHyyYrkLMsIdX]{Prescient Planner} feats.
Veskarium Logistics Specialist.name: Veskarium Logistics Specialist

Vestigial Restraint.description: Countless generations of specialization have stripped your two pairs of vestigial arms of much of their strength, but you've trained them to gain enough strength to be useful in combat. Though they aren't strong or agile enough to grab an opponent, you can use them to maintain a grip you already have. When you successfully grapple a creature that's at least one size smaller than you, you can transfer the foe to your vestigial arms as a free action, freeing your primary hands. You have a –2 circumstance penalty to the Escape DC for your grapple against creatures you have @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.kWc1fhmv9LBiTuei]{Grabbed} in your vestigial arms.
Vestigial Restraint.name: Vestigial Restraint

Veteran Trap Finder.description: You can use [[/act disable-device skill=mission-lore]]{Mission Lore} instead of Computers or Thievery to disable traps in locations you researched using Mission Briefing. You can disable traps that require a proficiency rank of master in Computers or Thievery. If you have master proficiency in Computers or Thievery, you can disable traps that require a proficiency rank of legendary in that skill instead, and increase the circumstance bonus you gain from Danger Awareness to +2.
Veteran Trap Finder.name: Veteran Trap Finder

Veteran Traveler.description: You've spent years traveling, and you know better than most that roads aren't always paved. Or clear. Or even built yet. You become trained in Nature or Survival. If you're already trained in both of those skills, you instead become trained in another skill of your choice. Choose one kind of terrain from the following list: muddy, rocky, sandy, sloped, or undergrowth. You ignore difficult or uneven terrain of that type.
Veteran Traveler.name: Veteran Traveler

Vibe Eruption.description: By allowing yourself to drown in ambient emotions, you can cause them to spill over and erupt around you in a cathartic flow of primal energy. You can cast @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.spells.Item.wRNRWwCEbmSxbHDl]{Vibe Check} as a 4th-rank primal innate spell four times per day. You must select a different emotion each time you Cast the Spell in a day, and the emotion must match your current soulfeel (or wonder, if you select fear).
Vibe Eruption.name: Vibe Eruption

Vibration Whiskers.description: Your whiskers have developed the same senses as that of your bonded hymothoa. You gain motion sense as an imprecise sense with a range of 30 feet. Motion sense allows you to detect nearby motion through vibration and air movement.
Vibration Whiskers.name: Vibration Whiskers

Vicious Breath.description: The intensity of your draconic breath lays waste to the environment and your foes. When you use Dragonkin Breath, the area of your breath becomes difficult terrain for 1 minute. Any creature that enters the area of your dragonkin breath or is occupying your breath's area at the end of its turn takes @Damage[4d6[@actor.flags.system.dragonkinBreath.damageType]|options:area-damage] damage of the same type (@Check[reflex|against:class-spell|basic|options:area-effect] save against the same DC as your dragonkin breath).
Vicious Breath.name: Vicious Breath

Vicious Takedown.description:
Requirements Your most recent action was a success on a melee Strike against a creature who is at least one size larger than you.

You know that being small only means you need to be more vicious to survive and have learned to use your size to your advantage against larger foes. Attempt an Athletics check to @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.actions.Item.7blmbDrQFNfdT731]{Shove} or @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.actions.Item.ge56Lu1xXVFYUnLP]{Trip} the target, ignoring the size requirements. If you roll a critical failure, you get a failure instead.
Vicious Takedown.name: Vicious Takedown

Virtuosic Performer.description:
You have exceptional talent with one type of performance. You gain a +1 circumstance bonus when making a certain type of performance. If you are a master in Performance, this bonus increases to +2. Select one of the following specialties and apply the bonus when attempting Performance checks of that type. If it's unclear whether the specialty applies, the GM decides.

SpecialtyExamples
ActingDrama, live streams, reality shows
ComedyBuffoonery, joke telling, stand-up routines
DanceBallet, ballroom, interpretive, pop, traditional
KeyboardsKeytar, organ, piano
OratoryEpic, ode, poetry, storytelling
PercussionBells, chimes, drum kit, xylophone
SingingBallad, chant, pop, rock, shanty
StringsGuitar, singing coil, theremin
SynthsSynth deck, turn table
WindsHorn, flute, pipes
Virtuosic Performer.name: Virtuosic Performer

Visceral Warmask.description:
Requirements You're adjacent to a creature that isn't immune to bleed damage and died within the last minute.

You dip your fingers into the gushing wounds of the fallen, using their ichor to mask your face in a visceral ritual that pays homage to the fallen while calming yourself for in the din of battle. For 1 minute, you gain a +1 circumstance bonus to Intimidation checks to [[/act demoralize]], a +1 status bonus to Will saves against emotion effects, and at the end of your turn, reduce your @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{Frightened} condition by 2 instead of 1.
Visceral Warmask.name: Visceral Warmask

Visual Static.description: You scrub your presence from your enemies' minds in a blast of psychic static that disorients them. You become @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.DmAIPqOBomZ7H95W]{Concealed} against any number of observable creatures of your choice within 30 feet for 1 round.
Visual Static.name: Visual Static

Vital Sap.description: The sticky sap produced by your vined body has healing properties. You produce 1d4 vials of sap each day when you are exposed to natural sunlight for at least 4 hours. A creature that drinks a vial of the sap as an Interact action restores 2d8 Hit Points. This effect has the healing and vitality traits.
Vital Sap.name: Vital Sap

Vitality Network.description: You gain a @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.class-features.Item.hNnIAyBxfQ2Howp2]{Vitality Network} with 10 Hit Points and can use @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.actions.Item.UeMHbnnaXDa3sGfG]{Transfer Vitality} to transfer up to 10 HP. Increase the maximum capacity of your vitality network by 10 at 10th, 15th, and 20th-level. Increase the amount you can transfer by 5 at 5th, 10th, 15th, and 20th-level.
Vitality Network.name: Vitality Network

Vitality Web.description: You can manifest your bond as a web of vital energy between your allies. You learn the @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.spells.Item.6HMiN0oQzeoYR3it]{Vitality Web} epiphany spell.
Vitality Web.name: Vitality Web

Vlaka Lore.description:
You strive to keep the traditions and stories of your people alive, even as you build new communities and forge new alliances. You gain the trained proficiency rank in Diplomacy and Society. If you would automatically become trained in one of those skills (from your background or class, for example), you instead become trained in a skill of your choice.

You also gain the @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.feats.Item.BocFD2KV0qgUC76x]{Additional Lore} general feat for Vlaka Lore.
Vlaka Lore.name: Vlaka Lore

Void Blood.description: The ichor pulsing through your veins is infused with void energy, and it protects your body and soul from the same sinister power. You have void resistance equal to half your level.
Void Blood.name: Void Blood

Void Inversion.description: You've learned to channel your void inversion into another creature. You gain @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.spells.Item.FIW0VpGULprL2u8J]{Void Seed} as a 2nd-rank occult innate spell that you can cast once every 10 minutes.
Void Inversion.name: Void Inversion

Void Sight.description: You're accustomed to living or working in utter darkness, and your eyes have adjusted to the gloom. You gain greater darkvision.
Void Sight.name: Void Sight

Void Stalker.description:
Requirements You're @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.iU0fEDdBp3rXpTMC]{Hidden} to at least one enemy.

You can strike fear into those you stalk simply by letting them know that you can see them, but they can't see you. You [[/act sneak]] or [[/act hide]] and verbally mock a single creature within 30 feet from whom you're hidden. Your Stealth check against that target's Perception DC gains the following success and failure results in addition to its usual results.

Critical Success The target you mock becomes @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{Frightened 2}. The target can't reduce its frightened condition below 1 until 1 minute passes or until it observes you (whichever comes first).

Success The target you mock becomes @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{Frightened 1}.

Critical Failure You become @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.1wQY3JYyhMYeeV2G]{Observed} to the target you mock.
Void Stalker.name: Void Stalker

Void Vision.description: Your time spent stuck to the hull of a traveling starship has made you hypersensitive to even the faintest traces of light. You gain darkvision.
Void Vision.name: Void Vision

Voidpath.description:
You've unlocked a deeper connection to the depths of emptiness that voidborns call home. This connection allows you to travel through hidden spaces while avoiding the attention of others. While @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.VRSef5y1LmL2Hkjf]{Undetected} by all non-allies in an area of dim light or darkness, you can @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.actions.Item.VMozDqMMuK5kpoX4]{Sneak} without attempting a Stealth check so long as you move less than 15 feet and don't pass within 15 feet of an enemy during your movement.

During exploration, this also allows you to automatically approach within 20 feet of other creatures while @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.actions.Item.IE2nThCmoyhQA0Jn]{Avoiding their Notice} in an area of dim light or darkness, as long as they aren't actively @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.actions.Item.TiNDYUGlMmxzxBYU]{Searching} or on guard.
Voidpath.name: Voidpath

Voidstrong.description:
Your unbelievable resilience allows you to survive even in the vacuum of space—at least for a while. You can hold your breath for 10 minutes. You have cold resistance equal to half your level.

Special If you have the glacierborn shobhad heritage, your cold resistance is instead equal to your level. If you have the offworld shobhad heritage, you additionally gain the @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.feats.Item.aJUXbe9HJVvv0Mxa]{Breath Control} general feat.
Voidstrong.name: Voidstrong

Volosian Spit.description: You've inherited a greater connection to your Volosian heritage and begin to exhibit hymothoa habits. You gain the @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.actions.Item.oxYfBuSCruRWTqJ9]{Volosian Spit} action.
Volosian Spit.name: Volosian Spit

Voracious Bite.description:
You slurp residual nutrients as you dissolve those you bite. Whenever you inflict persistent poison damage with your jaws unarmed attack, you gain temporary Hit Points equal to half your level for 1 minute.

@UUID[Compendium.sf2e.feat-effects.Item.JYc2d8FHhg3t3gea]{Effect: Voracious Bite (Temporary Hit Points)}

Special If you have the @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.heritages.Item.HlkSZKuMn4rG1uiQ]{Suskillon Cutoff Shirren} heritage, whenever you inflict persistent poison damage with your jaws unarmed attack, you also gain a +2 status bonus to your next @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.actions.Item.1OagaWtBpVXExToo]{Recall Knowledge} check to recall information about creatures with the same trait as the target for the next minute.

@UUID[Compendium.sf2e.feat-effects.Item.NSGtb7a9NrcwIpcu]{Effect: Voracious Bite (Recall Knowledge)}
Voracious Bite.name: Voracious Bite

Voracious Reader.description: When a topic draws your interest, you learn all you can about it but can just as easily shift to a new subject at the drop of a hat. Gain the @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.feats.Item.BocFD2KV0qgUC76x]{Additional Lore} feat. During your daily preparations, if you have access to the infosphere or any relevant learning material, you can swap the Lore skill you have selected with your Additional Lore feat (including any additional skill increases applied to that Lore skill using Additional Lore). Since the proficiency from this selection is temporary, you can't use it to satisfy a prerequisite for a permanent character option (like a feat).
Voracious Reader.name: Voracious Reader

Vulkari Item Hack.description: You can use your knowledge of computer coding and machine learning to hack magical items, enabling you to operate these powerful items even if you lack any magical talent. You gain the @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.feats.Item.uR62fVC9FyQAMCO1]{Trick Magic Item} skill feat, even if you don't meet the prerequisites. When you Trick Magic Item, you can choose to use Computers instead of Arcana, Nature, Occultism, or Religion for the skill check, regardless of the item's magic tradition.
Vulkari Item Hack.name: Vulkari Item Hack

Vulkari Linguist.description: You are a skilled linguist and translator, with the uncanny ability to detect linguistic nuances, understand local parlance and metaphor, interpret nonverbal body language and communication, and ensure you're understood by those around you when it really counts, even when speaking a language they don't know. You gain two additional languages of your choice. Your linguistic effects work on targets who share a language with you, even if you aren't certain which language you share or aren't using the shared language.
Vulkari Linguist.name: Vulkari Linguist

Vulkari Spell Decipher.description: You understand that magic is just another language, and you can recognize and decode even magic outside of your spellcasting tradition. You gain the @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.feats.Item.MjQyTcV8Jiv1Jtln]{Recognize Spell} skill feat. When you Recognize Spell and you don't automatically identify the spell, you select which of the listed skill checks the GM rolls secretly to identify the spell, rather than the GM rolling whichever corresponds to the tradition of the spell being cast. In addition, you can get a result better than failure if you're not trained in the skill.

featPrerequisites.0: trained in Arcana, Nature, Occultism, or Religion

Vulkari Spell Decipher.name: Vulkari Spell Decipher

Waiting for your Moment.description: You understand the power of waiting for the opportune moment. When you would roll initiative, you can choose to forgo rolling and instead receive a result of 1. If you do, you are @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.nlCjDvLMf2EkV2dl]{Quickened} during the first round of combat. You can use the extra action only to Stride or to Strike.
Waiting for your Moment.name: Waiting for your Moment

Wall Jump.description:
You can use your momentum from a jump to propel yourself off a wall. If you're adjacent to a wall at the end of a jump (whether performing a @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.actions.Item.2HJ4yuEFY1Cast4h]{High Jump}, @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.actions.Item.JUvAvruz7yRQXfz2]{Long Jump}, or @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.actions.Item.d5I6018Mci2SWokk]{Leap}), you don't fall as long as your next action is another jump. Your previous jump gives you momentum, letting you use High Jump or Long Jump as a single action, but you don't get to Stride as part of the activity.

You can use Wall Jump only once in a turn, unless you're legendary in Athletics, in which case you can use it as many times as you can use consecutive jump actions in that turn.
Wall Jump.name: Wall Jump

Warblood of Damoritosh.description: The vesk deity of conquest, Damoritosh, has gifted (or cursed) you with the divine energy to persevere through the most intense combat situations. The first time each day that you would die, Damoritosh protects you, granting you a sliver of healing and the drive to push through the coming challenge. This prevents you from dying, restores @Damage[5[healing]] Hit Points, and you become @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.nlCjDvLMf2EkV2dl]{Quickened} for 1 minute. If the cause of your death was a condition or effect that would still cause you to die after regaining Hit Points, such as a high value on the @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.3uh1r86TzbQvosxv]{Doomed} condition, you suppress that condition for 1 minute.
Warblood of Damoritosh.name: Warblood of Damoritosh

Ward Medic.description: You've studied in large medical wards, treating several patients at once and tending to all their needs. When you use @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.actions.Item.TC7OcDa7JlWbqMaN]{Treat Disease} or @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.actions.Item.1kGNdIIhuglAjIp9]{Treat Wounds}, you can treat up to two targets. If you're a master in Medicine, you can treat up to four targets, and if you're legendary, you can treat up to eight targets.
Ward Medic.name: Ward Medic

Warmount Shell.description: Your immense shell has the capability to mount weapons of destructive power like other species might wield in their arms. You count as having an additional pair of arms that can only be used to hold a single two-handed weapon. This weapon is implanted as an augmentation but doesn't count toward your implant limit and can be removed with an Interact action.
Warmount Shell.name: Warmount Shell

Warp Wounds.description:
Trigger An enemy damages you.

Requirements An enemy or willing ally is in your quantum field.

Your reality shifts to partly overlap with another in which someone else was injured in your stead. You gain resistance to all damage against the triggering attack equal to half your level, and one enemy or willing ally in your quantum field takes damage of the same type equal to the amount of damage prevented this way, with a @Check[fortitude|against:witchwarper|basic] save against your class DC.
Warp Wounds.name: Warp Wounds

Wary Disarmament.description: If you trigger a device or set off a trap while disarming it, you gain a +2 circumstance bonus to your AC or saving throw against the device or trap. This applies only to attacks or effects triggered by your failed attempt, not to any later ones, such as additional attacks from a complex trap.
Wary Disarmament.name: Wary Disarmament

Waste Not.description:
With careful focus, you guarantee vital energy lost from a target is caught by your vitality network. If the next action you use is to Cast a Spell that deals void damage to a living creature, your vitality network gains Hit Points equal to twice the spell's rank.

Special You can Waste Not without the spellshape trait. If you do and your next action is to Strike with a weapon that deals void damage, your vitality network gains 2 Hit Points per weapon damage die.
Waste Not.name: Waste Not

Wasteland Warrior.description: Pioneers have overcome many of the wastelands' dangers, gaining both resilience and the skills needed to survive there. You gain resistance to cold and fire damage equal to half your level. You can disable environmental hazards using [[/act disable-device skill=survival]] instead of Athletics or Thievery. If you're a master in Survival, you can disable environmental hazards that require a proficiency rank of master or lower in Athletics or Thievery.
Wasteland Warrior.name: Wasteland Warrior

Watch Out.description:
Trigger A creature targets an ally within 60 feet with an attack, and you can see both the attacker and your ally.

You signal a warning to your ally, granting them a +2 circumstance bonus to AC against the triggering attack.

@UUID[Compendium.sf2e.feat-effects.Item.8eqdNadBEcXMvjng]{Effect: Watch Out}
Watch Out.name: Watch Out

Weakening Shot.description:
Requirements You're wielding a gun.

You target a creature's limbs or load-bearing appendages to weaken them. You Aim and then make a ranged Strike against your mark. If the Strike hits, the creature becomes your choice of @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.i3OJZU2nk64Df3xm]{Clumsy 1} or @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.MIRkyAjyBeXivMa7]{Enfeebled 1} until the end of your next turn (@UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.i3OJZU2nk64Df3xm]{Clumsy 2} or @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.MIRkyAjyBeXivMa7]{Enfeebled 2} on a critical hit).
Weakening Shot.name: Weakening Shot

Weapon Proficiency.description:
You become trained in all martial weapons. If you were already trained in all martial weapons, you become trained in one advanced weapon of your choice. If you are at least 11th level, you also become an expert in these weapons.

Special You can select this feat more than once. Each time you do, you become trained in an advanced weapon.
Weapon Proficiency.name: Weapon Proficiency

Weave Obscurity.description: You understand your affliction enough to wield your inability to communicate certain things as a shield against prying eyes, adorning yourself with imagery of pre-Gap truths that are obscured to most people. You can cast @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.spells.Item.XXqE1eY3w3z6xJCB]{Invisibility} as a 2nd-rank occult innate spell three times per day, but the spell's duration becomes "until the end of your next turn."
Weave Obscurity.name: Weave Obscurity

Weave Silk Balloon.description:
Frequency once per minute You create a silk balloon that allows you to fly a short distance.

You Fly up to 35 feet. If you aren't on solid ground at the end of this movement, you fall.
Weave Silk Balloon.name: Weave Silk Balloon

Weightless Defense.description:
Requirements You're @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.z1ucw4CLwLqHoAp3]{Untethered} in zero gravity.

You have learned kasathan techniques that takes advantage of your extra arms for increasing your defense in zero gravity. You curl yourself into a tight ball, using one set of arms to balance and one set of arms to protect yourself. You lose the @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.AJh5ex99aV6VTggg]{Off-Guard} condition from being untethered, and you gain a +1 circumstance bonus to AC and Reflex saves for as long as you're untethered or until you use an action with the manipulate trait.

Special If you're a @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.heritages.Item.ES2B7mYJB3zNaySw]{Void Acolyte Kasatha}, you don't lose the benefits of Weightless Defense by using an action with the manipulate trait.
Weightless Defense.name: Weightless Defense

Well of Vitality.description: Your flowering is a reservoir of incredible vitality energy. Once per day, you can cast @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.spells.Item.Hnc7eGi7vyZenAIm]{Breath of Life} as a primal innate spell.
Well of Vitality.name: Well of Vitality

Well-Connected.description:
You've studied the dense and interconnected network of kasathan Great Families. You know all their major achievements, and you can use this knowledge either to flatter or to find the right person for a job, depending on what the situation calls for.

You become trained in Society and gain the @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.feats.Item.X2jGFfLU5qI5XVot]{Streetwise} skill feat. In addition, when you're in a settlement with a significant kasatha population, you can request help or expertise by meeting with a member of a Great Family; when you do so, you gain a +2 status bonus to Society checks to @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.actions.Item.plBGdZhqq5JBl1D8]{Gather Information}.
Well-Connected.name: Well-Connected

Well-Loved Trinket.description:
Frequency once per day

One of your personal trinkets has aged from years of love and wear. Looking at it reminds you of times when you were safe and filled with joy, such as when you were a child listening to stories of heroic triumph. When you use the @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.actions.Item.cx5V4zwJFbsKG1ri]{Self Soothe} action, you also reduce your @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.3uh1r86TzbQvosxv]{Doomed} value by 1. You cannot use this to reduce a permanent doomed value.
Well-Loved Trinket.name: Well-Loved Trinket

What's Mine is Yours.description:
Frequency once per round

You have little regard for the concepts of personal space and individual ownership, and you often place your equipment in your allies' possession without their knowledge. Fortunately, you know exactly where you put it! You call out to your allies, urging them to pull something out of a pocket or bag. Each of your allies within 100 feet who can perceive you can use a reaction to draw one item of your choice from their pocket, bag, or similar storage space. They can additionally stow an item as part of this reaction, if desired. You choose the drawn item for each ally individually, from among the items in your possession that weigh 1 Bulk or less.
What's Mine is Yours.name: What's Mine is Yours

What, Me, Fail?.description:
Frequency once per hour

Trigger You fail, but do not critically fail, a skill check with the chosen skill.

You have worked hard to become one of the greatest talents in a particular area, and your reputation simply wouldn't stand if you were seen failing. When you select this feat, choose a skill that you're a master in. You can reroll the triggering check, but you must use the new result, even if it's worse.

Special You can select this feat more than once, choosing a different skill each time. You can What, Me, Fail? once per hour for each skill you've chosen.
What, Me, Fail?.name: What, Me, Fail?

Whirling Swipe.description:
Requirements You're wielding a two-handed melee weapon.

You swipe your weapon in a wide swing to create a deadly arc. Your weapon gains the area (burst 5 feet) and unwieldy traits until the end of the turn. If your weapon has reach, the burst radius becomes the reach of your weapon. @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.actions.Item.oc0ZKnk5zD0GXqZi]{Area Fire} with the required weapon, centering the burst on a corner of a square you occupy. You're excluded from the burst. If you're using a weapon with the backswing or sweep trait, you gain a +1 circumstance bonus to the save DC of the attack. If you have the primary target class feature, the primary target Strike you make is a melee Strike, rather than a ranged Strike.
Whirling Swipe.name: Whirling Swipe

Whisper to the Restoring Waters.description:
Frequency once per day

With a sacred word of gratitude, you drink some water and allow it to channel vitality into your body. The water functions as your choice of an advanced medpatch or hypopen. At 13th level, it functions as a superior medpatch or hypopen. At 17th level, it functions as an elite medpatch or hypopen.
Whisper to the Restoring Waters.name: Whisper to the Restoring Waters

Wide Field of View.description: Your eyes are set particularly far apart, even relative to other izalguuns, and with some focus you can keep track of all the threats around you. You gain all-around vision until the start of your next turn. This lets you see in all directions and prevents you from being flanked.
Wide Field of View.name: Wide Field of View

Wide-Spectrum Artillery Repulsion Device.description: You've integrated a Wide-Spectrum Artillery Repulsion Device, or WARD, into your LFAN that emits energy to absorb incoming projectiles. The WARD is always active by default, but you can deactivate or reactivate it with a single Interact action. While your WARD is active, any damage you would take from a ranged attack is applied to the force field's Hit Points first before being applied to your Hit Points (including temporary Hit Points). If an attack reduces the WARD to 0 Hit Points, you take any excess damage, the WARD deactivates, and it can't be activated again for 10 minutes. Your WARD has @Damage[39[healing]] Hit Points and regains @Damage[6[healing]] Hit Points at the start of your turn. At 15th level and every 2 levels thereafter, increase the total Hit Points of your WARD by 3 and the amount of Hit Points it replenishes by 1.
Wide-Spectrum Artillery Repulsion Device.name: Wide-Spectrum Artillery Repulsion Device

Widen Area.description:
Requirements You're wielding an area or automatic weapon.

You set up your area weapon to affect more targets. If the next action you use is to Area Fire or Auto-Fire in a burst, cone, or line, or if you use @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.feats.Item.xND8wnEdnGSq84kn]{Whirling Swipe}, you increase the area of that attack. Add 5 feet to the radius of a burst that normally has a radius of at least 10 feet (a burst with a smaller radius isn't affected). Add 5 feet to the length of a cone or line that's normally 15 feet or smaller, and add 10 feet to the length of a larger cone or line.
Widen Area.name: Widen Area

Widen Field of View.description: With some effort and concentration, you can track the battlefield from both heads at once. You gain all-around vision until the start of your next turn. This lets you see in all directions and prevents you from being flanked.
Widen Field of View.name: Widen Field of View

Widen Spell.description: You manipulate the energy of your spell, causing it to affect a wider area. If the next action you use is to Cast a Spell that has an area of a burst, cone, or line and doesn't have a duration, increase the area of that spell. Add 5 feet to the radius of a burst that normally has a radius of at least 10 feet (a burst with a smaller radius isn't affected). Add 5 feet to the length of a cone or line that's normally 15 feet long or smaller, and add 10 feet to the length of a larger cone or line.
Widen Spell.name: Widen Spell

Widest Field of View (Izalguun).description: You can process enough visual information that you can see in all directions at once. You permanently gain all-around vision, meaning you can't be flanked. Additionally, you can [[/act seek]] in two directions at once.
Widest Field of View (Izalguun).name: Widest Field of View (Izalguun)

Widest Field of View (Phasorq).description: Each of yours heads looks out for the other. You gain all-around vision, meaning you can’t be flanked.
Widest Field of View (Phasorq).name: Widest Field of View (Phasorq)

Wild Bond.description: Understanding that all living things are part of the same tapestry of life, you can tap into the universal code to radically alter the genes of creatures in your bond. You gain the @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.spells.Item.ssOpTABjuHAqNTPu]{Wild Bond} epiphany spell.
Wild Bond.name: Wild Bond

Wild Soulfeel.description: You're as fickle as the inhabitants of the First World. When you use an action with both the emotion and moyishuu traits, you must immediately attune your soulfeel to a different emotion. If the action had a duration, it becomes until the end of your turn. You can attempt to keep the same emotional attunement by succeeding at a @Check[flat|dc:15], but if you fail, the frequency of the action becomes once per hour.
Wild Soulfeel.name: Wild Soulfeel

Willful Defiance.description: You loudly proclaim your opposition to a single creature you're aware of within 60 feet. You gain a +1 circumstance bonus to Armor Class and saving throws against the selected creature's attacks, spells, and other effects for 1 minute. During that time, if you would fail or critically fail a saving throw against the selected creature, you can choose to reroll the failed save. If you do, after rerolling, Willful Defiance ends.
Willful Defiance.name: Willful Defiance

Wind Walker.description: Your skill at flying allows you to do it as easily as other species might walk. Whenever you Stride, you can Fly or use @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.feats.Item.tEH4JIm2MUyGluQo]{Basic Flight} instead.

featPrerequisites.0: a fly Speed granted by your ancestry, or Basic Flight

Wind Walker.name: Wind Walker

Witchwarper Dedication.description:
Choose a paradox. You become trained in the paradox's skill or, if you were already trained, you become trained in a skill of your choice. You gain the Warp Reality action, but your quantum field is a @Template[type:burst|distance:10].

You cast spells like a witchwarper. You gain access to the Cast a Spell activity. You gain a spell repertoire with two common cantrips from the spell list associated with your paradox, from the spells granted by your paradox, or any other cantrips of that tradition you learn or discover. You're trained in the spell attack modifier and spell DC statistics. Your key spellcasting attribute for witchwarper archetype spells is your choice of Intelligence or Charisma, and they are witchwarper spells of your paradox's tradition. You don't gain any other abilities from your choice of paradox.

@UUID[Compendium.sf2e.journals.JournalEntry.vx5FGEG34AxI2dow.JournalEntryPage.0zIwv4pBobwXGZvQ]{Witchwarper}
Witchwarper Dedication.name: Witchwarper Dedication

Without a Trace.description: You're an expert at destroying or removing incriminating evidence from a crime scene. When using the Cover Tracks exploration activity, an yone tracking you must succeed at a Perception check against your @Check[perception|against:deception]{Deception}, @Check[perception|against:stealth]{Stealth}, or @Check[perception|against:underworld-lore]{Underworld Lore} DC (whichever is highest). If you spent 10 minutes cleaning up a crime scene, anyone investigating the scene must succeed at a Perception check against your Deception, Stealth, or Underworld Lore DC (whichever is highest) to uncover any @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.iU0fEDdBp3rXpTMC]{Hidden} evidence.

featPrerequisites.0: trained in Deception, Stealth, or Underworld Lore

Without a Trace.name: Without a Trace

Work's Never Done.description: Your experience as a brood-minder has hardened you, and you can function fully with little to no rest. You require only two hours of sleep to get a full night's rest, rather than eight. You can use exploration activities when @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.HL2l2VRSaQHu9lUw]{Fatigued}.
Work's Never Done.name: Work's Never Done

Working Artist.description: People have noticed the originality and quality of your artistic creations, and you've started moonlighting as a professional artist. You become trained in Crafting or a Lore skill related to art (such as Art Lore or Sculpture Lore). When you succeed or critically succeed on a check to @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.actions.Item.QyzlsLrqM0EEwd7j]{Earn Income} using Crafting or a Lore skill related to art, calculate the amount you earn as if you'd attempted a check one level higher.
Working Artist.name: Working Artist

World Shards.description:
Frequency once per day

You call upon the spinning and beating hearts of every planet you've ever visited and share their true power with your enemies, unleashing a blast of superdense, red-hot iron shards. Each creature in a @Template[type:cone|distance:30] takes @Damage[14d6[piercing]|options:area-damage] damage and @Damage[4d6[persistent,fire]|options:area-damage] damage with a basic Reflex save against the higher of your class DC or spell DC. A creature that fails its save becomes suppressed until the end of your next turn. If you and your targets are in an underground environment, they don't get a bonus to their Reflex saves from standard cover against World Shards but still gain a +2 circumstance bonus to Reflex saves if they have greater cover.
World Shards.name: World Shards

Wormhole.description:
Frequency once per hour

You force a rip in space that acts as a tunnel to a nearby location. Create two wormholes in unoccupied squares in line of effect that are within 100 feet, visible to you, and at least 15 feet apart. When a creature enters a wormhole's space, they emerge in an unoccupied space of their choice adjacent to the other wormhole. A creature that isn't flying treats all spaces lacking solid ground as occupied. If there's no valid space for the creature to enter, then both wormholes collapse and the creature remains in the space where it entered the first wormhole. The wormholes last for 1 round before collapsing, but you can Sustain the wormholes for up to 1 minute. Use your attunement when you take the Wormhole action to determine its attuned effects.

Graviton-Attuned A creature beginning its turn adjacent to a wormhole must succeed at a @Check[fortitude|against:solarian|options:forced-movement] save against your class DC or be pulled into the wormhole.

Photon-Attuned A creature entering the wormhole becomes @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.DmAIPqOBomZ7H95W]{Concealed} until the start of its next turn.
Wormhole.name: Wormhole

Wormhole Warren.description:
Frequency once per hour

You've realized the truth: that the universe is merely a series of tunnels, each connected individually by quantum particles into a massive and infinite warren. Create two wormholes, one adjacent to you, and one in an unoccupied square within 100 feet, visible to you, and at least 15 feet from the one adjacent to you. You immediately Step through the wormhole adjacent to you and appear at the other wormhole. The wormhole lasts for 1 round before collapsing, but you can Sustain the wormholes for up to 1 minute. Other ysoki can travel through your wormholes as well, but if a non-ysoki creature attempts to enter the wormhole, it automatically collapses.
Wormhole Warren.name: Wormhole Warren

Wriggling Contortionist.description: You can wriggle your way around tight spaces without much difficulty, making it hard for others to pin you down. You can ignore difficult terrain caused by moving through tight spaces that aren't tight enough to force you to @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.actions.Item.kMcV8e5EZUxa6evt]{Squeeze}. If you roll a success to Squeeze, you get a critical success instead. Ignore any penalties to Speeds conferred by the suppressed condition.
Wriggling Contortionist.name: Wriggling Contortionist

Wriggling Tail.description:
Trigger You become @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.kWc1fhmv9LBiTuei]{Grabbed}.

Requirements You have a fully grown tail.

You disconnect and drop part of your tail to escape. You cease being grabbed then Step. It takes 1 day (or an effect like @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.spells.Item.2Vkd1IxylPceUAAF]{Regenerate}) for your tail to fully grow back. Until it does, you can't use your tail, and you take a –2 circumstance penalty on checks to [[/act balance]].

Special If you have @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.feats.Item.RdWNYoypgL5dMO0a]{Ancestral Unarmed Attack} (tail), you can eject your tail as a reaction when you take damage from an attack. If you do, you Step and one adjacent square becomes difficult terrain for 1 minute as your tail wriggles in place. If you also have the @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.feats.Item.Q6vXNDmTwDom59GV]{Feign Death} skill feat, you can Feign Death instead of Stepping, with a +2 circumstance bonus to your Deception DC.
Wriggling Tail.name: Wriggling Tail

Xenoarchaeologist Dedication.description:
You become an expert in Society and Thievery and gain a +1 circumstance bonus to @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.actions.Item.1OagaWtBpVXExToo]{Recall Knowledge} checks and Delve Lore checks when using Investigate as your exploration activity.

You gain the @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.feats.Item.BocFD2KV0qgUC76x]{Additional Lore} general feat in Delve Lore, which you can use to Recall Knowledge about sites of archaeological significance, and about ancient history, relics, languages, and peoples. Upon gaining this skill, choose either Intelligence or Wisdom as the key attribute for your Delve Lore checks. This choice is permanent and can't be changed later.

@UUID[Compendium.sf2e.journals.JournalEntry.vx5FGEG34AxI2dow.JournalEntryPage.rk2VU7bKKHd59nBv]{Xenoarchaeologist}

featPrerequisites.0: trained in Society, Thievery, and your choice of Arcana, Nature, Occultism, or Religion

Xenoarchaeologist Dedication.name: Xenoarchaeologist Dedication

Xenodruid Bond.description:
You join a primal order of xenodruids with ties to nature and the biodiversity of the Universe, such as the Xenowardens. Choose one of the following xenodruid orders.

Order Animal; Skill Animal Lore; Spells 1st: @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.spells.Item.gfPjmG6Fe6D3MFjl]{Pest Form}; 2nd: @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.spells.Item.wp09USMB3GIW1qbp]{Animal Form}; 5th: @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.spells.Item.n5a3t5Qnx5AU8auy]{Carcinization}

Order Plant; Skill Plant Lore; Spells 1st: @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.spells.Item.jSRAyd57kd4WZ4yE]{Summon Plant or Fungus}; 2nd: @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.spells.Item.hk2mTLH9DIvNqDuS]{Verdant Code}; 5th: @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.spells.Item.zCcfPS4y5SrZzU2x]{Plant Form}

Order Viral; Skill Genealogy Lore; Spells 1st: @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.spells.Item.QqxwHeYEVylkYjsO]{Detect Poison}; 2nd: @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.spells.Item.mnoTqz0gjRmuc4oR]{Instant Virus}; 5th: @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.spells.Item.MlpbeZ61Euhl0d60]{Toxic Cloud}

You become trained in the listed skill associated with the order and add the listed spells to your spell list and spell repertoire as signature spells. If you were already trained in the listed skill, you instead become trained in another skill of your choice.
Xenodruid Bond.name: Xenodruid Bond

Xenodruid Dedication.description:
You can form a bond with the collective spirit of a world's ecosystems. This is a 10-minute activity that involves communing with nature and meditation. The planet must have an active biosphere. You can only bond with one planet at a time. This counts toward your maximum number of bonds. Planets don't count as creatures nor allies for the purposes of spells, prerequisites, or other abilities, including your vitality network.

You gain a +1 circumstance bonus to Recall Knowledge about your planet's life and natural occurrences. You also gain a +1 circumstance bonus to Survival checks to subsist in its wilds and a +1 circumstance bonus to saving throws against environmental hazards and effects naturally found on your bonded planet. When off-world, you always know the general direction your planet lies in relation to you (but not distance), which grants a +1 circumstance bonus to Piloting checks to navigate.

In addition, you can assess the health of your planet once per day and attempt to locate any major disturbances to its ecosystems. Attempt a @Check[nature|dc:20] check while in contact with your planet.

Critical Success You diagnose the planet's health through its various ecospheres. In addition, you can detect specific ongoing disturbances to the natural world—such as industrial mining or a fire in a particular valley. You can sense the distance and direction of the disturbance and gain a +1 circumstance bonus to saving throws against hazards created by this disturbance.

Success As a critical success, but you can only sense disturbances happening on a massive scale (such as hurricanes, volcanic eruptions, or planetwide pollution) and the direction to it.

Failure You diagnose the planet's health but don't identify any disturbances.

Special You can take this feat if you have the mystic multiclass archetype dedication feat even if you haven't taken two additional mystic feats. Mystic archetype feats count as xenodruid feats, and vice-versa, for purposes of completing the archetypes.

@UUID[Compendium.sf2e.journals.JournalEntry.vx5FGEG34AxI2dow.JournalEntryPage.xDaTqWGIR4LGAsPg]{Xenodruid}

featPrerequisites.1: spellcaster class feature that chooses spells from the primal spell list

Xenodruid Dedication.name: Xenodruid Dedication

Xenogourmand.description:
You love to cook anything you find, even if you really shouldn't. You gain the @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.feats.Item.BocFD2KV0qgUC76x]{Additional Lore} feat with Cooking Lore. You can spend thirty minutes preparing and serving a meal for up to 5 living creatures; when you do so, partaking creatures must attempt a @Check[fortitude|against:cooking-lore] save against your Cooking Lore DC. Your targets are then temporarily immune to xenogourmand for 1 day.

Critical Success The creature feels nourished; they're full for the day and gain temporary Hit Points equal to your level for 1 day.

@UUID[Compendium.sf2e.feat-effects.Item.Yi6NrMHTkm6qgbGS]{Effect: Xenogourmand (Critical Success)}

Success The creature is full for a few hours and gains temporary Hit Points equal to your level for two hours.

@UUID[Compendium.sf2e.feat-effects.Item.DrC3IJz3ePwm6Bmk]{Effect: Xenogourmand (Success)}

Critical Failure Your meal doesn't sit well with the creature's stomach. Unless they're goblins, they're @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.fesd1n5eVhpCSS18]{Sickened 1} and can't reduce their sickened value for 10 minutes.
Xenogourmand.name: Xenogourmand

Yaraesa's Antennae.description: Field agents of the Informational Safety Board and clergy of the Glory In Knowledge Museum codeveloped methods to biomagically cultivate telepathic sensory organs, and you've undergone their regimens and rituals to better serve Yaraesa. You gain limited telepathy, allowing you to communicate mentally with creatures within 30 feet that share a language with you, and they can mentally respond. This doesn't give you any access to their thoughts and communicates no more information than normal speech would.
Yaraesa's Antennae.name: Yaraesa's Antennae

You Can Do It.description:
Requirements Your last action was a 1-action directive.

You motivate an ally within 60 feet to lead by example. As a free action, that ally can immediately perform the lead by example actions of your last action, gaining any benefits and using any abilities that would normally be used as if you used two-actions to issue the direction. Use your Charisma modifier instead of your ally's when determining any relevant benefits, such as the status bonus to damage for Get 'Em!
You Can Do It.name: You Can Do It

You Can't Teach Speed.description:
Frequency once per day

Sometimes, you need to ignore your own limits and run just a little bit faster. When circumstances are dire, you can draw on an inner strength and push your body to go even faster than usual. You gain the @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.nlCjDvLMf2EkV2dl]{Quickened} condition for 3 rounds. You can use the extra action only to [[/act long-jump]] or Stride.
You Can't Teach Speed.name: You Can't Teach Speed

You Should See the Other Guy.description:
Frequency once every 10 minutes

Trigger A creature you can sense critically succeeds on a Strike against you.

You can't stand being shown up in battle, and those who best you face your swift retribution. You Strike the triggering creature.
You Should See the Other Guy.name: You Should See the Other Guy

You'll Have to Go Through Me!.description: You brace yourself as you prepare to defend your allies behind you. You @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.actions.Item.oc0ZKnk5zD0GXqZi]{Area Fire} or @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.actions.Item.6ctkxUnVwqooSvgg]{Auto-Fire}. Until the start of your next turn or until you use a move action, whichever happens first, you gain the @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.actions.Item.lNcZ7j1T2YmMwXF7]{Living Shield} reaction and, if you would be moved by a forced movement effect, you move 10 feet less.
You'll Have to Go Through Me!.name: You'll Have to Go Through Me!

You've Got Mail.description:
Frequency once every 10 minutes

You have a MAIL (Messaging Augmentation Integrated LFAN), which allows you to efficiently communicate information to others by translating it into a form that can be efficiently transmitted to their nervous system. You use your LFAN to transmit information to the nervous system of an adjacent willing creature, imparting to that target an amount of information in an instant that could otherwise be communicated in 10 minutes.

Special As long as you have a MAIL, you gain a special form of limited telepathy that allows you to communicate mentally with any raxilite within 30 feet as long as they share a language with you.
You've Got Mail.name: You've Got Mail

Your Lucky Number.description: You've refined your relationship with the most fickle force in the universe, and you can tap into it with an expertise that people all over the galaxy would envy. At the beginning of each adventuring day, roll 1d20. This number is your lucky number, and the first time you roll it on an attack, check, or save, treat the roll as a 20. If you roll a 20, your lucky number becomes 1 instead.
Your Lucky Number.name: Your Lucky Number

Ysoki Lore.description:
Years of experience living among ysoki communities have trained your nimble steps and sneaky moves. You gain the trained proficiency rank in Acrobatics and Stealth. If you would automatically become trained in one of those skills (from your background or class, for example), you instead become trained in a skill of your choice.

You also gain the @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.feats.Item.BocFD2KV0qgUC76x]{Additional Lore} general feat for Ysoki Lore.
Ysoki Lore.name: Ysoki Lore

Zero-G Tail.description: You can use your nimble tail to maneuver in zero gravity. You can Float up to your Speed when you @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.actions.Item.FF5KgZHj345s2moq]{Push Off} using your tail instead of up to half your Speed. In addition, you can spend your reaction to [[/act grab-an-edge]] at any point in your movement while Floating that you pass adjacent to an object, halting your movement immediately if you succeed at your check.
Zero-G Tail.name: Zero-G Tail

Zero-G Training.description:
You have spent time working in zero gravity and are able to keep your stomach even when floating freely. The interior of asteroids or ships that have lost power are easily navigable for you.

You can use your legs to @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.actions.Item.FF5KgZHj345s2moq]{Push Off} while in zero-g without needing a free hand. You can ignore the @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.i3OJZU2nk64Df3xm]{Clumsy} and @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.AJh5ex99aV6VTggg]{Off-Guard} penalties while @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.z1ucw4CLwLqHoAp3]{Untethered} in zero gravity.
Zero-G Training.name: Zero-G Training

Zone Overlap.description:
Requirements Your quantum field is active with one zone affecting it.

You cause a second zone to overlap your quantum field. You can choose to apply another zone you're able to create, or apply the existing zone again, improving its effects as follows: @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.feats.Item.ryCmTz9Z62qbtmQM]{Danger Zone} deals 1 extra damage, @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.feats.Item.sW7AbeYfKc8OH7nG]{Debris Zone} becomes greater difficult terrain, and @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.feats.Item.rTebGqlQpa420YQy]{Twisted Dark Zone} ignores the temporary immunity of creatures that previously critically succeeded at the save for 1 round.
Zone Overlap.name: Zone Overlap

Zoomies.description:
Frequency once per day

You unleash your pent up energy in a flurry of unpredictable motion. You gain the @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.nlCjDvLMf2EkV2dl]{Quickened} condition for 4 rounds. You can use the extra action each round only to Stride.
Zoomies.name: Zoomies
